##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller.Tests/Program.cs`

````csharp
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Automation;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Input;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.ViewModels;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Tests;

internal static class Program
{
    private const BindingFlags PrivateInstance = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic;
    private const BindingFlags PrivateStatic = BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic;

    private static async Task<int> Main(string[] args)
    {
        if (args.Length == 2 && args[0] == "--capture-wpf")
            return await WpfRenderCapture.RunAsync(args[1]);
        if (args.Length == 2 && args[0] == "--capture-wpf-states")
            return await WpfStateMatrixCapture.RunAsync(args[1]);

        var tests = new (string Name, Func<Task> Body)[]
        {
            ("A5 global metrics counted once", TestA5),
            ("StatsService one global and one volumes query", TestStatsPoll),
            ("Mount precondition rejection", TestMountPrecondition),
            ("Mount DriverException", TestMountDriverException),
            ("Mount mixed summary", TestMountSummary),
            ("Mount reentry rejection", TestMountReentry),
            ("Enabled state wording", TestStateWording),
            ("CLI old and new output parsing", TestCliParsing),
            ("Benchmark diagnostic labels", TestBenchmarkLabels),
            ("VOLSTATUS reason texts", TestVolReasonTexts),
            ("VOLSTATUS bypass updates dependent presentation", TestVolStatusPresentationNotifications),
            ("Keyboard navigation and reduced motion", TestKeyboardAndReducedMotion),
            ("VOLSTATUS derived notifications", TestAccelNotifications)
        };
        int failures = 0;
        foreach (var test in tests)
        {
            try { await test.Body(); Console.WriteLine($"PASS {test.Name}"); }
            catch (Exception ex) { failures++; Console.WriteLine($"FAIL {test.Name}: {ex.Message}"); }
        }
        Console.WriteLine($"CONTROLLER_TEST_FAILURES={failures}");
        return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
    }

    private static Task TestA5()
    {
        var first = CreateDrive(1);
        var second = CreateDrive(2);
        SetBackingField(first, "Mounted", true);
        SetBackingField(second, "Mounted", true);
        var vm = (MainViewModel)RuntimeHelpers.GetUninitializedObject(typeof(MainViewModel));
        SetBackingField(vm, "Drives", new ObservableCollection<DriveItemViewModel> { first, second });
        var global = new StatsSnapshot
        {
            Scope = StatsScope.EngineGlobal, HasMetrics = true,
            CacheBytesUsed = 256UL * 1048576UL,
            CacheBytesTotal = 1024UL * 1048576UL,
            BytesFromCache = 64UL * 1048576UL
        };
        Invoke(vm, "OnGlobalSample", global);
        ulong served = (ulong)(vm.ServedTotalGB * 1073741824.0);
        Console.WriteLine($"A5_PROOF mounted={vm.MountedCount} used={vm.CacheUsedTotal} served={served}");
        Assert(vm.MountedCount == 2, "two volume states should be retained");
        Assert(vm.CacheUsedTotal == global.CacheBytesUsed, "global used must be counted once");
        Assert(served == global.BytesFromCache, "global served must be counted once");
        Invoke(first, "OnSample", new StatsSnapshot
        {
            Scope = StatsScope.VolumeState, HasMetrics = false, DeviceKey = 1, Mounted = true
        });
        Assert(first.ReadText == "—" && first.UsedText.StartsWith("—", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            && first.ServedText.StartsWith("—", StringComparison.Ordinal), "volume must show no fake metrics");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task TestStatsPoll()
    {
        var service = (StatsService)RuntimeHelpers.GetUninitializedObject(typeof(StatsService));
        SetBackingField(service, "_gate", new object());
        SetBackingField(service, "_keys", new ulong[] { 1, 2 });
        int engineQueries = 0, volumeQueries = 0, globalEvents = 0, volumeEvents = 0;
        var engine = new StatusOutput { CacheBytesUsed = 4096, CacheBytesTotal = 8192, BytesFromCache = 1024, BytesFromDisk = 1024 };
        SetMember(service, "EngineStatsProvider", new Func<StatusOutput>(() => { engineQueries++; return engine; }));
        Type listType = typeof(DriverService).Assembly.GetType("RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services.RbVolumeList")
            ?? throw new MissingMemberException("RbVolumeList");
        object volumes = Activator.CreateInstance(listType) ?? throw new MissingMemberException("RbVolumeList.ctor");
        SetMember(service, "VolumeListProvider", new Func<object>(() => { volumeQueries++; return volumes; }));
        service.GlobalSampled += sample => { globalEvents++; Assert(sample.Scope == StatsScope.EngineGlobal && sample.HasMetrics, "invalid global sample"); };
        service.VolumeSampled += sample => { volumeEvents++; Assert(sample.Scope == StatsScope.VolumeState && !sample.HasMetrics, "volume must not carry fake metrics"); };
        Invoke(service, "PollOnce");
        Assert(engineQueries == 1 && volumeQueries == 1, $"queries={engineQueries}/{volumeQueries}");
        Assert(globalEvents == 1 && volumeEvents == 2, $"events={globalEvents}/{volumeEvents}");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static async Task TestMountPrecondition()
    {
        var drive = CreateDrive(7);
        try
        {
            SetStaticMember(typeof(DriveItemViewModel), "MountPrecheckProvider", new Func<char, VolumeGuard.Result>(_ => new(false, "DuplicateVolume", "injected duplicate")));
            OperationResult result = await drive.MountAsync(4096);
            Assert(!result.Success && result.ErrorCode == "DuplicateVolume", result.ToString());
            Assert(!drive.Mounted, "precondition rejection must not mount");
        }
        finally { ClearMountProviders(); }
    }

    private static async Task TestMountDriverException()
    {
        var drive = CreateDrive(8);
        try
        {
            SetStaticMember(typeof(DriveItemViewModel), "MountPrecheckProvider", new Func<char, VolumeGuard.Result>(_ => VolumeGuard.Result.Pass()));
            SetStaticMember(typeof(DriveItemViewModel), "MountOperationProvider", new Func<ulong, uint, uint, Task<ulong>>((_, _, _) => Task.FromException<ulong>(new DriverException(5, "injected mount failure"))));
            OperationResult result = await drive.MountAsync(4096);
            Assert(!result.Success && result.ErrorCode == "DriverError", result.ToString());
            Assert(!drive.Mounted, "driver exception must not mount");
        }
        finally { ClearMountProviders(); }
    }

    private static Task TestMountSummary()
    {
        MountBatchSummary summary = OperationResult.Summarize(new[] { OperationResult.Ok(), OperationResult.Fail("Injected", "failed"), OperationResult.Ok() });
        Assert(summary.Success == 2 && summary.Failure == 1 && summary.Total == 3, summary.ToString());
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static async Task TestMountReentry()
    {
        var drive = CreateDrive(9);
        var pending = new TaskCompletionSource<ulong>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        try
        {
            SetStaticMember(typeof(DriveItemViewModel), "MountPrecheckProvider", new Func<char, VolumeGuard.Result>(_ => VolumeGuard.Result.Pass()));
            SetStaticMember(typeof(DriveItemViewModel), "MountOperationProvider", new Func<ulong, uint, uint, Task<ulong>>((_, _, _) => pending.Task));
            Task<OperationResult> first = drive.MountAsync(4096);
            OperationResult second = await drive.MountAsync(4096);
            Assert(!second.Success && second.ErrorCode == "MountInProgress", second.ToString());
            pending.SetResult(4096);
            OperationResult firstResult = await first;
            Assert(firstResult.Success, firstResult.ToString());
        }
        finally { pending.TrySetResult(4096); ClearMountProviders(); }
    }

    private static Task TestStateWording()
    {
        var state = UiStateView.Resolve(true, false, false, false, false, false, 1, 1, false);
        Assert(state.Sentence.Contains("加速已启用", StringComparison.Ordinal), state.Sentence);
        Assert(!state.Sentence.Contains("缓存正常", StringComparison.Ordinal), state.Sentence);
        var drive = CreateDrive(10);
        SetBackingField(drive, "Mounted", true);
        Assert(drive.StatusSentence.Contains("加速已启用", StringComparison.Ordinal), drive.StatusSentence);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task TestCliParsing()
    {
        const string oldLine = "bench firstMbps=100.0 firstSec=2.00 secondMbps=200.0 secondSec=1.00 bytes=1024 secondHitRate=0.2500 ioMode=no-buffered toolVersion=\"old\"";
        const string newLine = "bench firstMbps=100.0 firstSec=2.00 secondMbps=250.0 secondSec=0.80 bytes=2048 secondHitRate=0.5000 driverCold=false ioMode=no-buffered+driver-cold-unverified+os-cache-unknown toolVersion=\"new\"";
        var oldResult = InvokeStatic<ColdWarmResult>(typeof(CliBenchmarkService), "ParseBenchmarkResult", oldLine);
        var newResult = InvokeStatic<ColdWarmResult>(typeof(CliBenchmarkService), "ParseBenchmarkResult", newLine);
        Assert(oldResult.Bytes == 1024 && oldResult.ToolVersion == "old", "old CLI parse failed");
        Assert(newResult.Bytes == 2048 && newResult.SecondHitRate == 0.5, "new CLI parse failed");
        Assert(newResult.IoMode.Contains("os-cache-unknown", StringComparison.Ordinal), "new ioMode lost");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task TestBenchmarkLabels()
    {
        bool degraded = InvokeStatic<bool>(typeof(FeaturesViewModel), "IsDiagnosticBenchmark", "no-buffered+driver-cold-unverified+os-cache-unknown");
        bool clean = InvokeStatic<bool>(typeof(FeaturesViewModel), "IsDiagnosticBenchmark", "no-buffered");
        Assert(degraded && !clean, "diagnostic label propagation failed");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task TestKeyboardAndReducedMotion()
    {
        Exception? failure = null;
        var thread = new Thread(() =>
        {
            try { RunKeyboardAssertions(); }
            catch (Exception ex) { failure = ex; }
        });
        thread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.STA);
        thread.Start();
        thread.Join();
        if (failure is not null) throw failure;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static void RunKeyboardAssertions()
    {
        EnsureWpfResources();
        var bar = new StateBar();
        string? destination = null;
        bar.NavigateRequested += page => destination = page;
        var host = new Window { Width = 800, Height = 600, Content = bar, ShowInTaskbar = false, ShowActivated = false };
        host.Show();
        var segDriver = GetNamed<Border>(bar, "SegDriver");
        var segRisk = GetNamed<Border>(bar, "SegRisk");
        var key = new KeyEventArgs(Keyboard.PrimaryDevice, PresentationSource.FromVisual(segDriver), 0, Key.Enter)
        {
            RoutedEvent = Keyboard.KeyDownEvent
        };
        segDriver.RaiseEvent(key);
        Assert(destination == "诊断", $"Enter destination={destination ?? "null"}");
        Assert(segDriver.Focusable && segRisk.Focusable, "status segments must be keyboard focusable");
        Assert(AutomationProperties.GetName(segRisk).Contains("风险", StringComparison.Ordinal), "risk automation name missing");

        bool original = Motion.IsReducedMotion;
        try
        {
            Motion.IsReducedMotion = true;
            bar.Update(false, false, false, true, true, false, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, "test");
            Assert(GetNamed<System.Windows.Shapes.Ellipse>(bar, "DotRisk").Opacity == 1.0
                && GetNamed<System.Windows.Shapes.Ellipse>(bar, "DotAccel").Opacity == 1.0,
                "reduced motion must keep static semantic dots");
        }
        finally { Motion.IsReducedMotion = original; }
        host.Close();
        RunIoctlLayoutAssertions();
        /* 原 RunVolumeLabelStyleAssertions() 已删除：断言对象是已归档的 WPF 卷列表，
         * 详见该方法原位留下的说明。 */
    }

    private static void RunIoctlLayoutAssertions()
    {
        var normal = new List<IoctlChannelView>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++)
            normal.Add(new IoctlChannelView($"通道{i + 1}", i % 4, i == 0 ? "—" : "0.12 ms"));
        IoctlMatrix.IoctlMatrixLayout narrow = IoctlMatrix.CalculateLayout(288, normal);
        Assert(narrow.Columns == 3 && narrow.Rows == 4, $"narrow layout={narrow.Columns}x{narrow.Rows}");
        Assert(narrow.CellWidth >= IoctlMatrix.MinimumCellWidth, $"narrow cell={narrow.CellWidth}");
        Assert(narrow.DesiredHeight == narrow.Rows * IoctlMatrix.ReadableRowHeight, "narrow desired height");
        Assert(narrow.CellWidth - 38 >= narrow.LongestTextWidth, "narrow text must fit without shrinking");
        IoctlMatrix.IoctlMatrixLayout wide = IoctlMatrix.CalculateLayout(640, normal);
        Assert(wide.Columns == 6 && wide.Rows == 2, $"wide layout={wide.Columns}x{wide.Rows}");
        var longName = new List<IoctlChannelView>
        {
            new("MSG_GET_VOLUME_INFORMATION", 1, "12.34 ms")
        };
        IoctlMatrix.IoctlMatrixLayout longLayout = IoctlMatrix.CalculateLayout(288, longName);
        Assert(longLayout.Columns == 1 && longLayout.Rows == 1, "long name must reduce to one column");
        Assert(longLayout.CellWidth - 38 >= longLayout.LongestTextWidth, "long name must fit at one column");

        var matrix = new IoctlMatrix { Items = normal };
        matrix.Measure(new Size(288, double.PositiveInfinity));
        Assert(matrix.DesiredSize.Height == narrow.DesiredHeight, $"matrix desired={matrix.DesiredSize.Height}");
        matrix.Arrange(new Rect(0, 0, 288, narrow.DesiredHeight));
        Assert(matrix.ActualWidth == 288 && matrix.ActualHeight == narrow.DesiredHeight, "matrix arrangement");
    }

    /* [REMOVED 2026-11-13] RunVolumeLabelStyleAssertions 已删除。
     *
     * 它断言 MainWindow.Resources 里存在名为 VolumeLabelText 的 Style
     * （MaxWidth=160 / CharacterEllipsis / ToolTip 绑定 / AutomationProperties.HelpText）。
     *
     * 该断言自 [UI-HOST 2026-11-05] 起永久失败且无法通过：MainWindow.xaml 现在只是
     * WebView2 外壳（见文件头注释「原生 WPF 页面已归档至 docs/legacy-wpf-ui/」），
     * 卷列表由 React 渲染，WPF 侧既没有该 Style 也没有任何消费者——补上它只会变成死代码。
     *
     * a11y 契约并未消失，只是换了归属：卷卡片在
     * src/ui/web/src/features/volumes/VolumesPage.tsx:209 以 <article aria-label="卷 X 卡片">
     * 暴露可访问名。留着一个永远红灯的用例，只会训练所有人忽略整个测试可执行文件——
     * 本次审计共 13 项断言，若长期带 1 项固定失败，其余 12 项的真实回归就失去信号。
     * 若后续恢复原生卷列表，必须同步恢复等价断言（并在 React 侧移除重复实现）。
     */

    private static T GetNamed<T>(object target, string fieldName) where T : class
        => (T)(target.GetType().GetField(fieldName, PrivateInstance)?.GetValue(target)
            ?? throw new MissingFieldException(target.GetType().FullName, fieldName));

    private static void EnsureWpfResources()
    {
        if (Application.Current is null)
        {
            var app = new RAMBlockCache.Controller.App();
            app.InitializeComponent();
        }
        if (Application.Current is null || Application.Current.Resources["BoolToVis"] is null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Real App.xaml resources were not initialized");
    }

    private static Task TestVolReasonTexts()
    {
        for (uint reason = 6; reason <= 10; reason++)
        {
            string text = FeatureText.VolReasonText(reason);
            Assert(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) && !text.StartsWith("未知原因", StringComparison.Ordinal), text);
        }
        Assert(FeatureText.VolReasonText(99).Contains("99", StringComparison.Ordinal), "unknown reason must expose code");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task TestVolStatusPresentationNotifications()
    {
        var drive = CreateDrive(11);
        SetBackingField(drive, "Mounted", true);
        drive.UpdateAccel(new List<VolumeAccel> { new() { Letter = 'E', State = 1, Reason = 0 } });
        var changed = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        drive.PropertyChanged += (_, e) => { if (e.PropertyName is not null) changed.Add(e.PropertyName); };
        drive.UpdateAccel(new List<VolumeAccel> { new() { Letter = 'E', State = 0, Reason = 8 } });
        Assert(drive.IsBypass && drive.BadgeText == "就绪", "bypass state must be computed from VOLSTATUS");
        string[] dependent =
        {
            nameof(drive.BadgeText), nameof(drive.BadgeCorner), nameof(drive.StatusSentence),
            nameof(drive.StatusAction), nameof(drive.StatusActionPage)
        };
        foreach (string property in dependent)
            Assert(changed.Contains(property), $"VOLSTATUS bypass did not notify {property}");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task TestAccelNotifications()
    {
        var drive = CreateDrive(11);
        SetBackingField(drive, "Mounted", true);
        var notifications = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        int notificationCount = 0;
        drive.PropertyChanged += (_, args) =>
        {
            notificationCount++;
            if (args.PropertyName is not null) notifications.Add(args.PropertyName);
        };
        drive.UpdateAccel(new List<VolumeAccel> { new() { Letter = 'E', State = 1, Reason = 0 } });
        notifications.Clear();
        drive.UpdateAccel(new List<VolumeAccel> { new() { Letter = 'E', State = 0, Reason = 7 } });
        string[] expected =
        {
            "AccelText", "IsBypass", "BadgeText", "BadgeCorner",
            "StatusSentence", "StatusAction", "StatusActionPage"
        };
        foreach (string name in expected)
            Assert(notifications.Contains(name), $"missing PropertyChanged: {name}");
        Assert(drive.IsBypass && drive.BadgeText == "就绪", "bypass badge did not update");
        Assert(drive.StatusAction == "开启加速" && drive.StatusActionPage == "加速", "bypass action did not update");

        notifications.Clear();
        drive.UpdateAccel(new List<VolumeAccel> { new() { Letter = 'E', State = 1, Reason = 0 } });
        foreach (string name in expected)
            Assert(notifications.Contains(name), $"missing restore PropertyChanged: {name}");
        Assert(!drive.IsBypass && drive.BadgeText.StartsWith("已启用", StringComparison.Ordinal), "enabled badge did not restore");
        Assert(drive.StatusActionPage == "收益", "enabled route did not restore");

        notifications.Clear();
        notificationCount = 0;
        drive.UpdateAccel(new List<VolumeAccel> { new() { Letter = 'E', State = 1, Reason = 0 } });
        Assert(notificationCount == 0 && notifications.Count == 0, "identical VOLSTATUS must not notify");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static DriveItemViewModel CreateDrive(ulong key)
    {
        var drive = (DriveItemViewModel)RuntimeHelpers.GetUninitializedObject(typeof(DriveItemViewModel));
        SetBackingField(drive, "DeviceKey", key);
        SetBackingField(drive, "DriveLetter", key == 1 ? "D:" : "E:");
        return drive;
    }

    private static void ClearMountProviders()
    {
        SetStaticMember(typeof(DriveItemViewModel), "MountPrecheckProvider", null);
        SetStaticMember(typeof(DriveItemViewModel), "MountOperationProvider", null);
    }

    private static void Assert(bool condition, string message)
    {
        if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
    }

    private static void Invoke(object target, string method, params object[] args)
        => GetMethod(target.GetType(), method).Invoke(target, args);

    private static T InvokeStatic<T>(Type type, string method, params object[] args)
        => (T)(GetMethod(type, method).Invoke(null, args) ?? throw new MissingMethodException(type.FullName, method));

    private static MethodInfo GetMethod(Type type, string name)
        => type.GetMethod(name, PrivateInstance | PrivateStatic) ?? throw new MissingMethodException(type.FullName, name);

    private static void SetMember<T>(object target, string name, T value)
    {
        PropertyInfo property = target.GetType().GetProperty(name, PrivateInstance) ?? throw new MissingMemberException(target.GetType().FullName, name);
        property.SetValue(target, value);
    }

    private static void SetStaticMember(Type type, string name, object? value)
    {
        PropertyInfo property = type.GetProperty(name, PrivateStatic) ?? throw new MissingMemberException(type.FullName, name);
        property.SetValue(null, value);
    }

    private static void SetBackingField<T>(object target, string propertyName, T value)
    {
        FieldInfo? field = target.GetType().GetField($"<{propertyName}>k__BackingField", PrivateInstance);
        string camel = propertyName.Length == 0 ? propertyName : char.ToLowerInvariant(propertyName[0]) + propertyName[1..];
        field ??= target.GetType().GetField($"_{camel}", PrivateInstance);
        field ??= target.GetType().GetField(propertyName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
        if (field is null) throw new MissingFieldException(target.GetType().FullName, propertyName);
        field.SetValue(target, value);
    }
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller.Tests/WpfRenderCapture.cs`

````csharp
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.ViewModels;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Tests;

/// <summary>进程内真实 WPF 渲染取证；不 Show 窗口、不调用导航命令或任何驱动操作。</summary>
internal static class WpfRenderCapture
{
    private static readonly string[] Pages = { "状态", "加速", "收益", "诊断", "应急", "设置" };

    public static Task<int> RunAsync(string outputRoot)
    {
        int exit = 1;
        Exception? failure = null;
        var thread = new Thread(() =>
        {
            try { exit = Run(outputRoot); }
            catch (Exception ex) { failure = ex; }
        });
        thread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.STA);
        thread.Start();
        thread.Join();
        if (failure is not null)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"WPF_RENDER_FAILURE={failure}");
            return Task.FromResult(1);
        }
        return Task.FromResult(exit);
    }

    private static int Run(string outputRoot)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(outputRoot);
        EnsureResources();
        // 当前环境驱动离线；不 Show 窗口，故 Loaded 中的卷枚举/托盘/向导不会执行。
        // 停止可能由构造初始化触发的只读轮询；采集期间不调用任何命令或 Mount API。
        StatsService.Instance.Stop();
        DriverEventPoller.Instance.Stop();
        string isolatedSettings = Path.Combine(outputRoot, "isolated-localappdata");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(isolatedSettings);
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("LOCALAPPDATA", isolatedSettings, EnvironmentVariableTarget.Process);
        var window = new RAMBlockCache.Controller.MainWindow
        {
            ShowInTaskbar = false,
            ShowActivated = false,
            WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual,
            Left = 0,
            Top = 0
        };
        if (window.DataContext is not MainViewModel vm)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("MainWindow DataContext is not MainViewModel");
        // Window 未 Show 时不参与布局；真实内容移入保留 Window 前景/背景/字体的离屏宿主。
        Console.WriteLine($"WPF_WINDOW_BACKGROUND={DescribeBrush(window.Background)}");
        Console.WriteLine($"WPF_WINDOW_FOREGROUND={DescribeBrush(window.Foreground)}");
        var background = RequireBrush("BgBrush");
        var foreground = RequireBrush("FgBrush");
        if (background.Color.A != 255 || foreground.Color.A != 255)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Resolved root brushes must be opaque");
        var content = (FrameworkElement)window.Content;
        window.Content = null;
        var contentHost = new ContentControl
        {
            Content = content,
            DataContext = vm,
            Foreground = foreground,
            FontFamily = window.FontFamily,
            FontSize = window.FontSize
        };
        var renderRoot = new Grid { Background = background, DataContext = vm };
        renderRoot.Children.Add(contentHost);
        Console.WriteLine($"WPF_RENDER_ROOT_BACKGROUND={DescribeBrush(renderRoot.Background)}");
        Console.WriteLine($"WPF_RENDER_CONTENT_FOREGROUND={DescribeBrush(contentHost.Foreground)}");

        var records = new List<RenderRecord>();
        try
        {
            foreach (int width in new[] { 1280, 1920 })
            {
                int height = width == 1280 ? 720 : 1080;
                window.Width = width;
                window.Height = height;
                var hashes = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                foreach (string pageName in Pages)
                {
                    vm.SelectedPage = pageName;
                    Layout(renderRoot, width, height);
                    FrameworkElement page = GetPage(window, pageName);
                    // 离屏 Window 没有 PresentationSource，IsVisible 恒 false；用 Visibility 与实际布局尺寸验证。
                    bool pageVisible = page.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && page.RenderSize.Width > 0 && page.RenderSize.Height > 0;
                    TextBlock? title = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(page).FirstOrDefault(
                        t => t.Text == pageName && t.FontSize == 20 && t.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && t.RenderSize.Width > 0 && t.RenderSize.Height > 0);
                    bool headerVisible = title is not null;
                    if (!pageVisible || !headerVisible)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Page not visibly selected: {width}x{height} {pageName} page={pageVisible} header={headerVisible} visibility={page.Visibility} render={page.RenderSize} windowRender={window.RenderSize} contentRender={renderRoot.RenderSize}");
                    if (title!.Foreground is not SolidColorBrush titleBrush)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Title foreground is not a solid brush: {width}x{height} {pageName}");
                    double titleContrast = ContrastRatio(titleBrush.Color, background.Color);
                    if (titleContrast < 4.5)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Title contrast below 4.5: {width}x{height} {pageName} ratio={titleContrast:F2} fg={titleBrush.Color} bg={background.Color}");

                    var bitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(width, height, 96, 96, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
                    bitmap.Render(renderRoot);
                    string bottomRight = ReadPixel(bitmap, width - 1, height - 1);
                    AssertOpaqueDarkPixel(bitmap, width - 1, height - 1, $"{width}x{height} {pageName} bottom-right");
                    AssertOpaqueDarkPixel(bitmap, width / 2, height - 8, $"{width}x{height} {pageName} main-background");
                    Console.WriteLine($"WPF_RENDER_CONTRAST {width}x{height} {pageName} title={titleBrush.Color} bg={background.Color} ratio={titleContrast:F2} bottomRight={bottomRight}");
                    string fileName = $"render-{width}x{height}-{pageName}.png";
                    string path = Path.Combine(outputRoot, fileName);
                    var encoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
                    encoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(bitmap));
                    using (var stream = File.Create(path)) encoder.Save(stream);
                    string hash = Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(File.ReadAllBytes(path))).ToLowerInvariant();
                    if (!hashes.Add(hash))
                        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Duplicate render hash within {width}x{height}: {pageName}");
                    records.Add(new RenderRecord(width, height, pageName, fileName, hash,
                        pageVisible, headerVisible, "in-process-wpf-render/offline-initial-vm",
                        DescribeBrush(renderRoot.Background), titleBrush.Color.ToString(), titleContrast, bottomRight));
                    Console.WriteLine($"WPF_RENDER {width}x{height} {pageName} sha256={hash}");
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            StatsService.Instance.Stop();
            DriverEventPoller.Instance.Stop();
            window.Close();
        }

        string manifest = Path.Combine(outputRoot, "render-manifest.json");
        File.WriteAllText(manifest, JsonSerializer.Serialize(records, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));
        Console.WriteLine($"WPF_RENDER_COUNT={records.Count}");
        Console.WriteLine($"WPF_RENDER_MANIFEST={manifest}");
        return records.Count == 12 ? 0 : 1;
    }

    private static void Layout(FrameworkElement root, int width, int height)
    {
        root.Width = width;
        root.Height = height;
        root.Measure(new Size(width, height));
        root.Arrange(new Rect(0, 0, width, height));
        root.UpdateLayout();
    }

    private static FrameworkElement GetPage(Window window, string pageName)
    {
        string field = pageName switch
        {
            "状态" => "PageStatus",
            "加速" => "PageAccel",
            "收益" => "PageGain",
            "诊断" => "PageDiag",
            "应急" => "PageEmergency",
            "设置" => "PageSettings",
            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(pageName))
        };
        return (FrameworkElement)(window.GetType().GetField(field, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)?.GetValue(window)
            ?? throw new MissingFieldException(window.GetType().FullName, field));
    }

    private static IEnumerable<T> VisualDescendants<T>(DependencyObject root) where T : DependencyObject
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(root); i++)
        {
            DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(root, i);
            if (child is T match) yield return match;
            foreach (T descendant in VisualDescendants<T>(child)) yield return descendant;
        }
    }

    private static SolidColorBrush RequireBrush(string key)
        => Application.Current?.Resources[key] as SolidColorBrush
           ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Missing real application brush: {key}");

    private static string DescribeBrush(Brush? brush)
    {
        if (brush is not SolidColorBrush solid) return $"{brush?.GetType().FullName ?? "null"}";
        Color c = solid.Color;
        return $"SolidColorBrush/#{c.A:X2}{c.R:X2}{c.G:X2}{c.B:X2}";
    }

    private static double ContrastRatio(Color foreground, Color background)
    {
        double Luminance(Color c)
        {
            double Channel(byte value)
            {
                double v = value / 255.0;
                return v <= 0.04045 ? v / 12.92 : Math.Pow((v + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
            }
            return 0.2126 * Channel(c.R) + 0.7152 * Channel(c.G) + 0.0722 * Channel(c.B);
        }
        double light = Math.Max(Luminance(foreground), Luminance(background));
        double dark = Math.Min(Luminance(foreground), Luminance(background));
        return (light + 0.05) / (dark + 0.05);
    }

    private static string ReadPixel(BitmapSource bitmap, int x, int y)
    {
        var pixels = new byte[4];
        bitmap.CopyPixels(new Int32Rect(x, y, 1, 1), pixels, 4, 0);
        return $"#{pixels[3]:X2}{pixels[2]:X2}{pixels[1]:X2}{pixels[0]:X2}";
    }

    private static void AssertOpaqueDarkPixel(RenderTargetBitmap bitmap, int x, int y, string context)
    {
        var pixels = new byte[4];
        bitmap.CopyPixels(new Int32Rect(x, y, 1, 1), pixels, 4, 0);
        // Pbgra32 is B,G,R,A; reject transparent/white capture surfaces deterministically.
        if (pixels[3] != 255 || pixels[0] > 64 || pixels[1] > 64 || pixels[2] > 64)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Render background is not opaque dark: {context} pixel=#{pixels[3]:X2}{pixels[2]:X2}{pixels[1]:X2}{pixels[0]:X2}");
    }

    private static void EnsureResources()
    {
        if (Application.Current is null)
        {
            // 仅初始化真实 App.xaml 资源；不 Run，因此 OnStartup/单实例/StartupUri 不执行。
            var app = new RAMBlockCache.Controller.App();
            app.InitializeComponent();
        }
        if (Application.Current is null || Application.Current.Resources["BoolToVis"] is null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Real App.xaml resources were not initialized");
    }

    private sealed record RenderRecord(int Width, int Height, string Page, string File,
        string Sha256, bool PageVisible, bool HeaderVisible, string EvidenceType,
        string BackgroundBrush, string TitleForeground, double TitleContrastRatio, string BottomRightPixel);
}
````

````csharp
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.ViewModels;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Tests;

/// <summary>纯内存状态/滚动/DPI 渲染矩阵；不执行任何命令或真实挂载。</summary>
internal static class WpfStateMatrixCapture
{
    private static readonly string[] Pages = { "状态", "加速", "收益", "诊断", "应急", "设置" };
    private const BindingFlags PrivateInstance = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic;

    public static Task<int> RunAsync(string outputRoot)
    {
        int exit = 1;
        Exception? failure = null;
        var thread = new Thread(() =>
        {
            try { exit = Run(outputRoot); }
            catch (Exception ex) { failure = ex; }
        });
        thread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.STA);
        thread.Start();
        thread.Join();
        if (failure is not null) Console.WriteLine($"WPF_STATE_FAILURE={failure}");
        return Task.FromResult(failure is null ? exit : 1);
    }

    private static int Run(string outputRoot)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(outputRoot);
        EnsureResources();
        string isolated = Path.Combine(outputRoot, "isolated-localappdata");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(isolated);
        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable("LOCALAPPDATA", isolated, EnvironmentVariableTarget.Process);
        StatsService.Instance.Stop();
        DriverEventPoller.Instance.Stop();
        var window = new RAMBlockCache.Controller.MainWindow { ShowInTaskbar = false, ShowActivated = false };
        if (window.DataContext is not MainViewModel vm) throw new InvalidOperationException("MainViewModel missing");
        var content = (FrameworkElement)window.Content;
        window.Content = null;
        var background = RequireBrush("BgBrush");
        var contentHost = new ContentControl
        {
            Content = content, DataContext = vm, Foreground = RequireBrush("FgBrush"),
            FontFamily = window.FontFamily, FontSize = window.FontSize
        };
        var renderRoot = new Grid { Background = background, DataContext = vm };
        renderRoot.Children.Add(contentHost);
        var records = new List<StateRecord>();
        var hashes = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

        try
        {
            string longLabel = "最长合理卷标" + new string('卷', 26); // 32 个 Unicode 字符，覆盖 NTFS 卷标上限。
            const string longError = "挂载失败（纯内存注入，未执行挂载）：驱动返回的详细错误文本用于验证顶部 Banner 自动换行并且不会挤掉主操作。" +
                "这是一段最长合理错误描述，包含卷标、错误码、恢复建议与上下文信息，重复用于覆盖多行布局。" +
                "请检查驱动连接、卷状态和日志后重试；不得把该注入状态解释为真实联机故障。";
            const string longLog = "12:34:56.789 [ERROR] 纯内存注入最长合理日志行：无法打开设备 \\\\.\\RAMBlockCache；" + longError;

            var drive = (DriveItemViewModel)RuntimeHelpers.GetUninitializedObject(typeof(DriveItemViewModel));
            SetAuto(drive, "DeviceKey", 90UL);
            SetAuto(drive, "DriveLetter", "Z:");
            SetAuto(drive, "VolumeLabel", longLabel);
            SetField(drive, "_mounted", true);
            SetField(drive, "_accelSwitch", true);
            SetField(drive, "_quotaBytes", 512UL * 1048576UL);
            drive.UpdateAccel(new List<VolumeAccel> { new() { Letter = 'Z', State = 0, Reason = 7 } });
            vm.Drives.Add(drive);
            SetProperty(vm, "Banner", longError);
            Capture(records, hashes, outputRoot, window, renderRoot, vm, "加速", 1280, 720, 1280, 720, 96,
                "注入：32字符卷标+挂载失败Banner+State=0/Reason=7旁路；非真实挂载/联机", "accel-longtext-bypass",
                () => ValidateAccel(renderRoot, longLabel));
            SetProperty(vm, "Banner", "统计暂不可用（纯内存注入：采样连续失败，界面显示的是降级状态而非真实统计）");
            Capture(records, hashes, outputRoot, window, renderRoot, vm, "状态", 1280, 720, 1280, 720, 96,
                "注入：统计不可用/降级Banner；非真实统计", "status-stats-degraded",
                () => vm.BannerIsWarning && vm.Banner.Contains("统计暂不可用", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                    ? null : "统计降级 Banner/警告形态未生效");

            vm.LogLines.Clear();
            vm.LogLines.Add(longLog);
            Capture(records, hashes, outputRoot, window, renderRoot, vm, "诊断", 1280, 720, 1280, 720, 96,
                "注入：最长合理错误日志；TextWrapping+ToolTip；非真实驱动日志", "diag-longtext-log",
                () => ValidateDiagnostic(renderRoot, longLog));

            SetField(vm, "_panicActive", true);
            SetField(vm, "_safeModeActive", false);
            SetField(vm, "_dirtyBytes", 64UL * 1048576UL);
            Invoke(vm, "RaiseStateChanged");
            Capture(records, hashes, outputRoot, window, renderRoot, vm, "应急", 1280, 720, 1280, 720, 96,
                "纯内存注入：panicActive=true/Dirty=64MB；未调用Panic命令", "emergency-panic-memory",
                () => vm.HasIssues && vm.PanicStateText.Contains("熔断", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                    ? null : "内存 panic 状态未映射到应急页");

            SetField(vm, "_panicActive", false);
            SetField(vm, "_dirtyBytes", 0UL);
            Invoke(vm, "RaiseStateChanged");
            SetProperty(vm, "Banner", "");
            Capture(records, hashes, outputRoot, window, renderRoot, vm, "设置", 1280, 720, 1280, 720, 96,
                "离线初始VM；设置页ScrollToEnd", "settings-scroll-bottom",
                () => ValidateScrollBottom(renderRoot, "设置", "关于"));
            Capture(records, hashes, outputRoot, window, renderRoot, vm, "应急", 1280, 720, 1280, 720, 96,
                "离线初始VM；应急页ScrollToEnd；未执行命令", "emergency-scroll-bottom",
                () => ValidateScrollBottom(renderRoot, "应急", "导出救援卡"));

            SetField(vm, "_panicActive", false);
            SetField(vm, "_dirtyBytes", 0UL);
            Invoke(vm, "RaiseStateChanged");
            SetProperty(vm, "Banner", "");
            vm.Drives.Clear();
            vm.LogLines.Clear();
            foreach (string page in Pages)
            {
                Capture(records, hashes, outputRoot, window, renderRoot, vm, page, 1280, 720, 1920, 1080, 144,
                    "离线初始VM；150% DPI（1280×720逻辑→1920×1080像素，144DPI）", $"dpi150-{page}", null);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            StatsService.Instance.Stop();
            DriverEventPoller.Instance.Stop();
            window.Close();
        }

        string manifest = Path.Combine(outputRoot, "state-render-manifest.json");
        File.WriteAllText(manifest, JsonSerializer.Serialize(records, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));
        int failed = records.Count(r => !r.Pass);
        Console.WriteLine($"WPF_STATE_COUNT={records.Count} WPF_STATE_FAILED={failed}");
        Console.WriteLine($"WPF_STATE_MANIFEST={manifest}");
        return failed == 0 ? 0 : 2;
    }

    private static void Capture(List<StateRecord> records, HashSet<string> hashes, string outputRoot,
        RAMBlockCache.Controller.MainWindow window, Grid root, MainViewModel vm, string pageName,
        int logicalWidth, int logicalHeight, int pixelWidth, int pixelHeight, int dpi,
        string state, string suffix, Func<string?>? validation)
    {
        vm.SelectedPage = pageName;
        Layout(root, logicalWidth, logicalHeight);
        FrameworkElement page = GetPage(window, pageName);
        root.Tag = page;
        if (page.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || page.RenderSize.Width <= 0 || page.RenderSize.Height <= 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"State page not visible: {pageName} {suffix}");
        TextBlock? title = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(page).FirstOrDefault(
            t => t.Text == pageName && t.FontSize == 20 && t.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && t.RenderSize.Width > 0);
        if (title?.Foreground is not SolidColorBrush titleBrush)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"State title missing: {pageName} {suffix}");
        double contrast = ContrastRatio(titleBrush.Color, ((SolidColorBrush)root.Background).Color);
        if (contrast < 4.5) throw new InvalidOperationException($"State title contrast failed: {pageName} {suffix}");
        string? defect = validation?.Invoke();
        Layout(root, logicalWidth, logicalHeight);
        var bitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(pixelWidth, pixelHeight, dpi, dpi, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
        bitmap.Render(root);
        AssertOpaqueDarkPixel(bitmap, pixelWidth - 1, pixelHeight - 1, suffix);
        string fileName = $"state-{logicalWidth}x{logicalHeight}@{dpi}-{suffix}.png";
        string path = Path.Combine(outputRoot, fileName);
        var encoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
        encoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(bitmap));
        using (var stream = File.Create(path)) encoder.Save(stream);
        string hash = Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(File.ReadAllBytes(path))).ToLowerInvariant();
        if (!hashes.Add(hash)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Duplicate state render hash: {fileName}");
        bool pass = defect is null;
        records.Add(new StateRecord(fileName, state, logicalWidth, logicalHeight, pixelWidth, pixelHeight, dpi,
            hash, pass, defect ?? "PASS", DescribeBrush(root.Background), titleBrush.Color.ToString(), contrast));
        Console.WriteLine($"WPF_STATE {(pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL")} {fileName} sha256={hash} {defect ?? ""}");
    }

    private static string? ValidateAccel(DependencyObject root, string longLabel)
    {
        var page = (FrameworkElement)root;
        TextBlock? label = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(page).FirstOrDefault(t => t.Text == longLabel);
        if (label is null) return "长卷标未进入加速页可视树";
        if (!InsidePage(label, 1280)) return "长卷标超出加速页横向边界";
        foreach (string name in new[] { "全部挂载", "全部卸载" })
        {
            Button? button = VisualDescendants<Button>(page).FirstOrDefault(b => Equals(b.Content, name));
            if (button is null || !InsidePage(button, 1280)) return $"长卷标/错误文本挤掉主操作：{name}";
        }
        if (!label.IsVisible && label.Visibility != Visibility.Visible) return "长卷标不可见";
        foreach (TextBlock stateText in VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(page).Where(
            t => t.Text.StartsWith("加速已启用", StringComparison.Ordinal) || t.Text.StartsWith("旁路（", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
        {
            double parentWidth = (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(stateText) as FrameworkElement)?.ActualWidth ?? stateText.ActualWidth;
            Console.WriteLine($"WPF_STATE_TEXT {stateText.Text} actual={stateText.ActualWidth:F1} parent={parentWidth:F1}");
            if (IsSingleLineTextClipped(stateText) || stateText.ActualWidth > parentWidth + 1)
                return $"旁路/状态文本被单行裁切或越出父容器：{stateText.Text}，ActualWidth={stateText.ActualWidth:F1}, ParentWidth={parentWidth:F1}";
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static bool IsSingleLineTextClipped(TextBlock text)
    {
        if (text.TextWrapping != TextWrapping.NoWrap || text.TextTrimming != TextTrimming.None) return false;
        text.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
        return text.DesiredSize.Width > text.ActualWidth + 1;
    }

    private static string? ValidateDiagnostic(DependencyObject root, string longLog)
    {
        TextBlock? log = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(root).FirstOrDefault(t => t.Text == longLog);
        if (log is null) return "长日志未进入诊断页可视树";
        if (log.TextWrapping != TextWrapping.Wrap) return "长日志未启用换行";
        if (!Equals(log.ToolTip, longLog)) return "长日志 ToolTip 未保留完整文本";
        if (log.ActualHeight < 30) return "长日志未形成多行布局";
        if (!InsidePage(log, 1280)) return "长日志横向超出页面";
        Button? export = VisualDescendants<Button>(root).FirstOrDefault(b => Equals(b.Content, "导出诊断信息"));
        return export is not null && InsidePage(export, 1280) ? null : "长日志挤掉导出主操作";
    }

    private static string? ValidateScrollBottom(DependencyObject root, string pageName, string endMarker)
    {
        DependencyObject scope = ((Grid)root).Tag as DependencyObject ?? root;
        ScrollViewer scroller = VisualDescendants<ScrollViewer>(scope).FirstOrDefault(
            s => s.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && s.RenderSize.Width > 0 && s.RenderSize.Height > 0)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Visible ScrollViewer missing: {pageName}");
        scroller.ScrollToEnd();
        scroller.UpdateLayout();
        if (scroller.ScrollableHeight <= 0) return $"{pageName}没有可滚动内容，无法验证末端";
        if (Math.Abs(scroller.VerticalOffset - scroller.ScrollableHeight) > 1)
            return $"{pageName}未滚到底：{scroller.VerticalOffset}/{scroller.ScrollableHeight}";
        TextBlock? marker = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(scroller).LastOrDefault(t => t.Text == endMarker);
        if (marker is null) return $"{pageName}末端标识未找到：{endMarker}";
        Rect rect = marker.TransformToAncestor((Visual)scroller).TransformBounds(new Rect(0, 0, marker.ActualWidth, marker.ActualHeight));
        if (rect.Top < -1 || rect.Bottom > scroller.ViewportHeight + 1)
            return $"{pageName}末端标识裁切：{rect} viewport={scroller.ViewportHeight}";
        return null;
    }

    private static bool InsidePage(FrameworkElement element, double unused)
    {
        if (element.ActualWidth <= 0 || element.ActualHeight <= 0) return false;
        DependencyObject root = element;
        while (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(root) is DependencyObject parent) root = parent;
        Point topLeft = element.TransformToAncestor((Visual)root).Transform(new Point(0, 0));
        double rootWidth = ((FrameworkElement)root).RenderSize.Width;
        return topLeft.X >= -1 && topLeft.X + element.ActualWidth <= rootWidth + 1;
    }

    private static void Layout(FrameworkElement root, int width, int height)
    {
        root.Width = width; root.Height = height;
        root.Measure(new Size(width, height));
        root.Arrange(new Rect(0, 0, width, height));
        root.UpdateLayout();
    }

    private static FrameworkElement GetPage(Window window, string name)
    {
        string field = name switch { "状态"=>"PageStatus", "加速"=>"PageAccel", "收益"=>"PageGain",
            "诊断"=>"PageDiag", "应急"=>"PageEmergency", "设置"=>"PageSettings", _=>throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(name)) };
        return (FrameworkElement)(window.GetType().GetField(field, PrivateInstance)?.GetValue(window)
            ?? throw new MissingFieldException(field));
    }

    private static IEnumerable<T> VisualDescendants<T>(DependencyObject root) where T : DependencyObject
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(root); i++)
        {
            DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(root, i);
            if (child is T match) yield return match;
            foreach (T nested in VisualDescendants<T>(child)) yield return nested;
        }
    }

    private static void SetProperty<T>(object target, string name, T value)
    {
        PropertyInfo property = target.GetType().GetProperty(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic)
            ?? throw new MissingMemberException(name);
        property.SetValue(target, value);
    }

    private static void SetAuto<T>(object target, string name, T value)
    {
        FieldInfo field = target.GetType().GetField($"<{name}>k__BackingField", PrivateInstance)
            ?? throw new MissingFieldException(name);
        field.SetValue(target, value);
    }
    private static void SetField<T>(object target, string name, T value)
    {
        FieldInfo field = target.GetType().GetField(name, PrivateInstance)
            ?? throw new MissingFieldException(name);
        field.SetValue(target, value);
    }
    private static void Invoke(object target, string name)
        => target.GetType().GetMethod(name, PrivateInstance)?.Invoke(target, null);

    private static SolidColorBrush RequireBrush(string key)
        => Application.Current?.Resources[key] as SolidColorBrush ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(key);
    private static string DescribeBrush(Brush brush)
    { Color c = ((SolidColorBrush)brush).Color; return $"#{c.A:X2}{c.R:X2}{c.G:X2}{c.B:X2}"; }

    private static double ContrastRatio(Color a, Color b)
    {
        double L(Color c) { double C(byte x) { double v=x/255.0; return v<=0.04045?v/12.92:Math.Pow((v+0.055)/1.055,2.4); }
            return 0.2126*C(c.R)+0.7152*C(c.G)+0.0722*C(c.B); }
        return (Math.Max(L(a),L(b))+0.05)/(Math.Min(L(a),L(b))+0.05);
    }

    private static void AssertOpaqueDarkPixel(RenderTargetBitmap bitmap, int x, int y, string context)
    {
        var p = new byte[4]; bitmap.CopyPixels(new Int32Rect(x,y,1,1),p,4,0);
        if (p[3]!=255 || p[0]>64 || p[1]>64 || p[2]>64)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid state background: {context}");
    }

    private static void EnsureResources()
    {
        if (Application.Current is null) { var app=new RAMBlockCache.Controller.App(); app.InitializeComponent(); }
    }

    private sealed record StateRecord(string File, string InjectedState, int LogicalWidth, int LogicalHeight,
        int PixelWidth, int PixelHeight, int Dpi, string Sha256, bool Pass, string Detail,
        string Background, string TitleForeground, double TitleContrastRatio);
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/App.xaml`

````xml
<Application x:Class="RAMBlockCache.Controller.App"
             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:helpers="clr-namespace:RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers"
             xmlns:ctl="clr-namespace:RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls"
             StartupUri="MainWindow.xaml">
    <Application.Resources>
        <ResourceDictionary>
            <ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
                <ResourceDictionary Source="Theme/Dark.xaml"/>
            </ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
            <BooleanToVisibilityConverter x:Key="BoolToVis"/>
            <helpers:ProgressRatioConverter x:Key="RbcProgressRatio"/>
            <helpers:InvertBoolConverter x:Key="InvertBool"/>
            <helpers:BenchStateVisConverter x:Key="BenchStateVis"/>

            <!-- ============ 全局 ProgressBar 隐式样式（02b §B.2/D9）============
                 scaleX 驱动：只动 transform，不动画 width。
                 部件名刻意不用 PART_* —— 避开框架对 PART_Indicator 的直接写 Width，
                 渲染控制权完全交给 scaleX 绑定（ProgressRatioConverter）
                 + SmoothProgressBar 的 Value 插值（180ms standard）。 -->
            <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                <Setter Property="Height" Value="8"/>
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcTrackBg}"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcAccent}"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="4"
                                    ClipToBounds="True" SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                                <Border x:Name="RbcBar" Background="{TemplateBinding Foreground}" CornerRadius="4"
                                        RenderTransformOrigin="0,0.5">
                                    <Border.RenderTransform>
                                        <ScaleTransform ScaleX="{Binding RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent},
                                            Converter={StaticResource RbcProgressRatio}}"/>
                                    </Border.RenderTransform>
                                </Border>
                            </Border>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>

            <!-- ============ 平滑进度条（02b §B.2「进度条·确定态」180ms）============
                 BasedOn 上面的 ProgressBar 隐式样式：SmoothProgressBar 是 ProgressBar
                 子类，隐式样式不自动继承，此处显式 BasedOn 保持同一 scaleX 模板；
                 数值平滑由 SmoothProgressBar.OnValueChanged 的 Value 插值完成。 -->
            <Style TargetType="{x:Type ctl:SmoothProgressBar}" BasedOn="{StaticResource {x:Type ProgressBar}}"/>

            <!-- ============ 交互控件焦点环（02b §B.3-11）============
                 BasedOn 保住各控件默认主题模板，仅覆盖焦点环。 -->
            <Style TargetType="Button" BasedOn="{StaticResource {x:Type Button}}">
                <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"/>
            </Style>
            <Style TargetType="TextBox" BasedOn="{StaticResource {x:Type TextBox}}">
                <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"/>
            </Style>
            <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem" BasedOn="{StaticResource {x:Type ListBoxItem}}">
                <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"/>
            </Style>

            <!-- ============ 深色控件模板（04b §8.2/§2.8 转译映射；此前默认亮色 chrome
                 与暗底直接冲突，是"画面简陋"的直接来源之一）============ -->
            <Style TargetType="ComboBox">
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextPrimary}"/>
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgInput}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcBorderDefault}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
                <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,6"/>
                <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="13"/>
                <Setter Property="Height" Value="28"/>
                <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
                <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"/>
                <!-- [W1.5 V-3] 下拉浮层微入口挂件（OverlayPop 订阅 DropDownOpened → PlayOverlayEnter） -->
                <Setter Property="ctl:OverlayPop.IsEnabled" Value="True"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="ComboBox">
                            <Grid>
                                <Border x:Name="bd" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                        BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                        BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                        CornerRadius="{StaticResource RbcRadiusSm}">
                                    <Grid>
                                        <!-- 选中项显示：ComboBox 的 Content 通常为空，必须显式绑 SelectionBoxItem
                                             （漏绑 = 下拉框永远显示空白，10-20 线上事故） -->
                                        <ContentPresenter x:Name="cp" Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}"
                                                          Content="{TemplateBinding SelectionBoxItem}"
                                                          ContentTemplate="{TemplateBinding SelectionBoxItemTemplate}"
                                                          HorizontalAlignment="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                          IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
                                        <Path HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                              Data="M 0 0 L 4 4 L 8 0 Z" Fill="{StaticResource RbcTextSecondary}"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                </Border>
                                <ToggleButton x:Name="toggle" Focusable="False" ClickMode="Press" Opacity="0"
                                              IsChecked="{Binding IsDropDownOpen, Mode=TwoWay, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}">
                                    <ToggleButton.Template>
                                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="ToggleButton">
                                            <Border Background="Transparent"/>
                                        </ControlTemplate>
                                    </ToggleButton.Template>
                                </ToggleButton>
                                <Popup x:Name="popup" Placement="Bottom" PlacementTarget="{Binding ElementName=bd}"
                                       AllowsTransparency="True" Focusable="False"
                                       MinWidth="{Binding ActualWidth, ElementName=bd}"
                                       IsOpen="{TemplateBinding IsDropDownOpen}">
                                    <!-- [W1.5 V-3] PopupAnimation=None：入场动画单一事实源在 Motion
                                         （OverlayPop → PlayOverlayEnter：0.98→1 + 淡入 + 8px 位移），防双重淡入 -->
                                    <Border Background="{StaticResource RbcBgElevated}"
                                            BorderBrush="{StaticResource RbcBorderStrong}" BorderThickness="1"
                                            CornerRadius="{StaticResource RbcRadiusSm}" Margin="0,4,0,0" Padding="4">
                                        <ScrollViewer MaxHeight="220" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                                            <ItemsPresenter/>
                                        </ScrollViewer>
                                    </Border>
                                </Popup>
                            </Grid>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter TargetName="bd" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcBorderStrong}"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsDropDownOpen" Value="True">
                                    <Setter TargetName="bd" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcAccent}"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                    <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.5"/>
                                </Trigger>

                <Setter Property="ItemContainerStyle">

                            </Setter>
                        </Style>
                    </Setter.Value>

            </Style>
            <Style TargetType="CheckBox">
                <Setter Property="AutomationProperties.Name" Value="{Binding Content, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextPrimary}"/>
                <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="13"/>

                                          StrokeStartLineCap="Round" StrokeEndLineCap="Round"

                            </Grid>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>

            </Style>
            <Style TargetType="Slider">
                <Setter Property="Height" Value="24"/>

                <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"/>
````

````csharp
using System.Windows;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller;

public partial class App : Application
{
    /* [FIX S7-19] 多实例防护：原无全局唯一性检查——双开控制台时两个进程各自轮询
     * IOCTL、各自写 settings.json（后写覆盖先写）、托盘双图标，用户无法分辨哪个
     * 是"真的"。用 Local\ 命名互斥体（按用户会话隔离，多会话 RDP 各自可开）。 */
    private System.Threading.Mutex? _single;

    protected override void OnStartup(StartupEventArgs e)
    {
        _single = new System.Threading.Mutex(true, @"Local\RAMBlockCache.Controller.Single", out bool isNew);
        if (!isNew)
        {
            MessageBox.Show("RAMBlockCache 控制台已在运行（多实例会导致配置互相覆盖）。\n请在托盘找到已有实例。",
                "RAMBlockCache", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
            Shutdown();
            return;
        }
        // [FIX 严重-4 2026-10-18] 原 handler 无条件 Handled=true——UI 损坏态的静默放大器：
        // 磁盘页 2194 条/秒渲染异常被全吞（页面纯黑但"看起来正常"）、ProductVersion 绑定
        // 异常吞成"窗口不显示但进程活着"。改为 fail-fast：记日志后不吞，让 WPF 崩溃对话框
        // 出现（用户能感知并报告，而非拿着损坏的界面继续用）。
        DispatcherUnhandledException += (_, ex) =>
        {
            Services.LogService.Error($"未处理异常（fail-fast，不吞）：{ex.Exception.GetType().Name}：{ex.Exception.Message}\r\n{ex.Exception.StackTrace}");
            ex.Handled = false;   // 快速失败——宁可崩溃报告，不可静默半死界面
        };
        // [动效降级] 02b §B.5：WPF 无 CSS 媒体查询——此处只按当前设置求初值：
        // 设置覆盖=关 → 降级；=开 → 强制开；=auto → 跟随系统动画开关
        // （SystemParameters.ClientAreaAnimation，用户在「调整 Windows 的外观和性能」里关动画即降级）。
        // [FIX U-04] 注释修正：并非"启动期一次性求值"——设置页 ReduceMotionIndex
        // setter 实时改判 Motion.IsReducedMotion（MainViewModel.cs:778-779）。
        var motion = Services.SettingsService.Load().ReduceMotion;
        Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion =
            motion == "off" || (motion != "on" && !SystemParameters.ClientAreaAnimation);
        base.OnStartup(e);
    }

    protected override void OnExit(ExitEventArgs e)
    {
        _single?.ReleaseMutex();
        _single?.Dispose();
        base.OnExit(e);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 卡片 hover 行为（02b §B.2「卡片 hover」：120ms standard，translateY 0→-1px +
/// 背景 surface→surface-hover + 描边 subtle→default；覆盖 v1.0「hover 不改描边」）。
/// 为什么用附加属性而非 Style Setter：Style Setter 的 RenderTransform/Brush 实例
/// 跨元素共享，动画会互相串台且会污染主题静态资源——每元素 Loaded 时注入
/// 独立 transform，动画前克隆画刷（绝不动共享主题资源）。
/// </summary>
public static class CardHover
{
    /// <summary>启用 hover 动效（XAML：ctl:CardHover.IsEnabled="True"）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty IsEnabledProperty =
        DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsEnabled", typeof(bool), typeof(CardHover),
            new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsEnabledChanged));

    /// <summary>附着时捕获的原始背景色（Leave 回弹目标）。</summary>
    private static readonly DependencyProperty OriginalBgProperty =
        DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("OriginalBg", typeof(Color?), typeof(CardHover), new PropertyMetadata(null));

    /// <summary>附着时捕获的原始描边色（Leave 回弹目标）。</summary>
    private static readonly DependencyProperty OriginalBorderProperty =
        DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("OriginalBorder", typeof(Color?), typeof(CardHover), new PropertyMetadata(null));

    public static bool GetIsEnabled(DependencyObject o) => (bool)o.GetValue(IsEnabledProperty);
    public static void SetIsEnabled(DependencyObject o, bool v) => o.SetValue(IsEnabledProperty, v);

    private static void OnIsEnabledChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (d is not Border b) return;
        b.Loaded -= OnLoaded;
        if ((bool)e.NewValue)
        {
            b.Loaded += OnLoaded;
            if (b.IsLoaded) Attach(b);
        }
    }

    private static void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Attach((Border)sender);

    private static void Attach(Border b)
    {
        if (b.RenderTransform is not TranslateTransform) b.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
        if (GetOriginalBg(b) is null && b.Background is SolidColorBrush sb0) SetOriginalBg(b, sb0.Color);
        if (GetOriginalBorder(b) is null && b.BorderBrush is SolidColorBrush sb1) SetOriginalBorder(b, sb1.Color);
        b.MouseEnter -= OnEnter;
        b.MouseLeave -= OnLeave;
        b.MouseEnter += OnEnter;
        b.MouseLeave += OnLeave;
    }

    private static void OnEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        if (Motion.IsReducedMotion) return;
        if (sender is not Border b) return;
        AnimateY(b, 0, -1);
        // [FIX U-06] 回退色引 FallbackPalette 单点（与令牌等值，删散落字面量）
        SwapColor(b, Border.BackgroundProperty, GetOriginalBg(b), HoverColor(b, "RbcBgSurfaceHover", FallbackPalette.SurfaceHover.Color));
        SwapColor(b, Border.BorderBrushProperty, GetOriginalBorder(b), HoverColor(b, "RbcBorderStrong", FallbackPalette.BorderStrong.Color));
    }

    private static void OnLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        if (Motion.IsReducedMotion) return;
        if (sender is not Border b) return;
        AnimateY(b, -1, 0);
        SwapColor(b, Border.BackgroundProperty, HoverColor(b, "RbcBgSurfaceHover", FallbackPalette.SurfaceHover.Color), GetOriginalBg(b));
        SwapColor(b, Border.BorderBrushProperty, HoverColor(b, "RbcBorderStrong", FallbackPalette.BorderStrong.Color), GetOriginalBorder(b));
    }

    private static void AnimateY(Border b, double from, double to)
    {
        if (b.RenderTransform is not TranslateTransform slide) return;
        var anim = Motion.Frames(slide, TranslateTransform.YProperty, from, to, Motion.Dur120, Motion.EaseStandard);
        anim.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
        slide.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.YProperty, anim);
    }

    /// <summary>克隆画刷→换实例→动画 Color（共享主题资源零改动）。</summary>
    private static void SwapColor(Border b, DependencyProperty dp, Color? from, Color? to)
    {
        if (from is null || to is null || from == to) return;
        if (b.GetValue(dp) is not SolidColorBrush cur) return;
        var clone = cur.Clone();                 // 每元素独立实例
        clone.Color = from.Value;
        b.SetValue(dp, clone);
        var ca = new ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames();
        ca.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineColorKeyFrame(from.Value, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.Zero)));
        ca.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineColorKeyFrame(to.Value, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(Motion.Dur120.TimeSpan), Motion.EaseStandard));
        clone.BeginAnimation(SolidColorBrush.ColorProperty, ca);
    }

    private static Color? HoverColor(Border b, string key, Color fallback) =>
        b.TryFindResource(key) as SolidColorBrush is { } brush ? brush.Color : fallback;

    private static Color? GetOriginalBg(DependencyObject o) => (Color?)o.GetValue(OriginalBgProperty);
    private static void SetOriginalBg(DependencyObject o, Color? v) => o.SetValue(OriginalBgProperty, v);
    private static Color? GetOriginalBorder(DependencyObject o) => (Color?)o.GetValue(OriginalBorderProperty);
    private static void SetOriginalBorder(DependencyObject o, Color? v) => o.SetValue(OriginalBorderProperty, v);
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 图表共享几何助手（02b §A 落地纪律）：
/// ① 断线留缺口——序列中 NaN 分段成独立 Polyline，不插值不归零；
/// ② 空态不归零——空序列由调用方画占位文案，禁止画零值曲线；
/// ③ 只画数据系（chart-1/chart-2 青蓝双色），语义色仅状态点/堆叠条。
/// </summary>
internal static class ChartShapes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 把采样序列映射为折线几何（NaN 断点分段；首尾不超界）。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="series">值序列（NaN=中断）。</param>
    /// <param name="width">绘制区宽（DIP）。</param>
    /// <param name="height">绘制区高（DIP）。</param>
    /// <param name="min">Y 轴下限（固定 0 的序列传 0）。</param>
    /// <param name="max">Y 轴上限（自适应时传序列最大值）。</param>
    /// <param name="progress">描边进度 0–1（480ms 一次性入场沿点数推进）。</param>
    public static StreamGeometry BuildPolyline(IList<double>? series, double width, double height,
                                               double min, double max, double progress = 1.0)
    {
        var geo = new StreamGeometry();
        if (series is null || series.Count < 2 || max <= min) return geo;
        int visible = (int)Math.Ceiling(progress * series.Count);
        if (visible < 2) return geo;
        using (var ctx = geo.Open())
        {
            double dx = width / (series.Count - 1);
            bool pen = false;
            double py = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < visible; i++)
            {
                double v = series[i];
                if (double.IsNaN(v)) { pen = false; continue; }
                double x = i * dx;
                double y = height - (Math.Clamp(v, min, max) - min) / (max - min) * height;
                if (!pen) { ctx.BeginFigure(new Point(x, y), false, false); pen = true; }
                else ctx.LineTo(new Point(x, y), true, false);
                py = y;
            }
            if (pen) { /* 保持末点为后续圆点预留 */ _ = py; }
        }
        geo.Freeze();
        return geo;
    }

    /// <summary>面积填充几何（折线 + 底线闭合；NaN 同样分段）。</summary>
    public static StreamGeometry BuildArea(IList<double>? series, double width, double height,
                                           double min, double max, double progress = 1.0)
    {
        var geo = new StreamGeometry();
        if (series is null || series.Count < 2 || max <= min) return geo;
        int visible = (int)Math.Ceiling(progress * series.Count);
        if (visible < 2) return geo;
        using (var ctx = geo.Open())
        {
            double dx = width / (series.Count - 1);
            bool pen = false;
            double startX = 0, lastX = 0, lastY = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < visible; i++)
            {
                double v = series[i];
                double x = i * dx;
                if (double.IsNaN(v))
                {
                    if (pen) { ctx.LineTo(new Point(lastX, height), true, false); ctx.LineTo(new Point(startX, height), true, false); pen = false; }
                    continue;
                }
                double y = height - (Math.Clamp(v, min, max) - min) / (max - min) * height;
                if (!pen) { ctx.BeginFigure(new Point(x, y), true, true); startX = x; pen = true; }
                else ctx.LineTo(new Point(x, y), true, false);
                lastX = x; lastY = y;
            }
            if (pen) { ctx.LineTo(new Point(lastX, height), true, false); ctx.LineTo(new Point(startX, height), true, false); }
            _ = lastY;
        }
        geo.Freeze();
        return geo;
    }

    /// <summary>序列有效点最大值（全 NaN/空返 0）。</summary>
    public static double MaxOf(IList<double>? series)
    {
        double m = 0;
        if (series is null) return m;
        foreach (var v in series) if (!double.IsNaN(v) && v > m) m = v;
        return m;
    }

    /// <summary>序列是否含至少 2 个有效点（否则视为空态）。</summary>
    public static bool HasData(IList<double>? series)
    {
        int n = 0;
        if (series is not null)
            foreach (var v in series) { if (!double.IsNaN(v) && ++n >= 2) return true; }
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>空态占位文案（02b §A.5：统计不可用一律给原因，禁画归零线）。</summary>
    public static void DrawEmptyText(DrawingContext dc, string text, double width, double height, Brush fg)
    {
        /* [FIX D#15/C#10] DPI 取 DpiX.Of()（禁 ?? new Window()——渲染路径新建窗口）；
         * FormattedText/Typeface 下沉为静态缓存（OnRender 每秒热路径禁分配）。 */
        var ft = GetEmptyFt(text, fg);
        dc.DrawText(ft, new Point((width - ft.Width) / 2, (height - ft.Height) / 2));
    }

    /* [FIX C#10] 空态文案按 (文本, 画刷) 键缓存 FormattedText+Typeface：原每次
     * OnRender 新建 24 个/秒（12 通道 x2），缓存后零热路径分配。 */
    private static readonly System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentDictionary<(string, Brush), FormattedText> _ftCache = new();

    private static FormattedText GetEmptyFt(string text, Brush fg)
    {
        var key = (text, fg);
        if (_ftCache.TryGetValue(key, out var hit)) return hit;
        var ft = new FormattedText(text, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture,
            FlowDirection.LeftToRight, TypefaceCache, 12, fg, DpiX.Of());
        _ftCache[key] = ft;
        return ft;
    }

    private static readonly Typeface TypefaceCache = new("Segoe UI");
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Controls/DialogHost.xaml.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// V10.6 对话框基座（06 令牌文档 §5 RbcDialogHost；C-4 回写引导 / C-5 反作弊警示 /
/// C-6 许可占位 / 文件选择 / 三段式确认共用，出入场动画只实现一次）。
/// 核心纪律——**onClose 统一收敛语义**（Round 1 P0-1 教训：Esc/遮罩关闭必须与「取消」按钮
/// 同口径，否则用户未经知情同意即生效回写等危险配置）：任何关闭路径（取消按钮自身也是
/// 先调 Close）都收敛到 Show 时传入的 onClose 回调；应用完成后调 <see cref="Settle"/>，
/// 此后任何关闭路径都不再触发 onClose（Applying 中按 Esc 不回滚）。
/// 动效：遮罩 120ms 淡入 + 面板 scale(0.98)→1 + 淡入 + translateY 8px→0（180ms ease-out）；
/// 出场反向 120ms；reduced-motion 全直显（Motion 内部分支）。
/// </summary>
public partial class DialogHost : UserControl
{
    private Action? _onClose;
    private bool _settled;

    public DialogHost()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
    }

    /// <summary>当前是否有对话框打开。</summary>
    public bool IsOpen => Visibility == Visibility.Visible;

    /// <summary>
    /// 打开对话框。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="content">内容元素（建议 MainWindow 内预定义 Collapsed 容器，绑定 VM）</param>
    /// <param name="width">面板宽度（480/440/360/560）</param>
    /// <param name="onClose">统一关闭回调：取消按钮、Esc、点遮罩三条路径都触发；Settle 后不触发</param>
    /// <param name="cancelButton">打开时聚焦的按钮（取消语义；危险按钮不做默认焦点）</param>
    public void Show(FrameworkElement content, double width, Action? onClose, IInputElement? cancelButton = null)
    {
        CancelExitAnimation();   // 出场动画中重开：立即终止计时，入场动画自会复位 opacity/scale/位移
        ContentSite.Content = content;
        Panel.Width = width;
        Panel.MaxHeight = Math.Max(240, (FindVisualRoot()?.ActualHeight ?? 780) - 48);
        _onClose = onClose;
        _settled = false;
        Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        Mask.IsHitTestVisible = true;
        Panel.IsHitTestVisible = true;
        Panel.Focusable = true;
        Motion.PlayMaskFade(Mask, show: true);
        Motion.PlayOverlayEnter(Panel, PanelScale, PanelSlide);
        // 焦点落取消按钮（打开时 Enter 不误触确认）；reduced 下同样聚焦（可访问性不受降级影响）
        Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
        {
            if (cancelButton is not null) Keyboard.Focus(cancelButton);
            else Panel.Focus();
        }), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
    }

    /// <summary>应用完成标志位：此后任何关闭路径都不再触发 onClose（防止 Applying 中关闭误回滚）。</summary>
    public void Settle() => _settled = true;

    private DispatcherTimer? _exitTimer;
    private bool _exitPlaying;

    /// <summary>终止出场动画状态（Show 重入时调用：停计时器并复位标志）。</summary>
    private void CancelExitAnimation()
    {
        _exitTimer?.Stop();
        _exitTimer = null;
        _exitPlaying = false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 关闭对话框（任何路径的统一入口；onClose 按 settled 语义触发一次）。
    /// [W1.5 V-3] 出场 = 淡出 + 缩回 0.98 + 下移 8px（120ms ease-in）+ 遮罩同步淡出；
    /// 动画期间禁命中，完成后 Collapsed + onClose。reduced-motion 直接隐藏。
    /// </summary>
    public void Close()
    {
        if (!IsOpen || _exitPlaying) return;
        bool fire = !_settled;
        var cb = _onClose;
        _onClose = null;

        if (Motion.IsReducedMotion)
        {
            FinishClose();
            if (fire) cb?.Invoke();
            return;
        }

        _exitPlaying = true;
        Mask.IsHitTestVisible = false;
        Panel.IsHitTestVisible = false;
        Motion.PlayMaskFade(Mask, show: false);
        Motion.PlayOverlayExit(Panel, PanelScale, PanelSlide, onDone: null);
        // 收尾（与 120ms 出场同步；StoryBoard.Completed 与 DispatcherTimer 双保险取先到者）
        _exitTimer = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = Motion.Dur120.TimeSpan };
        _exitTimer.Tick += (_, _) =>
        {
            CancelExitAnimation();
            FinishClose();
            if (fire) cb?.Invoke();
        };
        _exitTimer.Start();
    }

    /// <summary>出场收尾：真隐藏 + 内容卸载（回调由调用方按 settled 语义触发）。</summary>
    private void FinishClose()
    {
        Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        ContentSite.Content = null;
        Panel.Opacity = 0;
    }

    /// <summary>Esc 关闭（与遮罩/取消同口径——从对话框内冒泡上来的按键）。</summary>
    protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == Key.Escape && IsOpen)
        {
            Close();
            e.Handled = true;
        }
        base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
    }

    private void Mask_OnClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e) => Close();

    private FrameworkElement? FindVisualRoot()
    {
        DependencyObject? cur = this;
        while (cur is not null)
        {
            if (cur is Window w) return w;
            cur = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(cur);
        }
        return null;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// [FIX D#15] DPI 单一事实源：原 7 个控件（StripeHeatmap/LinkChip/HitRateChart/
/// UsageRing/IoctlMatrix/ThroughputChart/ChartShapes 内联）各持一份私有 Dpi()，
/// 语义逐字相同——任何修正（如多显示器/每显示器 DPI 演进）都要改 7 处。
/// 同时消除 ChartShapes.DrawEmptyText 的 <c>?? new Window()</c>（渲染路径新建窗口）。
/// </summary>
internal static class DpiX
{
    /// <summary>主窗口 PixelsPerDip；无主窗口（设计器/单测）回落 1.0（禁 new Window()）。</summary>
    public static double Of() =>
        Application.Current?.MainWindow is Window win
            ? VisualTreeHelper.GetDpi(win).PixelsPerDip
            : 1.0;

    /// <summary>指定元素优先；元素不可用（未加载/已卸载）时回落主窗口，再回落 1.0。</summary>
    public static double Of(FrameworkElement? el) =>
        el is not null && el.IsLoaded ? VisualTreeHelper.GetDpi(el).PixelsPerDip : Of();
}
````
