````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// C-3 冷热对比双条形（06 C-3.2 纵向形态）：两遍同 Y 尺度（ceil 取整由 VM 的 BenchYMax 给），
/// 第一遍 neutral / 第二遍 chart-1；坐 1px 基线（外框由卡片提供，控件内无框无背景块）。
/// 动效：scaleY(0)→1 生长 480ms（Motion.Dur480；只动 transform，红线 6）；
/// reduced-motion 直显终态。渲染模板直出终态防重渲染隐形——<see cref="Render"/> 只管动画场景。
/// </summary>
public partial class DualBarCompare : UserControl
{
    public DualBarCompare()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
    }

    /// <summary>Y 轴尺度上限（MB/s；0=未运行隐藏整卡区）。</summary>
    public double YMax { get; set; }

    /// <summary>第一遍（盘速）数值 MB/s。</summary>
    public double FirstMbps { get; set; }

    /// <summary>第二遍（缓存速）数值 MB/s。</summary>
    public double SecondMbps { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 渲染（终态直出 + 生长动画）。调用方在结果态就绪后调用一次；
    /// 数值/尺度变化请先改属性再调本方法。
    /// </summary>
    public void Render()
    {
        if (YMax <= 0 || FirstMbps <= 0 || SecondMbps <= 0)
        {
            Root.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            return;
        }
        Root.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        Val1.Text = $"{FirstMbps:F0} MB/s";
        Val2.Text = $"{SecondMbps:F0} MB/s";

        double h1 = Math.Clamp(FirstMbps / YMax, 0.02, 1.0);
        double h2 = Math.Clamp(SecondMbps / YMax, 0.02, 1.0);
        // 条高 = 88px 区高 × 比值（scaleY 目标值；高度恒满区，靠缩放表达比例——禁布局属性动画）
        Bar1.Height = 88;
        Bar2.Height = 88;
        Bar1Scale.ScaleY = h1;
        Bar2Scale.ScaleY = h2;

        if (Motion.IsReducedMotion) return;   // 直显终态（位移/生长归零，信息不丢）
        // 生长：scaleY 0→目标（480ms ease-out），只一次（数据刷新不重播——解耦）
        Bar1Scale.ScaleY = 0;
        Bar2Scale.ScaleY = 0;
        var sb = new Storyboard();
        sb.Children.Add(Motion.Frames(Bar1Scale, ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty, 0, h1, Motion.Dur480, Motion.EaseOut));
        sb.Children.Add(Motion.Frames(Bar2Scale, ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty, 0, h2, Motion.Dur480, Motion.EaseOut));
        sb.Begin();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 读命中率趋势图（02b §A.1 图 #1：折线 + 单色 12% 面积，5 分钟 / 60 采样点）。
/// 纪律：数据系 chart-1 单色；断线留缺口（NaN 分段）；空态画原因文案不画归零线；
/// 480ms 一次性描边入场（沿点数推进，等价 stroke-dashoffset），刷新不重播；
/// reduced-motion 降级直接全显。网格 3 线 + 两端轴标（5 分钟前 / 现在）。
/// </summary>
public sealed class HitRateChart : Control
{
    static HitRateChart()
    {
        DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(HitRateChart),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(HitRateChart)));
    }

    /// <summary>采样序列（百分率 0–100；NaN=采样中断）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Series), typeof(IList<double>), typeof(HitRateChart),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnSeriesChanged));

    /// <summary>空态原因文案（统计不可用时显示；默认"统计暂不可用"）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty EmptyTextProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(EmptyText), typeof(string), typeof(HitRateChart),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("统计暂不可用", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public IList<double>? Series { get => (IList<double>?)GetValue(SeriesProperty); set => SetValue(SeriesProperty, value); }
    public string EmptyText { get => (string)GetValue(EmptyTextProperty); set => SetValue(EmptyTextProperty, value); }

    /// <summary>描边进度 0–1（480ms 一次性入场沿点数推进）。</summary>
    private static readonly DependencyProperty ProgressProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Progress), typeof(double), typeof(HitRateChart),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    private double Progress { get => (double)GetValue(ProgressProperty); set => SetValue(ProgressProperty, value); }

    /* [FIX 主-3 2026-10-19] 首播标记：VM 每次求值返回新数组引用 → DP 必判变，
     * 原实现每 5s 重播 480ms 入场动画（曲线周期性从头描边，"一次性"承诺失效）。
     * 首个非空序列播一次，此后刷新仅重绘（AffectsRender 已覆盖）。 */
    private bool _played;

    private static void OnSeriesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var c = (HitRateChart)d;
        if (Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion || !ChartShapes.HasData(c.Series)) { c.Progress = 1; return; }
        if (c._played) { c.Progress = 1; return; }   // 刷新不重播
        c._played = true;
        c.Progress = 0;
        var anim = new DoubleAnimation(0, 1, Controls.Motion.Dur480);
        anim.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
        anim.Completed += (_, _) => c.Progress = 1;
        c.BeginAnimation(ProgressProperty, anim);
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        base.OnRender(dc);
        double w = ActualWidth, h = ActualHeight;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        var grid = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartGrid");
        var axisText = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartAxisText");
        var line = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChart1");
        var area = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartAreaFill");

        // 网格 3 线（Y 轴 0/50/100 三刻度）
        var pen = new Pen(grid, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2; i++)
        {
            double y = h - i * h / 2;
            dc.DrawLine(pen, new Point(0, y), new Point(w, y));
        }

        if (!ChartShapes.HasData(Series))
        {
            ChartShapes.DrawEmptyText(dc, EmptyText, w, h, axisText);
            DrawAxisLabels(dc, w, h, axisText);
            return;
        }

        double p = Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion ? 1 : Progress;
        if (p < 1) p = Math.Max(p, 0.0);
        dc.DrawGeometry(area, null, ChartShapes.BuildArea(Series, w, h, 0, 100, p));
        dc.DrawGeometry(null, new Pen(line, 1.5) { LineJoin = PenLineJoin.Round, StartLineCap = PenLineCap.Round, EndLineCap = PenLineCap.Round },
            ChartShapes.BuildPolyline(Series, w, h, 0, 100, p));

        // 末端 3px 实心圆点（标示"当前值"；描边完成后才画）
        if (p >= 1)
        {
            for (int i = Series!.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                double v = Series[i];
                if (double.IsNaN(v)) continue;
                double x = w - (Series.Count - 1 - i) * (w / Math.Max(1, Series.Count - 1));
                double y = h - Math.Clamp(v, 0, 100) / 100.0 * h;
                dc.DrawEllipse(line, null, new Point(x, y), 3, 3);
                break;
            }
        }
        DrawAxisLabels(dc, w, h, axisText);
    }

    private static void DrawAxisLabels(DrawingContext dc, double w, double h, Brush fg)
    {
        var ft = new FormattedText("5 分钟前", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture,
            FlowDirection.LeftToRight, new Typeface("Segoe UI"), 11, fg, Dpi());
        dc.DrawText(ft, new Point(0, h + 2));
        var ft2 = new FormattedText("现在", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture,
            FlowDirection.LeftToRight, new Typeface("Segoe UI"), 11, fg, Dpi());
        dc.DrawText(ft2, new Point(w - ft2.Width, h + 2));
    }

    /* [FIX D#15] 收敛到 Controls/DpiX 单点（原 7 处同款私有实现） */
    private static double Dpi() => DpiX.Of();
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Controls/IoctlMatrix.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// IOCTL 通道健康点阵（02b §A.1 图 #6：12 消息 × 四态 + 延迟迷你条）。
/// 数据源 = MainViewModel.IoctlHealth（DriverService 收口埋点快照，A5）。
/// 四态：正常=success / 偏慢(≥50ms)=warning / 失败=danger / 未调用=neutral+"—"。
/// 纪律：纯展示控件零轮询（随 VM tick 刷新）；只读快照不持有协议对象。
/// </summary>
public sealed class IoctlMatrix : Control
{
    static IoctlMatrix()
    {
        DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(IoctlMatrix),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(IoctlMatrix)));
    }

    /// <summary>12 通道视图快照（空=全部未调用）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemsProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Items), typeof(IList<IoctlChannelView>), typeof(IoctlMatrix),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null,
                FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public IList<IoctlChannelView>? Items { get => (IList<IoctlChannelView>?)GetValue(ItemsProperty); set => SetValue(ItemsProperty, value); }

    /// <summary>延迟迷你条满刻度（ms）；超过按满刻度截断。</summary>
    public const double LatencyFullMs = 100;
    public const double MinimumCellWidth = 96;
    public const double ReadableRowHeight = 42;
    private const double TextLeftInset = 30;

    public readonly record struct IoctlMatrixLayout(
        int Columns, int Rows, double CellWidth, double RowHeight,
        double DesiredWidth, double DesiredHeight, double LongestTextWidth);

    /// <summary>确定布局：实际文字宽度决定最小格宽，窄栏优先减列；字号与行高不缩。</summary>
    public static IoctlMatrixLayout CalculateLayout(double availableWidth, IList<IoctlChannelView>? items)
    {
        int count = items?.Count ?? 0;
        if (count == 0) return new IoctlMatrixLayout(1, 0, 0, ReadableRowHeight, 0, 0, 0);
        double longestName = 0, longestMs = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            IoctlChannelView item = items![i];
            string ms = item.MsText + (item.State == 0 ? "" : " ms");
            longestName = Math.Max(longestName, MeasureText(item.Name));
            longestMs = Math.Max(longestMs, MeasureText(ms));
        }
        double longest = Math.Max(longestName, longestMs);
        double minCell = Math.Max(MinimumCellWidth, Math.Ceiling(TextLeftInset + longest + 8));
        int maxColumns = Math.Min(6, count);
        int columns;
        if (double.IsInfinity(availableWidth) || availableWidth <= 0)
            columns = maxColumns;
        else
            columns = Math.Clamp((int)Math.Floor(availableWidth / minCell), 1, maxColumns);
        int rows = (count + columns - 1) / columns;
        double cellWidth = double.IsInfinity(availableWidth) || availableWidth <= 0
            ? minCell : availableWidth / columns;
        double desiredWidth = double.IsInfinity(availableWidth) || availableWidth <= 0
            ? columns * minCell : availableWidth;
        return new IoctlMatrixLayout(columns, rows, cellWidth, ReadableRowHeight,
                                     desiredWidth, rows * ReadableRowHeight, longest);
    }

    private static double MeasureText(string text)
    {
        var ft = new FormattedText(text ?? "", CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
            Tface, 11, Brushes.Transparent, 1.0);
        return ft.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace;
    }

    protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
    {
        IoctlMatrixLayout layout = CalculateLayout(availableSize.Width, Items);
        return new Size(layout.DesiredWidth, layout.DesiredHeight);
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        base.OnRender(dc);
        double w = ActualWidth;
        if (w <= 0) return;
        var items = Items;
        if (items is null || items.Count == 0) return;
        IoctlMatrixLayout layout = CalculateLayout(w, items);
        int cols = layout.Columns;
        double cw = w / cols, ch = layout.RowHeight;

        var okB = (Brush)FindResource("RbcSuccessFg");
        var warnB = (Brush)FindResource("RbcWarningFg");
        var dangerB = (Brush)FindResource("RbcDangerFg");
        var neutralB = (Brush)FindResource("RbcNeutralFg");
        var trackB = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartTrack");
        var nameFg = (Brush)FindResource("RbcTextSecondary");
        var dimFg = (Brush)FindResource("RbcTextTertiary");
        double dpi = Dpi();
        /* [FIX C#10] 字体与 FormattedText 全部缓存：原每次 OnRender 为 12 通道各
         * 新建 2 个 FormattedText + 2 个 Typeface（每秒 48 个分配）。MsText 取值
         * 有限（"<1"/"0.12 ms"...），缓存表有界。 */
        for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
        {
            var it = items[i];
            int col = i % cols, row = i / cols;
            double x0 = col * cw, y0 = row * ch;
            Brush dot = it.State switch { 1 => okB, 2 => warnB, 3 => dangerB, _ => neutralB };

            double textWidth = Math.Max(8, cw - TextLeftInset - 8);
            dc.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(x0, y0, cw, ch)));
            // 状态点（10px，与通道名同一行）
            dc.DrawEllipse(dot, null, new Point(x0 + 13, y0 + 8), 5, 5);

            // 通道名/毫秒各占独立行，完整文字宽度已计入自适应格宽
            var ftName = Ft(it.Name, 11, nameFg, dpi, textWidth);
            dc.DrawText(ftName, new Point(x0 + TextLeftInset, y0 + 1));
            var ftMs = Ft(it.MsText + (it.State == 0 ? "" : " ms"), 11,
                          it.State == 0 ? dimFg : nameFg, dpi, textWidth);
            dc.DrawText(ftMs, new Point(x0 + TextLeftInset, y0 + 18));

            // 延迟迷你条（满刻度 100ms；未调用不画）
            // [FIX QA5-UI11] "<1"（亚毫秒）按 0.5ms 画最短条：原 TryParse 失败
            // 不画条，本地 IOCTL 常态亚毫秒 → 迷你条大面积缺失。
            double barX = x0 + TextLeftInset, barY = y0 + 35, barW = textWidth, barH = 4;
            dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(trackB, null, new Rect(barX, barY, barW, barH), 2, 2);
            if (it.State != 0)
            {
                double ms = it.MsText == "<1" ? 0.5 : (double.TryParse(it.MsText, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var p) ? p : -1);
                if (ms >= 0)
                {
                    double frac = Math.Clamp(ms / LatencyFullMs, 0.02, 1);
                    dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(dot, null, new Rect(barX, barY, barW * frac, barH), 2, 2);
                }
            }

            dc.Pop();
        }
    }

    /* [FIX D#15] 收敛到 Controls/DpiX 单点（原 7 处同款私有实现） */
    private static double Dpi() => DpiX.Of();

    /* [FIX C#10] Typeface/FormattedText 静态缓存（键=文本+字号+画刷；dpi 运行时恒定）。 */
    private static readonly Typeface Tface = new("Segoe UI");
    private static readonly System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentDictionary<(string, double, Brush, int), FormattedText> _ft =
        new();

    private static FormattedText Ft(string text, double size, Brush fg, double dpi, double maxWidth)
    {
        int widthKey = (int)Math.Ceiling(maxWidth);
        var key = (text, size, fg, widthKey);
        if (_ft.TryGetValue(key, out var hit)) return hit;
        var ft = new FormattedText(text, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
            Tface, size, fg, dpi)
        {
            MaxTextWidth = Math.Max(1, maxWidth),
            MaxLineCount = 1,
            Trimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis
        };
        _ft[key] = ft;
        return ft;
    }
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Controls/LinkChip.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 联调角标（联调模式开启时显示）：标注界面元素对应的数据面/接口来源，
/// 用于前后端联调时一眼看清"前端等什么后端"。
/// ID 语义：A=已接线（数据面就绪）/ B=待驱动字段核对 / C=待接口（随消费方重建）/ D=待实现。
/// 联调模式关闭时由调用方绑 LinkMode 置 Collapsed——产品视图零干扰。
/// </summary>
public sealed class LinkChip : Control
{
    static LinkChip()
    {
        DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(LinkChip),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(LinkChip)));
    }

    /// <summary>角标 ID（如 "A6"、"C5"；首字母决定语义色）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty IdProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Id), typeof(string), typeof(LinkChip),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public string Id { get => (string)GetValue(IdProperty); set => SetValue(IdProperty, value); }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        base.OnRender(dc);
        string id = Id;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)) return;
        double w = ActualWidth, h = ActualHeight;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        var bg = (Brush)FindResource("RbcBgInput");
        var border = (Brush)FindResource("RbcBorderDefault");
        // 类着色：A=青（已接线）/ B·C=琥珀（待办）/ D=灰（未实现）——色相即状态
        Brush fg = id[0] switch
        {
            'A' => (Brush)FindResource("RbcAccent"),
            'B' or 'C' => (Brush)FindResource("RbcWarningFg"),
            _ => (Brush)FindResource("RbcTextTertiary")
        };
        dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(bg, new Pen(border, 1), new Rect(0, 0, w, h), h / 2, h / 2);
        var ft = new FormattedText(id, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
            new Typeface("Segoe UI"), 11, fg, Dpi());
        dc.DrawText(ft, new Point((w - ft.Width) / 2, (h - ft.Height) / 2));
    }

    /* [FIX D#15] 收敛到 Controls/DpiX 单点（原 7 处同款私有实现） */
    private static double Dpi() => DpiX.Of();
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 动效中枢（deliverables/design/02b-charts-motion.md §B 的 WPF 落地，规范 v1.3）。
/// 纪律：只动 transform/opacity；时长 90/120/180/240/480 五档 + Dur320 数字滚动专用档
/// （02b §B.1 v1.2 增补，仅 NumberRoller 消费，禁止外溢）；
/// 缓动 5 条 KeySpline 精确复刻 cubic-bezier（standard/out/in/in-out + linear 由插值表达），
/// 禁弹跳/弹簧/过冲。降级：<see cref="IsReducedMotion"/>=true 时全部动效直达终态（信息不丢，02b §B.5）。
/// </summary>
public static class Motion
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 全局降级开关。App.OnStartup 按当前设置求初值：系统动画开关关闭
    /// （SystemParameters.ClientAreaAnimation=false）或设置页覆盖=关 → true。
    /// [FIX U-04] 注释修正：并非"此后不再变更（启动期一次性求值）"——设置页
    /// ReduceMotionIndex setter 实时改判本开关（MainViewModel.cs:778-779，
    /// 当期窗口刷新即生效）。
    /// </summary>
    public static bool IsReducedMotion { get; set; }

    /// <summary>五档时长（ms，02b §B.1）。</summary>
    public static readonly Duration Dur90  = new(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(90));
    public static readonly Duration Dur120 = new(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(120));
    public static readonly Duration Dur180 = new(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(180));
    public static readonly Duration Dur240 = new(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(240));
    public static readonly Duration Dur480 = new(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(480));
    /// <summary>数字滚动专用档 320ms（02b §B.1 v1.2 增补 --dur-roll；NumberRoller 唯一消费方，禁止外溢）。</summary>
    public static readonly Duration Dur320 = new(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(320));

    /// <summary>cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) 标准曲线（进出对称，默认）。</summary>
    public static readonly KeySpline EaseStandard = new(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
    /// <summary>cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 入场（减速）。</summary>
    public static readonly KeySpline EaseOut = new(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    /// <summary>cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1) 出场（加速）。</summary>
    public static readonly KeySpline EaseIn = new(0.4, 0, 1, 1);
    /// <summary>cubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1)（02b §B.1 v1.3 增补第 5 条：状态点脉冲/进度条不确定态，循环往复）。</summary>
    public static readonly KeySpline EaseInOut = new(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1);

    /// <summary>
    /// 页面入场：opacity 0→1 + translateY 8px→0（240ms ease-out，02b §B.2「页面切换淡入+8px 位移」）。
    /// 每元素独立 TranslateTransform（不用共享实例，避免多页面动画串台）。
    /// 降级时直接置终态。
    /// </summary>
    public static void PlayPageEnter(FrameworkElement page)
    {
        if (IsReducedMotion) { page.Opacity = 1; return; }
        var slide = page.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform ?? new TranslateTransform(0, 8);
        page.RenderTransform = slide;
        page.Opacity = 0;

        var sb = new Storyboard();
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(page, UIElement.OpacityProperty, 0, 1, Dur240, EaseOut));
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(slide, TranslateTransform.YProperty, 8, 0, Dur240, EaseOut));
        sb.Begin();
    }

    /// <summary>构造 from→to 的 Spline 关键帧动画（两帧：0ms 起点 + dur 终点，精确复刻 cubic-bezier）。</summary>
    public static DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Frames(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty dp,
        double from, double to, Duration dur, KeySpline ease)
    {
        var a = new DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames();
        a.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(from, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.Zero)));
        a.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(to, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(dur.TimeSpan), ease));
        Storyboard.SetTarget(a, target);
        Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(a, new PropertyPath(dp));
        return a;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Toast 进场（02b §B.3-9：180ms ease-out，opacity 0→1 + translateY 8px→0）。
    /// 降级时直接置终态（位移归零、信息不丢）。
    /// </summary>
    public static void PlayToastEnter(FrameworkElement el)
    {
        var slide = el.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform ?? new TranslateTransform(0, 8);
        el.RenderTransform = slide;
        if (IsReducedMotion) { el.Opacity = 1; slide.Y = 0; return; }
        el.Opacity = 0;
        var sb = new Storyboard();
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(el, UIElement.OpacityProperty, 0, 1, Dur180, EaseOut));
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(slide, TranslateTransform.YProperty, 8, 0, Dur180, EaseOut));
        sb.Begin();
    }

    /// <summary>Toast 出场（120ms ease-in，opacity→0 + translateY 0→8px；降级直接隐藏）。</summary>
    public static void PlayToastExit(FrameworkElement el)
    {
        var slide = el.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform ?? new TranslateTransform(0, 0);
        el.RenderTransform = slide;
        if (IsReducedMotion) { el.Opacity = 0; return; }
        var sb = new Storyboard();
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(el, UIElement.OpacityProperty, el.Opacity, 0, Dur120, EaseIn));
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(slide, TranslateTransform.YProperty, slide.Y, 8, Dur120, EaseIn));
        sb.Completed += (_, _) => el.Opacity = 0;
        sb.Begin();
    }

    // ═══════════ V10.6 增量（06 令牌文档 §4 N-1/N-2 + §5 WPF 映射） ═══════════

    /// <summary>N-1 列表装载阶梯间隔（24ms）：卷卡首次装载 ≤5 项逐项淡入的"逐项间隔"语义，
    /// 与六档"一次过渡"时长区分，防止 Motion.cs 可读性破坏。5 项总跨度 ≤96ms 落 Dur120 感知档。</summary>
    public static readonly Duration DurStagger = new(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(24));

    /// <summary>N-2 浮层入场缩放起点（0.98→1 配 Dur180 + EaseOut）：弹窗/下拉/浮层全局一致，
    /// 写成常量防各处字面量漂移；禁弹跳（红线 9）。</summary>
    public const double ScaleOverlayFrom = 0.98;

    /// <summary>
    /// 浮层（对话框/下拉）面板入场：scale 0.98→1 + opacity 0→1 + translateY 8px→0，180ms ease-out。
    /// 面板须自带 ScaleTransform（RenderTransform）与 TranslateTransform 组合——调用方传 panel 与其 transform 组。
    /// 降级：直接置终态（opacity=1、scale=1、位移归零）。
    /// </summary>
    public static void PlayOverlayEnter(FrameworkElement panel, ScaleTransform scale, TranslateTransform slide)
    {
        panel.RenderTransform = new TransformGroup
        {
            Children = { scale, slide }
        };
        if (IsReducedMotion) { panel.Opacity = 1; scale.ScaleX = 1; scale.ScaleY = 1; slide.Y = 0; return; }
        panel.Opacity = 0;
        scale.ScaleX = ScaleOverlayFrom; scale.ScaleY = ScaleOverlayFrom;
        slide.Y = 8;
        var sb = new Storyboard();
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(panel, UIElement.OpacityProperty, 0, 1, Dur180, EaseOut));
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(scale, ScaleTransform.ScaleXProperty, ScaleOverlayFrom, 1, Dur180, EaseOut));
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(scale, ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty, ScaleOverlayFrom, 1, Dur180, EaseOut));
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(slide, TranslateTransform.YProperty, 8, 0, Dur180, EaseOut));
        sb.Begin();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 浮层面板出场：scale→0.98 + opacity→0 + translateY→8px，120ms ease-in（信息已读，允许消失）。
    /// [W1.5 V-3] onDone：出场完成回调（DialogHost 收尾隐藏/回调用；可空）。
    /// </summary>
    public static void PlayOverlayExit(FrameworkElement panel, ScaleTransform scale, TranslateTransform slide, Action? onDone = null)
    {
        if (IsReducedMotion) { panel.Opacity = 0; onDone?.Invoke(); return; }
        var sb = new Storyboard();
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(panel, UIElement.OpacityProperty, panel.Opacity, 0, Dur120, EaseIn));
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(scale, ScaleTransform.ScaleXProperty, scale.ScaleX, ScaleOverlayFrom, Dur120, EaseIn));
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(scale, ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty, scale.ScaleY, ScaleOverlayFrom, Dur120, EaseIn));
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(slide, TranslateTransform.YProperty, slide.Y, 8, Dur120, EaseIn));
        sb.Completed += (_, _) => { panel.Opacity = 0; onDone?.Invoke(); };
        sb.Begin();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 遮罩淡入/淡出（120ms ease-out / ease-in，02b §B.3-9 遮罩节奏）。
    /// [W1.5 V-3] show=false = 出场淡出（与面板 PlayOverlayExit 同步；完成后 opacity=0）。
    /// </summary>
    public static void PlayMaskFade(Border mask, bool show)
    {
        if (IsReducedMotion) { mask.Opacity = show ? 1 : 0; return; }
        if (show)
        {
            mask.Opacity = 0;
            var sb = new Storyboard();
            sb.Children.Add(Frames(mask, UIElement.OpacityProperty, 0, 1, Dur120, EaseOut));
            sb.Begin();
        }
        else
        {
            var sb = new Storyboard();
            sb.Children.Add(Frames(mask, UIElement.OpacityProperty, mask.Opacity, 0, Dur120, EaseIn));
            sb.Completed += (_, _) => mask.Opacity = 0;
            sb.Begin();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// V-6 列表装载阶梯：第 i 项延迟 i×24ms 淡入（opacity 0→1，180ms ease-out；≤5 项，仅首次装载）。
    /// 纯 opacity 不做位移（装载动效标示"内容已到达"，不承载空间信息）；降级全量直显。
    /// </summary>
    public static void PlayListStagger(FrameworkElement item, int index)
    {
        if (IsReducedMotion) { item.Opacity = 1; return; }
        double delayMs = index * DurStagger.TimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds;
        item.Opacity = 0;
        var sb = new Storyboard();
        sb.BeginTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delayMs);
        sb.Children.Add(Frames(item, UIElement.OpacityProperty, 0, 1, Dur180, EaseOut));
        sb.Begin();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 数字滚动附加属性（02b §B.2「数字滚动计数」：320ms ease-out，rAF 逐帧的 WPF 等价物）。
/// 用法：&lt;TextBlock ctl:NumberRoller.Value="{Binding AvgHit}" ctl:NumberRoller.Format="F1"/&gt;
/// 只滚数值本身；单位/百分号另起 Run，避免一起滚导致布局抖动。
/// 降级时直接写终值。
/// </summary>
public static class NumberRoller
{
    /// <summary>滚动目标值（绑定源）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty =
        DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Value", typeof(double), typeof(NumberRoller),
            new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, OnValueChanged));

    /// <summary>数值格式串（默认 "F0"）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty FormatProperty =
        DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Format", typeof(string), typeof(NumberRoller),
            new PropertyMetadata("F0"));

    /// <summary>滚动中标记（防中间帧递归再起动画）。</summary>
    private static readonly DependencyProperty RollingProperty =
        DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Rolling", typeof(bool), typeof(NumberRoller), new PropertyMetadata(false));

    public static double GetValue(DependencyObject o) => (double)o.GetValue(ValueProperty);
    public static void SetValue(DependencyObject o, double v) => o.SetValue(ValueProperty, v);
    public static string GetFormat(DependencyObject o) => (string)o.GetValue(FormatProperty);
    public static void SetFormat(DependencyObject o, string v) => o.SetValue(FormatProperty, v);
    private static bool GetRolling(DependencyObject o) => (bool)o.GetValue(RollingProperty);
    private static void SetRolling(DependencyObject o, bool v) => o.SetValue(RollingProperty, v);

    private static void OnValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (d is not TextBlock tb) return;
        double to = (double)e.NewValue;
        if (double.IsNaN(to)) return;
        string fmt = GetFormat(d);

        // [FIX B27 2026-10-18] 起点统一取依赖属性当前值：动画在飞时 GetValue 返回
        // 当前动画帧值 → 新目标到达即以呈现值为起点重启动画（连续衔接无抖动）。
        // 原实现"滚动中只写文本"与在飞动画互相覆盖（文本在新旧目标间跳变）。
        double from;
        if (GetRolling(d))
            from = (double)d.GetValue(ValueProperty);          // 在飞：当前帧衔接
        else if (e.OldValue is double old && !double.IsNaN(old))
            from = old;                                        // 常规：旧值起步
        else
            from = to;                                         // 首次：直达
        if (Motion.IsReducedMotion)
        {
            tb.Text = to.ToString(fmt, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            return;
        }

        if (Math.Abs(from - to) < 1e-9)
        {
            tb.Text = to.ToString(fmt, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            return;
        }

        SetRolling(d, true);
        var anim = Motion.Frames(tb, ValueProperty, from, to, Motion.Dur320, Motion.EaseOut);
        // FillBehavior.Stop：结束即交还绑定控制权，后续采样照常触发
        anim.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
        anim.Completed += (_, _) => SetRolling(d, false);
        tb.BeginAnimation(ValueProperty, anim);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// [W1.5 V-3] 下拉浮层微入场挂件（06 令牌文档 V-3 消费方"下拉浮层"的 WPF 落地）。
/// 用法：ComboBox 全局样式 Setter 设置 <c>OverlayPop.IsEnabled="True"</c>；模板内
/// Popup 须命名 "popup"（其 Child 为浮层面板）。DropDownOpened 后一拍（Render 优先级，
/// 等 Popup 布局就绪）对面板播 <see cref="Motion.PlayOverlayEnter"/>：
/// scale 0.98→1 + 淡入 + translateY 8px→0（180ms EaseOut；reduced-motion 直显终态）。
/// 出场不做：WPF Popup 关闭由框架即时收起（无出场时机）——能力边界如实标注，
/// 系统 PopupAnimation 须置 None（动画单一事实源在 Motion，防双重淡入）。
/// </summary>
public static class OverlayPop
{
    public static readonly DependencyProperty IsEnabledProperty =
        DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsEnabled", typeof(bool), typeof(OverlayPop),
            new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsEnabledChanged));

    public static bool GetIsEnabled(DependencyObject o) => (bool)o.GetValue(IsEnabledProperty);
    public static void SetIsEnabled(DependencyObject o, bool value) => o.SetValue(IsEnabledProperty, value);

    private static void OnIsEnabledChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (d is not ComboBox cb) return;
        if ((bool)e.NewValue) cb.DropDownOpened += OnDropDownOpened;
        else cb.DropDownOpened -= OnDropDownOpened;
    }

    private static void OnDropDownOpened(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not ComboBox cb) return;
        // 一拍 Render 优先级：等 Popup 完成布局再播（面板尺寸/位置已就绪）
        cb.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
        {
            if (!cb.IsDropDownOpen) return;   // 竞态：瞬间关闭则不播
            if (cb.Template.FindName("popup", cb) is not Popup { Child: FrameworkElement panel }) return;
            // PlayOverlayEnter 自带 TransformGroup 组装 + reduced-motion 分支；每次打开复用同面板，
            // RenderTransform 覆盖式重建（新 Scale/Slide 实例），无跨开泄漏
            Motion.PlayOverlayEnter(panel, new ScaleTransform(), new TranslateTransform());
        }), DispatcherPriority.Render);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>堆叠条分段（Value=字节数/卷数；BrushKey=语义色键名）。</summary>
public sealed record BarSegment(double Value, string BrushKey);

/// <summary>
/// 水平堆叠条（02b §A.1 图 #5 未落盘堆叠 / #7 写模式构成共用）。
/// 纪律：只动 transform/opacity（scaleX 补间 180ms standard）；段间 2px 间隙；
/// 总量 0 → 轨道 + 居中空态文案（禁 0 长度条误导）；语义色只表达状态、数据系单色。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SegmentedBar : Control
{
    static SegmentedBar()
    {
        DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SegmentedBar),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(SegmentedBar)));
    }

    /// <summary>分段集合（空=空态）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty SegmentsProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Segments), typeof(IList<BarSegment>), typeof(SegmentedBar),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnSegmentsChanged));

    /// <summary>总量（0=按分段和自动；>0=按给定总量归一，余量画轨道）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty TotalProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Total), typeof(double), typeof(SegmentedBar),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    /// <summary>空态文案（总量 0 时居中显示）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty EmptyTextProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(EmptyText), typeof(string), typeof(SegmentedBar),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public IList<BarSegment>? Segments { get => (IList<BarSegment>?)GetValue(SegmentsProperty); set => SetValue(SegmentsProperty, value); }
    public double Total { get => (double)GetValue(TotalProperty); set => SetValue(TotalProperty, value); }
    public string EmptyText { get => (string)GetValue(EmptyTextProperty); set => SetValue(EmptyTextProperty, value); }

    private static readonly DependencyProperty ProgressProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Progress), typeof(double), typeof(SegmentedBar),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    private double Progress { get => (double)GetValue(ProgressProperty); set => SetValue(ProgressProperty, value); }

    /* [FIX QA5-UI4] 首播保护：VM 每 tick 抛新数组引用 → DP 必判变，原实现
     * 每 5s 重播 180ms 生长动画（周期性闪烁）。首播后纯数据刷新只重绘。 */
    private bool _played;

    private static void OnSegmentsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var c = (SegmentedBar)d;
        double sum = 0;
        if (c.Segments is not null) foreach (var s in c.Segments) sum += Math.Max(0, s.Value);
        if (Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion || sum <= 0) { c.Progress = 1; return; }
        if (c._played) { c.Progress = 1; return; }   // 刷新不重播
        c._played = true;
        c.Progress = 0;
        var anim = new DoubleAnimation(0, 1, Controls.Motion.Dur180);
        anim.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
        anim.Completed += (_, _) => c.Progress = 1;
        c.BeginAnimation(ProgressProperty, anim);
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        base.OnRender(dc);
        double w = ActualWidth, h = ActualHeight;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        var track = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartTrack");
        double sum = 0;
        if (Segments is not null) foreach (var s in Segments) sum += Math.Max(0, s.Value);
        double total = Total > 0 ? Total : sum;

        // 轨道（整条）
        dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(track, null, new Rect(0, 0, w, h), h / 2, h / 2);

        if (sum <= 0)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(EmptyText))
                ChartShapes.DrawEmptyText(dc, EmptyText, w, h, (Brush)FindResource("RbcTextTertiary"));
            return;
        }

        double p = Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion ? 1 : Progress;
        /* [FIX QA5-UI3] Total 归一：先按 sum/total 收缩总宽（Total>0 时段间
         * 留出轨道），再按 sum 分配段宽——原 total 是死变量，段宽按 sum 归一，
         * 未落盘 1GB/上限 24GB 会被画成满条（视觉误导）。 */
        double drawW = w * p * Math.Min(1.0, sum / total);
        const double gap = 2;
        double usable = drawW - gap * (Segments!.Count - 1);
        if (usable <= 0) return;
        double x = 0;
        foreach (var seg in Segments!)
        {
            double v = Math.Max(0, seg.Value);
            double sw = usable * v / sum;
            if (sw <= 0) continue;
            var brush = TryBrush(seg.BrushKey) ?? track;
            dc.DrawRoundedRectangle(brush, null, new Rect(x, 0, sw, h), h / 2, h / 2);
            x += sw + gap;
        }
    }

    private Brush? TryBrush(string key)
    {
        try { return FindResource(key) as Brush; }
        catch { return null; }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 平滑进度条（02b §B.2「进度条·确定态」180ms standard）。
/// 做法：动画驱动 Value 本身（180ms 插值），视觉层由 App.xaml 隐式样式的
/// scaleX 绑定逐帧消费——数值平滑且只动 transform（D9 合规）。
/// 降级（IsReducedMotion）走基类即时刷新。
/// </summary>
public sealed class SmoothProgressBar : ProgressBar
{
    private bool _rolling;

    protected override void OnValueChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
    {
        if (_rolling || Motion.IsReducedMotion || !IsLoaded)
        {
            base.OnValueChanged(oldValue, newValue);
            return;
        }
        double target = Clamp(newValue);
        if (Math.Abs(target - Clamp(oldValue)) < 0.0001)
        {
            base.OnValueChanged(oldValue, newValue);
            return;
        }

        _rolling = true;
        var anim = Motion.Frames(this, RangeBase.ValueProperty, Clamp(oldValue), target,
            Motion.Dur180, Motion.EaseStandard);
        anim.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;   // 结束交还绑定，防动画阴影冻结后续采样
        anim.Completed += (_, _) => _rolling = false;
        BeginAnimation(RangeBase.ValueProperty, anim);
    }

    private double Clamp(double v)
    {
        double max = Maximum <= 0 ? 100 : Maximum;
        return double.IsNaN(v) ? 0 : v < 0 ? 0 : v > max ? max : v;
    }
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Controls/Sparkline.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 轻量折线图（FrameworkElement 自绘）：Value 推入环形缓冲，OnRender 画线。
/// 磁盘页以此显示读/写 MB/s 迷你曲线。
/// [FIX 致命-1 2026-10-18] Stroke 由 Color 改 Brush——XAML 传 SolidColorBrush 资源
/// （如 RbcSuccessFg）原类型错配导致模板实例化异常风暴（2194 条/秒、磁盘页全黑）。
/// [FIX 警告-7] Capacity 生效（变更即重建缓冲）；Unloaded 清空历史（ListBox 容器
/// 回收复用时不再混入上一卷曲线）；Loaded 仅首次播种（重复 Loaded 不产生重复点）。
/// [FIX B28] 默认笔画对齐主题 RbcAccent（#4CC2FF），不再散落色值。
/// </summary>
public sealed class Sparkline : FrameworkElement
{
    private static readonly Brush DefaultStroke = CreateDefaultStroke();

    private static Brush CreateDefaultStroke()
    {
        var b = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(0x4C, 0xC2, 0xFF));   // = RbcAccent
        b.Freeze();
        return b;
    }

    /// <summary>新采样值（推入即绘图；磁盘页每秒刷新）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(Value), typeof(double), typeof(Sparkline),
        new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));
    /// <summary>环形缓冲容量（默认 30 点；变更即重建缓冲）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty CapacityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(Capacity), typeof(int), typeof(Sparkline),
        new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(30, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));
    /// <summary>线条笔画（Brush——与 WPF 笔画属性惯例一致）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty StrokeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(Stroke), typeof(Brush), typeof(Sparkline),
        new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(DefaultStroke, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public double Value { get => (double)GetValue(ValueProperty); set => SetValue(ValueProperty, value); }
    public int Capacity { get => (int)GetValue(CapacityProperty); set => SetValue(CapacityProperty, value); }
    public Brush Stroke { get => (Brush)GetValue(StrokeProperty); set => SetValue(StrokeProperty, value); }

    private double[] _ring = new double[30];
    private int _head, _count;
    private bool _seeded;

    public Sparkline()
    {
        Loaded  += (_, _) => { if (!_seeded) { Push(Value); _seeded = true; } };
        Unloaded += (_, _) => { _head = 0; _count = 0; _seeded = false; };   // 容器回收：清历史
    }

    protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
        if (e.Property == ValueProperty) Push(Value);
        else if (e.Property == CapacityProperty) { Reset(); InvalidateVisual(); }
    }

    private void Reset() { _ring = new double[Math.Max(2, Capacity)]; _head = 0; _count = 0; _seeded = false; }

    private void Push(double v)
    {
        if (_ring.Length != Math.Max(2, Capacity)) Reset();
        /* [FIX R6-UI14] NaN 过滤：控件是公共 DP（Value 可为任意 double），NaN 进
         * 环形缓冲后 OnRender 的 max=NaN → 全部 y=NaN → StreamGeometry 收 NaN 点
         * （渲染异常路径）。当前绑定源恒有限故不可达，属纪律补齐。 */
        if (double.IsNaN(v)) v = 0;
        _ring[_head] = v;
        _head = (_head + 1) % _ring.Length;
        _count = Math.Min(_count + 1, _ring.Length);
        InvalidateVisual();
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        double w = ActualWidth, h = ActualHeight;
        var stroke = Stroke ?? DefaultStroke;
        // [设计 v2 2026-10-24] 空态画基线轨道——原 _count<2 直接 return 让卷卡
        // sparkline 区塌陷成空白（加速页截图实锤），控件应有视觉存在感
        if (_count < 2)
        {
            var trackPen = new Pen(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(0x23, 0x23, 0x2B)), 1);   // = RbcChartTrack
            trackPen.Freeze();
            dc.DrawLine(trackPen, new Point(0, h - 1), new Point(w, h - 1));
            return;
        }
        double max = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++) max = Math.Max(max, _ring[i]);
        var brush = stroke.Clone(); brush.Freeze();               // 渲染线程要求冻结画刷
        var pen = new Pen(brush, 1.6);
        pen.Freeze();
        var geo = new StreamGeometry();
        using (var ctx = geo.Open())
        {
            bool first = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++)
            {
                int idx = (_head - _count + i + _ring.Length) % _ring.Length;
                double x = w * i / (_count - 1);
                double y = h - h * (_ring[idx] / max) * 0.92 - 2;
                if (first) { ctx.BeginFigure(new Point(x, y), false, false); first = false; }
                else ctx.LineTo(new Point(x, y), true, false);
            }
        }
        geo.Freeze();
        dc.DrawGeometry(null, pen, geo);
    }
}
````

````xml
<UserControl x:Class="RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls.StateBar"
             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
    <!-- 常驻四段状态条（契约 §1 / 体验架构 §4.2；原型 renderStatusbar + .seg CSS 的 1:1 转译）
         段：驱动 · 挂栈 · 加速 · 风险；Click 事件由 MainViewModel 路由到处置页。
         [FIX B26] 三枚状态条令牌落地消费（原 Dark.xaml 死令牌）：
         底= RbcBgStatusbar、高= RbcStatusbarHeight、内边距= RbcPadStatusbar。
         [W1.5 截图比对 S8 2026-10-23] 对齐原型 .seg 精确规格：
         · 药丸：高恒 30px（设计软件实测 45px@150%DPI，非 HTML 原型 CSS 的 24px）、padding 0 12px、元素间距 8px（flex gap）、radius=md(10px) 圆角矩形——用户 17:29 裁决圆角矩形 + 17:34 裁决弧度加大一档（sm6→md10）；
         · 标签/点 = 段类语义色（ok=绿/info=蓝/warning=琥珀/danger=红/neutral=灰）；
         · 值 = 恒 RbcTextPrimary + 600（原型 .seg-val，不随语义色）；
         · 「success」类在原型 CSS 无 tint 定义 → 加速/风险正常态 = 透明裸段（点/标签灰）。
         颜色由 code-behind ColorSeg 按 Update() 状态驱动（XAML 不写死任何前景色）。 -->
    <Border Background="{StaticResource RbcBgStatusbar}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource RbcBorder}"
            BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="{StaticResource RbcPadStatusbar}"
            MinHeight="{StaticResource RbcStatusbarHeight}">
        <!-- 原型 .statusbar{align-items:center}：24px 药丸在 40px 条内垂直居中 -->
        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
            <Border x:Name="SegDriver" CornerRadius="{StaticResource RbcRadiusMd}" Padding="12,0" MinHeight="30" Margin="0,0,12,0"
                    Background="Transparent" Cursor="Hand" Focusable="True"
                    AutomationProperties.Name="驱动连接状态，Enter 打开诊断"
                    FocusVisualStyle="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"
                    MouseLeftButtonUp="SegDriver_Click">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8" Margin="0,0,8,0" x:Name="DotDriver"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LblDriver" Text="驱动" FontSize="12"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="ValDriver" Margin="8,0,0,0" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            <Border x:Name="SegStack" CornerRadius="{StaticResource RbcRadiusMd}" Padding="12,0" MinHeight="30" Margin="0,0,12,0"
                    Background="Transparent" Cursor="Hand" Focusable="True"
                    AutomationProperties.Name="挂栈卷状态，Enter 打开加速"
                    FocusVisualStyle="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"
                    MouseLeftButtonUp="SegStack_Click">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8" Margin="0,0,8,0" x:Name="DotStack"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LblStack" Text="挂栈" FontSize="12"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="ValStack" Margin="8,0,0,0" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            <Border x:Name="SegAccel" CornerRadius="{StaticResource RbcRadiusMd}" Padding="12,0" MinHeight="30" Margin="0,0,12,0"
                    Background="Transparent" Cursor="Hand" Focusable="True"
                    AutomationProperties.Name="加速启用状态，Enter 打开状态"
                    FocusVisualStyle="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"
                    MouseLeftButtonUp="SegAccel_Click">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8" Margin="0,0,8,0" x:Name="DotAccel"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LblAccel" Text="加速" FontSize="12"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="ValAccel" Margin="8,0,0,0" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            <Border x:Name="SegRisk" CornerRadius="{StaticResource RbcRadiusMd}" Padding="12,0" MinHeight="30"
                    Background="Transparent" Cursor="Hand" Focusable="True"
                    AutomationProperties.Name="风险状态，Enter 打开应急"
                    FocusVisualStyle="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"
                    MouseLeftButtonUp="SegRisk_Click">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Ellipse Width="8" Height="8" Margin="0,0,8,0" x:Name="DotRisk"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LblRisk" Text="风险" FontSize="12"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="ValRisk" Margin="8,0,0,0" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>
        </StackPanel>
    </Border>
</UserControl>
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;
using System.Windows.Shapes;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 四段状态条（原型 final/RAMBlockCache-UI-prototype.html 的 WPF 对应物）。
/// 数据输入：Update() 传驱动快照；渲染一律经 UiStateView（状态单一事实）。
/// 动效：颜色过渡 240ms 标准曲线（02b §B；只动 Brush/Opacity，不做布局动画）。
/// </summary>
public partial class StateBar : UserControl
{
    /// <summary>段点击 → 请求导航（主窗口把路由到对应处置页）。</summary>
    public event Action<string>? NavigateRequested;

    public StateBar() { InitializeComponent(); }

    // 资源查找走 FrameworkElement.TryFindResource（实例成员，从控件可视树向上解析
    // 主题字典）；故 BrushOf/ColorSeg 均为实例方法（旧静态签名 CS0120）。
    private SolidColorBrush BrushOf(string key) =>
        TryFindResource(key) as SolidColorBrush ?? FallbackPalette.Neutral;

    /* [FIX C#10] ~12% 语义底缓存（键=基色）：冻结画刷跨线程共享 + 零每帧分配。 */
    private static readonly System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentDictionary<Color, SolidColorBrush> _tints = new();

    private static SolidColorBrush Tint(Color c)
    {
        if (_tints.TryGetValue(c, out var hit)) return hit;
        var tint = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(0x1E, c.R, c.G, c.B));
        tint.Freeze();
        _tints[c] = tint;
        return tint;
    }

    private void ColorSeg(Border seg, Ellipse dot, SolidColorBrush fg) => ColorSeg(seg, dot, null, null, fg);

    /// <summary>
    /// 段渲染（[W1.5 截图比对 S8 2026-10-23] 原型 .seg CSS 1:1 转译）：
    /// · tint 类段（ok/info/warning/danger/neutral）：12% 语义底 + 点/标签语义色；
    /// · 裸段（原型 'success' 类无 CSS 定义=正常加速/风险态）：**透明底 + 点/标签灰**；
    /// · 值恒 RbcTextPrimary + 600（原型 .seg-val——不随段类变色）。
    /// 上一轮"四段全染绿"是误读原型，本版回到逐段类规则。
    /// </summary>
    private void ColorSeg(Border seg, Ellipse dot, System.Windows.Controls.TextBlock? lbl,
                          System.Windows.Controls.TextBlock? val, SolidColorBrush fg, bool plain = false)
    {
        var sec = BrushOf("RbcTextSecondary");
        if (plain)
        {
            seg.Background = Brushes.Transparent;
            dot.Fill = sec;
            if (lbl is not null) lbl.Foreground = sec;
        }
        else
        {
            // [FIX 严重-3 2026-10-18] 直接应用 ~12% 语义色底（02b 低透明语义底规范）
            // [FIX U-06] 回退色引 FallbackPalette.Neutral；[FIX C#10] Tint 按色键缓存+Freeze
            var c = (fg as SolidColorBrush)?.Color ?? FallbackPalette.Neutral.Color;
            seg.Background = Tint(c);
            dot.Fill = fg;
            if (lbl is not null) lbl.Foreground = fg;
        }
        if (val is not null) val.Foreground = BrushOf("RbcTextPrimary");
    }

    /// <summary>[动效 02b §B.2] 等待态圆点脉冲：1200ms opacity 1→0.45→1 循环。
    /// 适用：驱动未连接（重连等待）/ 熔断自愈中 / 脏数据待落盘。
    /// 静止态或降级（IsReducedMotion）：停动画并恒定全不透明——信息不丢。
    /// [FIX 警-9 2026-10-19] 状态未变化不重启动画：Update() 每 1s 调用且每次
    /// BeginAnimation 替换=相位重置，1200ms 周期的回升段（600-1200ms）永远
    /// 不可达——圆点在 ~0.45 处被硬拉回 1.0，视觉抽搐而非平滑脉冲。
    private bool _pulseDriver, _pulseAccel, _pulseRisk;

    private void PulseDot(Ellipse dot, bool waiting, ref bool state)
    {
        if (!waiting || Motion.IsReducedMotion)
        {
            if (!state && !waiting) return;   /* 本就静止：不动 */
            state = waiting;
            dot.BeginAnimation(OpacityProperty, null);
            dot.Opacity = 1;
            return;
        }
        if (state) return;                    /* 已在脉冲：不重启相位 */
        state = true;
        var a = new DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames { RepeatBehavior = RepeatBehavior.Forever };
        a.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(1.0, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.Zero)));
        a.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(0.45, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(600)), Motion.EaseIn));
        a.KeyFrames.Add(new SplineDoubleKeyFrame(1.0, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1200)), Motion.EaseOut));
        dot.BeginAnimation(OpacityProperty, a);
    }

    /// <summary>主入口：驱动快照 → 四段渲染。参数来自 MainViewModel 的采样结果。
    /// [FIX B2] lostDirtyBytes/lostWarnThreshold 可选追加（既有调用方零改动）：
    /// 已确认丢失 > 阈值时风险段转琥珀"已丢失 X"（点击段 → 应急页核对入口）。</summary>
    public void Update(bool connected, bool accessDenied, bool protocolMismatch,
                       bool panic, bool healing, bool safeMode,
                       int boundCount, int attachedCount, int backCount,
                       ulong dirtyBytes, ulong dirtyWarnThreshold,
                       string driverVersion,
                       ulong lostDirtyBytes = 0, ulong lostWarnThreshold = 0)
    {
        // —— 段 1：驱动 ——（原型 renderStatusbar：无权限/版本不匹配=danger；未连接=neutral；正常=ok 绿）
        if (!connected && accessDenied)
        {
            ValDriver.Text = "无权限";
            ColorSeg(SegDriver, DotDriver, LblDriver, ValDriver, BrushOf("RbcDangerFg"));
        }
        else if (!connected)
        {
            ValDriver.Text = "未连接";
            ColorSeg(SegDriver, DotDriver, LblDriver, ValDriver, BrushOf("RbcNeutralFg"));
        }
        else if (protocolMismatch)
        {
            ValDriver.Text = "版本不匹配";
            ColorSeg(SegDriver, DotDriver, LblDriver, ValDriver, BrushOf("RbcDangerFg"));
        }
        else
        {
            ValDriver.Text = $"已连接 {driverVersion}";
            ColorSeg(SegDriver, DotDriver, LblDriver, ValDriver, BrushOf("RbcSuccessFg"));
        }

        // —— 段 2：挂栈 ——（原型：已连接恒 info 蓝「已挂 N 卷」；未连接 neutral「—」）
        ValStack.Text = connected ? $"已挂 {boundCount} 卷" : "—";
        ColorSeg(SegStack, DotStack, LblStack, ValStack,
            connected ? BrushOf("RbcInfoFg") : BrushOf("RbcNeutralFg"));

        // —— 段 3：加速 ——（原型：panic=danger / safeMode=warning / 未连接=neutral /
        //     加速中=裸段统计口径（success 类无 tint）/ 未加速·未挂栈=info 蓝）
        if (panic)
        {
            ValAccel.Text = healing ? "熔断 · 自愈中" : "熔断暂停";
            ColorSeg(SegAccel, DotAccel, LblAccel, ValAccel, BrushOf("RbcDangerFg"));
        }
        else if (safeMode)
        {
            ValAccel.Text = "安全模式 · 强制直写";
            ColorSeg(SegAccel, DotAccel, LblAccel, ValAccel, BrushOf("RbcWarningFg"));
        }
        else if (!connected)
        {
            ValAccel.Text = "—";
            ColorSeg(SegAccel, DotAccel, LblAccel, ValAccel, BrushOf("RbcNeutralFg"));
        }
        else if (attachedCount > 0)
        {
            // 原型口径：混合=「N 卷 · X 直写 / Y 回写」；纯直写=「N 卷 · 直写」（无"/ 0 回写"尾巴）
            ValAccel.Text = backCount > 0
                ? $"{attachedCount} 卷 · {attachedCount - backCount} 直写 / {backCount} 回写"
                : $"{attachedCount} 卷 · 直写";
            ColorSeg(SegAccel, DotAccel, LblAccel, ValAccel, BrushOf("RbcSuccessFg"), plain: true);
        }
        else if (boundCount > 0)
        {
            ValAccel.Text = "未加速";
            ColorSeg(SegAccel, DotAccel, LblAccel, ValAccel, BrushOf("RbcInfoFg"));
        }
        else
        {
            ValAccel.Text = "未挂栈";
            ColorSeg(SegAccel, DotAccel, LblAccel, ValAccel, BrushOf("RbcInfoFg"));
        }

        // —— 段 4：风险 ——（原型：panic=danger / safeMode·未落盘=warning / 正常=裸段「无」；
        //     [FIX B2] 已确认丢失=warning 琥珀，既成事实优先于未落盘超限）
        var risk = UiStateView.ResolveRisk(panic, safeMode, dirtyBytes, dirtyWarnThreshold,
                                           lostDirtyBytes, lostWarnThreshold);
        switch (risk)
        {
            case UiRisk.Panic:
                ValRisk.Text = healing ? "熔断 · 自愈中" : "熔断中";
                ColorSeg(SegRisk, DotRisk, LblRisk, ValRisk, BrushOf("RbcDangerFg"));
                break;
            case UiRisk.SafeMode:
                ValRisk.Text = "安全模式";
                ColorSeg(SegRisk, DotRisk, LblRisk, ValRisk, BrushOf("RbcWarningFg"));
                break;
            case UiRisk.LostDirty:
                ValRisk.Text = $"已丢失 {lostDirtyBytes / 1048576.0:F1} MB";
                ColorSeg(SegRisk, DotRisk, LblRisk, ValRisk, BrushOf("RbcWarningFg"));
                break;
            case UiRisk.DirtyPending:
                ValRisk.Text = $"未落盘 {dirtyBytes / 1048576} MB";
                ColorSeg(SegRisk, DotRisk, LblRisk, ValRisk, BrushOf("RbcWarningFg"));
                break;
            default:
                ValRisk.Text = "无";
                ColorSeg(SegRisk, DotRisk, LblRisk, ValRisk, BrushOf("RbcSuccessFg"), plain: true);
                break;
        }

        // [动效] 等待态脉冲（原型仅两处：加速段熔断自愈中 + 风险段熔断自愈中；
        // 未连接不脉冲——WPF 无「正在重连」子态，驱动段恒静止；静止态自动停；降级内置处理）
        PulseDot(DotDriver, false, ref _pulseDriver);
        PulseDot(DotAccel, panic && healing, ref _pulseAccel);
        PulseDot(DotRisk, panic && healing, ref _pulseRisk);
    }

    /// <summary>键盘与鼠标共用导航：Enter/Space 激活当前状态段。</summary>
    protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == Key.Enter || e.Key == Key.Space)
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(e.OriginalSource, SegDriver)) NavigateRequested?.Invoke("诊断");
            else if (ReferenceEquals(e.OriginalSource, SegStack)) NavigateRequested?.Invoke("加速");
            else if (ReferenceEquals(e.OriginalSource, SegAccel)) NavigateRequested?.Invoke("状态");
            else if (ReferenceEquals(e.OriginalSource, SegRisk)) NavigateRequested?.Invoke("应急");
            else { base.OnKeyDown(e); return; }
            e.Handled = true;
        }
        base.OnKeyDown(e);
    }

    // [FIX M25] 段点击导航映射到真实页面：原导航"诊断/加速/应急"在 NavItems 与
    // DataTrigger 中均不存在 → 内容区整片空白（100% 复现）。改为就近语义映射。
    // [IA 重组 2026-10-19] 六页新路由（T3.5）：驱动→诊断、挂栈→加速、加速→状态、风险→应急。
    private void SegDriver_Click(object s, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e) => NavigateRequested?.Invoke("诊断");
    private void SegStack_Click(object s, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e) => NavigateRequested?.Invoke("加速");
    private void SegAccel_Click(object s, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e) => NavigateRequested?.Invoke("状态");
    private void SegRisk_Click(object s, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e) => NavigateRequested?.Invoke("应急");
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 分片吞吐热力条（02b §A.1 图 #4：64 分片 × 读/写双行，三色热阶）。
/// 数据语义：每格 = 该分片本周期吞吐量（VM 按相邻全局采样差值算好并已按本周期
/// 峰值归一 0..1；控件内部再按行内最大值兜底归一一次——对已归一输入幂等）。
/// 纪律（02b §A.5 / §F.2-7）：
/// ① 空态不归零——两行都无热值（首样本/驱动离线/全 0）时画原因文案，禁画热块；
/// ② 零值格画 RbcChartTrack 底（表示"该分片本周期无吞吐"，非数据缺失）；
/// ③ 热阶 RbcChartHeat1→2→3 按强度量化（复用 V2.0 已预留热力三色，不新增令牌）；
/// ④ NaN/越界长度按无数据格处理（track 底），不插值；
/// ⑤ 480ms 一次性淡入（只动 opacity）；reduced-motion 直接全显。
/// </summary>
public sealed class StripeHeatmap : Control
{
    /// <summary>分片格数（与 RbP.Stripes / RB_STRIPES 一致，协议冻结 64）。</summary>
    public const int Cells = 64;

    /// <summary>[W1.5 V-2] 热力格子圆角 = 2px（06 §4.3 组件常量 RbcHeatCellRadius：
    /// 单消费方按增量原则 #4 不下沉令牌；图表专用微圆角，不进五档圆角体系）。</summary>
    private const double CellRadius = 2;

    static StripeHeatmap()
    {
        DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(StripeHeatmap),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(StripeHeatmap)));
    }

    /// <summary>读吞吐归一序列（0..1；NaN=无数据；长度非 64 时按前 64 格截取）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty ReadValuesProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(ReadValues), typeof(IList<double>), typeof(StripeHeatmap),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnValuesChanged));

    /// <summary>写吞吐归一序列（0..1；语义同 ReadValues）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty WriteValuesProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(WriteValues), typeof(IList<double>), typeof(StripeHeatmap),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnValuesChanged));

    /// <summary>空态原因文案（统计不可用时显示；默认"统计暂不可用"）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty EmptyTextProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(EmptyText), typeof(string), typeof(StripeHeatmap),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("统计暂不可用", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public IList<double>? ReadValues { get => (IList<double>?)GetValue(ReadValuesProperty); set => SetValue(ReadValuesProperty, value); }
    public IList<double>? WriteValues { get => (IList<double>?)GetValue(WriteValuesProperty); set => SetValue(WriteValuesProperty, value); }
    public string EmptyText { get => (string)GetValue(EmptyTextProperty); set => SetValue(EmptyTextProperty, value); }

    /// <summary>淡入进度 0–1（480ms 一次性入场；reduced-motion 恒 1）。</summary>
    private static readonly DependencyProperty ProgressProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Progress), typeof(double), typeof(StripeHeatmap),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    private double Progress { get => (double)GetValue(ProgressProperty); set => SetValue(ProgressProperty, value); }

    /* [FIX 主-3 2026-10-19] 首播标记：VM 每 5s 抛新数组 → DP 必判变，原实现
     * 每 5s 重播 480ms 淡入（整图周期性闪烁）。首播后仅重绘。 */
    private bool _played;

    private static void OnValuesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var c = (StripeHeatmap)d;
        // 480ms 一次性淡入：新数据到达且未降级时播放一次；无数据/降级直接全显
        if (Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion || !(HasHeat(c.ReadValues) || HasHeat(c.WriteValues)))
        { c.Progress = 1; return; }
        if (c._played) { c.Progress = 1; return; }   // 刷新不重播
        c._played = true;
        c.Progress = 0;
        var anim = new DoubleAnimation(0, 1, Controls.Motion.Dur480);
        anim.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
        anim.Completed += (_, _) => c.Progress = 1;
        c.BeginAnimation(ProgressProperty, anim);
    }

    /// <summary>序列是否含至少一个热值（非 NaN 且 &gt;0）；全 0/全 NaN/空=空态。</summary>
    private static bool HasHeat(IList<double>? series)
    {
        if (series is null) return false;
        foreach (var v in series) if (!double.IsNaN(v) && v > 0) return true;
        return false;
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        base.OnRender(dc);
        double w = ActualWidth, h = ActualHeight;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        var track = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartTrack");
        var axisText = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartAxisText");
        var heat1 = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartHeat1");
        var heat2 = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartHeat2");
        var heat3 = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartHeat3");

        bool hasR = HasHeat(ReadValues), hasW = HasHeat(WriteValues);
        if (!hasR && !hasW)
        {
            // 空态：画原因文案，禁画 64 格 track 底（避免"有结构无数据"的误导）
            ChartShapes.DrawEmptyText(dc, EmptyText, w, h, axisText);
            return;
        }

        // 布局：两行（读上/写下），行标 20px + 8px 行间距；格宽自适应，≥4px 时留 1.5px 间隙
        const double labelW = 20, rowGap = 8;
        double rowH = Math.Clamp((h - rowGap) / 2, 12, 44);
        double cellW = (w - labelW) / Cells;
        double drawW = Math.Max(cellW - (cellW >= 4 ? 1.5 : 0.5), 0.5);

        double p = Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion ? 1 : Math.Clamp(Progress, 0, 1);
        if (p < 1) dc.PushOpacity(p, null);
        DrawRow(dc, "读", ReadValues, 0, labelW, cellW, drawW, rowH, track, axisText, heat1, heat2, heat3);
        DrawRow(dc, "写", WriteValues, rowH + rowGap, labelW, cellW, drawW, rowH, track, axisText, heat1, heat2, heat3);
        if (p < 1) dc.Pop();
    }

    /// <summary>画一行 64 格热力（行标 + 分片格；行内按最大值兜底归一，peak≤0 全 track）。</summary>
    private static void DrawRow(DrawingContext dc, string label, IList<double>? series, double y,
                                double labelW, double cellW, double drawW, double rowH,
                                Brush track, Brush axisText, Brush heat1, Brush heat2, Brush heat3)
    {
        var ft = new FormattedText(label, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
            new Typeface("Segoe UI"), 12, axisText, Dpi());
        dc.DrawText(ft, new Point(0, y + rowH / 2 - ft.Height / 2));

        double peak = ChartShapes.MaxOf(series);
        // [W1.5 V-2] 圆角半径 clamp 到格子半宽/半高（64 格窄列下 drawW 可 &lt;4px，防半径越界）
        double radius = Math.Min(CellRadius, drawW / 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < Cells; i++)
        {
            double v = series is not null && i < series.Count ? series[i] : double.NaN;
            double t = peak > 0 && !double.IsNaN(v) ? Math.Clamp(v / peak, 0, 1) : 0;
            // 三色热阶量化：低→Heat1 / 中→Heat2 / 高→Heat3；0/NaN→track 底（无吞吐）
            Brush fill = t <= 0 ? track : t < 0.34 ? heat1 : t < 0.67 ? heat2 : heat3;
            double x = labelW + i * cellW;
            dc.DrawGeometry(fill, null, new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(x, y, drawW, rowH), radius, radius));
        }
    }

    /* [FIX D#15] 收敛到 Controls/DpiX 单点（原 7 处同款私有实现） */
    private static double Dpi() => DpiX.Of();
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 读写吞吐双线（02b §A.1 图 #3：双 Path + 图例，Y 自适应）。
/// 纪律：数据系 chart-1（读）/ chart-2（写）明度差 + 图例标签区分；
/// 断线留缺口；空态画原因文案；480ms 一次性描边（两条同播）。
/// </summary>
public sealed class ThroughputChart : Control
{
    static ThroughputChart()
    {
        DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ThroughputChart),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(ThroughputChart)));
    }

    /// <summary>读吞吐序列（MB/s；NaN=中断）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty ReadSeriesProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(ReadSeries), typeof(IList<double>), typeof(ThroughputChart),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnSeriesChanged));

    /// <summary>写吞吐序列（MB/s；NaN=中断）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty WriteSeriesProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(WriteSeries), typeof(IList<double>), typeof(ThroughputChart),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnSeriesChanged));

    /// <summary>空态原因文案。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty EmptyTextProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(EmptyText), typeof(string), typeof(ThroughputChart),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("统计暂不可用", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public IList<double>? ReadSeries { get => (IList<double>?)GetValue(ReadSeriesProperty); set => SetValue(ReadSeriesProperty, value); }
    public IList<double>? WriteSeries { get => (IList<double>?)GetValue(WriteSeriesProperty); set => SetValue(WriteSeriesProperty, value); }
    public string EmptyText { get => (string)GetValue(EmptyTextProperty); set => SetValue(EmptyTextProperty, value); }

    private static readonly DependencyProperty ProgressProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Progress), typeof(double), typeof(ThroughputChart),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    private double Progress { get => (double)GetValue(ProgressProperty); set => SetValue(ProgressProperty, value); }

    /* [FIX 主-3 2026-10-19] 首播标记：VM 每 5s 抛新数组引用 → DP 必判变，
     * 原实现每 5s 重播 480ms 入场动画（"一次性"承诺失效）。首播后仅重绘。 */
    private bool _played;

    private static void OnSeriesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var c = (ThroughputChart)d;
        bool has = ChartShapes.HasData(c.ReadSeries) || ChartShapes.HasData(c.WriteSeries);
        if (Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion || !has) { c.Progress = 1; return; }
        if (c._played) { c.Progress = 1; return; }   // 刷新不重播
        c._played = true;
        c.Progress = 0;
        var anim = new DoubleAnimation(0, 1, Controls.Motion.Dur480);
        anim.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
        anim.Completed += (_, _) => c.Progress = 1;
        c.BeginAnimation(ProgressProperty, anim);
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        base.OnRender(dc);
        double w = ActualWidth, h = ActualHeight;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
        double legendH = 18;   // 图例区
        double chartH = h - legendH;

        var grid = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartGrid");
        var axisText = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartAxisText");

        // 网格 3 线
        var pen = new Pen(grid, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2; i++)
        {
            double y = chartH - i * chartH / 2;
            dc.DrawLine(pen, new Point(0, y), new Point(w, y));
        }

        bool hasR = ChartShapes.HasData(ReadSeries), hasW = ChartShapes.HasData(WriteSeries);
        if (!hasR && !hasW)
        {
            ChartShapes.DrawEmptyText(dc, EmptyText, w, chartH, axisText);
        }
        else
        {
            double max = Math.Max(ChartShapes.MaxOf(ReadSeries), ChartShapes.MaxOf(WriteSeries));
            if (max <= 0) max = 1;   // 有数据但全 0：给 1MB/s 尺度避免除零（不画归零线问题不存在——值就是 0）
            double p = Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion ? 1 : Progress;
            if (hasW)
                dc.DrawGeometry(null, new Pen((Brush)FindResource("RbcChart2"), 1.5)
                    { LineJoin = PenLineJoin.Round, StartLineCap = PenLineCap.Round, EndLineCap = PenLineCap.Round },
                    ChartShapes.BuildPolyline(WriteSeries, w, chartH, 0, max, p));
            if (hasR)
                dc.DrawGeometry(null, new Pen((Brush)FindResource("RbcChart1"), 1.5)
                    { LineJoin = PenLineJoin.Round, StartLineCap = PenLineCap.Round, EndLineCap = PenLineCap.Round },
                    ChartShapes.BuildPolyline(ReadSeries, w, chartH, 0, max, p));

            // Y 轴上刻度（自适应最大值，2 位有效）
            var ftMax = new FormattedText(Fmt(max) + " MB/s", CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
                new Typeface("Segoe UI"), 11, axisText, Dpi());
            dc.DrawText(ftMax, new Point(w - ftMax.Width, 0));
        }

        // 图例（读 chart-1 / 写 chart-2；明度差 + 标签双通道）
        double lx = 0;
        lx = DrawLegend(dc, lx, chartH + 4, (Brush)FindResource("RbcChart1"), "读");
        DrawLegend(dc, lx, chartH + 4, (Brush)FindResource("RbcChart2"), "写");
    }

    private double DrawLegend(DrawingContext dc, double x, double y, Brush color, string label)
    {
        dc.DrawRectangle(color, null, new Rect(x, y + 3, 12, 3));
        var ft = new FormattedText(label, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
            new Typeface("Segoe UI"), 11, (Brush)FindResource("RbcTextSecondary"), Dpi());
        dc.DrawText(ft, new Point(x + 16, y));
        return x + 16 + ft.Width + 16;
    }

    private static string Fmt(double v) => v >= 100 ? v.ToString("F0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        : v >= 10 ? v.ToString("F1", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : v.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    /* [FIX D#15] 收敛到 Controls/DpiX 单点（原 7 处同款私有实现） */
    private static double Dpi() => DpiX.Of();
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Controls/UsageRing.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

/// <summary>
/// 缓存占用环（02b §A.1 图 #2：环形进度，环心大数字 + 单位分排）。
/// 纪律：数据系 chart-1 填充 + chart-track 轨道；超限（Value&gt;1）环体变琥珀；
/// 无数据（NaN）轨道全灰 + 环心"—"（禁显示 0）；180ms standard 补间。
/// reduced-motion 降级直接落终值。
/// </summary>
public sealed class UsageRing : Control
{
    static UsageRing()
    {
        DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(UsageRing),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(UsageRing)));
    }

    /// <summary>占用比例（0–1；NaN=未知；&gt;1=超限）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Value), typeof(double), typeof(UsageRing),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnValueChanged));

    /// <summary>环心大数字文本（如 "12.4"；空态由控件置 "—"）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty TextProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Text), typeof(string), typeof(UsageRing),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    /// <summary>环心单位文本（11px 次级色，基线对齐，I1 分排）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty UnitProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Unit), typeof(string), typeof(UsageRing),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    /// <summary>超限角标（Value&gt;1 时显示，如 "已超限"）。</summary>
    public static readonly DependencyProperty OverTextProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(OverText), typeof(string), typeof(UsageRing),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("已超限", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public double Value { get => (double)GetValue(ValueProperty); set => SetValue(ValueProperty, value); }
    public string Text { get => (string)GetValue(TextProperty); set => SetValue(TextProperty, value); }
    public string Unit { get => (string)GetValue(UnitProperty); set => SetValue(UnitProperty, value); }
    public string OverText { get => (string)GetValue(OverTextProperty); set => SetValue(OverTextProperty, value); }

    private double _shown = double.NaN;   // 当前呈现比例（补间中）

    private static readonly DependencyProperty ShownProperty =
        DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Shown), typeof(double), typeof(UsageRing),
            new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    private double Shown { get => (double)GetValue(ShownProperty); set => SetValue(ShownProperty, value); }

    private static void OnValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var c = (UsageRing)d;
        double to = (double)e.NewValue;
        /* [FIX R6-UI12] 补间起点取当前呈现帧值（动画在飞时 GetValue 返回当前帧），
         * 而非上一目标值 _shown（仅 Completed 时更新）——否则 180ms 内新值到达时
         * 环体先跳回旧目标再补间（回跳）。与 NumberRoller [FIX B27] 同款纪律。 */
        double cur = (double)c.GetValue(ShownProperty);
        double from = double.IsNaN(cur) ? 0 : cur;
        if (Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion || double.IsNaN(to)) { c._shown = to; c.Shown = to; return; }
        var anim = new DoubleAnimation(from, double.IsNaN(to) ? 0 : to, Controls.Motion.Dur180);
        anim.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
        anim.Completed += (_, _) => { c._shown = to; c.Shown = to; };
        c.BeginAnimation(ShownProperty, anim);
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        base.OnRender(dc);
        double w = ActualWidth, h = ActualHeight;
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
        double stroke = 10;
        double r = Math.Min(w, h) / 2 - stroke / 2 - 1;
        var center = new Point(w / 2, h / 2);

        var track = (Brush)FindResource("RbcChartTrack");
        bool over = !double.IsNaN(Value) && Value > 1;
        var fill = over ? (Brush)FindResource("RbcWarningFg") : (Brush)FindResource("RbcChart1");

        // 轨道（整环）
        dc.DrawGeometry(null, new Pen(track, stroke), CircleGeo(center, r));

        // 数据弧（NaN=空态只画轨道）
        double v = Controls.Motion.IsReducedMotion ? Value : Shown;
        if (!double.IsNaN(v) && v > 0)
        {
            double sweep = Math.Clamp(v, 0, 1) * 360;
            dc.DrawGeometry(null, new Pen(fill, stroke) { StartLineCap = PenLineCap.Round, EndLineCap = PenLineCap.Round },
                ArcGeo(center, r, -90, sweep));
        }

        // 环心：大数字 + 单位分排（等宽栈缓解抖动，I1）
        // [W1.5 用户截图比对 S13 2026-10-23] Text 为空串 = 环心**不画数字**（状态页占用环
        // 数值改走右侧大值列，用户裁决"圆里不要有数字"）；原 fallback 百分比逻辑移除
        // （无消费位依赖）。超限角标改以环心几何定位（不依赖 ftBig）。
        var fg = (Brush)FindResource("RbcTextPrimary");
        var sec = (Brush)FindResource("RbcTextSecondary");
        var mono = new Typeface(new FontFamily("Cascadia Mono, Consolas"), FontStyles.Normal, FontWeights.SemiBold, FontStretches.Normal);
        double dpi = Dpi();
        bool empty = double.IsNaN(Value);
        string big = empty ? "—" : (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Text) ? "" : Text);
        double bigFont = 32;
        FormattedText? ftBig = null;
        if (big.Length > 0)
        {
            // 字号随环内径缩放 + 宽度自适应收缩（防小环溢出；V12 引入的守卫保留）
            double inner = 2 * (r - stroke / 2);
            bigFont = Math.Clamp(inner / 4.4, 12, 32);
            ftBig = new FormattedText(big, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
                mono, bigFont, fg, dpi);
            var ftUnit0 = new FormattedText(empty ? "" : Unit, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
                new Typeface("Segoe UI"), 11, sec, dpi);
            double totalW = ftBig.Width + (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Unit) || empty ? 0 : ftUnit0.Width + 4);
            double maxW = inner * 0.92;
            if (totalW > maxW && totalW > 0)
            {
                bigFont *= maxW / totalW;
                ftBig = new FormattedText(big, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
                    mono, bigFont, fg, dpi);
                totalW = ftBig.Width + (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Unit) || empty ? 0 : ftUnit0.Width + 4);
            }
            double x = center.X - totalW / 2;
            double upBias = bigFont * 0.18;
            dc.DrawText(ftBig, new Point(x, center.Y - ftBig.Height / 2 - upBias));
            if (!empty && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Unit))
            {
                var ftUnit = new FormattedText(Unit, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
                    new Typeface("Segoe UI"), 11, sec, dpi);
                dc.DrawText(ftUnit, new Point(x + ftBig.Width + 4, center.Y - ftUnit.Height / 2 - upBias + 4));
            }
        }

        if (over)
        {
            var ftOver = new FormattedText(OverText, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
                new Typeface("Segoe UI"), 11, (Brush)FindResource("RbcWarningFg"), dpi);
            double overY = ftBig is not null
                ? center.Y + ftBig.Height / 2 - 4
                : center.Y + 10;   // 空环心：角标挂在环心正中偏下
            dc.DrawText(ftOver, new Point(center.X - ftOver.Width / 2, overY));
        }
    }

    private static StreamGeometry CircleGeo(Point c, double r)
    {
        var g = new StreamGeometry();
        using var ctx = g.Open();
        ctx.BeginFigure(new Point(c.X, c.Y - r), true, true);
        ctx.ArcTo(new Point(c.X, c.Y + r), new Size(r, r), 0, false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, true, false);
        ctx.ArcTo(new Point(c.X, c.Y - r), new Size(r, r), 0, false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, true, false);
        g.Freeze();
        return g;
    }

    private static StreamGeometry ArcGeo(Point c, double r, double startDeg, double sweepDeg)
    {
        var g = new StreamGeometry();
        if (sweepDeg <= 0) return g;
        double a0 = startDeg * Math.PI / 180, a1 = (startDeg + sweepDeg) * Math.PI / 180;
        var p0 = new Point(c.X + r * Math.Cos(a0), c.Y + r * Math.Sin(a0));
        var p1 = new Point(c.X + r * Math.Cos(a1), c.Y + r * Math.Sin(a1));
        using var ctx = g.Open();
        ctx.BeginFigure(p0, false, false);
        ctx.ArcTo(p1, new Size(r, r), sweepDeg, sweepDeg > 180, SweepDirection.Clockwise, true, false);
        g.Freeze();
        return g;
    }

    /* [FIX D#15] 收敛到 Controls/DpiX 单点（原 7 处同款私有实现） */
    private static double Dpi() => DpiX.Of();
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Data;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// 状态串 → Visibility（ConverterParameter=目标态）：冷热对比卡五态切换用
/// （Binding Features.BenchState, Converter={StaticResource BenchStateVis}, ConverterParameter=result）。
/// 空 parameter = 任意非空态可见（兜底）；匹配大小写不敏感。
/// </summary>
public sealed class BenchStateVisConverter : IValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
    {
        string? state = value as string;
        string? want = parameter as string;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(want)) return string.IsNullOrEmpty(state) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        return string.Equals(state, want, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
    }

    public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        => throw new NotSupportedException();
}
````

````csharp
using System;
````
