````csharp
namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;

/// <summary>布尔取反转换器（IsEnabled="{Binding SomeBusy, Converter={StaticResource InvertBool}}"；
/// 忙=禁用的场景免去每个 VM 属性再造一个反相属性）。</summary>
public sealed class InvertBoolConverter : IValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        => value is bool b ? !b : true;

    public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        => value is bool b ? !b : false;
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Data;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// ProgressBar Value/Maximum → 0..1 比例（供 App.xaml 隐式样式的 scaleX 绑定）。
/// Maximum&lt;=0 按 100 归一；NaN/负值归零。
/// </summary>
public sealed class ProgressRatioConverter : IValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture)
    {
        if (value is not ProgressBar pb) return 0d;
        double max = pb.Maximum <= 0 ? 100 : pb.Maximum;
        double v = double.IsNaN(pb.Value) ? 0 : pb.Value;
        return Math.Clamp(v / max, 0d, 1d);
    }

    public object ConvertBack(object? value, Type targetType, object? parameter, CultureInfo culture) =>
        throw new NotSupportedException("单向绑定，不支持反向");
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Helpers/RelayCommand.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Input;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// MVVM 基类：属性变更通知 + UI 线程投递。
/// </summary>
public abstract class ObservableObject : INotifyPropertyChanged
{
    public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

    /// <summary>ViewModel 构造时捕获的 UI 线程同步上下文（构造线程即 UI 线程时非空）。</summary>
    private readonly SynchronizationContext? _ui = SynchronizationContext.Current;

    protected void RaisePropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string? n = null)
        => PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(n));
    protected bool Set<T>(ref T field, T value, [CallerMemberName] string? n = null)
    {
        if (Equals(field, value)) return false;
        field = value; RaisePropertyChanged(n); return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 把回调投递到 UI 线程执行；捕获不到同步上下文时直接执行。
    /// （原为 MainViewModel / DriveItemViewModel 各自持有的相同私有实现，重构时合并至此。）
    /// </summary>
    protected void Post(Action a) { if (_ui != null) _ui.Post(_ => a(), null); else a(); }
}

/// <summary>同步命令：包装 Action，可选 canExecute 谓词。</summary>
public sealed class RelayCommand : ICommand
{
    private readonly Action _exec;
    private readonly Func<bool>? _can;
    public RelayCommand(Action exec, Func<bool>? can = null) { _exec = exec; _can = can; }
    public bool CanExecute(object? p) => _can?.Invoke() ?? true;
    public void Execute(object? p) => _exec();
    public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged
    { add => CommandManager.RequerySuggested += value; remove => CommandManager.RequerySuggested -= value; }
}

/// <summary>带参数同步命令（如"按页名跳转"的行内行动按钮；参数经 CommandParameter 传入）。</summary>
public sealed class RelayCommand<T> : ICommand
{
    private readonly Action<T> _exec;
    private readonly Func<T, bool>? _can;
    public RelayCommand(Action<T> exec, Func<T, bool>? can = null) { _exec = exec; _can = can; }
    public bool CanExecute(object? p) => _can is null || (p is T t && _can(t));
    public void Execute(object? p) { if (p is T t) _exec(t); }
    public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged
    { add => CommandManager.RequerySuggested += value; remove => CommandManager.RequerySuggested -= value; }
}

/// <summary>
/// 异步命令：包装 Func&lt;Task&gt;，执行期间禁用重入（_busy）；
/// 未处理异常写 LogService，不冒泡到 UI 调度器。
/// </summary>
public sealed class AsyncRelayCommand : ICommand
{
    private readonly Func<Task> _exec;
    private readonly Func<bool>? _can;
    private bool _busy;
    public AsyncRelayCommand(Func<Task> exec, Func<bool>? can = null) { _exec = exec; _can = can; }
    public bool CanExecute(object? p) => !_busy && (_can?.Invoke() ?? true);
    /// <summary>
    /// [FIX 严重-2 2026-10-18] 可等待执行：调用方（如 UnmountAll 的 Task.WaitAll）
    /// 能真正等到内部 Task 完成再继续——async void Execute 只到第一个 await 即返回，
    /// 造成"等待全部完成"形同虚设（Telemetry 提前上报、关窗时卸载未完成）。
    /// </summary>
    public Task ExecuteAsync(object? p) => RunAsync(p);
    public async void Execute(object? p) => await RunAsync(p);
    private async Task RunAsync(object? p)
    {
        if (!CanExecute(p)) return;
        _busy = true; CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
        try { await _exec(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Services.LogService.Error($"命令执行异常：{ex.Message}"); }
        finally { _busy = false; CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested(); }
    }
    public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged
    { add => CommandManager.RequerySuggested += value; remove => CommandManager.RequerySuggested -= value; }
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Interop/DwmLiquidGlassHelper.cs`

````csharp
// 放置路径 1: src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Interop/DwmLiquidGlassHelper.cs
// 放置路径 2: src/ui/installer/RAMBlockCache.Setup/Interop/DwmLiquidGlassHelper.cs
// 铁律: 落盘后必须同步登记至 build/sources.manifest.json (Gate16 check_build_manifest.py)
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Shell;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Interop
{
    public static class DwmLiquidGlassHelper
    {
        private const int DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE = 20;
        private const int DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE = 33;
        private const int DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR = 34;
        private const int DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE = 38;

        private const int DWMWCP_ROUND = 2;
        private const int DWMSBT_TRANSIENTWINDOW = 3; // DWM Transient Acrylic 桌面透光通道
        private const uint DWMWA_COLOR_NONE = 0xFFFFFFFE;

        [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
        private struct MARGINS
        {
            public int cxLeftWidth;
            public int cxRightWidth;
            public int cyTopHeight;
            public int cyBottomHeight;
        }

        [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
        private struct ACCENT_POLICY
        {
            public int AccentState;
            public int AccentFlags;
            public uint GradientColor; // AABBGGRR
            public int AnimationId;
        }

        [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
        private struct WINDOWCOMPOSITIONATTRIBDATA
        {
            public int Attribute;
            public IntPtr Data;
            public int SizeOfData;
        }

        [DllImport("dwmapi.dll")]
        private static extern int DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea(IntPtr hwnd, ref MARGINS pMarInset);

        [DllImport("dwmapi.dll")]
        private static extern int DwmSetWindowAttribute(IntPtr hwnd, int attr, ref int attrValue, int attrSize);

        [DllImport("dwmapi.dll")]
        private static extern int DwmGetColorizationColor(out uint pcrColorization, out bool pfOpaqueBlend);

        [DllImport("user32.dll")]
        private static extern int SetWindowCompositionAttribute(IntPtr hwnd, ref WINDOWCOMPOSITIONATTRIBDATA data);

        /// <summary>
        /// 启用硬件加速的桌面透光透色液态玻璃基底（不开启 AllowsTransparency，保留 DWM 帧率）
        /// 修 BUG-NEW-10：
        /// 1) 高对比度模式 (SystemParameters.HighContrast) 自动旁路保护；
        /// 2) Win11 22H2+ (Build >= 22621) 仅调用 DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE(38)，绝不叠加 WCA_ACCENT_POLICY(4)，
        ///    彻底避免 Win11 窗口鼠标拖拽掉帧与双层底色闪烁；仅在旧版系统降级使用 EnableAcrylicComposition。
        /// </summary>
        public static void AttachLiquidGlassWindow(Window window, bool darkMode = false)
        {
            if (window == null) return;

            if (SystemParameters.HighContrast)
            {
                window.Background = SystemColors.WindowBrush;
                return;
            }

            var chrome = new WindowChrome
            {
                CaptionHeight = 0,
                ResizeBorderThickness = new Thickness(6),
                GlassFrameThickness = new Thickness(-1),
                NonClientFrameEdges = NonClientFrameEdges.None,
                UseAeroCaptionButtons = false
            };
            WindowChrome.SetWindowChrome(window, chrome);
            window.Background = Brushes.Transparent;

            void OnSourceReady()
            {
                if (SystemParameters.HighContrast) return;

                IntPtr hwnd = new WindowInteropHelper(window).Handle;
                if (hwnd == IntPtr.Zero) return;

                var hwndSource = HwndSource.FromHwnd(hwnd);
                if (hwndSource?.CompositionTarget != null)
                {
                    hwndSource.CompositionTarget.BackgroundColor = Colors.Transparent;
                }

                var margins = new MARGINS { cxLeftWidth = -1, cxRightWidth = -1, cyTopHeight = -1, cyBottomHeight = -1 };
                DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea(hwnd, ref margins);

                int darkFlag = darkMode ? 1 : 0;
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, ref darkFlag, sizeof(int));

                int corner = DWMWCP_ROUND;
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE, ref corner, sizeof(int));

                int borderNone = unchecked((int)DWMWA_COLOR_NONE);
                DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR, ref borderNone, sizeof(int));

                bool backdropApplied = false;
                if (Environment.OSVersion.Version.Build >= 22621)
                {
                    int backdrop = DWMSBT_TRANSIENTWINDOW;
                    int hr = DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, ref backdrop, sizeof(int));
                    backdropApplied = (hr == 0);
                }

                if (!backdropApplied)
                {
                    byte alpha = darkMode ? (byte)0x38 : (byte)0x52;
                    uint bgr = darkMode ? 0x0020120Au : 0x00F9F5F3u;
                    EnableAcrylicComposition(hwnd, alpha, bgr);
                }
            }

            if (window.IsLoaded)
            {
                OnSourceReady();
            }
            else
            {
                // One-shot init: the handler below detaches itself as soon as the
                // HWND exists, so DWM setup can never run twice for this window.
                window.SourceInitialized += OnSourceInitialized;

                void OnSourceInitialized(object? sender, EventArgs e)
                {
                    window.SourceInitialized -= OnSourceInitialized;
                    OnSourceReady();
                }
            }
        }

        private static void EnableAcrylicComposition(IntPtr hwnd, byte alpha, uint bgr)
        {
            var accent = new ACCENT_POLICY
            {
                AccentState = 4, // ACCENT_ENABLE_ACRYLICBLURBEHIND (Win10 fallback only)
                AccentFlags = 2,
                GradientColor = ((uint)alpha << 24) | (bgr & 0x00FFFFFFu),
                AnimationId = 0
            };

            int size = Marshal.SizeOf(accent);
            IntPtr ptr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(size);
            try
            {
                Marshal.StructureToPtr(accent, ptr, false);
                var data = new WINDOWCOMPOSITIONATTRIBDATA
                {
                    Attribute = 19, // WCA_ACCENT_POLICY
                    Data = ptr,
                    SizeOfData = size
                };
                SetWindowCompositionAttribute(hwnd, ref data);
            }
            finally
            {
                Marshal.FreeHGlobal(ptr);
            }
        }

        public static Color GetDesktopAccentColor()
        {
            if (DwmGetColorizationColor(out uint argb, out _) == 0)
            {
                return Color.FromArgb(
                    255,
                    (byte)((argb >> 16) & 0xFF),
                    (byte)((argb >> 8) & 0xFF),
                    (byte)(argb & 0xFF));
            }
            return Color.FromRgb(15, 134, 224); // 对齐 --rbc-accent: #0f86e0
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 修 BUG-NEW-07：在当前交互用户会话 (Session >= 1) 将 DWM 色彩转换为 CSS HSL 令牌字符串，
        /// 供控制器内置 WebView2 通过 PostWebMessageAsJson 推送给前端 --rbc-lg-desktop-h1 / h2，
        /// 无需修改 Session 0 SYSTEM 计划任务运行的 Node Bridge。
        /// </summary>
        public static string BuildDesktopAccentMessageJson()
        {
            Color c = GetDesktopAccentColor();
            RgbToHsl(c.R, c.G, c.B, out int h, out int s, out int l);
            int h2 = (h + 346) % 360;
            return string.Format(
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                "{{\"type\":\"rbc-desktop-accent\",\"h1\":\"{0} {1}% {2}%\",\"h2\":\"{3} {1}% {4}%\"}}",
                h,
                Math.Clamp(s, 45, 92),
                Math.Clamp(l, 42, 62),
                h2,
                Math.Clamp(l - 4, 38, 58));
        }

        private static void RgbToHsl(byte rByte, byte gByte, byte bByte, out int hDeg, out int sPct, out int lPct)
        {
            double r = rByte / 255.0;
            double g = gByte / 255.0;
            double b = bByte / 255.0;
            double max = Math.Max(r, Math.Max(g, b));
            double min = Math.Min(r, Math.Min(g, b));
            double d = max - min;
            double h = 0.0;
            double l = (max + min) / 2.0;
            double s = d == 0.0 ? 0.0 : d / (1.0 - Math.Abs(2.0 * l - 1.0));

            if (d != 0.0)
            {
                if (max == r) h = 60.0 * (((g - b) / d) % 6.0);
                else if (max == g) h = 60.0 * (((b - r) / d) + 2.0);
                else h = 60.0 * (((r - g) / d) + 4.0);
                if (h < 0.0) h += 360.0;
            }

            hDeg = (int)Math.Round(h);
            sPct = (int)Math.Round(s * 100.0);
            lPct = (int)Math.Round(l * 100.0);
        }
    }
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/MainWindow.xaml.cs`

````csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Windows;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;
using RAMBlockCache.Interop;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller;

/* [UI-HOST 2026-11-05] 控制器主窗口 = Web 控制台宿主。
 *
 * 职责：
 *   1) 启动便携 node 桥接（installDir\webconsole\node.exe bridge\server\index.ts）
 *   2) 轮询 health 直到就绪（上限 ~20s）
 *   3) WebView2 内嵌导航 http://127.0.0.1:5199/（Bento 六页，与 Web 端 100% 一致）
 *   4) 托盘常驻（保留原行为：关闭=入托盘，托盘菜单退出才真退）
 *
 * 设计取舍：
 *   - 原生 WPF 六页已归档 docs/legacy-wpf-ui/（两套 UI 永远不同步的教训）；
 *   - node 进程由本窗口拥有：窗口真退出时结束桥接（避免孤儿进程占 5199）；
 *   - [SHELL-REUSE 2026-11-08] 桥接已在跑（ONSTART 计划任务）时只复用不重复拉起；
 *   - 开发期源码树运行（webconsole 目录不存在）→ 显示明确错误引导用构建包。
 */
public partial class MainWindow : Window
{
    private Services.TrayService? _tray;
    private bool _reallyExit;
    private Process? _nodeProc;
    private int _bridgePort = 5199;

    public MainWindow()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        // [235 Phase 3] DWM desktop bleed-through + high-contrast bypass. The
        // WebView2 host below stays the single desktop-accent source (Session >= 1).
        DwmLiquidGlassHelper.AttachLiquidGlassWindow(this);
        Loaded += async (_, _) =>
        {
            InitTray();   // 托盘常驻（保留原行为）
            await StartBridgeAndNavigateAsync();
        };
        Closing += OnClosing;
        Application.Current.SessionEnding += (_, _) =>
        {
            _reallyExit = true;
            _tray?.Dispose();
            KillNode();
        };
    }

    /// <summary>定位 webconsole 目录：安装布局=installDir\webconsole；源码树=repo\web。</summary>
    private string? FindWebConsoleDir()
    {
        var exeDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(Environment.ProcessPath) ?? AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
        // 安装布局：installDir\RAMBlockCache.Controller.exe，webconsole 在旁
        var cand1 = Path.Combine(exeDir, "webconsole");
        if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(cand1, "node.exe"))) return cand1;
        // 源码树回退：controller 项目向上 4 层到 repo，web\bridge 即运行目录
        var cand2 = Path.Combine(exeDir, "..", "..", "..", "..", "..", "web");
        try
        {
            var full = Path.GetFullPath(cand2);
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(full, "bridge", "server"))) return full;
        }
        catch { }
        return null;
    }

    private async Task StartBridgeAndNavigateAsync()
    {
        RetryBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        ErrorText.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        LoadBar.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        LoadingText.Text = "正在启动控制台服务…";

        // [SHELL-REUSE 2026-11-08] 先探 health：Setup 已注册 ONSTART 计划任务
        // （RAMBlockCacheBridge），桥接多半早已在跑。此时只复用、不重复 spawn，
        // 避免第二实例绑定 5199 失败滞留成孤儿 node 进程。
        if (await IsBridgeAliveAsync(3, 300))
        {
            _nodeProc = null;   // 桥接归外部所有：本窗口退出时不杀
            await NavigateConsoleAsync();
            return;
        }

        var wc = FindWebConsoleDir();
        if (wc is null)
        {
            ShowError("未找到 webconsole 目录（node.exe + bridge）。\n" +
                      "请使用官方 RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe 安装（含便携运行时），" +
                      "或从源码树运行：web\\bridge。");
            return;
        }

        var nodeExe = Path.Combine(wc, "node.exe");
        var server = Path.Combine(wc, "bridge", "server", "index.ts");
        if (!File.Exists(nodeExe) || !File.Exists(server))
        {
            ShowError("webconsole 组件不完整（node.exe / bridge\\server\\index.ts 缺失）。");
            return;
        }

        // 启动桥接（隐藏窗口；工作目录=webconsole，桥接按相对路径找 native/server）
        try
        {
            _nodeProc?.Kill();
        }
        catch { }
        _nodeProc = new Process
        {
            StartInfo = new ProcessStartInfo
            {
                FileName = nodeExe,
                Arguments = "bridge\\server\\index.ts",
                WorkingDirectory = wc,
                UseShellExecute = false,
                CreateNoWindow = true,
            }
        };
        try { _nodeProc.Start(); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            ShowError("桥接进程启动失败：" + ex.Message);
            return;
        }

        // 轮询 health（上限 ~20s）
        LoadingText.Text = "等待控制通道就绪…";
        if (!await IsBridgeAliveAsync(40, 500))
        {
            ShowError("桥接服务未在 20 秒内就绪（node 可能被安全软件拦截）。\n" +
                      "可关闭安全软件后点重试，或直接用浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:5199/");
            return;
        }

        await NavigateConsoleAsync();
    }

    /// <summary>[SHELL-REUSE 2026-11-08] 探测桥接 health 是否就绪（总时长 ≈ tries×delayMs）。</summary>
    private async Task<bool> IsBridgeAliveAsync(int tries, int delayMs)
    {
        using var http = new System.Net.Http.HttpClient();
        for (int i = 0; i < tries; i++)
        {
            try
            {
                using var resp = await http.GetAsync($"http://127.0.0.1:{_bridgePort}/health");
                if (resp.IsSuccessStatusCode) return true;
            }
            catch { }
            await Task.Delay(delayMs);
        }
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>WebView2 初始化并导航到控制台首页。</summary>
    private async Task NavigateConsoleAsync()
    {
        LoadingText.Text = "加载控制台界面…";
        try
        {
            // [235 Phase 3 / BUG-NEW-07] transparent WebView2 host: let the Web
            // SPA's liquid glass see the real desktop through the DWM glass frame.
            Web.DefaultBackgroundColor = System.Drawing.Color.Transparent;
            await Web.EnsureCoreWebView2Async();
            Web.CoreWebView2.NavigationCompleted += (_, e) =>
            {
                LoadingMask.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                // Push the interactive user's DWM accent from this host process
                // (Session >= 1); the Session 0 SYSTEM Node Bridge is untouched.
                Web.CoreWebView2.PostWebMessageAsJson(
                    DwmLiquidGlassHelper.BuildDesktopAccentMessageJson());

                // [243 / C05] Thin-host guard: the SPA is now the single source of
                // truth for sampling. Mask removal and the DWM push above stay
                // unconditional on purpose - a failed navigation must never leave
                // the loading mask pinned over the window.
                if (e.IsSuccess)
                {
                    Services.ThinHostModeGuard.Instance.MarkWebViewUiReady();
                }
                else
                {
                    Services.ThinHostModeGuard.Instance.MarkWebViewFallback();
                }
            };
            Web.Source = new Uri($"http://127.0.0.1:{_bridgePort}/");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            ShowError("WebView2 初始化失败：" + ex.Message +
                      "\n（Windows 10 需安装 WebView2 Runtime；Windows 11 自带）");
        }
    }

    private void ShowError(string msg)
    {
        LoadBar.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        ErrorText.Text = msg;
        ErrorText.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        RetryBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
    }

    private async void RetryBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        ErrorText.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        RetryBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        LoadBar.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        await StartBridgeAndNavigateAsync();
    }

    // ---- 托盘（保留原行为） ----

    private void InitTray()
    {
        try
        {
            _tray = new Services.TrayService();
            _tray.ShowWindowRequested += () =>
            {
                Show();
                WindowState = WindowState.Normal;
                Activate();
            };
            _tray.FlushRequested += () =>
            {
                // Web 控制台页面内已有 FLUSH 按钮；托盘保留快捷入口（HTTP 直发）
                try
                {
                    using var http = new System.Net.Http.HttpClient();
                    _ = http.PostAsync($"http://127.0.0.1:{_bridgePort}/rpc",
                        new System.Net.Http.StringContent(
                            "{\"method\":3}", System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));
                    Services.LogService.Info("托盘：已下发立即回写（全局 FLUSH）");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Services.LogService.Error($"托盘立即回写失败：{ex.Message}");
                }
            };
            _tray.ExitRequested += () =>
            {
                _reallyExit = true;
                Close();
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Services.LogService.Error($"托盘初始化失败（不影响主窗口）：{ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    private void OnClosing(object? sender, System.ComponentModel.CancelEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!_reallyExit && _tray is not null)
        {
            e.Cancel = true;          // 关闭 → 托盘常驻
            Hide();
            return;
        }
        KillNode();
    }

    private void KillNode()
    {
        try { _nodeProc?.Kill(); } catch { }
        try { _nodeProc?.Dispose(); } catch { }
        _nodeProc = null;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

/// <summary>
/// 驱动通信失败异常。Win32Error 同时承载两类错误码：
/// Win32 错误（如 5 拒绝访问）与驱动回传的负 NTSTATUS（Status@8 &lt; 0）。
/// </summary>
public sealed class DriverException : Exception
{
    public int Win32Error { get; }

    public DriverException(int win32Error, string context)
        : base($"{context}（{Describe(win32Error)}）") => Win32Error = win32Error;

    private static string Describe(int e) => e switch
    {
        2    => "设备未就绪，驱动未加载或该卷未挂载",
        5    => "拒绝访问，请以管理员身份运行控制器",
        31   => "驱动侧设备故障，请检查驱动日志",
        87   => "参数非法，控制器与驱动协议版本不一致",
        170  => "驱动忙，正在重试",
        1219 => "多次凭据冲突",
        _    => $"Win32 错误 {e}"
    };
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

// ============================================================================
// 真实协议层（ctl/rb_proto.h, Protocol 9）—— 单一 IOCTL 0x222000 + RB_MSG.Type 分发。
// 旧 ui/wpf/RbClient 已验证此布局能连上正在运行的 Build 17 驱动，逐字段对齐照抄。
//   消息头: Type@0(u32) / Size@4(u32) / Status@8(i32, NTSTATUS) / Reserved@12(u32)
//   联合体 Data@16，整块 RbMsgSize = 8224 字节（[FIX 2026-10-24] B-7 事件环加入后
//   RB_EVENT_LIST(8208) 成为 union 最大成员，原 7704 使驱动 Size 校验拒发——Win32 87）。
//
// [重构 P1-3 同步警示] 本协议布局共**三处手工副本**，无生成器、纯人工同步：
//   ① ctl/rb_proto.h（C 权威，ABI 冻结，Protocol 9）
//   ② 本文件（RAMBlockCache.Controller 树，当前在用的 UI）
//   ③ ..\..\wpf\Models\RbProto.cs（旧 RamBoostFS.Wpf 树副本，审计结论前保留）
// 改任何字段/偏移/常量必须三处同步。字段偏移已冻结，只许末尾追加，本次重构不动任何字段。
// ============================================================================
public static class RbP
{
    public const uint IOCTL_RB_REQUEST = 0x00222000;

    public const uint GET_STATS = 1;
    public const uint SET_CONFIG = 2;
    public const uint FLUSH = 3;
    public const uint GET_CONFIG = 4;
    public const uint EXIT_SAFE_MODE = 5;
    public const uint SET_VOLUME = 6;
    public const uint GET_VOLUMES = 7;
    public const uint ATTACH_VOLUME = 8;
    public const uint GET_LOG = 9;
    public const uint GET_VERSION = 10;
    public const uint PANIC = 11;
    public const uint PANIC_CLEAR = 12;
    public const uint INVALIDATE_RANGE = 13;   /* [V10.6/B-5] 缓存范围失效 */
    public const uint GET_EVENTS = 14;         /* [V10.6/B-7] 操作进度事件轮询 */

    public const int DataOffset = 16;
    public const int MsgSize = 8224;   /* [FIX 2026-10-24] RB_EVENT_LIST(8208)>RB_LOG_LIST(7688)：信封16+8208（与 check_proto_sync 动态计算一致） */

    public const int MaxVolumes = 8;
    public const int Stripes = 64;
    public const int NameLen = 16;
    public const int SignerLen = 32;
    public const int EventMax = 64;            /* [V10.6/B-7] 事件环容量 */
    public const int EventText = 48;           /* [V10.6/B-7] 阶段文案上限 */

    /* [V10.6/B-7] 操作类型（OpProgress.OpType 合法值） */
    public const uint OpBenchmark = 1;
    public const uint OpPresetApply = 2;
    public const uint OpUnmount = 3;
    public const uint OpL2Rebuild = 4;
    /* [V10.6/B-8] L2 重建阶段 */
    public const uint PhaseStart = 1;
    public const uint PhaseProgress = 2;
    public const uint PhaseDone = 3;

    public const uint WM_THROUGH = 0;
    public const uint WM_BACK = 1;
    public const uint WM_GLOBAL = 2;
}

// ---------------- 真实内核结构（Pack=8，逐字段对齐） ----------------

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbStats
{
    public ulong ReadReq, ReadHit, ReadBytes, ReadHitBytes;
    public ulong WriteReq, WriteBytes, WriteCached, WbFlush, WbBytes, EvictBytes;
    public ulong CurBytes, DirtyBytes, ChunkCount;
    public uint InstanceCount, CacheSizeMB, EffectiveCacheMB, WriteBackMode, Enabled, SafeMode, RmwReads, TrimCount;
    public ulong IdleReclaimBytes, LostDirtyBytes;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.Stripes)] public ulong[] StripeRead;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.Stripes)] public ulong[] StripeWrite;
    public uint StripeCount;
    public uint PressureLevel, DynamicLimitMB;
    public ulong AvailablePhysMB, PeakBytes, ReadaheadBytes, ReadaheadHitBytes, PressureShrinkBytes;
    public uint ReadaheadActive;
    public uint PanicActive, BootFails, DirtySnapshotMB;
    /* ---- [V10.6/B-12] 读延迟 EWMA（微秒；末尾纯追加；0=尚无样本）----
     * 后端已交付（rb_proto.h RB_STATS 末尾 + DriverService.RbStats 镜像 + wpf 第三副本，
     * check_proto_sync --strict 把关）。UI 消费位：MainViewModel.LatencyDetailText
     * → V106Contracts.RbStatsLatency.FormatDetail（无样本显示「—」不画假值）。 */
    public uint CacheReadLatencyUs, DiskReadLatencyUs;
    /* ---- [U1 2026-11-06] 读延迟分位数（微秒；log2 桶近似；0=尚无样本）----
     * rb_proto.h RB_STATS 末尾纯追加；MainViewModel 分位明细展示消费。 */
    public uint CacheReadLatP50Us, CacheReadLatP95Us, CacheReadLatP99Us;
    public uint DiskReadLatP50Us, DiskReadLatP95Us, DiskReadLatP99Us;
    /* ---- [83 2026-11-07] 运行期几何重建统计（末尾纯追加；三副本同步；Pack=8）----
     * 与 rb_proto.h RB_STATS 末尾五字段逐字对应：u32@1280/1284/1288/1292 + u64@1296。
     * check_proto_sync.py --strict 把关字段名/顺序/偏移/sizeof(=1304)。 */
    public uint EngineBlockSize, GeometryRebuildCount, GeometryRebuildLastStatus, GeometryRebuildInProgress;
    public ulong LastGeometryRebuildUtc;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbVolumeInfo
{
    public ushort Letter;
    public uint Attached, ReadEnabled, WriteEnabled, IsSystem;
    public ulong CapacityMB, FreeMB;
    public uint Bound, WriteMode, LogicalSectorBytes, PhysicalSectorBytes;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbVolumeList
{
    public uint Count;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.MaxVolumes)] public RbVolumeInfo[] Items;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbVolumeAttach
{
    public ushort Letter;
    public uint Attach, ReadEnabled, WriteEnabled, WriteMode;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbConfigNative
{
    public uint Enabled, ReadCacheEnabled, WriteCacheEnabled, WriteBack;
    public uint CacheSizeMB, FlushIntervalMs, DirtyHighPct, DirtyLowPct;
    public uint SystemVolumeCached, IdleReclaimEnabled, IdleReclaimSec, ParallelFlush;
    public uint CachePagingIo, WriteRelease, Frozen, IdleFlush;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.MaxVolumes * 4)] public ushort[] VolumeFilter;
    public uint ReadaheadEnabled, ReadaheadWindowKB, AutoMemory, MemReserveMB, AutoUsePct, BlockSize;
    public uint TinyLFU;   // [F1 2026-11-06] TinyLFU 准入（末尾纯追加）
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbVersionNative
{
    public uint ProtocolVersion, Major, Minor, Build, IsBlockFilter, Reserved;
    public ulong DriverFlags;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.NameLen)] public ushort[] Name;
    /* [V10.6/B-6] 驱动签名态（rb_proto.h RB_VERSION_T 末尾纯追加；三副本同步） */
    public uint TestSigned, Reserved2;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.SignerLen)] public ushort[] Signer;
}

/// <summary>[V10.6/B-5] 缓存范围失效请求（rb_proto.h RB_INVALIDATE_RANGE_T 镜像；消息 13）。</summary>
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbInvalidateRangeNative
{
    public ushort Letter;
    public uint Reserved;
    public ulong Offset;
    public ulong Length;
}

/// <summary>
/// [V10.6/B-7] 操作进度事件（rb_proto.h RB_EVENT_REC_T 镜像；消息 14 游标增量）。
/// 驱动当前发布点=卸载回写；二遍读/预设应用在 UI 本地总线（不经驱动）。
/// </summary>
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbEventRecNative
{
    public ulong Seq;
    public uint OpType;
    public uint Percent;
    public uint Cancelable;
    public uint Phase;
    public ulong RecoveredBytes;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.EventText)] public ushort[] StageText;

    /// <summary>阶段文案（宽字符数组 → 字符串，去尾零）。</summary>
    public string StageTextStr => StageText == null ? "" :
        new string(Array.ConvertAll(StageText, c => (char)c)).TrimEnd('\0');
}

/// <summary>[V10.6/B-7] 事件轮询请求（游标=上次消费到的 Seq；0=从环内最早开始）。</summary>
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbEventQueryNative
{
    public ulong Cursor;
    public uint MaxCount;
}

/// <summary>[V10.6/B-7] 事件轮询应答（Cursor=新消费游标；Count=本次条数）。</summary>
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbEventListNative
{
    public ulong Cursor;
    public uint Count;
    public uint Reserved;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.EventMax)] public RbEventRecNative[] Items;
}

// ---------------- UI 展示 DTO（ViewModel/XAML 绑定用，保持字段名不变） ----------------

/// <summary>版本展示 DTO（GET_VERSION 应答的 UI 侧裁剪，含 Patch）。</summary>

{

/// <summary>全局统计展示 DTO（旧代按卷上报结构，当前驱动为全局统计，仅历史保留）。</summary>

{

    public ulong ReadBytesTotal, WriteBytesTotal;
    public ulong ReadHits, ReadMisses, WriteHits, WriteMisses;
    public uint ActiveVolumes, MountedVolumeMask, FlushCount, EvictCount;
}

/// <summary>单卷统计展示 DTO（旧代结构，当前未由 DriverService 产出，仅历史保留）。</summary>

{

    public uint Mounted;

    public ulong UsedBytes;

    public ulong ReadHits, ReadMisses, WriteHits, WriteMisses;

}

/// <summary>单卷统计数组容器（旧代结构，当前未使用，仅历史保留）。</summary>
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbVolumeStatsOut
{
    public uint Count;
    public uint Reserved;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = 26)] public RbVolumeStats[] V;
}

/// <summary>CachePage 提交的小配置（只映射驱动支持的 WriteBack / FlushIntervalMs）。</summary>
public struct RbConfig
{
    public uint DefaultCacheMB;
    public uint FlushIntervalMs;
    public uint WriteMode;       // 1=回写 2=直写
    public uint EvictPolicy;
    public uint MaxTotalCacheMB;
}

/// <summary>字节量格式化工具（KB/MB/GB 自适应）。</summary>
public static class Conv
{
    public const ulong KB = 1024, MB = 1024 * 1024, GB = 1024UL * 1024 * 1024;

    public static string Size(ulong b)
    {
        return b >= GB ? $"{(double)b / GB:F2} GB"
             : b >= MB ? $"{(double)b / MB:F1} MB"
             : b >= KB ? $"{(double)b / KB:F1} KB"
             : $"{b} B";
    }
    public static string Rate(double bytesPerSec) => bytesPerSec <= 0 ? "0 B/s" : Size((ulong)bytesPerSec) + "/s";
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Models/OperationResult.cs`

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

public readonly record struct MountBatchSummary(int Success, int Failure, int Total);

/// <summary>应用层操作结果；不属于 V106Contracts，也不进入驱动线协议。</summary>
public sealed record OperationResult(bool Success, string? ErrorCode, string? ErrorMessage)
{
    public static OperationResult Ok() => new(true, null, null);

    public static OperationResult Fail(string? code, string message)
        => new(false, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code) ? "OperationFailed" : code, message);

    public static MountBatchSummary Summarize(IEnumerable<OperationResult> results)
    {
        int success = 0, total = 0;
        foreach (OperationResult result in results)
        {
            total++;
            if (result.Success) success++;
        }
        return new MountBatchSummary(success, total - success, total);
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

/// <summary>
/// 预留特性层错误码（W1–W4 占位功能的统一错误语汇）。
/// 与 <see cref="RbFeatureException"/> 配对使用；Win32/NTSTATUS 类错误仍走 DriverException。
/// </summary>
public enum RbErrorCode
{
    /// <summary>无错误。</summary>
    None = 0,
    /// <summary>预留占位：接口契约已就位，对应波次（W1–W4）尚未开发，调用方按未实现处理。</summary>
    NotImplemented = 1,
    /// <summary>未授权（W4-3 许可面占位）。</summary>
    NotLicensed = 2,
    /// <summary>被策略/开关禁用（如用户关闭预取总开关后逐卷开启被拒）。</summary>
    DisabledByPolicy = 3,
    /// <summary>前置条件不满足（如 W3-3 预取激活门：非已验证卷/系统卷/温度超标）。</summary>
    PreconditionFailed = 4,
    /// <summary>驱动未连接（握手失败或服务未运行）。</summary>
    DriverOffline = 5,
    /// <summary>重复初始化（如向导已完成后再次启动）。</summary>
    AlreadyInitialized = 6,
    /// <summary>重复盘符/卷 GUID 冲突（B-9 挂载前校验拒绝；前端展示部分已就绪）。</summary>
    DuplicateVolume = 7,
    /// <summary>缓存范围刷新不支持/未就绪（B-5 FlushFileRange；前端降级横幅文案已就绪：
    /// 「缓存范围刷新能力不可用，第一遍可能不是冷读，结果仅供参考」）。</summary>
    FlushRangeUnsupported = 8,
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

// ============================================================================
// RB2 特性层（V10.3 feature layer）C# 镜像——与协议 9 RB_MSG 无关的独立 IOCTL 通道。
//
// 手工副本同步义务（改任何字段/顺序/常量必须同步以下全部副本，缺一即 ABI 漂移）：
//   ① src/driver/rb_common2.h（C 权威：RB_STATS2 / RB2_VOLSTATUS_LIST / RB2F_* / IOCTL func 号）
//   ② src/ctl/rbfeatctl.c（STATS2 / VS_LIST 手工副本 + 注册表键名与语义）
//   ③ 本文件（Controller 树；DriverService 内的线路镜像同宗）
//
// IOCTL 码 = CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN=0x22, func, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_ANY_ACCESS)
//          = (0x22<<16) | (func<<2)
//          → STATS 0x00222404 / REFRESH 0x00222408 / SHRINK 0x0022240C
//            SNAPSHOT 0x00222410 / VOLSTATUS 0x00222414
//
// 注册表（HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache，驱动侧宽字符读取，
// UI 侧 Microsoft.Win32.Registry 同为宽字符，天然一致）：
//   Features\Flags(DWORD)       特性位，部署红线=0 全关
//   Features\L2Letter(DWORD)    WCHAR 容器盘符
//   Features\L2SizeGB(DWORD)    容器容量，缺省 32，合法 1..128
//   Features\UseDefaultExcl(DWORD)  内置排除名单总开，缺省 1
//   Features\ProcessExclude(MULTI_SZ, UTF-16)  用户排除名单，≤32 条、每条 ≤15 字符、支持 * ? 通配
//   Policies\<X>\ReadAheadMB(DWORD)  每卷预读窗口：缺省 16 / 显式 0=该卷关 / 合法 {8,16,32,64} / 其余回退 16
// ============================================================================

/// <summary>特性位（Features\Flags；部署红线 = 0 全关）。与 rb_common2.h RB2F_* 逐值一致。</summary>
public static class Rb2F
{
    public const uint Prefetch = 0x00000001;
    public const uint Hot      = 0x00000002;
    public const uint L2       = 0x00000004;
    public const uint WbCoal   = 0x00000008;
    public const uint MemGuard = 0x00000010;
    public const uint Etw      = 0x00000020;
    public const uint Thermal  = 0x00000040;   /* [Build15] 温度护栏 */
}

/// <summary>
/// 特性层统计快照（RB_STATS2 的 UI 视图，Version=2）。
/// 计数均为"本次开机累计"——FR-L2-06/FR-PF-04 的叙事指标直接取此。
/// </summary>
public sealed class FeatureStats
{
    public uint Version { get; init; }
    /// <summary>当前生效特性位（驱动重载后的真实值，非 UI 输入回显）。</summary>
    public uint Flags { get; init; }
    public uint CpuGroups { get; init; }
    public uint Workers { get; init; }
    public ulong Hits { get; init; }
    public ulong Misses { get; init; }
    public ulong BytesHit { get; init; }
    public ulong BytesMiss { get; init; }
    /// <summary>发出的预读作业数（FR-PF-04）。</summary>
    public ulong PrefIssued { get; init; }
    /// <summary>预读成功填充数（FR-PF-04）。</summary>
    public ulong PrefFillOk { get; init; }
    public ulong WbQueued { get; init; }
    public ulong WbDone { get; init; }
    public ulong WbThrottled { get; init; }
    /// <summary>L2 写入次数（FR-L2-06）。</summary>
    public ulong L2Stores { get; init; }
    /// <summary>L2 命中次数（FR-L2-06"重启后命中"叙事）。</summary>
    public ulong L2Hits { get; init; }
    public ulong L2Miss { get; init; }
    public uint HotZones { get; init; }
    /// <summary>RbL2State()：0=关 1=已开 2=拒绝-多卷 3=拒绝-块大小 4=拒绝-配置无效。</summary>
    public uint L2State { get; init; }
    /// <summary>温度护栏暂停预取事件累计（FR-PF-03 可观测）。</summary>
    public uint ThermalStops { get; init; }
    /// <summary>准入排除名单拒绝累计（panic 拒绝不计；FR-BL-03 可观测）。</summary>
    public uint AdmitRejects { get; init; }
}

/// <summary>每卷加速/旁路状态（RB2_IOCTL_VOLSTATUS 条目，Count 封顶 8）。</summary>
public sealed class VolumeAccel
{
    public char Letter { get; init; }
    /// <summary>0=旁路 1=加速。</summary>
    public uint State { get; init; }
    /// <summary>0=无 1=系统卷默认排除 2=用户关闭 3=panic/安全模式 4=引导保护 5=已移除。</summary>
    public uint Reason { get; init; }
}

/// <summary>特性层状态/原因码 → 用户可读文本（单一事实源，UI 禁散落判定与文案）。</summary>
public static class FeatureText
{
    public static string L2StateText(uint s) => s switch
    {
        0 => "关闭",
        1 => "已开启",
        2 => "已拒绝：附加多个卷（M1 仅支持单卷）",
        3 => "已拒绝：块大小几何不符（BlockSize×16≠64KB）",
        4 => "已拒绝：配置无效",
        _ => "未知状态"
    };

    public static string VolStateText(uint s) => s == 1 ? "加速已启用" : "旁路";

    public static string VolReasonText(uint r) => r switch
    {
        0 => "",
        1 => "系统卷默认排除",
        2 => "用户关闭",
        3 => "熔断/安全模式",
        4 => "引导保护",
        5 => "卷已移除",
        6 => "流/几何不可用",
        7 => "缓存方向已禁用",
        8 => "最近 IO 超过缓存门",
        9 => "最近进程/准入排除",
        10 => "最近分配/队列资源降级",
        _ => $"未知原因({r})"
    };

    /// <summary>特性位 → 中文名（设置页/日志展示用）。</summary>
    public static string FlagName(uint bit) => bit switch
    {
        Rb2F.Prefetch => "预取",
        Rb2F.Hot => "热区",
        Rb2F.L2 => "L2 持久缓存",
        Rb2F.WbCoal => "写合并",
        Rb2F.MemGuard => "内存守卫",
        Rb2F.Etw => "ETW",
        Rb2F.Thermal => "温度护栏",
        _ => "未知特性"
    };
}

/// <summary>每卷预读窗口合法档位（FR-PF-02：0=关；缺省 16；其余值驱动回退 16）。
/// [回滚 2026-10-24] 128/256/512 扩档撤回（随扩档部署出现整机崩溃，驱动侧同步回退）。</summary>
public static class ReadAheadMBOptions
{
    public static readonly uint[] Legal = { 0, 8, 16, 32, 64 };
    public const uint Default = 16;
    public const uint Off = 0;

    public static bool IsLegal(uint mb) => mb is 0 or 8 or 16 or 32 or 64;

    /// <summary>下拉展示名（0 显示"关闭"）。</summary>
    public static string Label(uint mb) => mb == 0 ? "关闭" : $"{mb} MB";
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

/// <summary>
/// 预留特性层异常（W1–W4 占位功能）。携带 <see cref="RbErrorCode"/> 与功能编号
/// （如 "W4-3"），UI 统一经 IErrorMessageProvider 转三段式文案。
/// </summary>
public sealed class RbFeatureException : Exception
{
    /// <summary>错误码。</summary>
    public RbErrorCode Code { get; }
    /// <summary>来源功能编号（迭代计划波次项，如 "W1-1"/"W3-3"）。</summary>
    public string FeatureId { get; }

    public RbFeatureException(RbErrorCode code, string featureId, string message) : base(message)
    {
        Code = code;
        FeatureId = featureId;
    }

    public RbFeatureException(RbErrorCode code, string featureId, string message, Exception inner) : base(message, inner)
    {
        Code = code;
        FeatureId = featureId;
    }
}
````

````csharp
/// <summary>
/// 【契约 B-12】收益页二级明细延迟行文本换算（协议字段已交付：RB_STATS 末尾
/// CacheReadLatencyUs/DiskReadLatencyUs EWMA，三副本同步）。无字段不画假值纪律：
/// 无样本（两值皆 0）显示「—」诚实降级，不显示估计值。
/// UI 消费位：MainViewModel.LatencyDetailText（本类提供共用换算口径）。
/// </summary>
public static class RbStatsLatency
{
    /// <summary>延迟明细文本（真值换算；cacheUs/diskUs=0 表示尚无样本）。</summary>
    public static string FormatDetail(uint cacheUs, uint diskUs)
        => FormatDetail(cacheUs, diskUs, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);

    /// <summary>[U1 2026-11-06] 延迟明细文本（EWMA + 分位数）。
    /// 分位全 0（老驱动/尚无样本）时只显示 EWMA 行——契约向后兼容；
    /// 有样本时以 log2 桶近似下界呈现 P50/P95/P99，与 EWMA 并列。</summary>
    public static string FormatDetail(uint cacheUs, uint diskUs,
                                      uint cacheP50, uint cacheP95, uint cacheP99,
                                      uint diskP50, uint diskP95, uint diskP99)
    {
        if (cacheUs == 0 && diskUs == 0)
            return "—（样本不足，多读一些后再看；驱动按 1/64 采样）";
        string ewma = $"缓存命中 {cacheUs} μs · 含下盘读 {diskUs} μs（EWMA · 采样 1/64）";
        if (cacheP50 == 0 && diskP50 == 0)
            return ewma;   // 老驱动（无分位字段）或尚无分位样本：不画假值
        string part(uint p50, uint p95, uint p99) => p50 == 0
            ? "—"
            : $"P50 {p50} · P95 {p95} · P99 {p99} μs";
        return ewma + $" ｜ 命中分位 {part(cacheP50, cacheP95, cacheP99)} ｜ 下盘分位 {part(diskP50, diskP95, diskP99)}（log2 桶近似）";
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 【契约 B-4 / B-5】二遍读基准执行体 + 缓存范围刷新契约（CLI 同款）。
/// 形状出处：deliverables/09-backend-handover-2026-10-21.md §3 B-4/B-5。
/// 纪律：B-4 是「可信」支柱地基——执行体未就绪前控制台走降级演示路径
/// （演示数据 + 降级横幅，标注「演示数据」不冒充真结果）；后端交付即解锁。
/// </summary>
public interface IBenchmarkService
{
    /// <summary>执行体是否就绪（false=B-4 未就绪，调用方必须走降级演示路径，禁把演示数据当真结果）。</summary>
    bool IsReady { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 【契约 B-4】RunColdWarmBenchmark(path) → ColdWarmResult
    /// {firstMbps, firstSec, secondMbps, secondSec, bytes, secondHitRate, ioMode, toolVersion}。
    /// 进度经 <paramref name="progress"/> 以 BenchPassProgress 上报（4Hz 节流由执行体负责）；
    /// 取消语义：取消后 stats 口径不变（不污染统计）。
    /// 降级行为：未就绪实现抛 RbFeatureException(NotImplemented, "B-4")。
    /// </summary>
    Task<ColdWarmResult> RunColdWarmBenchmarkAsync(
        string path, IProgress<BenchPassProgress>? progress, CancellationToken ct);

    /// <summary>
    /// 【契约 B-5】FlushFileRange(path)：把指定文件当前占用的缓存块失效/刷新，
    /// 使第一遍读真正落到磁盘（第一遍冷读前提）。
    /// 降级行为：不支持/未就绪时返回 ok=false + 明确 errorCode/errorText
    /// （前端降级横幅文案已就绪，不抛异常打断对比流程）。
    /// </summary>
    Task<FlushRangeResult> FlushFileRangeAsync(string path);
}

/// <summary>
/// B-4/B-5 未就绪期的默认实现（接口先行、后端交付即解锁的占位语义）：
/// 不冒充真结果——调用方按 IsReady=false 走降级演示路径；直调用则收到明确错误。
/// </summary>
public sealed class DeferredBenchmarkService : IBenchmarkService
{
    /// <summary>进程内单例（无状态；就绪实现经 FeatureRegistry force 注册替换）。</summary>
    public static DeferredBenchmarkService Instance { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>恒 false：B-4 二遍读执行体（CLI 同款测量代码路径）未就绪。</summary>
    public bool IsReady => false;

    /// <summary>未就绪：抛 RbFeatureException(NotImplemented)——调用方走降级演示路径。</summary>
    public Task<ColdWarmResult> RunColdWarmBenchmarkAsync(
        string path, IProgress<BenchPassProgress>? progress, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            throw new ArgumentException("对比文件路径不能为空", nameof(path));
        throw new RbFeatureException(RbErrorCode.NotImplemented, "B-4",
            "二遍读基准执行体未就绪（B-4 待后端）：与 ramboostctl stats 同一测量代码路径的执行体交付后启用；"
            + "当前控制台显示演示数据并常驻降级横幅，不冒充真结果。");
    }

    /// <summary>未就绪：返回 ok=false + NotImplemented + 降级横幅同款文案（不抛异常打断流程）。</summary>
    public Task<FlushRangeResult> FlushFileRangeAsync(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            throw new ArgumentException("对比文件路径不能为空", nameof(path));
        return Task.FromResult(new FlushRangeResult(
            false, RbErrorCode.NotImplemented,
            "缓存范围刷新能力不可用（B-5 待后端），第一遍可能不是冷读，结果仅供参考。"));
    }
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Services/Abstractions/IErrorMessageProvider.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 三段式错误文案契约（W1-2 信任显性化占位）。
/// 结构：发生了什么 / 对用户的影响 / 现在能做什么——对齐高频故障覆盖
/// （反作弊冲突/驱动混用/大版本后异常 + 权限/未加载类）。
/// </summary>
public interface IErrorMessageProvider
{
    /// <summary>异常 → 三段式文案（DriverException 按 Win32 码查目录）。</summary>
    RbErrorMessage Describe(Exception ex);

    /// <summary>错误码 → 三段式文案（预留特性层异常路径）。</summary>
    RbErrorMessage Describe(RbErrorCode code, string? context = null);
}

/// <summary>三段式文案（What/Impact/Action）。</summary>
public sealed record RbErrorMessage(string What, string Impact, string Action)
{
    /// <summary>Banner 单行展示形态。</summary>
    public string ToBanner() => $"{What}：{Impact}。{Action}";
}

/// <summary>
/// 目录化默认实现：内置高频故障三段式文案；未命中回落通用文案。
/// 文案目录随 W1-2 可用性测试迭代扩充（此处为 v1 骨架）。
/// </summary>
public sealed class CatalogErrorMessageProvider : IErrorMessageProvider
{
    public static CatalogErrorMessageProvider Instance { get; } = new();

    public RbErrorMessage Describe(Exception ex) => ex switch
    {
        RbFeatureException fe => Describe(fe.Code, fe.FeatureId),
        DriverException de => de.Win32Error switch
        {
            2   => new("驱动未加载", "缓存不工作，磁盘以原生速度运行", "请先安装并启动 RAMBlockCache 驱动（安装器已内置签名预检）"),
            5   => new("拒绝访问", "控制台无法与驱动通信", "请以管理员身份运行本控制台"),
            87  => new("协议版本不一致", "控制器与驱动无法互认，功能全部不可用", "请将控制器与驱动升级到同一版本"),
            _   => new("驱动命令失败", "该操作未生效", $"详情：{de.Message}"),
        },
        _ => new("操作失败", "该操作未生效", $"详情：{ex.Message}"),
    };

    public RbErrorMessage Describe(RbErrorCode code, string? context = null) => code switch
    {
        RbErrorCode.NotImplemented => new(
            "该功能为预留占位",
            "接口契约已就位但对应波次尚未开发，当前不可用",
            context is { Length: > 0 } ? $"随迭代计划 {context} 波次交付" : "随迭代计划对应波次交付"),
        RbErrorCode.NotLicensed => new("未授权", "该功能需要有效许可", "请激活许可或购买授权（W4-3）"),
        RbErrorCode.DisabledByPolicy => new("被开关或策略禁用", "当前配置下该操作不被允许", "请先在设置页开启对应开关"),
        RbErrorCode.PreconditionFailed => new("前置条件不满足", "当前卷或环境不满足该操作的安全前提", context ?? "请按页面提示调整后重试"),
        RbErrorCode.DriverOffline => new("驱动未连接", "所有缓存功能不可用", "请检查驱动安装与管理员权限"),
        RbErrorCode.AlreadyInitialized => new("已初始化", "重复操作被忽略", "无需处理"),
        _ => new("未知错误", "操作未生效", "请查看日志页获取详情"),
    };
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 许可授权契约（W4-3 定价测试与授权条款占位 + B-14 结构化状态）。
/// 商业口径未定（产品级 PRD 六待确认问题之一），占位期行为=不阻塞功能。
/// 【契约 B-14】扩展：Status 属性提供 LicenseStatusInfo 结构化 DTO
/// （形状出处：09 移交报告 §4 B-14「LicenseStatus{state, trialStartDate, trialDays,
/// remainingDays, licenseType, activatedDate}」）；Activate 形状保持（密钥校验+绑定
/// 随激活端点交付）。
/// [用户裁决 2026-10-23 23:42] **试用时间无上限**：本地口径不再倒计时/过期——
/// RemainingDays 恒 -1（契约注释"-1=无限期"语义）；后端 B-14 就绪后由服务端点接管口径。
/// </summary>
public interface ILicenseService
{
    /// <summary>当前许可状态。</summary>
    LicenseState State { get; }
    /// <summary>剩余天数（-1=无限期/不适用）。</summary>
    int DaysRemaining { get; }
    /// <summary>是否已正式授权。</summary>
    bool IsLicensed { get; }
    /// <summary>【契约 B-14】许可状态结构化 DTO（F5 许可卡五态 VM 的数据源）。</summary>
    LicenseStatusInfo Status { get; }
    /// <summary>校验当前许可；null=通过，非 null=阻塞原因（三段式文案）。</summary>
    RbErrorMessage? Validate();
    /// <summary>激活许可密钥（占位：抛 NotImplemented，由 UI Guard 转 Banner）。</summary>
    void Activate(string key);
}

/// <summary>许可状态（W4-3 占位语汇）。</summary>
public enum LicenseState
{
    Unlicensed,
    Trial,
    Licensed,
    Expired,
}

/// <summary>
/// 本地演示实现（B-14 服务端点就绪前的 settings.json 口径）：
/// **试用无上限**（[用户裁决 2026-10-23]）——恒 Trial + RemainingDays=-1（无限期），
/// 不再倒计时/转过期；全部成员由同一实况推导，避免两套许可故事；
/// 激活端点未就绪：Activate 抛 NotImplemented（UI Guard 转 Banner）。
/// </summary>
public sealed class NoopLicenseService : ILicenseService
{
    public static NoopLicenseService Instance { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>无限期标记（契约口径：-1=无限期/不适用；TrialDays/RemainingDays 同用）。</summary>
    private const int Unlimited = -1;

    /// <summary>从 settings.json 推导结构化状态（首跑自动落试用起始日；读失败不抛）。</summary>
    public LicenseStatusInfo Status
    {
        get
        {
            var s = SettingsService.Load();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.TrialStartDate))
            {
                s.TrialStartDate = DateTime.Today.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
                SettingsService.Save(s);
            }
            if (s.LicenseState == "active")
            {
                // 激活日期本地不跟踪（随 B-14 安装器/服务端点落库）；F5 卡展示许可类型即可
                return new LicenseStatusInfo(
                    LicenseStates.Active, s.TrialStartDate, Unlimited, Unlimited,
                    string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.LicenseType) ? "正式版" : s.LicenseType, "");
            }
            // [用户裁决] 试用无上限：恒 Trial，RemainingDays=-1（不再倒计时/过期）
            return new LicenseStatusInfo(
                LicenseStates.Trial, s.TrialStartDate, Unlimited, Unlimited, "", "");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>占位期=试用态（无上限；授权条款随 W4-3 拍板）。</summary>
    public LicenseState State => Status.State switch
    {
        LicenseStates.Active => LicenseState.Licensed,
        _ => LicenseState.Trial
    };

    /// <summary>剩余天数（-1=无限期；与 Status.RemainingDays 同源）。</summary>
    public int DaysRemaining => Status.RemainingDays;

    /// <summary>是否已正式授权（settings.json 本地口径）。</summary>
    bool ILicenseService.IsLicensed => Status.State == LicenseStates.Active;

    /// <summary>占位期不阻塞任何功能（试用无上限，恒放行；过期策略 D-5 随商业化拍板）。</summary>
    public RbErrorMessage? Validate() => null;

    /// <summary>激活端点未就绪：抛 RbFeatureException(NotImplemented)，由 UI Guard 转 Banner。</summary>
    public void Activate(string key) => throw new RbFeatureException(RbErrorCode.NotImplemented, "W4-3",
        "许可激活为 W4-3 预留占位：定价与授权条款随产品级 PRD 拍板后实现");
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Services/Abstractions/IOperationProgress.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 【契约 B-7 / B-8】操作进度事件源抽象（公共基座）。
/// 形状出处：deliverables/09-backend-handover-2026-10-21.md §3 B-7 / §4 B-8。
/// 一个事件解锁四个界面：二遍读运行态 / 预设多卷应用 / 卸载回写 / L2 重建——
/// 前端统一渲染：进度条（4Hz 节流）+ 阶段文案 + 取消按钮（cancelable 时）。
/// B-8 的 L2 重建事件挂在本基座上（无事件时前端静默，不造假）。
/// 订阅/取消订阅 = C# 事件机制；后端事件源就绪后替换实现，消费方不变。
/// </summary>
public interface IOperationProgress
{
    /// <summary>B-7 操作进度事件（后台线程可触发；订阅方自行投递 UI 线程）。</summary>
    event Action<OpProgress>? Progressed;

    /// <summary>B-8 L2 恢复重建事件（挂电恢复场景；无事件=前端静默）。</summary>
    event Action<L2RebuildProgress>? L2Rebuild;

    /// <summary>发布一条进度（前端自身长操作的执行体也经此总线，后端事件源就绪后由实现侧发布）。</summary>
    void Publish(OpProgress progress);

    /// <summary>发布一条 L2 重建事件。</summary>
    void PublishL2Rebuild(L2RebuildProgress progress);

    /// <summary>登记可取消操作（opId → 取消动作；取消按钮/取消命令经此应答）。</summary>
    bool RegisterCancelable(string opId, Action cancel);

    /// <summary>取消已登记操作（返回 false=该 opId 未登记/已结束）。</summary>
    bool Cancel(string opId);

    /// <summary>操作结束（清理取消登记；防泄漏）。</summary>
    void Complete(string opId);
}

/// <summary>
/// 默认实现 = 进程内事件总线（后端事件源未就绪期的前端自给基座）。
/// 纪律：订阅者缺陷不得倒灌生产路径（进度发布可能在后台线程）——
/// 逐订阅者隔离异常并记 WARN（与 LogService.Appended 的 R6-UI10 纪律同款）。
/// </summary>
public sealed class InProcessOperationProgress : IOperationProgress
{
    /// <summary>进程内单例（FeatureRegistry 默认接线）。</summary>
    public static InProcessOperationProgress Instance { get; } = new();

    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Action> _cancelable = new();

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public event Action<OpProgress>? Progressed;

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public event Action<L2RebuildProgress>? L2Rebuild;

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public void Publish(OpProgress progress)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(progress);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(progress.OpId))
            throw new ArgumentException("opId 不能为空", nameof(progress));
        var handlers = Progressed;
        if (handlers is null) return;
        foreach (Action<OpProgress> d in handlers.GetInvocationList())
        {
            try { d(progress); }
            catch (Exception ex) { LogService.Warn($"进度订阅者异常（已隔离，不影响生产方）：{ex.Message}"); }
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public void PublishL2Rebuild(L2RebuildProgress progress)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(progress);
        var handlers = L2Rebuild;
        if (handlers is null) return;
        foreach (Action<L2RebuildProgress> d in handlers.GetInvocationList())
        {
            try { d(progress); }
            catch (Exception ex) { LogService.Warn($"L2 重建订阅者异常（已隔离，不影响生产方）：{ex.Message}"); }
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public bool RegisterCancelable(string opId, Action cancel)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(opId)) throw new ArgumentException("opId 不能为空", nameof(opId));
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(cancel);
        lock (_gate) { _cancelable[opId] = cancel; }
        return true;
    }

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public bool Cancel(string opId)
    {
        Action? cancel;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (!_cancelable.TryGetValue(opId, out cancel)) return false;
        }
        try { cancel(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { LogService.Warn($"取消操作 {opId} 异常（已记录）：{ex.Message}"); }
        return true;
    }

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public void Complete(string opId)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(opId)) return;
        lock (_gate) { _cancelable.Remove(opId); }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 【契约 B-11】预取门（预取激活前置校验：已验证加速卷 / 非系统卷 / 温度正常）。
/// 形状出处：deliverables/09-backend-handover-2026-10-21.md §4 B-11；
/// 消费方：预取总开关（FeatureConfigService.SetPrefetchGlobal 开启向）+
/// 预设「开预取」（经同一开关面）。不满足 → 返回原因文案，调用方拒绝并呈现。
/// </summary>
public interface IPrefetchGate
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 校验预取激活前提。<paramref name="driveLetter"/>='\0' = 全局开启校验
    /// （至少一个合规卷）；指定盘符 = 逐卷校验（预读控件/未来逐卷预取开关消费）。
    /// </summary>
    PrefetchGateResult Check(char driveLetter);
}

/// <summary>预取门校验结果（Ok=false 时 Reason 为可读原因文案）。</summary>
public sealed record PrefetchGateResult(bool Ok, string Reason);

/// <summary>
/// 默认实现：三项前置校验（顺序即优先级）。
///   ① 非系统卷——客户端判定（系统根盘符），恒可用；
///   ② 已验证加速卷——VOLSTATUS 真相（State==1）；驱动离线=校验不可用 →
///      **放行 + WARN**（与 B-9 挂载前校验同款降级：驱动侧仍有最终裁决，UI 不阻塞演示路径）；
///   ③ 温度正常——RB_STATS2 当前无温度字段（协议未就绪）：该项**跳过**（见注释），不造假。
/// </summary>
public sealed class DefaultPrefetchGate : IPrefetchGate
{
    /// <summary>进程内单例（无状态；驱动侧门就绪后替换实现）。</summary>
    public static DefaultPrefetchGate Instance { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>系统根盘符（与 MainViewModel.IsSystemLetter / 驱动"系统卷默认不附加"同口径；取不到回落 C）。</summary>
    private static char SystemRootLetter()
    {
        try
        {
            string? root = Path.GetPathRoot(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.System));
            if (root is { Length: > 0 } && char.IsLetter(root[0])) return char.ToUpperInvariant(root[0]);
        }
        catch { /* 取不到按 C 保守处理 */ }
        return 'C';
    }

    /// <inheritdoc/>
    public PrefetchGateResult Check(char driveLetter)
    {
        bool global = driveLetter == '\0';
        char letter = char.ToUpperInvariant(driveLetter);

        // ① 非系统卷（系统卷默认不纳入预取——安全第一，与加速门同口径）
        if (!global && letter == SystemRootLetter())
            return new PrefetchGateResult(false, $"系统卷（{letter}:）默认不纳入预取（安全第一）");

        // ② 已验证加速卷（VOLSTATUS 真相；驱动离线=校验不可用→放行+WARN，禁把"查不到"当"不合规"）
        List<VolumeAccel> vols;
        try { vols = DriverService.Instance.QueryVolumeAccel(); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            LogService.Warn($"预取门：加速态校验不可用（{ex.Message}），按放行处理（驱动侧仍有最终裁决）");
            return new PrefetchGateResult(true, "");
        }

        if (global)
        {
            bool any = vols.Any(v => v.State == 1 && char.ToUpperInvariant(v.Letter) != SystemRootLetter());
            return any
                ? new PrefetchGateResult(true, "")
                : new PrefetchGateResult(false,
                    "当前没有已验证的加速数据卷：预取总开关暂无适用对象（请先在「加速」页挂载数据卷）");
        }

        var vol = vols.FirstOrDefault(v => char.ToUpperInvariant(v.Letter) == letter);
        if (vol is null || vol.State != 1)
            return new PrefetchGateResult(false, $"该卷尚未进入加速态（{letter}: 未挂载或旁路），预取门拒绝开启");

        // ③ 温度正常：RB_STATS2 无温度字段（协议未就绪，B-11 后端交付温度位后启用）——此处跳过，不造假
        return new PrefetchGateResult(true, "");
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 【契约 B-3】场景预设服务契约（ApplyPreset / GetPresetDiff）。
/// 形状出处：deliverables/09-backend-handover-2026-10-21.md §3 B-3。
/// 原子性：全字段成功或全回滚；任一受管字段失败即回滚已应用项（退化方案中由
/// 调用方凭快照回滚，后端编排上线后在实现内回滚——消费侧行为不变）。
/// 永不覆写：每卷配额、挂载状态、自定义排除名单（用户个体决策）。
/// </summary>
public interface IPresetService
{
    /// <summary>后端原子编排是否已就绪（false=前端退化编排在跑：逐字段应用 + 调用方快照回滚）。</summary>
    bool IsReady { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 【契约 B-3】ApplyPreset(presetId: "safe"|"balanced"|"perf") → ApplyResult{ok, failedField?, errorText?}。
    /// 受管字段（7 项中的可写 5 项）：每卷写模式 / 读预取总开关 / 每卷预读窗口 / L2 / 回写周期；
    /// 全局内存预算（B-13 未确认前）与进程准入/配额/挂载/排除名单不覆写。
    /// 失败错误沿用三段式归因（发生了什么/影响与风险/如何撤销），前端不发明新错误范式。
    /// </summary>
    Task<ApplyResult> ApplyPresetAsync(string presetId);

    /// <summary>
    /// 【契约 B-3】GetPresetDiff() → 差异行列表（当前实况 vs 基础档位；
    /// 前端「自定义（基于：X）」+ 差异清单消费）。
    /// </summary>
    IReadOnlyList<string> GetPresetDiff();
}

/// <summary>
/// 退化编排执行面（VM 适配器）：把受管字段的读写接到 VM/驱动现状。
/// 服务不反向依赖 ViewModel——全部经委托注入；后端 B-3 编排就绪后替换
/// IPresetService 实现，本适配器与消费方一起退场。
/// </summary>
public sealed class PresetApplyAdapter
{
    /// <summary>每卷写模式目标（0=直写 1=回写；null=不覆写）。
    /// perf 档仅经 F3 引导确认后为 1（原子性：用户取消则整档不应用）。</summary>
    public uint? WriteMode { get; set; }

    /// <summary>设置全部卷写模式（0=直写 1=回写）。</summary>
    public required Action<uint> SetVolumeWriteMode { get; init; }
    /// <summary>设置全部卷预读窗口索引（safe=1 / balanced=2 / perf=3）。</summary>
    public required Action<int> SetVolumeReadAhead { get; init; }
    /// <summary>读预取总开关（经 B-11 预取门）。</summary>
    public required Action<bool> SetPrefetchGlobal { get; init; }
    /// <summary>L2 持久缓存开关。</summary>
    public required Action<bool> SetL2 { get; init; }
    /// <summary>回写周期下拉索引（FlushIntervalOptions 下标）。</summary>
    public required Action<int> SetFlushInterval { get; init; }

    /// <summary>当前档位（摘要表/差异清单的"当前实况"侧）。</summary>
    public required Func<PresetTier> CurrentTier { get; init; }
    /// <summary>基础档位（自定义时记录来源）。</summary>
    public required Func<PresetTier> BaselineTier { get; init; }
    /// <summary>按受管参数名取当前实况值文本（差异清单消费）。</summary>
    public required Func<string, string> ActualValue { get; init; }
}

/// <summary>
/// B-3 默认实现 = 前端退化编排（PresetService 现逻辑的降级落地）：
/// 逐字段应用（顺序与 FeaturesViewModel.ApplyCoreAsync 既有序列逐字一致：
/// ① 每卷写模式 → ② 每卷预读窗口 → ③ 读预取总开关 → ④ L2 → ⑤ 回写周期），
/// 任一字段失败即返回 ApplyResult(false, failedField, errorText)，由调用方
/// 凭快照回滚已应用项（退化方案同语义）；差异清单委托 PresetService.DiffLines。
/// 后端原子编排就绪后：以 force 注册新实现整体替换，VM 与 XAML 不变。
/// </summary>
public sealed class DegradedPresetService : IPresetService
{
    private readonly PresetApplyAdapter _ad;
    private readonly IOperationProgress _progress;

    /// <summary>构造退化编排（适配器由消费方 VM 提供；进度总线默认进程内单例）。</summary>
    public DegradedPresetService(PresetApplyAdapter adapter, IOperationProgress? progress = null)
    {
        _ad = adapter ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(adapter));
        _progress = progress ?? InProcessOperationProgress.Instance;
    }

    /// <summary>恒 false：后端原子编排（B-3）未就绪，前端退化方案在跑。</summary>
    public bool IsReady => false;

    /// <summary>presetId 键 → 档位枚举（与 PresetService.TierKey 互为逆映射）。</summary>
    private static PresetTier KeyToTier(string key) => key switch
    {
        "safe" => PresetTier.Safe,
        "perf" => PresetTier.Perf,
        "custom" => PresetTier.Custom,
        _ => PresetTier.Balanced
    };

    /// <summary>字段失败包装：记日志 + 三段式归因载荷（failedField 精确到受管项）。</summary>
    private static ApplyResult Fail(string field, Exception ex)
    {
        LogService.Error($"预设应用失败（{field}）：{ex.Message}");
        return new ApplyResult(false, field, ex.Message);
    }

    /// <summary>应用档位（退化编排：逐字段 + 失败即报；回滚由调用方凭快照执行）。
    /// [契约 B-7] 每步字段经进度总线发布（opType=preset-apply；状态页通用进度条消费）。</summary>
    public Task<ApplyResult> ApplyPresetAsync(string presetId)
    {
        var tier = KeyToTier(presetId);
        if (tier == PresetTier.Custom)
            return Task.FromResult(new ApplyResult(false, null, "自定义档不可直接应用（请先应用某一基础档）"));
        const string opId = "preset-apply";
        const int steps = 5;
        int step = 0;
        void Pub(string field)
            => _progress.Publish(new OpProgress(opId, OpTypes.PresetApply,
                step * 100.0 / steps, $"正在应用：{field}", false));
        try
        {
            // ① 每卷写模式：安全/均衡=全直写；性能档=经 F3 确认后翻回写（未确认=不覆写）
            step++; Pub("每卷写模式");
            if (_ad.WriteMode is uint m) _ad.SetVolumeWriteMode(m);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { _progress.Complete(opId); return Task.FromResult(Fail("每卷写模式", ex)); }
        try
        {
            // ② 每卷预读窗口（safe=8 块 idx1 / balanced=16 块 idx2 / perf=32 块 idx3）
            step++; Pub("每卷预读窗口");
            _ad.SetVolumeReadAhead(tier == PresetTier.Safe ? 1 : tier == PresetTier.Perf ? 3 : 2);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { _progress.Complete(opId); return Task.FromResult(Fail("每卷预读窗口", ex)); }
        try
        {
            // ③ 读预取总开关（safe=关；balanced/perf=开——开过 B-11 预取门）
            step++; Pub("读预取总开关");
            _ad.SetPrefetchGlobal(tier != PresetTier.Safe);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { _progress.Complete(opId); return Task.FromResult(Fail("读预取总开关", ex)); }
        try
        {
            // ④ L2 持久缓存（perf=开；safe/balanced=关）
            step++; Pub("L2 持久缓存");
            _ad.SetL2(tier == PresetTier.Perf);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { _progress.Complete(opId); return Task.FromResult(Fail("L2 持久缓存", ex)); }
        try
        {
            // ⑤ 回写周期（60 秒档 idx2；safe 不适用=直写无脏数据）
            step++; Pub("回写周期");
            _ad.SetFlushInterval(2);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { _progress.Complete(opId); return Task.FromResult(Fail("回写周期", ex)); }
        // 全局内存预算：B-13 协议未确认前不覆写（摘要表标注「协议待确认」）
        _progress.Publish(new OpProgress(opId, OpTypes.PresetApply, 100, "预设已应用", false));
        _progress.Complete(opId);
        return Task.FromResult(new ApplyResult(true, null, null));
    }

    /// <summary>差异清单（当前实况 vs 基础档；委托 PresetService.DiffLines 既有逻辑）。</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<string> GetPresetDiff()
    {
        return PresetService.DiffLines(
            _ad.CurrentTier(), _ad.BaselineTier(),
            _ad.ActualValue("每卷写模式"), _ad.ActualValue("每卷预读窗口"), _ad.ActualValue("读预取总开关"),
            _ad.ActualValue("L2 持久缓存"), _ad.ActualValue("回写周期"));
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 遥测客户端契约（W1-1 最小遥测集 v1 占位）。
/// 纪律：采集默认关、匿名、一键可关（W1-1 三原则）；Noop 实现不落任何数据。
/// </summary>
public interface ITelemetryClient
{
    /// <summary>采集器是否已就绪（占位期 Noop 恒 false=采集未实现）。</summary>
    bool IsEnabled { get; }

    /// <summary>记录一条事件（未 opt-in 或占位期实现方必须静默丢弃）。</summary>
    void Record(TelemetryEvent evt, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? properties = null);

    /// <summary>立即冲刷缓冲（进程退出/关键事件后调用）。</summary>
    void Flush();

    /// <summary>关闭客户端（应用退出）。</summary>
    void Shutdown();
}

/// <summary>最小遥测事件集（W1-1 指标面：安装/激活/命中率/稳定性）。</summary>
public enum TelemetryEvent
{
    InstallCompleted,
    VolumeActivated,
    VolumeDeactivated,
    PanicTriggered,
    PanicCleared,
    SafeModeExited,
    DirtyLossDetected,
    HandshakeFailed,
    UnmountCompleted,
    UnmountPartialFailed,   /* [FIX C#11] 全部卸载部分卷失败（与 UnmountCompleted 分流） */
    FlushCompleted,
}

/// <summary>默认占位实现：不采集、不落盘、不联网（W1-1 未开发期行为）。</summary>
public sealed class NoopTelemetryClient : ITelemetryClient
{
    public static NoopTelemetryClient Instance { get; } = new();

    public bool IsEnabled => false;

    public void Record(TelemetryEvent evt, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? properties = null) { }

    public void Flush() { }

    public void Shutdown() { }
}
````

````csharp
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 反作弊环境探测（F4；06 契约 #13：枚举 vgk/BEDaisy/EasyAntiCheat，纯客户端能力）。
/// 实现走**注册表服务键枚举**（HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services，纯托管零 P/Invoke）——
/// 原 advapi32 EnumServicesStatusEx 实现因结构体条目封送（指针成员 + 对齐）在
/// x64 上取到错位指针 → PtrToStringUni AccessViolation（15:2x 崩溃根因三），
/// 且 AV 不可 try/catch。注册表路径与服务枚举等价（服务名=键名），且免依赖。
/// 命中规则：服务名（小写）包含 vgk / bedaisy / easyanticheat。
/// </summary>
public static class AnticheatInfo
{
    private const string ServicesKey = @"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services";

    /// <summary>探测结果（Detected=命中反作弊服务；Matched=白名单格式服务名列表）。</summary>
    public sealed record AnticheatResult(bool Detected, string[] Matched);

    /// <summary>枚举本机服务键，返回反作弊命中列表（探测失败按未命中处理——不制造恐慌）。</summary>
    public static AnticheatResult Query()
    {
        try
        {
            using var key = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(ServicesKey, writable: false);
            if (key is null) return new AnticheatResult(false, Array.Empty<string>());
            var hits = new List<string>();
            foreach (var name in key.GetSubKeyNames())
            {
                string lower = name.ToLowerInvariant();
                if (lower.Contains("vgk") || lower.Contains("bedaisy") || lower.Contains("easyanticheat"))
                    hits.Add(FormatName(name));
            }
            hits.Sort();
            return new AnticheatResult(hits.Count > 0, hits.ToArray());
        }
        catch
        {
            return new AnticheatResult(false, Array.Empty<string>());
        }
    }

    /// <summary>服务名 → 白名单格式「中文名（代号）」（06 C-5.6；未知名按原样）。</summary>
    private static string FormatName(string serviceName) => serviceName.ToLowerInvariant() switch
    {
        "vgk" => "VALORANT · Vanguard（vgk）",
        "bedaisy" => "BattlEye（BEDaisy）",
        "easyanticheat" => "EasyAntiCheat（EasyAntiCheat）",
        _ => serviceName
    };
}
````

##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Services/CliBenchmarkService.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 【契约 B-4/B-5】二遍读基准真实执行体（CLI 同款测量路径：ramboostctl bench / flushfile）。
/// 形状出处：09-backend-handover §3 B-4/B-5（最硬契约：no-buffered + stats 同源时钟 + 误差&lt;2%）。
/// 后端 CLI 已交付（13-iteration-handover §3.1）——本类把执行体接进 <see cref="IBenchmarkService"/>，
/// exe 不可定位时由 <see cref="DeferredBenchmarkService"/> 兜底（降级演示路径，不冒充真结果）。
/// 解析契约（与 cli_bench 输出逐字对应）：
///   stdout 结构化行：bench firstMbps=%.1f firstSec=%.2f secondMbps=%.1f secondSec=%.2f
///                        bytes=%llu secondHitRate=%.4f ioMode=%s toolVersion="%s"
///   stderr 进度行（250ms 节流）：[bench progress] pass=%s percent=%.1f mbpsInstant=%.1f
///   flushfile 结构化行：flushfile ok=1 errorCode=0 extents=%d fallback=%d /
///                       flushfile ok=0 errorCode=%d errorText="%s"
/// 取消语义：Kill 进程树（CLI 侧只读统计，stats 口径不受影响）。
/// </summary>
public sealed partial class CliBenchmarkService : IBenchmarkService
{
    private readonly string _exe;

    private CliBenchmarkService(string exe) { _exe = exe; }

    /// <summary>
    /// 定位 ramboostctl.exe（部署态：与控制器 exe 同目录平铺，见 build_setup.ps1 payload；
    /// 开发态：源码树 src\ctl）。找到返回实例，找不到返回 null（调用方回退 Deferred）。
    /// </summary>
    public static CliBenchmarkService? TryCreate()
    {
        foreach (var cand in CandidatePaths())
        {
            try { if (System.IO.File.Exists(cand)) return new CliBenchmarkService(cand); }
            catch { /* 路径构造异常：跳过该候选 */ }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<string> CandidatePaths()
    {
        // ① 部署态：安装目录平铺（build_setup.ps1 把 ramboostctl.exe 与控制器 exe 同拷一层）
        yield return System.IO.Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "ramboostctl.exe");
        // ② 开发态：UI 跑在 <源码包根>\src\ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\bin\{cfg}\{tfm}\，
        // 到源码包根需上溯 7 级（少一级会停在 src 目录拼出 src\src\ctl 落空——实测踩过）
        string? dir = AppContext.BaseDirectory;
        for (int i = 0; i < 7 && dir is not null; i++)
        {
            dir = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(dir.TrimEnd(System.IO.Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
            if (dir is null) break;
            yield return System.IO.Path.Combine(dir, "src", "ctl", "ramboostctl.exe");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>执行体就绪（构造期已定位到 exe；测量纪律由 CLI 同款路径保证）。</summary>
    public bool IsReady => true;

    /// <summary>
    /// 【契约 B-4】跑二遍读基准：起 CLI 子进程，stderr 逐行解析进度（CLI 已 250ms 节流），
    /// stdout 结构化行解析八字段。取消=Kill 进程树；取消/失败不污染 stats（CLI 侧只读）。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<ColdWarmResult> RunColdWarmBenchmarkAsync(
        string path, IProgress<BenchPassProgress>? progress, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            throw new ArgumentException("对比文件路径不能为空", nameof(path));

        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo
        {
            FileName = _exe,
            Arguments = $"bench {Quote(path)}",
            UseShellExecute = false,
            CreateNoWindow = true,
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true,
            // CLI 控制台输出按 ACP（结构化行全 ASCII，中文人类行用 Default 解不炸）
            StandardOutputEncoding = Encoding.Default,
            StandardErrorEncoding = Encoding.Default,
        };

        using var proc = new Process { StartInfo = psi };
        var stdout = new StringBuilder();
        var stderr = new StringBuilder();
        proc.OutputDataReceived += (_, e) => { if (e.Data is not null) lock (stdout) stdout.AppendLine(e.Data); };
        proc.ErrorDataReceived += (_, e) =>
        {
            if (e.Data is null) return;
            lock (stderr) stderr.AppendLine(e.Data);
            var m = ProgressRe().Match(e.Data);
            if (m is { Success: true } && progress is not null
                && double.TryParse(m.Groups[2].Value, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var pct)
                && double.TryParse(m.Groups[3].Value, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var mbps))
            {
                progress.Report(new BenchPassProgress(m.Groups[1].Value, pct, mbps, Cancelable: true));
            }
        };

        if (!proc.Start()) throw new RbFeatureException(RbErrorCode.PreconditionFailed, "B-4", "无法启动二遍读执行体（ramboostctl bench）");
        proc.BeginOutputReadLine();
        proc.BeginErrorReadLine();

        using var reg = ct.Register(() =>
        {
            try { proc.Kill(entireProcessTree: true); } catch { /* 已退出：忽略 */ }
        });

        await proc.WaitForExitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);   // 取消时 reg 已 Kill，下面按取消路径抛

        string outText;
        lock (stdout) outText = stdout.ToString();
        var r = ResultRe().Match(outText);
        if (!r.Success)
        {
            string tail;
            lock (stderr) tail = stderr.ToString();
            // 取消优先于失败归因（Kill 后 WaitForExitAsync 正常返回的场景）
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            string lastErr = LastMeaningfulLine(tail) ?? "（无输出）";
            throw new RbFeatureException(RbErrorCode.PreconditionFailed, "B-4",
                $"二遍读执行体未产出结构化结果：{lastErr}");
        }

        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        return ParseBenchmarkResult(outText);
    }

    /// <summary>真实结构化解析入口；兼容旧八字段与可选 driverCold 字段。</summary>
    internal static ColdWarmResult ParseBenchmarkResult(string output)
    {
        var r = ResultRe().Match(output);
        if (!r.Success) throw new ArgumentException("bench 结构化结果缺失或字段不完整", nameof(output));
        return new ColdWarmResult(
            ParseD(r.Groups[1]), ParseD(r.Groups[2]), ParseD(r.Groups[3]), ParseD(r.Groups[4]),
            ParseU(r.Groups[5]), ParseD(r.Groups[6]),
            r.Groups[7].Value, r.Groups[8].Value);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 【契约 B-5】缓存范围刷新（CLI 同款：FSCTL_GET_RETRIEVAL_POINTERS → 消息 13 逐区间）。
    /// 失败返回 ok=false + 明确错误码/文案（降级横幅消费，不抛异常打断对比流程）。
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<FlushRangeResult> FlushFileRangeAsync(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            throw new ArgumentException("对比文件路径不能为空", nameof(path));

        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo
        {
            FileName = _exe,
            Arguments = $"flushfile {Quote(path)}",
            UseShellExecute = false,
            CreateNoWindow = true,
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true,
            StandardOutputEncoding = Encoding.Default,
            StandardErrorEncoding = Encoding.Default,
        };
        using var proc = new Process { StartInfo = psi };
        string outText = "", errText = "";
        try
        {
            if (!proc.Start()) return FlushFail(RbErrorCode.PreconditionFailed, "无法启动缓存范围刷新执行体（ramboostctl flushfile）");
            outText = await proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            errText = await proc.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            await proc.WaitForExitAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return FlushFail(RbErrorCode.PreconditionFailed, $"缓存范围刷新执行体异常：{ex.Message}");
        }

        // 结构化行优先（ok=1/errorCode=0），失败时错误码与 RbErrorCode 数值对齐（CLI 侧口径）
        var m = FlushRe().Match(outText);
        if (m is { Success: true } && m.Groups[1].Value == "1")
            return new FlushRangeResult(true, null, null);
        if (m is { Success: true })
        {
            var code = (RbErrorCode)ParseU(m.Groups[2]);
            return FlushFail(code, m.Groups[3].Value);
        }
        // 无结构化行（参数错 exit 2 / 打不开文件 exit 1）：取 stderr 末条可读行
        return FlushFail(RbErrorCode.PreconditionFailed, LastMeaningfulLine(errText) ?? "缓存范围刷新失败（无输出）");
    }

    private static FlushRangeResult FlushFail(RbErrorCode code, string text)
        => new(false, code, $"{text}——driver-cold-unverified / os-cache-unknown，结果仅供诊断。");

    // —— 解析辅助 ——

    /// <summary>bench 结构化结果行（八字段与 ColdWarmResult 逐字对应；toolVersion 带引号）。</summary>
    [System.Text.RegularExpressions.GeneratedRegex(@"bench\s+firstMbps=([\d.\-]+)\s+firstSec=([\d.\-]+)\s+secondMbps=([\d.\-]+)\s+secondSec=([\d.\-]+)\s+bytes=(\d+)\s+secondHitRate=([\d.\-]+)(?:\s+driverCold=(?:true|false))?\s+ioMode=(\S+)\s+toolVersion=""([^""]*)""")]
    private static partial Regex ResultRe();

    /// <summary>进度行（stderr，250ms 节流；pass=first|second）。</summary>
    [System.Text.RegularExpressions.GeneratedRegex(@"\[bench progress\]\s+pass=(\w+)\s+percent=([\d.]+)\s+mbpsInstant=([\d.]+)")]
    private static partial Regex ProgressRe();

    /// <summary>flushfile 结构化行。</summary>
    [System.Text.RegularExpressions.GeneratedRegex(@"flushfile\s+ok=(\d)\s+errorCode=(\d+)(?:\s+errorText=""([^""]*)"")?")]
    private static partial Regex FlushRe();

    private static double ParseD(System.Text.RegularExpressions.Group g)
        => double.TryParse(g.Value, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var v) ? v : 0;

    private static ulong ParseU(System.Text.RegularExpressions.Group g)
        => ulong.TryParse(g.Value, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var v) ? v : 0;

    /// <summary>stderr 末条可读错误行（跳过空行；无则 null）。</summary>
    private static string? LastMeaningfulLine(string text)
    {
        string? last = null;
        foreach (var line in text.Split('\n'))
        {
            var t = line.Trim('\r', ' ', '\t');
            if (t.Length > 0) last = t;
        }
        return last;
    }

    /// <summary>Windows 命令行引号转义（CommandLineToArgvW 规则：内部引号转 \"、引号前的反斜杠与末尾反斜杠加倍）。</summary>
    private static string Quote(string s)
    {
        if (!s.Contains(' ') && !s.Contains('\t') && !s.Contains('"'))
            return s;
        // 内部引号 → \"（其前置反斜杠链加倍）；末尾反斜杠链加倍（防止闭合引号被吃掉）
        var sb = new StringBuilder("\"");
        int backslashes = 0;
        foreach (var c in s)
        {
            if (c == '\\') { backslashes++; continue; }
            if (c == '"') { sb.Append('\\', backslashes * 2 + 1).Append('"'); backslashes = 0; continue; }
            sb.Append('\\', backslashes).Append(c);
            backslashes = 0;
        }
        sb.Append('\\', backslashes * 2).Append('"');
        return sb.ToString();
    }
}
````
