````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

public enum StatsScope { EngineGlobal, VolumeState }

/// <summary>应用层快照：引擎指标与卷状态分离；卷状态没有伪逐卷指标。</summary>
public sealed class StatsSnapshot
{
    public StatsScope Scope { get; init; }
    public bool HasMetrics { get; init; }
    public ulong DeviceKey { get; init; }
    public StatusOutput EngineStats { get; init; }
    public double ReadMbps, WriteMbps, HitPct;
    public ulong CacheBytesUsed, CacheBytesTotal;
    public ulong BytesFromCache, WbBytes;
    public bool Mounted, Paused;
    public uint Mode;
}

/// <summary>每轮一次全局统计和一次卷列表，再分发一个全局样本与 N 个卷状态样本。</summary>
public sealed class StatsService : IDisposable
{
    public static StatsService Instance { get; } = new();
    private StatsService() { }

    private static readonly TimeSpan _period = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
    private PeriodicTimer? _timer;
    private Task? _loop;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _cts;
    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private (ulong disk, ulong wb, long at) _last;
    private ulong[] _keys = Array.Empty<ulong>();

    // 内部测试接缝；生产默认仍走真实 DriverService，不改变公开驱动协议。
    internal Func<StatusOutput>? EngineStatsProvider { get; set; }
    internal Func<object>? VolumeListProvider { get; set; }

    /// <summary>兼容托盘/主窗口：每轮只触发一次，且只携带全局指标。</summary>
    public event Action<StatsSnapshot>? Sampled;
    public event Action<StatsSnapshot>? GlobalSampled;
    public event Action<StatsSnapshot>? VolumeSampled;
    public event Action<ulong>? DriverReportedUnmounted;
    public event Action<string>? StatsDegraded;
    public event Action? StatsRecovered;

    private const int DegradeAfterFailRounds = 3;
    private int _failStreak;
    private bool _degraded;

    public void SetKeys(IEnumerable<ulong> deviceKeys)
    {
        lock (_gate) _keys = deviceKeys.Distinct().ToArray();
    }

    public void ForgetKey(ulong deviceKey)
    {
        // 全局引擎基线不因单卷插拔而清零；保留该方法以兼容既有调用方。
    }

    public void Start(IEnumerable<ulong> deviceKeys)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            StopCore();
            _keys = deviceKeys.Distinct().ToArray();
            _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
            _timer = new PeriodicTimer(_period);
            _loop = Task.Run(() => LoopAsync(_timer, _cts.Token));
        }
    }

    private StatusOutput QueryEngineStats()
        => EngineStatsProvider?.Invoke() ?? DriverService.Instance.QueryEngineStats();

    private RbVolumeList QueryVolumes()
    {
        if (VolumeListProvider is null) return DriverService.Instance.QueryVolumes();
        object value = VolumeListProvider();
        if (value is RbVolumeList list) return list;
        throw new InvalidOperationException("卷列表测试接缝必须返回 RbVolumeList");
    }

    private async Task LoopAsync(PeriodicTimer timer, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false))
        {
            int ok = 0;
            string? failReason = null;
            try { PollOnce(); ok = 1; }
            catch (DriverException ex) when (ex.Win32Error == 2)
            {
                foreach (var key in _keys) DriverReportedUnmounted?.Invoke(key);
                failReason = ex.Message;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                LogService.Warn($"统计轮询本轮异常（已继续）：{ex.Message}");
                failReason = ex.Message;
            }

            if (_keys.Length > 0 && ok == 0)
            {
                _failStreak++;
                if (!_degraded && _failStreak >= DegradeAfterFailRounds)
                {
                    _degraded = true;
                    LogService.Warn($"统计连续 {_failStreak} 轮不可用（最后原因：{failReason ?? "未知原因"}）");
                    try { StatsDegraded?.Invoke(failReason ?? "未知原因"); }
                    catch (Exception ex) { LogService.Warn($"统计降级事件处理失败：{ex.Message}"); }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                if (_degraded && ok > 0)
                {
                    _degraded = false;
                    LogService.Info("统计采样已恢复");
                    try { StatsRecovered?.Invoke(); }
                    catch (Exception ex) { LogService.Warn($"统计恢复事件处理失败：{ex.Message}"); }
                }
                _failStreak = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    private StatsSnapshot BuildGlobalSnapshot(StatusOutput s)
    {
        var now = Environment.TickCount64;
        double readMbps = 0, writeMbps = 0;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_last.at > 0 && now > _last.at)
            {
                double dt = (now - _last.at) / 1000.0;
                ulong disk = s.BytesFromDisk >= _last.disk ? s.BytesFromDisk - _last.disk : 0;
                ulong wb = s.WbBytes >= _last.wb ? s.WbBytes - _last.wb : 0;
                readMbps = Math.Max(0, disk / dt / 1048576.0);
                writeMbps = Math.Max(0, wb / dt / 1048576.0);
            }
            _last = (s.BytesFromDisk, s.WbBytes, now);
        }
        ulong totalBytes = s.BytesFromCache + s.BytesFromDisk;
        return new StatsSnapshot
        {
            Scope = StatsScope.EngineGlobal,
            HasMetrics = true,
            DeviceKey = 0,
            EngineStats = s,
            ReadMbps = readMbps,
            WriteMbps = writeMbps,
            HitPct = totalBytes == 0 ? 0 : s.BytesFromCache * 100.0 / totalBytes,
            CacheBytesUsed = s.CacheBytesUsed,
            CacheBytesTotal = s.CacheBytesTotal,
            BytesFromCache = s.BytesFromCache,
            WbBytes = s.WbBytes
        };
    }

    /// <summary>单轮真实入口；测试可通过内部提供器验证查询次数，无需 IOCTL。</summary>
    internal void PollOnce()
    {
        StatusOutput engine = QueryEngineStats();
        RbVolumeList volumes = QueryVolumes();
        engine.Volumes = volumes;
        StatsSnapshot global = BuildGlobalSnapshot(engine);
        InvokeSafely(GlobalSampled, global, "全局统计");
        InvokeSafely(Sampled, global, "兼容统计");

        foreach (ulong key in _keys)
        {
            StatusOutput state = DriverService.Instance.QueryVolumeState(key, volumes);
            var snapshot = new StatsSnapshot
            {
                Scope = StatsScope.VolumeState,
                HasMetrics = false,
                DeviceKey = key,
                Mounted = state.Mounted != 0,
                Paused = state.Paused != 0,
                Mode = state.Mode
            };
            InvokeSafely(VolumeSampled, snapshot, $"卷 0x{key:X}");
        }
    }

    private static void InvokeSafely(Action<StatsSnapshot>? handlers, StatsSnapshot snapshot, string name)
    {
        try { handlers?.Invoke(snapshot); }
        catch (Exception ex) { LogService.Warn($"{name}事件分发失败：{ex.Message}"); }
    }

    public void Stop() { lock (_gate) StopCore(); }

    private void StopCore()
    {
        _cts?.Cancel();
        _timer?.Dispose();
        _timer = null;
        try { _loop?.Wait(500); }
        catch (Exception ex) { LogService.Warn($"轮询线程停止等待异常（继续停止流程）：{ex.Message}"); }
        _loop = null;
        _cts?.Dispose();
        _cts = null;
        _last = default;
        _failStreak = 0;
        _degraded = false;
    }

    public void Dispose() => Stop();
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Principal;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 系统环境辅助：提权检测、盘符 ⇄ 设备键编解码、固定卷枚举、卷标读取、开机启动项。
/// </summary>
public static class SystemService
{
    /// <summary>当前进程是否以管理员运行（IOCTL 需要）。</summary>
    public static bool IsElevated =>
        new WindowsPrincipal(WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent()).IsInRole(WindowsBuiltInRole.Administrator);

    // 真实驱动按盘符识别卷：把盘符 A-Z 编码为稳定 ulong 设备键（替代文档假设的 FNV-GUID）。
    /// <summary>盘符根（如 "C:\"）→ 设备键（盘符 ASCII 值）；无字母返回 0。</summary>
    public static ulong DeviceKeyFromVolumeGuid(string driveOrRoot)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(driveOrRoot)) return 0;
        char c = char.ToUpperInvariant(driveOrRoot.FirstOrDefault(char.IsLetter));
        return c == default ? 0 : (ulong)c;
    }

    /// <summary>设备键 → 盘符（低 16 位）。</summary>
    public static char LetterFromKey(ulong deviceKey) => (char)(ushort)(deviceKey & 0xFFFF);

    /// <summary>枚举固定磁盘卷（盘符根，如 "C:\"）。</summary>
    /* [FIX S7-11] 逐卷 try/catch：DriveInfo.IsReady 对异常卷（热拔瞬间/未就绪/
     * 掉线）可抛 IOException——原裸调经 RefreshDrivesCommand（同步命令无 Guard）
     * 冒泡到 DispatcherUnhandledException = fail-fast 崩溃。与 LabelFromRoot 纪律对齐。 */
    public static string[] EnumerateFixedVolumes()
    {
        var outp = new List<string>();
        DriveInfo[] drives;
        try { drives = DriveInfo.GetDrives(); }
        catch { return Array.Empty<string>(); }
        foreach (var d in drives)
        {
            try
            {
                if (d.DriveType == DriveType.Fixed && d.IsReady) outp.Add(d.Name);
            }
            catch { /* 单卷异常：跳过（热插拔/未就绪），不影响其余卷枚举 */ }
        }
        return outp.ToArray();
    }

    /// <summary>卷标；取不到时返回"本地磁盘"。</summary>
    public static string LabelFromRoot(string root)
    {
        try
        {
            var di = new DriveInfo(root);
            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(di.VolumeLabel) ? di.VolumeLabel : "本地磁盘";
        }
        catch { return "本地磁盘"; }
    }

    /// <summary>开/关"随 Windows 启动"（HKCU ...\Run 键 "RAMBlockCache.Controller"）。</summary>
    public static void SetLaunchOnBoot(bool enable)
    {
        const string keyPath = @"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run";
        const string name = "RAMBlockCache.Controller";
        using var key = Microsoft.Win32.Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(keyPath, writable: true)
                        ?? Microsoft.Win32.Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(keyPath);
        if (enable)
            key.SetValue(name, Environment.ProcessPath ?? "", Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind.String);
        else
            key.DeleteValue(name, throwOnMissingValue: false);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 宿主薄壳模式守卫（240 号文档模块 5）。
    ///
    /// 事实核验（2026-11-14）：本仓库 MainWindow 已是纯 WebView2 壳，
    /// MainViewModel 全仓无实例化点，DriverEventPoller 不会随窗口启动，
    /// 因此文档 ARCH-05 描述的「C# 与 SPA 双端重复轮询」在当前代码里并不成立。
    /// 本类型按 R10（不扩大范围）仅作为设计层守卫落盘并纳入编译验证，
    /// 未接入任何轮询调用链；若后续重新启用原生 ViewModel，可用
    /// ShouldAllowLegacyCSharpPolling 在启动采样前做显式门控。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ThinHostModeGuard
    {
        private static readonly Lazy<ThinHostModeGuard> LazyInstance =
            new Lazy<ThinHostModeGuard>(() => new ThinHostModeGuard());

        public static ThinHostModeGuard Instance => LazyInstance.Value;

        private volatile bool _isWebViewUiReady;

        private ThinHostModeGuard() { }

        public bool IsWebViewUiReady => _isWebViewUiReady;

        /// <summary>WebView2 尚未就绪时，才允许 C# 宿主做最小化健康探测。</summary>
        public bool ShouldAllowLegacyCSharpPolling => !_isWebViewUiReady;

        public event EventHandler<bool>? HostModeChanged;

        public void MarkWebViewUiReady()
        {
            if (_isWebViewUiReady) return;
            _isWebViewUiReady = true;
            HostModeChanged?.Invoke(this, true);
        }

        public void MarkWebViewFallback()
        {
            if (!_isWebViewUiReady) return;
            _isWebViewUiReady = false;
            HostModeChanged?.Invoke(this, false);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>Toast 严重度（决定语义色；颜色之外还有文案，不单靠颜色传意）。</summary>
public enum ToastLevel { Info, Success, Warning, Danger }

/// <summary>单条 Toast 视图项（进出场动画由宿主容器绑定 <see cref="Closing"/> 播放）。</summary>
public sealed class ToastItem : ObservableObject
{
    public string Text { get; }
    public ToastLevel Level { get; }
    public ToastItem(string text, ToastLevel level) { Text = text; Level = level; }

    private bool _closing;
    /// <summary>出场中（宿主据此项播出场动画后移除）。</summary>
    public bool Closing { get => _closing; set => Set(ref _closing, value); }
}

/// <summary>
/// [D5/W1-2] Toast 命令反馈面（02b §B.2/B.3-9：进 180ms ease-out / 出 120ms ease-in，位移 8px）。
/// 纪律：每条 Toast 必须来自真实命令完成事件（禁占位假接线）；UI 线程入队；
/// reduced-motion 降级时位移归零、仍完整显示（信息不丢）。
/// </summary>
public sealed class ToastService
{
    public static readonly ToastService Instance = new();

    /// <summary>当前 Toast 队列（宿主 ItemsControl 绑定；最多 3 条，超出挤最早）。</summary>
    public ObservableCollection<ToastItem> Toasts { get; } = new();

    private ToastService() { }

    /// <summary>入队一条 Toast（任意线程可调；内部 Post 到 UI）。</summary>
    public void Show(string text, ToastLevel level = ToastLevel.Info)
    {
        var app = Application.Current;
        if (app?.Dispatcher is not Dispatcher d) return;
        if (!d.CheckAccess()) { d.BeginInvoke(new Action(() => Show(text, level))); return; }
        Toasts.Add(new ToastItem(text, level));
        /* [FIX 2026-11-13] 旧实现对「挤压最旧项」的处理自相矛盾：先把 item0 标
         * Closing 并起 120ms 出场，紧接着 while 条件（Count>3）仍成立，于是下一
         * 轮看到 Toasts[0].Closing==true 走 else 分支 **立即 RemoveAt(0)** ——
         * 刚启动的出场动画在同一个调用栈里被摘掉，B22 的目标（挤压也走出场）
         * 实际从未发生，且随后 120ms 的 Task 还会去删一个已不存在的项。
         *
         * 现改为软/硬两级：软上限 3 条播 120ms 出场（期间允许短暂 4 条），
         * 只有突发堆积超过 4 条才硬摘，避免 Closing 项无限累积。 */
        while (Toasts.Count > HardLimit)
        {
            Toasts.RemoveAt(0);
        }
        if (Toasts.Count > SoftLimit)
        {
            var evicted = Toasts[0];
            if (!evicted.Closing)
            {
                evicted.Closing = true;
                _ = RemoveAfterExitAsync(evicted);
            }
        }
        var item = Toasts[^1];
        _ = DismissLaterAsync(item);   /* 4s 后自动出场；异常内部兜底不外溢 */
    }

    /// <summary>软上限：3 条同时可见。</summary>
    private const int SoftLimit = 3;

    /// <summary>硬上限：突发时允许短暂 4 条，超过则直接摘除最旧项。</summary>
    private const int HardLimit = 4;

    /// <summary>出场动画结束后摘除（不在 Show 的同一调用栈里立即摘）。</summary>
    private async Task RemoveAfterExitAsync(ToastItem item)
    {
        try
        {
            await Task.Delay(Controls.Motion.Dur120.TimeSpan).ConfigureAwait(true);
            var app = Application.Current;
            if (app?.Dispatcher is Dispatcher d && !d.HasShutdownStarted)
                d.Invoke(() => Toasts.Remove(item));
        }
        catch { /* Toast 装饰路径：任何失败静默 */ }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// [FIX 2026-11-13] 由 <c>async void</c> 改为 <c>async Task</c>：async void 的
    /// 异常无法被调用方观察，只能依赖内部全捕获。改为 Task 后调用点显式丢弃，
    /// 语义仍是即发即忘，但不再依赖 async void 的隐式上下文行为。
    /// </summary>
    private async Task DismissLaterAsync(ToastItem item)
    {
        // [FIX QA5-UI8] 整段异常保护：关机/注销时 Dispatcher 已停摆，第二个 await
        // 之后的 Invoke 抛出会沿 async void 逃逸到 fail-fast 全局处理器 → 退出期
        // 崩溃对话框。异常一律静默吞（Toast 只是装饰，绝不能拖垮退出流程）。
        try
        {
            try { await Task.Delay(4000).ConfigureAwait(true); }
            catch { return; }
            if (!item.Closing) item.Closing = true;   // 宿主播出场动画
            await Task.Delay(Controls.Motion.Dur120.TimeSpan).ConfigureAwait(true);
            var app = Application.Current;
            if (app?.Dispatcher is Dispatcher d && !d.HasShutdownStarted)
                d.Invoke(() => Toasts.Remove(item));
        }
        catch { /* Toast 装饰路径：任何失败静默 */ }
    }

    /// <summary>语义色键（宿主 DataTrigger 用；颜色之外文案承载语义）。</summary>
    public static string BrushKey(ToastLevel level) => level switch
    {
        ToastLevel.Success => "RbcSuccessFg",
        ToastLevel.Warning => "RbcWarningFg",
        ToastLevel.Danger => "RbcDangerFg",
        _ => "RbcInfoFg"
    };

    /// <summary>背景色键（语义低透明底）。</summary>
    public static string BgKey(ToastLevel level) => level switch
    {
        ToastLevel.Success => "RbcSuccessBg",
        ToastLevel.Warning => "RbcWarningBg",
        ToastLevel.Danger => "RbcDangerBg",
        _ => "RbcInfoBg"
    };
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Threading;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// 托盘常驻（U0-1）：纯 Win32 Shell_NotifyIcon（隐藏消息窗口 + 弹出菜单），
/// 不引 WinForms/System.Drawing——规避 UseWindowsForms 对既有文件引入
/// Application/UserControl/Color/Brush 等 CS0104 歧义（零回归纪律，与
/// DriverService 的 P/Invoke 先例一致）。数据源 = 现有 RB_STATS
/// （StatsService 秒级采样节流后查询），不新增协议面。
/// 纪律：菜单不含「暂停」——驱动不支持逐卷暂停（警告-3：误导性 UI）。
/// UI 层：UI。
/// </summary>
public sealed class TrayService : IDisposable
{
    // ---- Win32 常量 ----
    private const uint WM_USER = 0x0400;
    private const int TrayIconMsg = (int)WM_USER + 1;
    private const uint WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK = 0x0203;
    private const uint WM_RBUTTONUP = 0x0205;
    private const uint WM_COMMAND = 0x0111;
    private const uint NIM_ADD = 0, NIM_MODIFY = 1, NIM_DELETE = 2;
    private const uint NIF_MESSAGE = 0x1, NIF_ICON = 0x2, NIF_TIP = 0x4, NIF_INFO = 0x10;
    private const uint TPM_RIGHTBUTTON = 0x0002;
    private const uint MF_STRING = 0x0000;
    private const uint IMAGE_ICON = 1;
    private const uint LR_LOADFROMFILE = 0x0010;
    private const int IDM_OPEN = 1001, IDM_FLUSH = 1002, IDM_EXIT = 1003;
    private static readonly IntPtr HWND_MESSAGE = new(-3);

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private struct NOTIFYICONDATAW
    {
        public int cbSize;
        public IntPtr hWnd;
        public uint uID;
        public uint uFlags;
        public int uCallbackMessage;
        public IntPtr hIcon;
        [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 128)] public string szTip;
        public uint dwState;
        public uint dwStateFlags;
        [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 256)] public string szInfo;
        public uint uTimeoutOrVersion;
        [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 64)] public string szInfoTitle;
        public uint dwInfoFlags;
        public Guid guidItem;
        public IntPtr hBalloonIcon;
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private struct WNDCLASS
    {
        public uint style;
        [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.FunctionPtr)] public WndProcDelegate lpfnWndProc;
        public int cbClsExtra;
        public int cbWndExtra;
        public IntPtr hInstance;
        public IntPtr hIcon;
        public IntPtr hCursor;
        public IntPtr hbrBackground;
        [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string lpszMenuName;
        [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string lpszClassName;
    }

    private delegate IntPtr WndProcDelegate(IntPtr hWnd, uint msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);

    [DllImport("shell32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool Shell_NotifyIconW(uint dwMessage, ref NOTIFYICONDATAW lpData);

    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern ushort RegisterClass(ref WNDCLASS wc);

    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern IntPtr CreateWindowEx(uint exStyle, string className, string windowName, uint style,
        int x, int y, int width, int height, IntPtr parent, IntPtr menu, IntPtr instance, IntPtr param);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    private static extern IntPtr DefWindowProc(IntPtr hWnd, uint msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool DestroyWindow(IntPtr hWnd);

    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern IntPtr LoadImageW(IntPtr instance, string name, uint type, int cx, int cy, uint load);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    private static extern IntPtr CreatePopupMenu();

    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool AppendMenu(IntPtr hMenu, uint flags, IntPtr id, string text);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool TrackPopupMenu(IntPtr hMenu, uint flags, int x, int y, int reserved, IntPtr wnd, IntPtr rect);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool DestroyMenu(IntPtr hMenu);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr hWnd);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool GetCursorPos(out POINT pt);

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct POINT { public int X, Y; }

    /// <summary>打开控制台（双击托盘或菜单）。</summary>
    public event Action? ShowWindowRequested;
    /// <summary>立即回写全部脏数据（全局 FLUSH）。</summary>
    public event Action? FlushRequested;
    /// <summary>退出进程（托盘菜单唯一退出路径）。</summary>
    public event Action? ExitRequested;

    private readonly IntPtr _hwnd;
    private readonly IntPtr _hIcon;
    private readonly WndProcDelegate _proc;   // 防 GC 回收委托
    private readonly string _className = "RAMBlockCacheTrayWindow_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
    private long _lastTick;
    private int _tipInFlight;   // [FIX R6-UI2] tooltip 查询在途闸门（0=空闲）
    private bool _disposed;

    public TrayService()
    {
        _proc = WndProc;
        var wc = new WNDCLASS
        {
            lpfnWndProc = _proc,
            lpszClassName = _className,
            hInstance = Marshal.GetHINSTANCE(typeof(TrayService).Assembly.GetModules()[0]),
        };
        if (RegisterClass(ref wc) == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("RegisterClass failed for tray window");
        _hwnd = CreateWindowEx(0, _className, "", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, HWND_MESSAGE, IntPtr.Zero, wc.hInstance, IntPtr.Zero);
        if (_hwnd == IntPtr.Zero)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("CreateWindowEx(HWND_MESSAGE) failed for tray window");

        string exe = Environment.ProcessPath ?? "";
        _hIcon = LoadImageW(IntPtr.Zero, exe, IMAGE_ICON, 32, 32, LR_LOADFROMFILE);
        if (_hIcon == IntPtr.Zero) _hIcon = LoadIcon(IntPtr.Zero, new IntPtr(32512));   // IDI_APPLICATION

        var nid = NewNid();
        nid.uFlags = NIF_MESSAGE | NIF_ICON | NIF_TIP;
        nid.uCallbackMessage = TrayIconMsg;
        nid.hIcon = _hIcon;
        nid.szTip = "RAMBlockCache（启动中…）";
        if (!Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_ADD, ref nid))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Shell_NotifyIcon(NIM_ADD) failed");

        /* [FIX 警告-1 同款节流] Sampled 每卷每秒 Invoke（N 卷=N 次）→ 1s 闸门合并。
         * [FIX R6-UI2 2026-10-21] QueryStats 同步 IOCTL 移出轮询线程：原实现直接在
         * 轮询线程同步执行，驱动挂死时阻塞轮询循环（StatsDegraded 到不了）——与
         * MainViewModel 特性层刷新同型。现轮询线程只发信号，查询在线程池跑。 */
        StatsService.Instance.Sampled += OnSampledTip;
    }

    /// <summary>[FIX R6-UI2/UI9] 采样事件命名处理器：可退订（Dispose -=）+ 线程池隔离。</summary>
    private void OnSampledTip(Services.StatsSnapshot snap)
    {
        long now = Environment.TickCount64;
        if (now - Interlocked.Read(ref _lastTick) < 1000) return;
        if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _tipInFlight, 1, 0) != 0) return;   // 在途不重叠
        Interlocked.Exchange(ref _lastTick, now);
        _ = System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(() =>
        {
            try
            {
                var s = snap.EngineStats;   // 复用本轮唯一全局样本，避免托盘重复 IOCTL
                // StatusOutput 无 ReadReq 原字段：请求总数 = ReadHits + ReadMisses
                ulong req = s.ReadHits + s.ReadMisses;
                double hit = req > 0 ? s.ReadHits * 100.0 / req : 0;
                string dirty = s.DirtyBytes < 1048576 ? $"{s.DirtyBytes / 1024.0:F0} KB" : $"{s.DirtyBytes / 1048576.0:F0} MB";
                UpdateTooltip($"RAMBlockCache · 命中率 {hit:F0}% · 未落盘 {dirty}");
            }
            catch { UpdateTooltip("RAMBlockCache · 驱动未连接"); }
            finally { Interlocked.Exchange(ref _tipInFlight, 0); }
        });
    }

    private NOTIFYICONDATAW NewNid() => new()
    {
        cbSize = Marshal.SizeOf<NOTIFYICONDATAW>(),
        hWnd = _hwnd,
        uID = 1,
    };

    /// <summary>tooltip 文本（szTip 上限 127 字符，超长截断防越界）。</summary>
    public void UpdateTooltip(string text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) return;
        if (text.Length > 127) text = text[..127];
        var nid = NewNid();
        nid.uFlags = NIF_TIP;
        nid.szTip = text;
        Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_MODIFY, ref nid);
    }

    public void ShowBalloon(string title, string text)
    {
        var nid = NewNid();
        nid.uFlags = NIF_INFO;
        nid.szInfoTitle = title.Length > 63 ? title[..63] : title;
        nid.szInfo = text.Length > 255 ? text[..255] : text;
        nid.dwInfoFlags = 0;   // NIIF_NONE
        Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_MODIFY, ref nid);
    }

    private IntPtr WndProc(IntPtr hWnd, uint msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam)
    {
        if (msg == TrayIconMsg)
        {
            uint ev = (uint)(lParam.ToInt64() & 0xFFFF);
            if (ev == WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK) ShowWindowRequested?.Invoke();
            else if (ev == WM_RBUTTONUP) ShowContextMenu();
            return IntPtr.Zero;
        }
        if (msg == WM_COMMAND)
        {
            int id = (int)(wParam.ToInt64() & 0xFFFF);
            if (id == IDM_OPEN) ShowWindowRequested?.Invoke();
            else if (id == IDM_FLUSH) FlushRequested?.Invoke();
            else if (id == IDM_EXIT) ExitRequested?.Invoke();
            return IntPtr.Zero;
        }
        return DefWindowProc(hWnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
    }

    private void ShowContextMenu()
    {
        IntPtr menu = CreatePopupMenu();
        if (menu == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        AppendMenu(menu, MF_STRING, new IntPtr(IDM_OPEN), "打开控制台");
        AppendMenu(menu, MF_STRING, new IntPtr(IDM_FLUSH), "立即回写");
        AppendMenu(menu, 0x00000800 /*MF_SEPARATOR*/, IntPtr.Zero, "");
        AppendMenu(menu, MF_STRING, new IntPtr(IDM_EXIT), "退出");
        GetCursorPos(out POINT pt);
        // TrackPopupMenu 前必须 SetForegroundWindow，否则菜单不消失（Win32 经典坑）
        SetForegroundWindow(_hwnd);
        TrackPopupMenu(menu, TPM_RIGHTBUTTON, pt.X, pt.Y, 0, _hwnd, IntPtr.Zero);
        DestroyMenu(menu);
    }

    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private static extern IntPtr LoadIcon(IntPtr instance, IntPtr name);

    public void Dispose()
    {
        // [FIX R6-UI9] 退订采样事件：原 Dispose 只删图标不退订——轮询线程若正卡在
        // handler 里，Dispose 后其 NIM_MODIFY 打的是已删除图标（静默失败但脏）。
        try { StatsService.Instance.Sampled -= OnSampledTip; } catch { }
        // 事件为 lambda 无法 -=，故上面用命名方法；见订阅处改造。
        if (_disposed) return;
        _disposed = true;
        var nid = NewNid();
        Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_DELETE, ref nid);
        if (_hwnd != IntPtr.Zero) DestroyWindow(_hwnd);
        GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// [契约 §2 / 体验架构 §5.1] 状态语义单一映射（UiState）。
/// 全部用户可见状态（状态条四段、卷卡徽标、异常卡）必须经本类产出——
/// 禁止在任何 View/ViewModel 里散落写判定逻辑或文案（防"同态多说法"）。
///
/// 六态 + 熔断自愈子态（同红色，不新增色）：
///   NotInstalled / Bound / Ready / AccelerateThrough / AccelerateBack
///   / SafeMode / Panic(含 Settling 子态)
///
/// 判定优先级（唯一，互斥；来源契约 §2.1 九级优先级表）：
///   1 未安装        连接失败且 Win32 ∈ {2,3}
///   2 权限不足      连接失败且 Win32 == 5（归入 NotInstalled 展示，但文案区分）
///   3 协议不匹配    Negotiate 抛 87（横幅阻断写操作）
///   4 熔断          RbStats.PanicActive == 1
///   4a 自愈中       熔断且 PANIC_CLEAR 曾被拒（0xC00000A3）或 Settleing 未确认
///   5 安全模式      RbStats.SafeMode == 1
///   6 加速中·回写   任一卷 Attached=1 且 WriteMode=1
///   7 加速中·直写   任一卷 Attached=1 且 WriteMode=0
///   8 就绪未加速    Bound 卷存在且全部 Attached=0
///   9 已安装未挂栈  连接成功但无 Bound 卷
/// </summary>
public enum UiStateKind
{
    NotInstalled,        // 未检测到驱动（含权限不足子文案）
    AccessDenied,        // 权限不足（NotInstalled 的特化，文案与动作不同）
    ProtocolMismatch,    // 协议不匹配（Win32 87）
    PanicHealing,        // 熔断 · 自愈中（解除不可用）
    PanicSettled,        // 熔断 · 已结算（可解除）
    SafeMode,            // 降级 · 安全模式
    AccelerateBack,      // 加速中 · 回写
    AccelerateThrough,   // 加速中 · 直写
    Ready,               // 就绪未加速（已挂栈）
    Bound                // 已安装未挂栈
}

/// <summary>状态条"风险"段的取值（独立于全局态：脏量>阈值时即使正常态也提示）。</summary>
public enum UiRisk
{
    None,            // 无
    DirtyPending,    // 有未落盘数据
    SafeMode,        // 安全模式
    Panic,           // 熔断中
    LostDirty        // [FIX B2] 已确认丢失（异常退出未能落盘、驱动如实记账；琥珀，不新增色）
}

/// <summary>一个状态的全部用户可见产物（文案/颜色键/主行动/是否阻断写操作）。</summary>
public sealed record UiStateView(
    UiStateKind Kind,
    string Badge,          // 徽标短文案（≤6 字）
    string Sentence,       // 一句话结论
    string PrimaryAction,  // 主行动文案
    string ColorKey,       // 语义色资源键（RbcSuccessFg/RbcWarningFg/RbcDangerFg/RbcInfoFg/RbcNeutralFg）
    bool BlocksWrites)     // 协议不匹配/熔断时禁用写操作
{
    /// <summary>由原始驱动状态判定唯一状态（契约 §2.1 优先级唯一出口）。</summary>
    public static UiStateView Resolve(
        bool connected, bool accessDenied, bool protocolMismatch,
        bool panicActive, bool panicHealing, bool safeMode,
        int boundCount, int attachedCount, bool anyBackMode)
    {
        if (!connected)
            return accessDenied
                ? new UiStateView(UiStateKind.AccessDenied, "无权限",
                    "没有权限访问缓存驱动", "以管理员身份运行", "RbcDangerFg", true)
                : new UiStateView(UiStateKind.NotInstalled, "未安装",
                    "未检测到 RAMBlockCache 驱动", "运行安装向导", "RbcNeutralFg", true);
        if (protocolMismatch)
            return new UiStateView(UiStateKind.ProtocolMismatch, "版本不匹配",
                "驱动与控制台协议版本不一致", "重新安装匹配版本", "RbcDangerFg", true);
        if (panicActive)
            return panicHealing
                ? new UiStateView(UiStateKind.PanicHealing, "熔断 · 自愈中",
                    "正在把未落盘数据写完，暂不可解除", "等待自愈完成", "RbcDangerFg", true)
                : new UiStateView(UiStateKind.PanicSettled, "熔断",
                    "所有读写直接到盘，缓存暂停", "解除熔断", "RbcDangerFg", true);
        if (safeMode)
            return new UiStateView(UiStateKind.SafeMode, "安全模式",
                "上次未正常退出，已强制直写保护数据", "确认数据无误后退出", "RbcWarningFg", false);
        if (attachedCount > 0)
            return anyBackMode
                ? new UiStateView(UiStateKind.AccelerateBack, "已启用 · 回写",
                    "加速已启用 · 回写；异常退出可能丢未落盘数据", "查看未落盘量", "RbcSuccessFg", false)
                : new UiStateView(UiStateKind.AccelerateThrough, "已启用 · 直写",
                    "加速已启用 · 直写；等待全局命中样本", "查看收益", "RbcSuccessFg", false);
        if (boundCount > 0)
            return new UiStateView(UiStateKind.Ready, "就绪",
                "已挂栈，未开启加速", "开启加速", "RbcInfoFg", false);
        return new UiStateView(UiStateKind.Bound, "未挂栈",
            "驱动已就绪，尚未挂到任何卷", "运行首次向导", "RbcInfoFg", false);
    }

    /// <summary>风险段（状态条第 4 段）判定。
    /// [FIX B2] 增 lostDirtyBytes：已确认丢失（既成事实）优先于未落盘超限（预测风险）
    /// 呈现；两者都只到琥珀（RbcWarningFg），不新增色、不制造双红。</summary>
    public static UiRisk ResolveRisk(bool panicActive, bool safeMode, ulong dirtyBytes, ulong thresholdBytes,
                                     ulong lostDirtyBytes = 0, ulong lostThresholdBytes = 0)
        => panicActive ? UiRisk.Panic
         : safeMode ? UiRisk.SafeMode
         : lostDirtyBytes > lostThresholdBytes ? UiRisk.LostDirty
         : dirtyBytes > thresholdBytes ? UiRisk.DirtyPending
         : UiRisk.None;

    /// <summary>语义色键 → 画刷（只允许从这里取色，禁止界面散落 Color 常量）。</summary>
    public static SolidColorBrush ColorForRisk(UiRisk risk) => risk switch
    {
        // [FIX U-06] 回退色收敛到 FallbackPalette 单点（与 Dark.xaml 令牌等值）
        UiRisk.Panic => FindBrush("RbcDangerFg", FallbackPalette.Danger),
        UiRisk.SafeMode => FindBrush("RbcWarningFg", FallbackPalette.Warning),
        UiRisk.DirtyPending => FindBrush("RbcWarningFg", FallbackPalette.Warning),
        // [FIX B2] 已确认丢失同为琥珀（异常事实提示，非系统级危险）
        UiRisk.LostDirty => FindBrush("RbcWarningFg", FallbackPalette.Warning),
        _ => FindBrush("RbcSuccessFg", FallbackPalette.Success)
    };

    private static SolidColorBrush FindBrush(string key, SolidColorBrush fallback)
    {
        try { return (Application.Current.Resources[key] as SolidColorBrush) ?? fallback; }
        catch { return fallback; }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// [FIX U-06] 代码侧回退色单点（D9 / SW-8）：主题资源缺失时的降级路径与正常
/// 路径同色相。取值 = Dark.xaml 令牌值；字段注释逐条锚定令牌键——改令牌值必须
/// 同步此处（注释即契约）。CardHover / StateBar / UiState.ColorForRisk 全部引用
/// 本点，替代原散落回退字面量（三色语义回退 + 两处 Gray + 两处 hover 十六进制色）。
/// internal：仅程序集内使用，不扩大公开面。
/// </summary>
internal static class FallbackPalette
{
    /// <summary>危险语义（锚定令牌 RbcDangerFg #FFF27A72）。</summary>
    public static readonly SolidColorBrush Danger = new(Color.FromRgb(0xF2, 0x7A, 0x72));
    /// <summary>警告语义（锚定令牌 RbcWarningFg #FFF2B84B）。</summary>
    public static readonly SolidColorBrush Warning = new(Color.FromRgb(0xF2, 0xB8, 0x4B));
    /// <summary>成功语义（锚定令牌 RbcSuccessFg #FF63D6A0）。</summary>
    public static readonly SolidColorBrush Success = new(Color.FromRgb(0x63, 0xD6, 0xA0));
    /// <summary>中性语义（锚定令牌 RbcNeutralFg #FFA6A6B0；StateBar 旧 Gray 回退映射于此，A7）。</summary>
    public static readonly SolidColorBrush Neutral = new(Color.FromRgb(0xA6, 0xA6, 0xB0));
    /// <summary>卡片 hover 底色回退（锚定令牌 RbcBgSurfaceHover #FF1E1E24）。</summary>
    public static readonly SolidColorBrush SurfaceHover = new(Color.FromRgb(0x1E, 0x1E, 0x24));
    /// <summary>卡片 hover 描边回退（锚定令牌 RbcBorderStrong #FF3A3A45）。</summary>
    public static readonly SolidColorBrush BorderStrong = new(Color.FromRgb(0x3A, 0x3A, 0x45));

    /// <summary>静态构造统一冻结画刷（跨线程共享 + 零可变状态）。</summary>
    static FallbackPalette()
    {
        Danger.Freeze();
        Warning.Freeze();
        Success.Freeze();
        Neutral.Freeze();
        SurfaceHover.Freeze();
        BorderStrong.Freeze();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

/// <summary>
/// [契约 B-9 用户态实现] 挂载前重复盘符/卷冲突校验。
/// 形状出处：09 移交报告 §4 B-9「挂栈前校验卷 GUID/盘符唯一性；冲突返回明确错误码
/// （前端展示部分已就绪）」。
///
/// **实现边界（为什么是用户态）**：权威校验应在驱动挂栈路径内（拒绝第二个设备挂同
/// 一盘符），协议/驱动侧实现未就绪；本类做**前置可读化**——在挂载 IOCTL 下发前用
/// VOLSTATUS（0x905）拿当前挂载盘符集合，目标盘符已在集合即预拒，把驱动侧的
/// "重复挂载"错误码提前翻译成用户可读原因（不再只看到裸 IOCTL 失败）。
/// 降级语义（契约 DTO 注释口径）：VOLSTATUS 查询失败=校验不可用→**放行**
/// （由驱动继续做权威拒绝，不新增阻塞面）。
/// </summary>
public static class VolumeGuard
{
    /// <summary>校验结果（Ok=false 时 ErrorText 为可读原因；ErrorCode 供日志归因）。</summary>
    public sealed record Result(bool Ok, string? ErrorCode, string? ErrorText)
    {
        /// <summary>校验不可用降级=放行（驱动继续权威拒绝）。</summary>
        public static Result Pass() => new(true, null, null);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 挂载前校验：目标盘符是否已被缓存驱动挂载。
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="driveLetter">待挂载盘符（如 'D'）。</param>
    public static Result CheckMount(char driveLetter)
    {
        try
        {
            var accel = DriverService.Instance.QueryVolumeAccel();
            char up = char.ToUpperInvariant(driveLetter);
            foreach (var v in accel)
            {
                if (char.ToUpperInvariant(v.Letter) == up)
                {
                    return new Result(false, "DuplicateVolume",
                        $"盘符 {up}: 已挂载在缓存驱动上。如为重复挂载，请先卸载该卷再试；"
                        + "若盘符被其他卷设备占用，请先在磁盘管理中调整。");
                }
            }
            return Result.Pass();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // 校验不可用=放行（禁把探测失败升级成挂载阻塞——驱动仍会权威拒绝）
            LogService.Warn($"[B-9] 挂载前盘符校验不可用（放行由驱动权威拒绝）：{ex.Message}");
            return Result.Pass();
        }
    }
}
````

````xml
    <!-- ===== 文字层级（02 §B.1.2；tertiary 仅限 ≥24px 或非信息装饰，见 04b §F-1）===== -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcTextPrimary"    Color="#FFEDEDF2"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcTextSecondary"  Color="#FF9A9AA5"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcTextTertiary"   Color="#FF6B6B76"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcTextDisabled"   Color="#FF4A4A54"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcTextOnAccent"   Color="#FF06222E"/>

    <!-- ===== 强调 / 交互身份（02 §B.1.3；禁止表达状态）===== -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcAccent"         Color="#FF4CC2FF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcAccentHover"    Color="#FF6FD0FF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcAccentActive"   Color="#FF2AA8E8"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcAccentSubtle"   Color="#FF0A2636"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcFocusRing"      Color="#8C4CC2FF"/>   <!-- α.55，实测 min 3.35:1（R-7） -->

    <!-- ===== 语义五色（02 §B.1.4 · 三件套 + 实心；对比度实测见 04b §2.4）===== -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcSuccessFg"      Color="#FF63D6A0"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcSuccessBg"      Color="#FF0E2A20"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcSuccessBorder"  Color="#FF1E5C46"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcSuccessSolid"   Color="#FF1F8F63"/>   <!-- 仅图形；禁白字（F-3） -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcWarningFg"      Color="#FFF2B84B"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcWarningBg"      Color="#FF2E2109"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcWarningBorder"  Color="#FF7A5310"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcDangerFg"       Color="#FFF27A72"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcDangerBg"       Color="#FF331312"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcDangerBorder"   Color="#FF8A2A26"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcDangerSolid"    Color="#FFB3382F"/>   <!-- 原 RbcDangerBtn（A-2） -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcDangerSolidHover" Color="#FFC6453B"/> <!-- 原 RbcDangerBtnHover（A-2） -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcInfoFg"         Color="#FF6FB4F5"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcInfoBg"         Color="#FF0C2138"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcInfoBorder"     Color="#FF1E4E80"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcNeutralFg"      Color="#FFA6A6B0"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcNeutralBg"      Color="#FF1C1C22"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcNeutralBorder"  Color="#FF3A3A45"/>
    <!-- 缓引（无消费方，随消费方同波加回，零死令牌纪律）：
         RbcWarningSolid #B07C18 / RbcInfoSolid #2E6DB4（02 §B.1.4 保留定义） -->

    <!-- ===== 进度轨道 ===== -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcTrackBg"        Color="#FF23232B"/>

    <!-- ===== 图表专用色（02b §A.2 · 随 T2.4 消费方同波落地，I7）=====
         数据系（青蓝）只表达"量"；语义系直引 Rbc*Fg（ok/warn/danger/neutral 不设独立键）；
         禁第三色系；禁语义色画中性趋势、禁青蓝画状态点。 -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcChart1"         Color="#FF4CC2FF"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcChart2"         Color="#FF2E86D6"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcChartGrid"      Color="#FF23232B"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcChartAxisText"  Color="#FF9A9AA5"/>   <!-- R-2：11px 信息文本须 AA -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcChartAreaFill"  Color="#1F4CC2FF"/>   <!-- α12% 单色面积填充 -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcChartTrack"     Color="#FF23232B"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcChartHeat1"     Color="#FF1E3A4D"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcChartHeat2"     Color="#FF2E86D6"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RbcChartHeat3"     Color="#FF4CC2FF"/>
    <!-- [FIX B26] 死令牌 RbcSkeletonHighlight 已删除（零消费方；如需请随消费方一并加回） -->

    <!-- ===== 字体（02 §B.2.1）===== -->
    <FontFamily x:Key="RbcFontUi">Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei UI, Microsoft YaHei</FontFamily>
    <FontFamily x:Key="RbcFontMono">Cascadia Mono, Consolas</FontFamily>

    <!-- ===== 间距 / 圆角 / 布局常量（02 §B.3；space-1..7 为规范令牌，此处列高频资源）===== -->
    <Thickness x:Key="RbcPadCard">16,16</Thickness>
    <Thickness x:Key="RbcPadBtn">12,8</Thickness>
    <!-- [FIX B26] 死令牌 RbcPadSeg 已删除（零消费方；如需请随消费方一并加回） -->
    <Thickness x:Key="RbcPadStatusbar">12,0</Thickness>
    <CornerRadius x:Key="RbcRadiusXs">4</CornerRadius>
    <CornerRadius x:Key="RbcRadiusSm">6</CornerRadius>
    <CornerRadius x:Key="RbcRadiusMd">10</CornerRadius>
    <!-- [FIX B26 纪律兑现] RbcRadiusLg 曾当死令牌删除；V10.6 DialogHost 弹层面板成为真实消费方，随消费方加回（06 令牌五档 lg=12） -->
    <CornerRadius x:Key="RbcRadiusLg">12</CornerRadius>
    <CornerRadius x:Key="RbcRadiusPill">999</CornerRadius>
    <sys:Double x:Key="RbcSidebarWidth">216</sys:Double>
    <sys:Double x:Key="RbcStatusbarHeight">40</sys:Double>
    <!-- [FIX B26] 死令牌 RbcContentPad 已删除（零消费方；如需请随消费方一并加回） -->
    <!-- [FIX B26] 死令牌 RbcGridGap 已删除（零消费方；如需请随消费方一并加回） -->

    <!-- ===== 存量别名（兼容旧 XAML，勿在新代码中使用；值与令牌等值）===== -->
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="BgBrush"     Color="#FF0E0E11"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="CardBrush"   Color="#FF17171C"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="FgBrush"     Color="#FFEDEDF2"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="DimBrush"    Color="#FF9A9AA5"/>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="AccentBrush" Color="#FF4CC2FF"/>

    <!-- ===== 焦点环（02b §B.3-11：2px 外环，键盘焦点始终可见；I2 无淡入）===== -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcFocusRingStyle" TargetType="Control">
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate>
                    <Rectangle Stroke="{StaticResource RbcFocusRing}" StrokeThickness="2"
                               RadiusX="4" RadiusY="4" SnapsToDevicePixels="True" Margin="-2"/>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>

    <!-- ===== 按钮：主 / 次 / 危险 / 幽灵（02 §B.4.1 + 04b §8.2）===== -->
    <!-- 主按钮 = 青色身份（04b §11.1 主理人拍板：对齐 02 规范 #4CC2FF）；
         危险按钮 Focusable=False（契约：不做默认焦点）。 -->
    <Style x:Key="BtnBase" TargetType="Button">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextPrimary}"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="13"/>
        <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="{StaticResource RbcPadBtn}"/>
        <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="32"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
        <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"/>
        <Setter Property="AutomationProperties.Name" Value="{Binding Content, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                    <Border x:Name="bd" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                            BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                            BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                            CornerRadius="{StaticResource RbcRadiusSm}" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}"
                            RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                        <Border.RenderTransform>
                            <TranslateTransform x:Name="press" Y="0"/>
                        </Border.RenderTransform>
                        <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </Border>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                            <!-- 02b 允许特效：按钮按下位移 1px（只动 transform）。
                                 Trigger Setter 无法定向属性元素内的命名 transform（MC4111），
                                 改走 EnterActions/ExitActions + Storyboard.TargetName 动画；
                                 释放在 IsPressed=False 的 ExitActions 回位（非弹跳）。 -->
                            <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <BeginStoryboard>
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="press" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Y"
                                                         To="1" Duration="{x:Static ctl:Motion.Dur90}"/>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </BeginStoryboard>
                            </Trigger.EnterActions>
                            <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                <BeginStoryboard>
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="press" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Y"
                                                         To="0" Duration="{x:Static ctl:Motion.Dur90}"/>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </BeginStoryboard>
                            </Trigger.ExitActions>
                        </Trigger>
                        <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                            <!-- 04b §8.2：禁用态 = 输入底 + 禁用文字色（原因文案由卡外副文本承载） -->
                            <Setter TargetName="bd" Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgInput}"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextDisabled}"/>
                        </Trigger>
                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="BtnPrimary" TargetType="Button" BasedOn="{StaticResource BtnBase}">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcAccent}"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextOnAccent}"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcAccentHover}"/>
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcAccentActive}"/>
            </Trigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="BtnSecondary" TargetType="Button" BasedOn="{StaticResource BtnBase}">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcBorderDefault}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgSurfaceHover}"/>
            </Trigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="BtnDanger" TargetType="Button" BasedOn="{StaticResource BtnBase}">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcDangerSolid}"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
        <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="True"/>
        <Setter Property="IsDefault" Value="False"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcDangerSolidHover}"/>
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FF9E2F27"/>
            </Trigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="BtnGhost" TargetType="Button" BasedOn="{StaticResource BtnBase}">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextSecondary}"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,8"/>
        <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="28"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgInput}"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextPrimary}"/>
            </Trigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>
    <!-- 幽灵派生（ToggleButton 专用：收益页二级明细折叠开关）。
         注意：ToggleButton 不继承 Button，不能 BasedOn BtnBase/BtnGhost，须独立定义。 -->
    <Style x:Key="BtnGhostToggle" TargetType="ToggleButton">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextSecondary}"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,6"/>
        <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
        <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="ToggleButton">
                    <Border x:Name="bd" Background="Transparent" CornerRadius="{StaticResource RbcRadiusSm}"
                            BorderBrush="{StaticResource RbcBorderDefault}" BorderThickness="1"
                            Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                        <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </Border>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                            <Setter TargetName="bd" Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgInput}"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextPrimary}"/>
                        </Trigger>
                        <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                            <Setter TargetName="bd" Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcAccentSubtle}"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextPrimary}"/>
                        </Trigger>
                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    <!-- 加速开关（ToggleButton 药丸：轨道 + 滑块；勾选=青色=已挂载加速；原型 ctl-col 主控件） -->
    <Style x:Key="SwitchToggle" TargetType="ToggleButton">
        <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
        <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{StaticResource RbcFocusRingStyle}"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="ToggleButton">
                    <Grid Width="40" Height="22">
                        <Border x:Name="track" Background="{StaticResource RbcBgInput}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource RbcBorderDefault}"
                                BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="11"/>
                        <Ellipse x:Name="knob" Width="14" Height="14" Fill="{StaticResource RbcTextSecondary}"
                                 HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="5,0,0,0"/>
                    </Grid>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                            <!-- §2.8：开 = RbcSuccessSolid（仅图形用途 F-3）+ knob #FFF -->
                            <Setter TargetName="track" Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcSuccessSolid}"/>
                            <Setter TargetName="track" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcSuccessSolid}"/>
                            <Setter TargetName="knob" Property="Fill" Value="White"/>
                            <Setter TargetName="knob" Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Right"/>
                            <Setter TargetName="knob" Property="Margin" Value="0,0,5,0"/>
                        </Trigger>
                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                            <Setter TargetName="track" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcBorderStrong}"/>
                        </Trigger>
                        <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                            <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.5"/>
                        </Trigger>
                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    <!-- ===== Expander（暗色模板：收益页二级明细；标题行 + Chevron 旋转 180ms，§1/§5 明文） ===== -->
    <Style TargetType="Expander">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextPrimary}"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="Expander">
                    <StackPanel>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="HeaderSite" Cursor="Hand"
                                      IsChecked="{Binding IsExpanded, Mode=TwoWay, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}">
                            <ToggleButton.Template>
                                <ControlTemplate TargetType="ToggleButton">
                                    <Border Background="Transparent" Padding="0,6">
                                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                            <ContentPresenter Content="{Binding Header, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Expander}}"
                                                              VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                            <Path x:Name="chev" Data="M 0 0 L 4 4 L 8 0 Z" Fill="{StaticResource RbcTextSecondary}"
                                                  RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5" Margin="8,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <Path.RenderTransform>
                                                    <RotateTransform/>
                                                </Path.RenderTransform>
                                            </Path>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Border>
                                </ControlTemplate>
                            </ToggleButton.Template>
                        </ToggleButton>
                        <ContentPresenter x:Name="BodySite" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,4,0,0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        <Trigger Property="IsExpanded" Value="True">
                            <Setter TargetName="BodySite" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                            <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <BeginStoryboard>
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="chev"
                                                         Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(RotateTransform.Angle)"
                                                         To="180" Duration="{x:Static ctl:Motion.Dur180}"/>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </BeginStoryboard>
                            </Trigger.EnterActions>
                            <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                <BeginStoryboard>
                                    <Storyboard>
                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="chev"
                                                         Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(RotateTransform.Angle)"
                                                         To="0" Duration="{x:Static ctl:Motion.Dur180}"/>
                                    </Storyboard>
                                </BeginStoryboard>
                            </Trigger.ExitActions>
                        </Trigger>
                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>
    <!-- =====================================================================
         V10.6 增量（06-v106-design-tokens-2026-10-21.md：C-1~C-7 组件 +
         N-1/N-2/N-3 令牌）。纪律：V2 令牌全冻结不动；本区只新增。
         N-1 DurStagger / N-2 ScaleOverlayFrom 落在 Controls/Motion.cs；
         此处补 N-3 度量令牌 + 新组件样式。状态色一律 DataTrigger 绑 VM 字符串键。
         ===================================================================== -->

    <!-- N-3 预设档位语义条宽度（度量常量；间距体系之外，不与 4 的倍数栅格混淆） -->
    <sys:Double x:Key="RbcPresetTierBarWidth">3</sys:Double>

    <!-- C-1 场景预设卡（设置页置顶功能卡） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcPresetCard" TargetType="Border">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgSurface}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcBorder}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{StaticResource RbcRadiusMd}"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="16,16,16,16"/>
    </Style>

    <!-- C-1 三档语义条（3px 左条；06 R-1 裁定：档位标识≠状态表达，安全=info/均衡=accent/性能=warning/自定义=neutral）
         [W1.5 D10] 样式与 DataContext 约定：消费位 Border 须设 DataContext=FeaturesViewModel（PresetTier 在其上） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcPresetTierBar" TargetType="Border">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="{StaticResource RbcPresetTierBarWidth}"/>
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="2"/>
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcNeutralFg}"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding PresetTier}" Value="safe">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcInfoFg}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding PresetTier}" Value="balanced">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcAccent}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding PresetTier}" Value="perf">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningFg}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>

    <!-- C-2 预设来源 chip（16px 轻量角标族：surface 底 + 1px 描边 + 常规中文；与灰底等宽字母的 LinkChip 五重区分） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcSourceChip" TargetType="Border">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgSurface}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcBorder}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{StaticResource RbcRadiusPill}"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,2"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgSurfaceHover}"/>
            </Trigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>

    <!-- C-7 电源 chip（20px 语义状态族：neutral/info/warning 三态 + 未知/读取中=neutral；与许可徽标/反作弊服务名同族）
         [W1.5 D10] 样式与 DataContext 约定：消费位 Border 须设 DataContext=FeaturesViewModel（PowerState 在其上）
         [W1.5 D11] Padding 8,3（06 C-7.3 padding 0 8px）+ 低电量/未知态 ToolTip（C-7.5 明细） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcPowerStateChip" TargetType="Border">
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,3"/>
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{StaticResource RbcRadiusPill}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcNeutralBg}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcNeutralBorder}"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding PowerState}" Value="laptop">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcInfoBg}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcInfoBorder}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding PowerState}" Value="low">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBg}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBorder}"/>
                <Setter Property="ToolTip" Value="回写确认将被禁用"/>
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding PowerState}" Value="unknown">
                <Setter Property="ToolTip" Value="无法检测电源状态，按保守策略处理"/>
            </DataTrigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>

    <!-- C-7 电源 chip 状态点（跟随 PowerState 语义色；DataContext 约定同上） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcPowerStateDot" TargetType="Ellipse">
        <Setter Property="Width" Value="8"/>
        <Setter Property="Height" Value="8"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource RbcNeutralFg}"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding PowerState}" Value="laptop">
                <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource RbcInfoFg}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding PowerState}" Value="low">
                <Setter Property="Fill" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningFg}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>

    <!-- [W1.5 D11] ToolTip 隐式样式（06 C-7.3：Elevated 底 + BorderStrong + radius-sm +
         Raised 阴影 0 1px 2px + 12px secondary + padding 4 8；C-7 chip ToolTip 消费，
         全局浮层提示统一受益） -->
    <Style TargetType="ToolTip">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgElevated}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcBorderStrong}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource RbcTextSecondary}"/>
        <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,4"/>
        <Setter Property="HorizontalOffset" Value="0"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalOffset" Value="4"/>
        <Setter Property="HasDropShadow" Value="True"/>
        <Setter Property="Template">
            <Setter.Value>
                <ControlTemplate TargetType="ToolTip">
                    <Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                            BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                            BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                            CornerRadius="{StaticResource RbcRadiusSm}"
                            Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                        <Border.Effect>
                            <DropShadowEffect BlurRadius="2" ShadowDepth="1" Direction="270" Color="Black" Opacity="0.45"/>
                        </Border.Effect>
                        <ContentPresenter/>
                    </Border>
                </ControlTemplate>
            </Setter.Value>
        </Setter>
    </Style>

    <!-- C-6 许可徽标（20px 语义状态族：五态）
         [W1.5 D10] 样式与 DataContext 约定：消费位 Border 须设 DataContext=FeaturesViewModel（LicenseState 在其上）
         [W1.5 审查 P2#4] Padding 10,3→8,3（与 C-7 电源 chip 同 20px 语义族规格对齐，06 C-6.3） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcLicenseBadge" TargetType="Border">
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,3"/>
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{StaticResource RbcRadiusPill}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcNeutralBg}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcNeutralBorder}"/>
        <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
        <Style.Triggers>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding LicenseState}" Value="expiring">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBg}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBorder}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding LicenseState}" Value="active">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcSuccessBg}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcSuccessBorder}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding LicenseState}" Value="expired">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBg}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBorder}"/>
            </DataTrigger>
        </Style.Triggers>
    </Style>

    <!-- C-4/C-5 对话框内容通用：三段式小节（段间距 16 + 1px 分隔，06 C-4.3） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcDialogSection" TargetType="StackPanel">
        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,16"/>
    </Style>

    <!-- C-4 场景适配双列块（推荐=info 底 / 劝阻=warning 底） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcAdviceInfo" TargetType="Border">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcInfoBg}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcInfoBorder}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{StaticResource RbcRadiusSm}"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,8"/>
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="RbcAdviceWarn" TargetType="Border">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBg}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBorder}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{StaticResource RbcRadiusSm}"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,8"/>
    </Style>

    <!-- C-3 冷热对比卡（收益页 span2 黄金位） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcBenchmarkCard" TargetType="Border">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcBgSurface}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcBorder}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{StaticResource RbcRadiusMd}"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="{StaticResource RbcPadCard}"/>
    </Style>

    <!-- C-3 降级横幅（warning 底小条：能力不可用 + 原因从句） -->
    <Style x:Key="RbcDegradeBanner" TargetType="Border">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBg}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource RbcWarningBorder}"/>
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{StaticResource RbcRadiusSm}"/>
        <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,6"/>
    </Style>
</ResourceDictionary>
````
