##### `src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/ViewModels/DriveItemViewModel.cs`

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Input;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.ViewModels;

/// <summary>
/// 磁盘页/缓存页单卷 ViewModel。实时指标来自 StatsSnapshot（= RbStats 派生），
/// 控制动作走 DriverService（IOCTL）。
/// </summary>
public sealed class DriveItemViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    /// <summary>设备键（盘符 ASCII；驱动侧即按此识别卷）。</summary>
    public ulong DeviceKey { get; }
    /// <summary>盘符显示串（如 "D:"）。</summary>
    public string DriveLetter { get; }
    /// <summary>卷标（读不到为"本地磁盘"）。</summary>
    public string VolumeLabel { get; }

    private bool _mounted;
    /// <summary>是否已挂载（驱动 ATTACH_VOLUME 与采样上报同步）。</summary>
    public bool Mounted
    {
        get => _mounted;
        private set
        {
            if (Set(ref _mounted, value))
            {
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText));
                // [设计对齐] 徽标/结论句/行动随挂载态联动（状态页行卡 + 加速页卷卡共用）
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BadgeText));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BadgeCorner));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusSentence));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusAction));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusActionPage));
                // [空值口径 S16] 未挂载卷指标文本 "—" 联动
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ReadText));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(WriteText));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(HitText));
            }
        }
    }

    // —— 设计对齐（原型 volBadge/volSentence/volAction）：徽标 + 结论先行一句话 + 行内行动 ——

    /// <summary>旁路态（已挂载但未加速：VOLSTATUS 上报旁路，如系统卷/熔断恢复中）。</summary>
    public bool IsBypass => Mounted && (AccelText?.Contains("旁路") ?? false);

    /// <summary>状态徽标短文案（原型六态白名单：未挂载 / 就绪 / 加速 · 直写 / 加速 · 回写）。</summary>
    public string BadgeText => !Mounted ? "未挂载" : IsBypass ? "就绪" : Mode == 1 ? "已启用 · 回写" : "已启用 · 直写";
    /// <summary>徽标角标（回写卷提示未落盘风险；空=无角标；原型带"· "前缀）。</summary>
    public string BadgeCorner => Mounted && !IsBypass && Mode == 1 ? "· 有未落盘数据" : "";
    /// <summary>结论先行的一句话（原型 volSentence 逐条对：系统卷/未挂载/就绪/回写/直写五态）。</summary>
    public string StatusSentence => !Mounted
        ? (IsSystem ? "系统卷默认不加速（安全第一）。" : "未挂载：该卷暂未由缓存加速。")
        : IsBypass ? "已挂载，未开启加速。"
        : Mode == 1 ? "加速已启用 · 回写；异常退出可能丢未落盘数据。" : "加速已启用 · 直写；等待全局命中样本。";
    /// <summary>行内主行动文案（原型 volAction：跟着结论走）。</summary>
    public string StatusAction => !Mounted ? "去加速页" : IsBypass ? "开启加速" : Mode == 1 ? "查看未落盘量" : "查看收益";
    /// <summary>行内主行动目标页。</summary>
    public string StatusActionPage => !Mounted || IsBypass ? "加速" : Mode == 1 ? "应急" : "收益";

    /// <summary>系统卷标识（C:；原型 sys-tag 与 ctl-reason 数据源）。</summary>
    public bool IsSystem { get; }

    /// <summary>读预取窗口当前档位文本（如"16 块（≈64KB）"；预设摘要表实况值消费）。</summary>
    public string ReadAheadMBText
    {
        get
        {
            int idx = _raIndex;
            if (idx < 0 || idx >= ReadAheadMBOptions.Legal.Length) return "—";
            uint mb = ReadAheadMBOptions.Legal[idx];
            return mb == 0 ? "关闭" : $"{mb / 4} 块（≈{mb * 1024 / 1024} MB）";
        }
    }

    /// <summary>加速页微状态行（原型："缓存已启用 · 直写" / "已挂栈 · 未开启加速" / "系统卷默认不加速" / "未挂载"）。</summary>
    public string AccelStateText => !Mounted
        ? (IsSystem ? "系统卷默认不加速" : "未挂载")
        : Mode == 1 ? "加速已启用 · 回写（等待样本）" : "加速已启用 · 直写（等待样本）";

    /// <summary>控制区原因文案（原型 ctl-reason；系统卷未挂载时给出安全第一说明）。</summary>
    public string CtlReason => IsSystem && !Mounted ? "系统卷默认不加速（安全第一）" : "";

    private bool _accelSwitch;
    /// <summary>加速开关（原型 ctl-col 主控件：勾选=挂载加速；切换即下发 ATTACH/DETACH，
    /// 采样回纠以驱动真相为准——OnSample 同步开关位）。系统卷默认不勾选。</summary>
    public bool AccelSwitch
    {
        get => _accelSwitch;
        set
        {
            if (_accelSwitch == value) return;
            _accelSwitch = value;
            RaisePropertyChanged();
            /* [FIX D#12] 系统卷入口早退：原 C: 卡开关可点 → MountAsync 下发 →
             * 驱动确定性拒绝（系统卷硬排除）→ 仅日志，开关位被采样回纠——
             * 用户观感"点了没反应"（与 round3 警告-3 同型误导）。
             * 双保险：VM 早退 + XAML IsEnabled=CanAccel 置灰。 */
            if (IsSystem)
            {
                RaisePropertyChanged();
                LogService.Info($"{DriveLetter}: 系统卷默认不加速（安全第一），开关已阻止");
                return;
            }
            if (value) _ = MountAsync((uint)Math.Min(_quotaBytes, uint.MaxValue));
            else _ = Task.Run(() => { if (!DoUnmount()) { /* [FIX D#9] 异常已在 DoUnmount 内捕并记日志，不会逃逸；结果由采样回纠开关位 */ } });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>[FIX D#12] 系统卷不允许手动加速（驱动侧硬排除，UI 置灰避免误导）。</summary>
    public bool CanAccel => !IsSystem;

    private bool _paused;
    /// <summary>是否已暂停（驱动不支持，当前恒由采样上报覆盖）。</summary>
    public bool Paused { get => _paused; private set { if (Set(ref _paused, value)) RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText)); } }

    /// <summary>状态文本：未挂载 / 已暂停 / 已挂载 · WriteBack|WriteThrough。</summary>
    public string StatusText => !Mounted ? "未挂载"
        : Paused ? "已暂停" : _mode == Rb.ModeWriteBack ? "已挂载 · WriteBack" : "已挂载 · WriteThrough";

    private ulong _quotaBytes;
    /// <summary>配额字节（Slider 经 QuotaMB 映射写入；驱动动态自适应，仅 UI 侧记录）。</summary>
    public ulong QuotaBytes
    {
        get => _quotaBytes;
        set
        {
            if (_quotaBytes == value || value == 0) return;
            var old = _quotaBytes;
            _quotaBytes = value;
            RaisePropertyChanged();
            _ = ApplyQuotaAsync(old);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>配额的 MB 视图（Slider 绑定用，最小 64MB 取整）。</summary>
    public double QuotaMB
    {
        get => _quotaBytes / 1048576.0;
        set => QuotaBytes = (ulong)Math.Max(64, Math.Round(value)) * 1048576UL;
    }

    // [P1-11] 默认直写：与驱动 RB_DEFAULT_WRITEBACK=0 安全默认一致。
    // 旧默认 ModeWriteBack 会让新卷/自动挂载静默走回写（异常退出丢脏）。
    private uint _mode = Rb.ModeWriteThrough;

    /// <summary>[契约 消息#6] 写模式的 UI 桥（SelectedIndex 0=直写 1=回写）。
    /// setter 复用 Mode 的 SET_VOLUME 下发逻辑；采样回读时同步索引。</summary>
    public int ModeIndex
    {
        get => _mode == Rb.ModeWriteBack ? 1 : 0;
        set => Mode = value == 1 ? Rb.ModeWriteBack : Rb.ModeWriteThrough;
    }
    /// <summary>写模式（0=WriteThrough 1=WriteBack；SET_VOLUME 下发，失败仅记日志不改 UI）。</summary>
    public uint Mode
    {
        get => _mode;
        set
        {
            if (_mode == value) return;
            // [W1-3①] 乐观渲染：用户切换下拉立即反映到 StatusText/下拉本身，
            // 不等 IOCTL 回读——旧行为让 ComboBox 在异步期间被采样回纠弹回旧值。
            // 失败不立即回滚：_modeInFlight 保护采样回纠，下一 tick 以驱动真相为准。
            _mode = value;
            RaisePropertyChanged();
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText));
            // [设计对齐] 徽标/结论句/行动随写模式联动
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BadgeText));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BadgeCorner));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusSentence));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusAction));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusActionPage));
            // [W1.5/R2] 回写风险一句话随写模式联动（加速页卷卡写模式 ComboBox 下方）
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(WriteModeHint));
            // [FIX M24] 同步 IOCTL 移出 UI 线程：WPF 标量属性的通知可从后台线程安全触发
            // [FIX R2-U5] 请求入队 + 单消费者串行下放：快速切换不再出现"完成顺序漂移"
            // 覆盖旧值；非 DriverException 异常同样观察记录（原被 async void 吞掉）
            _modeQueue.Enqueue(value);
            Interlocked.Increment(ref _modeInFlight);
            if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _modeDraining, 1, 0) != 0) return;
            Task.Run(() =>
            {
                for (;;)
                {
                    if (_modeQueue.TryDequeue(out var v))
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            DriverService.Instance.SetMode(DeviceKey, v);
                            LogService.Info($"{DriveLetter} 缓存模式 → {(v == Rb.ModeWriteBack ? "WriteBack" : "WriteThrough")}");
                        }
                        catch (DriverException ex) { LogService.Error($"{DriveLetter} 模式切换失败：{ex.Message}"); }
                        catch (Exception ex) { LogService.Error($"{DriveLetter} 模式切换异常：{ex.Message}"); }
                        finally { Interlocked.Decrement(ref _modeInFlight); }
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _modeDraining, 0) == 0) break;
                    if (_modeQueue.IsEmpty) break;                       // 真排空
                    if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _modeDraining, 1, 0) != 0) break;   // 竞态：新消费者接管
                }
            });
        }
    }
    private readonly System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentQueue<uint> _modeQueue = new();
    private int _modeDraining;
    private int _modeInFlight;   // [W1-3①] 未完成的下放计数：>0 时采样回读不得回纠 UI 值

    /// <summary>[W1.5/R2] 写模式一句话风险提示（回写=掉电可能丢未落盘数据；直写=空串）。</summary>
    public string WriteModeHint => _mode == Rb.ModeWriteBack
        ? "回写：写入先标脏即返回、后台落盘；掉电或异常退出可能丢失尚未落盘的数据。"
        : "";

    private double _hitPct;
    /// <summary>读命中率 %（RbStats.ReadHit / ReadReq）。</summary>
    public double HitPct { get => _hitPct; private set => Set(ref _hitPct, value); }
    private double _readMbps;
    /// <summary>读吞吐 MB/s（BytesFromDisk 差值 / 间隔）。</summary>
    public double ReadMbps { get => _readMbps; private set => Set(ref _readMbps, value); }
    private double _writeMbps;
    /// <summary>写吞吐 MB/s（回写模式=脏块后台落盘速率 WbBytes 差值；直写模式恒 0，属预期）。</summary>
    public double WriteMbps { get => _writeMbps; private set => Set(ref _writeMbps, value); }

    /// <summary>当前驱动没有逐卷指标；卷卡缺数据时统一显示“—”。</summary>
    public bool MetricsAvailable { get; private set; }
    public string ReadText => Mounted && MetricsAvailable ? $"{_readMbps:F1}" : "—";
    public string WriteText => Mounted && MetricsAvailable ? $"{_writeMbps:F1}" : "—";
    public string HitText => Mounted && MetricsAvailable ? $"{_hitPct:F1}" : "—";
    private string _usedText = "—";
    /// <summary>"已用 / 总缓存 (MB)" 文本（EffectiveCacheMB 为动态上限）。</summary>
    public string UsedText { get => _usedText; private set => Set(ref _usedText, value); }
    private double _usedPct;
    /// <summary>缓存占用百分比（ProgressBar 绑定）。</summary>
    public double UsedPct { get => _usedPct; private set => Set(ref _usedPct, value); }
    private ulong _cacheUsedBytes;
    /// <summary>已用缓存字节（总览页汇总 CacheText 用）。</summary>
    public ulong CacheUsedBytes { get => _cacheUsedBytes; private set => Set(ref _cacheUsedBytes, value); }

    private string _servedText = "";
    /// <summary>[BUG3] 缓存证据行：本次开机累计从缓存读取的字节（驱动 ReadHitBytes，
    /// 全局开机以来累计）。让"缓存在工作"可见——解决"挂载后看不出有没有加速"。</summary>
    public string ServedText
    {
        get => _servedText;
        private set => Set(ref _servedText, value);
    }

    private ulong _servedBytes;
    /// <summary>[A6] ServedText 的数值源（本次开机累计缓存读取字节；状态页"省下磁盘读"汇总用）。</summary>
    public ulong ServedBytes { get => _servedBytes; private set => Set(ref _servedBytes, value); }

    /// <summary>挂载按钮。</summary>
    public ICommand MountCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>卸载按钮。</summary>
    public ICommand UnmountCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>Flush 按钮（全局 FLUSH）。</summary>
    public ICommand FlushCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>暂停/恢复按钮（驱动不支持，仅 WARN）。</summary>
    public ICommand PauseResumeCommand { get; }

    public DriveItemViewModel(string driveRoot, string driveLetter, string label, ulong defaultQuota,
                              uint readAheadMB = ReadAheadMBOptions.Default)
    {
        DeviceKey = SystemService.DeviceKeyFromVolumeGuid(driveRoot);
        DriveLetter = driveLetter;
        VolumeLabel = label;
        _quotaBytes = defaultQuota;
        // [1:1 原型] 系统卷标识（C: 卡显示"系统卷 · 默认不加速"标签 + ctl-reason；判定同向导：系统根盘符）
        try
        {
            string? sysRoot = Path.GetPathRoot(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.System));
            IsSystem = sysRoot is { Length: > 0 } && char.ToUpperInvariant(sysRoot[0]) == char.ToUpperInvariant(driveLetter[0]);
        }
        catch { IsSystem = char.ToUpperInvariant(driveLetter[0]) == 'C'; }
        // [M1/FR-PF-02] 每卷预读窗口初值（注册表显式值优先，缺省 16=驱动默认档）
        int idx = Array.IndexOf(ReadAheadMBOptions.Legal, readAheadMB);
        _raIndex = idx < 0 ? Array.IndexOf(ReadAheadMBOptions.Legal, ReadAheadMBOptions.Default) : idx;

        MountCommand     = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => MountAsync((uint)Math.Min(_quotaBytes, uint.MaxValue)));
        UnmountCommand   = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => Task.Run(() => DoUnmount()));
        FlushCommand     = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => Task.Run(() =>
        {
            // [FIX 警告-4 2026-10-18] MSG_FLUSH 是全局 Flush（协议消息不带 DeviceKey），
            // 驱动对全部脏块落盘——原日志"{盘符} 已下发 Flush"误导排查定位。
            DriverService.Instance.Flush(DeviceKey);
            LogService.Info($"[全局] 已下发 Flush（驱动对全部卷脏数据落盘；由 {DriveLetter} 卡片触发）");
        }));
        // [FIX 警告-3 2026-10-18] 暂停/恢复：驱动侧 Pause/Resume 仅打 WARN 不实现（不支持），
        // 点击后 UI 闪"已暂停"1 秒被采样打回——误导。按钮置灰（canExecute 恒 false），
        // 待驱动实现 Pause/Resume 后恢复。
        PauseResumeCommand = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => Task.Run(() =>
        {
            if (Paused) { DriverService.Instance.Resume(DeviceKey); Paused = false; }
            else        { DriverService.Instance.Pause(DeviceKey);  Paused = true;  }
        }), can: () => false);

        StatsService.Instance.VolumeSampled += OnSample;
    }

    private int _mountInFlight;
    internal static Func<char, Services.VolumeGuard.Result>? MountPrecheckProvider { get; set; }
    internal static Func<ulong, uint, uint, Task<ulong>>? MountOperationProvider { get; set; }

    /// <summary>挂载显式结果；前置拒绝、异常、超时和重入均返回失败。</summary>
    public async Task<OperationResult> MountAsync(uint quotaBytes, uint mode = Rb.ModeWriteThrough)
    {
        if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _mountInFlight, 1, 0) != 0)
            return OperationResult.Fail("MountInProgress", $"{DriveLetter} 挂载正在进行，请等待当前操作完成");

        try
        {
            var pre = MountPrecheckProvider?.Invoke(DriveLetter[0])
                ?? Services.VolumeGuard.CheckMount(DriveLetter[0]);
            if (!pre.Ok)
            {
                Post(() => Mounted = false);
                string text = $"{DriveLetter} 挂载被前置校验拒绝：{pre.ErrorText}";
                LogService.Error(text);
                return OperationResult.Fail(pre.ErrorCode, text);
            }

            Task<ulong> operation = MountOperationProvider?.Invoke(DeviceKey, quotaBytes, mode)
                ?? Task.Run(() => DriverService.Instance.MountAsync(DeviceKey, quotaBytes, mode));
            ulong applied = await operation.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(35)).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Post(() =>
            {
                Mounted = true;
                Paused = false;
                _mode = mode;
                _quotaBytes = applied;
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(QuotaBytes));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(QuotaMB));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(WriteModeHint));
            });
            LogService.Info($"{DriveLetter} 挂载成功，配额 {applied / 1048576} MB");
            return OperationResult.Ok();
        }
        catch (TimeoutException ex)
        {
            Post(() => Mounted = false);
            string text = $"{DriveLetter} 挂载超时：{ex.Message}";
            LogService.Error(text);
            return OperationResult.Fail("MountTimeout", text);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Post(() => Mounted = false);
            string code = ex is DriverException ? "DriverError" : "MountError";
            string text = $"{DriveLetter} 挂载失败：{ex.Message}";
            LogService.Error(text);
            return OperationResult.Fail(code, text);
        }
        finally
        {
            Interlocked.Exchange(ref _mountInFlight, 0);
        }
    }

    /* [FIX C#11] 返回成败：原 VOID 吞掉 DriverException 仅记日志——UnmountAll 的
     * 遥测与 Toast 无法区分"全部完成"与"部分失败"（失败也上报 UnmountCompleted）。 */
    private bool DoUnmount()
    {
        try
        {
            DriverService.Instance.Unmount(DeviceKey);
            Post(() => { Mounted = false; Paused = false; RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText)); });
            LogService.Info($"{DriveLetter} 已卸载");
            return true;
        }
        catch (DriverException ex) { LogService.Error($"{DriveLetter} 卸载失败：{ex.Message}"); return false; }
    }

    /// <summary>[FIX C#11] 卸载并回报成败（UnmountAll 聚合用；单卷路径仍走命令）。</summary>
    public bool DoUnmountPublic() => DoUnmount();

    private async Task ApplyQuotaAsync(ulong fallback)
    {
        ulong want = _quotaBytes;
        try
        {
            ulong applied = await Task.Run(() => DriverService.Instance.SetQuota(DeviceKey, want)).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Post(() => { _quotaBytes = applied; RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(QuotaBytes)); });
        }
        catch (DriverException ex)
        {
            LogService.Error($"{DriveLetter} 配额下发失败：{ex.Message}，回滚 UI");
            Post(() => { _quotaBytes = fallback; RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(QuotaBytes)); });
        }
    }

    private void OnSample(StatsSnapshot s)
    {
        if (s.DeviceKey != DeviceKey) return;
        Post(() =>
        {
            MetricsAvailable = s.HasMetrics;
            HitPct = 0;
            ReadMbps = 0;
            WriteMbps = 0;
            CacheUsedBytes = 0;
            ServedBytes = 0;
            UsedPct = 0;
            UsedText = "—（暂无逐卷统计）";
            ServedText = "—（无逐卷命中数据）";
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ReadText));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(WriteText));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(HitText));
            // [W1-3①] in-flight 保护：用户已乐观切换但 IOCTL 未完成时，
            // 采样回报的仍是旧模式——跳过回纠，等下一 tick（下放完成后）以真相为准。
            if (Volatile.Read(ref _modeInFlight) == 0 && _mode != s.Mode)
            {
                _mode = s.Mode;
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ModeIndex));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(WriteModeHint));   // [W1.5] 采样回纠同步提示
            }
            if (!s.Mounted && Mounted) { Mounted = false; LogService.Warn($"{DriveLetter} 驱动上报未挂载，UI 已同步"); }
            else if (s.Mounted && !Mounted) Mounted = true;
            // [1:1 原型] 加速开关随驱动真相回纠（外部挂载/卸载/熔断后开关位不漂移）
            if (_accelSwitch != Mounted) { _accelSwitch = Mounted; RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(AccelSwitch)); }
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(AccelStateText));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(CtlReason));
            if (s.Paused != Paused) Paused = s.Paused;
        });
    }

    // ================= 特性层每卷面（FR-PF-02 预读窗口 / FR-BL-06 原因码） =================

    private int _raIndex;   // ReadAheadMBOptions.Legal 下标：0=关 1=8 2=16 3=32 4=64（[回滚 2026-10-24] 扩档撤回）

    /// <summary>每卷预读窗口下拉索引（缓存页绑定；变更即写 Policies\&lt;X&gt;\ReadAheadMB 并 REFRESH）。</summary>
    public int ReadAheadIndex
    {
        get => _raIndex;
        set
        {
            int v = Math.Clamp(value, 0, ReadAheadMBOptions.Legal.Length - 1);
            if (_raIndex == v) return;
            _raIndex = v;
            RaisePropertyChanged();
            // [W1.5/R7] 预读一句话引导随档位联动（加速页卷卡预读 ComboBox 下方）
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ReadAheadHint));
            uint mb = ReadAheadMBOptions.Legal[v];
            try { FeatureConfigService.SetReadAheadMB(DriveLetter[0], mb); }
            catch (Exception ex) { LogService.Error($"{DriveLetter} 预读窗口设置失败：{ex.Message}"); }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>[W1.5/R7] 预读窗口一句话说明（关闭=无预热；开启=顺序读第二遍受益、随机读无益）。</summary>
    public string ReadAheadHint => _raIndex == 0
        ? "预读关闭：顺序读无预热。"
        : "预读开启：顺序读第二遍受益，随机读无益。";

    /// <summary>静默校正下拉初值（握手后注册表配置到达时调用；不写注册表、不发 REFRESH）。</summary>
    public void SyncReadAhead(uint mb)
    {
        int idx = Array.IndexOf(ReadAheadMBOptions.Legal, mb);
        if (idx < 0) idx = Array.IndexOf(ReadAheadMBOptions.Legal, ReadAheadMBOptions.Default);
        if (_raIndex != idx)
        {
            _raIndex = idx;
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ReadAheadIndex));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ReadAheadHint));   // [W1.5] 校正后提示文案同步
        }
    }

    private uint? _accelState;
    private uint _accelReason;

    /// <summary>每卷加速状态文本（FR-BL-06：已加速/旁路 + 原因码；null=驱动未上报该卷）。</summary>
    public string AccelText
    {
        get
        {
            if (_accelState is null) return "—";
            string s = FeatureText.VolStateText(_accelState.Value);
            string r = FeatureText.VolReasonText(_accelReason);
            return r.Length == 0 ? s : $"{s}（{r}）";
        }
    }

    /// <summary>VOLSTATUS 上报刷新（null=驱动离线，该卷状态清空为未知）。</summary>
    public void UpdateAccel(List<VolumeAccel>? vols)    {
        uint? st = null; uint reason = 0;
        if (vols is not null)
        {
            char me = char.ToUpperInvariant(DriveLetter[0]);
            foreach (var v in vols)
                if (char.ToUpperInvariant(v.Letter) == me) { st = v.State; reason = v.Reason; break; }
        }
        if (st != _accelState || reason != _accelReason)
        {
            _accelState = st; _accelReason = reason;
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(AccelText));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(IsBypass));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BadgeText));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BadgeCorner));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusSentence));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusAction));
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusActionPage));
        }
    }

    public void Unsubscribe() => StatsService.Instance.VolumeSampled -= OnSample;
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Input;
using Microsoft.Win32;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;
using PresetTierE = RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services.PresetTier;   // 别名：解 VM 属性 PresetTier 对枚举类型名的遮蔽

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.ViewModels;

/// <summary>
/// V10.6 新功能面 VM（F1 场景预设 / F2 冷热二遍读对比 / F3 回写引导输入 / F4 反作弊检测 / F5 许可试用）。
/// 设计契约：05-v106-requirements §2 + 06-v106-design-tokens §2（组件 C-1~C-7）。
/// 纪律：① 状态键一律字符串（XAML DataTrigger 消费，禁在 VM 造画刷）；② 预设不覆写每卷配额/挂载/排除名单；
/// ③ 全局内存预算协议未确认前不管理（摘要表标注"协议待确认"）；④ F2 执行体未就绪（B-4）前走降级路径，
///    不显示 mock 为真结果；⑤ 写模式翻转必须经 F3 引导（本 VM 通过 WritebackGuideRequested 外交给窗口）。
/// [V10.6 契约接口层] 预设/二遍读/进度/预取门/许可全部改调抽象（B-3/B-4/B-5/B-7/B-8/B-11/B-14），
///    后端交付即解锁、降级保底不变。
/// </summary>
public sealed class FeaturesViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    private readonly MainViewModel _main;
    private readonly IPresetService _preset;
    private readonly PresetApplyAdapter _presetAdapter;
    private readonly IBenchmarkService _bench;
    private readonly IOperationProgress _progress;
    private readonly ILicenseService _license = FeatureRegistry.Get<ILicenseService>();
    private string _benchOpId = "";   // 当前二遍读 opId（B-7 投影过滤 + 取消登记）

    public FeaturesViewModel(MainViewModel main)
    {
        _main = main;
        // [契约接口层] 服务解析（FeatureRegistry 默认接线；后端就绪后 force 替换即解锁）
        _presetAdapter = BuildPresetAdapter();
        // B-3 退化编排携带 VM 适配器注册（真实接线：FIX U-03 纪律）；若真实实现已预注册则优先
        // （Register 无 force：已存在则不覆盖）。注意必须显式类型参数——泛型推断会注册到
        // 具体类名下（DegradedPresetService），Get<IPresetService>() 将永远找不到（15:0x 崩溃根因）。
        FeatureRegistry.Register<IPresetService>(new DegradedPresetService(_presetAdapter));
        _preset = FeatureRegistry.Get<IPresetService>();
        _bench = FeatureRegistry.Get<IBenchmarkService>();
        _progress = FeatureRegistry.Get<IOperationProgress>();
        _progress.Progressed += OnOpProgress;      // B-7：BenchPercent/BenchStageText 的投影源
        _progress.L2Rebuild += OnL2Rebuild;        // B-8：无事件=静默（不造假）

        ApplyPresetCommand = new RelayCommand<string>(t => _ = ApplyPresetAsync(t));
        RestorePresetDefaultCommand = new RelayCommand(() => _ = RestoreDefaultAsync());
        RefreshPowerCommand = new RelayCommand(() => RefreshPower());
        CheckAnticheatCommand = new RelayCommand(() => CheckAnticheat());
        SelectBenchFileCommand = new RelayCommand(SelectBenchFile);
        RunBenchmarkCommand = new RelayCommand(() => _ = RunBenchmarkAsync());
        CancelBenchmarkCommand = new RelayCommand(CancelBenchmark);
        ActivateLicenseCommand = new RelayCommand(() => LicensePlaceholderRequested?.Invoke());
        SystemVolumeOptInCommand = new RelayCommand(() => OptInSystemVolume());   // [B-10]
        // [设计 v2 2026-10-24] 初始态恒 empty（选择文件入口永远可达）：
        // degraded 只承担横幅/口径文字语义，不再当页面状态键——原 degraded 初始态
        // 让冷热对比卡只剩标题行（无选择文件面板），B-4 未就绪期功能不可达。
        // 执行体就绪时无降级横幅；未就绪横幅常显 + 走演示路径（不冒充真结果）。
        BenchState = "empty";
        if (_bench.IsReady) BenchDegraded = false;
        RefreshPower();
        RefreshLicense();
        RefreshTier();
    }

    // ═══════════ 外交事件（窗口订阅：Toast/导航/F3 引导对话框/许可占位框） ═══════════

    /// <summary>请求 Toast（level: info/success/warning/danger）。</summary>
    public event Action<string, string>? ToastRequested;
    /// <summary>F3 引导请求：待翻转回写的卷 + 确认/取消回调（窗口弹 DialogHost；关闭路径统一收敛到取消）。</summary>
    public event Action<List<DriveItemViewModel>, Action, Action>? WritebackGuideRequested;
    /// <summary>[B-10] 系统卷 opt-in 三段式确认请求（窗口弹 DialogHost；确认/取消回调）。</summary>
    public event Action<Action, Action>? SystemVolumeOptInRequested;
    /// <summary>许可激活占位对话框请求（360px 说明框）。</summary>
    public event Action? LicensePlaceholderRequested;

    private void Toast(string text, string level = "info") => ToastRequested?.Invoke(text, level);

    // ═══════════ 命令面（XAML 绑 Features.XXXCommand） ═══════════

    /// <summary>F1 应用预设（参数：safe/balanced/perf；custom 忽略）。</summary>
    public ICommand ApplyPresetCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>F1 恢复默认（轻确认由窗口弹 440 框）。</summary>
    public ICommand RestorePresetDefaultCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>F3 刷新电源状态。</summary>
    public ICommand RefreshPowerCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>F4 重新扫描反作弊服务。</summary>
    public ICommand CheckAnticheatCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>F2 选择对比文件。</summary>
    public ICommand SelectBenchFileCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>F2 开始二遍读对比。</summary>
    public ICommand RunBenchmarkCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>F2 取消对比。</summary>
    public ICommand CancelBenchmarkCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>F5 激活入口（占位说明框）。</summary>
    public ICommand ActivateLicenseCommand { get; }
    /// <summary>[B-10] 系统卷 opt-in 显式开关入口（风险确认记录；协议开关就绪前不实际开启）。</summary>
    public ICommand SystemVolumeOptInCommand { get; }

    // ═══════════ F1 场景预设 ═══════════

    private string _presetTier = "balanced";
    /// <summary>当前档位键（XAML 语义条 DataTrigger：safe/balanced/perf/custom）。</summary>
    public string PresetTier { get => _presetTier; private set => Set(ref _presetTier, value); }

    private string _presetBaseKey = "balanced";
    /// <summary>基础档位（自定义时记录来源，如"自定义（基于：均衡）"）。</summary>
    public string PresetBaseKey { get => _presetBaseKey; private set => Set(ref _presetBaseKey, value); }

    /// <summary>档位显示名（chip/Toast 用）。</summary>
    public string PresetTierName => PresetService.TierName(KeyToTier(PresetTier));

    /// <summary>档位说明（06 C-1.7 文案表原文，随档位切换；设置页预设卡 13px secondary 行）。</summary>
    public string PresetTierDesc => PresetTier switch
    {
        "safe" => "只加速读取，写入直连磁盘；适合存放重要数据的仓库盘",
        "perf" => "读取加速 + 写入先入缓存；适合下载、编译等可重新生成的目录，开启前需确认回写风险",
        "custom" => "当前参数与任一预设不同",
        _ => "读取加速 + 写入直连磁盘；适合大多数日常使用场景（推荐）"
    };

    /// <summary>来源 chip 全文（加速页卷卡用）。</summary>
    public string SourceChipText => PresetTier == "custom"
        ? $"自定义（基于：{PresetService.TierName(KeyToTier(PresetBaseKey))}）"
        : $"当前：{PresetService.TierName(KeyToTier(PresetTier))}";

    /// <summary>摘要表行（参数名 + 当前档位值；custom 行显示实况值）。</summary>
    public ObservableCollection<PresetSummaryRow> PresetSummary { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>差异清单（custom 态 vs 基础档；非 custom 时为空）。</summary>
    public ObservableCollection<string> PresetDiff { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>[W1.5 D16] 差异条可见性（custom 态且存在差异行；06 C-1.4 差异条条件渲染）。</summary>
    public bool HasPresetDiff => PresetDiff.Count > 0;

    /// <summary>[W1.5 D16] 差异条标题（06 C-1.7：「已偏离『{base}』预设：{N} 项不同」）。</summary>
    public string PresetDiffHeaderText
        => $"已偏离『{PresetService.TierName(KeyToTier(PresetBaseKey))}』预设：{PresetDiff.Count} 项不同";

    private bool _presetApplying;
    /// <summary>应用进行中（ComboBox 禁用 + 骨架）。</summary>
    public bool PresetApplying { get => _presetApplying; private set => Set(ref _presetApplying, value); }

    private static PresetTier KeyToTier(string key) => key switch
    {
        "safe" => PresetTierE.Safe,
        "perf" => PresetTierE.Perf,
        "custom" => PresetTierE.Custom,
        _ => PresetTierE.Balanced
    };

    /// <summary>从卷实况 + 全局字段刷新档位推导（采样 tick / 手改受管项后调用）。</summary>
    public void RefreshTier()
    {
        var vols = _main.Drives.Select(d => (d.Mode, d.ReadAheadIndex)).ToList();
        var tier = PresetService.Derive(vols, _main.L2On, MainViewModel.FlushIntervalOptions[_main.FlushIntervalIndex]);
        PresetTier = PresetService.TierKey(tier);
        if (tier == PresetTierE.Custom) PresetBaseKey = "balanced";
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(PresetTierName));
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(PresetTierDesc));
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(SourceChipText));
        RebuildSummary();
        RebuildDiff();
    }

    private void RebuildSummary()
    {
        PresetSummary.Clear();
        var tier = KeyToTier(PresetTier);
        foreach (var p in PresetService.Params)
        {
            string value = tier == PresetTierE.Custom ? ActualValueOf(p) : PresetService.ValueOf(p, tier);
            PresetSummary.Add(new PresetSummaryRow(p.Name, value, p.Note));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>custom 态取实况值（协议待确认项显示「—（协议待确认）」）。</summary>
    private string ActualValueOf(PresetService.ManagedParam p) => ActualValueOf(p.Name);

    /// <summary>按受管参数名取实况值（IPresetService 适配器 ActualValue 委托的实现体）。</summary>
    private string ActualValueOf(string name) => name switch
    {
        "每卷写模式" => _main.Drives.Any(d => d.Mode == 1) ? "混合（有回写卷）" : "直写",
        "读预取总开关" => _main.PrefetchOn ? "开" : "关",
        "每卷预读窗口" => _main.Drives.Count > 0 ? _main.Drives[0].ReadAheadMBText : "—",
        "L2 持久缓存" => _main.L2On ? "开" : "关",
        "回写周期" => _main.FlushIntervalText,
        "进程准入排除" => "内置名单开",
        _ => "—（协议待确认）"
    };

    /// <summary>差异清单（[契约 B-3] 经 IPresetService.GetPresetDiff 取行；非 custom 时为空）。</summary>
    private void RebuildDiff()
    {
        PresetDiff.Clear();
        if (PresetTier != "custom") { NotifyDiff(); return; }
        foreach (var line in _preset.GetPresetDiff()) PresetDiff.Add(line);
        NotifyDiff();
    }

    /// <summary>[W1.5 D16] 差异条派生属性通知（HasPresetDiff/标题行随清单重建联动）。</summary>
    private void NotifyDiff()
    {
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(HasPresetDiff));
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(PresetDiffHeaderText));
    }

    /// <summary>F1 应用预设（交互流：安全/均衡即应用；性能档 → F3 引导 → 确认才应用/取消整档不应用）。</summary>
    public async Task ApplyPresetAsync(string tierKey)
    {
        if (PresetApplying) return;
        var tier = KeyToTier(tierKey);
        if (tier == PresetTierE.Custom) return;

        if (tier == PresetTierE.Perf)
        {
            // 性能档含回写开启：拦截 F3（外交事件；取消 = 整档不应用，原子性 05 F1 验收#3）
            var vols = _main.Drives.Where(d => d.Mounted && d.Mode != 1).ToList();
            if (vols.Count > 0)
            {
                WritebackGuideRequested?.Invoke(vols,
                    () => _ = ApplyCoreAsync(tier, flipWriteback: true),
                    () => Toast($"已取消回写开启，『{PresetService.TierName(tier)}』预设未应用", "warning"));
                return;
            }
        }
        await ApplyCoreAsync(tier, flipWriteback: false);
    }

    /// <summary>B-3 适配器装配（把受管字段读写接到 VM/驱动现状；服务不反向依赖 VM）。</summary>
    private PresetApplyAdapter BuildPresetAdapter() => new()
    {
        SetVolumeWriteMode = mode => { foreach (var d in _main.Drives) d.ModeIndex = mode == 1 ? 1 : 0; },
        SetVolumeReadAhead = idx => { foreach (var d in _main.Drives) d.ReadAheadIndex = idx; },
        SetPrefetchGlobal = on => FeatureConfigService.SetPrefetchGlobal(on),
        SetL2 = on => { if (on) _main.EnableL2Command.Execute(null); else _main.DisableL2Command.Execute(null); },
        SetFlushInterval = idx => _main.FlushIntervalIndex = idx,
        CurrentTier = () => KeyToTier(PresetTier),
        BaselineTier = () => KeyToTier(PresetBaseKey),
        ActualValue = ActualValueOf,
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// 应用核心（[契约 B-3] 经 IPresetService.ApplyPresetAsync 走抽象；快照/回滚/Toast 留在 VM）。
    /// 行为与既有退化方案一致：任一受管字段失败 → 已应用项全部回滚 + 三段式归因 Toast（05 F1 验收#4）。
    /// </summary>
    private async Task ApplyCoreAsync(PresetTierE tier, bool flipWriteback)
    {
        PresetApplying = true;
        // 回滚快照（每卷写模式/预读 + 全局 L2/预取/回写周期）
        var snap = _main.Drives.Select(d => (d.Mode, d.ReadAheadIndex)).ToList();
        bool l2Was = _main.L2On, pfWas = _main.PrefetchOn;
        int flushWas = _main.FlushIntervalIndex;
        // 每卷写模式目标（perf 档仅 F3 确认后翻转；未确认=不覆写——与既有逻辑逐字一致）
        _presetAdapter.WriteMode = tier == PresetTierE.Perf ? (flipWriteback ? 1u : (uint?)null) : 0u;
        try
        {
            var r = await _preset.ApplyPresetAsync(PresetService.TierKey(tier)).ConfigureAwait(true);
            if (r.Ok)
            {
                await Task.Delay(50).ConfigureAwait(true);   // 让 IOCTL 回读落地（特性层统计下一个采样 tick 刷新）
                RefreshTier();
                Toast($"已应用『{PresetService.TierName(tier)}』预设", "success");
            }
            else
            {
                // 已应用项回滚 + 三段式归因 Toast（05 F1 验收#4）
                RestoreSnapshot(snap, l2Was, pfWas, flushWas);
                LogService.Error($"预设应用失败（{r.FailedField ?? "未知字段"}）已回滚：{r.ErrorText}");
                Toast($"预设应用失败：{r.ErrorText}。已应用项已回滚，可重试或手动调整。", "warning");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // 保险：编排本身异常（非字段失败）也回滚，保留现场
            try { RestoreSnapshot(snap, l2Was, pfWas, flushWas); } catch { /* 回滚失败：保留现场，日志已记 */ }
            LogService.Error($"预设应用异常已回滚：{ex.Message}");
            Toast($"预设应用失败：{ex.Message}。已应用项已回滚，可重试或手动调整。", "warning");
        }
        finally
        {
            _presetAdapter.WriteMode = null;
            PresetApplying = false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>回滚快照到受管字段原值（回滚路径不过预取门：撤销既有状态不应被门禁二次拦截）。</summary>
    private void RestoreSnapshot(List<(uint Mode, int ReadAheadIndex)> snap, bool l2Was, bool pfWas, int flushWas)
    {
        try
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _main.Drives.Count && i < snap.Count; i++)
            {
                _main.Drives[i].ModeIndex = (int)snap[i].Mode;
                _main.Drives[i].ReadAheadIndex = snap[i].ReadAheadIndex;
            }
            if (l2Was != _main.L2On) { if (l2Was) _main.EnableL2Command.Execute(null); else _main.DisableL2Command.Execute(null); }
            if (pfWas != _main.PrefetchOn) FeatureConfigService.SetPrefetchGlobal(pfWas, enforceGate: false);
            _main.FlushIntervalIndex = flushWas;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            LogService.Error($"预设回滚失败（保留现场）：{ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>恢复默认（轻确认由窗口弹 440 确认框；确认后回到基础档标称值）。</summary>
    public async Task RestoreDefaultAsync()
    {
        var baseTier = KeyToTier(PresetBaseKey == "custom" ? "balanced" : PresetBaseKey);
        await ApplyCoreAsync(baseTier, flipWriteback: false);
    }
    /// <summary>手改受管字段 → 标自定义（设置页控件/卷卡控件变更时由窗口调用）。</summary>
    public void MarkCustom()
    {
        if (PresetTier != "custom") PresetBaseKey = PresetTier;
        PresetTier = "custom";
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(SourceChipText));
        RebuildSummary();
        RebuildDiff();
    }

    /// <summary>最近一次电源快照（GuidePowerHint 的充电态文案消费；RefreshPower 更新）。</summary>
    private PowerInfo.PowerSnapshot _lastPower = PowerInfo.Unknown;

    /// <summary>刷新电源快照（P/Invoke；启动/设置页进入/F3 对话框打开时调用）。</summary>
    public void RefreshPower()
    {
        var s = PowerInfo.Query();
        _lastPower = s;
        PowerState = PowerInfo.StateKey(s);
        PowerStateLabel = PowerState switch
        {
            "desktop" => "台式机 · 无电池",
            "laptop" => "笔记本 · 电池",
            "low" => "电池电量低",
            _ => "电源状态未知"
        };
        // 百分比数字走等宽段（chip 内 Run 拆分渲染；台式机/未知无数字）
        PowerStatePct = PowerState is "laptop" or "low" && s.ChargePercent >= 0 ? $"{s.ChargePercent}%" : "";
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(PowerStateText));
    }

    private string _guideVolumesText = "";

    /// <summary>F3 对话框电源行态说明（06 C-4.4 四态原文；R2 补欠——原转写改写版废弃）。</summary>
    public string GuidePowerHint { get => _guidePowerHint; private set => Set(ref _guidePowerHint, value); }

    private string _guideBlockReason = "";
    /// <summary>F3 对话框禁用原因（低电量优先于未勾选；空=可确认）。</summary>
    public string GuideBlockReason { get => _guideBlockReason; private set => Set(ref _guideBlockReason, value); }

    private bool _guideAck;
    /// <summary>F3 知情勾选（确认按钮禁用联动）。
    /// [审查 P1 2026-10-23] 勾选变化联动禁用原因（红线 12：禁用必给原因）——
    /// 优先级 C-4.4：低电量 &gt; 未勾选。</summary>
    public bool GuideAck
    {
        get => _guideAck;
        set
        {
            if (Set(ref _guideAck, value)) RefreshGuideBlockReason();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>重算 F3 确认按钮禁用原因（低电量优先于未勾选；勾选且非低电=空串可确认）。</summary>
    private void RefreshGuideBlockReason()
        => GuideBlockReason = PowerState == "low" ? "请接通电源后再开启回写"
            : !GuideAck ? "请先勾选「我已知悉上述风险」" : "";

    /// <summary>对话框打开前准备（刷新电源 + 计算提示/禁用原因 + 重置勾选）。</summary>
    public void PrepareGuide()
    {
        RefreshPower();
        // [R2 补欠 2026-10-23] 06 C-4.4 四态说明原文（含充电态分支与未知态诊断记录）
        GuidePowerHint = PowerState switch
        {
            "desktop" => "台式机没有电池备用，意外断电可能丢失未落盘数据",
            "laptop" => _lastPower.ChargePercent >= 0
                ? $"检测到笔记本电池（当前 {_lastPower.ChargePercent}%，{(_lastPower.OnAC ? "充电中" : "未充电")}）"
                : "检测到笔记本电池",
            "low" => "电池电量低，回写风险升高",
            _ => "无法检测电源状态，按最保守情况评估（等同台式机）"
        };
        if (PowerState == "low") LogService.Warn("F3 引导：检测到低电量，确认按钮将禁用");
        GuideAck = false;                 // setter 可能不触发（原本就 false）——显式重算保证原因即位
        RefreshGuideBlockReason();
    }

    // ═══════════ F4 反作弊检测 ═══════════

    /// <summary>命中反作弊服务显示名（白名单格式）。</summary>
    public ObservableCollection<string> AnticheatMatched { get; } = new();

    private bool _anticheatDetected;
    /// <summary>是否命中（对话框触发条件之一；另一条件=签名态未知按测试签名保守处理）。</summary>
    public bool AnticheatDetected { get => _anticheatDetected; private set => Set(ref _anticheatDetected, value); }

    /// <summary>本次会话已提示过（一次性警示）。</summary>
    public bool AnticheatWarned { get; set; }

    private bool _driverSigUnknown = true;
    private bool _driverTestSigned = true;   // 保守默认：取不到=按测试签名（B-6 有意的安全默认）

    /// <summary>[B-6] 驱动签名态是否已取到（false=取不到 → 保守分支照弹）。</summary>
    public bool DriverSignatureKnown => !_driverSigUnknown;

    /// <summary>[B-6] 驱动是否测试签名（取不到时恒 true=保守；正式签名=false）。</summary>
    public bool DriverTestSigned => _driverTestSigned;

    /// <summary>
    /// [B-6] 反作弊警示是否需要弹出：命中反作弊服务 且 签名态有风险（取不到或测试签名）。
    /// 正式签名版（B-6 就绪后 testSigned=false）→ 零弹窗（静默规格）；当前协议字段未就绪
    /// （QueryDriverSignature 恒 null）→ 恒按测试签名保守处理，行为与既有安全默认一致。
    /// </summary>
    public bool AnticheatWarningNeeded => AnticheatDetected && (_driverSigUnknown || _driverTestSigned);

    /// <summary>反作弊段①文案（服务名列表）。</summary>
    public string AnticheatServicesText => AnticheatMatched.Count == 0
        ? "（未命中）" : string.Join("、", AnticheatMatched);

    /// <summary>扫描本机服务（启动时/手动刷新；命中 + 签名态有风险 → 由窗口决定弹一次性警示）。</summary>
    public void CheckAnticheat()
    {
        var r = AnticheatInfo.Query();
        AnticheatMatched.Clear();
        foreach (var m in r.Matched) AnticheatMatched.Add(m);
        AnticheatDetected = r.Detected;
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(AnticheatServicesText));
        RefreshDriverSignature();
    }

    /// <summary>[B-6] 刷新驱动签名态。协议字段（QueryDriverSignature）优先；
    /// 取不到时走用户态过渡探测（DriverSignatureProbe：signtool 验证本机 sys 文件签名链）——
    /// 正式签名驱动不再被误判为测试签名（消除误弹窗）；过渡探测也不可用时才回保守分支。</summary>
    private void RefreshDriverSignature()
    {
        try
        {
            var sig = DriverService.Instance.QueryDriverSignature();
            if (sig is not null)
            {
                _driverSigUnknown = false;
                _driverTestSigned = sig.TestSigned;
                LogService.Info($"驱动签名态：{(sig.TestSigned ? "测试签名" : "正式签名")}"
                                + (sig.Signer.Length > 0 ? $"（{sig.Signer}）" : ""));
            }
            else
            {
                // 协议字段未就绪 → 用户态过渡探测（B-6 契约的落地前置）
                var probe = DriverSignatureProbe.Query();
                if (probe is not null)
                {
                    _driverSigUnknown = false;
                    _driverTestSigned = probe.TestSigned;
                    LogService.Info($"驱动签名态（用户态过渡探测·{DriverSignatureProbe.SysPath()}）："
                                    + $"{(probe.TestSigned ? "测试签名/无效签名链" : "正式签名")}"
                                    + (probe.Signer.Length > 0 ? $"（{probe.Signer}）" : ""));
                }
                else
                {
                    _driverSigUnknown = true;
                    _driverTestSigned = true;
                    LogService.Info("驱动签名态：协议字段与用户态探测均不可用——按测试签名保守处理");
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // 查询异常等同取不到：保守分支（禁把异常静默成"正式签名"）
            _driverSigUnknown = true;
            _driverTestSigned = true;
            LogService.Warn($"驱动签名态查询异常（按测试签名保守处理）：{ex.Message}");
        }
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(DriverSignatureKnown));
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(DriverTestSigned));
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(AnticheatWarningNeeded));
    }

    private bool _licenseDaysVisible;
    /// <summary>「天」后缀可见性（仅试用中/即将到期显示天数）。</summary>
    public bool LicenseDaysVisible { get => _licenseDaysVisible; private set => Set(ref _licenseDaysVisible, value); }

    /// <summary>刷新许可态（[契约 B-14] 经 ILicenseService.Status 取 DTO。
    /// [用户裁决 2026-10-23 23:42] **试用时间无上限**——本地口径恒 Trial+RemainingDays=-1
    /// （无限期），不再倒计时/转 expiring/expired；大值槽文本型「无限期」。
    /// 读失败按 05 §F5 降级：试用中 + 日志标注）。</summary>
    public void RefreshLicense()
    {
        LicenseStatusInfo st;
        try
        {
            st = _license.Status;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            LogService.Warn($"许可状态读取失败（按试用中处理，不影响使用）：{ex.Message}");
            st = new LicenseStatusInfo(LicenseStates.Trial, "", -1, -1, "", "");
        }
        LicenseState = st.State switch
        {
            LicenseStates.Active => "active",
            LicenseStates.Expired => "expired",
            _ => "trial"   // 试用无上限：不再因天数转 expiring/expired（后端 B-14 交付后由其口径接管）
        };
        LicenseTypeText = st.State == LicenseStates.Active
            ? (string.IsNullOrEmpty(st.LicenseType) ? "正式版" : st.LicenseType)
            : "";
        LicenseDaysRemaining = st.RemainingDays;
        LicenseBigText = LicenseState switch
        {
            "active" => LicenseTypeText,
            "expired" => "—",
            _ => "无限期"   // 试用无上限：大值槽改文本型
        };
        // [W1.5 D15] 五态说明（06 C-6.2 说明/小字两列；读取失败按试用降级的既有口径不变）
        LicenseHeadHint = LicenseState switch
        {
            "active" => "许可信息由安装器写入，与激活渠道保持一致",
            "expired" => "新增加速需激活，已加速卷不受影响",
            "expiring" => "到期后需激活许可",
            "unknown" => "许可状态读取失败（不影响使用）",
            _ => "试用期无时间限制，功能不阻塞"
        };
        LicenseFootText = LicenseState is "trial" or "expiring" ? "试用期内所有功能可正常使用" : "";
        LicenseStateText = LicenseState switch
        {
            "active" => "已激活",
            "expired" => "试用已过期",
            "expiring" => "试用即将到期",
            _ => "试用中 · 无限期"
        };
        // [用户裁决] 试用无上限：无天数可显——「剩余」标签行与「天」后缀不再出现
        LicenseDaysVisible = false;
    }

    public double BenchYMax { get => _benchYMax; private set => Set(ref _benchYMax, value); }

    private bool _benchRunning;
    /// <summary>运行中（取消按钮可见/切换演示态时中止）。</summary>
    public bool BenchRunning { get => _benchRunning; private set => Set(ref _benchRunning, value); }

    private System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource? _benchCts;

    /// <summary>选择文件（OpenFileDialog；确定后 Validating 300ms → FileReady；C: 未挂栈行内拒绝）。</summary>
    private void SelectBenchFile()
    {
        var dlg = new OpenFileDialog { Title = "选择用于对比的文件（建议 512 MB 以上）" };
        if (dlg.ShowDialog() != true) return;
        string path = dlg.FileName;
        // C: 系统卷默认不加速 → 行内拒绝（05 F2：所在卷需已挂栈加速）
        char letter = char.ToUpperInvariant(path[0]);
        var drive = _main.Drives.FirstOrDefault(d => d.DriveLetter.StartsWith(letter.ToString(), StringComparison.Ordinal));
        if (drive is null || !drive.Mounted || drive.IsSystem)
        {
            Toast($"所在卷尚未挂栈加速（{letter}:），请选择已加速数据卷上的文件", "warning");
            return;
        }
        BenchFilePath = path;
        BenchFileInfo = "正在校验文件…";
        BenchState = "validating";
        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            await Task.Delay(300).ConfigureAwait(false);   // Validating→FileReady（06 C-3.4）
            long size = 0;
            try { size = new System.IO.FileInfo(path).Length; } catch { }
            Application.Current?.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                BenchBytesText = Conv.Size((ulong)Math.Max(0, size));
                BenchFileInfo = $"{Conv.Size((ulong)Math.Max(0, size))} · 所在卷已启用加速";
                BenchState = "fileready";
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 开始对比（分支：B-4 执行体就绪=真路径（FlushFileRange 前置 + 执行体 + B-7 总线进度）；
    /// 未就绪=降级演示路径（演示数据 + 横幅常显，标注「演示数据」不冒充真结果）。
    /// </summary>
    private async Task RunBenchmarkAsync()
    {
        if (BenchRunning || BenchState != "fileready") return;
        BenchRunning = true;
        _benchCts = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
        var ct = _benchCts.Token;
        _benchOpId = $"bench-{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        BenchState = "running";
        try
        {
            if (_bench.IsReady) await RunRealBenchmarkAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(true);
            else await RunDemoBenchmarkAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            Toast("已取消，统计口径不受影响", "info");
            BenchState = "fileready";
            BenchPercent = 0;
        }
        catch (RbFeatureException ex)
        {
            // 执行体就绪但调用失败：三段式归因；不用演示数据冒充真结果
            LogService.Error($"二遍读执行失败：{ex.Message}");
            Toast($"对比未能完成：{ex.Message}", "warning");
            BenchState = "fileready";
        }
        finally
        {
            _progress.Complete(_benchOpId);
            _benchOpId = "";
            BenchRunning = false;
            _benchCts?.Dispose();
            _benchCts = null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>降级演示路径（B-4 未就绪期）：硬编码演示值 + 「演示数据」标注 + 降级横幅常显。</summary>
    private async Task RunDemoBenchmarkAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // 第一遍（慢）：1.6s，250ms 节流刷新（R-7 ≤4Hz）
        BenchStageText = "第一遍：磁盘读取中…";
        for (double p = 0; p <= 100; p += 100.0 / 1600 * 250)
        {
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested) throw new OperationCanceledException();
            BenchPercent = Math.Min(100, p);
            await Task.Delay(250, ct).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
        double firstMbps = 312.0;   // 演示值（B-4 就绪前标注降级，不冒充真结果）
        BenchFirstMbps = firstMbps;
        BenchFirstSec = 1.9;
        // 第二遍（快）：0.8s
        BenchStageText = "第二遍：缓存读取中…";
        BenchPercent = 0;
        for (double p = 0; p <= 100; p += 100.0 / 800 * 250)
        {
            if (ct.IsCancellationRequested) throw new OperationCanceledException();
            BenchPercent = Math.Min(100, p);
            await Task.Delay(250, ct).ConfigureAwait(true);
        }
        double secondMbps = 3180.0;
        BenchSecondMbps = secondMbps;
        BenchSecondSec = 0.19;
        BenchHitRateText = "—";   // [C-3] 演示态无命中率测量，不造假
        BenchYMax = Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(firstMbps, secondMbps) / 400.0) * 400.0;   // 同 Y 尺度取整
        BenchSpeedupText = $"{(secondMbps / firstMbps):F1}×";
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BenchTimeSavedPct));
        BenchState = "result";
        Toast("对比完成（演示数据）：第二遍快 10.2×", "success");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// [契约 B-4/B-5] 真路径：FlushFileRange 前置（第一遍冷读前提）→ 执行体测量 →
    /// 进度经 B-7 总线投影（OnOpProgress 过滤 _benchOpId）。取消经总线登记应答（stats 口径不变）。
    /// </summary>
    internal static bool IsDiagnosticBenchmark(string ioMode)
        => ioMode.Contains("driver-offline", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || ioMode.Contains("driver-cold-unverified", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || ioMode.Contains("os-cache-unknown", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private async Task RunRealBenchmarkAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // B-5：缓存范围刷新；不可用=降级横幅（不中断对比，口径声明"第一遍可能不是冷读"）
        var flush = await _bench.FlushFileRangeAsync(BenchFilePath).ConfigureAwait(true);
        if (!flush.Ok)
        {
            BenchDegraded = true;
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BenchDegraded));
            LogService.Warn($"FlushFileRange 不可用：{flush.ErrorText}");
        }
        // B-7：登记可取消 + 进度经总线发布（4Hz 节流由执行体负责）
        _progress.RegisterCancelable(_benchOpId, () => _benchCts?.Cancel());
        var prog = new Progress<BenchPassProgress>(pp =>
        {
            _progress.Publish(new OpProgress(_benchOpId, OpTypes.Benchmark, pp.Percent,
                pp.Pass == BenchPass.First ? "第一遍：磁盘读取中…" : "第二遍：缓存读取中…", pp.Cancelable));
        });
        var r = await _bench.RunColdWarmBenchmarkAsync(BenchFilePath, prog, ct).ConfigureAwait(true);
        BenchFirstMbps = r.FirstMbps;
        BenchFirstSec = r.FirstSec;
        BenchSecondMbps = r.SecondMbps;
        BenchSecondSec = r.SecondSec;
        BenchBytesText = Conv.Size(r.Bytes);
        BenchHitRateText = r.SecondHitRate >= 0 ? $"{r.SecondHitRate * 100:F1}%（字节）" : "—";
        BenchYMax = Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(r.FirstMbps, r.SecondMbps) / 400.0) * 400.0;
        BenchSpeedupText = r.FirstMbps > 0 ? $"{r.SecondMbps / r.FirstMbps:F1}×" : "—";
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BenchTimeSavedPct));
        BenchState = "result";
        bool degraded = IsDiagnosticBenchmark(r.IoMode);
        BenchDegraded = degraded;
        RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BenchDegraded));
        if (degraded)
            Toast($"诊断测量完成（冷态未验证）：第二遍 {BenchSpeedupText}；{r.IoMode}", "warning");
        else
            Toast($"对比完成：第二遍快 {BenchSpeedupText}", "success");
    }

    /// <summary>取消对比（取消后 stats 口径不变——真路径经总线登记，演示路径直接 CTS）。</summary>
    private void CancelBenchmark()
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_benchOpId)) _progress.Cancel(_benchOpId);
        _benchCts?.Cancel();
    }

    /// <summary>[B-7] 总线进度投影：只认当前二遍读 opId，其余操作（预设应用/卸载/L2）由各自消费方处理。</summary>
    private void OnOpProgress(OpProgress p)
    {
        if (p.OpId != _benchOpId) return;
        Application.Current?.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
        {
            BenchPercent = p.Percent;
            BenchStageText = p.StageText;
        });
    }

    private string _l2RebuildText = "";
    /// <summary>[B-8] L2 恢复重建事件文案（无事件=静默空串，不造假；收益/状态页事件条消费）。</summary>
    public string L2RebuildText { get => _l2RebuildText; private set => Set(ref _l2RebuildText, value); }

    /// <summary>[B-8] L2 重建事件消费（挂本基座上；无事件前端静默）。</summary>
    private void OnL2Rebuild(L2RebuildProgress p)
    {
        string txt = p.Phase switch
        {
            "start" => "L2 持久缓存恢复重建中…",
            "progress" => $"L2 重建中：{p.Percent:F0}%",
            "done" => "L2 恢复重建完成",
            _ => ""
        };
        Application.Current?.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
        {
            L2RebuildText = txt;
            if (p.Phase == "done") Toast("L2 持久缓存恢复重建完成", "info");
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// [B-10] 系统卷 opt-in 入口（C: 卡「手动开启」）：外交三段式确认框（窗口弹），
    /// 确认才写 SET_CONFIG + 记录；取消=零副作用。形状出处：v106-iface-handoff-ui §2.3。
    /// </summary>
    private void OptInSystemVolume()
    {
        SystemVolumeOptInRequested?.Invoke(ConfirmSystemVolumeOptIn, CancelSystemVolumeOptIn);
    }

    /// <summary>[B-10] 确认回调：写显式开关 + 确认记录进 UI 日志（诊断包验收项）。</summary>
    private void ConfirmSystemVolumeOptIn()
    {
        try
        {
            FeatureConfigService.SetSystemVolumeCached(true);
            // 风险确认记录（进诊断包——09 §4 B-10 验收"确认记录进诊断包"）
            LogService.Info("[B-10] 用户已确认系统卷纳入缓存：将发生什么=系统盘读请求走缓存；"
                            + "影响与风险=系统卷强制直写（永不回写），掉电无未落盘数据；如何恢复=再次点击关闭或恢复默认");
            Toast("已开启系统卷加速：系统卷强制直写（永不回写），掉电无未落盘风险", "success");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            LogService.Error($"[B-10] 系统卷 opt-in 写入失败：{ex.Message}");
            Toast($"系统卷加速开启失败：{ex.Message}", "warning");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>[B-10] 取消回调：零副作用，仅记录用户选择。</summary>
    private void CancelSystemVolumeOptIn()
        => LogService.Info("[B-10] 用户取消系统卷 opt-in（零副作用）");

    /// <summary>重置到空态（演示态切换时由窗口调用；运行中先中止）。</summary>
    public void ResetBenchmark()
    {
        _benchCts?.Cancel();
        BenchRunning = false;
        BenchPercent = 0;
        BenchState = "empty";   // [设计 v2] degraded 不再是页面状态键（只管横幅语义）
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Input;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.ViewModels;

/// <summary>向导卷条目（数据卷默认勾选；系统卷灰显）。</summary>
public sealed class WizardVolumeItem : ObservableObject
{
    public string DriveLetter { get; }      // 形如 "D:"
    public string Label { get; }
    public string CapacityText { get; }
    public bool IsSystem { get; }
    public ulong DeviceKey { get; }

    private bool _isSelected;
    public bool IsSelected
    {
        get => _isSelected;
        set { if (Set(ref _isSelected, value)) RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(CanSelect)); }
    }
    // 系统卷不可勾选（默认不加速；手动 opt-in 入口在磁盘页，产品口径不变）
    public bool CanSelect => !IsSystem;

    public WizardVolumeItem(string driveLetter, string label, ulong capacityMB, bool isSystem, ulong deviceKey)
    {
        DriveLetter = driveLetter;
        Label = label;
        CapacityText = capacityMB > 0 ? $"{capacityMB / 1024.0:F0} GB" : "容量未知";
        IsSystem = isSystem;
        DeviceKey = deviceKey;
        _isSelected = !isSystem;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// 首跑向导 VM（U0-3 + D6，四步：认知 / 环境自检 / 卷选择 / 完成+效果验证）。
/// 环境自检（UX J1）：驱动连接 / 协议版本 / 卷枚举 / 管理员身份四项实测，
/// 不阻断流程（离线也能选卷，挂载在驱动恢复后生效）。
/// 卷列表来源：SystemService.EnumerateFixedVolumes（OS 权威）+ 驱动 GET_VOLUMES
/// （容量/系统卷标注叠加）；挂载走 DriverService.MountAsync（默认直写，
/// RB_DEFAULT_WRITEBACK=0 纪律）；效果验证 = 目标卷临时文件两遍读，统计
/// ReadReq/ReadHit 增量（第二遍命中率）。驱动离线时验证降级为提示，不阻塞。
/// UI 层：UI。
/// </summary>
public sealed class FirstRunWizardViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    private int _step;
    public int Step
    {
        get => _step;
        set { if (Set(ref _step, value)) { RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ShowStep1)); RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ShowStep2)); RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ShowStep3)); RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ShowStep4)); RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(ShowStep5)); RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(CanNext)); RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(NextText)); } }
    }
    public bool ShowStep1 => Step == 0;
    public bool ShowStep2 => Step == 1;
    public bool ShowStep3 => Step == 2;
    /// <summary>[V10.6 F1 第三入口] 第四步：场景预设选择（选卷后并入，支撑 3 分钟首配）。</summary>
    public bool ShowStep4 => Step == 3;
    /// <summary>第五步：完成 + 效果验证（原第四步）。</summary>
    public bool ShowStep5 => Step == 4;

    public ObservableCollection<WizardVolumeItem> Volumes { get; } = new();

    // —— D6 环境自检（UX J1；四项实测，不阻断）——

    /// <summary>单项自检结果（Ok=通过/警告/失败三态由 Detail 文案承载，不单靠颜色）。</summary>
    public sealed class EnvCheckItem : ObservableObject
    {
        public string Name { get; }
        public bool Ok { get; }
        public string Detail { get; }
        public EnvCheckItem(string name, bool ok, string detail) { Name = name; Ok = ok; Detail = detail; }
    }

    public ObservableCollection<EnvCheckItem> EnvChecks { get; } = new();

    private string _envSummary = "";
    /// <summary>自检总结人话（进入第二步时实测填充）。</summary>
    public string EnvSummary { get => _envSummary; private set => Set(ref _envSummary, value); }

    private bool _envBusy;
    public bool EnvBusy { get => _envBusy; set => Set(ref _envBusy, value); }

    private bool _autoMountAfterBoot = true;
    /// <summary>以后开机自动挂载这些卷（写 settings AutoStartWithVolumes）。</summary>
    public bool AutoMountAfterBoot { get => _autoMountAfterBoot; set => Set(ref _autoMountAfterBoot, value); }

    private string _effectText = "正在验证…";
    public string EffectText { get => _effectText; private set => Set(ref _effectText, value); }

    private string _summaryText = "";
    public string SummaryText { get => _summaryText; private set => Set(ref _summaryText, value); }

    private bool _busy;
    public bool Busy { get => _busy; set { if (Set(ref _busy, value)) RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(CanNext)); } }

    public bool CanNext => !Busy && !EnvBusy;
    public string NextText => Step == 4 ? "完成" : "下一步";

    public ICommand NextCommand { get; }
    public ICommand BackCommand { get; }

    /// <summary>[FIX C#6] 跳过向导（持久化 FirstRunDone 后关闭，下次不再弹出）。</summary>
    public ICommand SkipCommand { get; }

    /// <summary>向导完成（第四步"完成"按钮）——由窗口订阅后持久化 FirstRunDone 并关闭。</summary>
    public event Action? Completed;

    public FirstRunWizardViewModel()
    {
        /* [FIX 警-4 2026-10-19] 改用 AsyncRelayCommand：同步 RelayCommand 无内置
         * busy 且不随 PropertyChanged 主动刷新 CanExecute——双击"下一步"可并发
         * 两个 MountSelectedAsync（同卷并发 ATTACH IOCTL，0xA 事故放大面同型）。 */
        NextCommand = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => AdvanceAsync(), () => CanNext);
        /* [FIX C#5] 完成页（Step==3）不可回退：原可 3→2 回退到选卷页再"下一步"，
         * 对已挂载卷重复 ATTACH（0xA 并发挂载事故同型面）。幂等另由
         * MountSelectedAsync 的 _mountedKeys 集合保证（双保险）。 */
        BackCommand = new RelayCommand(() => Step--, () => Step > 0 && Step < 4 && !Busy);
        SkipCommand = new RelayCommand(() =>
        {
            /* [FIX C#6] 跳过向导：原无显式跳过路径——用户关 X 后 FirstRunDone
             * 不落盘，下次启动向导再弹，无法表达"现在不配"。 */
            var st = SettingsService.Load();
            st.FirstRunDone = true;                 /* 与 AdvanceAsync Step==3 同款持久化 */
            SettingsService.Save(st);
            LogService.Info("用户跳过首跑向导（FirstRunDone 已持久化，下次不再弹出）");
            Completed?.Invoke();
        });
        /* [FIX C#7] 卷枚举+驱动查询移出 UI 线程（详见 LoadVolumesAsync）：原构造期
         * 同步跑 QueryVolumes（IOCTL），驱动挂死（30s 阻塞）即冻结向导窗口。 */
        _ = LoadVolumesAsync();
    }

    /// <summary>D6 环境自检（后台线程跑握手；UI 线程汇总）。离线不报错，给"安装后可用的卷"降级结论。</summary>
    public async void RunEnvChecks()
    {
        if (EnvBusy) return;
        EnvBusy = true;
        EnvChecks.Clear();
        EnvSummary = "正在检查…";
        string driverVer = "unknown";
        bool connOk = false, protoOk = false;
        string connDetail = "驱动未连接（未装/未启动/未以管理员运行）", protoDetail = "无法校验";
        await Task.Run(() =>
        {
            try
            {
                var (proto, build) = DriverService.Instance.Negotiate();
                driverVer = DriverService.Instance.DriverVersion;
                connOk = true;
                protoOk = true;
                connDetail = $"已连接 · {driverVer}";
                protoDetail = $"Protocol {proto}（控制台期望一致）";
            }
            catch (DriverException ex)
            {
                connDetail = ex.Win32Error == 87 ? "协议不匹配，拒绝连接" : $"驱动未连接：{ex.Message}";
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { connDetail = $"检查失败：{ex.Message}"; }
        }).ConfigureAwait(true);
        bool elev = SystemService.IsElevated;
        Post(() =>
        {
            EnvChecks.Add(new EnvCheckItem("驱动连接", connOk, connDetail));
            EnvChecks.Add(new EnvCheckItem("协议版本", protoOk, protoDetail));
            EnvChecks.Add(new EnvCheckItem("固定卷枚举", Volumes.Count > 0, Volumes.Count > 0 ? $"枚举到 {Volumes.Count} 个固定卷" : "未枚举到固定卷"));
            EnvChecks.Add(new EnvCheckItem("管理员身份", elev, elev ? "已提权（IOCTL 可用）" : "未提权：挂载/配置会被拒绝，请右键以管理员身份运行"));
            EnvSummary = connOk && elev ? "环境就绪，可以选卷加速" : connOk ? "未提权：先以管理员身份重启本程序" : "驱动未连接：仍可选卷，驱动恢复后生效";
            EnvBusy = false;
        });
    }

    /* [FIX C#7] 异步装载：IOCTL/枚举全部在线程池执行，仅集合填充回 UI 线程。
     * 原构造期同步 LoadVolumes 在驱动挂死（IOCTL 30s）时冻结向导窗口——
     * 用户第一印象面卡死且无任何提示（ RD.5 类静默故障）。 */
    private async Task LoadVolumesAsync()
    {
        Services.RbVolumeList? drv = null;
        string[] roots = Array.Empty<string>();
        try { drv = await Task.Run(() => DriverService.Instance.QueryVolumes()).ConfigureAwait(true); }
        catch { /* 离线：只用 OS 枚举 */ }
        try { roots = await Task.Run(() => SystemService.EnumerateFixedVolumes()).ConfigureAwait(true); }
        catch { /* 枚举失败：空列表，选卷页显示空态 */ }
        FillVolumes(drv, roots);
    }

    /* [FIX C#7] 填充（UI 线程调用）：驱动卷信息（容量/系统卷/已挂载态）——
     * 离线时退化为纯 OS 枚举。注意：DriverService.QueryVolumes 返回 Services
     * 命名空间的 internal 镜像（Models 下另有同名 DTO，勿混用）。 */
    private void FillVolumes(Services.RbVolumeList? drv, string[] roots)
    {
        foreach (var root in roots)
        {
            char letter = root.Length > 0 ? char.ToUpperInvariant(root[0]) : '?';
            string drv2 = letter + ":";
            if (Volumes.Any(v => v.DriveLetter == drv2)) continue;
            string label = SystemService.LabelFromRoot(root);
            ulong capMB = 0;
            bool isSystem = false;
            if (drv is Services.RbVolumeList list)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < list.Count && i < 8; i++)
                {
                    if (char.ToUpperInvariant((char)list.Items[i].Letter) == letter)
                    {
                        capMB = list.Items[i].CapacityMB;
                        isSystem = list.Items[i].IsSystem != 0;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!isSystem)
            {
                try
                {
                    string? sysRoot = Path.GetPathRoot(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.System));
                    isSystem = sysRoot is { Length: > 0 } && char.ToUpperInvariant(sysRoot[0]) == letter;
                }
                catch { isSystem = letter == 'C'; }
            }
            Volumes.Add(new WizardVolumeItem(drv2, label, capMB, isSystem,
                SystemService.DeviceKeyFromVolumeGuid(root)));
        }
    }

    private async Task AdvanceAsync()
    {
        if (Step == 0) { Step = 1; RunEnvChecks(); return; }        // 进入环境自检
        if (Step == 1) { Step = 2; return; }                        // 自检 → 选卷（不阻断）
        if (Step == 2) { await MountSelectedAsync(); Step = 3; return; }   // 选卷 → 选预设
        if (Step == 3) { Step = 4; return; }                        // 选预设 → 完成（应用由窗口在关闭后执行，perf 走 F3 引导）
        // Step == 4：完成——持久化开机自动挂载意愿 + 预设选择（勾选状态即设置）
        var s = SettingsService.Load();
        s.AutoStartWithVolumes = AutoMountAfterBoot;
        s.WizardPreset = WizardPresetKey;
        SettingsService.Save(s);
        Completed?.Invoke();
    }

    // —— [V10.6 F1] 第四步：场景预设选择（三档卡片单选；值写入 settings.WizardPreset，
    //    窗口在向导关闭后经 Features.ApplyPresetAsync 应用；perf 档自动走 F3 回写引导） ——

    private string _wizardPresetKey = "balanced";
    /// <summary>向导内选择的预设档位键（safe/balanced/perf；默认均衡）。</summary>
    public string WizardPresetKey { get => _wizardPresetKey; set => Set(ref _wizardPresetKey, value); }

    /// <summary>三档预设展示（卡片：语义条 + 档位名 + 一句人话；零术语）。</summary>
    public sealed record WizardPresetOption(string Key, string Name, string Desc);

    /// <summary>预设选项集（与 PresetService 三档同口径；文案守 I-08 白名单）。</summary>
    public WizardPresetOption[] PresetOptions { get; } =
    {
        new("safe",     "安全 · 只读", "只读加速，写入直接落盘，最稳"),
        new("balanced", "均衡 · 读写", "读加速 + 直写，推荐大多数数据盘"),
        new("perf",     "性能 · 回写", "读加速 + 回写，需确认掉电风险"),
    };

    private readonly HashSet<ulong> _mountedKeys = new();   /* [FIX C#5] 已挂载卷：幂等跳过 */

    /// <summary>挂载勾选卷（默认直写；与 RB_DEFAULT_WRITEBACK=0 纪律一致），完成后跑效果验证。</summary>
    private async Task MountSelectedAsync()
    {
        Busy = true;
        EffectText = "正在验证…";
        var targets = Volumes.Where(v => v.IsSelected && !v.IsSystem && !_mountedKeys.Contains(v.DeviceKey)).ToList();
        int ok = 0;
        foreach (var v in targets)
        {
            try
            {
                await DriverService.Instance.MountAsync(v.DeviceKey, 512u * 1048576, 0).ConfigureAwait(true);
                _mountedKeys.Add(v.DeviceKey);   /* [FIX C#5] 记入：回退后再进不重复挂载 */
                ok++;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                LogService.Warn($"向导挂载 {v.DriveLetter} 失败：{ex.Message}");
            }
        }
        SummaryText = targets.Count == 0
            ? "未选择数据卷——可随时在磁盘页逐卷挂载"
            : $"已加速 {ok}/{targets.Count} 个数据卷";
        await VerifyEffectAsync(targets.FirstOrDefault(v => !v.IsSystem));
        Busy = false;
    }

    /// <summary>3 秒效果验证：目标卷写临时文件→第一遍读（miss）→第二遍读（hit），
    /// 统计第二遍 ReadReq/ReadHit 增量作为命中率。驱动离线/无目标卷时降级提示。</summary>
    private async Task VerifyEffectAsync(WizardVolumeItem? target)
    {
        if (target is null) { EffectText = "未选择卷，跳过效果验证"; return; }
        string? tmp = null;
        try
        {
            (ulong req0, ulong hit0) = await Task.Run(() => ReadStats()).ConfigureAwait(true);   /* [FIX C#7] */
            tmp = Path.Combine(target.DriveLetter + "\\", $"rbc-wizard-{Guid.NewGuid():N}.tmp");
            await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(tmp, new byte[4 * 1024 * 1024]).ConfigureAwait(true);
            _ = File.ReadAllBytes(tmp);                       // 第一遍：预期 miss（刚写的内容按直写已落盘）
            (ulong req1, ulong hit1) = await Task.Run(() => ReadStats()).ConfigureAwait(true);   /* [FIX C#7] */
            _ = File.ReadAllBytes(tmp);                       // 第二遍：预期 hit（缓存内）
            (ulong req2, ulong hit2) = await Task.Run(() => ReadStats()).ConfigureAwait(true);   /* [FIX C#7] */
            ulong dReq = req2 - req1, dHit = hit2 - hit1;
            EffectText = dReq > 0
                ? $"第二遍读命中率 {dHit * 100.0 / dReq:F0}%（{dHit}/{dReq} 次读来自内存）——缓存正在工作"
                : "第二遍读未产生新请求（系统可能已自行缓存）——属正常现象，稍后可在控制台查看持续命中率";
            _ = (req0, hit0);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            EffectText = $"效果验证跳过（{ex.Message}）——稍后可在控制台磁盘页查看命中率";
            LogService.Warn($"向导效果验证降级：{ex.Message}");
        }
        finally
        {
            if (tmp is not null) { try { File.Delete(tmp); } catch { /* 临时文件清理失败不阻塞 */ } }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>全局统计读数（StatusOutput 无 ReadReq 原字段：请求总数=ReadHits+ReadMisses）。</summary>
    private static (ulong req, ulong hit) ReadStats()
    {
        var s = DriverService.Instance.QueryStats(0);
        return (s.ReadHits + s.ReadMisses, s.ReadHits);
    }
}
````

````csharp
        // [FIX 回归A 2026-10-18 复审] 采集放在命令 lambda 的同步段（UI 线程，Execute
````
