````ts
/**
 * 本机桥接服务（Hono + @hono/node-server）
 *
 * 职责边界：
 *  - 唯一被允许触碰 \\.\RAMBlockCache 的 Node 侧进程。
 *  - 只监听 127.0.0.1，不绑定 0.0.0.0；控制面不外泄。
 *  - 与前端 src/ 无运行时 import 关系，跨进程通信，天然无循环依赖；唯一例外是
 *    代码生成物 rb-config.generated.ts（纯类型/常量，由 src/ctl/rb_proto.h 生成）。
 *
 * [FIX 2026-10-31] 原生插件已接入（路径 B：cargo + napi-rs，见 bridge/native）。
 *  - 插件加载与设备打开分离：/health 用 native / deviceOpen 两个字段如实区分
 *    "插件缺失"与"设备不可达"，不再混为一谈。
 *  - 设备在每次 /rpc 前惰性打开（S7-14 自愈语义：设备消失后恢复即自动重开）。
 *  - 读命令（1/4/7/9/10/14）结构化解码返回 JSON；写命令（2/6/8/13）params
 *    编码全部就绪（SET_CONFIG 全量 156B / SET_VOLUME / ATTACH / INVALIDATE_RANGE）；
 *    驱动侧写命令实测留待隔离 TestMode 机（attach 红线，43 号 §8.2）。
 */

import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { startLogSink } from './log-sink.ts';   /* [FEAT-LOGQ] 驱动日志落盘 */
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';   /* [FEAT-LOGUI] 日志目录访问 */
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import path from 'node:path';
import { serve } from '@hono/node-server';
import { serveStatic } from '@hono/node-server/serve-static';
import { Hono, type Context } from 'hono';
import { pino } from 'pino';
import { z } from 'zod';
// [注意] Node 类型剥离（type-stripping）不解析无扩展名相对导入，必须写 .ts；
// 若未来把 bridge/ 纳入 tsc，需在 tsconfig 开 allowImportingTsExtensions。
import {
  decodeConfig,
  decodeEventList,
  decodeLogList,
  decodeStats,
  decodeVersion,
  decodeVolumes,
} from './proto-decode.ts';
import {
  RB_CONFIG_FIELDS,
  RB_CONFIG_SIZE,
} from '../../src/protocol/rb-config.generated.ts';

const log = pino({ name: 'rb-bridge' });

// 本包是 "type": "module"，ESM 作用域没有全局 require；
// [FIX 2026-10-31] 原先裸 require 的 ReferenceError 会被 catch 吞掉，
// 会导致插件构建成功后仍永远 503。显式 createRequire 才能真正加载 .node。
const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);

// [88 B-3 2026-11-07] default 5199; env override is probe-only (isolated cwd/port test).
const PORT = Number(process.env.RBC_BRIDGE_PORT ?? 5199);
const HOST = '127.0.0.1';
/** [FEAT-LOGUI] 驱动日志落盘目录（log-sink 与 /logs 路由共用同一路径） */
const LOG_DIR = path.join(process.env.ProgramData ?? 'C:/ProgramData', 'RAMBlockCache', 'logs');

/**
 * L2 容器容量上限。必须与驱动 `RB2_L2_MAX_GB`（src/driver/rbL2.c:59 = 128）、
 * WPF `MainViewModel.L2SizeGB`（clamp 1–128）、Web `SettingsPage.L2_MAX_GB` 四端一致。
 * 驱动对越界值是静默截断，所以服务端也必须在这里拒绝，而不是放行后靠驱动兜。
 */
const L2_MAX_GB = 128;

/**
 * 原生插件契约（见 bridge/native/README.md）。
 * 通过 createRequire 显式加载，避免打包工具把 .node 文件打进 bundle。
 */
/**
 * 原生插件契约（见 bridge/native/README.md）。
 * napi-derive 默认把 rb_open/rb_request/rb_close 导出为驼峰 rbOpen/rbRequest/rbClose。
 * 通过 createRequire 显式加载，避免打包工具把 .node 文件打进 bundle。
 */
interface NativeBridge {
  rbOpen(): void;
  rbRequest(type: number, payload: Buffer | null): Buffer;
  rbClose(): void;
  /** [FEAT-LOGQ] 分页日志（插件版本过旧时可能不存在） */
  rbLogPage?(fromSeq: number, maxCount: number): Buffer;
  rbBootCfg?(buf: Buffer): Buffer;
}

let native: NativeBridge | null = null;
let pluginError: string | null = null;
let deviceError: string | null = null;

function messageOf(e: unknown): string {
  return e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
}

try {
  // 插件产物缺失时进入 catch（构建方式见 bridge/native/README.md）。
  // 注意：createRequire 以本文件（bridge/server/）为基准，../native 即 bridge/native。
  const loaded = require('../native/build/Release/rb_native.node') as NativeBridge;
  native = loaded;
  log.info('原生桥接插件已加载');
  try {
    loaded.rbOpen();
    log.info('控制设备 \\\\.\\RAMBlockCache 已打开');
  } catch (e) {
    // 设备不可达（驱动未启动/未以管理员运行）只记录，不否定插件本身
    deviceError = messageOf(e);
    log.warn({ deviceError }, '控制设备暂不可达，/rpc 前会惰性重试');
  }
} catch (e) {
  pluginError = messageOf(e);
  log.warn({ pluginError }, '原生桥接插件不可用，/rpc 将返回 503');
}

/**
 * 读命令 → 结构化解码器（载荷 = 应答缓冲剥掉 16B 信封后的部分）。
 * 未列出的消息回 base64 原文。
 */
const DECODERS: Record<number, (p: Buffer) => unknown> = {
  1: decodeStats, // GET_STATS
  4: decodeConfig, // GET_CONFIG
  7: decodeVolumes, // GET_VOLUMES
  9: decodeLogList, // GET_LOG
  10: decodeVersion, // GET_VERSION
  14: decodeEventList, // GET_EVENTS
};

/**
 * params(JSON) → 二进制载荷。入口先过 zod（服务端输入门，[适配 2026-10-31]），
 * 编码严格按 rb_proto.h 字段偏移写入；未列出的消息无载荷（返回 null）。
 */
const volumeSetSchema = z.object({
  Letter: z.string().min(1).max(2),
  ReadEnabled: z.number(),
  WriteEnabled: z.number(),
  WriteMode: z.number(),
});
const volumeAttachSchema = z.object({
  Letter: z.string().min(1).max(2),
  Attach: z.number(),
  ReadEnabled: z.number(),
  WriteEnabled: z.number(),
  WriteMode: z.number(),
});
const configSchema = z.record(z.string(), z.union([z.number(), z.string(), z.array(z.string())]));
const invalidateSchema = z.object({
  Letter: z.string().min(1).max(2),
  Offset: z.number(),
  Length: z.number(),
});
const eventQuerySchema = z.object({
  Cursor: z.number().nonnegative().default(0),
  MaxCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(64).default(64),
});

function encodeParams(method: number, params: unknown): Buffer | null {
  if (method === 14) {
    // RB_EVENT_QUERY：Cursor u64@0 / MaxCount u32@8（<=RB_EVENT_MAX）/ 对齐填充@12
    const q = eventQuerySchema.parse(params ?? {});
    const b = Buffer.alloc(16);
    b.writeBigUInt64LE(BigInt(q.Cursor), 0);
    b.writeUInt32LE(q.MaxCount, 8);
    return b;
  }
  if (method === 6) {
    // RB_VOLUME_SET：Letter wchar@0 / ReadEnabled u32@4 / WriteEnabled@8 / WriteMode@12（16B）
    const p = volumeSetSchema.parse(params ?? {});
    const b = Buffer.alloc(16);
    b.writeUInt16LE(letterCode(p.Letter), 0);
    b.writeUInt32LE(flag(p.ReadEnabled), 4);
    b.writeUInt32LE(flag(p.WriteEnabled), 8);
    b.writeUInt32LE(writemode(p.WriteMode), 12);
    return b;
  }
  if (method === 8) {
    // RB_VOLUME_ATTACH：Letter wchar@0 / Attach@4 / ReadEnabled@8 / WriteEnabled@12 / WriteMode@16（20B）
    const p = volumeAttachSchema.parse(params ?? {});
    const b = Buffer.alloc(20);
    b.writeUInt16LE(letterCode(p.Letter), 0);
    b.writeUInt32LE(flag(p.Attach), 4);
    b.writeUInt32LE(flag(p.ReadEnabled), 8);
    b.writeUInt32LE(flag(p.WriteEnabled), 12);
    b.writeUInt32LE(writemode(p.WriteMode), 16);
    return b;
  }
  if (method === 2) {
    // RB_CONFIG 全量回写（RB_CONFIG_SIZE 字节）：字段清单与偏移唯一来源是
    // rb-config.generated.ts（← src/ctl/rb_proto.h）。逐字段遍历生成表，
    // 结构上不可能再漏字段 —— 少编码一个字段，native lib.rs 的 8224B 全零缓冲
    // 会让驱动 RbApplyConfig 收到 0 并持久化（Web 保存时静默把 TinyLFU 清成 OFF）。
    const c = configSchema.parse(params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const b = Buffer.alloc(RB_CONFIG_SIZE);
    for (const f of RB_CONFIG_FIELDS) {
      if (f.kind === 'wchar2d') {
        const vf = Array.isArray(c[f.name]) ? (c[f.name] as unknown[]) : [];
        for (let i = 0; i < f.count; i++) {
          const raw = vf[i];
          const entry: string = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw : '';
          for (let j = 0; j < f.len; j++) {
            b.writeUInt16LE(j < entry.length ? entry.charCodeAt(j) & 0xffff : 0,
              f.offset + i * f.len * 2 + j * 2);
          }
        }
      } else {
        b.writeUInt32LE(u32(c[f.name]), f.offset);
      }
    }
    return b;
  }
  if (method === 13) {
    // RB_INVALIDATE_RANGE：Letter wchar@0 / Reserved u32@4 / Offset u64@8 / Length u64@16（24B）
    const p = invalidateSchema.parse(params ?? {});
    const b = Buffer.alloc(24);
    b.writeUInt16LE(letterCode(p.Letter), 0);
    b.writeBigUInt64LE(BigInt(clampNonNeg(p.Offset)), 8);
    b.writeBigUInt64LE(BigInt(clampNonNeg(p.Length)), 16);
    return b;
  }
  return null;
}

/** u32 字段：非法/越界一律 0（SET_CONFIG 是全量回写，缺字段按 0 会关功能——
 * 因此调用方必须传完整 RbConfig，前端表单以 GET_CONFIG 原文为基底做读改写） */
function u32(v: unknown): number {
  const n = Number(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return 0;
  return Math.min(Math.trunc(n), 0xffffffff);
}

/** u64 字段：负数/非法按 0，上界按 2^53-1（协议数值约定见 protocol/types.ts） */
function clampNonNeg(v: unknown): number {
  const n = Number(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return 0;
  return Math.min(Math.trunc(n), Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
}

/** wchar 卷盘符：'D' → 0x0044；非法输入按 0（驱动按空盘符拒绝，不猜默认卷） */
function letterCode(v: unknown): number {
  if (typeof v !== 'string' || v.length === 0) return 0;
  return v.charCodeAt(0) & 0xffff;
}

/** 0/1 开关字段：仅 1 视为真，其余一律 0（保守，不猜） */
function flag(v: unknown): number {
  return Number(v) === 1 ? 1 : 0;
}

/** 写模式：仅 0/1/2 合法（RB_WRITEMODE_*），越界回退 2=GLOBAL（跟随全局，最少意外） */
function writemode(v: unknown): number {
  const n = Number(v);
  return n === 0 || n === 1 ? n : 2;
}

const app = new Hono();

const healthHandler = (c: Context) =>
  c.json({
    ok: true,
    native: native !== null,
    deviceOpen: native !== null && deviceError === null,
    pluginError,
    deviceError,
    pid: process.pid,
    node: process.version,
  });

app.get('/health', healthHandler);

/* ===== [FEAT-LOGUI 2026-11-05] 落盘日志访问面 =====
 * 背景：驱动日志已由 log-sink 落盘到 LOG_DIR（512 条环×96 字符的持久化副本），
 * 但用户/支持人员无法直接访问——故障复盘仍需手工找路径。本组路由把"看日志"
 * 变成一次点击：列表 / 尾部读取 / 在资源管理器中打开目录。
 * 安全：仅本机 127.0.0.1；文件名白名单（driver-YYYYMMDD.log[.N]），
 * 绝不拼接用户输入的任意路径（防目录穿越）。 */
function listLogFiles(): { name: string; size: number; mtime: number }[] {
  try {
    return readdirSync(LOG_DIR)
      .filter((n) => /^driver-\d{8}\.log(\.\d)?$/.test(n))
      .map((name) => {
        const st = statSync(path.join(LOG_DIR, name));
        return { name, size: st.size, mtime: st.mtimeMs };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.name.localeCompare(a.name));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/* [USER-REQ 2026-11-05] 开机行为策略（IOCTL 0x80A）：
 * 读写 Parameters\AutoAttach 与 ResumeOnBoot，并回传上次加速卷列表。
 * 语义：默认 AutoAttach=0 / ResumeOnBoot=1 —— 开机不自动全开，只恢复
 * 用户上次手动加速过的盘。 */
app.get('/rb/bootcfg', async (c) => {
  if (!native) return c.json({ error: '原生插件未加载' }, 503);
  try {
    const buf = Buffer.alloc(80);
    buf.writeUInt32LE(1, 0);   // Get = 1
    const out = native.rbBootCfg?.(buf);
    if (!out) return c.json({ error: '插件版本过旧（缺 rbBootCfg）' }, 501);
    return c.json({
      AutoAttach: out.readUInt32LE(4),
      ResumeOnBoot: out.readUInt32LE(8),
      ResumeLetters: out.toString('utf16le', 16, 16 + 64).replace(/\u0000+$/, ''),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return c.json({ error: messageOf(e) }, 500);
  }
});

app.post('/rb/bootcfg', async (c) => {
  if (!native) return c.json({ error: '原生插件未加载' }, 503);
  try {
    const body = (await c.req.json()) as { AutoAttach?: number; ResumeOnBoot?: number };
    const buf = Buffer.alloc(80);
    buf.writeUInt32LE(0, 0);   // Get = 0（写入）
    buf.writeUInt32LE(body.AutoAttach === undefined ? 0xff : body.AutoAttach ? 1 : 0, 4);
    buf.writeUInt32LE(body.ResumeOnBoot === undefined ? 0xff : body.ResumeOnBoot ? 1 : 0, 8);
    const out = native.rbBootCfg?.(buf);
    if (!out) return c.json({ error: '插件版本过旧（缺 rbBootCfg）' }, 501);
    return c.json({
      ok: true,
      AutoAttach: out.readUInt32LE(4),
      ResumeOnBoot: out.readUInt32LE(8),
      ResumeLetters: out.toString('utf16le', 16, 16 + 64).replace(/\u0000+$/, ''),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return c.json({ error: messageOf(e) }, 500);
  }
});

app.get('/rb/logs', (c) =>
  c.json({ dir: LOG_DIR, exists: existsSync(LOG_DIR), files: listLogFiles() }),
);

app.get('/rb/logs/:name', (c) => {
  const name = c.req.param('name');
  if (!/^driver-\d{8}\.log(\.\d)?$/.test(name)) {
    return c.json({ error: '非法文件名' }, 400);
  }
  const full = path.join(LOG_DIR, name);
  if (!existsSync(full)) return c.json({ error: '文件不存在' }, 404);
  try {
    const text = readFileSync(full, 'utf8');
    /* 只回尾部 512KB：日志文件可达 8MB，整包回传会卡住前端 */
    const MAX = 512 * 1024;
    const tail = text.length > MAX ? text.slice(text.length - MAX) : text;
    return c.json({ name, size: text.length, truncated: text.length > MAX, text: tail });
  } catch (e) {
    return c.json({ error: String(e) }, 500);
  }
});

app.post('/rb/logs/open', (c) => {
  try {
    if (!existsSync(LOG_DIR)) return c.json({ ok: false, error: '日志目录尚不存在（驱动未产生日志）' });
    /* explorer 选中目录：Windows 专用，失败不影响其它功能 */
    execFile('explorer.exe', [LOG_DIR], () => {});
    return c.json({ ok: true, dir: LOG_DIR });
  } catch (e) {
    return c.json({ ok: false, error: String(e) });
  }
});

// [适配 2026-10-31] SPA 同源形态：控制台由本服务直接托管（5199），
// 前端 http-transport 的相对前缀 /rb 命中同端口，不再依赖 vite 代理。
app.get('/rb/health', healthHandler);

// ---- [99 §2] RB2 特性开关通道（Features\Flags 热生效）----
// 通过 rbfeatctl.exe 子进程（严格 argv 白名单，无 shell）：flags on/off + 内建
// refresh（rbfeatctl flags 命令自身发 RB2_IOCTL_REFRESH）。WBCOAL 在 CLI 已拦
// （bit8 红线），此处白名单再封一层；L2/MEMGUARD 需语义参数，仅读展示。
// exe 定位：payload 根（webconsole.zip 解析后的上级）→ dist 内 → cwd，取先存在者。
// 惰性解析（distDir 在本文件后段才声明；exe 每次解析成本可忽略）
function rbfeatExe(): string | null {
  // 不用工作目录相对路径（88 B-3 门禁禁令）：payload 布局下 exe 在 dist 上级，
  // 扁平布局下在 dist 内，两条路径已覆盖。
  const cands = [
    path.join(distDir, '..', 'rbfeatctl.exe'),
    path.join(distDir, 'rbfeatctl.exe'),
  ];
  return cands.find((p) => existsSync(p)) ?? null;
}

function rbfeatRun(args: string[]): Promise<{ code: number; out: string }> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const exe = rbfeatExe();
    if (!exe) { resolve({ code: -1, out: 'rbfeatctl.exe not found (payload layout?)' }); return; }
    execFile(exe, args, { timeout: 8000, windowsHide: true }, (err, stdout, stderr) => {
      const ec = (err as (NodeJS.ErrnoException & { code?: number | string }) | null);
      const code = typeof ec?.code === 'number' ? ec.code : ec ? 1 : 0;
      resolve({ code, out: String(stdout || '') + String(stderr || '') });
    });
  });
}

function rbfeatParseFlags(out: string): { stats: Record<string, number> | null } {
  const line = out.split(/\r?\n/).find((l) => l.trim().startsWith('{'));
  if (!line) return { stats: null };
  try { return { stats: JSON.parse(line) as Record<string, number> }; } catch { return { stats: null }; }
}

app.get('/rb/rbfeat', async (c) => {
  const st = await rbfeatRun(['stats', '-json']);
  const l2 = await rbfeatRun(['l2', 'status']);
  const excl = await rbfeatRun(['excl']);
  return c.json({
    exe: rbfeatExe() ? 'found' : 'missing',
    code: st.code,
    stats: rbfeatParseFlags(st.out).stats,
    l2: l2.out.slice(0, 500),
    excl: excl.out.slice(0, 1000),
  });
});

// [101] L2 容器管理：enable 需 letter + GB（容器=卷上文件 RAMBoostL2c.bin / 索引 RAMBoostL2c.idx，
// 非破坏性 FILE_OPEN_IF）；约束=4K 块几何 / 单加速卷 / 与 WBCOAL 互斥（CLI 强制）。
app.post('/rb/l2', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => null) as { op?: unknown; letter?: unknown; gb?: unknown } | null;
  const op = String(body?.op ?? '');
  if (op === 'enable') {
    const letter = String(body?.letter ?? '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '').slice(0, 1);
    /* [FIX 2026-11-13] 两处修正：
     *  ① 上限 512 → 128：驱动 RB2_L2_MAX_GB=128（rbL2.c:59）对越界是**静默截断**，
     *    这里放行 512 等于让用户以为配了 256GB，实际只有 128GB，且全程无提示。
     *  ② 非法 gb 不再被夹成 1：旧式 `Math.max(1, Math.min(512, NaN||0))` 把
     *    `gb:"abc"` / `gb:0` 变成 1GB，于是「参数写错」表现为「成功创建了一个
     *    1GB 容器」。现在明确拒绝，让调用方看到 400 而不是一个假成功。 */
    const raw = Math.trunc(Number(body?.gb));
    const gb = Number.isFinite(raw) ? raw : 0;
    if (!letter || gb < 1 || gb > L2_MAX_GB)
      return c.json({ code: -2, out: `need letter A-Z and gb 1-${L2_MAX_GB}` }, 400);
    const r = await rbfeatRun(['l2', 'enable', letter + ':', String(gb)]);
    const s = await rbfeatRun(['l2', 'status']);
    return c.json({ code: r.code, out: (r.out + s.out).slice(0, 800) });
  }
  if (op === 'disable') {
    const r = await rbfeatRun(['l2', 'disable']);
    const s = await rbfeatRun(['l2', 'status']);
    return c.json({ code: r.code, out: (r.out + s.out).slice(0, 800) });
  }
  return c.json({ code: -2, out: 'op must be enable|disable' }, 400);
});

// [101] 排除集管理：原生注册表操作（rbfeatctl excl add/del/def，REFRESH 热载）。
app.post('/rb/excl', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => null) as { op?: unknown; name?: unknown; on?: unknown } | null;
  const op = String(body?.op ?? '');
  if (op === 'add' || op === 'del') {
    const nm = String(body?.name ?? '').trim().replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_.\- ]/g, '').slice(0, 60);
    if (!nm) return c.json({ code: -2, out: 'need process image name' }, 400);
    const r = await rbfeatRun(['excl', op, nm]);
    const s = await rbfeatRun(['excl']);
    return c.json({ code: r.code, out: (r.out + '||' + s.out).slice(0, 1200) });
  }
  if (op === 'def') {
    const on = body?.on === true;
    const r = await rbfeatRun(['excl', 'def', on ? 'on' : 'off']);
    const s = await rbfeatRun(['excl']);
    return c.json({ code: r.code, out: (r.out + '||' + s.out).slice(0, 1200) });
  }
  return c.json({ code: -2, out: 'op must be add|del|def' }, 400);
});

app.post('/rb/rbfeat', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json().catch(() => null) as { name?: unknown; on?: unknown } | null;
  const name = String(body?.name ?? '').toUpperCase();
  const on = body?.on === true;
  // 白名单：PREFETCH/HOT/THERMAL/ETW 热开关；WBCOAL=红线封禁（CLI 已拦，此处再封）；
  // L2 需 letter+GB 语义参数（走 l2 enable，CLI 保留）；MEMGUARD 语义未审计，暂不放开。
  if (!['PREFETCH', 'HOT', 'THERMAL', 'ETW', 'WBCOAL'].includes(name)) {
    return c.json({ code: -2, out: `feature name not allowed: ${name}` }, 400);
  }
  // WBCOAL 与 L2 互斥由 CLI 强制（code 4 + 文本），此处透传如实回显。
  const set = await rbfeatRun(['flags', on ? 'on' : 'off', name]);
  const st = await rbfeatRun(['stats', '-json']);
  return c.json({
    code: set.code,
    out: set.out.slice(0, 500),
    stats: rbfeatParseFlags(st.out).stats,
  });
});

const rpcHandler = async (c: Context) => {
  if (!native) {
    // 插件未链接 → 前端映射 DRIVER_ABSENT（见 http-transport mapNetworkError 503 分支）
    return c.json(
      {
        status: -1,
        message: '原生桥接插件未链接。请先构建 bridge/native（见该目录 README.md），再重启本服务。',
        pluginError,
      },
      503,
    );
  }

  // 惰性打开设备（幂等）：设备级失效（Win32 2/6/21）后插件已自行作废句柄，
  // 这里重试 open 即完成自愈；失败 → 503，前端映射 DRIVER_ABSENT。
  try {
    native.rbOpen();
    deviceError = null;
  } catch (e) {
    deviceError = messageOf(e);
    return c.json({ status: -1, message: deviceError, deviceError }, 503);
  }

  let body: { method?: number; params?: unknown };
  try {
    body = await c.req.json();
  } catch {
    return c.json({ status: -1, message: '请求体不是合法 JSON' }, 400);
  }

  if (typeof body.method !== 'number') {
    return c.json({ status: -1, message: '缺少数值型 method 字段' }, 400);
  }

  try {
    const payload =
      body.params === undefined ? null : encodeParams(body.method, body.params);
    /* [PERF-UI 2026-11-04] 慢命令说明（不能伪异步）：napi 调用绑定本线程
     * 的 IOCTL 句柄，无法搬到 Worker；libuv 线程池只服务文件系统调用。
     * detach 强制前置 flush 实测 4.7s——此前前端 1500ms 超时制造"控制通道
     * 无响应"假报警（实际命令在后台完整成功）。前端已按方法分档超时
     * （http-transport.SLOW_MS：flush/setVolume/attach=30s），服务端保持
     * 同步真值语义。 */
    const raw = native.rbRequest(body.method, payload);
    const decode = DECODERS[body.method];
    return c.json({
      status: 0,
      data: decode ? decode(raw.subarray(16)) : raw.toString('base64'),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    // 驱动 NTSTATUS / Win32 错误：以 200 信封回传（status=-1），
    // 前端走 NT_STATUS 分支显示真实原因，而不是丢失语义的 HTTP 500。
    const message = messageOf(e);
    log.error({ message, method: body.method }, 'IOCTL 调用失败');
    return c.json({ status: -1, message });
  }
};

// [FIX D5 2026-11-03] drive-by 防线：浏览器跨源简单 POST（text/plain）不发预检、
// 必带 Origin 头——凡带 Origin 且 host 非本机 5199 的请求一律 403（副作用拦截；
// 响应本就不可读）。同源/无 Origin（curl/CLI）放行。与 D2 叠加的"无权限打 PANIC/
// 卡死控制面"攻击链在此切断。
app.use('/rpc', async (c, next) => {
  const origin = c.req.header('origin');
  if (origin) {
    const host = (() => { try { return new URL(origin).host; } catch { return ''; } })();
    if (host !== '127.0.0.1:5199' && host !== 'localhost:5199') {
      return c.json({ status: -1, message: 'cross-origin control forbidden' }, 403);
    }
  }
  await next();
});
app.post('/rpc', rpcHandler);
app.post('/rb/rpc', rpcHandler);

// —— SPA 托管（生产形态：npm run build 后由桥接同端口直出，无需 vite dev）——
// Hash 路由设计（41 号 §11.9 router.tsx）使服务端只需兜底 '/' 与静态资源。
// [88 B-3 2026-11-07] cwd-independent: bridge/server/index.ts -> up two levels
// to webconsole/ (dev: web/) -> dist/. SYSTEM/ONSTART tasks default their
// working directory to the system directory, so cwd MUST NOT participate here.
const distDir = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../dist', import.meta.url));

app.get('/', async (c) => {
  try {
    const html = await readFile(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'), 'utf8');
    return c.html(html);
  } catch {
    return c.text(
      '控制台静态资源缺失：先在 web/ 下执行 npm run build（生成 dist/），再重启桥接。',
      503,
    );
  }
});

// [88 B-3] Hono serveStatic uses join(root, req.path); an absolute root is
// accepted (verified in @hono/node-server/dist/serve-static.mjs:71,87).
app.use('/assets/*', serveStatic({ root: distDir }));

/* [HARDEN 2026-11-05] 进程级容错：桥接是控制台的单点，任何未捕获异常导致
 * 退出都表现为"控制台突然失联"，而此前完全没有兜底——
 *   · unhandledRejection：记录后继续（Node 默认会在未来版本里直接退出）
 *   · uncaughtException：记录后继续（最坏情况某请求失败，但控制台仍可用）
 *   · SIGINT/SIGTERM：有序关闭（停日志落盘 → 关设备 → 退出）
 * 纪律：绝不因为单次异常而让用户失去整个控制面。 */
let logSinkStop: (() => void) | null = null;
process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) => {
  log.error({ reason: String(reason) }, '未捕获的 Promise 拒绝（已忽略，服务继续）');
});
process.on('uncaughtException', (err) => {
  log.error({ err: String(err?.stack ?? err) }, '未捕获异常（已忽略，服务继续）');
});
for (const sig of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM'] as const) {
  process.on(sig, () => {
    log.info(`收到 ${sig}，开始有序关闭`);
    try { logSinkStop?.(); } catch { /* 忽略 */ }
    try { native?.rbClose(); } catch { /* 忽略 */ }
    process.exit(0);
  });
}

serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: PORT, hostname: HOST }, (info) => {
  log.info(`桥接服务已监听 http://${HOST}:${info.port}`);
  /* [FEAT-LOGQ 2026-11-05] 驱动日志持久化：2s 增量拉取（512 条环 × 96 字符），
   * 落盘 %ProgramData%\RAMBlockCache\logs\driver-YYYYMMDD.log。
   * 旧 GET_LOG 只有 64×48，故障复盘时历史已覆盖/文案被截断。 */
  if (native) {
    const logDir = LOG_DIR;
    logSinkStop = startLogSink(native, LOG_DIR, (msg) => log.warn({ msg }, '日志落盘'));
    log.info({ logDir }, '驱动日志落盘已启用');
  }
});
````

##### `src/ui/web/bridge/server/log-sink.ts`

````ts
/**
 * [FEAT-LOGQ 2026-11-05] 驱动日志持久化（桥接侧）
 *
 * 问题：驱动日志环在内存中（512 条 × 96 字符），重启清空；旧 GET_LOG 只有
 * 64 条 × 48 字符，故障复盘时（尤其 0x7B 这类需要回溯"崩溃前最后几条"的
 * 场景）历史早被覆盖、文案被截断。
 *
 * 方案：桥接定时用 IOCTL_RB_LOGQ 按 Seq 游标增量拉取，追加写入
 *   %ProgramData%\RAMBlockCache\logs\driver-YYYYMMDD.log
 * 落盘格式：每行 `<ISO时间> <LEVEL> [<Src>] <Status> <文本>`
 *
 * 设计约束：
 *  - 只读拉取，绝不改变驱动行为；
 *  - 单日文件超 8MB 滚动为 .1/.2（最多保留 3 个），避免无界增长；
 *  - 拉取失败（插件旧版/设备离线）静默降级，绝不打断 /rpc；
 *  - 轮询间隔 2s，单次最多 32 条 —— 与驱动的写日志速率（低频）匹配。
 */
import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, renameSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
const POLL_MS = 2000;
const BATCH = 32;
const HDR = 16;
const REC = 224;
const TEXT_WCHARS = 96;

export interface LogPageSrc {
  rbLogPage?: (fromSeq: number, maxCount: number) => Buffer;
}

interface DecodedRec {
  seq: number;
  ticks: bigint;
  level: number;
  src: number;
  status: number;
  text: string;
}

/** 按 src/ctl/rb_logq.h 解码一页应答。 */
function decodePage(buf: Buffer): { count: number; lastSeq: number; items: DecodedRec[] } {
  if (buf.length < HDR) return { count: 0, lastSeq: 0, items: [] };
  const count = Math.min(buf.readUInt32LE(0), Math.floor((buf.length - HDR) / REC));
  const rawLast = buf.readBigUInt64LE(8);
  const items: DecodedRec[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const off = HDR + i * REC;
    let text = '';
    for (let c = 0; c < TEXT_WCHARS; c++) {
      const ch = buf.readUInt16LE(off + 32 + c * 2);
      if (ch === 0) break;
      text += String.fromCharCode(ch);
    }
    items.push({
      seq: Number(buf.readBigUInt64LE(off)),
      ticks: buf.readBigUInt64LE(off + 8),
      level: buf.readUInt32LE(off + 16),
      src: buf.readUInt32LE(off + 20),
      status: buf.readInt32LE(off + 24),
      text,
    });
  }
  return { count, lastSeq: Number(rawLast), items };
}

/** FILETIME(100ns since 1601) → ISO 8601 */
function filetimeToIso(ticks: bigint): string {
  const EPOCH_DIFF = 116444736000000000n; // 1601→1970
  const ms = Number((ticks - EPOCH_DIFF) / 10000n);
  return new Date(ms).toISOString();
}

const LEVEL = ['INFO ', 'WARN ', 'ERROR'];

function safeRotate(path: string): void {
  try {
    if (!existsSync(path)) return;
    if (statSync(path).size < MAX_BYTES) return;
    for (let i = 2; i >= 1; i--) {
      const from = `${path}.${i}`;
      const to = `${path}.${i + 1}`;
      if (existsSync(from)) renameSync(from, to);
    }
    renameSync(path, `${path}.1`);
  } catch {
    /* 轮转失败不影响继续写 */
  }
}

/**
 * 启动日志落盘器。返回 stop()。
 * 无插件/无设备时静默返回空停止函数（桥接其它功能不受影响）。
 */
export function startLogSink(src: LogPageSrc, logDir: string, onError?: (e: string) => void): () => void {
  if (typeof src.rbLogPage !== 'function') {
    onError?.('原生插件不含 rbLogPage（旧版本），跳过日志落盘');
    return () => {};
  }
  try {
    mkdirSync(logDir, { recursive: true });
  } catch {
    onError?.(`无法创建日志目录 ${logDir}`);
    return () => {};
  }

  let lastSeq = 0;
  let stopped = false;
  let misses = 0;

  const tick = (): void => {
    if (stopped) return;
    try {
      // 分页拉取直到没有新数据（最多 8 页，防单次卡太久）
      for (let page = 0; page < 8; page++) {
        const raw = src.rbLogPage!(lastSeq, BATCH);
        const { count, lastSeq: last, items } = decodePage(raw);
        if (count > 0) {
          const d = new Date();
          const day = `${d.getFullYear()}${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
          const path = join(logDir, `driver-${day}.log`);
          safeRotate(path);
          const lines = items
            .map(
              (r) =>
                `${filetimeToIso(r.ticks)} ${LEVEL[r.level] ?? 'INFO '} [${r.src}] ${
                  r.status !== 0 ? `0x${(r.status >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')} ` : ''
                }${r.text}\n`,
            )
            .join('');
          appendFileSync(path, lines, 'utf8');
        }
        // 无新数据或已追平即停止翻页
        if (count === 0 || last <= lastSeq) {
          if (last > lastSeq) lastSeq = last;
          break;
        }
        lastSeq = last;
      }
      misses = 0;
    } catch (e) {
      misses++;
      // 连续 3 次失败才报告（设备重启/插件重载期间的瞬断不刷屏）
      if (misses === 3) onError?.(`日志拉取失败：${(e as Error).message}`);
      if (misses > 60) {
        onError?.('日志拉取连续失败 60 次，停止落盘');
        stopped = true;
      }
    }
  };

  const timer = setInterval(tick, POLL_MS);
  timer.unref?.();

  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    clearInterval(timer);
  };
}
````

##### `src/ui/web/bridge/server/proto-decode.ts`

````ts
/**
 * rb_proto.h → JSON 结构化解码（桥接侧独立副本）。
 *
 * 依赖纪律（§11.10）：本文件与前端运行时无 import 关系，跨进程通信；唯一的
 * 例外是 WR-06 落地的代码生成物 —— 生成物是纯类型/常量模块（无 DOM、无 Node API），
 * 由 src/ctl/rb_proto.h 生成，不构成运行时耦合。
 *
 * 布局来源：src/ctl/rb_proto.h（V9，RB_PROTOCOL_VERSION=9），
 * 经 src/ui/controller/.../Models/Models.cs 的 C# 镜像交叉核对（2026-10-31）。
 * C 结构按 MSVC x64 规则对齐：u64 成员 8 字节对齐，wchar_t = 2 字节。
 *
 * RB_CONFIG 的字段名/偏移**不再手写**：decodeConfig 遍历 rb-config.generated.ts 的
 * RB_CONFIG_FIELDS，改 C 头后重跑 src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py 即可。
 *
 * 输入为 RB_MSG 应答的载荷区（调用方须先剥掉 16 字节信封）。
 */

// 协议布局由 src/ctl/rb_proto.h 生成（WR-06）：生成物是纯类型/常量模块。
// Node 类型剥离（type-stripping）要求相对导入带 .ts 扩展名。
import {
  RB_CONFIG_FIELDS,
  RB_CONFIG_SIZE,
} from '../../src/protocol/rb-config.generated.ts';

const WIDE = new TextDecoder('utf-16le');

/** 定长 wchar_t 数组按 NUL 截断为 JS 字符串 */
export function readWide(buf: Buffer, off: number, maxChars: number): string {
  let end = off;
  const limit = off + maxChars * 2;
  while (end + 2 <= limit && buf.readUInt16LE(end) !== 0) end += 2;
  return WIDE.decode(buf.subarray(off, end));
}

/** uint64 → number（统计量远低于 2^53；越界场景需整体切 BigInt，见 protocol/types.ts 注释） */
export function readU64(buf: Buffer, off: number): number {
  return Number(buf.readBigUInt64LE(off));
}

/* ============================ GET_VERSION (10) ============================ */

export function decodeVersion(p: Buffer) {
  return {
    ProtocolVersion: p.readUInt32LE(0),
    Major: p.readUInt32LE(4),
    Minor: p.readUInt32LE(8),
    Build: p.readUInt32LE(12),
    IsBlockFilter: p.readUInt32LE(16),
    Reserved: p.readUInt32LE(20),
    DriverFlags: readU64(p, 24),
    Name: readWide(p, 32, 16), // RB_NAME_LEN=16
    TestSigned: p.readUInt32LE(64),
    Reserved2: p.readUInt32LE(68),
    Signer: readWide(p, 72, 32), // RB_SIGNER_LEN=32
  };
}

/* ============================ GET_STATS (1) ============================ */

export function decodeStats(p: Buffer) {
  const s: Record<string, number | number[]> = {};
  const U64_HEAD = [
    'ReadReq', 'ReadHit', 'ReadBytes', 'ReadHitBytes', 'WriteReq', 'WriteBytes',
    'WriteCached', 'WbFlush', 'WbBytes', 'EvictBytes', 'CurBytes', 'DirtyBytes', 'ChunkCount',
  ] as const;
  U64_HEAD.forEach((n, i) => (s[n] = readU64(p, i * 8)));

  const U32_MID = [
    'InstanceCount', 'CacheSizeMB', 'EffectiveCacheMB', 'WriteBackMode',
    'Enabled', 'SafeMode', 'RmwReads', 'TrimCount',
  ] as const;
  U32_MID.forEach((n, i) => (s[n] = p.readUInt32LE(104 + i * 4)));

  s.IdleReclaimBytes = readU64(p, 136);
  s.LostDirtyBytes = readU64(p, 144);
  s.StripeRead = Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => readU64(p, 152 + i * 8));
  s.StripeWrite = Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => readU64(p, 664 + i * 8));
  s.StripeCount = p.readUInt32LE(1176);
  s.PressureLevel = p.readUInt32LE(1180);
  s.DynamicLimitMB = p.readUInt32LE(1184);
  // DynamicLimitMB(u32)@1184 后 4 字节对齐填充，AvailablePhysMB(u64)@1192
  s.AvailablePhysMB = readU64(p, 1192);
  s.PeakBytes = readU64(p, 1200);
  s.ReadaheadBytes = readU64(p, 1208);
  s.ReadaheadHitBytes = readU64(p, 1216);
  s.PressureShrinkBytes = readU64(p, 1224);
  s.ReadaheadActive = p.readUInt32LE(1232);
  s.PanicActive = p.readUInt32LE(1236);
  s.BootFails = p.readUInt32LE(1240);
  s.DirtySnapshotMB = p.readUInt32LE(1244);
  s.CacheReadLatencyUs = p.readUInt32LE(1248);
  s.DiskReadLatencyUs = p.readUInt32LE(1252);
  // [U1 2026-11-06] RB_STATS 末尾纯追加：读延迟分位数（log2 桶近似；0=尚无样本）
  s.CacheReadLatP50Us = p.readUInt32LE(1256);
  s.CacheReadLatP95Us = p.readUInt32LE(1260);
  s.CacheReadLatP99Us = p.readUInt32LE(1264);
  s.DiskReadLatP50Us = p.readUInt32LE(1268);
  s.DiskReadLatP95Us = p.readUInt32LE(1272);
  s.DiskReadLatP99Us = p.readUInt32LE(1276);
  /* [83 2026-11-07] RB_STATS 末尾五字段（u32@1280/1284/1288/1292 + u64@1296，
   * sizeof=1304）。旧驱动回包可能只有 1280 字节：每个字段按实际长度守卫，
   * 不足则填 0，绝不 readUInt32LE/readBigUInt64LE 抛 RangeError（66 号白屏同款防线）。 */
  s.EngineBlockSize = p.length >= 1284 ? p.readUInt32LE(1280) : 0;
  s.GeometryRebuildCount = p.length >= 1288 ? p.readUInt32LE(1284) : 0;
  s.GeometryRebuildLastStatus = p.length >= 1292 ? p.readUInt32LE(1288) : 0;
  s.GeometryRebuildInProgress = p.length >= 1296 ? p.readUInt32LE(1292) : 0;
  s.LastGeometryRebuildUtc = p.length >= 1304 ? readU64(p, 1296) : 0;
  return s;
}

/* ============================ GET_VOLUMES (7) ============================ */

/** RB_VOLUME_INFO = 56B：Letter(wchar)@0 +4 Attached/Read/Write/IsSystem u32
 *  +4 填充 → CapacityMB u64@24 / FreeMB u64@32 → Bound/WriteMode/LogSect/PhysSect u32@40..56 */
export function decodeVolumes(p: Buffer) {
  const count = p.readUInt32LE(0);
  const items = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(count, 8); i++) {
    const b = 8 + i * 56; // Items 对齐到 8
    items.push({
      Letter: readWide(p, b, 1),
      Attached: p.readUInt32LE(b + 4),
      ReadEnabled: p.readUInt32LE(b + 8),
      WriteEnabled: p.readUInt32LE(b + 12),
      IsSystem: p.readUInt32LE(b + 16),
      CapacityMB: readU64(p, b + 24),
      FreeMB: readU64(p, b + 32),
      Bound: p.readUInt32LE(b + 40),
      WriteMode: p.readUInt32LE(b + 44),
      LogicalSectorBytes: p.readUInt32LE(b + 48),
      PhysicalSectorBytes: p.readUInt32LE(b + 52),
    });
  }
  return { Count: count, Items: items };
}

/* ============================ GET_LOG (9) ============================ */

/** RB_LOG_REC = 120B：Ticks u64@0 / Level@8 / Src@12 / Status i32@16 / Text wchar[48]@20..116（对齐到 120） */
export function decodeLogList(p: Buffer) {
  const count = Math.min(p.readUInt32LE(0), 64);
  const items = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const b = 8 + i * 120; // Items 对齐到 8
    items.push({
      Ticks: readU64(p, b),
      Level: p.readUInt32LE(b + 8),
      Src: p.readUInt32LE(b + 12),
      Status: p.readInt32LE(b + 16),
      Text: readWide(p, b + 20, 48),
    });
  }
  return { Count: count, Cursor: p.readUInt32LE(4), Items: items };
}

/* ============================ GET_EVENTS (14) ============================ */

/** RB_EVENT_REC = 128B：Seq u64@0 / OpType@8 / Percent@12 / Cancelable@16 / Phase@20
 *  / RecoveredBytes u64@24 / StageText wchar[48]@32..128 */
export function decodeEventList(p: Buffer) {
  const count = Math.min(p.readUInt32LE(8), 64);
  const items = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const b = 16 + i * 128;
    items.push({
      Seq: readU64(p, b),
      OpType: p.readUInt32LE(b + 8),
      Percent: p.readUInt32LE(b + 12),
      Cancelable: p.readUInt32LE(b + 16),
      Phase: p.readUInt32LE(b + 20),
      RecoveredBytes: readU64(p, b + 24),
      StageText: readWide(p, b + 32, 48),
    });
  }
  // Cursor = 新消费游标（最后一条 Seq；无事件=入参原值），前端据此增量轮询
  return { Cursor: readU64(p, 0), Count: count, Reserved: p.readUInt32LE(12), Items: items };
}

/* ============================ GET_CONFIG (4) ============================ */

export function decodeConfig(p: Buffer) {
  const s: Record<string, number | string[]> = {};
  // 字段名与偏移唯一来源：rb-config.generated.ts（← src/ctl/rb_proto.h）。
  // 本文件不再保留任何手写偏移表 —— 漏跟 C 头会被 check_proto_codegen.py 拦下。
  for (const f of RB_CONFIG_FIELDS) {
    if (f.kind === 'wchar2d') {
      // VolumeFilter wchar[8][4]：驱动明确忽略该字段，按原样解出备查。
      s[f.name] = Array.from({ length: f.count }, (_, i) =>
        readWide(p, f.offset + i * f.len * 2, f.len),
      );
    } else {
      // [旧驱动兼容] 老驱动 RB_CONFIG 只有 152B、不含末尾纯追加的 TinyLFU，
      // 直接 readUInt32LE(152) 会 RangeError。0=OFF 缺省（新特性默认全关红线），
      // 是有意的向后兼容：只放宽这一个字段，其余字段仍按固定偏移严格解码、
      // 不静默吞其它错误。
      s[f.name] = f.name === 'TinyLFU'
        ? (p.length >= RB_CONFIG_SIZE ? p.readUInt32LE(f.offset) : 0)
        : p.readUInt32LE(f.offset);
    }
  }
  return s;
}
````

````js
const { execSync } = require('child_process');
const B = 'http://127.0.0.1:5199/rpc';
const rpc = async (m) => {
  const r = await fetch(B, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ method: m }) });
  return r.json();
};
(async () => {
  const s0 = (await rpc(1)).data;
  console.log(`前: ReadReq=${s0.ReadReq} ReadBytes=${(s0.ReadBytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)}MB HitBytes=${(s0.ReadHitBytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)}MB`);
  const exe = 'C:/Users/陈/Desktop/RAMBlockCache-V10.4.3-build19-源码包/src/ctl/ramboostctl.exe';
  const file = 'F:/Delta Force/Delta Force/DeltaForce/Content/Paks/pak-0-0-pakchunk20-WindowsClient.pak';
  execSync(`"${exe}" bench "${file}"`, { stdio: 'ignore' });
  const s1 = (await rpc(1)).data;
  const dReq = s1.ReadReq - s0.ReadReq;
  const dBytes = (s1.ReadBytes - s0.ReadBytes) / 1048576;
  const dHit = (s1.ReadHitBytes - s0.ReadHitBytes) / 1048576;
  console.log(`后: ReadReq=${s1.ReadReq} ReadBytes=${(s1.ReadBytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)}MB`);
  console.log(`增量: ReadReq+${dReq} · ReadBytes+${dBytes.toFixed(1)}MB · HitBytes+${dHit.toFixed(1)}MB`);
  console.log(dReq > 0 ? '★ 数据面接通！' : '✗ 数据面仍旁路');
  process.exit(0);
})().catch((e) => { console.log('ERR', e.message); process.exit(2); });
````

##### `src/ui/web/README.md`

````markdown
# RAMBlockCache Web 前端

> 状态：**六页全部实装、全链路联通驱动（2026-10-31）**——Node 27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0 +
> npm 12.2.1 + TS 7.0.2 + napi-rs 原生插件；状态/加速/收益/诊断/应急/设置六页 +
> 全部读写命令编码（SET_CONFIG/SET_VOLUME/ATTACH/INVALIDATE_RANGE）。
> 验证记录见 `deliverables/43-web-track-verification-2026-10-31.md`。
> 运行前提：`sc.exe start RAMBlockCache` + 桥接以管理员运行（见 `bridge/native/README.md`）。

## 依赖方向（单向，禁止反向）

```
src/main.tsx
  └─ app/（壳 + 路由）
       └─ features/（页面）
            ├─ state/driver-store.ts        会话级状态
            │    └─ bridge/http-transport.ts
            │         └─ bridge/transport.ts     接口
            │              └─ protocol/types.ts  类型
            │                   └─ protocol/constants.ts
            └─ styles/tokens.css            纯样式，无 TS 依赖

bridge/server（Hono，独立进程）──HTTP──> 被 http-transport 调用
bridge/native（napi-rs，未实现）──被──> bridge/server 加载
```

`src/` 与 `bridge/` 之间**没有任何 import 关系**，只有 HTTP。因此不存在循环依赖。

## 命令

```bash
node -v && npm -v          # Node 27 Alpha / npm 12.2.1
npm install                # 首次：生成 package-lock.json
npm run bridge             # 起本机桥接（当前 /rpc 返回 503，属预期）
npm run dev                # 起前端，http://localhost:5178
```

## 目录

| 路径 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `src/protocol/` | 协议常量与类型，唯一与 `rb_proto.h` 对应的 TS 层 |
| `src/bridge/` | 传输接口与 HTTP 实现，含 zod 运行时校验 |
| `src/state/` | 会话级状态（连接阶段、版本、最近错误） |
| `src/features/` | 页面。已迁移：状态 / 诊断 / 收益；剩余：加速 / 应急 / 设置 |
| `src/app/` | 壳、路由、导航 |
| `src/styles/` | 设计令牌（映射 `Theme/Dark.xaml`） |
| `bridge/server/` | 本机 HTTP 桥接，唯一触碰驱动的 Node 进程（须管理员运行） |
| `bridge/native/` | napi-rs 原生插件（**已实现**），`cargo build --release` 构建 |

## 当前边界

- 读命令 GET_VERSION/GET_STATS/GET_VOLUMES/GET_CONFIG 已结构化解码；
  GET_LOG/GET_EVENTS 解码与写命令 params 编码随页面迁移补齐（`bridge/server/index.ts` TODO）。
- 未挂载任何卷时统计为诚实全零、命中率「—」、延迟「未采样」，这是正确行为。
````

##### `src/ui/web/selftest.cjs`

````js
/**
 * Web 控制台全量自测（Phase 3）：经桥接 /rpc 对运行驱动逐命令核对，
 * 每条带预期断言（含 F1/F2/F4 的"预期拒绝"）。PASS/FAIL 表输出。
 * 运行：node selftest.cjs（需桥接在 5199 且已提权）
 */
const B = 'http://127.0.0.1:5199/rpc';
const rpc = async (m, p) => {
  const r = await fetch(B, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(p === undefined ? { method: m } : { method: m, params: p }),
  });
  return { http: r.status, ...(await r.json()) };
};

let pass = 0, fail = 0;
function check(name, cond, detail) {
  if (cond) { pass++; console.log(`  PASS  ${name}`); }
  else { fail++; console.log(`  FAIL  ${name} — ${detail}`); }
}

(async () => {
  console.log('== A. 读取面 ==');
  const v = await rpc(10);
  check('GET_VERSION status=0', v.status === 0);
  check('GET_VERSION 字段', v.data?.ProtocolVersion === 9 && v.data?.Major === 1 && v.data?.Build === 19 && v.data?.Name === 'RAMBlockCache');

  const st = await rpc(1);
  check('GET_STATS status=0', st.status === 0);
  check('GET_STATS StripeRead[64]', Array.isArray(st.data?.StripeRead) && st.data.StripeRead.length === 64);

  const cfg = await rpc(4);
  check('GET_CONFIG status=0', cfg.status === 0 && typeof cfg.data?.Enabled === 'number');
  check('GET_CONFIG VolumeFilter[8]', Array.isArray(cfg.data?.VolumeFilter) && cfg.data.VolumeFilter.length === 8);

  const vol = await rpc(7);
  check('GET_VOLUMES status=0', vol.status === 0 && typeof vol.data?.Count === 'number');

  const log = await rpc(9);
  check('GET_LOG status=0', log.status === 0 && Array.isArray(log.data?.Items));

  const ev = await rpc(14, { Cursor: 0, MaxCount: 64 });
  check('GET_EVENTS status=0 (游标编码)', ev.status === 0 && typeof ev.data?.Cursor === 'number');

  console.log('== B. 写命令面 ==');
  const fl = await rpc(3);
  check('FLUSH status=0', fl.status === 0);

  const es = await rpc(5);
  check('EXIT_SAFE_MODE status=0', es.status === 0);

  // SET_CONFIG 读改写对照（panic 态下 F2：驱动会降级——断言"被驱动接管"本身）
  const c1 = await rpc(4);
  const w = await rpc(2, c1.data);
  check('SET_CONFIG 提交 status=0', w.status === 0);
  const c2 = await rpc(4);
  check('SET_CONFIG panic 降级集生效（F2 断言）', c2.data.Enabled === 0 || c2.data.Enabled === c1.data.Enabled);

  console.log('== C. 预期拒绝面（fail-closed 行为断言）==');
  const pc = await rpc(12);
  const panicked = (await rpc(1)).data.PanicActive === 1;
  check('PANIC_CLEAR 拒绝（F1，panic 态）', panicked ? pc.status === -1 : pc.status === 0);

  const sv = await rpc(6, { Letter: 'D', ReadEnabled: 1, WriteEnabled: 1, WriteMode: 2 });
  check('SET_VOLUME 语义（挂载态幂等=0 / 未挂载=1168）', sv.status === 0 || (sv.status === -1 && /1168/.test(sv.message ?? '')));

  const at = await rpc(8, { Letter: 'D', Attach: 1, ReadEnabled: 1, WriteEnabled: 1, WriteMode: 2 });
  check('ATTACH 语义（挂载态幂等=0 / 未挂载=21）', at.status === 0 || (at.status === -1 && /21/.test(at.message ?? '')));

  console.log('== D. 输入门（zod）==');
  const badCursor = await rpc(14, { Cursor: -5 });
  check('负游标被 zod 拒绝', badCursor.status === -1 || badCursor.http === 400 || badCursor.http === 500);
  const badLetter = await rpc(8, { Letter: '', Attach: 1, ReadEnabled: 1, WriteEnabled: 1, WriteMode: 2 });
  check('空盘符被 zod 拒绝', badLetter.status === -1 || badLetter.http === 400 || badLetter.http === 500);

  console.log(`\n结果: PASS=${pass} FAIL=${fail}`);
  process.exit(fail === 0 ? 0 : 1);
})().catch((e) => { console.log('SELFTEST ERROR', e.message); process.exit(2); });
````

##### `src/ui/web/src/app/App.tsx`

````tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { NavLink, Outlet, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import { ErrorBoundary, type FallbackProps } from 'react-error-boundary';
import { useHotkeys } from 'react-hotkeys-hook';
import { useDriverStore } from '@state/driver-store';
import StatsPoller from './StatsPoller';
import ConfirmDialog from '@components/ConfirmDialog';
import ToastHost from '@components/ToastHost';
import GlobalAlertBanner from '@components/GlobalAlertBanner';
import { Badge, BrandMark, Button, Icons } from '@components/ui';
import { DUR, EASE, pageEnter, useMotion } from '@lib/motion';
import { LiquidGlassFilter } from '../components/LiquidGlassFilter';
import { useLiquidGlassPointer } from '../hooks/useLiquidGlassPointer';
import { useVisibilityAwarePoll } from '../hooks/useVisibilityAwarePoll';

/**
 * 应用壳（布局重做 2026-10-31）：
 * 弃"侧栏管理后台"老套结构 → **顶部指令条 + 居中内容画布**。
 *  - 指令条：品牌 + 药丸导航 + 连接状态徽标（玻璃质感，吸顶）
 *  - 内容：max-w 居中画布 + page-fade；ErrorBoundary 单页隔离
 *  - 错误反馈走 Toast + 指令条徽标，不再设底栏
 * 数据纪律不变：轮询单例（StatsPoller），页面只读观察。
 */

const NAV = [
  { to: '/status', label: '状态', icon: Icons.gauge },
  { to: '/volumes', label: '加速', icon: Icons.disk },
  { to: '/benefit', label: '收益', icon: Icons.trend },
  { to: '/diagnostics', label: '诊断', icon: Icons.pulse },
  { to: '/emergency', label: '应急', icon: Icons.shield },
  { to: '/settings', label: '设置', icon: Icons.sliders },
] as const;

export default function App() {
  const phase = useDriverStore((s) => s.phase);
  const version = useDriverStore((s) => s.version);
  const lastError = useDriverStore((s) => s.lastError);
  const connect = useDriverStore((s) => s.connect);
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  /* [A6] 全局动效偏好：页面转场与导航指示器统一归一化时长 */
  const { reduce } = useMotion();

  /* [235 Phase 2] 液态玻璃：根容器 ref 供指针追踪与 WPF 宿主桌面色消息使用。
   * 只追加 ref 与两个脱离文档流的装饰节点，绝不改 h-screen / overflow-hidden。 */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useLiquidGlassPointer(rootRef);

  useEffect(() => {
    void connect();
  }, [connect]);

  // 自动重连：离线/降级时 5s 重试握手（低频补偿控制通道 retry:0 纪律）。
  // [237] 改为可见性感知轮询：窗口隐藏/最小化时不留任何 5s 定时器。
  useVisibilityAwarePoll(
    () => { void connect(); },
    {
      intervalMs: 5000,
      enabled: phase === 'offline' || phase === 'degraded',
    },
  );

  // Alt+1..6 直达页面（react-hotkeys-hook，P1-5 键盘导航）
  const navCombos = NAV.map((_, i) => `alt+${i + 1}`).join(',');
  useHotkeys(
    navCombos,
    (_e, h) => {
      const idx = Number(h.keys?.[0]) - 1;
      const target = NAV[idx];
      if (target) navigate(target.to);
    },
    { preventDefault: true },
  );

  const connected = phase === 'online';

  return (
    /* [UI-2026-11-12] 从 `min-h-screen` 改为**固定视口高度 + 让 main 自己滚**。
     *
     * 原写法 `min-h-screen flex flex-col` 配合 tokens.css 的
     * `html, body, #root { height: 100% }`：`#root` 被钉死成视口高，
     * 而子元素的 `min-height:100vh` 又把内容撑出视口 —— 实测 703×770 下
     * 页面**完全滚不动**，"形状/延迟/环境"三段永远到不了（首屏底部
     * "TRIM 已处理"卡被切在视口边缘）。这是可访问性缺陷，不是观感问题。
     *
     * 正确的 app-shell：壳 = 100vh 且 overflow:hidden（内部不再产生文档流
     * 溢出），滚动条归 main 独占。附带好处：sticky header 不再需要 sticky，
     * 因为它本来就在不滚动的容器里。 */
    <div
      ref={rootRef}
      className="rbc-app-bg flex h-screen flex-col overflow-hidden"
      style={{ color: 'var(--rbc-text-primary)' }}
    >
      {/* Layer 0 桌面透光透色基底 + SVG 折射滤镜定义（均为脱离文档流的装饰节点） */}
      <div className="rbc-desktop-bleed-canvas" aria-hidden="true" />
      <LiquidGlassFilter />
      <StatsPoller />
      <ConfirmDialog />
      <ToastHost />
      <GlobalAlertBanner />

      {/* —— 顶部指令条 —— */}
      <header
        className="rbc-glass z-40 shrink-0"
        style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--rbc-border)' }}
      >
        <div
          className="mx-auto flex min-h-14 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 px-4 py-1.5"
          style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 'var(--rbc-canvas-max)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2.5 whitespace-nowrap">
            <BrandMark size={24} />
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">RAMBlockCache</span>
            <Badge tone="neutral">{version ? `v${version.Major}.${version.Minor} Build${version.Build}` : '未握手'}</Badge>
          </div>

          {/* [UI-2026-11-12] nav 允许换行（flex-wrap）而不是横向滚动。
              原因：横向滚动在 703px 宽下会把"诊断/应急/设置"三个板块推到
              可视区外，而滚动条被隐藏 ⇒ 用户根本不知道还有三页。
              换成换行后任何宽度下 6 个板块都可见。 */}
          <nav
            className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-wrap items-center gap-1"
            aria-label="主导航"
          >
            {NAV.map(({ to, label, icon: Icon }, i) => (
              <NavLink
                key={to}
                to={to}
                title={`${label}（Alt+${i + 1}）`}
                /* [UI-2026-11-12] 原为 !rounded-[--rbc-radius-pill]：999px 胶囊
                 * 是 SaaS 后台语汇。本控制台的定调是工业仪器盘（窄圆角 + 发丝边），
                 * 所以改成 4px 方角；快捷键在 title 里可发现（此前 Alt+1..6 只能靠读源码）。 */
                className="rbc-nav-item relative !rounded-[var(--rbc-radius-sm)] !px-3 !py-1.5"
              >
                {({ isActive }) => (
                  <>
                    {isActive && (
                      <motion.span
                        layoutId="nav-pill"
                        className="absolute inset-0 rounded-[var(--rbc-radius-sm)]"
                        style={{
                          background: 'var(--rbc-accent-subtle)',
                          /* 原为 rgba(15,134,224,0.28) 冷蓝 —— 压在琥珀底上撞色 */
                          border: '1px solid var(--rbc-accent-border)',
                        }}
                        /* [A6] 原为硬编码 spring；减弱动效时退化为瞬时（duration 0
                           不可用于 spring，改用 tween 长度 0 才真正无动画）。 */
                        transition={
                          reduce
                            ? { duration: 0 }
                            : { type: 'spring', stiffness: 420, damping: 34 }
                        }
                      />
                    )}
                    <span
                      className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-1.5"
                      style={{ color: isActive ? 'var(--rbc-accent)' : undefined }}
                    >
                      <Icon size={15} />
                      <span>{label}</span>
                    </span>
                  </>
                )}
              </NavLink>
            ))}
          </nav>

          {/* 连接状态徽标：点 + 阶段；错误时红色可悬停查看 */}
          <div
            title={lastError ? `最近错误：${lastError.message}` : undefined}
            className="rbc-liquid-pill flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-[var(--rbc-radius-pill)] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs"
            style={{
              background: connected
                ? 'var(--rbc-success-bg)'
                : phase === 'degraded'
                  ? 'var(--rbc-warning-bg)'
                  : 'var(--rbc-danger-bg)',
              border: `1px solid ${
                connected
                  ? 'var(--rbc-success-border)'
                  : phase === 'degraded'
                    ? 'var(--rbc-warning-border)'
                    : 'var(--rbc-danger-border)'
              }`,
              color: connected
                ? 'var(--rbc-success-fg)'
                : phase === 'degraded'
                  ? 'var(--rbc-warning-fg)'
                  : 'var(--rbc-danger-fg)',
            }}
          >
            <span
              aria-hidden
              className={connected ? 'rbc-pulse-dot' : ''}
              style={{
                width: 7,
                height: 7,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                background: 'currentColor',
              }}
            />
            {phaseLabel(phase)}
            {version && <span className="font-mono">· 协议 v{version.ProtocolVersion}</span>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* —— 内容画布 —— */}
      {/* 唯一的滚动容器：main 自己滚，页面内部不再与文档流抢滚动条 */}
      <main className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
        <div
          className="mx-auto w-full p-5"
          style={{ maxWidth: 'var(--rbc-canvas-max)' }}
        >
        <ErrorBoundary
          fallbackRender={(p: FallbackProps) =>
            isStaleChunkError(p.error) ? (
              <StaleChunkRecovery />
            ) : (
              <div className="rbc-card flex flex-col items-start gap-3 p-6" role="alert">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--rbc-danger-fg)' }}>
                  页面渲染异常
                </h2>
                <pre
                  className="max-h-40 overflow-auto font-mono text-xs"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--rbc-text-tertiary)' }}
                >
                  {(p.error as Error).message}
                </pre>
                <Button tone="secondary" onClick={() => p.resetErrorBoundary()}>
                  重试渲染
                </Button>
              </div>
            )
          }
          resetKeys={[location.pathname]}
        >
          {/* [FIX 2026-10-31] 页面级 motion 淡入在 hash 路由切换后可能滞留 opacity:0
              （与卡片级 .rbc-fade-up 双层动画叠加，实测标题透明）。移除页面级动画，
              入场动效由卡片级 rbc-fade-up 单层承担——确定性优先。

              [A6 2026-11-11] 恢复页面转场，但按"只入场、不退出"实现。
              三条约束直接对应上面那次事故：
               1. key 绑 pathname → 每次导航重建容器，入场动画必然重新触发
                  （复用同一节点时 initial 不重放，动画看似"没生效"）；
               2. 不使用 AnimatePresence / exit：退出动画是"节点已卸载但仍在
                  动画"的状态，正是 opacity 残留的高发区。旧页即时卸载，
                  新页从 initial 入场 —— 没有中间态；
               3. 容器只动 opacity/y，终态显式写死 opacity:1（见 pageEnter），
                  不依赖动画完成回调；即使被打断也停在可见态。
              容器内子元素的 `.rbc-fade-up` 保留：它动的是同一属性但由 CSS
              单层控制，与容器的 motion 分属不同元素，不构成"双写"。
              减弱动效时 duration=0，容器以终态直接挂载。 */}
          <motion.div
            key={location.pathname}
            variants={pageEnter}
            initial="initial"
            animate="animate"
            transition={{ duration: reduce ? 0 : DUR.slow, ease: EASE.decel }}
          >
            <Outlet />
          </motion.div>
        </ErrorBoundary>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

function phaseLabel(phase: string): string {
  switch (phase) {
    case 'online':
      return '已连接';
    case 'connecting':
      return '握手中';
    case 'degraded':
      return '降级运行';
    case 'offline':
      return '未连接';
    default:
      return '待握手';
  }
}

/**
 * [UI-2026-11-12] 「构建产物已更新」自愈。
 *
 * 现象（本轮实测）：`vite build` 重新生成 dist 后，已经打开的控制台仍持有旧
 * `index-*.js` 里的 chunk 名表；点侧栏切到懒加载路由时请求
 * `/assets/VolumesPage-<旧hash>.js` → 404 → 路由抛
 * `Failed to fetch dynamically imported module`，ErrorBoundary 显示
 * 「页面渲染异常 / 重试渲染」。但**重试永远失败**——它拿的还是同一张旧表。
 *
 * 唯一出路是整页 reload（重新拉 index.html 拿到新表）。这里是本地桥接服务的
 * 控制台，dist 会被反复重建，所以必须自动恢复而不是让用户对着红色报错发愣。
 * 用 sessionStorage 记一次时间戳，15 秒内不重复自动 reload，避免真死循环。
 */
function StaleChunkRecovery() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const KEY = 'rbc.staleChunkRetryAt';
    let last = 0;
    try {
      last = Number(window.sessionStorage.getItem(KEY) ?? 0);
    } catch {
      /* 隐私模式下 sessionStorage 可能抛，退化为"每次都 reload"一次机会 */
    }
    if (Date.now() - last < 15000) return;
    try {
      window.sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, String(Date.now()));
    } catch {
      /* 同上 */
    }
    window.location.reload();
  }, []);
  return (
    <div className="rbc-card p-6 text-sm" role="status" style={{ color: 'var(--rbc-text-secondary)' }}>
      控制台已更新，正在重新加载…
    </div>
  );
}

/** 识别「chunk 已失效」这一类错误（不同打包器/浏览器措辞不同） */
function isStaleChunkError(err: unknown): boolean {
  const m = String((err as Error)?.message ?? '');
  return /dynamically imported module|Importing a module script failed|ChunkLoadError|Loading chunk \d+ failed/i.test(m);
}
````

````tsx
import { createHashRouter, Navigate } from 'react-router';
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import App from './App';

// [PERF-UI 2026-11-04] 路由级代码分割：六页静态 import 使单 chunk 超 500KB
// （构建警告），首屏要下载解析全部页面代码。lazy 化后首屏只载当前页，
// 其余按需——本地 HTTP 虽快，解析成本仍是首屏延迟的大头。
const StatusPage = lazy(() => import('@features/status/StatusPage'));
const DiagnosticsPage = lazy(() => import('@features/diagnostics/DiagnosticsPage'));
const BenefitPage = lazy(() => import('@features/benefit/BenefitPage'));
const VolumesPage = lazy(() => import('@features/volumes/VolumesPage'));
const EmergencyPage = lazy(() => import('@features/emergency/EmergencyPage'));
const SettingsPage = lazy(() => import('@features/settings/SettingsPage'));

// 采用 Hash 路由：本地桌面场景可能以 file:// 或自定义 scheme 加载，
// Browser 路由在非 HTTP 环境下会失配。六页全部实装（2026-10-31）。
function PageFallback() {
  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 32, color: 'var(--rbc-text-secondary, #666)' }}>
      加载页面…
    </div>
  );
}

export const router = createHashRouter([
  {
    path: '/',
    element: <App />,
    children: [
      { index: true, element: <Navigate to="/status" replace /> },
      { path: 'status', element: <Suspense fallback={<PageFallback />}><StatusPage /></Suspense> },
      { path: 'volumes', element: <Suspense fallback={<PageFallback />}><VolumesPage /></Suspense> },
      { path: 'benefit', element: <Suspense fallback={<PageFallback />}><BenefitPage /></Suspense> },
      { path: 'diagnostics', element: <Suspense fallback={<PageFallback />}><DiagnosticsPage /></Suspense> },
      { path: 'emergency', element: <Suspense fallback={<PageFallback />}><EmergencyPage /></Suspense> },
      { path: 'settings', element: <Suspense fallback={<PageFallback />}><SettingsPage /></Suspense> },
      { path: '*', element: <Navigate to="/status" replace /> },
    ],
  },
]);
````

##### `src/ui/web/src/app/StatsPoller.tsx`

````tsx
import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useDriverStore } from '@state/driver-store';
import { recordStatsSample } from '@state/stats-history';

/**
 * 全局唯一统计轮询（1s）+ 卷枚举轮询（5s）。
 *
 * [FIX 2026-10-31] 统计查询从 StatusPage 上移至此：react-query 的去重只覆盖
 * "并发在飞"的请求，两个页面各自挂 refetchInterval 会形成双倍 IOCTL 节奏。
 * 挂在 App 后全应用只有这一路 1s 轮询，页面一律作为只读观察者消费缓存。
 * 卷枚举同理收编（5s：低频变化），加速页改为观察者 + 手动刷新。
 */
export default function StatsPoller() {
  const transport = useDriverStore((s) => s.transport);
  const reportError = useDriverStore((s) => s.reportError);
  const reportSuccess = useDriverStore((s) => s.reportSuccess);

  useQuery({
    queryKey: ['rb', 'stats'],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const result = await transport.getStats();
      if (!result.ok) {
        reportError(result.error);
        throw new Error(result.error.message);
      }
      reportSuccess();
      recordStatsSample(result.value);
      return result.value;
    },
    refetchInterval: 1000,
    refetchIntervalInBackground: false,
    retry: 0,
  });

  useQuery({
    queryKey: ['rb', 'volumes'],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const result = await transport.getVolumes();
      if (!result.ok) {
        // 卷枚举失败不污染全局连接态（统计轮询已负责上报），静默抛给观察者
        throw new Error(result.error.message);
      }
      return result.value;
    },
    refetchInterval: 5000,
    refetchIntervalInBackground: false,
    /* [PERF-UI 2026-11-04] 慢命令期间桥接排队 → 轮询超时不是故障：
     * 保留上一份数据继续显示（placeholderData）、失败不覆盖已知状态、
     * 重试一次。只有连续失败才会真正进入 error 态。 */
    retry: 1,
    retryDelay: 400,
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  });

  return null;
}
````

##### `src/ui/web/src/bridge/config-orchestrator.test.ts`

````ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { RbConfig, RbVolumeAttach } from '@protocol/types';
import type { Result } from './transport';
import {
  VALID_BLOCK_SIZES,
  PartialSettingsCommitError,
  commitSequentialEngineSettings,
  commitUnifiedConfig,
  validateAndSanitizeIntent,
  type BootPolicy,
  type CommandResult,
  type OrchestratorPorts,
  type RbfFeatName,
  type UnifiedEngineIntent,
} from './config-orchestrator';

const ok: CommandResult = { ok: true };
const cfg = (blockSize: number) => ({ BlockSize: blockSize }) as unknown as RbConfig;
const intent = (over: Partial<UnifiedEngineIntent> = {}): UnifiedEngineIntent => ({
  config: cfg(4096),
  featureFlags: 0x1 | 0x2,
  ...over,
});

function ports() {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  const p: OrchestratorPorts = {
    setConfig: vi.fn(async (_input: RbConfig) => { calls.push('SET_CONFIG'); return ok; }),
    setBootPolicy: vi.fn(async (_next: BootPolicy) => { calls.push('BOOTCFG'); return ok; }),
    attachVolume: vi.fn(async (_input: RbVolumeAttach) => { calls.push('ATTACH'); return ok; }),
    setFeature: vi.fn(async (_name: RbfFeatName, _on: boolean) => { calls.push('RBFEAT'); return ok; }),
  };
  return { p, calls };
}

describe('validateAndSanitizeIntent (R4 / R5 / R6 boundary)', () => {
  it('rejects 131072 and any size outside the whitelist', () => {
    const r = validateAndSanitizeIntent(intent({ config: cfg(131072) }));
    expect(r.valid).toBe(false);
    expect(r.error).toContain('131072');
    expect(VALID_BLOCK_SIZES).toEqual([4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536]);
  });

  it('strips WBCOAL (R4) and L2 while keeping PREFETCH|HOT', () => {
    const r = validateAndSanitizeIntent(intent({ featureFlags: 0x1 | 0x2 | 0x4 | 0x8 | 0x10 }));
    expect(r.valid).toBe(true);
    expect(r.sanitizedFlags).toBe(0x3);
    expect(r.warnings.join(' ')).toContain('R4');
  });

  it('normalizes letters: drops C:, de-duplicates, sorts, keeps D-Z only', () => {
    const r = validateAndSanitizeIntent(intent({ attachLetters: ['e:', 'D:\\', 'C:', 'e', '1'] }));
    expect(r.normalizedLetters).toEqual(['D', 'E']);
  });

  it('produces one /rb/rbfeat step per exposed feature name', () => {
    const r = validateAndSanitizeIntent(intent({ featureFlags: 0x1 | 0x20 }));
    expect(r.featureSteps).toEqual([
      { name: 'PREFETCH', on: true },
      { name: 'HOT', on: false },
      { name: 'THERMAL', on: false },
      { name: 'ETW', on: true },
    ]);
  });
});

describe('commitUnifiedConfig (real channels only)', () => {
  it('commits SET_CONFIG -> bootcfg -> method-8 attach -> per-name rbfeat in order', async () => {
    const { p, calls } = ports();
    const r = await commitUnifiedConfig(intent({
      config: cfg(65536),
      bootPolicy: { AutoAttach: 1, ResumeOnBoot: 1 },
      attachLetters: ['D:', 'E'],
    }), p);

    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(r.stepsExecuted[0]).toBe('SET_CONFIG');
    expect(r.stepsExecuted[1]).toBe('POST /rb/bootcfg');
    expect(r.stepsExecuted).toContain('ATTACH_VOLUME D:');
    expect(r.stepsExecuted).toContain('/rb/rbfeat PREFETCH=on');
    expect(calls[0]).toBe('SET_CONFIG');

    // /rb/bootcfg does NOT accept ResumeLetters; letters go through ATTACH_VOLUME.
    const policy = vi.mocked(p.setBootPolicy).mock.calls[0]![0];
    expect(policy).toEqual({ AutoAttach: 1, ResumeOnBoot: 1 });
    expect(policy).not.toHaveProperty('ResumeLetters');
    expect(vi.mocked(p.attachVolume).mock.calls[0]![0]).toMatchObject({ Letter: 'D', Attach: 1 });
  });

    const { p } = ports();
    vi.mocked(p.setConfig).mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: false, error: { message: 'denied' } });
    const r = await commitUnifiedConfig(intent({ attachLetters: ['D'] }), p);
    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    expect(r.stepsExecuted).toEqual([]);
    expect(p.setBootPolicy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(p.attachVolume).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(p.setFeature).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

/* [243 2026-11-15] The sequential coordinator that SettingsPage.onSaved now calls.
 * It must stay fail-closed, must not invent routes, and must not report a
 * /rb/rbfeat CLI failure (HTTP 200 + code != 0) as success. */
describe('commitSequentialEngineSettings (SettingsPage save path)', () => {
  const okVoid: Result<void> = { ok: true, value: undefined };
  const seq = (blockSize: number) => ({ BlockSize: blockSize }) as unknown as RbConfig;

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it('rejects 131072 before any byte leaves the control plane (R6)', async () => {
    const push = vi.fn(async () => okVoid);

      commitSequentialEngineSettings(push, { config: seq(131072) }),
    ).rejects.toThrow(/R6/);
    expect(push).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects WBCOAL at the boundary (R4)', async () => {
    const push = vi.fn(async () => okVoid);

    ).rejects.toThrow(/R4/);
    expect(push).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

    const fetchMock = vi.fn();
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    const push = vi.fn(async () => okVoid);

    expect(r.steps).toEqual(['SET_CONFIG(method=2)']);
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

      json: async () => ({ code: -1, out: 'rbfeatctl.exe not found' }),

      config: seq(4096),
      features: { PREFETCH: true },

    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(PartialSettingsCommitError);
    const partial = err as PartialSettingsCommitError;
    expect(partial.completedSteps).toEqual(['SET_CONFIG(method=2)']);
    expect(partial.engineConfigApplied).toBe(true);
    expect(partial.message).toContain('code=-1');

    const push = vi.fn(async (): Promise<Result<void>> => ({
      ok: false,

    }));

    expect((err as PartialSettingsCommitError).engineConfigApplied).toBe(false);
    expect((err as PartialSettingsCommitError).message).toBe('denied');
  });
});
````

````ts
/**
 * Control-plane orchestration for the three REAL channels in this repository.
 *
 * Origin: deliverables/240-full-stack-architecture-guidance-2026-11-14.md
 * module 2. The sample in that document was NOT copied: it posted to
 * `/rb/config` and `/rb/features` (neither route exists) and described
 * `method: 8` as "bootcfg restore". The real wiring is:
 *   - SET_CONFIG            -> transport.setConfig()        -> /rb/rpc method 2
 *   - GET_VOLUMES           -> transport.getVolumes()       -> /rb/rpc method 7
 *   - ATTACH_VOLUME         -> transport.attachVolume()     -> /rb/rpc method 8
 *   - boot policy           -> POST /rb/bootcfg {AutoAttach, ResumeOnBoot}
 *     (the route does NOT accept ResumeLetters; letters are attached per volume)
 *   - feature bits          -> POST /rb/rbfeat {name, on}   (per-name whitelist)
 *
 * All side effects are injected through ports, so this module is testable
 * without a live driver and never guesses a route or a drive letter.
 */
import { RB_WRITEMODE } from '@protocol/constants';
import type { RbConfig, RbVolumeAttach } from '@protocol/types';
import type { Result } from './transport';

export const VALID_BLOCK_SIZES = [4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536] as const;
export type ValidBlockSize = (typeof VALID_BLOCK_SIZES)[number];

/** Mirrors src/driver/rb_common2.h; checked by Gate23 check_ts_proto_sync.py. */
export const RB2_FLAGS = {
  PREFETCH: 0x1,
  HOT: 0x2,
  L2: 0x4,
  WBCOAL: 0x8, // R4: never enable
  MEMGUARD: 0x10,
  ETW: 0x20,
  THERMAL: 0x40,
} as const;

/** Names accepted by POST /rb/rbfeat (bridge/server/index.ts whitelist). */
export const RBFEAT_SETTABLE = ['PREFETCH', 'HOT', 'THERMAL', 'ETW'] as const;
export type RbfFeatName = (typeof RBFEAT_SETTABLE)[number];

export interface CommandResult {
  ok: boolean;
  error?: { message: string } | undefined;
}

export interface BootPolicy {
  AutoAttach?: number | undefined;
  ResumeOnBoot?: number | undefined;
}

export interface UnifiedEngineIntent {
  config: RbConfig;
  featureFlags: number;
  bootPolicy?: BootPolicy | undefined;
  attachLetters?: string[] | undefined;
}

export interface OrchestratorPorts {
  setConfig(input: RbConfig): Promise<CommandResult>;
  setBootPolicy(next: BootPolicy): Promise<CommandResult>;
  attachVolume(input: RbVolumeAttach): Promise<CommandResult>;
  setFeature(name: RbfFeatName, on: boolean): Promise<CommandResult>;
}

export interface SanitizedIntent {
  valid: boolean;
  error?: string | undefined;
  sanitizedFlags: number;
  warnings: string[];
  normalizedLetters: string[];
  featureSteps: Array<{ name: RbfFeatName; on: boolean }>;
}

/** Red-line gate at the boundary (R4 / R5 / R6) before anything is written. */
export function validateAndSanitizeIntent(intent: UnifiedEngineIntent): SanitizedIntent {
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const blockSize = intent.config.BlockSize;
  if (!VALID_BLOCK_SIZES.includes(blockSize as ValidBlockSize)) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      error: `BlockSize=${blockSize} rejected: only ${VALID_BLOCK_SIZES.join('/')} are allowed (131072 is permanently banned, R6).`,
      sanitizedFlags: 0,
      warnings,
      normalizedLetters: [],
      featureSteps: [],
    };
  }

  let flags = intent.featureFlags >>> 0;
  if ((flags & RB2_FLAGS.WBCOAL) !== 0) {
    flags &= ~RB2_FLAGS.WBCOAL;
    warnings.push('R4: WBCOAL (0x8) stripped; never enabled from the control plane.');
  }
  if ((flags & RB2_FLAGS.MEMGUARD) !== 0) {
    flags &= ~RB2_FLAGS.MEMGUARD;
    warnings.push('MEMGUARD (0x10) stripped; the kernel discards it and /rb/rbfeat does not expose it.');
  }
  if ((flags & RB2_FLAGS.L2) !== 0) {
    flags &= ~RB2_FLAGS.L2;
    warnings.push('L2 (0x4) not settable via /rb/rbfeat; Phase 4 kernel freeze keeps it off.');
  }

  // System/boot volume C: is always excluded; only real D-Z letters survive.
  const normalizedLetters = Array.from(
    new Set(
      (intent.attachLetters ?? [])
        .map((raw) => raw.trim().replace(/[:\\/]+$/g, '').toUpperCase())
        .filter((letter) => /^[D-Z]$/.test(letter)),
    ),
  ).sort();

  const featureSteps = RBFEAT_SETTABLE.map((name) => ({
    name,
    on: (flags & RB2_FLAGS[name as keyof typeof RB2_FLAGS]) !== 0,
  }));

  return {
    valid: true,
    sanitizedFlags: flags,
    warnings,
    normalizedLetters,
    featureSteps,
  };
}

export interface OrchestratorResult {
  ok: boolean;
  sanitizedFeatureFlags: number;
  stepsExecuted: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  error?: string | undefined;
}

/**
 * Serial commit, fail-closed on the first failing step. No step is retried:
 * SET_CONFIG and ATTACH_VOLUME have kernel side effects.
 */
export async function commitUnifiedConfig(
  intent: UnifiedEngineIntent,
  ports: OrchestratorPorts,
): Promise<OrchestratorResult> {
  const check = validateAndSanitizeIntent(intent);
  if (!check.valid) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      sanitizedFeatureFlags: 0,
      stepsExecuted: [],
      warnings: check.warnings,
      error: check.error,
    };
  }

  const steps: string[] = [];
  const run = async (label: string, action: () => Promise<CommandResult>): Promise<boolean> => {
    const r = await action();
    if (!r.ok) return false;
    steps.push(label);
    return true;
  };

  if (!(await run('SET_CONFIG', () => ports.setConfig(intent.config)))) {
    return { ok: false, sanitizedFeatureFlags: check.sanitizedFlags, stepsExecuted: steps, warnings: check.warnings, error: 'SET_CONFIG failed' };
  }

  if (intent.bootPolicy) {
    // /rb/bootcfg accepts ONLY AutoAttach / ResumeOnBoot. ResumeLetters is a
    // read-only field; attaching letters is done explicitly below.
    const policy: BootPolicy = {
      AutoAttach: intent.bootPolicy.AutoAttach,
      ResumeOnBoot: intent.bootPolicy.ResumeOnBoot,
    };
    if (!(await run('POST /rb/bootcfg', () => ports.setBootPolicy(policy)))) {
      return { ok: false, sanitizedFeatureFlags: check.sanitizedFlags, stepsExecuted: steps, warnings: check.warnings, error: 'boot policy update failed' };
    }
  }

  for (const letter of check.normalizedLetters) {
    const input: RbVolumeAttach = {
      Letter: letter,
      Attach: 1,
      ReadEnabled: 1,
      WriteEnabled: 1,
      WriteMode: RB_WRITEMODE.GLOBAL,
    };
    if (!(await run(`ATTACH_VOLUME ${letter}:`, () => ports.attachVolume(input)))) {
      return { ok: false, sanitizedFeatureFlags: check.sanitizedFlags, stepsExecuted: steps, warnings: check.warnings, error: `attach ${letter}: failed` };
    }
  }

  for (const step of check.featureSteps) {
    if (!(await run(`/rb/rbfeat ${step.name}=${step.on ? 'on' : 'off'}`, () => ports.setFeature(step.name, step.on)))) {
      return { ok: false, sanitizedFeatureFlags: check.sanitizedFlags, stepsExecuted: steps, warnings: check.warnings, error: `feature ${step.name} failed` };
    }
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    sanitizedFeatureFlags: check.sanitizedFlags,
    stepsExecuted: steps,
    warnings: check.warnings,
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// [243 APPEND 2026-11-15] Sequential engine settings coordinator.
// Origin: deliverables/243-ios26-liquid-glass-and-fullstack-wiring-2026-11-15.md 4.2
//
// Wired into SettingsPage.onSaved. All 13 exports above are untouched, so the
// 11 existing unit tests keep passing. Step 1 goes through the injected
// transport port ( /rb/rpc method 2 ). Steps 2 and 3 reuse the SAME relative
// fetch calls SettingsPage already uses for /rb/bootcfg and /rb/rbfeat, because
// /rb/rbfeat always answers HTTP 200 with { code, out } - checking res.ok alone
// would report a CLI failure as success.
// ============================================================================

export type SafeFeatureName = 'PREFETCH' | 'HOT' | 'THERMAL' | 'ETW';

export interface BootCfgIntent {
  AutoAttach: number;
  ResumeOnBoot: number;
}

export interface SequentialSavePayload {
  config: RbConfig;
  bootCfg?: BootCfgIntent | undefined;
  features?: Partial<Record<SafeFeatureName | 'WBCOAL', boolean>> | undefined;
}

export class PartialSettingsCommitError extends Error {
  public readonly completedSteps: string[];
  public readonly engineConfigApplied: boolean;

  constructor(message: string, completedSteps: string[]) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'PartialSettingsCommitError';
    this.completedSteps = completedSteps;
    this.engineConfigApplied = completedSteps.includes('SET_CONFIG(method=2)');
  }
}

/** Red-line gate (R4 / R6) before any byte leaves the control plane. */
export function assertSafeEnginePayload(payload: SequentialSavePayload): void {
  const bs = payload.config.BlockSize;
  if (bs === 131072 || !VALID_BLOCK_SIZES.includes(bs as ValidBlockSize)) {
    throw new Error(
      `红线 R6 拦截：BlockSize=${bs} 非法，仅允许 4096/8192/16384/32768/65536（131072 永久禁用）。`,
    );
  }
  if (payload.features && 'WBCOAL' in payload.features && payload.features.WBCOAL !== undefined) {
    throw new Error('红线 R4 拦截：WBCOAL 特性位已被永久禁开，禁止通过设置界面下发。');
  }
}

/**
 * Serial commit: SET_CONFIG (method 2) -> /rb/bootcfg -> /rb/rbfeat.
 * Fail-closed on the first failure; when the engine config already landed the
 * caller gets PartialSettingsCommitError so the UI can say "written but not
 * fully synced" instead of a blanket "save failed".
 */
export async function commitSequentialEngineSettings(
  setConfigFn: (cfg: RbConfig) => Promise<Result<void>>,
  payload: SequentialSavePayload,
): Promise<{ steps: string[] }> {
  assertSafeEnginePayload(payload);
  const steps: string[] = [];

  // Step 1: full RB_CONFIG write through the real transport (/rb/rpc method 2).
  const cfgRes = await setConfigFn(payload.config);
  if (!cfgRes.ok) {
    throw new PartialSettingsCommitError(
      cfgRes.error.message || 'SET_CONFIG 返回失败',
      steps,
    );
  }
  steps.push('SET_CONFIG(method=2)');

  // Step 2: only when the boot policy query has actually loaded. Passing
  // {0,0} on an undefined query would silently clear the user's AutoAttach.
  if (payload.bootCfg) {
    const bootRes = await fetch('/rb/bootcfg', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        AutoAttach: payload.bootCfg.AutoAttach ? 1 : 0,
        ResumeOnBoot: payload.bootCfg.ResumeOnBoot ? 1 : 0,
      }),
    });
    if (!bootRes.ok) {
      throw new PartialSettingsCommitError(
        `同步开机挂载策略 (/rb/bootcfg) 失败: HTTP ${bootRes.status}`,
        steps,
      );
    }
    steps.push('POST /rb/bootcfg');
  }

  // Step 3: per-name feature bits; /rb/rbfeat answers HTTP 200 with { code, out }.
  if (payload.features) {
    const allowedKeys: SafeFeatureName[] = ['PREFETCH', 'HOT', 'THERMAL', 'ETW'];
    for (const name of allowedKeys) {
      const on = payload.features[name];
      if (typeof on !== 'boolean') continue;
      const featRes = await fetch('/rb/rbfeat', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name, on }),
      });
      const body = (await featRes.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { code?: number; out?: string };
      if (!featRes.ok || body.code !== 0) {
        throw new PartialSettingsCommitError(
          `同步特性位 ${name}=${on ? 1 : 0} (/rb/rbfeat) 失败: HTTP ${featRes.status}, code=${
            body.code ?? 'n/a'
          } ${body.out ?? ''}`.trim(),
          steps,
        );
      }
      steps.push(`POST /rb/rbfeat(${name}=${on ? 1 : 0})`);
    }
  }

  return { steps };
}
````
