##### `src/scripts/analyze_bugcheck_dump.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""单机内核转储点名脚本（fail-closed）

用途：把 128 号 §5 的结论做成可运行链路 —— 发生池腐坏后，**不需要双机
WinDbg**，在本机用 cdb 离线打开完整内核转储即可读 Verifier Pool Tracking
记录的分配调用栈，点名 ExAllocatePool2 调用点。

用法：
  python analyze_bugcheck_dump.py [dump_path]
  python analyze_bugcheck_dump.py --all          # 批量分析 o9\\dumps 全部 dump
  python analyze_bugcheck_dump.py --out <json>   # 指定结果文件

判据（fail-closed，triage 一律不宣称点名）：
  POINTED     完整转储 + !verifier 3 有 Verifier 列表 + 出现我方分配栈帧
  INSUFFICIENT 其余全部，附带逐条 reason 与下一步指引

安全：只读，不重启、不部署、不改配置、不触发崩溃。
"""
import argparse
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

CDB = Path(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Debuggers\x64\cdb.exe")
PDB_ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\Public\o9\pdb")
DUMP_COPY = Path(r"C:\Users\Public\o9\dumps")
FULL_DUMP = Path(r"C:\Windows\MEMORY.DMP")
MINIDUMP = Path(r"C:\Windows\Minidump")
OUT_DIR = Path(r"C:\Users\Public\o9\stress")
SYM_STORE = r"srv*C:\symbols*https://msdl.microsoft.com/download/symbols"
COMMANDS = "!analyze -v; !verifier 3; lm m RAMBlock*; q"
FULL_DUMP_MIN_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024


def pdb_dirs():
    dirs = [str(PDB_ROOT)]
    if PDB_ROOT.is_dir():
        dirs += sorted(str(p) for p in PDB_ROOT.iterdir()
                       if p.is_dir() and (p / "RAMBlockCache.pdb").is_file())
    return dirs


def find_dumps(explicit=None, all_dumps=False):
    if explicit:
        return [Path(explicit)]
    if all_dumps:
        return sorted(DUMP_COPY.glob("*.dmp"))
    if FULL_DUMP.is_file() and FULL_DUMP.stat().st_size >= FULL_DUMP_MIN_BYTES:
        return [FULL_DUMP]
    if MINIDUMP.is_dir():
        ds = sorted(MINIDUMP.glob("*.dmp"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime,
                    reverse=True)
        if ds:
            return [ds[0]]
    return []


def classify(r, text, cdb_exit=0):
    """纯解析/判据。抽成独立函数以便 --self-test 提供阳性对照文本。"""
    r["cdb_exit"] = cdb_exit
    r["cdb_lines"] = len(text.splitlines())

    m = re.search(r"^BUGCHECK_CODE:\s*([0-9a-fA-F]+)", text, re.M)
    r["bugcheck"] = m.group(1) if m else None
    m = re.search(r"^ExceptionAddress:\s*(\S+)\s*\(([^)]*)\)", text, re.M)
    r["exception_address"] = m.group(1) if m else None
    r["faulting_symbol"] = m.group(2) if m else None
    m = re.search(r"^FAILURE_BUCKET_ID:\s*(.+)$", text, re.M)
    r["failure_bucket"] = m.group(1).strip() if m else None

    triage = ("Kernel Generated Triage Dump" in text or
              "Mini Kernel Dump File: Only registers" in text)
    verifier_ok = "Unable to get verifier list" not in text
    our_module = bool(re.search(r"^\s*[0-9a-f`]+\s+[0-9a-f`]+\s+RAMBlockCache\s",
                                text, re.M))
    alloc_frames = [l.strip() for l in text.splitlines()
                    if "RAMBlockCache!" in l and
                    re.search(r"ExAllocate|Rb2Alloc|RbLog|Pool", l, re.I)]
    r.update({"triage": triage, "verifier_list_available": verifier_ok,
              "our_module_in_dump": our_module,
              "pool_alloc_frames": alloc_frames[:8],
              "full_dump_by_size": r["size_bytes"] >= FULL_DUMP_MIN_BYTES})

    reasons = []
    if triage:
        reasons.append("Kernel Generated Triage Dump：只含寄存器与栈，无完整内核内存"
                       "，Pool Tracking 分配栈不可恢复")
    if not r["full_dump_by_size"]:
        reasons.append("dump 小于 64 MiB，不是完整内核转储"
                       "（CrashDumpEnabled=2 的完整转储通常远大于此）")
    if not verifier_ok:
        reasons.append("!verifier 3 报 Unable to get verifier list："
                       "无法读取 Verifier Pool Tracking 分配调用栈")
    if not alloc_frames:
        reasons.append("未出现我方分配栈帧，不能把被腐坏块的"
                       "ExAllocatePool2 调用点点名")
    if not reasons and our_module:
        r["VERDICT"] = "POINTED"
        r["reasons"] = ["完整转储 + Verifier 分配栈可用；"
                        "以 pool_alloc_frames 为准精确点名"]
    else:
        r["VERDICT"] = "INSUFFICIENT"
        r["reasons"] = reasons
        r["next_step"] = ("保留现场 → Ctrl+Scroll Lock×2 抓完整内核转储"
                          "（CrashDumpEnabled=2 / AlwaysKeepMemoryDump=1 / "
                          "CrashOnCtrlScroll=1 已就绪）→ 重跑本脚本。"
                          "全程单机，无需双机 WinDbg。")
    return r


def analyze_one(dump, sym, text_override=None, size_override=None):
    r = {"dump": str(dump),
         "size_bytes": size_override if size_override is not None else
                       (dump.stat().st_size if dump.is_file() else 0),
         "utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    if text_override is not None:
        return classify(r, text_override, 0)
    if not dump.is_file():
        r.update({"VERDICT": "INSUFFICIENT",
                  "reasons": ["dump file missing"]})
        return r
    if not CDB.is_file():
        r.update({"VERDICT": "INSUFFICIENT",
                  "reasons": ["cdb.exe not found at %s" % CDB]})
        return r

    cmd = [str(CDB), "-z", str(dump), "-y", sym, "-c", COMMANDS]
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
    text = p.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace") + "\n" + \
           p.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    return classify(r, text, p.returncode)


SYNTHETIC_FULL = """BUGCHECK_CODE:  7e
ExceptionAddress: fffff800e1b99210 (nt!RtlpHpVsSlotCompactChunks+0x210)
FAILURE_BUCKET_ID:  AV_nt!RtlpHpVsSlotCompactChunks
start             end                 module name
fffff800`74b00000 fffff800`74b6f000   RAMBlockCache   (pdb symbols)
Verifier Pool Tracking allocation stacks:
  RAMBlockCache!Rb2Alloc+0x18
  RAMBlockCache!ExAllocatePool2+0x42
"""


def self_test():
    """阳性/阴性对照：证明拿到真正完整转储时脚本会判 POINTED。"""
    fake = Path("synthetic-full.dmp")
    sz = 200 * 1024 * 1024
    pos = analyze_one(fake, "", text_override=SYNTHETIC_FULL,
                      size_override=sz)
    no_ver = analyze_one(fake, "", text_override=SYNTHETIC_FULL +
                         "\nUnable to get verifier list\n", size_override=sz)
    triage = analyze_one(fake, "", text_override=SYNTHETIC_FULL +
                         "\nKernel Generated Triage Dump\n", size_override=sz)
    checks = {
        "full_dump_with_verifier_stack_is_POINTED": pos["VERDICT"] == "POINTED",
        "missing_verifier_list_is_INSUFFICIENT": no_ver["VERDICT"] == "INSUFFICIENT",
        "triage_marker_is_INSUFFICIENT": triage["VERDICT"] == "INSUFFICIENT",
        "positive_frames_reported": len(pos["pool_alloc_frames"]) >= 2,
    }
    print(json.dumps({"SELF_TEST": checks}, ensure_ascii=False))
    print("RESULT: %s" % ("PASS" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL"))
    return 0 if all(checks.values()) else 1


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("dump", nargs="?", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--all", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if args.self_test:
        return self_test()

    sym = SYM_STORE + ";" + ";".join(pdb_dirs())
    dumps = find_dumps(args.dump, args.all)
    if not dumps:
        print("RESULT: INSUFFICIENT - no dump found")
        return 2
    results = [analyze_one(d, sym) for d in dumps]
    pointed = sum(1 for x in results if x["VERDICT"] == "POINTED")
    summary = {"analyzed": len(results), "pointed": pointed,
               "insufficient": len(results) - pointed,
               "symbol_pdb_dirs": len(pdb_dirs()) - 1,
               "results": results}
    out = Path(args.out) if args.out else OUT_DIR / "c6_dump_analysis.json"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                   encoding="utf-8")
    for x in results:
        print("%-34s %-8s bc=%-5s triage=%-5s verifier=%-5s %s" %
              (Path(x["dump"]).name, x["VERDICT"], x.get("bugcheck") or "-",
               x.get("triage"), x.get("verifier_list_available"),
               x.get("failure_bucket") or ""))
    print("SUMMARY: analyzed=%d pointed=%d insufficient=%d out=%s" %
          (len(results), pointed, len(results) - pointed, out))
    print("RESULT: %s" % ("POINTED" if pointed else "INSUFFICIENT"))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

````powershell
.SYNOPSIS
    bench_proto.ps1 —— 计数器判别式对账脚本（W1.5 读写路径专项 + 内存级速度专项）。
.DESCRIPTION
    AS SSD 2.0.7316 / CDM 9.0.1 均无 CLI 静默模式——跑分动作由人执行；本脚本负责：
      attached/detached 对照 + 二遍读协议轮次提示 + ReadReq/ReadHit/ReadHitBytes
      计数器抓取（Get-RbStats，dot-source rb_common.ps1）+ 3 轮中位 + CSV 输出。
    [W1.5] 判别式（设计 §9）：
      ① 计数器对账：分数变化与 ReadReq/命中率曲线同向；>8MB 的 IO 进入缓存面后
         应出现在 ReadReq 增量中；detached 态驱动不可见 → ReadReq 增量应为 0；
      ② 二遍读协议：同文件冷/热两轮——热轮达标 + 冷轮无回归 = 门+缓存面生效；
      ③ detached 裸盘基线一轮（B）：把 4K 写改善拆成"消除负优化"vs"回写吸收"归因；
      ④ 3 轮取中位抗噪；任一轮 Verifier 新告警即该轮作废（人工判据，脚本外）。
    [内存级专项 T05] Phase 1b 矩阵（每场景 3 轮取中位，判据见 README 手册）：
      SEQ1M 读/写 × Q8T1/Q1T1（写：Q8T1 ≥ Q1T1 消除倒退为 D2 主判据）、
      RND4K 读/写 × Q32T1/Q1T1（QD1 为热轮判据：先热一轮再测，冷轮=盘物理下限）。
      计数器增量含 LostDirtyDelta（C7 记账回归：失败路径/竞态不得丢脏无账）。
    数据安全回归点（脚本末尾自动执行）：detach 后 DirtyBytes 应为 0（全量回写）；
      WbFlush/WbBytes 增量序列供人工核对 ~60s 周期落盘节奏（CSV 内）。
    错误处理约定（规格书 D.3 / run_diskspd.ps1 同款）：$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'，
    失败不静默、以非零码退出；ctl 缺失/非零退出/关键行解析失败 → fail-closed。
.PARAMETER Letter
    被测卷盘符（默认 D）。
.PARAMETER TestFile
    测试文件路径（仅用于提示文案；默认 <Letter>:\asssd_test.bin）。
.PARAMETER Rounds
    每场景轮数（默认 3，取中位）。
.PARAMETER OutDir
    CSV 输出目录（默认 <repo>\bench_out-<时间戳>）。
.PARAMETER SkipDetached
    跳过 detached 裸盘基线轮（默认执行；仅当卷无法 detach 时使用）。
.PARAMETER DryRun
    干跑：不调用 ctl、合成全零计数器快照——用于无驱动环境验证脚本机制
    （字段齐全的 CSV 仍会输出，DryRun 列标记为 yes）。
.PARAMETER Auto

.EXAMPLE

.EXAMPLE
    powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File src\scripts\bench_proto.ps1 -DryRun -Auto
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [char]$Letter = 'D',
    [string]$TestFile = '',
    [int]$Rounds = 3,
    [string]$OutDir = '',
    [switch]$SkipDetached,
    [switch]$DryRun,
    [switch]$Auto
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'rb_common.ps1')
# [FIX S-DRYRUN] DryRun 不调用 ctl、不碰驱动（计数器为合成零值），无需管理员；
# 非 DryRun 的 attach/detach/status 走 Assert-Admin（fail-closed 不变）。
if (-not $DryRun) { Assert-Admin }

if ($Rounds -lt 1) { throw '-Rounds 必须 >= 1（3 轮取中位是协议口径）。' }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($TestFile)) { $TestFile = "$Letter`:\asssd_test.bin" }
$LetterStr = [string]$Letter

$ctl = Join-Path $ProjectRoot 'ctl\ramboostctl.exe'
if (-not $DryRun -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ctl)) {
    throw "未找到 $ctl（先编译 ctl；或先用 -DryRun 验证脚本机制）。"
}

$stamp  = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($OutDir)) { $OutDir = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "bench_out-$stamp" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir | Out-Null
$rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

# ---- 原生调用统一收口 ----
# 局部 EAP=Continue（Sign-Driver/Get-RbStats 同款模式）：stderr 合流不触发 Stop；
# 成败由 $LASTEXITCODE 显式判定——fail-closed 不依赖 EAP 副作用。
function Invoke-Ctl([string[]]$CtlArgs) {
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    $out = & $ctl @CtlArgs 2>&1
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    return @{ Out = ($out | Out-String); Code = $code }
}

# ---- 计数器快照（干跑=合成全零）----
function Get-Snap([string]$Tag) {
    if ($DryRun) {
        Write-Host "  [snap:$Tag] (dry-run 合成全零)"
        return [pscustomobject]@{
            ReadReq = [uint64]0; ReadHitPct = [double]0; ReadHit = [double]0
            ReadHitBytesPct = [double]0; WriteReq = [uint64]0; WbFlush = [uint64]0
            DirtyMB = [double]0; DirtyBytes = [uint64]0; WbBytes = [uint64]0
            LostDirtyBytes = [uint64]0
        }
    }
    return (Get-RbStats -CtlPath $ctl -Raw)
}

function Wait-Operator([string]$Msg) {
    Write-Host "`n===== $Msg =====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    if ($Auto) { Write-Host '  [auto] 跳过人工等待'; return }
    Read-Host '  该轮跑完后按回车继续'
}

function Read-Score([string]$What) {
    if ($Auto) { Write-Host "  [auto] $What：未记录"; return $null }
    $v = Read-Host "  请输入 $What（MB/s，Benchmark 界面读数；留空=未记录）"
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($v)) { return $null }
    $d = 0.0
    if ([double]::TryParse($v.Trim(), [ref]$d)) { return $d }
    Write-Host '  [警告] 无法解析为数字，按未记录处理。' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    return $null
}

function Add-Row([string]$Mode, [string]$Scenario, [int]$Round, [string]$Pass, $Score, $Before, $After) {
    $readReqDelta = [int64]($After.ReadReq - $Before.ReadReq)
    $scoreText = if ($null -eq $Score) { '' } else { $Score.ToString('F2') }
    $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        Mode             = $Mode
        Scenario         = $Scenario
        Round            = $Round
        Pass             = $Pass
        DryRun           = if ($DryRun) { 'yes' } else { 'no' }
        ScoreMBps        = $scoreText
        ReadReq          = $After.ReadReq
        ReadReqDelta     = $readReqDelta
        ReadHitPct       = $After.ReadHitPct
        ReadHitBytesPct  = $After.ReadHitBytesPct
        ReadHitDelta     = [math]::Round($After.ReadHit - $Before.ReadHit, 2)
        WriteReqDelta    = [int64]($After.WriteReq - $Before.WriteReq)
        WbFlushDelta     = [int64]($After.WbFlush - $Before.WbFlush)
        WbBytesDelta     = [int64]($After.WbBytes - $Before.WbBytes)
        LostDirtyDelta   = [int64]($After.LostDirtyBytes - $Before.LostDirtyBytes)
        DirtyBytesAfter  = $After.DirtyBytes
        Timestamp        = (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
    })
}

function Get-Median($Values) {
    $v = @($Values | Where-Object { $_ -ne $null -and $_ -gt 0 } | Sort-Object)
    if ($v.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
    $n = $v.Count
    if ($n % 2 -eq 1) { return [double]$v[[int](($n - 1) / 2)] }
    return ([double]$v[$n / 2 - 1] + [double]$v[$n / 2]) / 2.0
}

# [T05] 内存级矩阵场景表：Key=CSV/摘要标识，Prompt=人工提示，Pass=冷/热轮次语义。
# QD1 场景按二遍读协议：先热一轮（重建/重读测试文件）再测，热轮为内存级判据轮。
$Scenarios = [ordered]@{
    'seq-r-q8'  = @{ Prompt = 'AS SSD「Seq」读（QD8）';                    Pass = 'hot'  }
    'seq-w-q8'  = @{ Prompt = 'AS SSD「Seq」写（QD8，回写开）';             Pass = 'hot'  }
    'seq-r-q1'  = @{ Prompt = 'AS SSD「Seq」读（QD1）';                    Pass = 'hot'  }
    'seq-w-q1'  = @{ Prompt = 'AS SSD「Seq」写（QD1，回写开）';             Pass = 'hot'  }
    '4k-r-q32'  = @{ Prompt = 'AS SSD「4K」读（QD32）';                    Pass = 'hot'  }
    '4k-w-q32'  = @{ Prompt = 'AS SSD「4K」写（QD32，回写开）';             Pass = 'hot'  }
    '4k-r-q1'   = @{ Prompt = 'AS SSD「4K」读（QD1）【先热一轮：同文件第二遍】'; Pass = 'hot' }
    '4k-w-q1'   = @{ Prompt = 'AS SSD「4K」写（QD1，回写开）【先热一轮】';   Pass = 'hot'  }
}

Write-Host '== bench_proto (计数器判别式 + 内存级矩阵) ==' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  卷=$LetterStr  测试文件=$TestFile  轮数=$Rounds  输出=$OutDir"
if ($DryRun) { Write-Host '  [DRY-RUN] 不调用 ctl，计数器为合成零值（机制验证用）' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

# ================= Phase 0: detached 裸盘基线（B 轮）=================
if (-not $SkipDetached) {
    Write-Host "`n[Phase 0] detached 基线：分离卷 $LetterStr（裸盘对照）..."
    if ($DryRun) {
        Write-Host '  [dry-run] 跳过 detach'
    } else {
        $r = Invoke-Ctl @('detach', $LetterStr)
        if ($r.Code -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "  [警告] detach 返回 $($r.Code)（卷可能本就未 attach，继续）：$($r.Out)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }
    $b = Get-Snap 'detached-before'
    Wait-Operator "detached 基线 · 第一遍（冷）读：对 $TestFile 运行 AS SSD「Seq」读"
    $c = Get-Snap 'detached-cold'
    Add-Row 'detached' 'seq-r' 0 'cold' (Read-Score 'detached 冷读 Seq 读 MB/s') $b $c
    Wait-Operator 'detached 基线 · 第二遍（热）读：同文件再跑一次 AS SSD「Seq」读'
    $h = Get-Snap 'detached-hot'
    Add-Row 'detached' 'seq-r' 0 'hot' (Read-Score 'detached 热读 Seq 读 MB/s') $c $h
}

# ================= Phase 1: attached Seq 读对照（W1.5 既有口径）=================
Write-Host "`n[Phase 1] attached 对照：挂载卷 $LetterStr 进入缓存..."
if ($DryRun) {
    Write-Host '  [dry-run] 跳过 attach'
} else {
    $r = Invoke-Ctl @('attach', $LetterStr)
    if ($r.Code -ne 0) { throw "attach $LetterStr 失败（exit=$($r.Code)）：$($r.Out)" }
}
for ($i = 1; $i -le $Rounds; $i++) {
    $b = Get-Snap "attached-r$i-before"
    Wait-Operator "第 $i 轮 · 第一遍（冷）读：重建测试文件（删除后让 AS SSD 重写）再跑 AS SSD「Seq」读"
    $c = Get-Snap "attached-r$i-cold"
    Add-Row 'attached' 'seq-r' $i 'cold' (Read-Score "第 $i 轮 冷读 Seq 读 MB/s") $b $c
    Wait-Operator "第 $i 轮 · 第二遍（热）读：同文件再跑一次 AS SSD「Seq」读（第二遍应命中缓存）"
    $h = Get-Snap "attached-r$i-hot"
    Add-Row 'attached' 'seq-r' $i 'hot' (Read-Score "第 $i 轮 热读 Seq 读 MB/s") $c $h
}

# ================= Phase 1b: 内存级矩阵（T05）=================
# 每场景 3 轮取中位；QD1 场景的热轮判据要求"先热一轮"（提示文案已含）。
# 计数器增量（含 LostDirtyDelta）逐轮入 CSV——C7 记账回归：任何场景
# lost_dirty 增量应为 0（除非人为注入盘错，属预期失败路径）。
Write-Host "`n[Phase 1b] 内存级矩阵：$($Scenarios.Count) 个场景 × $Rounds 轮（人工跑分）..."
foreach ($key in $Scenarios.Keys) {
    $sc = $Scenarios[$key]
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $Rounds; $i++) {
        $b = Get-Snap "mx-$key-r$i-before"
        Wait-Operator ("矩阵 [{0}] 第 {1} 轮：{2}" -f $key, $i, $sc.Prompt)
        $a = Get-Snap "mx-$key-r$i-after"
        Add-Row 'matrix' $key $i $sc.Pass (Read-Score ("[{0}] 第 {1} 轮 MB/s" -f $key, $i)) $b $a
    }
}

# ================= Phase 2: 数据安全回归点 =================
Write-Host "`n[Phase 2] 数据安全回归：detach 前应已完成全量回写（DirtyBytes=0）..."
if ($DryRun) {
    Write-Host '  [dry-run] 跳过 detach/DirtyBytes 校验'
} else {
    $r = Invoke-Ctl @('detach', $LetterStr)
    if ($r.Code -ne 0) { Write-Host "  [警告] detach 返回 $($r.Code)：$($r.Out)" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
    $after = Get-RbStats -CtlPath $ctl -Raw
    if ($after.DirtyBytes -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "  [警告] detach 后 DirtyBytes=$($after.DirtyBytes)（期望 0：全量回写未完成？）" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    } else {
        Write-Host '  [ok] detach 后 DirtyBytes=0（全量回写完成，fix-report-2026-10-17 既有验收项）' -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    if ($after.LostDirtyBytes -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "  [警告] LostDirtyBytes=$($after.LostDirtyBytes)（C7 记账非零：检查是否有盘错/失败路径被触发）" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    } else {
        Write-Host '  [ok] LostDirtyBytes=0（C7 记账干净：无非预期丢弃）' -ForegroundColor Green
    }
}

# ================= Phase 3: 中位 + CSV + 判别式摘要 =================
$detCold = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'detached' -and $_.Pass -eq 'cold' -and $_.ScoreMBps -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.ScoreMBps })
$detHot  = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'detached' -and $_.Pass -eq 'hot'  -and $_.ScoreMBps -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.ScoreMBps })
$attCold = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'attached'  -and $_.Pass -eq 'cold' -and $_.ScoreMBps -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.ScoreMBps })
$attHot  = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'attached'  -and $_.Pass -eq 'hot'  -and $_.ScoreMBps -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.ScoreMBps })

$csv = Join-Path $OutDir "bench_proto-$stamp.csv"
$rows | Export-Csv -LiteralPath $csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "`n===== 中位摘要（每场景 3 轮取中位；detached 为单轮 B）=====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
function Show-Med([string]$Label, $Vals) {
    $m = Get-Median $Vals
    if ($null -eq $m) { Write-Host ("  {0,-28} : 无有效分数（未记录）" -f $Label); return }
    Write-Host ("  {0,-28} : {1:F2} MB/s（n={2}）" -f $Label, $m, $Vals.Count)
}
Show-Med 'detached 冷读' $detCold
Show-Med 'detached 热读' $detHot
Show-Med 'attached 冷读（3 轮中位）' $attCold
Show-Med 'attached 热读（3 轮中位）' $attHot
foreach ($key in $Scenarios.Keys) {
    $vals = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'matrix' -and $_.Scenario -eq $key -and $_.ScoreMBps -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.ScoreMBps })
    Show-Med ("矩阵 $key") $vals
}

Write-Host "`n===== 判别式辅助（数据供 QA 对账，最终判定按 README 手册判据表）=====" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$detRows = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'detached' })
$attRows = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'attached' })
$detReq = ($detRows | Measure-Object -Property ReadReqDelta -Sum).Sum
$attReq = ($attRows | Measure-Object -Property ReadReqDelta -Sum).Sum
Write-Host ("  门生效证据：ReadReq 增量 detached={0} / attached={1}（>8MB IO 进入缓存面才计数；detached 驱动不可见应为 0）" -f $detReq, $attReq)
$hotHit = ($attRows | Where-Object { $_.Pass -eq 'hot' } | Measure-Object -Property ReadHitPct -Average).Average
$coldHit = ($attRows | Where-Object { $_.Pass -eq 'cold' } | Measure-Object -Property ReadHitPct -Average).Average
if ($null -ne $hotHit -and $null -ne $coldHit) {
    Write-Host ("  命中曲线：attached 冷轮均命中 {0:F2}% → 热轮均命中 {1:F2}%（与分数同向=缓存命中所致）" -f $coldHit, $hotHit)
}
# [D2 主判据] SEQ 写 Q8T1 vs Q1T1：消除倒退（Q8T1 ≥ Q1T1）
$w8 = Get-Median @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'matrix' -and $_.Scenario -eq 'seq-w-q8' -and $_.ScoreMBps -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.ScoreMBps })
$w1 = Get-Median @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'matrix' -and $_.Scenario -eq 'seq-w-q1' -and $_.ScoreMBps -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.ScoreMBps })
if ($null -ne $w8 -and $null -ne $w1) {
    $verdict = if ($w8 -ge $w1) { 'PASS（倒退已消除）' } else { 'FAIL（仍倒退）' }
    Write-Host ("  [D2 主判据] SEQ 写 Q8T1={0:F2} vs Q1T1={1:F2} → {2}" -f $w8, $w1, $verdict)
} else {
    Write-Host '  [D2 主判据] SEQ 写 Q8T1/Q1T1 分数未记录（矩阵未跑或 Auto 模式）'
}
$mxLost = ($rows | Where-Object { $_.Mode -eq 'matrix' } | Measure-Object -Property LostDirtyDelta -Sum).Sum
Write-Host ("  C7 记账：矩阵 LostDirtyDelta 合计={0}（应为 0；非 0 说明有失败路径/竞态丢脏无账）" -f $mxLost)
Write-Host '  落盘节奏：见 CSV WbFlushDelta/WbBytesDelta 序列（~60s 脉动为正常，人工核对）'
Write-Host "  CSV: $csv"
Write-Host '  提示：任一轮 Driver Verifier 新告警 → 该轮作废重跑（人工判据）。'
Write-Host '== bench_proto done =='
````

##### `src/scripts/benchmark.ps1`

````powershell
# benchmark.ps1 - diskspd throughput comparison: uncached baseline (passthrough) vs cached (attach).
# Error-handling convention (spec D.3): $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' plus a non-zero exit on
# failure paths. Behavior difference vs before the refactor is limited to failure paths (which
# previously printed an error but still exited 0); the success path is unchanged.
# The 2>$null on the ctl detach/attach calls are probe invocations (detach before baseline /
# attach before load are allowed to fail, e.g. when the volume is not attached), which D.3
# explicitly permits to be silent; the redirections are kept as-is.
param([string]$Letter='F',[int]$SizeGB=4,[string]$Diskspd='diskspd.exe',
      [string]$Ctl='ramboostctl.exe',[string]$AttachArgs='attach',[string]$DetachArgs='detach')
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$f="$($Letter)\rb_bench.dat"
fsutil file createnew $f ($SizeGB*1GB) | Out-Null
function Run($t,$o){ & $Diskspd -c0 -d30 "-t$t" "-o$o" -b64K -r -Sh -w0 $f | Select-String 'MB/s|IOPS' | ForEach-Object {"t$t o$o : $_"} }
"== baseline (passthrough) =="; & $Ctl $DetachArgs 2>$null; Run 1 1; Run 8 8
"== cached (attach) =="; & $Ctl $AttachArgs 2>$null; Run 1 1; Run 8 8; Run 8 8
Remove-Item $f -Force
````

##### `src/scripts/boot_guard.ps1`

````powershell
# boot_guard.ps1  [V10.4 / 88 M-6] OnStartup guard.
# Normal path: roll back UpperFilters only when armed AND a boot failure is
# confirmed. Extra path (88 M-6): if FilterArmed was NEVER set but the
# Volume class UpperFilters already references RAMBlockCache, that is the
# B-2 historical half-installed state (engine appended the filter and then
# returned before arming). Remove the dangling reference so the next boot
# cannot 0x7B on an unloadable driver.
$svc      = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Parameters'
$volClass = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{71a27cdd-812a-11d0-bec7-08002be2092f}'
# [TICKET 2026-11-16] "This boot reached user mode" ticket -> Parameters\BootReachedUser.
# Consumed once by the driver on the NEXT boot (RbBootFailLoad):
#   if (healthy == 1 || (ticket == 1 && clean == 1)) { fails = 0; }   ticket read, then cleared.
# G1: the driver really is loaded this boot (service Running) -- a 0x7B / unloaded boot never
#     reaches this AtStartup task. G2: the volume class still lists RAMBlockCache -- blocks the
#     white ticket of a boot where the driver runs but never attaches (half-install / rolled back).
# Call ONLY on the "not a confirmed failure" exits below; NEVER on the two UpperFilters strip
# paths, otherwise the next boot erases the failure this very boot just recorded.
function Set-BootReachedUserTicket {
    param([string]$Key, [bool]$HasRb)
    if (-not $HasRb) { return }
    $st = (Get-Service -Name RAMBlockCache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Status
    if ("$st" -ne 'Running') { return }
    try { Set-ItemProperty -Path $Key -Name BootReachedUser -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch { }
}
try {
    $p = Get-ItemProperty -Path $svc -ErrorAction Stop
    $armed = ([int]$p.FilterArmed -eq 1)
    $uf = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $volClass -Name UpperFilters -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).UpperFilters
    $hasRb = $false
    if ($uf) { $hasRb = @($uf | Where-Object { $_ -eq 'RAMBlockCache' }).Count -gt 0 }

    if (-not $armed) {
        if (-not $hasRb) { exit 0 }   # not armed and no dangling reference: nothing to repair
        # [FIX 2026-11-13 J6-ROOT] A healthy, already-acknowledged deployment
        # is NOT an unarmed half-install. logon_disarm.ps1 clears FilterArmed
        # on every successful logon AND writes DeployAck = DeploySeq; a real
        # B-2 half-install has DeploySeq > DeployAck (deploy.ps1 bumped the
        # sequence before it bailed out). Stripping UpperFilters in the healthy
        # case removed the volume class filter on the NEXT boot, so PnP never
        # called RbAddDevice: DevList empty -> volumes:0 -> no cache IO ->
        # L2 never opened and H5 never received the power IRP that finalises
        # the L2 index. Real incident 2026-11-13: watch history shows
        # [volsnap,RAMBlockCache] at 11:37 and [volsnap] at 15:13.
        $seq = [int]$p.DeploySeq
        $ack = [int]$p.DeployAck
        # [TICKET] healthy, already-acked deployment: issue the ticket (mirrors the exit guard
        # below); the strip path after it must not issue one.
        if ($seq -gt 0 -and $seq -eq $ack) { Set-BootReachedUserTicket -Key $svc -HasRb $hasRb }
        if ($seq -gt 0 -and $seq -eq $ack) { exit 0 }
        # [88 M-6] genuine unarmed half-install: strip the dangling filter.
        $keep = @($uf | Where-Object { $_ -ne 'RAMBlockCache' })
        if ($keep.Count -eq 0) { $keep = @('volsnap') }
        Set-ItemProperty -Path $volClass -Name UpperFilters -Value $keep -Type MultiString
        Set-ItemProperty -Path $svc -Name FilterArmed -Value 0 -Type DWord
        exit 0
    }
    # [TICKET] armed and no confirmed failure: issue the ticket. The guard is duplicated from the
    # exit below on purpose -- the rollback path past it must not issue a ticket.
    if ([int]$p.BootFailCount -lt 1) { Set-BootReachedUserTicket -Key $svc -HasRb $hasRb }
    if ([int]$p.BootFailCount -lt 1) { exit 0 }   # no confirmed failure: do not touch

    if ($uf) {
        $keep = @($uf | Where-Object { $_ -ne 'RAMBlockCache' })
        if ($keep.Count -eq 0) { $keep = @('volsnap') }
        Set-ItemProperty -Path $volClass -Name UpperFilters -Value $keep -Type MultiString
    }
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svc -Name FilterArmed -Value 0 -Type DWord
    exit 0
} catch { exit 1 }
````

##### `src/scripts/bridge_keeper.ps1`

````powershell
# RB bridge keeper (runs as SYSTEM from scheduled task).
# PowerShell is Unicode-native -> Chinese paths are safe here (unlike .cmd).
#
# [FIX 2026-11-11] $web pointed at <repo>\web, which does not exist since the
# source tree was reorganised (the app now lives at src\ui\web). Push-Location
# to a missing directory does NOT throw -- it silently leaves the process in
# the previous cwd, so node was launched from %SystemRoot%\System32 every time
# and the bridge never listened. The keeper then slept 5s and retried forever,
# logging nothing about why. Hence: verify BOTH paths before the loop, and
# verify the cwd actually took effect instead of trusting Push-Location.

$root = 'C:\Users\陈\Desktop\RAMBlockCache-V10.4.3-build19-源码包'
$node = 'C:\Users\陈\.workbuddy\binaries\node\versions\node-v27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0-win-x64\node.exe'
$web  = Join-Path $root 'src\ui\web'
$logd = 'C:\ProgramData\rb-bridge'
$log  = Join-Path $logd 'keeper.log'

function W($m) { Add-Content -Path $log -Value ("[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss'), $m) }

$entry = Join-Path $web 'bridge\server\index.ts'
W "keeper start; pid=$PID node=$([bool](Test-Path $node)) web=$([bool](Test-Path $entry)) path=$web"

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $node)) { W 'FATAL: node binary missing; keeper exiting'; exit 1 }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $entry)) { W 'FATAL: bridge entry missing; keeper exiting'; exit 1 }

# [FIX 2026-11-11] Single-instance lock. Two keeper processes each tried to
# launch node and each appended to bridge-run.log; the second one died every
# 5s with "The process cannot access the file ... being used by another
# process" and could never start the bridge. A global mutex makes the second
# keeper exit immediately instead of fighting for the log.
$mutexName = 'Global\RAMBlockCacheBridgeKeeper'
$mutex = New-Object System.Threading.Mutex($false, $mutexName)
$haveLock = $false
try { $haveLock = $mutex.WaitOne(0, $false) } catch [System.Threading.AbandonedMutexException] { $haveLock = $true }
if (-not $haveLock) {
    W "another keeper owns $mutexName; this instance exits"
    exit 0
}
W "keeper lock acquired: $mutexName"

$runLog = Join-Path $logd 'bridge-run.log'

while ($true) {
    $busy = $false
    try {
        $busy = [bool](Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5199 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    } catch { $busy = $false }
    if (-not $busy) {
        Push-Location -LiteralPath $web
        # Compare normalised full paths: Get-Location can differ in casing or
        # trailing separator from the literal we passed in.
        $here = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-Location).Path).TrimEnd('\')
        $want = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($web).TrimEnd('\')
        if (-not $here.Equals($want, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            # Should be unreachable after the preflight above; log it rather
            # than silently running the bridge from the wrong directory.
            W "FATAL: cwd is '$here', expected '$want'"
            Pop-Location
            exit 1
        }
        try {
            # Open the log with ReadWrite sharing so a stray second writer can
            # never wedge the bridge again; append-only, one write per line.
            & $node 'bridge/server/index.ts' 2>&1 |
                ForEach-Object {
                    try {
                        $fs = [IO.File]::Open($runLog, 'Append', 'Write', 'ReadWrite')
                        try {
                            $sw = New-Object IO.StreamWriter($fs)
                            $sw.WriteLine($_)
                            $sw.Flush()
                        } finally { $fs.Dispose() }
                    } catch { }
                }
            W "node exited code=$LASTEXITCODE"
        } catch {
            W ("node launch failed: " + $_.Exception.Message)
        }
        Pop-Location
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
}
````

##### `src/scripts/bridge_watchdog.ps1`

````powershell
# File: src/scripts/bridge_watchdog.ps1
# Purpose: Supervise the local Node 27 HTTP bridge on 127.0.0.1:5199 and call
#          the existing restart_bridge.ps1 after two consecutive failures.
# Encoding: UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF, pure ASCII only.
# Origin: deliverables/240-full-stack-architecture-guidance-2026-11-14.md 4A.
# NOTE: this script does NOT register itself as a scheduled task. The sandbox
# cannot manage SYSTEM tasks, and the observation window is still active.
# Run it with -RunOnce for a read-only probe, or under an existing supervisor.

param(
    [string]$HealthUrl = 'http://127.0.0.1:5199/health',
    [int]$PollIntervalSec = 10,
    [int]$TimeoutSec = 3,
    [switch]$RunOnce
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$restartScript = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'restart_bridge.ps1'

function Test-BridgeAlive {
    param([string]$Url, [int]$Timeout)
    try {
        $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Url -Method Get -TimeoutSec $Timeout -ErrorAction Stop
        return ($resp.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $resp.StatusCode -lt 500)
    } catch {
        try {
            $tcp = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient
            $async = $tcp.BeginConnect('127.0.0.1', 5199, $null, $null)
            $connected = $async.AsyncWaitHandle.WaitOne(($Timeout * 1000), $false)
            if ($connected -and $tcp.Connected) {
                $tcp.EndConnect($async)
                $tcp.Close()
                return $true
            }
            $tcp.Close()
            return $false
        } catch {
            return $false
        }
    }
}

$consecutiveFails = 0
while ($true) {
    $alive = Test-BridgeAlive -Url $HealthUrl -Timeout $TimeoutSec
    if ($alive) {
        if ($consecutiveFails -gt 0) {
            Write-Host ('[WATCHDOG] Bridge recovered after {0} failure(s).' -f $consecutiveFails)
        }
        $consecutiveFails = 0
    } else {
        $consecutiveFails++
        Write-Host ('[WATCHDOG] Bridge unreachable (attempt {0}).' -f $consecutiveFails)
        if ($consecutiveFails -ge 2) {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $restartScript) {
                Write-Host '[WATCHDOG] Invoking restart_bridge.ps1...'
                & $restartScript
            } else {
                Write-Host ('[WATCHDOG] restart_bridge.ps1 not found at {0}' -f $restartScript)
            }
        }
    }
    if ($RunOnce) { break }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $PollIntervalSec
}
````
