##### `src/scripts/check_blocksize_contract.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Gate10 static contract: Web BlockSize dropdown <-> driver geometry whitelist.

Read-only, no subprocess, no build artifacts required. Runs on GitHub's
windows-latest hosted runner and locally.

Background (2026-11-07 BugFix):
  The Web console hard-coded `const BLOCK_SIZES = [4096];` because switching
  block size used to require a full machine reboot (11-06 F1 note). Deliverables
  79/83 landed volume-level geometry rebuild in the driver (rbrebuild.c): the
  engine is rebuilt in place per volume, no reboot needed; S2 full-chain replay
  passed on real hardware with FAIL=0 / WARN=0. The WPF view already offered
  {4096, 8192, 16384, 32768}; only the Web UI lagged behind.

Guarded drift:
  - SettingsPage.tsx BLOCK_SIZES literal must be exactly [4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536];
  - rbctl.c rb_legal_bs[] and rbrebuild.c rebuild-target condition must carry the
    same five values in the same order;
  - none of the three may contain 131072 (76 NO-GO: 11-03/11-04 BSOD unattributed
    for the 128K tier; 65536 was un-banned 2026-11-08 after the 59-64k-audit §5
    preconditions were met and the 64K test package went green);
  - src/ui/web/src/bridge/http-transport.ts configSchema must not clamp BlockSize with
    z.enum / z.literal / .refine (which would silently re-lock the UI to 4K);
  - .github/workflows/ci.yml must keep calling this script as Gate10, placed
    after Gate9 and before the Web typecheck + build step.

Exit 0 = contract holds; exit 1 = the UI/driver whitelist drifted.
"""
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
LEGAL = (4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536)
LEGAL_STR = "{4096,8192,16384,32768,65536}"
BANNED_STR = ("131072",)   # [64K-UNBAN] 65536 restored 2026-11-08 (59-64k-audit §5 preconditions met); 128K still banned

SETTINGS_TS = ROOT / "src/ui/web" / "src" / "features" / "settings" / "SettingsPage.tsx"
RBCTL_C = ROOT / "src" / "driver" / "rbctl.c"
REBUILD_C = ROOT / "src" / "driver" / "rbrebuild.c"
HTTP_TS = ROOT / "src/ui/web" / "src" / "bridge" / "http-transport.ts"
CI_YML = ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml"

# A restriction on BlockSize that would silently re-lock the UI to a subset.
FORBIDDEN_RESTRICTIONS = ("z.enum(", "z.literal(", ".refine(", ".superRefine(")


def _ints(snippet: str) -> tuple:
    """Return the decimal integer literals inside a whitelist snippet."""
    return tuple(int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+", snippet))


def _fmt(vals: tuple) -> str:
    """Render a value tuple as a compact comma-separated list."""
    return ", ".join(map(str, vals))


def main() -> int:
    fails = []
    paths = (SETTINGS_TS, RBCTL_C, REBUILD_C, HTTP_TS, CI_YML)
    for p in paths:
        if not p.is_file():
            fails.append("missing file: %s" % p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
    if fails:
        print("== check_blocksize_contract (Gate10) ==")
        for f in fails:
            print("[FAIL] " + f)
        print("result: FAIL (%d fail, 0 warn)" % len(fails))
        return 1

    settings = SETTINGS_TS.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    rbctl = RBCTL_C.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    rebuild = REBUILD_C.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    http = HTTP_TS.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    ci = CI_YML.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    # --- 1) Web dropdown literal: exactly the four legal values, in order ---
    m_ui = re.search(r"const\s+BLOCK_SIZES\s*=\s*\[([^\]]*)\]\s*;", settings)
    if not m_ui:
        fails.append("SettingsPage.tsx: BLOCK_SIZES array literal not found")
        ui_vals = ()
    else:
        ui_snippet = m_ui.group(1)
        ui_vals = _ints(ui_snippet)
        if ui_vals != LEGAL:
            fails.append("SettingsPage.tsx: BLOCK_SIZES = [%s], expected [%s]"
                         % (_fmt(ui_vals), _fmt(LEGAL)))
        for b in BANNED_STR:
            if b in ui_snippet:
                fails.append("SettingsPage.tsx: BLOCK_SIZES contains banned %s (76 NO-GO)" % b)

    # --- 2) driver clamp whitelist: rbctl.c rb_legal_bs[] ---
    m_ctl = re.search(r"rb_legal_bs\[\]\s*=\s*\{([^}]*)\}", rbctl)
    if not m_ctl:
        fails.append("rbctl.c: rb_legal_bs[] whitelist not found")
    else:
        ctl_snippet = m_ctl.group(1)
        ctl_vals = _ints(ctl_snippet)
        if ctl_vals != ui_vals:
            fails.append("rbctl.c: rb_legal_bs[] = {%s}, UI = [%s] (whitelist drift)"
                         % (_fmt(ctl_vals), _fmt(ui_vals)))
        if ctl_vals != LEGAL:
            fails.append("rbctl.c: rb_legal_bs[] = {%s}, expected %s"
                         % (_fmt(ctl_vals), LEGAL_STR))
        for b in BANNED_STR:
            if b in ctl_snippet:
                fails.append("rbctl.c: rb_legal_bs[] contains banned %s (F1 / 76 NO-GO)" % b)

    # --- 3) rbrebuild.c rebuild-target guard (five `newBlockSize != Nu` terms) ---
    m_rb = re.search(r"if\s*\(([^)]*newBlockSize\s*!=[^)]*)\)", rebuild, re.S)
    if not m_rb:
        fails.append("rbrebuild.c: newBlockSize whitelist guard not found")
    else:
        rb_snippet = m_rb.group(1)
        rb_vals = _ints(rb_snippet)
        if rb_vals != ui_vals:
            fails.append("rbrebuild.c: rebuild whitelist = {%s}, UI = [%s] (whitelist drift)"
                         % (_fmt(rb_vals), _fmt(ui_vals)))
        if len(rb_vals) != 5:
            fails.append("rbrebuild.c: rebuild whitelist has %d values, expected 5" % len(rb_vals))
        for b in BANNED_STR:
            if b in rb_snippet:
                fails.append("rbrebuild.c: rebuild whitelist contains banned %s (76 NO-GO)" % b)

    # --- 4) bridge configSchema must not re-restrict BlockSize ---
    m_schema = re.search(r"const\s+configSchema\s*=\s*z\.looseObject\(\{(.*?)\}\);",
                         http, re.S)
    if not m_schema:
        fails.append("http-transport.ts: configSchema not found")
    else:
        sbody = m_schema.group(1)
        m_bs = re.search(r"BlockSize\s*:\s*([^\n]*)", sbody)
        if not m_bs:
            fails.append("http-transport.ts: configSchema.BlockSize missing")
        else:
            bs_expr = m_bs.group(1)
            if "z.number()" not in bs_expr:
                fails.append("http-transport.ts: configSchema.BlockSize is no longer z.number()")
            for tok in FORBIDDEN_RESTRICTIONS:
                if tok in bs_expr:
                    fails.append("http-transport.ts: configSchema.BlockSize restricted by %s "
                                 "(would re-lock the UI)" % tok)
    # whole-file guard: a multi-line enum/literal/refine attached to BlockSize
    for tok in FORBIDDEN_RESTRICTIONS:
        if re.search(r"BlockSize[^\n]*" + re.escape(tok), http):
            fails.append("http-transport.ts: BlockSize carries %s restriction" % tok)

    # --- 5) CI keeps calling Gate10, between Gate9 and Web typecheck ---
    if "check_blocksize_contract.py" not in ci:
        fails.append("ci.yml: Gate10 check_blocksize_contract.py not registered")
    if "Gate10 check_blocksize_contract" not in ci:
        fails.append("ci.yml: step name 'Gate10 check_blocksize_contract' missing")
    i9 = ci.find("Gate9 check_ctl_freshness")
    i10 = ci.find("Gate10 check_blocksize_contract")
    iw = ci.find("Web typecheck + build")
    if i9 < 0 or i10 < 0 or iw < 0 or not (i9 < i10 < iw):
        fails.append("ci.yml: Gate10 must sit after Gate9 and before Web typecheck + build")

    print("== check_blocksize_contract (Gate10) ==")
    print("  legal whitelist   : %s" % LEGAL_STR)
    print("  UI BLOCK_SIZES    : [%s]" % _fmt(ui_vals))
    print("  banned (76 NO-GO) : 131072 (65536 restored 2026-11-08)")
    print("  guarded copies    : SettingsPage.tsx / rbctl.c rb_legal_bs[] / "
          "rbrebuild.c / configSchema / ci.yml")
    if fails:
        for f in fails:
            print("[FAIL] " + f)
        print("result: FAIL (%d fail, 0 warn)" % len(fails))
        return 1
    print("result: PASS (0 fail, 0 warn)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

##### `src/scripts/check_buffer_write_contract.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Gate14 · 定长缓冲自增下标写入点契约（防「漏网之鱼」）

130 号找到的 RbLogSnapshot 越界，本质是「固定容量数组 + 无钳位自增下标写入」。
本门禁把全库所有 `\bARR[VAR++] =` 写入点列成守恒清单，并对每一组要求
对应的上界钳位证据仍存在：

  R1 写入点分组集合守恒：新增/消失任何一组都 FAIL（新增必须先人工审计并登记）
  R2 每组钳位正则必须在对应文件中存在（删钳位即 FAIL）
  R3 已修的 RbLogSnapshot 显式钳位（其写法是 Items[n] 而非 Items[n++]，
     不在扫描集合内，故单独断言）
  R4 CI 自检

[C-PLAN 2026-11-12 审计记录] baseline 有 1 行变更，已逐条人工审计：
  - 删除 `if (L2Idx()[i].Use && L2Idx()[i].Lba == (b << 16)) L2Idx()[i].Use = 0;`
    原因：C 方案把 RbL2DropRange 从「按块号遍历 b0..b1 并钳到槽数」
    改为「遍历槽表 + lo/hi 字节偏移反查」(203 §1 P0-4 / 204 §4.5)。
    旧的块号钳位 `if (b1 > slots) b1 = slots` 在哈希槽寻址下会让高 LBA
    失效遍历不到 = 静默给错数据；新实现 O(s_Slots)、与哈希无关。
    写入点本身未消失，只是改为 `if (recOff >= lo && recOff < hi) L2Idx()[s].Use = 0;`
    （该行不含自增下标，不在本门禁扫描集合内，属预期）。

[C-SLICE 2026-11-13 审计记录] baseline 新增 1 行，已人工审计：
  - 新增 `if (rec->Lba != (blk << 16))                    return FALSE;   /* 索引错/撕裂 -> MISS */`
    （rbL2.c 的 RbL2FillPiece，切片填充的单块校验）
    性质：**不是写入点**，是记录头比对 + 早退。被扫进集合是因为启发式
    `HEAD_RE(^if\\s*\\()` + `CAP_RE(<\\s*\\d+)` 把 `blk << 16` 的左移当成了
    `< 16` 比较——与本文件既有第 103 行
    `if (cur->Use && cur->Lba != (blk << 16)) {` 完全同源的误报。
    审计结论：语义为「记录 Lba 与请求块号不符即判 MISS」，不写任何缓冲，
    不涉及下标自增，**不构成本门禁要守的越界写风险**；写入基线以保持行文本
    守恒（若将来该比对被删改，R2 会照常报 removed）。
    另：`RTL_COPYMEMORY` 的两处新增（`RbL2FillPiece` 的 dst 拷贝）不含
    `<` 与自增下标，不在扫描集合内；其容量约束由切片算术
    `off + take <= RB2_L2BLK` 与 `RbL2FillPiece` 入口显式断言共同保证。
  + 新增 `if (cur->Use && cur->Lba != (blk << 16)) {`
    原因：RbL2Store 的哈希冲突观测 (203 §1 P1-2)。这是**只读比较**，
    不写任何数组；后面仅做节流计数与 RbLog，不新增写入点组。
    正确性仍由 rec->Lba/VolId/Crc 三重校验保证（冲突时旧 blk 的 Probe 必 MISS）。
  R1 分组集合复算：13 组不变、无 extra/missing ⇒ 未引入未经审计的自增写入点。
  依据：deliverables/203-l2-c-plan-detailed-design-2026-11-12.md。

用法：python check_buffer_write_contract.py [--root <repo_root>]
      --root 供变异测试在最小骨架上运行。
"""
import argparse
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WRITE_RE = re.compile(r"(\w+)\s*\[\s*(\w+)\s*\+\+\s*\]\s*=")
CAP_RE = re.compile(r"<\s*(?:cap|Capacity|q\.MaxCount|RB_[A-Z0-9_]+|\d+)\b")
HEAD_RE = re.compile(r"^(for|while|if)\s*\(")

# 全库自增下标写入点（按 文件/数组/下标变量 去重后的守恒清单）
EXPECTED_GROUPS = {
    ("src/driver/rbL2.c", "path", "k"),
    ("src/driver/rbattach.c", "letters", "count"),
    ("src/driver/rbattach.c", "snap", "n"),
    ("src/driver/rbattach.c", "out", "j"),
    ("src/driver/rbctl.c", "Items", "n"),
    ("src/driver/rbdriver.c", "Out", "count"),
    ("src/driver/rbdriver.c", "snap", "n"),
    ("src/driver/rbdriver.c", "sd", "i"),
    ("src/driver/rbfeat.c", "path", "n"),
    ("src/driver/rbfeat.c", "sub", "n"),
    ("src/driver/rbfeat.c", "snap", "nsnap"),
    ("src/driver/rbhot.c", "top", "n"),
    ("src/driver/rbpools.c", "s_Obj", "s_N"),
}

# 每组写入点必须具备的上界钳位证据（正则，搜索对应文件全文）
GUARDS = [
    ("src/driver/rbL2.c", r"k \+ 1 < cap", "RbL2Path name/prefix copy clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbL2.c", r"k \+ 3 < cap", "RbL2Path drive-letter clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbL2.c", r"RbL2Path\(path, RTL_NUMBER_OF\(path\)", "L2 caller passes capacity"),
    ("src/driver/rbattach.c", r"count < RB_MAX_CRITICAL", "critical letters clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbattach.c", r"n < RB_MAX_VOLUMES", "DevList snapshot clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbattach.c", r"j < 30", "resume rebuild clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbattach.c", r"j < 31", "resume append clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbctl.c", r"n < q\.MaxCount", "event list clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbctl.c", r"q\.MaxCount > RB_EVENT_MAX", "event MaxCount cap"),
    ("src/driver/rbdriver.c", r"count < Capacity", "diag ring clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rblog.c", r"n < RB_LOG_MAX", "RbLogSnapshot clamp (130)"),
    ("src/driver/rblog.c", r"n < RB_LOG_MAX", "RbLogSnapshot 64 clamp (130)"),
    ("src/driver/rbdriver.c", r"n < RB_MAX_VOLUMES", "reaper snapshot clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbdriver.c", r"i < 8", "sysdrv label clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbfeat.c", r"n < cap", "Rb2Query path clamp (131)"),
    ("src/driver/rbfeat.c", r"RTL_NUMBER_OF\(path\)", "Rb2Query capacity source"),
    ("src/driver/rbfeat.c", r"nsnap < RB_MAX_VOLUMES", "volstatus snapshot clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbfeat.c", r"WCHAR sub\[24\]", "Policies\\<letter> fixed 24 wchar"),
    ("src/driver/rbhot.c", r"n < 64", "hot-zone top clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbpools.c", r"s_N < 64", "worker pool array clamp"),
    ("src/driver/rbpools.c", r"s_Obj\[64\]", "worker object array capacity"),
]


def scan(root):
    groups = set()
    hits = defaultdict(int)
    lines = []
    d = root / "src/driver"
    for f in sorted(d.glob("*.c")):
        rel = "src/driver/" + f.name
        for line in f.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace").splitlines():
            s = line.strip()
            ms = list(WRITE_RE.finditer(s))
            guarded = (not ms) and bool(HEAD_RE.match(s)) and bool(CAP_RE.search(s))
            if not ms and not guarded:
                continue
            lines.append(s)
            for m in ms:
                groups.add((rel, m.group(1), m.group(2)))
                hits[(rel, m.group(1), m.group(2))] += 1
    return groups, hits, lines


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--root", default=None)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    root = Path(args.root) if args.root else DEFAULT_ROOT
    fails = []

    groups, hits, lines = scan(root)
    missing = sorted(EXPECTED_GROUPS - groups)
    extra = sorted(groups - EXPECTED_GROUPS)
    if missing:
        fails.append("R1 write groups disappeared: %s" % missing)
    if extra:
        fails.append("R1 UNAUDITED new write groups: %s "
                     "(audit before adding)" % extra)

    # R2 行文本守恒：任何一处钳位被删改都会改变该行文本。
    # 全文正则会被「同文件其它位置仍有同名钳位」骗过，故按行精确比对。
    baseline_path = root / "src/scripts/buffer_write_baseline.txt"
    if not baseline_path.is_file():
        fails.append("R2 missing baseline file src/scripts/buffer_write_baseline.txt")
    else:
        base = [l.strip() for l in baseline_path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.strip()]
        cb, ca = Counter(base), Counter(lines)
        removed = list((cb - ca).elements())
        added = list((ca - cb).elements())
        if removed:
            fails.append("R2 write lines changed/removed (clamp deleted?): %s" % removed)
        if added:
            fails.append("R2 UNAUDITED new write lines: %s" % added)

    cache = {}
    for rel, pattern, why in GUARDS:
        p = root / rel
        if not p.is_file():
            fails.append("R2 missing file %s" % rel)
            continue
        if rel not in cache:
            cache[rel] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace")
        if not re.search(pattern, cache[rel]):
            fails.append("R2 %s: guard missing [%s] (%s)" % (rel, pattern, why))

    ci = root / ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
    if not ci.is_file() or "check_buffer_write_contract.py" not in ci.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"):
        fails.append("R4 CI: Gate14 not registered in ci.yml")

    if fails:
        for f in fails:
            print("[FAIL] %s" % f)
        print("result: FAIL (%d fail, 0 warn)" % len(fails))
        return 1
    print("Gate14 buffer-write contract: PASS "
          "(%d audited write groups, %d writes, %d guards)" %
          (len(groups), sum(hits.values()), len(GUARDS)))
    print("result: PASS (0 fail, 0 warn)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

##### `src/scripts/check_build_manifest.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Gate16 - build manifest is the single source of truth for compiled sources.

Checks (all bidirectional, fail-closed):
  1. Manifest sanity: known targets present, every listed source exists on disk,
     every path stays inside the repo.
  2. Driver <-> manifest: every .c under src/driver + src/core (the engine)
     must be listed in targets.driver.sources; nothing extra, nothing missing.
     This is the gate that would have caught I51's stale source list
     (_build_driver.ps1 missing rbdev/rbrebuild/read_plan -> 18 LNK2019).
  3. vcxproj <-> manifest: RAMBlockCache.vcxproj ClCompile entries must equal
     the manifest driver sources (this is the third copy that drifted).
  4. Build scripts must not inline source lists: driver/core/ctl/setup build
     entry points may not contain literal *.c source enumerations.
  5. Core regression suite: every regression-suite host file exists; every
     tests/core/*.c is registered in some suite (no orphans).
  6. .sln coverage: every product .csproj registered in targets.ui.projects
     (devTools exempt) must appear in build/RAMBlockCache.sln.

Exit 0 = PASS, 1 = FAIL.
"""
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MANIFEST = ROOT / "build" / "sources.manifest.json"
fails, warns = [], []

# --- 1. load manifest -------------------------------------------------------
try:
    m = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
except Exception as e:
    print(f"GATE16 FAIL: manifest unreadable: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)

tg = m.get("targets", {})
for req in ("driver", "core", "ctl", "setup", "ui", "web"):
    if req not in tg:
        fails.append(f"manifest: missing target '{req}'")

# --- 2. driver sources <-> disk ---------------------------------------------
drv = tg.get("driver", {})
work = ROOT / drv.get("workDir", "src/driver")
drv_sources = [s.replace("\\", "/") for s in drv.get("sources", [])]
if not drv_sources:
    fails.append("manifest: targets.driver.sources is empty")

# expected = every .c directly under src/driver + every .c under src/core
# (the engine lives in src/core; [142] split cache.c into cache.c plus five
#  domain TUs, so the core side is derived from disk rather than hardcoded).
core_dir = ROOT / "src" / "core"
disk = sorted(
    [f"{'/'.join(p.relative_to(work).parts)}" for p in work.glob("*.c")]
    + [f"../core/{p.name}" for p in core_dir.glob("*.c")]
)
listed = sorted(drv_sources)
missing = [s for s in disk if s not in listed]
extra = [s for s in listed if s not in disk]
for s in missing:
    fails.append(f"driver source on disk but NOT in manifest: {s}")
for s in extra:
    fails.append(f"driver source in manifest but NOT on disk: {s}")

# paths must resolve
for s in drv_sources:
    if ".." in s.split("/"):
        base = s
        # repo-relative resolution for ../core/...
        p = (work / s).resolve()
    else:
        p = work / s
    if not p.exists():
        fails.append(f"manifest driver source missing on disk: {s}")
    try:
        p.resolve().relative_to(ROOT)
    except ValueError:
        fails.append(f"manifest driver source escapes repo: {s}")

# --- 2b. core.engineSources: user-mode engine build covers every cache TU ----
eng_sources = [s.replace("\\", "/") for s in tg.get("core", {}).get(
    "engineSources", [])]
if not eng_sources:
    fails.append("manifest: targets.core.engineSources is empty")
cache_disk = sorted(f"src/core/{p.name}" for p in core_dir.glob("cache*.c"))
for s in cache_disk:
    if s not in eng_sources:
        fails.append(f"core engine source on disk but NOT in "
                     f"targets.core.engineSources: {s}")
for s in eng_sources:
    if not (ROOT / s).is_file():
        fails.append(f"targets.core.engineSources entry missing on disk: {s}")

# --- 3. vcxproj <-> manifest -------------------------------------------------
vcx = ROOT / drv.get("vcxproj", "src/driver/RAMBlockCache.vcxproj")
if not vcx.exists():
    fails.append(f"driver vcxproj missing: {vcx}")
else:
    txt = vcx.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    # take only the first Configuration|Platform block (Release|x64 preferred)
    entries = re.findall(r'<ClCompile Include="([^"]+)"\s*/?>', txt)
    norm = sorted(e.replace("\\", "/") for e in entries)
    if norm != listed:
        only_v = [s for s in norm if s not in listed]
        only_m = [s for s in listed if s not in norm]
        for s in only_v:
            fails.append(f"vcxproj compiles '{s}' but manifest does not list it")
        for s in only_m:
            fails.append(f"manifest lists '{s}' but vcxproj does not compile it")
    else:
        print(f"  vcxproj <-> manifest: {len(norm)} sources identical")

# --- 4. no inlined source lists in build scripts -----------------------------
# Any *.c literal inside a build entry is a fork waiting to drift (I51 root cause).
#
# [G21 2026-11-11] 审计 finding P0-2，两处静默失效：
#  ① guard 表原有 4 个目标，其中 3 个文件已从工作树删除（_build_all.ps1 /
#     _build_asan.ps1 / _build_manual.ps1 均已归档），`if not p.exists(): continue`
#     把它们静默跳过 → 实际只剩 build/build.ps1 一个守卫，而 I51 的元凶
#     _build_manual.ps1 恰恰是"被删了但物证还在"那个。改为：
#     REQUIRED_GUARDS 里的文件缺失即 FAIL（构建入口是契约的一部分，
#     文件消失必须显式声明，不能靠 continue 沉默）。
#  ② 正则只认双引号 `"x.c"`，而 build/build.ps1:215 用的是 PowerShell 单引号
#     `@('ramboostctl.c', 'bench_policy.c', 'rbfeatctl.c')` → findall 返回 []，
#     契约被违反但门禁 PASS。改为同时匹配单/双引号。
#
# 说明：`build/build.ps1:215` 那处**不是**违规——它列举的是 CLI 可执行文件名
# （ramboostctl/rbfeatctl 的 .c 是编译单元），不构成引擎源码清单。因此
# INLINE_ALLOW 给出显式豁免，而不是把正则改松。豁免必须写明理由，便于下次审计
# 判断该理由是否仍成立。
INLINE_LITERAL = re.compile(r"""['"]([\w./\\-]+\.c)['"]""")
INLINE_ALLOW = {
    "build/build.ps1": {
        "ramboostctl.c", "bench_policy.c", "rbfeatctl.c",
    },
}
# 构建入口是"单一事实源"契约的当事方，文件消失必须显式失败而不是静默跳过。
REQUIRED_GUARDS = ("build/build.ps1",)
OPTIONAL_GUARDS = (
    "src/core/_build_all.ps1",
    "src/core/_build_asan.ps1",
    "src/driver/_build_manual.ps1",
)
guarded = list(REQUIRED_GUARDS) + list(OPTIONAL_GUARDS)
for rel in guarded:
    p = ROOT / rel
    if not p.exists():
        if rel in REQUIRED_GUARDS:
            fails.append(f"{rel}: required build entry is missing (guard has no subject)")
        else:
            print(f"  [note] optional guard target absent (archived): {rel}")
        continue
    body = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    allow = INLINE_ALLOW.get(rel, set())
    hits = [h for h in INLINE_LITERAL.findall(body)
            if not h.endswith(".cache.c") and h not in allow]
    # allow boilerplate mentions in comments
    hits = [h for h in hits if not body[: body.find(h)].rstrip().endswith("#")]
    if hits:
        fails.append(f"{rel}: inlined source list literal(s) {hits[:4]} - "
                     f"source lists live only in build/sources.manifest.json "
                     f"(add to INLINE_ALLOW with a reason if legitimate)")
    if rel in REQUIRED_GUARDS:
        print(f"  inline-source guard: {rel} scanned "
              f"({len(INLINE_LITERAL.findall(body))} literal(s), "
              f"{len(allow)} allowed)")


# --- 5. core hosts: registered and orphan-free -------------------------------
hosts = m.get("tests", {}).get("hosts", [])
if not hosts:
    fails.append("manifest: tests.hosts is empty")
reg_files = set()
for h in hosts:
    p = ROOT / h.get("file", "")
    if not p.exists():
        fails.append(f"test host file missing: {h.get('file')}")
    reg_files.add(p.resolve())
    suite = h.get("suite", "")
    if suite not in ("regression", "qa", "bench", "diag", "e2e"):
        fails.append(f"test host {h.get('name')}: unknown suite '{suite}'")

reg_count = sum(1 for h in hosts if h.get("suite") == "regression")
print(f"  registered hosts: {len(hosts)} (regression: {reg_count})")

for p in list((ROOT / "tests" / "core").glob("*.c")):
    if p.resolve() not in reg_files:
        fails.append(f"orphan test host not registered in manifest: {p.relative_to(ROOT)}")
for p in list((ROOT / "tests" / "support").glob("*.c")) + list((ROOT / "tests").glob("*.c")):
    if p.resolve() not in reg_files:
        fails.append(f"orphan test helper not registered in manifest: {p.relative_to(ROOT)}")

# --- 5b. textually-included .c files must not be invisible to the manifest ---
# [G22 2026-11-11] 审计 finding P0-3：`src/core/cache.c:611` 有
#     #include "../../tests/core/support/parflush_stub.c"
# （在 `#ifndef RB_KERNEL_BUILD` 内），即一个**测试专用实现被文本编进了生产引擎
# TU**。而 parflush_stub 在 manifest 中出现 0 次，§5 的 orphan glob 也不含
# tests/core/support/ → 改它不产生任何 manifest/新鲜度信号，等于一个不受门禁
# 管辖的编译单元。
# 规则：生产源码（src/core + src/driver）里任何 `#include "*.c"`，被包含的
# 文件必须真实存在，且必须在 manifest 的某处被显式登记（tests.hosts 的
# file，或 targets.*.sources / engineSources）。
known = set(reg_files)
for s in drv_sources:
    known.add((work / s).resolve())
for s in eng_sources:
    known.add((ROOT / s).resolve())
# textualIncludes: 显式登记的"被 #include 进 TU"的文件（无法单独编译，因此
# 不进 tests.hosts；但必须可被门禁看到）。
textual = tg.get("core", {}).get("textualIncludes", []) or []
for ti in textual:
    rel = ti.get("file", "")
    if not rel:
        fails.append("manifest targets.core.textualIncludes entry missing 'file'")
        continue
    tp = ROOT / rel
    if not tp.is_file():
        fails.append(f"manifest textualIncludes file missing on disk: {rel}")
    if not ti.get("why"):
        fails.append(f"manifest textualIncludes '{rel}' has no 'why' reason")
    known.add(tp.resolve())
if textual:
    print(f"  textualIncludes registered: {len(textual)}")

INC_C = re.compile(r'^\s*#\s*include\s+"([^"]+\.(?:c|h))"', re.M)
for prod_dir in (ROOT / "src" / "core", ROOT / "src" / "driver"):
    if not prod_dir.is_dir():
        continue
    for p in prod_dir.glob("*.c"):
        body = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        for inc in INC_C.findall(body):
            # 只关心**本仓库内**的被包含源文件；外部 SDK 头不算。
            target = (p.parent / inc.replace("\\", "/")).resolve()
            if not str(inc).endswith(".c"):
                continue
            if not target.exists():
                fails.append(f"{p.name}: textually includes missing file '{inc}'")
                continue
            if target not in known:
                fails.append(
                    f"{p.name}: textually includes '{inc}' which is NOT "
                    f"registered in the manifest - it would be compiled into a "
                    f"production TU with no freshness signal")


# --- 5c. every skipped host must be traceable to an issue id -----------------
# [162 G-F 2026-11-12] 161 号 §3.4：`test_geom` 因 I52 被 skip（合理），但
# "skip 了但忘了登记" 与 "登记了但论证还引用它" 两种失效无人把关。本门不禁止
# skip（禁止会逼人删测试），只要求 skip 的理由里带一个**能在 KNOWN_ISSUES.md
# 里找到的编号**（I52 / N-150-x / Gxx）。没有编号 = 不可追溯 = FAIL。
ISSUE_ID = re.compile(r"\b(I\d{1,4}|N-\d+-\d+[a-z]?|G\d{1,3})\b")
KNOWN = ROOT / "KNOWN_ISSUES.md"
if not KNOWN.is_file():
    fails.append("KNOWN_ISSUES.md missing - skip traceability cannot be verified")
    ki = ""
else:
    ki = KNOWN.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
skips = [h for h in hosts if h.get("skip")]
for h in skips:
    name, why = h.get("name", "?"), str(h.get("skip"))
    ids = ISSUE_ID.findall(why)
    if not ids:
        fails.append(f"skip without issue id: {name} -> {why!r} "
                     f"(add e.g. 'I52: ...' and register it in KNOWN_ISSUES.md)")
        continue
    for i in ids:
        if not re.search(r"(?m)^\|\s*%s\s*\|" % re.escape(i), ki):
            fails.append(f"skip of {name} references {i} but KNOWN_ISSUES.md "
                         f"has no such row")
        elif name not in ki:
            warns.append(f"skip of {name} cites {i}, but {i} does not mention "
                         f"the host by name")
print(f"  skips: {len(skips)} ({', '.join(h.get('name', '?') for h in skips) or 'none'})")

# --- 5d. production sources must not include the test/deliverable trees -------
# [168 2026-11-12] src/core/cache.c used to do
#     #include "../../tests/core/support/parflush_stub.c"
# inside `#ifndef RB_KERNEL_BUILD`. The textual include itself was fine (the
# implementation needs cache.c's static helpers and the opaque rb_engine
# layout), but the DIRECTION was wrong: a production TU reached into tests/,
# so moving or deleting a test file could break the engine, and the mtime
# freshness gate cannot see that coupling. The implementation now lives in
# src/core/cache_testhook.inc. This rule keeps the inversion from returning:
# every relative `#include "..."` under the production source roots must
# resolve inside the repo and must NOT land in tests/ or deliverables/.
LAYER_ROOTS = (
    ROOT / "src" / "core",
    ROOT / "src" / "driver",
    ROOT / "src" / "ctl",
    ROOT / "src" / "common",
)
FORBIDDEN_TREES = (ROOT / "tests", ROOT / "deliverables")
LAYER_EXTS = (".c", ".h", ".inc", ".cpp", ".cc", ".hpp")
INC_REL = re.compile(r'^\s*#\s*include\s+"([^"]+)"')
layering_scanned = 0
layering_hits = 0
for prod_dir in LAYER_ROOTS:
    if not prod_dir.is_dir():
        continue
    for p in sorted(prod_dir.rglob("*")):
        if p.suffix.lower() not in LAYER_EXTS:
            continue
        try:
            lines = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
        except OSError:
            continue
        layering_scanned += 1
        for lineno, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            mm = INC_REL.match(line)
            if not mm:
                continue
            inc = mm.group(1).replace("\\", "/")
            target = (p.parent / inc).resolve()
            for bad in FORBIDDEN_TREES:
                bad_r = bad.resolve()
                try:
                    target.relative_to(bad_r)
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                layering_hits += 1
                fails.append(
                    f"{p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}:{lineno}: "
                    f'#include "{inc}" resolves into {bad.name}/ '
                    f"-> {target.as_posix()} "
                    f"(production sources must not cross-include the test "
                    f"or deliverable tree)")
                break
print(f"  layering: {layering_scanned} file(s) scanned under "
      f"{len(LAYER_ROOTS)} prod roots, {layering_hits} cross-layer include(s)")

# --- 6. solution coverage ----------------------------------------------------
sln = ROOT / "build" / "RAMBlockCache.sln"
if not sln.exists():
    fails.append("build/RAMBlockCache.sln missing (single .NET solution)")
else:
    stxt = sln.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    for prj in tg.get("ui", {}).get("projects", []):
        name = Path(prj["path"]).name
        if name not in stxt:
            fails.append(f"solution does not contain product project {name}")

# --- 6b. auxiliary UI/Web source arrays (D18, report 237) -------------------
# targets.ui.sources / targets.web.sources are registered as the single source
# of truth for the liquid-glass files, but no gate consumed them, so a renamed
# or deleted file produced no freshness signal. They are not compiled TUs: they
# only need to resolve to a non-empty file inside the repo. Fail-closed: a
# missing/empty array is a FAIL and 0 verified files is a FAIL -- an empty
# match set is never a PASS.
aux_checked = 0
for aux_name in ("ui", "web"):
    aux_obj = tg.get(aux_name)
    if not isinstance(aux_obj, dict):
        fails.append(f"manifest: targets.{aux_name} is missing")
        continue
    aux_sources = aux_obj.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(aux_sources, list) or not aux_sources:
        fails.append(f"manifest: targets.{aux_name}.sources is empty or missing")
        continue
    for rel in aux_sources:
        if not isinstance(rel, str) or not rel.strip():
            fails.append(f"targets.{aux_name}.sources: invalid empty entry")
            continue
        ap = ROOT / rel.replace("\\", "/")
        try:
            ap.resolve().relative_to(ROOT)
        except ValueError:
            fails.append(f"targets.{aux_name}.sources escapes repo: {rel}")
            continue
        if not ap.is_file():
            fails.append(f"targets.{aux_name}.sources file missing: {rel}")
        elif ap.stat().st_size == 0:
            fails.append(f"targets.{aux_name}.sources file is empty: {rel}")
        else:
            aux_checked += 1
if aux_checked == 0:
    fails.append("targets.ui/web sources: 0 files verified (empty match set)")
print(f"  auxiliary ui/web sources: {aux_checked} file(s) verified")

# --- output ------------------------------------------------------------------
print("== check_build_manifest (Gate16) ==")
if warns:
    for w in warns:
        print(f"  [warn] {w}")
if fails:
    for f in fails:
        print(f"  [FAIL] {f}")
    print(f"GATE16 FAIL ({len(fails)} problem(s))")
    sys.exit(1)
print("GATE16 PASS")
````

##### `src/scripts/check_coexist.ps1`

````powershell
# check_coexist.ps1 -- read-only post-install health check for distribution machines.
# 2026-11-06 (U-9). Run in an ELEVATED PowerShell on the target machine AFTER
# installing, ideally with the third-party AV (e.g. 360) active. Pure ASCII
# output so it survives GBK/CP1252 consoles; no system changes, no writes.
# Exit 0 = no FAIL (WARN allowed); exit 1 = at least one FAIL.
param([string]$ExpectedSysSha256 = "")
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$fail = 0; $warn = 0
function Ok([string]$m)   { Write-Host "[ok]   $m" }
function Warn([string]$m) { Write-Host "[warn] $m"; $script:warn++ }
function Bad([string]$m)  { Write-Host "[FAIL] $m"; $script:fail++ }

Write-Host "== check_coexist (read-only) =="
Write-Host ("  machine={0}  utc={1}" -f $env:COMPUTERNAME, (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'))

# --- 1) service ---
$svc = Get-Service RAMBlockCache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $svc) { Bad "service RAMBlockCache missing" }
else { Ok ("service: {0} / {1}" -f $svc.Status, $svc.StartType) }

# --- 2) signed driver + hash vs expected anchor ---
$sys = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sys)) { Bad "System32 driver missing: $sys" }
else {
    $sig = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $sys
    $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $sys -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    if ($sig.Status -ne 'Valid') { Bad ("driver signature = " + $sig.Status) }
    else { Ok ("driver signature Valid; sha256=" + $hash) }
    if (-not $ExpectedSysSha256) {
        $side = "$sys.sha256"
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $side) {
            $first = Get-Content -LiteralPath $side -TotalCount 1
            if ($first -match '(?<![0-9a-fA-F])[0-9a-fA-F]{64}(?![0-9a-fA-F])') { $ExpectedSysSha256 = $Matches[0].ToLower() }
        }
    }
    if ($ExpectedSysSha256 -and $hash -ne $ExpectedSysSha256.ToLower()) {
        Bad "System32 driver hash differs from expected anchor (running instance may still be the old build until reboot)"
    }
}

# --- 3) guard scripts ---
$gd = 'C:\ProgramData\RAMBoost'
foreach ($s in @('boot_guard.ps1','logon_disarm.ps1')) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gd $s)) { Ok "guard script present: $s" }
    else { Warn "guard script MISSING: $s (boot_guard net degraded to signature gate + offline_rollback.cmd)" }
}

# --- 4) scheduled tasks ---
# Use the native cmdlet: schtasks.exe can be blocked by host policy, and a
# failed external command leaves $LASTEXITCODE stale -> false "task present".
# SYSTEM-level tasks may be invisible to a non-elevated / sandboxed token;
# report WARN (never a false OK) and tell the operator how to confirm.
foreach ($t in @('RAMBoostBootGuard','RAMBoostLogonDisarm','RAMBlockCacheBridge')) {
    $task = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($task) { Ok ("task present: {0} state={1}" -f $t, $task.State) }
    else { Warn "task NOT VISIBLE: $t (SYSTEM task may be hidden from this token, or AV blocked registration; confirm in your own elevated console with Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName '$t')" }
}

# --- 5) feature flags / write mode / watchman state ---
$par = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Parameters'
if (Test-Path $par) {
    $p = Get-ItemProperty -Path $par
    Ok ("armed={0} healthy={1} bootfails={2} seq={3} ack={4}" -f $p.FilterArmed, $p.LastBootHealthy, $p.BootFailCount, $p.DeploySeq, $p.DeployAck)
    if ($p.WriteBack -eq 1) { Warn "WriteBack=1 (user explicitly enabled; ensure this is intended)" }
} else { Warn "Parameters key missing (fresh install or rolled back)" }
$feat = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Features'
if (Test-Path $feat) {
    $f = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $feat -Name Flags -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Flags
    if ($null -ne $f -and $f -ne 0) { Warn "Features\Flags=$f (default is 0 = all feature flags off)" }
    else { Ok "Features\Flags=0 (default)" }
}

# --- 6) AV interference hints (informational) ---
$av = Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match '360|QHSafe|ZhuDongFangYu' } | Select-Object -First 5 -ExpandProperty ProcessName
if ($av) { Warn ("AV processes present: " + ($av -join ',') + " - if boot_guard tasks are missing, this is the likely cause (installer degrades to 2-layer net)") }

# --- 7) Driver Verifier state ---
$mm = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($mm -and $mm.VerifyDrivers) { Warn ("Driver Verifier active: " + $mm.VerifyDrivers + " (expected during harvest cycle only)") }
else { Ok "Driver Verifier off" }

Write-Host ("== result: FAIL={0} WARN={1} ==" -f $fail, $warn)
if ($fail -gt 0) { exit 1 }
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/check_config_decode_contract.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Gate12 static contract: RB_CONFIG -> TS 副本字段级契约（生成物 + 派生纪律）。

背景（124 号 F9 / T7c 变异测试）：
  check_proto_sync.py --strict 只比对 rb_proto.h 与 C# 镜像；
  **decodeConfig 曾完全裸奔**：删掉 proto-decode.ts 的 `['TinyLFU', 152],`
  后 8 道门禁仍全绿 —— 这正是 66 号 TinyLFU@152 白屏事故的同款缺陷。

[166 2026-11-12] RB_CONFIG 的 TS 侧已改为**代码生成**（WR-06 落地）：
      src/ctl/rb_proto.h --gen_proto_ts.py--> rb-config.generated.ts
  proto/types.ts / proto-decode.ts / bridge/server/index.ts 三处不再手写
  字段名与偏移，而是遍历生成物的 RB_CONFIG_FIELDS。
  校验分工因此调整为：

    Gate18 (check_proto_codegen.py) : C 头 ──生成器──▶ 生成物（逐字节）
    本门 (Gate12)                   : C 头 ──▶ 生成物字段表 逐字段比对
                                      + 三处副本「确实由生成表驱动」的结构断言
                                      + http-transport.ts zod 键集 ⊆ RB_CONFIG

  仍是"先剥离注释再比对"：只加 `//` 前缀的移除必须能被检出。

Exit 0 = contract holds; exit 1 = drift.
"""
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROTO_H = ROOT / "src" / "ctl" / "rb_proto.h"
DECODE_TS = ROOT / "src/ui/web" / "bridge" / "server" / "proto-decode.ts"
CI_YML = ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml"
SCRIPT_NAME = "check_config_decode_contract.py"

# [162 G-A 2026-11-12] RB_CONFIG 的 TS 侧副本（编码/前端）。
# 161 号 §1.4：解码侧被 Gate12 锁死，编码侧裸奔——"少编码一个字段，驱动
# RbApplyConfig 收到 0 并持久化"（66 号白屏事故的结构性成因）。
#   #4 bridge/server/index.ts  encodeParams(method===2)：全量编码 RB_CONFIG
#   #5 src/bridge/http-transport.ts  configSchema：zod 校验键集
#   #6 src/protocol/types.ts          RbConfig 类型
# [166 2026-11-12] #4/#6 与 decodeConfig 已改为**遍历生成表**（不再手写偏移）；
# 生成物由 src/ctl/rb_proto.h 产出，Gate18 守 C 头 ↔ 生成物，本门守生成物 ↔ 消费方。
INDEX_TS = ROOT / "src/ui/web" / "bridge" / "server" / "index.ts"
HTTP_TS = ROOT / "src/ui/web" / "src" / "bridge" / "http-transport.ts"
TYPES_TS = ROOT / "src/ui/web" / "src" / "protocol" / "types.ts"
CODEGEN_TS = ROOT / "src/ui/web" / "src" / "protocol" / "rb-config.generated.ts"

# configSchema 是**部分**校验面（looseObject：未列出的键原样透传），因此对它是
# "键集必须是 C 字段集的子集"，不是逐项全等。但它当前校验的 5 个键是已发布
# 行为（TinyLFU 的 default(0) 有独立的旧桥接兼容语义），删掉任何一个都是回退：
# 用下界锁住，理由同 check_proto_sync.py 的 MSG_FLOOR（防"删了就没人管")。
SCHEMA_FLOOR = ("Enabled", "WriteBack", "CacheSizeMB", "BlockSize", "TinyLFU")


def strip_c_comments(t):
    t = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", t, flags=re.S)
    return re.sub(r"(?m)^\s*//.*$", "", t)


def strip_ts_comments(t):
    t = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", t, flags=re.S)
    return re.sub(r"(?m)^[ \t]*//.*$", "", t)


def parse_macros(text):
    out = {}
    for name, val in re.findall(r"#define\s+(RB_\w+)\s+(\d+)", text):
        out[name] = int(val)
    return out


def parse_c_config(text, macros):
    """返回 (u32_fields[(name,off)], volume_filter_off, sizeof)。"""
    m = re.search(r"typedef\s+struct\s+RB_CONFIG_T\s*\{(.*?)\}\s*RB_CONFIG\s*;",
                  text, re.S)
    if not m:
        return None, None, None
    body = strip_c_comments(m.group(1))
    fields, vf_off, off = [], None, 0
    for line in body.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        mu = re.match(r"uint32_t\s+(\w+)\s*;", line)
        if mu:
            fields.append((mu.group(1), off))
            off += 4
            continue
        mv = re.match(r"wchar_t\s+(\w+)\s*\[\s*(\w+)\s*\]\s*\[\s*(\w+)\s*\]\s*;", line)
        if mv:
            def dim(x):
                return int(x) if x.isdigit() else macros.get(x, 0)
            n, k = dim(mv.group(2)), dim(mv.group(3))
            vf_off = off
            off += n * k * 2
            continue
        # [2026-11-12 修 fail-open] 原实现对不认识的字段行静默 `continue`，且
        # **不推进 offset**。后果：往 RB_CONFIG_T 里加一个 uint64_t / uint8_t
        # 字段后 ——
        #   · sizeof(RB_CONFIG) 被低估 ⇒ 本门的 `sizeof != 156` 判据**通过**；
        #   · gen_proto_ts.py 复用本函数 ⇒ 生成物同样缺该字段 ⇒ Gate18 的
        #     逐字节比对也**通过**；
        # 两道门禁双双变绿，而 Web 侧按 156 分配、驱动按真实 sizeof 读写 ⇒
        # 越界/错位。这正是 66 号批白屏的同型事故，只是更隐蔽（那次是漏改
        # 手写副本，这次是漏改后**连门禁都看不见**）。
        # 失败方向必须是"不生成、不通过"：新增非 uint32_t 字段时，先扩展本
        # 解析器的类型支持（含对齐规则），否则这里直接抛错。
        raise ValueError(
            "parse_c_config: RB_CONFIG_T 中存在本解析器不认识的字段行 -> %r；"
            "新增字段必须同步扩展本解析器（含对齐），否则 sizeof/偏移会被低估，"
            "Gate12 与 Gate18 会双双假绿" % line)
    return fields, vf_off, off


def parse_generated(text):
    """解析 rb-config.generated.ts（#0 生成物）。

    返回 (size, entries[(name, offset, width, kind, count, len)]) 或 (None, None)。
    """
    ms = re.search(r"export\s+const\s+RB_CONFIG_SIZE\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*;", text)
    mf = re.search(r"export\s+const\s+RB_CONFIG_FIELDS\s*:\s*[^=]+=\s*\[(.*?)\];",
                   text, re.S)
    if not ms or not mf:
        return None, None
    body = strip_ts_comments(mf.group(1))
    entries = []
    for blk in re.findall(r"\{([^{}]*)\}", body):
        d = {}
        for k, v in re.findall(r"(\w+)\s*:\s*'?([\w]+)'?", blk):
            d[k] = v
        if "name" not in d or "offset" not in d:
            continue
        entries.append((d["name"], int(d["offset"]), int(d.get("width", 0)),
                        d.get("kind", "u32"), int(d.get("count", 1)),
                        int(d.get("len", 1))))
    return int(ms.group(1)), entries


def generated_imports(text):
    """从 rb-config.generated（可带 .ts 扩展名）导入的符号集合；无导入返回 None。"""
    names, found = set(), False
    for m in re.finditer(
            r"import\s*(?:type\s*)?\{([^}]*)\}\s*from\s*'[^']*rb-config\.generated(?:\.ts)?'",
            text):
        found = True
        for n in m.group(1).split(","):
            n = n.strip()
            if n:
                names.add(n)
    return names if found else None


def check_decoder(text):
    """#1 decodeConfig：必须由 RB_CONFIG_FIELDS 驱动，且不得残留手写偏移表。

    返回 dict(found, driven, vf, guard, hard[(name,off)])。
    """
    m = re.search(r"export\s+function\s+decodeConfig\s*\(\s*\w+\s*:\s*Buffer\s*\)\s*\{(.*?)\n\}",
                  text, re.S)
    if not m:
        return {"found": False}
    body = m.group(1)
    return {
        "found": True,
        "driven": bool(re.search(r"for\s*\(\s*const\s+\w+\s+of\s+RB_CONFIG_FIELDS\s*\)", body)),
        "vf": bool(re.search(r"kind\s*===\s*'wchar2d'", body)),
        "guard": bool(re.search(r"p\.length\s*>=\s*RB_CONFIG_SIZE\s*\?", body)),
        "hard": [(n, int(o)) for n, o in
                 re.findall(r"\[\s*'([A-Za-z_]\w*)'\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*\]", body)],
    }


def check_encoder(text):
    """#4 encodeParams(method===2)：必须用 RB_CONFIG_SIZE + RB_CONFIG_FIELDS。

    返回 dict(found, driven, vf, alloc_sym, alloc_num, hard[(name,off)])。
    """
    m = re.search(r"if\s*\(\s*method\s*===\s*2\s*\)\s*\{(.*?)\n  \}", text, re.S)
    if not m:
        return {"found": False}
    body = m.group(1)
    ma = re.search(r"Buffer\.alloc\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)", body)
    return {
        "found": True,
        "driven": bool(re.search(r"for\s*\(\s*const\s+\w+\s+of\s+RB_CONFIG_FIELDS\s*\)", body)),
        "vf": bool(re.search(r"kind\s*===\s*'wchar2d'", body)),
        "alloc_sym": bool(re.search(r"Buffer\.alloc\(\s*RB_CONFIG_SIZE\s*\)", body)),
        "alloc_num": ma.group(1) if ma else None,
        "hard": [(n, int(o)) for n, o in
                 re.findall(r"\[\s*'([A-Za-z_]\w*)'\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*\]", body)],
    }


def parse_ts_interface(text):
    """#6 types.ts：转发生成物的 RbConfig，且不得再声明同名 interface。

    返回 dict(imports, reexport, local_iface)。
    """
    return {
        "imports": generated_imports(text),
        "reexport": bool(re.search(r"export\s+type\s*\{\s*RbConfig\s*\}", text)),
        "local_iface": bool(re.search(r"(?m)^\s*(?:export\s+)?interface\s+RbConfig\s*\{", text)),
    }


def parse_zod_keys(text, var):
    """#5 zod schema 的键名（按声明顺序）。"""
    m = re.search(r"const\s+%s\s*=\s*z\.\w+\(\s*\{(.*?)\}\s*\)\s*;" % var, text, re.S)
    if not m:
        return None
    return re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*:\s*z\.", strip_ts_comments(m.group(1)))


def cmp_named(label, base, other, base_label="C"):
    """逐项比 (name, offset)：数量/名字/顺序/偏移全等。返回 fail 列表。"""
    out = []
    if len(base) != len(other):
        out.append("%s: field count %s=%d %s=%d" %
                   (label, base_label, len(base), label, len(other)))
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(base, other)):
        if a[0] != b[0]:
            out.append("%s: field[%d] name %s=%s %s=%s (order drift)" %
                       (label, i, base_label, a[0], label, b[0]))
        elif a[1] != b[1]:
            out.append("%s: field[%d] %s offset %s=%d %s=%d" %
                       (label, i, a[0], base_label, a[1], label, b[1]))
    return out


def main():
    fails = []
    for p in (PROTO_H, DECODE_TS, INDEX_TS, HTTP_TS, TYPES_TS, CODEGEN_TS, CI_YML):
        if not p.is_file():
            fails.append("missing file: " + str(p))
    if fails:
        print("== check_config_decode_contract (Gate12) ==")
        for f in fails:
            print("[FAIL] " + f)
        print("result: FAIL (%d)" % len(fails))
        return 1

    proto_raw = PROTO_H.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    proto = strip_c_comments(proto_raw)
    decode = strip_ts_comments(DECODE_TS.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    ci = CI_YML.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    macros = parse_macros(proto_raw)
    # [2026-11-12] 严格模式：不认识字段行 -> FAIL（原来静默跳过 = sizeof 低估 =
    # 本门 sizeof 判据与 Gate18 字节比对双双假绿，Web 侧少一个字段）。
    try:
        c_fields, vf_off, sizeof = parse_c_config(proto, macros)
    except ValueError as _e:
        fails.append(str(_e))
        c_fields, vf_off, sizeof = None, None, None
    gen_size, gen_entries = parse_generated(
        strip_ts_comments(CODEGEN_TS.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")))
    dec = check_decoder(decode)
    index_raw = INDEX_TS.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    enc = check_encoder(strip_ts_comments(index_raw))
    types_raw = TYPES_TS.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tys = parse_ts_interface(types_raw)
    schema = parse_zod_keys(HTTP_TS.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"), "configSchema")

    if c_fields is None:
        fails.append("rb_proto.h: RB_CONFIG struct not found")
    if gen_entries is None:
        fails.append("rb-config.generated.ts: RB_CONFIG_SIZE / RB_CONFIG_FIELDS not found"
                     "（重跑 python -B src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py）")

    # ── A. C 头 ↔ 生成物：名/顺序/偏移/宽度 ──
    # 生成物是"机器产出"而非手写副本，但仍可能被手改或忘了重跑；这里独立再比一遍
    # （Gate18 比的是整份文件字节，本门比的是字段语义，两者不是重复而是交叉）。
    gen_u32 = ([(n, o) for n, o, w, k, c, l in gen_entries if k == "u32"]
               if gen_entries is not None else None)
    if c_fields is not None and gen_u32 is not None:
        fails += cmp_named("rb-config.generated.ts", c_fields, gen_u32)
        for n, o, w, k, cnt, ln in gen_entries:
            if k == "u32" and w != 4:
                fails.append("generated: %s width=%d != 4（u32）" % (n, w))
            elif k == "wchar2d" and w != cnt * ln * 2:
                fails.append("generated: %s width=%d != count*len*2=%d"
                             % (n, w, cnt * ln * 2))
        vfs = [e for e in gen_entries if e[3] == "wchar2d"]
        if len(vfs) != 1:
            fails.append("generated: wchar2d 字段数 %d != 1" % len(vfs))
        else:
            n, o, w, k, cnt, ln = vfs[0]
            if o != vf_off:
                fails.append("generated: %s offset %d != C vf_off %r" % (n, o, vf_off))
            want_dims = (macros.get("RB_MAX_VOLUMES"), macros.get("RB_VOL_LEN"))
            if (cnt, ln) != want_dims:
                fails.append("generated: %s 维度 [%d][%d] != C 宏 [%s][%s]"
                             % (n, cnt, ln, want_dims[0], want_dims[1]))
        if gen_size != sizeof:
            fails.append("generated: RB_CONFIG_SIZE=%r != C sizeof(RB_CONFIG)=%r"
                         % (gen_size, sizeof))

    if vf_off != 64:
        fails.append("VolumeFilter offset: expected 64, got %r" % vf_off)
    if sizeof != 156:
        fails.append("sizeof(RB_CONFIG): expected 156, computed %r" % sizeof)
    if "sizeof(RB_CONFIG)=156" not in proto_raw:
        fails.append("rb_proto.h: sizeof(RB_CONFIG)=156 contract comment missing")
    if SCRIPT_NAME not in ci:
        fails.append("ci.yml: %s not registered as a gate" % SCRIPT_NAME)

    # ── B. 三处副本必须由生成表驱动（不再手写偏移）──
    # 这些断言守的是"不得退回手写副本"，不是"手写副本是否与 C 一致"：
    # 一旦有人把偏移表抄回来，即使数值暂时正确也 FAIL。
    if not dec["found"]:
        fails.append("proto-decode.ts: decodeConfig() not found")
    else:
        if not dec["driven"]:
            fails.append("proto-decode.ts: decodeConfig 未遍历 RB_CONFIG_FIELDS"
                         "（禁止手写偏移表）")
        if not dec["vf"]:
            fails.append("proto-decode.ts: VolumeFilter 的 wchar2d 分支缺失")
        if not dec["guard"]:
            fails.append("proto-decode.ts: TinyLFU 分级长度守卫 "
                         "`p.length >= RB_CONFIG_SIZE ?` 缺失")
        if dec["hard"]:
            fails.append("proto-decode.ts: decodeConfig 残留手写偏移表 %r"
                         % (dec["hard"][:3],))
    dimp = generated_imports(decode)
    if not dimp or not {"RB_CONFIG_FIELDS", "RB_CONFIG_SIZE"} <= dimp:
        fails.append("proto-decode.ts: 未从 rb-config.generated 导入 "
                     "RB_CONFIG_FIELDS / RB_CONFIG_SIZE")

    if not enc["found"]:
        fails.append("index.ts: encodeParams(method===2) not found")
    else:
        if not enc["driven"]:
            fails.append("index.ts: encodeParams(method===2) 未遍历 RB_CONFIG_FIELDS")
        if not enc["vf"]:
            fails.append("index.ts: VolumeFilter 的 wchar2d 分支缺失")
        if not enc["alloc_sym"]:
            fails.append("index.ts: 必须 Buffer.alloc(RB_CONFIG_SIZE)（实测 alloc(%r)）"
                         % (enc["alloc_num"],))
        if enc["hard"]:
            fails.append("index.ts: encodeParams(method===2) 残留手写偏移表 %r"
                         % (enc["hard"][:3],))
    iimp = generated_imports(index_raw)
    if not iimp or not {"RB_CONFIG_FIELDS", "RB_CONFIG_SIZE"} <= iimp:
        fails.append("index.ts: 未从 rb-config.generated 导入 "
                     "RB_CONFIG_FIELDS / RB_CONFIG_SIZE")

    if not tys["reexport"]:
        fails.append("types.ts: 未 `export type { RbConfig }` 转发生成物")
    if tys["local_iface"]:
        fails.append("types.ts: 仍声明本地 interface RbConfig —— 与生成物并存即漂移源")
    if not tys["imports"] or "RbConfig" not in tys["imports"]:
        fails.append("types.ts: 未从 rb-config.generated 导入 RbConfig")

    # ── C. #5 zod schema：仍是手写"部分校验面"，键集必须是 C 字段集的子集 ──
    c_full = [n for n, _ in c_fields] if c_fields else []
    if c_fields is not None and vf_off is not None and vf_off % 4 == 0:
        c_full = c_full[:vf_off // 4] + ["VolumeFilter"] + c_full[vf_off // 4:]

    if schema is None:
        fails.append("http-transport.ts: configSchema zod object not found")
    else:
        unknown = [k for k in schema if k not in c_full]
        if unknown:
            fails.append("http-transport.ts: configSchema keys not in RB_CONFIG: %s" % unknown)
        lost = [k for k in SCHEMA_FLOOR if k not in schema]
        if lost:
            fails.append("http-transport.ts: configSchema dropped published key(s): %s" % lost)

    print("== check_config_decode_contract (Gate12) ==")
    print("  C  u32 fields : %s" % (len(c_fields) if c_fields else "n/a"))
    print("  generated     : %s entries (%s u32) sizeof=%s  VolumeFilter@%s" %
          (len(gen_entries) if gen_entries else "n/a", len(gen_u32) if gen_u32 else "n/a",
           gen_size, vf_off))
    print("  decode/index  : driven=%s/%s  VF=%s/%s  allocSym=%s" %
          (dec.get("driven"), enc.get("driven"), dec.get("vf"), enc.get("vf"),
           enc.get("alloc_sym")))
    print("  types.ts      : reexport=%s local_iface=%s; schema keys=%s" %
          (tys["reexport"], tys["local_iface"], len(schema) if schema else "n/a"))
    for f in fails:
        print("[FAIL] " + f)
    print("result: %s (%d fail)" % ("FAIL" if fails else "PASS", len(fails)))
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````
