````powershell
# File: src/scripts/check_l1_accel_readiness.ps1
# Purpose: READ-ONLY L1 acceleration readiness inspection. No writes, no reboot.
# Encoding: UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF, pure ASCII only.
# Origin: deliverables/239-full-stack-liquid-glass-guidance-2026-11-14.md sec 4.2.
# The sample embedded a CJK repository path, which violates the pure-ASCII
# rule. The repo root is derived from $PSScriptRoot instead.

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'

$repoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$distDir  = Join-Path $repoRoot 'dist'
# Real ctl output directory comes from build/sources.manifest.json targets.ctl.outDir.
# dist/ holds ONLY the signed .sys, Setup.exe and the .sha256 anchor.
$ctlDir   = Join-Path $repoRoot 'src\ctl'
$distSys  = Join-Path $distDir 'RAMBlockCache.sys'
$featCtl  = Join-Path $ctlDir 'rbfeatctl.exe'
$liveSys  = Join-Path $env:windir 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'
$regFeat  = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Features'

Write-Host '[1/4] Checking Features Flags registry value...'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $regFeat) {
    $props = Get-ItemProperty -Path $regFeat -ErrorAction Stop
    if ($null -eq $props) { throw 'Get-ItemProperty returned null; refusing a vacuous PASS.' }
    Write-Host ('      Current Flags = {0} (safe default = 0, L1-fast suggestion = 3)' -f $props.Flags)
    if (($props.Flags -band 0x4) -ne 0) { Write-Host '      NOTE: RB2F_L2 (0x4) is SET; Phase 4 keeps L2 frozen.' }
    if (($props.Flags -band 0x8) -ne 0) { Write-Host '      WARNING: RB2F_WBCOAL (0x8) is SET (R4 red line).' }
} else {
    Write-Host '      Features key not present (driver defaults to Flags=0).'
}

Write-Host '[2/4] Comparing anchored dist image with live System32 image...'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $distSys) {
    $distHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $distSys -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    Write-Host ('      dist SHA256 = {0}' -f $distHash)
} else {
    Write-Host '      dist driver MISSING.'
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $liveSys) {
    $liveHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $liveSys -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    Write-Host ('      live SHA256 = {0}' -f $liveHash)
    if ($distHash -and ($distHash -ne $liveHash)) {
        Write-Host '      R2 EXCEPTION WINDOW ACTIVE: live image differs from anchored dist.'
        Write-Host '      NEXT: run the R2 restore package, reboot once, then VerifyRestore.'
    }
} else {
    Write-Host '      live System32 driver MISSING.'
}

Write-Host '[3/4] Querying live volumes via rbfeatctl.exe vols...'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $featCtl) {
    & $featCtl vols 2>&1 | Out-Host
    Write-Host ('      vols exit code = {0} (5 means "not elevated")' -f $LASTEXITCODE)
} else {
    Write-Host '      rbfeatctl.exe not found in dist.'
}

Write-Host '[4/4] Querying live counters via rbfeatctl.exe stats -json...'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $featCtl) {
    & $featCtl stats -json 2>&1 | Out-Host
    Write-Host ('      stats exit code = {0} (5 means "not elevated")' -f $LASTEXITCODE)
}

Write-Host 'READ-ONLY COMPLETE: no registry write, no config change, no reboot.'
Write-Host 'Any live configuration change requires an explicit user decision.'
````

##### `src/scripts/check_l2_contract.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Static contract: L2 hashed-slot container (C-plan, 203/204/205).

Read-only. No subprocess, no build artifacts. This is the CI-side guard for
the fact that the core regression suite (33 hosts x Release+ASan = 66) does
NOT compile src/driver/rbL2.c, so a regression in the kernel-side L2 path
would otherwise pass every existing gate silently.

Root cause being guarded (deliverables/195, 196, 198):
  Pre-C rbL2.c stored a record at 4096 + blk*RB2_L2REC with blk = lba/64KB,
  and guarded it with `if (blk >= s_Slots) goto cleanup` in both ProbeFill
  and Store. On a 931GB volume the workload file starts at 3.5-62.9GB, so
  every block was outside the 2GB "prefix window" -> stores/hits/miss all 0,
  i.e. the L2 data plane was structurally unreachable. Verified on real HW
  twice (both UNCOVERED).

C-plan fix (203): the index layer ALREADY hashes arbitrary blk to a slot
  (RbL2Hash, idx[slot].Lba == blk<<16, IdxSave/Load carry Lba+Slot). Only
  the container file offset was still block-addressed. So no index format
  change is needed; the container record now lives at
      4096 + slot * RB2_L2REC,  slot = Hash(blk) % slots.
  The two window gates are deleted, and the container+idx files are renamed
  to RAMBoostL2c.* so the old on-disk layout can never be read.

Asserts (all on COMMENT-STRIPPED code, because change-log comments quote
the removed guards deliberately):
  A. old name literals RAMBoostL2.bin / RAMBoostL2.idx are GONE from rbL2.c,
     including the file-header comment;
     new L"RAMBoostL2c.idx" appears exactly 2x (RbL2IdxOpen + BootUnseal),
     new L"RAMBoostL2c.bin" exactly 1x (container open). The BootUnseal
     rename is P0-E: missing it leaves the new .idx without boot unseal and
     revives J11 stale-index -> wrong data.
  B. both `if (blk >= s_Slots)` gates are gone; no `blk * RB2_L2REC` left.
  C. both container RbL2Io offsets use `slot * RB2_L2REC` and the Store
     index update uses the SAME local `slot` (direct-mapping invariant).
  D. RbL2DropRange has no block-number clamp (`b1 > slots`) and uses the
     byte-range lo/hi scheme; the overflow clamp `off > ... - len` stays.
  E. RbL2HashWith takes an explicit slots snapshot and guards slots==0;
     RbL2IdxProbe takes the caller's slots (no global re-read asymmetry).
  F. active user-facing code/scripts carry no old container name.

Exit 0 = contract holds; exit 1 = the C-plan fix drifted.
"""
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
L2 = ROOT / "src" / "driver" / "rbL2.c"


def strip_comments(text):
    """Remove C block comments then line comments, preserving newlines."""
    text = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", text, flags=re.S)
    text = re.sub(r"//[^\n]*", "", text)
    return text


def active_files():
    """Only the files 203 §3/§4 enumerates as P1 rename targets.

    Kept explicit on purpose: rglob over src/ui picks up thousands of build
    artifacts (bin/obj/publish payload copies) and would slow the gate and
    produce false positives from stale generated binaries.
    """
    rel = [
        "src/ctl/rbfeatctl.c",
        "src/ui/web/bridge/server/index.ts",
        "src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/ViewModels/MainViewModel.cs",
        "src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/ViewModels/MainViewModel.Settings.cs",
        "src/ui/controller/RAMBlockCache.Controller/Services/FeatureConfigService.cs",
        "deliverables/RB-l2-p0c-test.ps1",
        "deliverables/RB-l2-enable.ps1",
        "deliverables/RB-l2-enable.cmd",
    ]
    # 205 P2-1: these four were verified to have ZERO old-name hits; still
    # listed so a future accidental rename-add is caught.
    rel += [
        "deliverables/RB-l2-observe.ps1",
        "deliverables/RB-l2-p0c-forensics.cmd",
        "deliverables/RB-l2-p0c-rollback.cmd",
        "deliverables/RB-l2-p0c-test.cmd",
    ]
    return [ROOT / r for r in rel]


def main():
    fails = []
    if not L2.is_file():
        print("[FAIL] missing src/driver/rbL2.c")
        return 1
    raw = L2.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    code = strip_comments(raw)

    # A. rename (raw text, because the header comment counts too: G6)
    for old in ("RAMBoostL2.bin", "RAMBoostL2.idx"):
        n = raw.count(old)
        # NOTE: RAMBoostL2c.* contains the old string as a prefix, so count
        # only standalone occurrences (not followed by 'c').
        n = len(re.findall(re.escape(old) + r"(?!c)", raw))
        if n:
            fails.append("rbL2.c still has %d standalone '%s' (P0-C/E)" % (n, old))
    for lit, want in ((r'L"RAMBoostL2c.idx"', 2), (r'L"RAMBoostL2c.bin"', 1)):
        got = code.count(lit)
        if got != want:
            fails.append("%s appears %d times, expected %d (P0-E)" % (lit, got, want))

    # B. window gates + block-addressed container offsets
    if "if (blk >= s_Slots)" in code:
        fails.append("pre-C window gate `if (blk >= s_Slots)` still present")
    if re.search(r"\bblk\s*\*\s*RB2_L2REC", code):
        fails.append("container offset still block-addressed (blk * RB2_L2REC)")

    # C. hashed offsets, same local slot in Store
    # [C-SLICE 2026-11-13] 2 -> 3：新增 RbL2FillPiece（切片填充里的单块读，
    # 与 RbL2ProbeFill 使用同一个 slot 表达式）。断言同时升级为「必须落在
    # 预期函数体内」——只把数字 2 改成 3 会让第 4 处悄悄溜进来，也会漏掉
    # 「某处被搬到别的函数」这种等价于丢失守卫的改动。
    n_slot_rec = len(re.findall(r"slot\s*\*\s*RB2_L2REC", code))
    if n_slot_rec != 3:
        fails.append("expected 3 `slot * RB2_L2REC` IO offsets "
                     "(ProbeFill/Store/FillPiece), found %d" % n_slot_rec)
    for fn, pat in (("RbL2ProbeFill", r"NTSTATUS RbL2ProbeFill\((.*?)\ncleanup:"),
                    ("RbL2FillPiece", r"static BOOLEAN RbL2FillPiece\((.*?)\n\}")):
        m = re.search(pat, code, flags=re.S)
        if not m:
            fails.append("cannot locate %s body for slot*REC audit" % fn)
        elif not re.search(r"slot\s*\*\s*RB2_L2REC", m.group(1)):
            fails.append("%s lost its slot * RB2_L2REC offset" % fn)
    store = re.search(r"VOID RbL2Store\((.*?)\ncleanup:", code, flags=re.S)
    if not store:
        fails.append("cannot locate RbL2Store body")
    else:
        body = store.group(1)
        if not re.search(r"\bslot\s*=\s*RbL2HashWith\(blk,\s*slots\)", body):
            fails.append("Store does not compute slot from local slots snapshot")
        if re.search(r"\bi\s*=\s*RbL2Hash\(", body):
            fails.append("Store re-hashes for the index update (must reuse same slot)")
        if not re.search(r"\bi\s*=\s*slot\s*;", body):
            fails.append("Store index update does not use the same local slot")

    # D. DropRange byte-range scheme
    dr = re.search(r"VOID RbL2DropRange\((.*?)\ncleanup:", code, flags=re.S)
    if not dr:
        fails.append("cannot locate RbL2DropRange body")
    else:
        b = dr.group(1)
        if "b1 > slots" in b:
            fails.append("DropRange still clamps block numbers to slot count (stale data)")
        if "lo  = off" not in b or "hi  = end" not in b:
            fails.append("DropRange missing lo/hi byte-range scheme (204 P0-A)")
        if "(ULONG64)-1 - len" not in b:
            fails.append("DropRange lost the off+len overflow clamp (:179)")
        if "for (s = 0; s < slots; s++)" not in b:
            fails.append("DropRange no longer iterates the slot table (O(s_Slots))")

    # E. hash guards / no global re-read asymmetry
    if not re.search(r"static ULONG RbL2HashWith\(ULONG64 blk, ULONG slots\)", code):
        fails.append("RbL2HashWith(blk, slots) missing (205 G7)")
    if "return slots ?" not in code:
        fails.append("RbL2HashWith has no slots==0 guard (P0-3 #DE)")
    if not re.search(r"RbL2IdxProbe\(ULONG64 blk, ULONG slots\)", code):
        fails.append("RbL2IdxProbe does not take the caller's slots (205 G7)")
    if re.search(r"RbL2IdxProbe\(blk\)", code):
        fails.append("legacy RbL2IdxProbe(blk) call remains")

    # F. no stale names in active user-facing code/scripts
    stale = []
    targets = active_files()
    for p in targets:
        if not p.is_file():
            fails.append("active rename target missing: " + str(p.relative_to(ROOT)))
            continue
        try:
            t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except OSError:
            continue
        for old in ("RAMBoostL2.bin", "RAMBoostL2.idx"):
            if re.search(re.escape(old) + r"(?!c)", t):
                stale.append(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/") + " -> " + old)
                break
    if stale:
        fails.append("stale container name in active files: " + "; ".join(sorted(set(stale))))

    print("check_l2_contract: hashed-slot L2 container")
    print("  rbL2.c: %d bytes, %d comment-stripped lines" % (len(raw), code.count("\n")))
    print("  active rename targets scanned: %d" % len(targets))
    if fails:
        for f in fails:
            print("[FAIL] " + f)
        print("result: FAIL (%d)" % len(fails))
        return 1
    print("result: PASS (0 fail, 0 warn)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

##### `src/scripts/check_layout.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Gate15 - repository layout contract.

Pure-static, CI-friendly. Enforces the normalized layout that came out of
report 140 (B1..B4). Checks:

  1. Root whitelist: only the agreed files/dirs at repo root.
  2. Forbidden dirs anywhere in the tracked tree:
     src/src, src/ui/wpf (legacy), bin/, obj/, build dirs outside build/,
     node_modules, x64 (outside src/driver/x64 which is untracked output).
     Actually: tracked files must not live under bin/obj/node_modules/x64 at all.
  3. No mojibake tracked paths. Legit UTF-8 Chinese doc names are fine
     (docs/00-总览.md etc.); what this gate bans is GBK-transcode damage:
     U+FFFD replacement chars, CJK codepoints that appear inside *code*
     directories (src/**/*.c|h|py|ps1), and the known damaged stems (寰, 幆).
  4. No *.obj/*.exe/*.pdb/*.dll tracked outside the signed deliverables in dist/
     (the distribution keeps exactly: RAMBlockCache.sys, .sha256, Setup exe).
  5. build/sources.manifest.json + build/build.ps1 + build/RAMBlockCache.sln exist.
  6. src/scripts/finalize_*.ps1 must not come back (one-off scripts live in
     archive/oneoff/).
  7. No duplicate README pairs: README.txt must not exist (merged into README.md
     in B3; the deploy anchors reference README.txt -> that file must be
     regenerated by sync_anchors, not tracked at root).

Exit 0 = PASS, 1 = FAIL.
"""
import subprocess
import sys
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
fails = []

ROOT_WHITELIST = {
    ".git", ".github", ".gitignore", ".nuget", ".mimosa", ".workbuddy",
    ".workbuddy-ai", ".zcode",
    # [AGENTS.md 2026-11-11] 仓库根常驻工作协议（新会话入口 / 红线 / 交接规则）。
    # 它是**项目资产**而非临时文件：所有接手人（人和 agent）都从这里读规则。
    # 未跟踪状态是预期（仓库纪律"先不提交"），而本门禁遍历文件系统而非 git
    # 索引，故必须显式登记——否则本地 gates 会因它而误红（CI 干净 checkout
    # 时不存在该文件，两边结论本该一致）。
    "AGENTS.md",
    "KNOWN_ISSUES.md", "README.md",
    "archive", "build", "certs", "deliverables", "dist", "docs", "src",
    "tests", "tools",
}

FORBIDDEN_DIR_PARTS = {"node_modules", "obj", "bin", "x64", "Debug", "Release"}

def tracked_files():
    out = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "ls-files", "-z"],
        capture_output=True, check=True,
    ).stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").split("\0")
    return [f for f in out if f]

# --- 1. root whitelist -------------------------------------------------------
for p in ROOT.iterdir():
    if p.name.startswith(".") and p.name not in ROOT_WHITELIST:
        continue  # untracked dot-dirs are host artifacts, not repo layout
    if p.name not in ROOT_WHITELIST:
        fails.append(f"root entry outside whitelist: {p.name}")

# --- 2-4. per tracked file ---------------------------------------------------
art_pat = re.compile(r"\.(obj|pdb|dll|lib|exp|ilk)$", re.IGNORECASE)
exe_allowed = {
    "dist/RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe",
    # Payload release inputs: build_setup.ps1 embeds these verbatim, and there
    # is no MSVC on CI to rebuild them - the tracked exe IS the deliverable.
    # They are rebuilt locally by build/build.ps1 -Target ctl|setup and guarded
    # by Gate9 (RB_STATS contract strings + freshness).
    "src/ctl/ramboostctl.exe",
    "src/ctl/rbfeatctl.exe",
    "src/setup/ramboostsetup.exe",
}
sys_allowed = {"dist/RAMBlockCache.sys", "dist/RAMBlockCache.sys.sha256"}

for f in tracked_files():
    parts = f.split("/")
    low = [p.lower() for p in parts]
    if any(seg in FORBIDDEN_DIR_PARTS for seg in low[:-1]):
        fails.append(f"tracked file under forbidden build dir: {f}")
    if "src" in low and "src/src" in "/".join(low):
        fails.append(f"tracked file under src/src: {f}")
    if low[0] == "src" and len(low) > 2 and low[1] == "ui" and low[2] == "wpf":
        fails.append(f"legacy WPF ressurected under src/ui/wpf: {f}")
    # mojibake: U+FFFD anywhere, known damaged stems anywhere, or any CJK
    # character inside a CODE path (code tree must stay ASCII; docs may be
    # Chinese). This is the check that would have caught the 寰幆 trio.
    if "\ufffd" in f or "寰" in f or "幆" in f:
        fails.append(f"mojibake tracked path: {f}")
    elif any("\u4e00" <= ch <= "\u9fff" for ch in f):
        code_exts = (".c", ".h", ".cpp", ".py", ".ps1", ".cmd", ".bat",
                     ".cs", ".csproj", ".vcxproj", ".json", ".yml", ".rc")
        low = f.lower()
        if low.endswith(code_exts):
            fails.append(f"non-ASCII name on code file: {f}")
        elif low.startswith("src/") or low.startswith("tests/"):
            fails.append(f"non-ASCII path inside code tree: {f}")
    # build artifacts in the tree
    if art_pat.search(f):
        fails.append(f"tracked build artifact: {f}")
    if f.endswith(".exe") and f not in exe_allowed:
        fails.append(f"tracked exe outside whitelist: {f}")
    if f.endswith(".sys") and f not in sys_allowed:
        fails.append(f"tracked sys outside whitelist: {f}")
    if f == "README.txt":
        fails.append("README.txt tracked at root (merge into README.md; "
                     "anchor copies are generated, not tracked)")
    if f.startswith("src/scripts/finalize_"):
        fails.append(f"one-off finalize script back in src/scripts: {f}")
    if f.startswith("outputs/") or f.startswith("report/"):
        fails.append(f"scratch dir tracked: {f}")

# --- 5. build triangle --------------------------------------------------------
for req in ("build/build.ps1", "build/sources.manifest.json", "build/RAMBlockCache.sln"):
    if not (ROOT / req).exists():
        fails.append(f"missing required build file: {req}")

print("== check_layout (Gate15) ==")
if fails:
    for x in fails:
        print(f"  [FAIL] {x}")
    print(f"GATE15 FAIL ({len(fails)} problem(s))")
    sys.exit(1)
print("GATE15 PASS")
````

##### `src/scripts/check_node_contract.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Toolchain contract: Node 27 + npm 12.2.1 (user decision 2026-11-06 15:14).

Static, read-only, no credentials, no subprocess build. Used by CI and by
developers locally. It deliberately does NOT require the *current* runtime to
be Node 27: GitHub's setup-node manifest has no 27.x (alpha not published
there), so CI runs compile-level checks on Node 22 while the real build and
the shipped portable runtime are pinned to Node 27 by build_setup.ps1.

Exit 0 = contract files agree; exit 1 = someone drifted the pin.
"""
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
NODE_MIN = "27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0"
NPM_MIN = "12.2.1"
EXPECTED = {"node": ">=" + NODE_MIN, "npm": ">=" + NPM_MIN}


def main():
    fails = []

    pkg = json.loads((ROOT / "src/ui/web/package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    lock = json.loads((ROOT / "src/ui/web/package-lock.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    e_pkg = pkg.get("engines", {})
    e_lock = lock.get("packages", {}).get("", {}).get("engines", {})
    if e_pkg != EXPECTED:
        fails.append("src/ui/web/package.json engines = %r, expected %r" % (e_pkg, EXPECTED))
    if e_lock != EXPECTED:
        fails.append("src/ui/web/package-lock.json root engines = %r, expected %r" % (e_lock, EXPECTED))

    setup = (ROOT / "src/scripts/build_setup.ps1").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    for marker, why in (
        ("Resolve-Node27", "build_setup.ps1 must resolve Node 27 explicitly (not PATH order)"),
        ("12.2.1", "build_setup.ps1 must verify npm 12.2.1"),
        ("RBC_NODE27", "build_setup.ps1 must expose an override for other machines"),
        ("--loglevel=error", "known npm alpha engines warning must be explicitly suppressed"),
        ("node_modules\\npm", "Setup must ship npm 12.2.1 INSIDE the package (all built in)"),
        ("npm.cmd", "Setup must ship the npm shim next to portable node.exe"),
    ):
        if marker not in setup:
            fails.append("%s: %s" % (why, marker))

    # [88 H-11 2026-11-07] marker strings alone are not enough: prove the
    # Resolve-Node27 body really COMPARES the versions.
    m = re.search(r"function\s+Resolve-Node27\s*\{(.*?)\n\}", setup, re.S)
    if not m:
        fails.append("build_setup.ps1: function Resolve-Node27 not found")
    else:
        body = m.group(1)
        if not re.search(r"-notlike\s+'v27\.\*'", body):
            fails.append("Resolve-Node27 lost its v27.* node-version check")
        if not re.search(r"-notlike\s+'12\.2\.1\*'", body):
            fails.append("Resolve-Node27 lost its 12.2.1* npm-version check")
        if "--version" not in body:
            fails.append("Resolve-Node27 no longer probes --version")

    ci = (ROOT / ".github/workflows/ci.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "check_node_contract.py" not in ci:
        fails.append("CI must call check_node_contract.py (guard against pin drift)")

    print("== check_node_contract ==")
    print("  pin: node >=%s, npm >=%s" % (NODE_MIN, NPM_MIN))
    print("  package.json engines      : %s" % e_pkg)
    print("  package-lock.json engines : %s" % e_lock)
    print("  build_setup.ps1           : node27 resolver + npm pin + warning suppression")
    print("  H-11 version guards       : v27.* + 12.2.1* + --version (AST-level regex)")
    if fails:
        for f in fails:
            print("[FAIL] " + f)
        print("result: FAIL (%d)" % len(fails))
        return 1
    print("result: PASS (0 fail, 0 warn)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

##### `src/scripts/check_poolcopy_contract.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Gate13 · 池/静态区越界写契约（防 00:32 根因族回归）

背景：11-09 00:32 的 0x7E/0xC0000005 池腐坏运行于 c6d36c4c（00:11 代）。
该代同时含两处已定位的越界写，均在当天后续批次修复：
  - 119 号 13:21：Rb2CurrentImagePath 的
        us->MaximumLength = sizeof(buf) - 8
    与「数据区从 +8 个 WCHAR(=16B) 开始」不匹配 ⇒ 多报 8 字节越界；
    正确契约是 sizeof(buf) - sizeof(UNICODE_STRING)。
  - 121 号 14:06：s_ExPidN 无锁「检查/索引/++」TOCTOU ⇒
    s_ExPid[64] 越界写，提交注释明确标注「与 00:32 未点名的 0x7E 同族候选」；
    正确契约是 volatile LONG + Interlocked 原子占槽 + 读侧上界钳到 64。
本门禁静态钉死这些契约，并覆盖另外两处 Unicode/大块池拷贝边界：
  - RbReadRegValue：分配 qs + sizeof(WCHAR)、拷贝 qs、NUL 写在 [qs/2]
  - L2 记录：RB2_L2REC = sizeof(RB2_L2HDR) + RB2_L2BLK，且
    RtlCopyMemory(rec+1, src, RB2_L2BLK) 不得越出该分配

用法：python check_poolcopy_contract.py [--root <repo_root>]
      --root 供变异测试在最小骨架上运行，真实仓库零改动。
"""
import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def strip_c(text):
    text = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", text, flags=re.S)
    return "\n".join(re.sub(r"//.*$", "", l) for l in text.splitlines())


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--root", default=None)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    root = Path(args.root) if args.root else DEFAULT_ROOT
    fails = []

    paths = {
        "rbfeat": root / "src/driver/rbfeat.c",
        "rbattach": root / "src/driver/rbattach.c",
        "rbL2": root / "src/driver/rbL2.c",
        "rbdriver": root / "src/driver/rbdriver.c",
        "rblog": root / "src/driver/rblog.c",
        "rbproto": root / "src/ctl/rb_proto.h",
        "ci": root / ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
    }
    for k, p in paths.items():
        if not p.is_file():
            fails.append("missing file: %s" % p)
    if fails:
        print("\n".join(fails))
        print("result: FAIL (%d fail)" % len(fails))
        return 1

    feat = strip_c(paths["rbfeat"].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    attach = strip_c(paths["rbattach"].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    l2 = strip_c(paths["rbL2"].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    driver = strip_c(paths["rbdriver"].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    rlog = strip_c(paths["rblog"].read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    ci = paths["ci"].read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    # A1/A2 119 号：MaximumLength 必须与 UNICODE_STRING 头对齐，且旧写法绝迹
    good_ml = "us->MaximumLength = (USHORT)(sizeof(buf) - sizeof(UNICODE_STRING));"
    bad_ml = "sizeof(buf) - 8"
    n_good = feat.count(good_ml)
    if n_good < 2:
        fails.append("A1 rbfeat: sizeof(UNICODE_STRING)-aligned MaximumLength "
                     "must appear on BOTH the primary and the 27-fallback path "
                     "(found %d)" % n_good)
    if bad_ml in feat:
        fails.append("A2 rbfeat: legacy 'sizeof(buf) - 8' MaximumLength "
                     "(8-byte OOB, 119 pre-fix) reintroduced")

    # A3/A4 121 号：原子占槽 + 读侧钳位
    if "static volatile LONG s_ExPidN;" not in feat:
        fails.append("A3 rbfeat: s_ExPidN must be 'static volatile LONG' "
                     "(plain ULONG reintroduces TOCTOU OOB write)")
    if "static ULONG  s_ExPidN;" in feat:
        fails.append("A3b rbfeat: plain ULONG s_ExPidN detected")
    if feat.count("InterlockedCompareExchange((volatile LONG *)&s_ExPidN") < 3:
        fails.append("A4 rbfeat: Interlocked-based slot reservation incomplete "
                     "(need read + CAS-loop + publish)")
    if "if (n > RB2_EXPIID_MAX) n = RB2_EXPIID_MAX;" not in feat:
        fails.append("A4b rbfeat: read-side upper bound clamp missing")

    # A5 RbReadRegValue：分配/拷贝/NUL 三者同界
    for token, why in (
        ("qs + sizeof(WCHAR)", "allocation"),
        ("RtlCopyMemory(copy, qd, qs)", "copy length"),
        ("((PWCHAR)copy)[qs / sizeof(WCHAR)] = L'\\0';", "NUL index"),
    ):
        if token not in attach:
            fails.append("A5 rbattach: RbReadRegValue %s contract missing" % why)

    # A6 L2 记录：头 24B + 64KB，写 rec+1 不越界
    m_blk = re.search(r"#define\s+RB2_L2BLK\s+\(64\s*\*\s*1024\)", l2)
    m_rec = re.search(r"#define\s+RB2_L2REC\s+\(24\s*\+\s*RB2_L2BLK\)", l2)
    m_hdr = re.search(r"typedef struct _RB2_L2HDR\s*\{(.*?)\}\s*RB2_L2HDR;",
                      l2, re.S)
    if not (m_blk and m_rec and m_hdr):
        fails.append("A6 rbL2: RB2_L2BLK / RB2_L2REC / RB2_L2HDR definition missing")
    else:
        fields = m_hdr.group(1)
        size = (8 if "ULONG64 Lba" in fields else 0) + \
               (4 if "ULONG Stamp" in fields else 0) + \
               (4 if "ULONG Crc" in fields else 0) + \
               (8 if "ULONG64 VolId" in fields else 0)
        if size != 24:
            fails.append("A6 rbL2: RB2_L2HDR size is %d, RB2_L2REC assumes 24 "
                         "=> RtlCopyMemory(rec+1,...,64KB) would overflow" % size)
        if "RtlCopyMemory((PCHAR)(rec + 1), src, RB2_L2BLK);" not in l2:
            fails.append("A6b rbL2: L2 record payload copy missing or changed")

    # A8 00:32 根因（130 号）：RbLogSnapshot 输出容量钳位。
    # 环容量 512、RB_LOG_LIST.Items[64]；无钳位时写 61440 B 到 7688 B
    # 信封，越界 53240 B，写入内容即日志 Unicode 文本。
    # [142] 日志环整体迁 rblog.c（rbdriver.c 已无该段），契约锚点随符号走。
    if "for (i = 0; i < valid && n < RB_LOG_MAX; i++)" not in rlog:
        fails.append("A8 rblog: RbLogSnapshot missing 'n < RB_LOG_MAX' "
                     "clamp - 00:32 pool corruption (53KB OOB) would return")
    if "for (i = 0; i < valid && n < maxCount; i++)" not in rlog:
        fails.append("A8b rblog: RbLogQueryPair must keep 'n < maxCount' "
                     "clamp (0x809 LOGQ output)")
    if "#define RB_LOG_MAX       64" not in paths["rbproto"].read_text(
            encoding="utf-8-sig"):
        fails.append("A8c rb_proto.h: RB_LOG_MAX=64 ABI changed; "
                     "re-verify snapshot capacity")

    # A7 CI 自检
    if "check_poolcopy_contract.py" not in ci:
        fails.append("A7 CI: Gate13 not registered in ci.yml")

    # A9 [I48 2026-11-10] WB/Enabled 降档必须 fail-closed（数据安全门）：
    #   旧实现忽略 flush 结果并无条件 discard（core 侧 count_lost=1 计入
    #   lost_dirty_bytes），AV 在位时 flush 连续失败 → 一次降档即静默丢弃
    #   7.87MB 已 ack 脏数据（e4/e5 探针实证）。断言：丢弃点之前必须有
    #   dirty_after 守卫，且守卫分支必须返回 STATUS_IO_DEVICE_ERROR。
    rbctl_txt = root / "src/driver/rbctl.c"
    rbcfg_txt = root / "src/driver/rbconfig.c"
    if not rbctl_txt.is_file() or not rbcfg_txt.is_file():
        fails.append("A9 rbctl.c/rbconfig.c missing")
    else:
        ctl = rbctl_txt.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        cfgconf = rbcfg_txt.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        didx = cfgconf.find("RbDiscardAllCachedData();")
        if didx < 0:
            fails.append("A9 rbconfig: RbDiscardAllCachedData call site missing")
        else:
            guard = cfgconf[max(0, didx - 2400):didx]
            if "dirty_after != 0" not in guard:
                fails.append("A9 rbconfig: discard without 'dirty_after != 0' guard "
                             "- data-loss regression (I48)")
            if "STATUS_IO_DEVICE_ERROR" not in guard:
                fails.append("A9 rbconfig: transition refusal return missing "
                             "- fail-open regression (I48)")

    # A10 [I48b 2026-11-10] 软 detach 路径同样必须 fail-closed（第二条丢弃通道：
    #   rbattach.c 热停用时 flush 后无条件 discard_all，AV 在场时实测同样丢脏）。
    att = attach
    didx2 = att.find("rb_stream_discard_all(")
    if didx2 < 0:
        fails.append("A10 rbattach: detach discard site missing")
    else:
        g2 = att[max(0, didx2 - 1400):didx2]
        if "left == 0" not in g2 and "dirty_bytes(st) == 0" not in g2:
            fails.append("A10 rbattach: detach discard without dirty==0 guard "
                         "- data-loss regression (I48b)")

    # A11/A12 [I48c/I48d 2026-11-10] 第三条/第四条丢弃通道：attach 热开启与
    #   SET_VOLUME 切直写同样"flush 失败仍无条件 discard_all"（真机 e5 一次
    #   attach 丢 7,872,512 B）。断言：两处丢弃点前必须有 dirty==0 守卫，
    #   否则必须走 rb_stream_discard_clean（只丢干净块）并留 KEPT 日志。
    for tag, marker in (("A11 attach", "attach: cache view KEPT"),
                        ("A12 set-volume", "write-through switch: cache view KEPT")):
        midx = ctl.find(marker)
        if midx < 0:
            fails.append("%s rbctl: KEPT marker missing - data-loss regression (I48c/d)" % tag)
            continue
        g = ctl[max(0, midx - 1600):midx]
        if "discard_clean" not in g:
            fails.append("%s rbctl: discard path lacks rb_stream_discard_clean "
                         "- data-loss regression (I48c/d)" % tag)
        if "dirty_bytes(ext->Stream) == 0" not in g:
            fails.append("%s rbctl: discard without dirty==0 guard "
                         "- data-loss regression (I48c/d)" % tag)

    # A13 [I48e/I48f 2026-11-10] 簇重排 FSCTL/IOCTL：flush 未净时必须
    #   fail-closed（拒绝转发），不得 discard_all（丢脏）也不得把脏留在
    #   旧 LBA 上继续回写（重排后以旧盖新）。
    for tag, marker in (("A13 fsctl", "fsctl: refused - dirty remains after flush (cluster-affecting op)"),
                        ("A13 ioctl", "ioctl: refused - dirty remains after flush (cluster-affecting op)")):
        midx = ctl.find(marker)
        if midx < 0:
            fails.append("%s rbctl: fail-closed marker missing (I48e/f)" % tag)
            continue
        g = ctl[max(0, midx - 900):midx]
        if "STATUS_DEVICE_BUSY" not in g or "RbCtlFail(irp, STATUS_DEVICE_BUSY)" not in ctl:
            fails.append("%s rbctl: cluster-affecting op not fail-closed "
                         "- data-loss/corruption regression (I48e/f)" % tag)

    if fails:
        for f in fails:
            print("[FAIL] %s" % f)
        print("result: FAIL (%d fail, 0 warn)" % len(fails))
        return 1
    print("Gate13 pool-copy contract: PASS "
          "(A1/A2 119 layout, A3/A4 121 atomic slot, A5 reg value, "
          "A6 L2 record, A8 log snapshot clamp, A7 CI, "
          "A9/A10/A11/A12/A13 data-loss guards)")
    print("result: PASS (0 fail, 0 warn)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

##### `src/scripts/check_proto_codegen.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""check_proto_codegen.py —— rb-config.generated.ts 与 rb_proto.h 的新鲜度门禁（Gate18）。

背景（161 号 §5 ③ / 162 号 G-A）：
  上一轮把 RB_CONFIG 的 4 份 TS 副本纳入 Gate12 做"手写 + 事后比对"，
  仍是靠人肉同步。本轮改为**从 C 头生成 TS**（gen_proto_ts.py），
  于是门禁要守的不再是"两份手写是否一致"，而是：

      C 头 ──(生成器)──▶ 磁盘上的 rb-config.generated.ts

本门在内存里重跑一遍生成逻辑，与磁盘文件比对：
  * 一致 → PASS；
  * 不一致 → FAIL 并打印 unified diff。

它能抓到的典型事故：改了 src/ctl/rb_proto.h 却没重跑生成器
（新增/改名/重排字段），此时生成物是陈旧的，所有下游 TS 副本跟着错——
正是 66 号 TinyLFU@152 整页白屏的同款成因。

为什么比"两个手写副本互相 diff"更强：生成物本身没有手写成分，
唯一的输入是 C 头，所以不存在"两份手写一起错"的盲区。

换行符：生成器固定写 LF；本门比对前把磁盘文本的 CRLF 归一为 LF——
Windows 下 core.autocrlf=true 的 checkout 会把文件签成 CRLF，
不归一会造成与内容无关的假红（内容比对不受影响）。

Exit 0 = 一致；exit 1 = 漂移。
"""
import difflib
import pathlib
import sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent))

from gen_proto_ts import OUTPUT, PROTO_H, render  # noqa: E402

CI_YML = ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml"
SCRIPT_NAME = "check_proto_codegen.py"


def main():
    fails = []
    print("== check_proto_codegen (Gate18) ==")
    print("  source : %s" % PROTO_H.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
    print("  output : %s" % OUTPUT.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())

    if not PROTO_H.is_file():
        fails.append("missing source header: " + PROTO_H.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
    if not OUTPUT.is_file():
        fails.append("missing generated file: " + OUTPUT.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() +
                     "（运行 python -B src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py）")

    if not fails:
        try:
            expected, meta = render()
        except SystemExit as e:
            fails.append("generator failed: %s" % e)
            expected, meta = None, None

        if expected is not None:
            actual = OUTPUT.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
            if expected != actual:
                diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(
                    actual.splitlines(keepends=True),
                    expected.splitlines(keepends=True),
                    fromfile="disk:" + OUTPUT.name,
                    tofile="expected: gen_proto_ts.py(rb_proto.h)",
                    n=3))
                print("".join(ln if ln.endswith("\n") else ln + "\n" for ln in diff))
                fails.append(
                    "rb-config.generated.ts 与 rb_proto.h 不同步：改了 C 头但没重跑 "
                    "`python -B src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py`（上方 diff：- 磁盘 / + 应为）")
            else:
                u32 = sum(1 for f in meta["fields"] if f["kind"] == "u32")
                vf = [f for f in meta["fields"] if f["kind"] == "wchar2d"]
                print("  fields : %d u32 + %d wchar2d  sizeof=%d（与 C 头一致）"
                      % (u32, len(vf), meta["size"]))

    # 自注册：门禁被从 CI 里删掉时不能静默通过。
    if CI_YML.is_file() and SCRIPT_NAME not in CI_YML.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        fails.append("ci.yml: %s 未注册为门禁步骤" % SCRIPT_NAME)

    for f in fails:
        print("[FAIL] " + f)
    print("result: %s (%d fail)" % ("FAIL" if fails else "PASS", len(fails)))
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````
