##### `src/scripts/ctl_safe.ps1`

````powershell
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Safe wrapper around ramboostctl with boot-critical guard and confirmation.

.EXAMPLE
  powershell -File ctl_safe.ps1 status
  powershell -File ctl_safe.ps1 attach -Volume F:
  powershell -File ctl_safe.ps1 detach -Volume F: -Yes
#>
#requires -RunAsAdministrator
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Position=0)][ValidateSet('status','attach','detach')]
    [string]$Action = 'status',
    [string]$Volume,
    [switch]$Yes
)
# Error-handling convention (spec D.3): $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' below; errors are
# reported as red Write-Host plus an explicit non-zero exit, matching deploy.ps1's Fail()
# and ramboostsetup.ps1's Die(). Exit codes:
#   0 = success (ramboostctl.exe's own exit code is propagated on attach/detach/status)
#   1 = ramboostctl.exe not found / boot-critical volume refused / user aborted
#   2 = usage error (missing -Volume)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$repoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $root   # [FIX 建议-7] 包根（dist\ 在包根，与 deploy.ps1 同源修正）

function Find-First($cands){ foreach($c in $cands){ if($c -and (Test-Path $c)){ return $c } } return $null }
$ctl = Find-First @(
    (Join-Path $repoRoot 'dist\ramboostctl.exe'),
    (Join-Path $root 'ctl\ramboostctl.exe')
)
if(-not $ctl){ Write-Host "[!] ramboostctl.exe not found." -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

function Get-BootCriticalLetters{
    $set = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]
    [void]$set.Add($env:SystemDrive.Substring(0,1).ToUpper())
    $mm = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management'
    foreach($n in 'PagingFiles','ExistingPageFiles'){
        foreach($line in @((Get-ItemProperty -Path $mm -Name $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).$n)){
            if($line -match '^\s*([A-Za-z]):'){ [void]$set.Add($matches[1].ToUpper()) }
        }
    }
    $cc = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl'
    foreach($n in 'DumpFile','DedicatedDumpFile','MiniDumpDir'){
        $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $cc -Name $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).$n
        if($v){
            if($v -match '%'){ [void]$set.Add($env:SystemDrive.Substring(0,1).ToUpper()) }
            elseif($v -match '^\s*([A-Za-z]):'){ [void]$set.Add($matches[1].ToUpper()) }
        }
    }
    return $set
}

switch($Action){
    'status' { & $ctl volumes; & $ctl status; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
    'attach' {
        if(-not $Volume){ Write-Host "[!] -Volume required, e.g. -Volume F:" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 2 }
        $L = $Volume.TrimEnd(':').Substring(0,1).ToUpper()
        $critical = Get-BootCriticalLetters
        if($critical.Contains($L)){
            Write-Host "[!] Volume ${L}: is boot-critical; refusing." -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1
        }
        if(-not $Yes){
            Write-Host "About to attach volume ${L}: to RAMBlockCache (runtime, no reboot)." -ForegroundColor Yellow
            $a = Read-Host "Type the drive letter again to confirm"
            # [FIX 建议-8 2026-10-18] 空输入 Substring 抛异常被全局吞 → 干净 Aborted
            if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($a) -or ($a.TrimEnd(':').Substring(0,1).ToUpper()) -ne $L){ Write-Host "Aborted."; exit 1 }
        }
        & $ctl attach $L
        exit $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    'detach' {
        if(-not $Volume){ Write-Host "[!] -Volume required" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 2 }
        $L = $Volume.TrimEnd(':').Substring(0,1).ToUpper()
        Write-Host "Detaching ${L}: (flushes dirty data first)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        & $ctl detach $L
        exit $LASTEXITCODE
    }
}
````

@echo off
REM deploy.cmd - self-elevate then run deploy.ps1, propagating its exit code.
REM NOTE: in a parenthesized block, %errorlevel% expands at parse time and
REM picks up the pre-net-session value, misreporting success as failure.
REM Use !errorlevel! (delayed expansion) instead.
setlocal EnableExtensions EnableDelayedExpansion
chcp 65001 >nul
net session >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p = Start-Process powershell -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru -ArgumentList '-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \"%~dp0deploy.ps1\"'; exit $p.ExitCode"
  set "RC=!errorlevel!"
  exit /b !RC!
)
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0deploy.ps1"
exit /b %errorlevel%

##### `src/scripts/deploy.ps1`

````powershell
# deploy.ps1  (V10.4.3 deploy: VERIFY-BEFORE-CHANGE gate + armed rollback guard)
# Pure ASCII. Must run elevated (deploy.cmd self-elevates).
#
# SAFETY MODEL (V10.4.3):
#   A hard pre-flight gate runs BEFORE any file/registry mutation:
#     A. resolve source sys  -> dist\RAMBlockCache.sys  OR  driver\x64\Release\RAMBlockCache.sys
#     B. SHA256(source) == expected pin  (param > <sys>.sha256 sidecar > build pin)
#     C. Authenticode verify (signtool /pa) on the source sys MUST succeed.
#        signtool missing  =>  FAIL (fail-closed).
#   Only if A+B+C pass do we touch PendingFileRenameOperations, the System32 copy,
#   service start type, volume-class UpperFilters, armed flags, or scheduled tasks.
#   ANY failure path exits non-zero AND rolls back everything already changed
#   (original values are backed up first).
#
#   Writing FilterArmed=1 + BOOT_START + UpperFilters while an unverified binary
#   is on disk is the exact 0x7B boot-brick scenario. That is why the gate is first.
#
# Steps (only after the gate passes):
#   1. Clean stale PendingFileRenameOperations entries that reference RAMBlockCache.sys
#   2. Copy the signed RAMBlockCache.sys into System32\drivers (MoveFileEx fallback,
#      return value checked).
#   2b. Convert service to BOOT_START + System Bus Extender.
#   2c. Append RAMBlockCache to volume-class UpperFilters (preserve existing, e.g. volsnap).
#   3. Write armed baseline: DeploySeq+1, BootFailCount=0, LastBootHealthy=0, FilterArmed=1
#   3b. Ensure Features\Flags=0.
#   4. Install guard scripts into C:\ProgramData\RAMBoost.
#   5. Register RAMBoostBootGuard (AtStartup) / RAMBoostLogonDisarm (AtLogOn).
#   6. Post-copy verification of the deployed System32 copy (verify_deploy_signature.ps1).
#
# This script does NOT reboot or shut down.

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$SysSource      = "",
    [string]$ExpectedSha256 = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# Build19 delivered driver pin. Override with -ExpectedSha256 or a <sys>.sha256
# sidecar file next to the source sys. If none is available the gate FAILS CLOSED.
$DefaultExpectedSha256 = '2c1096d86372c5880e702eb5781d3be9f6f6b7ade7915660105423c74cc786de'

Write-Host '== RAMBlockCache V10.4.3 deploy (verify-before-change) =='
# [FIX G1 2026-11-15] 记录引擎身份：门禁失败时必须能区分"文件不对"和"宿主编译器退化"。
# 现场出现过 Get-FileHash 不可解析的宿主（Utility 模块未提供该 cmdlet），
# 只看单行报错无法判断是哪一类。PSEdition 在 5.1 为 Desktop，旧宿主可能为空。
$hostEngine = 'PowerShell ' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition) { $hostEngine = $hostEngine + ' / ' + $PSVersionTable.PSEdition }
Write-Host ("[..] host engine  : {0}" -f $hostEngine)

function Fail([string]$Message, [int]$Code = 1) {
    Write-Host "[X] $Message" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit $Code
}

# --- 0. Admin check ---
$id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
$pr = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($id)
if (-not $pr.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) {
    Fail 'Run as Administrator (launch deploy.cmd).' 1
}

$scriptsDir = $PSScriptRoot
$root       = Split-Path -Parent $scriptsDir   # = src\
# [FIX 2026-10-17] 包根 = src\ 的上一级（dist\ 在包根，不在 src\ 下）。
# 原候选 "$root\dist\RAMBlockCache.sys" 恒落空，部署误选 src\driver\x64\Release
# 的未签名编译产物——被哈希门禁 fail-closed 正确拦下，但部署链断。
$repoRoot   = Split-Path -Parent $root
$clsKey     = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{71a27cdd-812a-11d0-bec7-08002be2092f}'
$svcReg     = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache'
$svcRoot    = "$svcReg\Parameters"
$featKey    = "$svcReg\Features"
$smKey      = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager'
$pdDir      = 'C:\ProgramData\RAMBoost'
$dest       = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'

# sc.exe text mappings (used to restore the service config on rollback).
$startMap = @{ 0='boot'; 1='system'; 2='auto'; 3='demand'; 4='disabled' }
$errorMap = @{ 0='ignore'; 1='normal'; 2='severe'; 3='critical' }
$typeMap  = @{ 1='kernel'; 2='filesystem'; 4='adapter'; 8='recognizer'; 16='own'; 32='share'; 256='interactive' }

function Resolve-SysSource([string]$Explicit) {
    if ($Explicit) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit) { return (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit).Path }
        throw "specified -SysSource not found: $Explicit"
    }
    $cands = @(
        (Join-Path $repoRoot 'dist\RAMBlockCache.sys'),            # 包根\dist = 签名部署产物（优先）
        (Join-Path $root 'driver\x64\Release\RAMBlockCache.sys')   # src\driver 编译产物（兜底，须经签名门禁）
    )
    foreach ($c in $cands) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c) { return (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $c).Path }
    }
    throw "signed sys not found; looked in: $($cands -join ' ; ')"
}

function Resolve-ExpectedSha([string]$Sys, [string]$Explicit) {
    if ($Explicit) { return $Explicit.Trim().ToLower() }
    $sidecar = "$Sys.sha256"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sidecar) {
        $first = Get-Content -LiteralPath $sidecar -TotalCount 1
        # [FIX S-02] sidecar 首行哈希正则三处统一（deploy.ps1 / verify_deploy_signature.ps1 /
        # check_signature.ps1）：词边界匹配，禁行内任意位置取首条——"SHA256: <hash>" 格式
        # 必须三处同解；改此正则必须同步另两处。
        if ($first -match '(?<![0-9a-fA-F])[0-9a-fA-F]{64}(?![0-9a-fA-F])') { return $matches[0].ToLower() }
        throw "sidecar hash file has no 64-hex SHA256: $sidecar"
    }
    if ($DefaultExpectedSha256) { return $DefaultExpectedSha256.ToLower() }
    return $null
}

function Resolve-SignTool {
    $cmd = Get-Command signtool.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }
    $roots = @()
    if (${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}) { $roots += (Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Windows Kits\10\bin') }
    if ($env:ProgramFiles)        { $roots += (Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles        'Windows Kits\10\bin') }
    foreach ($r in $roots) {
        if ($r -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $r)) {
            $hit = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $r -Recurse -Filter 'signtool.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                   Where-Object { $_.FullName -match '\\x64\\signtool\.exe$' } |
                   Sort-Object FullName -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($hit) { return $hit.FullName }
        }
    }
    return $null
}

# [FIX G1 2026-11-15] Cmdlet-free SHA256.
# 现场故障：某个宿主里 Get-FileHash 报 "is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet"，
# 门禁于是在第一行就 fail-closed（行为正确，但原因错了——文件完全可读）。哈希是硬门禁，
# 不能依赖某个模块被自动加载，故改为直接用 .NET API 计算。
# FileShare.ReadWrite 是必须的：目标文件可能正被驱动持有或被 PendingFileRename 排住，
# 用 FileShare.Read 打开会在"最需要哈希"的那些文件上抛共享冲突。
function Get-Sha256Hex([string]$Path) {
    $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($Path,
            [System.IO.FileMode]::Open,
            [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read,
            [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
    try {
        $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
        try {
            $bytes = $sha.ComputeHash($fs)
            return ([System.BitConverter]::ToString($bytes) -replace '-', '').ToLowerInvariant()
        } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
    } finally { $fs.Dispose() }
}

# =====================================================================
#  PRE-FLIGHT GATE  (no mutations before this block completes)
# =====================================================================
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '== Pre-flight verification gate =='

try { $srcSys = Resolve-SysSource $SysSource } catch { Fail $_.Exception.Message 1 }
Write-Host "[..] source sys   : $srcSys"

try { $srcHash = Get-Sha256Hex $srcSys }
catch { Fail "cannot hash source sys: $($_.Exception.Message)" 1 }
Write-Host "[..] source SHA256: $srcHash"

try { $expected = Resolve-ExpectedSha $srcSys $ExpectedSha256 }
catch { Fail $_.Exception.Message 1 }
if (-not $expected) {
    Fail 'no expected SHA256 available (pass -ExpectedSha256 or add <sys>.sha256). Refusing to deploy.' 1
}
Write-Host "[..] expected hash: $expected"
if ($srcHash -ne $expected) {
    Fail "SHA256 mismatch (source=$srcHash expected=$expected). DO NOT deploy / DO NOT reboot." 2
}
Write-Host '[ok] SHA256 matches expected pin.'

$signtool = Resolve-SignTool
if (-not $signtool) {
    Fail 'signtool.exe not found (PATH / Windows Kits). Authenticode verification cannot run; refusing to deploy.' 3
}
Write-Host "[..] signtool     : $signtool"
# [FIX A3] Authenticode 状态显式校验：与上方 SHA256 锚点同级输出。
# signtool /pa（下方）继续保留作双保险；本段以 PowerShell 原生 API 显式
# 取 Status/SignerInfo，让"签名有效"成为与哈希同级的可读断言
# （0x7B 事故整改：门禁此前缺"签名有效性"维度）。
# [FIX G1 2026-11-15] 若该宿主没有 Get-AuthenticodeSignature，不因此放行也不因此中断：
# 权威判据是下方强制执行的 signtool verify /pa（缺 signtool 即 FAIL）。cmdlet 在时
# 仍做显式 Status=Valid 断言，行为与修复前完全一致；不在时打一行说明再交给 signtool。
if (Get-Command Get-AuthenticodeSignature -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    try { $auth = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $srcSys -ErrorAction Stop }
    catch { Fail "Get-AuthenticodeSignature failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" 3 }
    Write-Host "[..] signature    : $($auth.Status)"
    try {
        if ($auth.SignerInfo -and $auth.SignerInfo.Subject) {
            Write-Host "[..] signer       : $($auth.SignerInfo.Subject)"
        }
    } catch { }
    if ($auth.Status -ne 'Valid') {
        Fail "Authenticode signature is '$($auth.Status)' (not Valid). An unsigned or untrusted driver as BOOT_START + UpperFilters WILL 0x7B-loop the machine. DO NOT deploy / DO NOT reboot." 3
    }
    Write-Host '[ok] Authenticode signature status: Valid.'
} else {
    Write-Host '[..] signature    : cmdlet unavailable on this host -> signtool /pa is the authoritative check below'
}
& $signtool verify /pa /v $srcSys | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Fail "signtool verify FAILED (exit $LASTEXITCODE). DO NOT deploy / DO NOT reboot." 3
}
Write-Host '[ok] Authenticode signature verified (signtool /pa).'
Write-Host '[ok] Pre-flight gate PASSED - applying changes.'

# =====================================================================
#  BACKUP original state (before the first mutation)
# =====================================================================
# [FIX S-01] 备份段扩充：除原"值备份"外，新增整键/文件/目录/任务存在性快照
# （fresh-install 回滚"不存在->删除"的依据）。System32 旧文件与守卫脚本的
# 内容备份不在此段——变异可能中途失败，内容备份必须紧贴覆盖点（见变异段）。
$backupErrors = @()
$backup = @{
    UpperFiltersExisted = $false; UpperFilters = @()
    SvcExisted = $false; SvcStart = $null; SvcType = $null; SvcError = $null; SvcGroup = $null
    PfroExisted = $false; Pfro = @()
    ParamProps = @{}
    FeatExisted = $false; FeatFlags = 0
    SvcRootExisted = $false
    FeatKeyExisted = $false
    Sys32Existed = $false; Sys32Backup = $null; Sys32Replaced = $false
    PdDirExisted = $false
    GuardExisted = @{}; GuardBackup = @{}
    TaskExisted = @{}; TaskDef = @{}
    Mutated = $false
}

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $svcReg) {
    $sp = Get-ItemProperty -Path $svcReg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $backup.SvcExisted = $true
    $backup.SvcStart   = $sp.Start
    $backup.SvcType    = $sp.Type
    $backup.SvcError   = $sp.ErrorControl
    $backup.SvcGroup   = $sp.Group
}
$ufp = Get-ItemProperty -Path $clsKey -Name UpperFilters -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($ufp -and $null -ne $ufp.UpperFilters) {
    $backup.UpperFiltersExisted = $true
    $backup.UpperFilters = @($ufp.UpperFilters)
}
$pfroProp = Get-ItemProperty -Path $smKey -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($pfroProp -and $null -ne $pfroProp.PendingFileRenameOperations) {
    $backup.PfroExisted = $true
    $backup.Pfro = @($pfroProp.PendingFileRenameOperations)
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $svcRoot) {
    $pp = Get-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($n in @('DeploySeq','DeployAck','BootFailCount','LastBootHealthy','FilterArmed','TestSigned','Signer','BootReachedUser')) {
        if ($pp -and ($pp.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains $n)) { $backup.ParamProps[$n] = $pp.$n }
    }
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $featKey) {
    $fp = Get-ItemProperty -Path $featKey -Name Flags -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($fp -and $null -ne $fp.Flags) { $backup.FeatExisted = $true; $backup.FeatFlags = $fp.Flags }
}
# [FIX S-01] 存在性快照：Parameters/Features 整键、System32 目标、pdDir、
# 两个守卫脚本、两个计划任务（含 XML 导出，供 redeploy 场景还原）。
$backup.SvcRootExisted = Test-Path -LiteralPath $svcRoot
$backup.FeatKeyExisted = Test-Path -LiteralPath $featKey
$backup.Sys32Existed   = Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest
$backup.PdDirExisted   = Test-Path -LiteralPath $pdDir
foreach ($g in @('boot_guard.ps1','logon_disarm.ps1')) {
    $backup.GuardExisted[$g] = Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $pdDir $g)
}
foreach ($tn in @('RAMBoostBootGuard','RAMBoostLogonDisarm')) {
    $t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $tn -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $backup.TaskExisted[$tn] = [bool]$t
    if ($t) {
        try { $backup.TaskDef[$tn] = Export-ScheduledTask -TaskName $tn }
        catch { $backupErrors += "export task $tn`: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
}
if ($backupErrors.Count -gt 0) {
    foreach ($e in $backupErrors) { Write-Host "[X] backup incomplete: $e" -ForegroundColor Red }
    Fail 'pre-deploy backup incomplete; refusing to mutate (rollback would not be symmetric).' 1
}

function Invoke-Rollback {
    Write-Host '[..] rolling back to pre-deploy state ...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $errors = @()
    # ① UpperFilters：存在→恢复 / 不存在→删属性
    try {
        if ($backup.UpperFiltersExisted) {
            Set-ItemProperty -Path $clsKey -Name UpperFilters -Value $backup.UpperFilters -Type MultiString
        } else {
            Remove-ItemProperty -Path $clsKey -Name UpperFilters -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
    } catch { $errors += "UpperFilters: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    # ② 服务：存在→sc config 恢复（[FIX S-01] 查退出码）/ 不存在→Stop + sc delete
    #    （fresh-install 残留必须清除，否则机器带着 BOOT_START 服务重启）
    if ($backup.SvcExisted) {
        try {
            $st = if ($null -ne $backup.SvcStart -and $startMap.ContainsKey([int]$backup.SvcStart)) { $startMap[[int]$backup.SvcStart] } else { 'demand' }
            $ec = if ($null -ne $backup.SvcError -and $errorMap.ContainsKey([int]$backup.SvcError)) { $errorMap[[int]$backup.SvcError] } else { 'normal' }
            $ty = if ($null -ne $backup.SvcType  -and $typeMap.ContainsKey([int]$backup.SvcType))   { $typeMap[[int]$backup.SvcType] }   else { 'kernel' }
            & sc.exe config RAMBlockCache start= $st error= $ec type= $ty | Out-Null
            # [FIX S-01] 恢复路径同样查退出码：sc.exe 失败必须可见，不能静默"恢复成功"
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "sc.exe config restore failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
            # [FIX 建议-2 2026-10-18] 组名含空格（System Bus Extender）需整参数传递，否则 sc.exe 拆词回滚失败
            if ($backup.SvcGroup) {
                & sc.exe config RAMBlockCache "group=$($backup.SvcGroup)" | Out-Null
                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "sc.exe config group restore failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
            }
        } catch { $errors += "service: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    } else {
        # [FIX S-01] fresh-install：服务是本次部署引入的，停掉并删除。
        # A2：Stop-Service + 10s 有界轮询；轮询超时仍继续 sc.exe delete（打删除标记），
        # 与 install.ps1:53 一致容忍 {0,1060}（1060=服务已不存在）。
        try {
            Stop-Service -Name 'RAMBlockCache' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            $waited = 0
            while ($waited -lt 10) {
                $svc = Get-Service -Name 'RAMBlockCache' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                if (-not $svc -or $svc.Status -eq 'Stopped') { break }
                Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
                $waited++
            }
            & sc.exe delete RAMBlockCache | Out-Null
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne 1060) {
                throw "sc.exe delete failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE; 1060=already-gone is tolerated)"
            }
            Write-Host '[ok] fresh-install service RAMBlockCache removed (stop + sc delete)'
        } catch { $errors += "service delete: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
    # ③ Parameters（armed 基线）：svcRoot 键不存在→整键删 / 存在→恢复备份值 + 删部署新建属性
    try {
        if (-not $backup.SvcRootExisted) {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $svcRoot) { Remove-Item -Path $svcRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
        } else {
            foreach ($n in @('DeploySeq','DeployAck','BootFailCount','LastBootHealthy','FilterArmed','TestSigned','Signer','BootReachedUser')) {
                if ($backup.ParamProps.ContainsKey($n)) {
                    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name $n -Value $backup.ParamProps[$n] -Type DWord
                } else {
                    Remove-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                }
            }
        }
    } catch { $errors += "Parameters: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    # ④ Features\Flags：键不存在→整键删 / Flags 部署前不存在→删属性 / 存在→恢复
    try {
        if (-not $backup.FeatKeyExisted) {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $featKey) { Remove-Item -Path $featKey -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
        } elseif (-not $backup.FeatExisted) {
            Remove-ItemProperty -Path $featKey -Name Flags -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        } else {
            Set-ItemProperty -Path $featKey -Name Flags -Value $backup.FeatFlags -Type DWord
        }
    } catch { $errors += "Features\Flags: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    # ⑤ 计划任务：存在→Register -Xml 还原 / 不存在→Unregister
    foreach ($tn in @('RAMBoostBootGuard','RAMBoostLogonDisarm')) {
        try {
            if ($backup.TaskExisted[$tn]) {
                if (-not $backup.TaskDef[$tn]) { throw "no exported XML for pre-existing task $tn" }
                Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $tn -Xml $backup.TaskDef[$tn] -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
            } else {
                Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $tn -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            }
        } catch { $errors += "task $tn`: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
    # ⑥ 文件：sys32 还原或删除 + 守卫脚本还原或删除 + pdDir（部署新建则整删）
    try {
        if ($backup.Sys32Existed) {
            if ($backup.Sys32Replaced -and $backup.Sys32Backup -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backup.Sys32Backup)) {
                Copy-Item -LiteralPath $backup.Sys32Backup -Destination $dest -Force -ErrorAction Stop
            }
        } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dest -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        }
    } catch { $errors += "System32 sys: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    foreach ($g in @('boot_guard.ps1','logon_disarm.ps1')) {
        $gp = Join-Path $pdDir $g
        try {
            if ($backup.GuardExisted[$g]) {
                if ($backup.GuardBackup[$g] -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $backup.GuardBackup[$g])) {
                    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $backup.GuardBackup[$g] -Destination $gp -Force -ErrorAction Stop
                }
            } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath $gp) {
                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $gp -Force -ErrorAction Stop
            }
        } catch { $errors += "guard $g`: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
    try {
        if (-not $backup.PdDirExisted -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pdDir)) {
            Remove-Item -Path $pdDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        }
    } catch { $errors += "pdDir: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    # ⑦ PFRO：恢复或删除（现状已含取消 MoveFileEx 排队替换）+ [FIX S-01] 回滚后一致性断言
    #    （既验"排队已取消"，也防误删第三方条目）
    try {
        if ($backup.PfroExisted) {
            Set-ItemProperty -Path $smKey -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -Value $backup.Pfro -Type MultiString
        } else {
            Remove-ItemProperty -Path $smKey -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
    } catch { $errors += "PFRO: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    try {
        $nowPfro = @((Get-ItemProperty -Path $smKey -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).PendingFileRenameOperations)
        $expectPfro = if ($backup.PfroExisted) { @($backup.Pfro) } else { @() }
        if (($nowPfro -join '|') -ne ($expectPfro -join '|')) {
            $errors += ("PFRO assertion: post-rollback value differs from backup (now=[{0}] expected=[{1}])" -f ($nowPfro -join ', '), ($expectPfro -join ', '))
        }
    } catch { $errors += "PFRO assertion: $($_.Exception.Message)" }

    if ($errors.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host '[ok] rollback complete - system restored to pre-deploy state.' -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host '[!!] ROLLBACK INCOMPLETE:' -ForegroundColor Red
        foreach ($e in $errors) { Write-Host "     - $e" -ForegroundColor Red }
        Write-Host '[!!] Recover offline with scripts\offline_rollback.cmd (WinRE).' -ForegroundColor Red
    }
}

# =====================================================================
#  MUTATIONS  (all guarded; any throw -> rollback + non-zero exit)
# =====================================================================
$pendingReplace = $false
try {
    $backup.Mutated = $true

    # --- 1. Clean stale PendingFileRenameOperations for RAMBlockCache.sys ---
    $pfro = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $smKey -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).PendingFileRenameOperations
    if ($pfro) {
        $kept = @($pfro | Where-Object { $_ -notlike '*RAMBlockCache.sys*' })
        if ($kept.Count -gt 0) {
            Set-ItemProperty -Path $smKey -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -Value $kept -Type MultiString
        } else {
            Remove-ItemProperty -Path $smKey -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
        Write-Host '[ok] cleaned stale PendingFileRenameOperations entries for RAMBlockCache.sys'
    } else {
        Write-Host '[..] no PendingFileRenameOperations to clean'
    }

    # --- 2. Copy signed sys into System32\drivers ---
    # [FIX S-01] 覆盖前一刻内容备份（紧贴覆盖点：变异可能中途失败，
    # 备份段只记存在性布尔值）。A3：备份留在 $env:TEMP，回滚不删。
    if ($backup.Sys32Existed) {
        $backup.Sys32Backup = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'RAMBlockCache.sys.predeploy'
        try {
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $dest -Destination $backup.Sys32Backup -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        } catch {
            throw "cannot back up existing $dest before overwrite: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
    try {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $srcSys -Destination $dest -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        $backup.Sys32Replaced = $true
        Write-Host "[ok] copied $srcSys -> $dest"
    } catch {
        Write-Host "[..] $dest is locked; queueing replace on next reboot (MoveFileEx) ..."
        if (-not ('Win32.MoveFileEx' -as [type])) {
            Add-Type -Namespace Win32 -Name MoveFileEx -MemberDefinition `
                '[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet=System.Runtime.InteropServices.CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern bool MoveFileEx(string lpExistingFileName, string lpNewFileName, int dwFlags);'
        }
        $MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING   = 0x0001
        $MOVEFILE_DELAY_UNTIL_REBOOT = 0x0004
        $ok = [Win32.MoveFileEx]::MoveFileEx($srcSys, $dest, ($MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING -bor $MOVEFILE_DELAY_UNTIL_REBOOT))
        if (-not $ok) {
            $err = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::GetLastWin32Error()
            throw "MoveFileEx failed (Win32 error $err); cannot deploy $dest."
        }
        $pendingReplace = $true
        Write-Host '[ok] queued replacement (takes effect on next reboot)'
    }

    # --- 2b. Convert service to BOOT_START + System Bus Extender ---
    & sc.exe config RAMBlockCache start= boot error= normal type= kernel group= "System Bus Extender" | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "sc.exe config failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
    Write-Host '[ok] service RAMBlockCache set to BOOT_START / group=System Bus Extender / ErrorControl=NORMAL'

    # --- 2c. Re-append RAMBlockCache to volume-class UpperFilters (preserve volsnap) ---
    $cur = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $clsKey -Name UpperFilters -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).UpperFilters
    if (-not $cur) { $cur = @('volsnap') }
    $cur = @($cur | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' } | Select-Object -Unique)
    if ($cur -notcontains 'volsnap') { $cur = @('volsnap') + $cur }
    if ($cur -notcontains 'RAMBlockCache') { $cur += 'RAMBlockCache' }
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $clsKey -Name UpperFilters -Value $cur -Type MultiString
    Write-Host ('[ok] UpperFilters = [' + ($cur -join ', ') + ']')

    # --- 3. Write armed baseline ---
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $svcRoot)) { New-Item -Path $svcRoot -Force | Out-Null }
    $seq = [int](Get-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name DeploySeq -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).DeploySeq
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name DeploySeq       -Value ($seq + 1) -Type DWord
    # [147/N-146-7] 写 seq 的一方必须同时让 ack 失配，否则宽限静默失效。
    # 驱动判据（rbdriver.c:281）是 depSeq != depAck 才宽限；本脚本只自增 DeploySeq、
    # 从不碰 DeployAck，而 logon_disarm 每轮登录把 ack 置成 seq。于是第二轮部署时
    # 遗留 ack 恰好等于新 seq → 不宽限 → BootFailCount+1 → 自断环 → 所有卷不挂栈。
    # 实测指纹：DeploySeq=44 DeployAck=44 BootFailCount=1 FilterArmed=0 InstanceCount=0。
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name DeployAck       -Value 0 -Type DWord
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name BootFailCount   -Value 0 -Type DWord
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name LastBootHealthy -Value 0 -Type DWord
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name FilterArmed     -Value 1 -Type DWord
    # [TICKET 2026-11-16] drop any ticket left by the previous boot: the first boot after this
    # deploy must deterministically take the DeploySeq/DeployAck grace path in RbBootFailLoad.
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name BootReachedUser -Value 0 -Type DWord
    # --- 3a. [B-6] 签名态盖章：驱动 Load 时读 TestSigned/Signer 填 GET_VERSION
    # （前端 DriverSignatureState 契约；取不到=保守 1/空=反作弊警示照弹）。
    # 判定口径：证书自签（Subject==Issuer）= 测试签名 → 1；CA 链签发 → 0。 ---
    $b6Test = 1
    try {
        $b6cert = $auth.SignerCertificate
        if ($b6cert -and "$($b6cert.Subject)" -ne "$($b6cert.Issuer)") { $b6Test = 0 }
    } catch { $b6Test = 1 }
    $b6Signer = ''
    try { if ($auth.SignerInfo -and $auth.SignerInfo.Subject) { $b6Signer = [string]$auth.SignerInfo.Subject } } catch { }
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name TestSigned -Value $b6Test -Type DWord
    if ($b6Signer) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcRoot -Name Signer -Value $b6Signer -Type String }
    Write-Host ('[ok] signature state stamped: TestSigned={0}, Signer={1}' -f $b6Test, $(if ($b6Signer) { $b6Signer } else { '(empty)' }))
    Write-Host ('[ok] armed: DeploySeq={0}, DeployAck=0 (grace armed), BootFailCount=0, LastBootHealthy=0, FilterArmed=1' -f ($seq + 1))

    # --- 3b. Features\Flags default = 0 ---
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $featKey)) { New-Item -Path $featKey -Force | Out-Null }
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $featKey -Name Flags -Value 0 -Type DWord
    Write-Host '[ok] Features\Flags=0 (all feature flags off)'

    # --- 4. Install guard scripts ---
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pdDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $pdDir -Force | Out-Null }
    # [FIX S-01] 覆盖前一刻内容备份（紧贴覆盖点，同 System32 备份原则）。
    foreach ($g in @('boot_guard.ps1','logon_disarm.ps1')) {
        if ($backup.GuardExisted[$g]) {
            $gb = Join-Path $env:TEMP "RAMBoost.$g.predeploy"
            try {
                Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $pdDir $g) -Destination $gb -Force -ErrorAction Stop
                $backup.GuardBackup[$g] = $gb
            } catch {
                throw "cannot back up existing guard script ${g}: $($_.Exception.Message)"
            }
        }
    }
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $scriptsDir 'boot_guard.ps1')   (Join-Path $pdDir 'boot_guard.ps1')   -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $scriptsDir 'logon_disarm.ps1') (Join-Path $pdDir 'logon_disarm.ps1') -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    Write-Host "[ok] guard scripts installed to $pdDir"

    # --- 5. Register scheduled tasks ---
    $bgPath = Join-Path $pdDir 'boot_guard.ps1'
    $ldPath = Join-Path $pdDir 'logon_disarm.ps1'

    # [147/N-146-8] Register-ScheduledTask 的返回对象与 -Force 的"成功"都不可信：
    # 本轮实测到"打印 [ok] registered 但任务动作仍是旧快照"。判定必须读
    # C:\Windows\System32\Tasks\<name> 的真实磁盘 XML，并核对动作里引用的脚本。
    # 任务 XML 为 UTF-16LE（带 FF FE BOM），不能假定 Get-Content 的默认编码。
    $AssertTaskOnDisk = {
        param([string]$Name, [string]$MustReference)
        $disk = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot "System32\Tasks\$Name"
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $disk)) {
            throw "task ${Name}: Register-ScheduledTask returned success but no on-disk XML at $disk"
        }
        $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($disk)
        $u = [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString($bytes)
        $a = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)
        $hit = ($u.IndexOf($MustReference, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -ge 0) -or
               ($a.IndexOf($MustReference, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal) -ge 0)
        if (-not $hit) {
            # 失败代价不对称：这里抛异常会触发 deploy 回滚，把一次**成功**的部署
            # 撤掉（还原 UpperFilters/服务配置）。因此内容匹配只作 WARN 取证，
            # 存在性才是硬门（"报 ok 但其实没建"才是 N-146-8 的本体）。
            Write-Host ("  [!!] task {0}: on-disk XML does not contain '{1}' -- inspect {2}" -f $Name, $MustReference, $disk) -ForegroundColor Yellow
        } else {
            Write-Host ('[ok] task {0} verified on disk ({1} B, references {2})' -f $Name, $bytes.Length, $MustReference)
        }
    }

    $act1 = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' `
        -Argument "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File `"$bgPath`""
    $trg1 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtStartup
    $prin = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'RAMBoostBootGuard' -Action $act1 -Trigger $trg1 -Principal $prin -Force | Out-Null
    & $AssertTaskOnDisk 'RAMBoostBootGuard' 'boot_guard.ps1'
    Write-Host '[ok] scheduled task RAMBoostBootGuard registered (SYSTEM, AtStartup)'

    $act2 = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' `
        -Argument "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File `"$ldPath`""
    $trg2 = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'RAMBoostLogonDisarm' -Action $act2 -Trigger $trg2 -Principal $prin -Force | Out-Null
    & $AssertTaskOnDisk 'RAMBoostLogonDisarm' 'logon_disarm.ps1'
    Write-Host '[ok] scheduled task RAMBoostLogonDisarm registered (SYSTEM, AtLogOn)'

    # --- 6. Post-copy verification of the deployed copy ---
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '== Verifying deployed copy (Patch F) =='
    $verifyArgs = @{ SourcePath = $srcSys; ExpectedSha256 = $expected }
    if ($pendingReplace) { $verifyArgs['AllowPendingReplace'] = $true }
    & (Join-Path $scriptsDir 'verify_deploy_signature.ps1') @verifyArgs
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "post-copy verification failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
}
catch {
    Write-Host "[X] deploy step failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Invoke-Rollback
    exit 1
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '== Deploy complete. NEXT: reboot once. =='
if ($pendingReplace) {
    Write-Host '[!!] The System32 copy is queued for replace on next reboot (file was locked).'
    Write-Host '[!!] Source binary was hash-pinned and signature-verified before arming.'
}
Write-Host '  On a good boot: the logon task clears FilterArmed, passthrough stays.'
Write-Host '  On a failed boot: the boot guard rolls UpperFilters back to volsnap-only.'
Write-Host '  Worst case (no boot): run scripts\offline_rollback.cmd from WinRE.'
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/deploy_apply.ps1`

````powershell
# deploy_apply.ps1 - gated wrapper around deploy.ps1 (the actual deployment).
#
# WHY (report 253, 2026-11-15): deploy.ps1 is correct and non-interactive, but
# it changes the boot driver, the service group, the volume-class UpperFilters
# and the boot-guard registry baseline, and it needs SYSRIGHT elevation. Two
# things are missing for a one-click run:
#   1. A pre-change gate I can read afterwards. deploy.ps1 verifies the source
#      binary, but the caller should also assert that dist\, the sidecar and the
#      two script anchors are the SAME binary before anything is touched.
#   2. A transcript. The elevated window closes and the evidence goes with it.
#      This wrapper logs every line to C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy\deploy-apply-<utc>.log
#      and prints a post-deploy state snapshot.
#
# Contract:
#   * Refuses to run if dist\ hash != any anchor, or if the signature is not
#     Valid. Nothing is changed in that case.
#   * Runs deploy.ps1 in a CHILD process: deploy.ps1 ends with exit, and calling
#     it with & in-process would terminate this wrapper before the snapshot.
#   * Never reboots. The reboot stays an explicit human action.
#   * No registry change of its own: every write below belongs to deploy.ps1.
#
# Usage:
#   deliverables\RB-deploy-driver.cmd      (self-elevating wrapper)
#   pwsh -File src\scripts\deploy_apply.ps1 -Check   (read-only gate only)
#
# Exit: 0 = deployed (reboot pending) / 1 = deploy failed and rolled back /
#       2 = refused before any change (gate / environment)

param(
    [string]$SysSource = '',
    [switch]$Check
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$script:LogLines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$script:LogPath = $null

function Say([string]$Text, [string]$Tag = 'info') {
    $line = ('[{0,-5}] {1}' -f $Tag, $Text)
    Write-Host $line
    $script:LogLines.Add($line)
}

function Flush-Log {
    if (-not $script:LogPath) { return }
    try {
        [IO.File]::WriteAllLines($script:LogPath, $script:LogLines.ToArray(),
            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    } catch { }
}

function Get-Sha256Hex([string]$Path) {
    $sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    $fs = $null
    try {
        $fs = [IO.File]::Open($Path, [IO.FileMode]::Open, [IO.FileAccess]::Read,
            [IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
        return ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($fs)) -replace '-', '').ToLower()
    } finally {
        if ($fs) { $fs.Dispose() }
        $sha.Dispose()
    }
}

function Find-RepoRoot([string]$Start) {
    $d = $Start
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 8 -and $d; $i++) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'build\build.ps1')) { return $d }
        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $d
        if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $d) { break }
        $d = $parent
    }
    return $null
}

function Get-RegDword([string]$Path, [string]$Name) {
    try {
        $v = Get-ItemProperty -Path $Path -Name $Name -ErrorAction Stop
        if ($null -eq $v) { return $null }
        return $v.$Name
    } catch { return $null }
}

function Refuse([string]$Message) {
    Say $Message 'FAIL'
    Flush-Log
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '=================================================================='
    Write-Host '  REFUSED - nothing was changed'
    Write-Host '=================================================================='
    exit 2
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ preamble
$root = Find-RepoRoot $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $root) {
    Write-Host '[FAIL ] cannot locate the repo root (no build\build.ps1 above src\scripts)'
    exit 2
}
$logDir = 'C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $logDir -Force | Out-Null }
$stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')
$script:LogPath = Join-Path $logDir ('deploy-apply-' + $stamp + '.log')

Write-Host '=================================================================='
Write-Host '  RAMBlockCache DEPLOY (gated)'
if ($Check) { Write-Host '  MODE: gate only (nothing will be changed)' }
else { Write-Host '  MODE: verify -> deploy -> post-deploy snapshot (no reboot)' }
Write-Host '=================================================================='
Write-Host ''

Say "repo     : $root"
Say "log      : $($script:LogPath)"
Say "utc      : $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"

$isAdmin = $false
try {
    $isAdmin = (New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal(
        [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent())).IsInRole(
        [Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
} catch { }
Say ("elevated : {0}" -f $isAdmin)
if (-not $isAdmin -and -not $Check) {
    Refuse 'not elevated - launch deliverables\RB-deploy-driver.cmd instead'
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- gate
$distDir = Join-Path $root 'dist'
$distSys = Join-Path $distDir 'RAMBlockCache.sys'
$sidecar = "$distSys.sha256"
if (-not $SysSource) { $SysSource = $distSys }

Say '--- gate: the four sources must agree on one binary ---'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $SysSource)) { Refuse "source missing: $SysSource" }
$distSha = Get-Sha256Hex $SysSource
Say ("dist     : {0}  ({1:N0} B)" -f $distSha, (Get-Item -LiteralPath $SysSource).Length)

$bad = 0
$anchors = @(
    (Join-Path $root 'src\scripts\deploy.ps1'),
    (Join-Path $root 'src\scripts\verify_deploy_signature.ps1')
)
foreach ($f in $anchors) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Say "anchor missing: $f" 'FAIL'; $bad++; continue }
    $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)
    $m = [regex]::Match($t, 'DefaultExpectedSha256\s*=\s*''?([0-9a-fA-F]{64})''?')
    if (-not $m.Success) { Say "no DefaultExpectedSha256 in $f" 'FAIL'; $bad++; continue }
    $got = $m.Groups[1].Value.ToLower()
    if ($got -eq $distSha) { Say ("anchor   : {0} = {1}" -f (Split-Path -Leaf $f), $got) 'ok' }
    else { Say ("anchor   : {0} = {1} != {2}" -f (Split-Path -Leaf $f), $got, $distSha) 'FAIL'; $bad++ }
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sidecar) {
    $st = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($sidecar)
    $sm = [regex]::Match($st, '([0-9a-fA-F]{64})')
    if ($sm.Success -and $sm.Groups[1].Value.ToLower() -eq $distSha) {
        Say ("anchor   : dist sidecar = {0}" -f $sm.Groups[1].Value.ToLower()) 'ok'
    } else { Say 'anchor   : dist sidecar mismatch' 'FAIL'; $bad++ }
} else {
    Say "sidecar  : missing ($sidecar)" 'FAIL'; $bad++
}
if ($bad -ne 0) { Refuse "gate failed: $bad anchor(s) disagree with the dist binary" }

$authStatus = 'UNAVAILABLE'
if (Get-Command Get-AuthenticodeSignature -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    try {
        $a = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $SysSource
        $authStatus = "$($a.Status)"
        if ($a.Status -eq 'Valid') {
            Say ("signature: Valid  signer={0}" -f ($a.SignerCertificate.Subject -replace '\s+', ' ')) 'ok'
        } else {
            Say "signature: $($a.Status) - refusing to deploy an invalid binary" 'FAIL'
            Refuse 'signature gate failed'
        }
    } catch {
        Say "signature: cmdlet failed - $($_.Exception.Message)" 'FAIL'
        Refuse 'signature gate failed'
    }
} else {
    Say 'signature: Get-AuthenticodeSignature unavailable - deploy.ps1 will still enforce signtool /pa' 'warn'
}

# --------------------------------------------------------- current posture
Say '--- current posture (before) ---'
$clsKey = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{71a27cdd-812a-11d0-bec7-08002be2092f}'
$svcReg = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache'
$svcRoot = Join-Path $svcReg 'Parameters'
$featKey = Join-Path $svcReg 'Features'
$liveSys = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'

$liveSha = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $liveSys) { Get-Sha256Hex $liveSys } else { 'ABSENT' }
Say "live sys : $liveSha"
Say ("           ({0:N0} B)" -f (Get-Item -LiteralPath $liveSys).Length)

$uf = $null
try { $uf = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $clsKey -Name UpperFilters -ErrorAction Stop).UpperFilters } catch { }
if ($uf) { Say ("UpperFil : {0}" -f ($uf -join ', ')) } else { Say 'UpperFil : (unreadable or absent)' 'warn' }

$svc = Get-Service -Name RAMBlockCache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($svc) { Say ("service  : {0} / {1}" -f $svc.Status, $svc.StartType) } else { Say 'service  : NOT FOUND' 'warn' }

foreach ($n in @('DeploySeq', 'DeployAck', 'BootFailCount', 'LastBootHealthy', 'FilterArmed')) {
    $v = Get-RegDword $svcRoot $n
    Say ("{0,-15}: {1}" -f $n, $(if ($null -eq $v) { '(absent)' } else { $v }))
}
$flags = Get-RegDword $featKey 'Flags'
Say ("{0,-15}: {1}" -f 'Features\Flags', $(if ($null -eq $flags) { '(absent)' } else { ('0x{0:x}' -f [int]$flags) }))

Say '--- what deploy.ps1 will change ---'
Say '  System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys  -> the signed dist binary (locked now => queued for next reboot)'
Say '  service RAMBlockCache              -> BOOT_START / System Bus Extender / ErrorControl=NORMAL'
Say '  volume-class UpperFilters          -> volsnap kept, RAMBlockCache re-appended'
Say '  boot baseline                      -> DeploySeq+1, DeployAck=0, BootFailCount=0, LastBootHealthy=0, FilterArmed=1'
Say '  TestSigned / Signer                -> stamped from the signing cert'
Say '  Features\Flags                     -> forced to 0 (feature flags off)'
Say '  guards + tasks                     -> boot_guard.ps1 / logon_disarm.ps1 reinstalled, 2 tasks re-registered'

if ($Check) {
    Say 'gate PASS - nothing was changed (read-only mode)' 'ok'
    Flush-Log
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '=================================================================='
    Write-Host '  GATE PASS - run without -Check to deploy'
    Write-Host '=================================================================='
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- run deploy
$deployPs1 = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'deploy.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $deployPs1)) { Refuse "deploy.ps1 missing: $deployPs1" }
Say '--- running deploy.ps1 in a child process ---'
$hostExe = (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path
$prevEap = $ErrorActionPreference
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$out = & $hostExe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $deployPs1 -SysSource $SysSource 2>&1
$rc = $LASTEXITCODE
$ErrorActionPreference = $prevEap
foreach ($o in @($out)) { if ("$o".Trim()) { Say "$o" 'dep' } }
Say ("deploy.ps1 exit = {0}" -f $rc)

# ------------------------------------------------------- post-deploy snapshot
Say '--- post-deploy snapshot ---'
$liveSha2 = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $liveSys) { Get-Sha256Hex $liveSys } else { 'ABSENT' }
Say "live sys : $liveSha2"
if ($liveSha2 -eq $distSha) {
    Say '           live copy already matches (deploy wrote through)' 'ok'
} else {
    Say '           live copy still the OLD binary - expected when the file was locked'
    $pfro = $null
    try { $pfro = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager' -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -ErrorAction Stop).PendingFileRenameOperations } catch { }
    if ($pfro) {
        $hit = @($pfro | Where-Object { "$_" -match 'RAMBlockCache\.sys' })
        if ($hit.Count -gt 0) {
            Say 'pending replace: PendingFileRenameOperations references RAMBlockCache.sys' 'ok'
            foreach ($h in $hit) { Say ("             {0}" -f $h) }
        } else {
            Say 'pending replace: NOT found in PendingFileRenameOperations' 'FAIL'
        }
    } else {
        Say 'pending replace: PendingFileRenameOperations unreadable/empty' 'FAIL'
    }
}

$uf2 = $null
try { $uf2 = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $clsKey -Name UpperFilters -ErrorAction Stop).UpperFilters } catch { }
if ($uf2) { Say ("UpperFil : {0}" -f ($uf2 -join ', ')) }
$svc2 = Get-Service -Name RAMBlockCache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($svc2) { Say ("service  : {0} / {1}" -f $svc2.Status, $svc2.StartType) }
foreach ($n in @('DeploySeq', 'DeployAck', 'BootFailCount', 'LastBootHealthy', 'FilterArmed')) {
    $v = Get-RegDword $svcRoot $n
    Say ("{0,-15}: {1}" -f $n, $(if ($null -eq $v) { '(absent)' } else { $v }))
}
$flags2 = Get-RegDword $featKey 'Flags'
Say ("{0,-15}: {1}" -f 'Features\Flags', $(if ($null -eq $flags2) { '(absent)' } else { ('0x{0:x}' -f [int]$flags2) }))

Flush-Log
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=================================================================='
if ($rc -eq 0) {
    Write-Host '  DEPLOY COMPLETE - reboot once to activate'
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '  After the reboot run: deliverables\RB-postreboot-verify.cmd'
    Write-Host '  Expected: PASS=8 FAIL=0, UpperFilters keeps RAMBlockCache, volumes > 0'
} else {
    Write-Host ('  DEPLOY FAILED (exit {0}) - deploy.ps1 ran its own rollback')
    Write-Host '  dist\ and the anchors were NOT touched by this wrapper.'
    Write-Host '  Read the log before retrying.'
}
Write-Host ('  log: ' + $script:LogPath)
Write-Host '=================================================================='
exit $rc
````

##### `src/scripts/deploy_w15.ps1`

````powershell
# deploy_w15.ps1 -- W1.5 新驱动 签名→入 dist→锚点→部署 一条命令（需提权窗运行）
# Why: W1.5（64MB 大块 IO 门 + 读分片直读 + 写分块 + 同步 IO 池化）不部署则运行时仍是
#   旧 8MB 门驱动——回写/预取/无限周期全部被门挡在缓存外（16MB 顺序块直通硬盘）。
#   本脚本把"签名→复制→sync_anchors→门禁→部署"收敛为一次提权运行。
# Usage (elevated PowerShell):
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File src\scripts\deploy_w15.ps1              # 生产模式（部署后重启一次）
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File src\scripts\deploy_w15.ps1 -TestMode   # 测试模式（DEMAND_START，零重启）
# Discipline: every step checks exit code, fail fast. Pure ASCII.
# [FIX QA5-UI5] param() 声明必须置于任何语句之前（含 $ErrorActionPreference 赋值）：
# 原文件无 param()，按文档用法加 -TestMode 直接参数绑定报错脚本不执行；
# 不加则 $TestMode 恒 $null → 静默走生产模式（与"测试模式免重启"预期相反）。
param([switch]$TestMode)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root  = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "rb_common.ps1")
Assert-Admin

$sys     = Join-Path $root "src\driver\x64\Release\RAMBlockCache.sys"
$dist    = Join-Path $root "dist\RAMBlockCache.sys"
$thumb   = "DF1A0ADA2F2CD6E5778EA937C079CB0A035BA431"   # CN=RAMBoostFS Root（sign_all.cmd 同值）
$testMode = [bool]$TestMode

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sys)) { throw "W1.5 build not found: $sys (run src\driver\_build_manual.ps1 first)" }
$pre = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $sys -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
Write-Host "== [1/5] sign W1.5 build =="
Write-Host "  before: $pre (unsigned)"
$signTool = Find-SignTool
if (-not $signTool) { throw "signtool.exe not found - set SIGTOOL=<path> (see rb_common.ps1 Find-SignTool)" }
& $signTool sign /sm /s My /sha1 $thumb /fd SHA256 $sys
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "signtool failed (exit=$LASTEXITCODE) - run this script in an ELEVATED window (private key lives in LM\My)" }
$sig = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $sys
if ($sig.Status -ne "Valid") { throw "post-sign status = $($sig.Status) - refusing to deploy (fail-closed)" }
Write-Host "  after : $((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $sys -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) ($($sig.Status))"

Write-Host "== [2/5] copy to dist =="
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $sys -Destination $dist -Force

Write-Host "== [3/5] sync deploy anchors (fail-closed: unsigned refused) =="
& powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "sync_anchors.ps1")
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "sync_anchors failed (exit=$LASTEXITCODE)" }

Write-Host "== [4/5] signature gate =="
& powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "check_signature.ps1")
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "check_signature FAILED (exit=$LASTEXITCODE) - anchors/signature out of sync" }

Write-Host "== [5/5] deploy =="
if ($testMode) {
    # 测试模式：C 引擎切 DEMAND_START + TestMode=1 + 不写 UpperFilters（自身带验签预检；
    #   ramboostsetup.exe /TestMode——勿用 ramboostsetup.ps1，那是旧 V9 模型、无此参数）
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $sys -Destination (Join-Path $root "src\setup\RAMBlockCache.sys") -Force
    & (Join-Path $root "src\setup\ramboostsetup.exe") /TestMode
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "TestMode install failed (exit=$LASTEXITCODE)" }
    Write-Host "=== DEPLOY OK (TestMode, ZERO reboot) ==="
    Write-Host "next: sc start RAMBlockCache ; ramboostctl attach D: (then E:/F:)"
} else {
    # 生产模式：deploy.ps1（验签+锚点+boot_guard，MoveFileEx 排队替换）→ 重启一次
    & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "deploy.ps1")
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "deploy.ps1 failed (exit=$LASTEXITCODE)" }
    Write-Host "=== DEPLOY OK (production) ==="
    Write-Host "next: REBOOT ONCE (BOOT_START image swap). After reboot volumes auto-attach (AutoAttach=1)."
}
Write-Host "NOTE: per-volume write-back is runtime state (not persisted) - set it again after reboot/mount if needed."
````

##### `src/scripts/devloop.ps1`

````powershell
# devloop.ps1 - RAMBlockCache 开发循环一键脚本（U0-1，2026-10-19）
# Why: 测试循环原为六步全手工（编译 -> signtool -> copy -> sync_anchors ->
#   deploy -> 手动重启 -> 挂载），每轮 >=10 分钟 + 一次重启。本脚本收敛为一条命令：
#     构建 -> （签名 -> 锚点同步）-> 部署（测试模式零重启 / 生产模式一次重启）
# 纪律（与 iteration-plan / install-ux 方案一致）：
#   - 默认走生产模式：deploy.ps1 自带验签 + 锚点 + boot_guard，如实提示需重启一次；
#   - -TestMode 走零重启 dev loop，前提是安装器曾以 /TestMode 安装
#     （DEMAND_START 服务 + 注册表 TestMode=1），否则 fail-fast 并给出指引；
#   - -NoSign 产物仅本机功能验证，禁止部署（未签名驱动进引导路径 = 0x7B 事故形态）；
#   - 运行时挂栈（U0-1 驱动路径）默认关：仅 TestMode 安装写入注册表开关后才可达；
#     挂栈位置与 AddDevice 不同（栈顶 vs PDO 上），VSS/热插拔待 W0 Verifier 矩阵。
param(
    [switch]$NoSign,
    [switch]$TestMode,
    [string]$Configuration = "Release",
    [string[]]$AttachLetters = @()
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$sys  = Join-Path $root "src\driver\x64\Release\RAMBlockCache.sys"
$ctl  = Join-Path $root "src\ctl\ramboostctl.exe"
$svc  = "RAMBlockCache"
$thumb = "DF1A0ADA2F2CD6E5778EA937C079CB0A035BA431"   # CN=RAMBoostFS Root（与 sign_all.cmd 同值）

function Show-Step([int]$n, [string]$msg) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "== [$n] $msg ==" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

# ---------- 0) 前提：管理员（attach IOCTL / 服务控制 / System32 写入都要） ----------
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "rb_common.ps1")
Assert-Admin
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ctl)) { throw "ramboostctl.exe not found: $ctl (build ctl first)" }

# ---------- 1) 构建驱动（统一入口 build/build.ps1 -Target driver） ----------
# [G26 2026-11-11] 原为 `& powershell -File src\driver\_build_manual.ps1`。
# 该脚本已归档到 archive/oneoff/build-entries/，文件不存在 → 命令解析错误，
# `$LASTEXITCODE` 不写入而是**继承上一条命令的值**（实测：上一条为 0 时本步
# 静默通过）。即 devloop 原来会"成功"构建一个根本没构建的驱动，随后用旧 sys
# 继续签名/部署。改用构建系统统一入口，源码清单由
# build/sources.manifest.json 提供（I51 之后唯一允许路径）。
Show-Step 1 "building driver ($Configuration) ..."
$buildScript = Join-Path $root "build\build.ps1"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $buildScript)) {
    throw "build entry missing: $buildScript"
}
& powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $buildScript -Target driver
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "driver build failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sys)) { throw "build produced no sys: $sys" }
$hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $sys -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
Write-Host "  sys    : $sys"
Write-Host "  sha256 : $hash"

# ---------- 2) 签名 + 锚点同步（-NoSign 跳过并高亮警告） ----------
if ($NoSign) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[!!] -NoSign: UNSIGNED build - local functional verification ONLY." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "     DO NOT DEPLOY. Unsigned driver in the boot path = 0x7B bootloop" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "     (incident-0x7b-bootloop-2026-10-17). TestMode sc start also needs" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "     testsigning ON (bcdedit) or Code Integrity will refuse to load." -ForegroundColor Yellow
} else {
    Show-Step 2 "signing (user cert, /sm) + syncing deploy anchors ..."
    $signTool = Find-SignTool
    if (-not $signTool) { throw "signtool.exe not found - set SIGTOOL=<path> (see rb_common.ps1 Find-SignTool)" }
    & $signTool sign /sm /s My /sha1 $thumb /fd SHA256 $sys
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "signtool failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE). NOTE: signing needs an ELEVATED window (LM\My private key is not visible unelevated)."
    }
    & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "sync_anchors.ps1")
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "sync_anchors failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
}

# ---------- 3) 部署 ----------
if ($TestMode) {
    # --- 3a) 测试模式：DEMAND_START + 运行时挂栈，零重启 ---
    Show-Step 3 "TestMode deploy (zero-reboot dev loop) ..."
    $s = Get-Service -Name $svc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $s) {
        throw "service '$svc' not found. Install first (elevated): src\setup\ramboostsetup.exe /TestMode"
    }
    if ($s.StartType -ne "Manual") {
        throw "service start type = $($s.StartType); TestMode requires DEMAND_START (shows as Manual). Reinstall: ramboostsetup.exe /TestMode"
    }
    $tm = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Parameters" -Name TestMode -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).TestMode
    if ($tm -ne 1) {
        throw "registry TestMode != 1 (runtime attach path gated off). Install with: ramboostsetup.exe /TestMode"
    }

    # 停服 = 干净卸载（DriverUnload: 全量回写 -> 停线程 -> 逐卷拆除）；
    # join 超时时驱动按设计中止卸载保数据 -> 必须重启一次，不得假装成功。
    if ($s.Status -ne "Stopped") {
        Stop-Service -Name $svc -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        $w = 0
        while ((Get-Service -Name $svc).Status -ne "Stopped" -and $w -lt 30) {
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
            $w++
        }
        if ((Get-Service -Name $svc).Status -ne "Stopped") {
            throw "sc stop timed out (~15s): driver aborted unload by design (data safety). REBOOT ONCE, then re-run devloop -TestMode."
        }
        Write-Host "  [ok] service stopped (dirty flushed by DriverUnload)"
    }

    $dest = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot "System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys"
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $sys -Destination $dest -Force
    Write-Host "  [ok] sys swapped: $dest"
    Start-Service -Name $svc -ErrorAction Stop
    Write-Host "  [ok] service started (DEMAND_START; runtime attach path armed)"

    # attach：默认全部非系统固定卷（与"开机自动挂载只挂数据卷"同口径）
    if ($AttachLetters.Count -eq 0) {
        $sysRoot = [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot([Environment]::GetFolderPath("System")).TrimEnd('\')
        $AttachLetters = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DriveType=3" |
            Where-Object { $_.DeviceID -ne $sysRoot } |
            ForEach-Object { $_.DeviceID.TrimEnd(':') })
    }
    foreach ($l in $AttachLetters) {
        Write-Host "  [..] ramboostctl attach $l ..."
        & $ctl attach $l
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "  [!!] attach $l failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)." -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "       If this build predates the U0-1 runtime-attach path, TestMode attach" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "       is unavailable: use production mode (deploy + reboot) instead." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
    }
    & $ctl volumes

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "== acceptance checklist (W0-2 subset; mark manually) ==" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "  [ ] volumes: every data volume shows attached=1"
    Write-Host "  [ ] stats   : two-pass read of a test file -> ReadHit grows (ramboostctl status)"
    Write-Host "  [ ] verifier: zero new warnings under 'verifier /standard /driver RAMBlockCache.sys'"
    Write-Host "  [ ] teardown: ramboostctl detach <X> removes the filter device (no leftover !devobj)"
} else {
    # --- 3b) 生产模式：deploy.ps1（验签 + 锚点 + boot_guard），一次重启不可协商 ---
    Show-Step 3 "production deploy (deploy.ps1: verify + anchor + boot_guard) ..."
    & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "deploy.ps1")
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "deploy.ps1 failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "== production mode: REBOOT ONCE (BOOT_START image swap) ==" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "   category-inherent cost (PrimoCache identical) - do NOT promise no-reboot install."
    Write-Host "   after reboot: powershell -File src\scripts\verify_install.ps1   (expect 13 pass, 0 fail)"
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== devloop done (sys sha256=$hash) ===" -ForegroundColor Green
````

##### `src/scripts/game_mode.cmd`

````bat
@echo off
REM [FIX S-12] chcp 65001: the wrapped .ps1 emits UTF-8 Chinese output.
chcp 65001 >nul
REM game_mode.cmd - launcher wrapper for game_mode.ps1 (self-elevate + invoke).
REM Error-handling convention (spec D.3):
REM   * direct path: propagates the wrapped script's exit code (exit /b %errorlevel%).
REM     Identical to the implicit batch behavior (a batch file exits with the
REM     errorlevel of its last command); this line only makes the intent explicit.
REM   * elevation branch: the wrapped script is interactive (ends with Read-Host),
REM     so it is deliberately fire-and-forget, matching the existing uninstall.cmd
REM     pattern. For exit-code propagation on elevation, see deploy.cmd
REM     (Start-Process -Wait -PassThru + !errorlevel!).
net session >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Start-Process powershell -Verb RunAs -ArgumentList '-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \"%~dp0game_mode.ps1\"'"
  exit /b
)
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0game_mode.ps1"
exit /b %errorlevel%
````

##### `src/scripts/game_mode.ps1`

````powershell
# game_mode.ps1 —— testsigning on/off 切换（自签驱动需要 testsigning on）
# 玩法：
#   玩 Valorant 前：执行 off -> 重启（Valorant 反作弊会因 testsigning 报错）
#   不玩、要跑 RAMBlockCache：执行 on -> 重启
# 错误处理约定（规格书 D.3）：$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'，失败不静默、以非零码退出。
# 此行与 rb_common.ps1 内的同名设置等价；显式声明保证公共库缺失时也 fail-closed。
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'rb_common.ps1')
Assert-Admin

Write-Host "当前 testsigning 状态："
bcdedit /enum | Select-String 'testsigning'
# [FIX S-07] /enum 查退出码：bcdedit 不可用时状态不可见，fail-closed 退出 2。
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "[X] bcdedit /enum failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE); cannot read testsigning state." -ForegroundColor Red
    Read-Host '按回车关闭'
    exit 2
}
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '  [1] ON  (开启测试签名 = 允许加载 RAMBlockCache 自签驱动，需重启生效)'
Write-Host '  [2] OFF (关闭测试签名 = 玩 Valorant 前必做，需重启生效)'
Write-Host '  [Q] 退出（不做任何更改）'
# [FIX S-07] 输入循环仅收 1/2/Q：空/其他重新提示——旧代码任何非 '1' 输入
# （含空回车/误敲）即 bcdedit /set testsigning off 无确认，误操作+重启后
# 驱动不加载，表现为"产品坏了"。
$c = ''
while ($true) {
    $c = Read-Host '选 1 / 2 / Q(退出)'
    if ($c -eq '1' -or $c -eq '2' -or $c -eq 'Q' -or $c -eq 'q') { break }
    Write-Host '  输入无效，请选 1、2 或 Q。'
}
if ($c -eq 'Q' -or $c -eq 'q') {
    Write-Host '[..] 已取消，未做任何更改。'
    Read-Host '按回车关闭'
    exit 0
}
# [FIX S-07] OFF 需显式确认串：testsigning off 后自签驱动不加载，不可误触。
if ($c -eq '2') {
    $confirm = Read-Host '确认关闭 testsigning？关闭后 RAMBlockCache 自签驱动将不加载（玩 Valorant 前必做）。输入 YES 确认'
    if ($confirm -ne 'YES') {
        Write-Host '[..] 未确认，已取消，未做任何更改。'
        Read-Host '按回车关闭'
        exit 0
    }
}
if ($c -eq '1') {
    bcdedit /set testsigning on
    # [FIX S-07] /set 查退出码：失败非零收尾（3），说清原因。
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[X] bcdedit /set testsigning on failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)." -ForegroundColor Red
        Read-Host '按回车关闭'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Host '[ok] testsigning 已设为 ON。请重启后再加载/使用 RAMBlockCache。'
} else {
    bcdedit /set testsigning off
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[X] bcdedit /set testsigning off failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)." -ForegroundColor Red
        Read-Host '按回车关闭'
        exit 3
    }
    Write-Host '[ok] testsigning 已设为 OFF。请重启后再启动 Valorant。'
}
Read-Host '按回车关闭'
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""gen_proto_ts.py —— 从 src/ctl/rb_proto.h 生成 RB_CONFIG 的 TypeScript 定义。

背景（161 号 §5 ③ / 162 号 G-A）：
  RB_CONFIG 在 TS 侧原有 4 份**手写**副本（proto/types.ts interface、
  bridge/server/proto-decode.ts 解码表、bridge/server/index.ts 编码表、
  src/bridge/http-transport.ts zod 键集）。上一轮把它们纳入 Gate12 做
  "手写 + 事后比对"，仍依赖人肉同步。本生成器把头文件变成唯一事实源：

      rb_proto.h  ──gen_proto_ts.py──▶  rb-config.generated.ts  ──▶  4 份副本派生

  这样"改 C 头忘了改 TS"不再可能发生：忘了重跑生成器 → check_proto_codegen.py
  直接 FAIL（打印 unified diff）。

解析逻辑不另写一套：复用 check_config_decode_contract.py 的
  strip_c_comments / parse_macros / parse_c_config
（Gate12 用的就是同一份解析器，避免生成器与门禁对同一根头文件有两种口径）。

输出约定：
  * 只写 LF、UTF-8（无 BOM）；不写时间戳 / 机器路径 / 版本号，
    保证同样的头文件 → 逐字节相同的输出（幂等）。
  * 字段顺序 = 声明顺序 = 偏移升序；每个字段带 @offset 注释。

用法：
  python -B src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py            # 写入生成物
  python -B src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py --stdout   # 只打印不落盘（门禁复用）
退出码：0 = OK；1 = 解析失败（头文件结构变化超出本生成器认识的范围）。
"""
import argparse
import pathlib
import re
import sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]                     # src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py → 仓库根
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent))

# 单一解析口径：与 Gate12 共用同一份 C 解析器。
from check_config_decode_contract import (  # noqa: E402
    parse_c_config,
    parse_macros,
    strip_c_comments,
)

PROTO_H = ROOT / "src" / "ctl" / "rb_proto.h"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "src" / "ui" / "web" / "src" / "protocol" / "rb-config.generated.ts"

STRUCT_RE = r"typedef\s+struct\s+RB_CONFIG_T\s*\{(.*?)\}\s*RB_CONFIG\s*;"


def _struct_body(raw: str) -> str:
    m = re.search(STRUCT_RE, raw, re.S)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit("[FATAL] rb_proto.h: 找不到 typedef struct RB_CONFIG_T")
    return m.group(1)


def _field_docs(raw_body: str) -> dict:
    """抓每个字段行尾的 /* ... */ 注释，转成 TSDoc 文案（保留 C 侧原始说明）。"""
    docs = {}
    for line in raw_body.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"\s*(?:uint32_t|wchar_t)\s+(\w+)", line)
        if not m:
            continue
        cm = re.search(r"/\*(.*?)\*/", line, re.S)
        if cm:
            docs[m.group(1)] = " ".join(cm.group(1).split())
    return docs


def _volume_filter_dims(raw_body: str, macros: dict):
    """wchar_t Name[D1][D2]; 的维度（D 可能是 RB_* 宏）。"""
    m = re.search(r"wchar_t\s+(\w+)\s*\[\s*(\w+)\s*\]\s*\[\s*(\w+)\s*\]\s*;", raw_body)
    if not m:
        return None
    name, d1, d2 = m.groups()

    def dim(x: str) -> int:
        if x.isdigit():
            return int(x)
        if x not in macros:
            raise SystemExit("[FATAL] rb_proto.h: %s 的维度 %s 无法解析" % (name, x))
        return macros[x]

    return name, dim(d1), dim(d2)


def layout():
    """返回 (size, entries, macros)。

    entries: [{'name','offset','width','kind','type','c_type','count','len','doc'}]
    顺序 = 声明顺序 = 偏移升序（含 wchar 数组，它插在 u32 序列中间）。
    """
    raw = PROTO_H.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    stripped = strip_c_comments(raw)
    macros = parse_macros(raw)

    # [2026-11-12] parse_c_config 已改为严格模式：遇到不认识的字段行抛 ValueError
    # （原来静默跳过会让 sizeof 被低估，生成物缺字段，而 Gate12/Gate18 双双假绿）。
    # 这里把异常转成可读的 FATAL，避免整段 traceback 淹没真正的错因。
    try:
        u32_fields, vf_off, size = parse_c_config(stripped, macros)
    except ValueError as _e:
        raise SystemExit("[FATAL] %s" % _e)
    if u32_fields is None:
        raise SystemExit("[FATAL] rb_proto.h: RB_CONFIG 解析失败")
    if vf_off is None:
        raise SystemExit("[FATAL] rb_proto.h: RB_CONFIG 内未找到 wchar_t 二维数组")

    body = _struct_body(raw)
    dims = _volume_filter_dims(body, macros)
    if dims is None:
        raise SystemExit("[FATAL] rb_proto.h: wchar_t 二维数组维度解析失败")
    vf_name, vf_count, vf_len = dims
    docs = _field_docs(body)

    u32_doc = {}
    for name, _ in u32_fields:
        u32_doc[name] = "uint32_t"

    entries = []
    vf_entry = {
        "name": vf_name,
        "offset": vf_off,
        "width": vf_count * vf_len * 2,
        "kind": "wchar2d",
        "type": "string[]",
        "c_type": "wchar_t[%d][%d]" % (vf_count, vf_len),
        "count": vf_count,
        "len": vf_len,
        "doc": docs.get(vf_name, ""),
    }
    inserted = False
    for name, off in u32_fields:
        if not inserted and off > vf_off:
            entries.append(vf_entry)
            inserted = True
        entries.append({
            "name": name,
            "offset": off,
            "width": 4,
            "kind": "u32",
            "type": "number",
            "c_type": u32_doc[name],
            "count": 1,
            "len": 1,
            "doc": docs.get(name, ""),
        })
    if not inserted:
        entries.append(vf_entry)

    # 结构自洽：偏移必须严格递增，末字段必须正好结束在 sizeof 处。
    prev_end = 0
    for e in entries:
        if e["offset"] < prev_end:
            raise SystemExit("[FATAL] rb_proto.h: 字段 %s 偏移 %d 与前一字段重叠"
                             % (e["name"], e["offset"]))
        prev_end = e["offset"] + e["width"]
    if prev_end != size:
        raise SystemExit("[FATAL] rb_proto.h: 字段之和 %d != sizeof(RB_CONFIG) %d"
                         % (prev_end, size))
    return size, entries, macros


def _doc_text(e: dict) -> str:
    parts = ["@offset %d" % e["offset"], e["c_type"]]
    if e["kind"] == "wchar2d":
        parts.append("%d B" % e["width"])
    if e["doc"]:
        parts.append(e["doc"].replace("*/", "*\\/"))
    return " · ".join(parts)


def render():
    """返回 (完整 TS 文本, meta)。文本不含时间戳/绝对路径，可逐字节复现。"""
    size, entries, _ = layout()

    lines = [
        "/* AUTO-GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT.",
        " * 来源：src/ctl/rb_proto.h 的 typedef struct RB_CONFIG_T",
        " * 生成器：src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py（python -B src/scripts/gen_proto_ts.py）",
        " * 漂移门禁：src/scripts/check_proto_codegen.py（磁盘文件与 C 头不一致即 FAIL）",
        " *",
        " * 手改本文件无效：下一次生成会被覆盖，且门禁当场报红。",
        " */",
        "",
        "/** RB_CONFIG 字段的两种 C 形态：标量 u32 与 wchar_t 二维数组。 */",
        "export type RbConfigField =",
        "  | { readonly name: string; readonly offset: number; readonly width: 4;"
        " readonly kind: 'u32' }",
        "  | { readonly name: string; readonly offset: number; readonly width: number;"
        " readonly kind: 'wchar2d'; readonly count: number; readonly len: number };",
        "",
        "/**",
        " * RB_CONFIG —— 与 C 头逐字节一致（#pragma pack(8)）。",
        " * 字段名保留 C 原始 PascalCase 拼写，便于与 rb_proto.h 逐行对照。",
        " */",
        "export interface RbConfig {",
    ]
    for e in entries:
        lines.append("  /** %s */" % _doc_text(e))
        lines.append("  %s: %s;" % (e["name"], e["type"]))
    lines += [
        "}",
        "",
        "/** sizeof(RB_CONFIG)，单位字节。 */",
        "export const RB_CONFIG_SIZE = %d;" % size,
        "",
        "/**",
        " * RB_CONFIG 的全部字段，按声明顺序（= 偏移升序）。",
        " * 解码器 / 编码器 / zod 键集一律遍历本表，不得再手写偏移。",
        " */",
        "export const RB_CONFIG_FIELDS: ReadonlyArray<RbConfigField> = [",
    ]
    for e in entries:
        if e["kind"] == "wchar2d":
            lines.append(
                "  { name: '%s', offset: %d, width: %d, kind: 'wchar2d', count: %d, len: %d },"
                % (e["name"], e["offset"], e["width"], e["count"], e["len"]))
        else:
            lines.append("  { name: '%s', offset: %d, width: %d, kind: 'u32' },"
                         % (e["name"], e["offset"], e["width"]))
    lines += ["];", ""]

    return "\n".join(lines), {"size": size, "fields": entries}


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="从 rb_proto.h 生成 rb-config.generated.ts")
    ap.add_argument("--stdout", action="store_true", help="只打印，不写文件")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    text, meta = render()
    if args.stdout:
        sys.stdout.write(text)
        return 0

    # 显式写字节：不受 Windows 文本模式的 \n → \r\n 转换影响，保证幂等。
    OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OUTPUT.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))

    u32 = sum(1 for f in meta["fields"] if f["kind"] == "u32")
    vf = [f for f in meta["fields"] if f["kind"] == "wchar2d"]
    print("== gen_proto_ts ==")
    print("  source : src/ctl/rb_proto.h")
    print("  output : %s" % OUTPUT.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
    print("  fields : %d u32 + %d wchar2d[%d][%d]@%d  sizeof=%d"
          % (u32, len(vf), vf[0]["count"], vf[0]["len"], vf[0]["offset"], meta["size"]))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

##### `src/scripts/gen_version.ps1`

````powershell
# gen_version.ps1 —— 从 common/version.h 生成各 UI/安装器树的 Version.cs，保证单一事实来源。
# [P2-10] 修复：旧脚本只生成旧 WPF 树（且该树实测也无 Version.cs），Controller 树
# 完全没有生成物 → 版本显示硬编码、与 version.h 漂移。现所有树都生成。
# [2026-10-19] 发布名改由 RB_RELEASE_* 宏显式定义（此前用机器版本拼发布名，
# 与 README/UI 的营销版本双轨漂移）；安装器树（RAMBlockCache.Setup）加入生成列表。
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$h = Get-Content "$root\common\version.h" -Raw
function Get-Def([string]$name) {
    if ($h -match "#define\s+$name\s+(\d+)") { return $Matches[1] }
    throw "version.h 缺少 #define $name"
}
$maj = Get-Def 'RB_VERSION_MAJOR'
$min = Get-Def 'RB_VERSION_MINOR'
$pat = Get-Def 'RB_VERSION_PATCH'
$bld = Get-Def 'RB_VERSION_BUILD'
$rmaj = Get-Def 'RB_RELEASE_MAJOR'
$rmin = Get-Def 'RB_RELEASE_MINOR'
$rpat = Get-Def 'RB_RELEASE_PATCH'
$ver = "$maj.$min.$pat.$bld"
$rel = "V$rmaj.$rmin.$rpat Build $bld"
Write-Host "version.h -> machine=$ver release=$rel"

function Write-VersionCs([string]$path, [string]$ns, [string]$ver, [string]$rel) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $path
    if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { Write-Host "skip (no dir): $dir"; return }
    $body = @"
// AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/gen_version.ps1 from common/version.h - do not edit.
namespace $ns
{
    public static partial class AppInfo
    {
        /// <summary>Product version (machine version string from version.h).</summary>
        public const string Version = "$ver";
        /// <summary>Release name (marketing string).</summary>
        public const string ReleaseName = "$rel";
    }
}
"@
    Set-Content -Path $path -Value $body -Encoding UTF8
    Write-Host "wrote $path = $ver / $rel"
}

# 现行 UI（Controller 树，Build19 重写）
Write-VersionCs "$root\ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\Version.cs" 'RAMBlockCache.Controller' $ver $rel
# 安装器（Setup 树，U0-2 单 exe 安装器）
Write-VersionCs "$root\ui\installer\RAMBlockCache.Setup\Version.cs" 'RAMBlockCache.Setup' $ver $rel
# 旧代 UI（RamBoostFS.Wpf，归档待决策；存在即同步）
Write-VersionCs "$root\ui\wpf\Version.cs" 'RamBoostFS.Wpf' $ver $rel
````

##### `src/scripts/install.ps1`

````powershell
# install.ps1 —— 注册 RAMBlockCache 服务 + 给 Volume 类加 UpperFilters
# 双击 install.cmd 运行（自动 UAC 提权）。
# 注意：这是“唯一可能需要一次重启”的步骤（让 PnP 在既有卷栈上挂过滤设备）。
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'rb_common.ps1')
Assert-Admin

# 1) 编译（Release|x64）
$env:NUGET_PACKAGES = $Script:NugetPkg
& $Script:MSBuild (Join-Path $Script:DriverDir 'RAMBlockCache.vcxproj') `
    /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64 /m /v:m /nologo
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw '编译失败' }

# 2) 签名 + 落地
# [FIX N1 2026-10-19] 验签必须在 Install-DriverBinary（System32 覆盖）之前：
# 原顺序先覆盖 System32 再验签——验签失败时机器已带着 BOOT_START + UpperFilters
# + 未验证二进制等待重启 = 0x7B 同型。现对刚签名的构建产物（$Script:SysPath）
# 双验签，失败即终止且机器零变更；复制后的副本不再重复验签（复制的是已验文件）。
Sign-Driver
$sig = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $Script:SysPath -ErrorAction Stop
if ($sig.Status -ne 'Valid') { throw "驱动签名校验失败（$($sig.Status)）——拒绝安装。请先签名（见 README 签名节）。" }
$st = $Script:SignTool
& $st verify /pa $Script:SysPath 2>&1 | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "signtool verify /pa 失败——拒绝安装（exit=$LASTEXITCODE）" }
Write-Host "[ok] 驱动签名校验通过（$($sig.SignerCertificate.Subject)）"
Install-DriverBinary

# 3) 创建 PnP 过滤服务（SERVICE_DEMAND_START，不随开机自动加载）
# [FIX 致命-3 2026-10-18] 三重整改：
#   ① sc.exe delete 对运行中服务只打删除标记，紧随的 create 必返 1072
#      （ERROR_SERVICE_MARKED_FOR_DELETE）而旧代码照报 [ok] → 重启后卷类引用
#      已删除服务。现：先 Stop-Service 并确认停止（15s 上限），每步 sc.exe
#      检查 $LASTEXITCODE，失败即 throw（fail-closed）。
#   ② 全文零签名校验：本路径曾经是 0x7B 事故的 fail-open 变体。现补
#      Get-AuthenticodeSignature + signtool verify /pa 双验签（[FIX N1] 已前移到
#      System32 覆盖之前），未签名/验签失败即终止，绝不写 UpperFilters。
#   ③ 补 armed 基线（FilterArmed=1 + BootFailCount=0），与 deploy.ps1 第 3 步
#      一致，让 boot_guard.ps1 的回滚护栏在本路径同样生效。
# [FIX N-b] 统一入口口径（原与 ramboostsetup.ps1:15-21 互斥）：普通用户=
#   dist\RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe；开发者/脚本=deploy.ps1；本脚本与
#   ramboostsetup.ps1 均为 legacy 备选（详见 README"安装"节）。
# [FIX 回归B 2026-10-18 复审] 验签必须在停服/删服之前（与 ramboostsetup.c 严重-1
# 同型纪律：验签失败时机器保持原状，不做任何破坏性动作——原修复把验签放在了
# Stop-Service + sc delete 之后，失败路径仍会拆掉旧安装）。
$sysPath = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'

$svc = Get-Service $Script:ServiceName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($svc -and $svc.Status -ne 'Stopped') {
    Write-Host "[..] 停止运行中的 $Script:ServiceName（最多 15s）..."
    Stop-Service $Script:ServiceName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(15)
    while ((Get-Service $Script:ServiceName).Status -ne 'Stopped' -and (Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
    }
    if ((Get-Service $Script:ServiceName).Status -ne 'Stopped') {
        throw '旧服务 15s 内未停止（驱动可能停不掉——C3 设计保数据）。请重启后再安装，或改用 deploy.ps1。'
    }
}
sc.exe delete $Script:ServiceName | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -notin @(0, 1060)) { throw "sc.exe delete 失败（exit=$LASTEXITCODE）" }

sc.exe create $Script:ServiceName `
    type= kernel start= demand error= normal `
    binPath= $sysPath `
    DisplayName= 'RAMBlockCache RAM Disk Cache' | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "sc.exe create 失败（exit=$LASTEXITCODE，1072=服务标记删除未完成，需重启）" }
sc.exe config $Script:ServiceName loadordergroup= 'Volume Filter' | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "sc.exe config 失败（exit=$LASTEXITCODE）" }
Write-Host '[ok] 服务已注册（demand start）'

# 4) 把 RAMBlockCache 追加到 Volume 类 UpperFilters（多字符串追加，不覆盖既有）
$cls = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\$($Script:VolumeClassGuid)"
if (-not (Test-Path $cls)) { New-Item -Path $cls -Force | Out-Null }
$existing = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name UpperFilters -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).UpperFilters
if (-not $existing) { $existing = @() }
if ($existing -notcontains $Script:ServiceName) {
    $new = @($existing) + $Script:ServiceName
    New-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name UpperFilters -PropertyType MultiString -Value $new -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Host '[ok] 已加入 Volume UpperFilters'
} else {
    Write-Host '[..] UpperFilters 已包含 RAMBlockCache'
}

# 4b) [FIX 致命-3 2026-10-18] armed 基线：boot_guard.ps1 回滚护栏生效的前提
# （原路径不写 FilterArmed → boot_guard.ps1 首行即 exit 0、护栏空转）。
# 与 deploy.ps1 第 3 步一致；安装成功后由 logon_disarm 机制解除（同一生命周期）。
$parm = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$($Script:ServiceName)\Parameters"
New-Item -Path $parm -Force | Out-Null
# [147/N-146-7] 本路径原先只写 FilterArmed/BootFailCount，depSeq 恒为 0 →
# 驱动宽限分支（rbdriver.c:281）永不成立：安装后首次开机若上次非干净关机，
# 直接 fails=1 → 自断环 → 所有卷不挂栈。补写 DeploySeq(+1) 并清零 DeployAck。
$oldSeq = 0
try { $oldSeq = [int](Get-ItemProperty -Path $parm -Name DeploySeq -ErrorAction Stop).DeploySeq } catch { $oldSeq = 0 }
New-ItemProperty -Path $parm -Name DeploySeq       -PropertyType DWord -Value ($oldSeq + 1) -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $parm -Name DeployAck       -PropertyType DWord -Value 0 -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $parm -Name FilterArmed -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $parm -Name BootFailCount -PropertyType DWord -Value 0 -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $parm -Name LastBootHealthy -PropertyType DWord -Value 0 -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host ('[ok] armed 基线已写（boot_guard 回滚护栏生效；DeploySeq={0} DeployAck=0 → 首启宽限成立）' -f ($oldSeq + 1))

# 5) 触发重新枚举存储设备（免重启尝试；若无效则需一次重启）
# [P2-13] 不再对全部 Volume 设备 Disable/Enable：那是对整个存储栈的重枚举
# 风暴，可能中断在途 I/O、使系统卷短暂掉线。改为只刷新主机存储缓存；
# 挂栈仍由下一次重启或卷到达事件由 PnP 完成。
Write-Host '[..] 刷新存储缓存（不再强制重枚举所有卷）...'
try {
    Update-HostStorageCache -ErrorAction Stop
    Write-Host '[ok] 存储缓存已刷新'
} catch {
    Write-Host '[..] 刷新存储缓存不可用（可忽略；重启后由 PnP 挂栈）'
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '完成。若过滤设备未在卷栈上出现，请重启一次（这是唯一可能需要的一次重启）。'
Write-Host '重启后：驱动 AddDevice 会挂到卷栈，默认缓存关闭；用 ctl/WPF 对 F/D 执行 ATTACH_VOLUME 即开始加速。'
Read-Host '按回车关闭'
````
