##### `src/scripts/p5b_directed_reread.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""P5-B decisive re-read experiment (read-only, user mode, no driver change).

Why this exists (deliverables/211-l2-c-plan-p5-result-2026-11-12.md):
  P5 round 1 proved the WRITE side of the J18 fix (3 stores on out-of-window
  blocks, blk_min=1030317 > s_Slots=32756), but L2Hits stayed 0. Root cause
  candidates (211 section 3):
    A. rbL2.c:978 rejects any probe with len > 64KB; rbio_worker.c passes the
       core MISS RANGE length (up to 32MB slices), so most reads never reach
       the index lookup.
    B. shrink stored only 3 blocks while the re-read covered 2048 blocks, so
       even the few <=64KB probes likely missed those 3.

This tool removes BOTH confounders without touching the driver:
  Stage A - read the LIVE container C:\\RAMBoostL2c.bin record headers while
            L2 is still enabled. rbL2.c:712-716 opens it with
            FILE_SHARE_READ|WRITE|DELETE, so concurrent user-mode reads are
            legal. Store writes the whole record synchronously (:1099), so the
            headers are complete once shrink returns. Each header is 24 bytes:
              ULONG64 Lba, ULONG Stamp, ULONG Crc, ULONG64 VolId
            at offset 4096 + slot * (24 + 65536).
            Lba == blk << 16 == the VOLUME-ABSOLUTE byte offset (64KB aligned).
  Stage C - open the volume device \\\\.\\D: with FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING and do
            ONE 64KB read at exactly that volume offset, so the filter sees
            lba == stored Lba, len == 64KB, off == 0. That passes both
            rbfeat.c:823 (Len<=1MB) and rbL2.c:978 / :995 (no cross-slot).
            If the index/container path is healthy, Rb2Count(7,1) fires and
            L2Hits increments.

STRICTLY READ-ONLY: GENERIC_READ only; no writes, no FSCTL, no registry,
no IOCTL to the driver. All handles are closed in finally blocks so
Invoke-Rollback can delete the container afterwards.

Usage:
  python src/scripts/p5b_directed_reread.py --container C:\\RAMBoostL2c.bin \
      --volume D --slots 32756 --json <out.json>
"""
import argparse
import ctypes
import json
import os
import struct
import sys
from ctypes import wintypes

REC_HDR = 24
REC_DATA = 64 * 1024
REC = REC_HDR + REC_DATA           # 65560, matches rbL2.c RB2_L2REC
BASE = 4096                        # container header
HASH_MUL = 2654435761              # rbL2.c RB2_L2HASH_MUL
BLK = 64 * 1024

GENERIC_READ = 0x80000000
FILE_SHARE_READ = 0x1
FILE_SHARE_WRITE = 0x2
FILE_SHARE_DELETE = 0x4
OPEN_EXISTING = 3
FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING = 0x20000000
FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN = 0x08000000
INVALID_HANDLE = ctypes.c_void_p(-1).value

kernel32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
kernel32.CreateFileW.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
kernel32.CreateFileW.argtypes = [wintypes.LPCWSTR, wintypes.DWORD,
                                 wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.LPVOID,
                                 wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.DWORD,
                                 wintypes.HANDLE]
kernel32.SetFilePointerEx.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.SetFilePointerEx.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.c_longlong,
                                      ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_longlong),
                                      wintypes.DWORD]
kernel32.ReadFile.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.ReadFile.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.LPVOID,
                              wintypes.DWORD,
                              ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD), wintypes.LPVOID]
kernel32.CloseHandle.restype = wintypes.BOOL
kernel32.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]


def _open(path, flags):
    h = kernel32.CreateFileW(path, GENERIC_READ,
                             FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
                             None, OPEN_EXISTING, flags, None)
    if not h or h == INVALID_HANDLE:
        raise OSError("CreateFileW failed: %s err=%d" %
                      (path, ctypes.get_last_error()))
    return h


def _close(h):
    if h and h != INVALID_HANDLE:
        kernel32.CloseHandle(h)


def read_stored_blocks(container, slots):
    """Stage A: enumerate non-empty container records (read-only)."""
    h = _open(container, FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN)
    found = []
    try:
        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(REC_HDR)
        for slot in range(slots):
            newpos = ctypes.c_longlong(0)
            off = BASE + slot * REC
            if not kernel32.SetFilePointerEx(h, off, ctypes.byref(newpos), 0):
                continue
            n = wintypes.DWORD(0)
            if not kernel32.ReadFile(h, buf, REC_HDR, ctypes.byref(n), None):
                continue
            if n.value != REC_HDR:
                continue
            lba, stamp, crc, volid = struct.unpack("<QIIQ", buf.raw[:REC_HDR])
            if lba == 0:
                continue
            blk = lba >> 16
            expected = (blk * HASH_MUL) % slots
            found.append({
                "slot": slot,
                "lba": lba,
                "blk": blk,
                "vol_gb": round(lba / (1 << 30), 2),
                "stamp": stamp,
                "crc": crc,
                "volid": "0x%016X" % volid,
                "expected_slot": expected,
                "slot_ok": slot == expected,
                "out_of_legacy_prefix": blk > slots,
            })
    finally:
        _close(h)
    return found


def directed_reread(volume_letter, blocks):
    """Stage C: one 64KB unbuffered read per stored block, at its volume LBA."""
    path = "\\\\.\\%s:" % volume_letter.upper()
    h = _open(path, FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING)
    # NO_BUFFERING reads must be sector aligned; 64KB buffer + 64KB-aligned
    # volume offsets satisfy that. Use an aligned buffer via ctypes.
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(BLK + 4096)
    raw_addr = ctypes.addressof(buf)
    aligned = (raw_addr + 4095) & ~4095
    results = []
    try:
        for b in blocks:
            newpos = ctypes.c_longlong(0)
            ok = kernel32.SetFilePointerEx(h, b["lba"], ctypes.byref(newpos), 0)
            n = wintypes.DWORD(0)
            if ok:
                ok = kernel32.ReadFile(h, ctypes.c_void_p(aligned), BLK,
                                       ctypes.byref(n), None)
            results.append({
                "slot": b["slot"], "lba": b["lba"],
                "seek_ok": bool(ok), "bytes": n.value if ok else 0,
                "err": 0 if ok else ctypes.get_last_error(),
            })
    finally:
        _close(h)
    return results


def displace_core(path, mb):
    """Push the driver's block-level core cache OFF a chosen region (2026-11-13).

    LEGACY HELPER -- no longer called by stage D (round 5 / 2026-11-13).

    Why it was written, and why it did NOT work: `rbio.c` has an inline
    all-hit fast path (`rbio.c:534`: `len <= 1MB` and `rb_read_try_cache()`
    fully hits) that completes the IRP without entering the worker, so
    `RbFeatOnMiss` -- the only caller of `RbL2ProbeFill` -- is never reached.

    The round-3 theory ("shrink 100 leaves a 1MB core residual") was wrong.
    Real cause, confirmed by source + round-4 CSV: `rbio_worker.c:256/:289`
    call `rb_read_commit_gen()` even when `RbFeatOnMiss()` succeeded, and
    `cache_read.c:191` does `chunk_create + memcpy` => a stage-C L2 HIT
    REPOPULATES core. Stage D then reads 16 blocks from that exact set.
    Round 4 proved this displacement evicted nothing: its 1024 chunks were
    ALL core hits (coreHit +1023 / coreMiss +0), and the file tail range it
    reads overlaps the very volume-LBA cluster the span window lives in.

    The fixture now uses a `shrink 100` immediately before the span instead
    (no intervening read). This function is kept for ad-hoc experiments;
    do NOT re-enable it as a stage-D fix without first proving a coreMiss
    delta >= 1.

    Return code: 0 = completed, 2 = open/read failure.
    """
    size = os.path.getsize(path)
    want = int(mb) * 1024 * 1024
    if want <= 0:
        print("[FAIL] displace: --displace-mb must be > 0")
        return 2
    if want > size:
        want = size
    start = size - want
    start -= start % BLK                      # NO_BUFFERING: 64KB alignment
    want = min(want, size - start)
    want -= want % BLK
    print("displace: %s offset=%d bytes=%d (64KB chunks)" % (path, start, want))
    try:
        h = _open(path, FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING)
    except OSError as e:
        print("[FAIL] displace: %s" % e)
        return 2
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(BLK + 4096)
    aligned = (ctypes.addressof(buf) + 4095) & ~4095
    ok = err = 0
    try:
        cur = start
        end = start + want
        while cur < end:
            newpos = ctypes.c_longlong(0)
            if not kernel32.SetFilePointerEx(h, cur, ctypes.byref(newpos), 0):
                err += 1
                break
            n = wintypes.DWORD(0)
            if not kernel32.ReadFile(h, ctypes.c_void_p(aligned), BLK,
                                     ctypes.byref(n), None):
                err += 1
                break
            if n.value != BLK:
                err += 1
                break
            ok += 1
            cur += BLK
    finally:
        _close(h)
    print("displace: ok=%d chunks err=%d" % (ok, err))
    return 0 if err == 0 else 2


def _longest_run(blocks):
    """Longest run of consecutive block numbers (blk, not slot) in the container."""
    ordered = sorted(blocks, key=lambda b: b["blk"])
    best, i = [], 0
    while i < len(ordered):
        j = i
        while j + 1 < len(ordered) and ordered[j + 1]["blk"] == ordered[j]["blk"] + 1:
            j += 1
        if j - i + 1 > len(best):
            best = ordered[i:j + 1]
        i = j + 1
    return best


def span_reread(args):
    """Stage D: ONE unbuffered read covering N consecutive stored 64KB blocks.

    [C-SLICE 2026-11-13 / 218 section 5] This is the only stage that can tell the
    slice patch apart from the (already verified) single-block path: N separate
    64KB reads would each be a single-block probe. A single ReadFile of N*64KB is
    a >64KB miss range, which before the patch was rejected outright by the
    `len > RB2_L2BLK` gate, and after the patch must be sliced into N pieces
    (L2Hits += N, L2Miss += 0).

    Exit codes: 0 = read completed (judge L2Hits from the probe CSV), 2 = read
    failed, 3 = no run of N consecutive blocks (fixture/layout problem, NOT a
    driver verdict).
    """
    with open(args.from_json, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        blocks = json.load(f).get("blocks", [])
    print("p5b: stage D only, %d stored blocks from %s" % (len(blocks), args.from_json))
    run = _longest_run(blocks)
    n = args.span_blocks
    print("  longest consecutive run = %d blocks" % len(run))
    if len(run) < n:
        print("[FAIL] stage D needs %d consecutive blocks, only %d available "
              "(layout problem, not a driver defect)" % (n, len(run)))
        return 3
    sel = run[:n]
    # [C-SLICE round 5] Keep the shifted window: it stays inside the same
    # verified-contiguous run and costs nothing. But the round-4 rationale
    # ("1MB warm-up residual") was WRONG -- see displace_core() docstring.
    # The real reason rounds 3/4 saw coreHit +1 / coreMiss +0 is that stage C
    # repopulates core from L2 and stage D reads out of that same set. The
    # fixture now evicts core with `shrink 100` immediately before this read;
    # the shift alone never fixed anything and must not be credited for it.
    off = int(getattr(args, "span_offset", 0) or 0)
    if off < 0:
        off = 0
    if off > len(run) - n:
        off = len(run) - n
    sel = run[off:off + n]
    if off:
        print("  window shifted by %d blocks into the run (core-residual avoidance)"
              % off)
    base, total = sel[0]["lba"], n * BLK
    if base % BLK:
        print("[FAIL] base LBA %d is not 64KB aligned" % base)
        return 3
    try:
        h = _open("\\\\.\\%s:" % args.volume.upper(), FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING)
    except OSError as e:
        # Elevation / device-access failure is a FIXTURE limitation, never a
        # driver verdict -- the caller turns a non-zero exit into a WARN.
        print("[FAIL] stage D cannot open the volume: %s" % e)
        print("       (needs elevation; fixture limitation, NOT a driver defect)")
        return 2
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(total + 4096)
    aligned = (ctypes.addressof(buf) + 4095) & ~4095
    got, ok, err = 0, False, 0
    try:
        newpos = ctypes.c_longlong(0)
        ok = kernel32.SetFilePointerEx(h, base, ctypes.byref(newpos), 0)
        nrd = wintypes.DWORD(0)
        if ok:
            ok = kernel32.ReadFile(h, ctypes.c_void_p(aligned), total,
                                   ctypes.byref(nrd), None)
        if ok:
            got = nrd.value
        else:
            err = ctypes.get_last_error()
    finally:
        _close(h)
    print("  span: base_lba=%d blk=%d..%d pieces=%d expect=%d bytes=%d ok=%s err=%d"
          % (base, sel[0]["blk"], sel[-1]["blk"], n, total, got, bool(ok), err))
    print("  expect L2Hits += %d, L2Miss += 0 (judge from the probe CSV around "
          "pre/post-cslice-span)" % n)
    if not (ok and got == total):
        print("[FAIL] span read did not complete: ok=%s got=%d/%d" % (bool(ok), got, total))
        return 2
    print("result: PASS (stage D issued ONE %d-byte read over %d consecutive blocks)"
          % (total, n))
    return 0


def verify_record_crc(container, blocks):
    """Stage A2: recompute each record's data CRC in user mode.

    213 review section 8: the driver reports BOTH "IdxProbe MISS" and "record
    header triple-check failed" as Rb2Count(9,1) with no log line, so a failed
    hit cannot be attributed from counters alone. Read-only remedy: read the
    stored 64KB payload and recompute RbCrc32 (rbL2.c:138, standard CRC32 poly
    0xEDB88320) to prove the container record itself is valid. If the record
    CRC matches AND slot == Hash(blk), then a MISS can only come from the
    in-memory index (Use=0 or a different Lba), not from a torn record.
    """
    import zlib
    h = _open(container, FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN)
    out = []
    try:
        for b in blocks:
            newpos = ctypes.c_longlong(0)
            data_off = BASE + b["slot"] * REC + REC_HDR
            buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(REC_DATA)
            ok = kernel32.SetFilePointerEx(h, data_off, ctypes.byref(newpos), 0)
            n = wintypes.DWORD(0)
            if ok:
                ok = kernel32.ReadFile(h, buf, REC_DATA, ctypes.byref(n), None)
            crc_calc = (zlib.crc32(buf.raw[:n.value]) & 0xFFFFFFFF) if ok else None
            out.append({
                "slot": b["slot"], "lba": b["lba"], "crc_hdr": b["crc"],
                "crc_calc": crc_calc,
                "crc_ok": (crc_calc is not None and crc_calc == b["crc"]),
                "bytes": n.value if ok else 0,
            })
    finally:
        _close(h)
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--container", default="C:\\RAMBoostL2c.bin")
    ap.add_argument("--volume", default="D")
    ap.add_argument("--slots", type=int, default=32756)
    ap.add_argument("--json", dest="json_out", default=None,
                    help="write/read the stage-A report (JSON)")
    ap.add_argument("--no-directed", action="store_true",
                    help="Stage A only (skip volume device reads)")
    ap.add_argument("--from-json", dest="from_json", default=None,
                    help="Stage C only: read stored-block LBAs from a prior "
                         "stage-A JSON report (so CSV sampling points can be "
                         "inserted between A and C)")
    ap.add_argument("--span-blocks", dest="span_blocks", type=int, default=0,
                    help="Stage D only: ONE unbuffered read covering N consecutive "
                         "stored 64KB blocks (C-SLICE: RbL2ProbeFill must slice the "
                         ">64KB range and report L2Hits += N)")
    ap.add_argument("--displace-file", dest="displace_file", default=None,
                    help="Displacement only: read the LAST --displace-mb MB of this "
                         "file with FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING to evict the span blocks "
                         "from the core cache (so the span read is a real miss and "
                         "reaches RbFeatOnMiss). Run this BEFORE --span-blocks.")
    ap.add_argument("--displace-mb", dest="displace_mb", type=int, default=8,
                    help="Displacement size in MB (default 8; must exceed the core "
                         "dynamic limit, which is clamped to 1MB after shrink 100)")
    ap.add_argument("--span-offset", dest="span_offset", type=int, default=0,
                    help="Stage D: shift the measured window N blocks INTO the "
                         "longest run (default 0). Avoids the ~1MB core residual "
                         "left by shrink 100, which can be the run's first blocks.")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.displace_file:
        return displace_core(args.displace_file, args.displace_mb)

    if args.span_blocks:
        if not args.from_json:
            print("[FAIL] --span-blocks needs --from-json (stage A report)")
            return 3
        return span_reread(args)

    stage_c_only = bool(args.from_json)
    vc = []
    if stage_c_only:
        with open(args.from_json, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            prev = json.load(f)
        blocks = prev.get("blocks", [])
        print("p5b: stage C only, %d stored blocks from %s" %
              (len(blocks), args.from_json))
    else:
        print("p5b: container=%s volume=%s slots=%d" %
              (args.container, args.volume, args.slots))
        try:
            blocks = read_stored_blocks(args.container, args.slots)
        except OSError as e:
            print("[FAIL] stage A: %s" % e)
            return 1
        print("  stored blocks = %d" % len(blocks))
        for b in blocks[:16]:
            print("    slot=%-6d lba=%-14d blk=%-9d (%.2f GB) slot_ok=%s "
                  "out_of_prefix=%s stamp=%d volid=%s" %
                  (b["slot"], b["lba"], b["blk"], b["vol_gb"], b["slot_ok"],
                   b["out_of_legacy_prefix"], b["stamp"], b["volid"]))
        if len(blocks) > 16:
            print("    ... %d more" % (len(blocks) - 16))
        # Stage A2: record-integrity evidence (213 section 8 attribution remedy)
        try:
            vc = verify_record_crc(args.container, blocks)
            okc = sum(1 for v in vc if v["crc_ok"])
            print("  record CRC verified = %d / %d" % (okc, len(vc)))
            for v in vc:
                if not v["crc_ok"]:
                    print("    [WARN] slot=%d crc hdr=0x%08X calc=%s bytes=%d" %
                          (v["slot"], v["crc_hdr"],
                           "None" if v["crc_calc"] is None else "0x%08X" % v["crc_calc"],
                           v["bytes"]))
        except OSError as e:
            vc = []
            print("[WARN] stage A2 (record CRC) skipped: %s" % e)

    rereads = []
    if not args.no_directed and blocks:
        try:
            rereads = directed_reread(args.volume, blocks)
        except OSError as e:
            print("[WARN] stage C unavailable: %s" % e)
            rereads = []
        okn = sum(1 for r in rereads if r["seek_ok"] and r["bytes"] == BLK)
        print("  directed 64KB reads ok = %d / %d" % (okn, len(rereads)))

    report = {"blocks": blocks, "directed": rereads,
              "stage_c_available": bool(rereads),
              "record_crc": vc if not stage_c_only else []}
    if args.json_out and not stage_c_only:
        with open(args.json_out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
        print("  json: %s" % args.json_out)

    if not blocks:
        print("[FAIL] no stored blocks found -- cannot run a decisive re-read")
        return 1
    bad = [b for b in blocks if not b["slot_ok"]]
    if bad:
        print("[FAIL] %d blocks violate slot == Hash(blk)" % len(bad))
        return 1
    print("result: PASS (stage A evidence collected%s)" %
          ("" if args.no_directed else ", stage C attempted"))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

##### `src/scripts/parse_l2_idx.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Parse a RAMBoostL2c.idx index file (read-only, user mode, no driver change).

C-plan P5 judgement 5 (deliverables/203-l2-c-plan-detailed-design-2026-11-12.md
section 1 P0-D / 205 section 2 G4): rbfeatctl's 5 IOCTLs are counters/config
only, so there is NO way to read back the in-memory L2 index through the
control device. Instead we parse the persisted index file directly.

Four preconditions (from 205 G4), all checked here:
  1. The index must have been FINALISED: `l2 disable` (RbL2CloseIntEx with
     Persist=TRUE) or clean shutdown H5 writes the final header. Otherwise
     RbL2IdxUnseal has zeroed h.Magic and the file means "not finalised".
     => This tool must run BEFORE the fixture's Invoke-Rollback deletes the
        file, or against a copy taken at that point.
  2. h.Magic == RB2_IDX_MAGIC (0x32494258), plus Build / SlotCount / Count
     sanity.
  3. CRC recomputed with the SAME algorithm as rbL2.c:138 RbCrc32:
     standard CRC32, poly 0xEDB88320, init/xor 0xFFFFFFFF. zlib.crc32 is
     bit-identical.
  4. s_BootSeq / s_VolId are driver-runtime values: user mode cannot fully
     reproduce IdxLoad's BootSeq/VolId gate. This tool can only assert that
     entries are self-consistent (slot == Hash(Lba>>16)) and that the CRC
     covers them. Runtime acceptance still needs P5 L2Hits>0 + reboot hit.

Layout (rbL2.c:56-59 and :49), little-endian, no padding surprises:
  RB2_L2IDX_H = 6*ULONG (Magic, Build, SlotCount, Count, Crc, BootSeq)
              + ULONG64 VolId                       = 32 bytes
  RB2_L2IDX_E = ULONG64 Lba + ULONG Stamp + ULONG Slot = 16 bytes

Exit 0 = index is well-formed and self-consistent; exit 1 = invalid / drifted.
"""
import argparse
import pathlib
import struct
import sys
import zlib

RB2_IDX_MAGIC = 0x32494258
RB2_L2HASH_MUL = 2654435761
HEADER_FMT = "<6IQ"          # 6 ULONG + 1 ULONG64
ENTRY_FMT = "<Q2I"           # Lba (ULONG64), Stamp, Slot
HEADER_SIZE = struct.calcsize(HEADER_FMT)   # 32
ENTRY_SIZE = struct.calcsize(ENTRY_FMT)     # 16


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("path", help="path to RAMBoostL2c.idx")
    ap.add_argument("--slots", type=int, default=None,
                    help="expected s_Slots (defaults to header SlotCount)")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    p = pathlib.Path(args.path)
    if not p.is_file():
        print("[FAIL] index file not found: %s" % p)
        print("       (was it deleted by Invoke-Rollback? run before rollback)")
        return 1
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    fails = []

    print("parse_l2_idx: %s (%d bytes)" % (p, len(raw)))
    if len(raw) < HEADER_SIZE:
        print("[FAIL] file shorter than 32-byte header")
        return 1

    (magic, build, slot_count, count, crc, boot_seq, vol_id) = \
        struct.unpack_from(HEADER_FMT, raw, 0)
    print("  Magic     = 0x%08X  Build=%d  SlotCount=%d  Count=%d" %
          (magic, build, slot_count, count))
    print("  Crc       = 0x%08X  BootSeq=%d  VolId=0x%016X" %
          (crc, boot_seq, vol_id))

    # precondition 1/2: finalised header
    if magic != RB2_IDX_MAGIC:
        fails.append("h.Magic != RB2_IDX_MAGIC (index NOT finalised, or "
                     "RbL2IdxUnseal zeroed it)")
    if slot_count == 0:
        fails.append("h.SlotCount == 0")
    if count > 262144:                      # RB2_L2IDX_MAX, rbL2.c:45
        fails.append("h.Count=%d > RB2_L2IDX_MAX" % count)
    slots = args.slots if args.slots else slot_count
    if slots == 0:
        fails.append("effective s_Slots == 0")

    need = HEADER_SIZE + count * ENTRY_SIZE
    if len(raw) < need:
        fails.append("file truncated: need %d bytes for %d entries, have %d" %
                     (need, count, len(raw)))
        body = raw[HEADER_SIZE:]
    else:
        body = raw[HEADER_SIZE:need]

    # precondition 3: CRC over exactly the entry array
    calc = zlib.crc32(body) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    print("  Crc calc  = 0x%08X  (%s)" %
          (calc, "match" if calc == crc else "MISMATCH"))
    if calc != crc:
        fails.append("CRC mismatch: header 0x%08X vs computed 0x%08X" %
                     (crc, calc))

    # direct-mapping invariant: slot == Hash(Lba >> 16)
    n = min(count, len(body) // ENTRY_SIZE)
    bad_slot = 0
    for k in range(n):
        lba, stamp, slot = struct.unpack_from(ENTRY_FMT, body, k * ENTRY_SIZE)
        blk = lba >> 16
        expect = (blk * RB2_L2HASH_MUL) % slots if slots else 0
        print("    entry %d: Lba=0x%X blk=%d (%.2f GB) Slot=%d expected=%d" %
              (k, lba, blk, lba / (1 << 30), slot, expect))
        if slot != expect:
            bad_slot += 1
            if bad_slot <= 3:
                print("    entry %d: Lba=0x%X blk=%d Slot=%d expected=%d" %
                      (k, lba, blk, slot, expect))
    print("  entries   = %d parsed, slot-invariant violations = %d" %
          (n, bad_slot))
    if bad_slot:
        fails.append("%d entries violate slot == Hash(Lba>>16) "
                     "(direct-mapping invariant broken)" % bad_slot)

    print("  LIMIT: user mode cannot verify BootSeq/VolId runtime gates; "
          "runtime acceptance needs L2Hits>0 + reboot hit.")
    if fails:
        for f in fails:
            print("[FAIL] " + f)
        print("result: FAIL (%d)" % len(fails))
        return 1
    print("result: PASS (0 fail) -- index self-consistent; "
          "this is judgement-5 evidence, NOT a caching correctness proof")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

##### `src/scripts/pfro_pending.ps1`

````powershell
# pfro_pending.ps1 -- PFRO 排队替换纯函数库 [FIX S-04]
# 层：Scripts。职责：把 verify_deploy_signature.ps1 的 -AllowPendingReplace 匹配逻辑
# 抽为可 dot-source 的纯函数（无系统访问、无顶层副作用），供 verify 运行时侧与
# QA 测试侧复用；deploy.ps1 与 verify 之间是子进程调用而非 dot-source，deploy 侧
# "整值备份/恢复 + 断言"不需要配对匹配，故不 dot-source 本库（库对其开放，零副作用）。
#
# PFRO = HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager 的
# PendingFileRenameOperations（REG_MULTI_SZ），条目扁平排布为
# [源1, 目标1, 源2, 目标2, ...]，步长 2 切对；奇数尾元素丢弃
# （REG_MULTI_SZ 理应成对，畸形数据不参与匹配，见设计假设 A4）。
#
# 匹配语义（fail-closed）：源（归一化）== 期望源 且 目标（归一化）== 期望目标
# 才 $true；空数组 / 陈旧队列（源是旧 dist 路径的旧二进制）-> $false。
#
# 本文件必须保持 UTF-8 with BOM（check_ps_syntax.ps1 断言）。

# 去 \??\ / \\?\ 前缀 + Trim + ToLowerInvariant（大小写不敏感归一化）。
# 注意：PowerShell 单引号串无反斜杠转义，'\??\' 即 4 字符 \??\，'\\?\' 即 4 字符 \\?\。
function Remove-PfroPathPrefix([string]$Path) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Path)) { return '' }
    $p = $Path.Trim()
    if ($p.StartsWith('\??\')) { $p = $p.Substring(4) }
    elseif ($p.StartsWith('\\?\')) { $p = $p.Substring(4) }
    return $p.ToLowerInvariant()
}

# 按 REG_MULTI_SZ 扁平结构步长 2 切 (Source,Target) 对；奇数尾元素丢弃。
# return ,$pairs 保空数组语义（空输入返回空数组而非 $null）。
function Split-PfroPairs([string[]]$Entries) {
    $pairs = @()
    if ($null -ne $Entries -and $Entries.Count -ge 2) {
        $n = 2 * [int][math]::Floor($Entries.Count / 2)
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $n; $i += 2) {
            $pairs += [pscustomobject]@{ Source = $Entries[$i]; Target = $Entries[$i + 1] }
        }
    }
    return ,$pairs
}

# 成对匹配：源（归一化）== $ExpectedSource 且 目标（归一化）== $ExpectedTarget 才 $true。
# 空数组 / 陈旧队列 -> $false。纯函数：不读注册表、不碰磁盘。
function Test-PfroPendingReplace([string[]]$PfroEntries, [string]$ExpectedSource, [string]$ExpectedTarget) {
    if ($null -eq $PfroEntries -or $PfroEntries.Count -lt 2) { return $false }
    $src = Remove-PfroPathPrefix $ExpectedSource
    $dst = Remove-PfroPathPrefix $ExpectedTarget
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($src) -or [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($dst)) { return $false }
    foreach ($pair in (Split-PfroPairs $PfroEntries)) {
        if ((Remove-PfroPathPrefix $pair.Source) -eq $src -and (Remove-PfroPathPrefix $pair.Target) -eq $dst) {
            return $true
        }
    }
    return $false
}
````

##### `src/scripts/phase4_close_race_probe.ps1`

````powershell
# phase4_close_race_probe.ps1 - READ-ONLY close-race evidence collector.
# Phase 4 / C-02. Collects the trigger + stability evidence required by
# KNOWN_ISSUES.md J17 and deliverables/175 (Verifier + Special Pool +
# directed interleave). It NEVER deploys, signs, reboots, writes registry,
# changes config, or enables write-back / WBCOAL (red lines R4/R9).
# See deliverables/design/phase4-close-race-verification-2026-11-13.md.
param(
    [int]$Minutes = 30,
    [int]$IntervalSec = 5,
    [switch]$InjectRefresh
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$deploy = 'C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy'
$repo = $env:RB_REPO
$log = Join-Path $deploy ('phase4-close-race-' + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ') + '.log')
$script:lines = @()

function Say([string]$s) {
    $script:lines += $s
    Write-Host $s
}
function Flush-Lines {
    if ($script:lines.Count -gt 0) {
        Add-Content -LiteralPath $log -Value $script:lines -Encoding utf8
        $script:lines = @()
    }
}
function Get-VerifierInfo {
    $mm = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($mm) {
        return ('VerifyDrivers=[' + ($mm.VerifyDrivers -join ',') + '] VerifyType=' + $mm.VerifyDriversType)
    }
    return 'VerifyDrivers=UNREADABLE'
}
function Get-SpecialPoolState {
    # verifier.exe output is localized, but the flag token is plain ASCII.
    try {
        $vq = (& verifier.exe /querysettings 2>&1 | Out-String)
        if ($vq -match '0x00000001') { return 'special_pool=ON' }
        return 'special_pool=UNCONFIRMED'
    } catch {
        return 'special_pool=UNREADABLE'
    }
}
function Get-SysInfo {
    $p = Join-Path $env:windir 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { return 'System32 sys MISSING' }
    $h = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    $sg = (Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $p).Status
    return ('System32 sys sha=' + $h + ' sig=' + $sg)
}
function Get-CloseDeferredCount {
    $dir = Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'RAMBlockCache\logs'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    foreach ($f in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter 'driver-*.log' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        $n += @(Select-String -LiteralPath $f.FullName -SimpleMatch 'l2: close deferred' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
    }
    return $n
}
function Get-CrashCount {
    # No matching events is NOT a query failure: SilentlyContinue returns an
    # empty array, so a quiet 24h window is correctly reported as zero.
    $evts = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'System'; Id = 1001,41,6008; StartTime = (Get-Date).AddHours(-24) } -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    return $evts.Count
}
function Get-DumpCount {
    $d = Join-Path $env:windir 'Minidump'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d)) { return 0 }
    return @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Filter '*.dmp' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
}

Say ('repo=' + $repo)

Say (Get-SpecialPoolState)
Say (Get-SysInfo)
$svc = Get-Service RAMBlockCache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($svc) { Say ('service=' + $svc.Status + '/' + $svc.StartType) } else { Say 'service=MISSING' }
$pinFile = 'C:\Users\Public\o9\o9_fix_deploy_result.txt'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pinFile) {
    $ms = [regex]::Matches((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $pinFile), 'SIGNED sha=([0-9a-fA-F]{64})')
    if ($ms.Count -gt 0) { Say ('watch_pin=' + $ms[$ms.Count - 1].Groups[1].Value.ToLower()) }
}
if ($repo) {
    $anchor = Join-Path $repo 'dist\RAMBlockCache.sys.sha256'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $anchor) { Say ('anchor=' + (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $anchor).Trim()) }
}
$cd0 = Get-CloseDeferredCount
$cr0 = Get-CrashCount
$du0 = Get-DumpCount
Say ('baseline close_deferred=' + $cd0 + ' crash_events=' + $cr0 + ' dumps=' + $du0)
Say ('log=' + $log)
Flush-Lines

$deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($Minutes)
$samples = 0
while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
    $samples++
    if ($InjectRefresh -and $repo) {
        $exe = Join-Path $repo 'src\ctl\rbfeatctl.exe'
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe) { & $exe refresh 2>&1 | Out-Null }
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $IntervalSec
    if (($samples % 10) -eq 0) {
        $cd = Get-CloseDeferredCount
        Say ('sample=' + $samples + ' utc=' + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') + ' close_deferred=' + $cd)
        Flush-Lines
    }
}

$cd1 = Get-CloseDeferredCount
$cr1 = Get-CrashCount
$du1 = Get-DumpCount
$trigger = $cd1 - $cd0
$crashDelta = if ($cr0 -ge 0 -and $cr1 -ge 0) { $cr1 - $cr0 } else { -1 }
$dumpDelta = $du1 - $du0
$verifierOk = (Get-VerifierInfo) -match 'RAMBlockCache'
$specialPoolOk = ((Get-SpecialPoolState) -eq 'special_pool=ON')
Say ('final close_deferred=' + $cd1 + ' (delta=' + $trigger + ') crash_events=' + $cr1 + ' (delta=' + $crashDelta + ') dumps=' + $du1 + ' (delta=' + $dumpDelta + ')')
Say ('samples=' + $samples + ' verifier_target_ok=' + $verifierOk + ' special_pool_ok=' + $specialPoolOk)
if ($trigger -le 0) {
    Say 'VERDICT: INCONCLUSIVE - NO TRIGGER EVIDENCE (R7). The timeout branch was never exercised.'
} elseif ($crashDelta -lt 0) {
    Say 'VERDICT: INCONCLUSIVE - crash event query unavailable; stability cannot be asserted.'
} elseif ($crashDelta -gt 0 -or $dumpDelta -gt 0) {
    Say 'VERDICT: FAIL - new bugcheck/dump under the patched build. Reject the C-02 patch.'
} elseif (-not $verifierOk) {
    Say 'VERDICT: INCONCLUSIVE - Verifier is not targeting RAMBlockCache.sys.'
} elseif (-not $specialPoolOk) {
    Say 'VERDICT: INCONCLUSIVE - Special Pool is not confirmed active.'
} else {
    Say 'VERDICT: EVIDENCE COLLECTED - trigger + Verifier + no new crash. Send this log for independent review.'
}
Say ('end_utc=' + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))
Flush-Lines
Write-Host ('log: ' + $log)
````

##### `src/scripts/qa_geom_gate.ps1`

````powershell
# qa_geom_gate.ps1 - [72/73/74 2026-11-06] >4K geometry concurrency gate (fail-closed)
# Purpose: prove the cache.c rb_write_pass2 stripe-lock fix is effective at
#   block_size 8192/16384/32768 AND that 4K stays structurally identical to
#   the noon-63 baseline. Runs test_flushpar Release + ASan on every cell.
# Output: structured JSON + explicit GATE: PASS/FAIL + process exit 0/1.
# Rules: Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatible. ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
#   ALWAYS. Never use 'Stop' with native 2>&1 (71-harvest-closeout G1).
#   Every native run uses Start-Process with separate stdout/stderr files.
# File encoding: UTF-8 with BOM + CRLF. ASCII content only.
param(
  [int]$Rounds = 30,
  [string]$CoreDir = '',
  [string]$VcBin = '',   # [85 B13] empty = auto-detect MSVC toolset; explicit path still honored
  [string]$AsanStage = 'C:\Users\Public\rbc-geom-gate',
  [string]$Baseline4KNoArg = '',
  [string]$Baseline4K16 = '',
  [string]$OutJson = ''
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# [G19 2026-11-11] Default -CoreDir used to be <repo>\src\core, which stopped
# holding the test hosts after [140 B3] -> all 3 prerequisites missing.
# Worse, line 24 defaulted $OutJson under $build, and the prerequisite-failure
# path created that directory and wrote JSON BEFORE declaring FAIL -- i.e. the
# probe created the very directory it was looking for, so later triage believed
# the layout was correct. Now derived from manifest targets.core; explicit
# -CoreDir is still honored.
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'qa_paths.ps1')
$root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
if ($CoreDir -eq '') {
  $coreTarget = $Script:QaManifest.targets.core
  if (-not $coreTarget.workDir) {
    Write-Output '[X] manifest targets.core.workDir missing - cannot resolve core dir'
    Write-Output 'GATE: FAIL'; exit 1
  }
  $CoreDir = Join-Path $root ($coreTarget.workDir -replace '/', '\')
}
$build = Join-Path $CoreDir 'build'
if ($OutJson -eq '') { $OutJson = Join-Path $build 'qa_geom_gate.json' }
$relExe  = Join-Path $build 'test_flushpar.exe'
$asanExe = Join-Path $build 'asan_test_flushpar.exe'
$asanPdb = Join-Path $build 'asan_test_flushpar.pdb'
$evidence = Join-Path $build 'qa_geom_gate_runs'
$failReasons = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$cells = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$illegal = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$equival = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList

function Add-Fail([string]$m) {
  [void]$failReasons.Add($m)
  Write-Output "[X] $m"
}
function Run-Native([string]$exe, [string[]]$argList, [string]$out, [string]$err) {
  $p = $null
  if ($null -eq $argList -or $argList.Count -eq 0) {
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru `
          -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err
  } else {
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $argList -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru `
          -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err
  }
  if ($null -eq $p) { return -1 }
  return $p.ExitCode
}
function Read-Both([string]$out, [string]$err) {
  $s = ''
  if (Test-Path $out) { $v = Get-Content $out -Raw; if ($v) { $s += $v } }
  if (Test-Path $err) { $v = Get-Content $err -Raw; if ($v) { $s += $v } }
  return $s
}
function Get-NormLines([string]$path) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $path)) { return @() }
  $list = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
  foreach ($l in (Get-Content $path)) {
    $s = $l -replace '\[empty-zone\]',''
    $s = $s -replace '\d+','#'
    $s = ($s -replace '\s+',' ').Trim()
    if ($s.Length -gt 0) { $list.Add($s) }
  }
  return $list.ToArray()
}
function Compare-Norm([string]$a, [string]$b, [string]$label) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $a) -or -not (Test-Path $b)) {
    Add-Fail "$label : baseline or output file missing"
    $bad = [ordered]@{ label=$label; lines_a=0; lines_b=0; mismatches=-1; verdict='FAIL' }
    return $bad
  }
  [string[]]$A = @(Get-NormLines $a)
  [string[]]$B = @(Get-NormLines $b)
  if ($A.Count -lt 2 -or $B.Count -lt 2) {
    Add-Fail "$label : normalized line count too small"
    $bad2 = [ordered]@{ label=$label; lines_a=$A.Count; lines_b=$B.Count; mismatches=-1; verdict='FAIL' }
    return $bad2
  }
  $n = [Math]::Min($A.Count, $B.Count)
  $d = 0
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt $n; $i++) { if ($A[$i] -cne $B[$i]) { $d++ } }
  $d += [Math]::Abs($A.Count - $B.Count)
  $r = [ordered]@{ label=$label; lines_a=$A.Count; lines_b=$B.Count; mismatches=$d; verdict='PASS' }
  if ($d -ne 0) { $r.verdict = 'FAIL'; Add-Fail "$label : $d structural mismatches" }
  return $r
}
function Invoke-Cell([int]$bs, [int]$lanes, [string]$mode, [string]$exe, [int]$rounds, [string]$tag) {
  $r = [ordered]@{
    block_size=$bs; lanes=$lanes; mode=$mode; rounds=$rounds;
    exit_codes=@(); exit_nonzero=0; fail_lines=0; bad_runs=0;
    asan_reports=0; first_bad_file=''; verdict='PASS'
  }
  $codes = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
  for ($i = 1; $i -le $rounds; $i++) {
    $stem = "gate_${tag}_bs${bs}_l${lanes}_r${i}"
    $out = Join-Path $evidence "$stem.out"
    $err = Join-Path $evidence "$stem.err"
    $argList = @("$lanes", '6', '20261106', "$bs")
    $rc = Run-Native $exe $argList $out $err
    [void]$codes.Add($rc)
    $txt = Read-Both $out $err
    $asan = 0
    if ($txt -match 'AddressSanitizer') {
      $asan = 1; $r.asan_reports++
      if (Test-Path $err) {
        Copy-Item $err (Join-Path $build "qa_geom_gate_ASAN_HIT_${tag}_bs${bs}_l${lanes}_r${i}.err") -Force
      }
    }
    $nf = ([regex]::Matches($txt, '\[FAIL\]')).Count
    $r.fail_lines += $nf
    if ($rc -ne 0) { $r.exit_nonzero++ }
    $bad = ($rc -ne 0) -or ($nf -gt 0) -or ($asan -eq 1) -or ($txt -match 'test_flushpar: FAIL')
    if ($bad) {
      $r.bad_runs++
      if ($r.first_bad_file -eq '') { $r.first_bad_file = $out }
      $r.verdict = 'FAIL'
      $r.exit_codes = @($codes.ToArray())
      Add-Fail "cell bs=$bs lanes=$lanes mode=$mode run=$i exit=$rc fail_lines=$nf asan=$asan output=$out"
      return $r
    }
  }
  $r.exit_codes = @($codes.ToArray())
  return $r
}

Write-Output '== qa_geom_gate: >4K concurrency gate (fail-closed) =='
Write-Output "rounds=$Rounds core=$CoreDir"

# --- fail-closed prerequisites ---
foreach ($p in @($relExe, $asanExe, $asanPdb)) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { Add-Fail "missing prerequisite: $p" }
}
if ($Rounds -lt 1) { Add-Fail 'Rounds must be >= 1' }
# [85 B13] Deterministic ASan toolset resolution (no hardcoded MSVC version).
# Root cause (84 report, two independent rounds): asan_*.exe imports
# clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll; each MSVC toolset ships a different build
# (14.44 = 1,193,496 B, 14.51 = 1,881,912 B). Default -VcBin was hardcoded to
# 14.44 while the staged exe was built with 14.51 -> loader fails with
# 0xC0000139 STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND and 0-byte .out/.err = FALSE FAIL.
# Fix: when -VcBin is empty, enumerate installed MSVC toolset bins and pick the
# one whose ASan runtime actually loads the staged exe (single-run probe);
# an explicit -VcBin is still honored and verified the same way. The old
# "[warn] MSVC bin missing" is upgraded to fail-closed: in ASan mode a missing
# or mismatched bin now Add-Fail with a clear diagnostic instead of letting
# 360 runs produce a misleading false FAIL.
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $evidence | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $AsanStage | Out-Null
$asanStaged = Join-Path $AsanStage 'asan_test_flushpar.exe'
Copy-Item $asanExe $asanStaged -Force
Copy-Item $asanPdb (Join-Path $AsanStage 'asan_test_flushpar.pdb') -Force

function Get-MsvcAsanBinCandidates {
  $roots = @(
    'C:\Program1\VC\Tools\MSVC',
    'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\BuildTools\VC\Tools\MSVC',
    'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Tools\MSVC',
    'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Tools\MSVC',
    'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Enterprise\VC\Tools\MSVC',
    'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Enterprise\VC\Tools\MSVC'
  )
  $found = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
  foreach ($r in $roots) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $r)) { continue }
    foreach ($d in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $r -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
      $bin = Join-Path $d.FullName 'bin\Hostx64\x64'
      if (Test-Path (Join-Path $bin 'clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll')) {
        [void]$found.Add($bin)
      }
    }
  }
  return $found.ToArray()
}

function Test-AsanRuntime([string]$bin, [string]$exe) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $bin)) { return $false }
  $saved = $env:PATH
  try {
    $env:PATH = "$bin;$env:SystemRoot\System32;$env:SystemRoot;$saved"
    $o = Join-Path $AsanStage 'vcprobe.out'
    $e = Join-Path $AsanStage 'vcprobe.err'
    $rc = Run-Native $exe @('4','6','20261106','8192') $o $e
    $txt = Read-Both $o $e
    Remove-Item $o,$e -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (($rc -eq 0) -and ($txt -match 'RESULT: PASS') -and ($txt.Length -gt 0)) { return $true }
    return $false
  } finally { $env:PATH = $saved }
}

$effectiveVcBin = ''
if ($VcBin -ne '') {
  $effectiveVcBin = $VcBin
  if (-not (Test-Path $effectiveVcBin)) {
    Add-Fail "MSVC -VcBin path missing: $effectiveVcBin (ASan runtime cannot load; pass the toolset that built asan_*.exe, or leave default for auto-detect)"
  } elseif (-not (Test-AsanRuntime $effectiveVcBin $asanStaged)) {
    Add-Fail "-VcBin $effectiveVcBin does NOT match the ASan runtime of $asanExe (0xC0000139 false-FAIL risk); pass the toolset that built asan_*.exe or leave default"
  }
} else {
  $cands = @(Get-MsvcAsanBinCandidates)
  foreach ($c in $cands) {
    if (Test-AsanRuntime $c $asanStaged) { $effectiveVcBin = $c; break }
  }
  if ($effectiveVcBin -eq '') {
    Add-Fail "auto-detect failed: no installed MSVC toolset matched $asanExe (probed $($cands.Count) candidate bin(s)); rebuild asan_*.exe with one toolset or pass -VcBin"
  } else {
    Write-Output "[info] auto-detected ASan MSVC toolset bin: $effectiveVcBin"
  }
}
if ($effectiveVcBin -ne '') {
  $symbolizer = Join-Path $effectiveVcBin 'llvm-symbolizer.exe'
  $env:PATH = "$effectiveVcBin;$env:SystemRoot\System32;$env:SystemRoot;$env:PATH"
  $env:ASAN_SYMBOLIZER_PATH = $symbolizer
}

if ($failReasons.Count -gt 0) {
  # still emit JSON so CI has a machine-readable failure record
  $outObj = [ordered]@{ gate='qa_geom_gate'; verdict='FAIL'; fail_reasons=@($failReasons.ToArray()) }
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutJson, ($outObj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
  Write-Output 'GATE: FAIL'; exit 1
}

# --- 4K equivalence: no-arg 40 combos + single 16-lane run ---
$noargOut = Join-Path $build 'qa_geom_gate_4k_noarg.out'
$noargErr = Join-Path $build 'qa_geom_gate_4k_noarg.err'
$rcNoArg = Run-Native $relExe @() $noargOut $noargErr
$noargTxt = Read-Both $noargOut $noargErr
$eq1 = [ordered]@{
  label='4K no-arg sweep'; exit_code=$rcNoArg;
  runs40_bad0=($noargTxt -match 'runs=40 bad=0');
  result_pass=([regex]::Matches($noargTxt,'RESULT: PASS')).Count;
  fail_lines=([regex]::Matches($noargTxt,'\[FAIL\]')).Count;
  wb_gran_4096=([regex]::Matches($noargTxt,'wb_bytes%4096=0')).Count;
  verdict='PASS'
}
if (($rcNoArg -ne 0) -or (-not $eq1.runs40_bad0) -or ($eq1.result_pass -ne 40) -or
    ($eq1.fail_lines -ne 0) -or ($eq1.wb_gran_4096 -ne 40)) {
  $eq1.verdict='FAIL'; Add-Fail '4K no-arg sweep invariants failed'
}
[void]$equival.Add($eq1)

$l16Out = Join-Path $build 'qa_geom_gate_4k_l16.out'
$l16Err = Join-Path $build 'qa_geom_gate_4k_l16.err'
$rcL16 = Run-Native $relExe @('16','6','20261106') $l16Out $l16Err
$l16Txt = Read-Both $l16Out $l16Err
$eq2 = [ordered]@{
  label='4K lanes=16'; exit_code=$rcL16;
  runs8_bad0=($l16Txt -match 'runs=8 bad=0');
  result_pass=([regex]::Matches($l16Txt,'RESULT: PASS')).Count;
  fail_lines=([regex]::Matches($l16Txt,'\[FAIL\]')).Count;
  zones_266237=([regex]::Matches($l16Txt,'16 zones x 266237 B')).Count;
  active_zones_16=([regex]::Matches($l16Txt,'active_zones=16')).Count;
  set_exclude_16=([regex]::Matches($l16Txt,'set_exclude\(16 extents\)')).Count;
  verdict='PASS'
}
if (($rcL16 -ne 0) -or (-not $eq2.runs8_bad0) -or ($eq2.result_pass -ne 8) -or
    ($eq2.fail_lines -ne 0) -or ($eq2.zones_266237 -lt 1) -or
    ($eq2.active_zones_16 -ne 4) -or ($eq2.set_exclude_16 -ne 2)) {
  $eq2.verdict='FAIL'; Add-Fail '4K lanes=16 invariants failed'
}
[void]$equival.Add($eq2)

# optional structural diff against noon/engineer baselines (fail-closed if path given but absent)
if ($Baseline4KNoArg -ne '') {
  if (Test-Path $Baseline4KNoArg) { [void]$equival.Add((Compare-Norm $noargOut $Baseline4KNoArg '4K no-arg vs baseline')) }
  else { Add-Fail "Baseline4KNoArg not found: $Baseline4KNoArg" }
}
if ($Baseline4K16 -ne '') {
  if (Test-Path $Baseline4K16) { [void]$equival.Add((Compare-Norm $l16Out $Baseline4K16 '4K lanes=16 vs baseline')) }
  else { Add-Fail "Baseline4K16 not found: $Baseline4K16" }
}

# --- illegal geometry fail-closed ---
# [G27 2026-11-11] The list below used to contain '65536'. That value was
# RE-ADMITTED to the whitelist on 2026-11-08 by [64K-UNBAN]:
#   src/core/cache.c:264    legal[] = {4096,8192,16384,32768,65536}
#   src/driver/rbctl.c:175  rb_legal_bs[] = {4096,8192,16384,32768,65536}
# (see deliverables/97-64k-unban-perf-2026-11-08.md)
# The test side already agrees: tests/core/test_flushpar.c:131 legal_block_size()
# accepts 65536. So this gate was demanding exit=2 for a LEGAL value, observing
# exit=0, and reporting "did not fail closed" -- a stale-expectation FALSE
# FAIL, not a driver defect. 131072 remains banned (slab retention incident).
# 8191 added: a non-whitelisted value adjacent to a power of two.
foreach ($v in @('4095','131072','8191','0','abc')) {
  $o = Join-Path $evidence "gate_illegal_$v.out"; $e = Join-Path $evidence "gate_illegal_$v.err"
  $rc = Run-Native $relExe @('16','6','20261106',$v) $o $e
  $t = Read-Both $o $e
  $r = [ordered]@{ block_size_arg=$v; exit_code=$rc; fail_closed=($t -match 'FAIL illegal block_size'); verdict='PASS' }
  if (($rc -ne 2) -or (-not $r.fail_closed)) { $r.verdict='FAIL'; Add-Fail "illegal block_size '$v' did not fail closed (exit=$rc)" }
  [void]$illegal.Add($r)
}

# --- legal whitelist must be ACCEPTED (positive control) ---
# Without this, an implementation that rejects EVERY value would pass the
# illegal-value loop above. Whitelist source of truth:
# src/core/cache.c legal[] and src/driver/rbctl.c rb_legal_bs[].
foreach ($v in @('4096','8192','16384','32768','65536')) {
  $o = Join-Path $evidence "gate_legal_$v.out"; $e = Join-Path $evidence "gate_legal_$v.err"
  $rc = Run-Native $relExe @('1','1','20261106',$v) $o $e
  $t = Read-Both $o $e
  $r = [ordered]@{ block_size_arg=$v; exit_code=$rc; accepted=($t -notmatch 'FAIL illegal block_size'); verdict='PASS' }
  if (($rc -ne 0) -or (-not $r.accepted)) {
    $r.verdict='FAIL'
    Add-Fail "legal block_size '$v' was REJECTED (exit=$rc) - whitelist drift between gate and cache.c/rbctl.c"
  }
  [void]$illegal.Add($r)
}

# --- >4K cells: Release + ASan, STOP-ON-FAIL ---
$bsList = @(8192,16384,32768)
$lanesList = @(4,16)
$stop = $false
foreach ($mode in @('Release','ASan')) {
  $exeToRun = $relExe
  if ($mode -eq 'ASan') { $exeToRun = $asanStaged }
  foreach ($bs in $bsList) {
    foreach ($lanes in $lanesList) {
      $tag = $mode.ToLower()
      $r = Invoke-Cell $bs $lanes $mode $exeToRun $Rounds $tag
      [void]$cells.Add($r)
      Write-Output ("  bs={0} lanes={1} mode={2}: bad={3}/{4} asan={5} exit_nonzero={6} {7}" -f `
        $bs,$lanes,$mode,$r.bad_runs,$Rounds,$r.asan_reports,$r.exit_nonzero,$r.verdict)
      if ($r.verdict -eq 'FAIL') { $stop = $true; break }
    }
    if ($stop) { break }
  }
  if ($stop) { break }
}

$verdict = 'PASS'
if ($failReasons.Count -gt 0) { $verdict = 'FAIL' }
$summary = [ordered]@{
  cells_run=$cells.Count; cells_failed=0; total_runs=0;
  asan_reports_total=0; illegal_failed=0; equival_failed=0;
  rounds_below_recommended=($Rounds -lt 30)
}
foreach ($c in $cells) { if ($c.verdict -eq 'FAIL') { $summary.cells_failed++ }; $summary.total_runs += $c.rounds; $summary.asan_reports_total += $c.asan_reports }
foreach ($r in $illegal) { if ($r.verdict -eq 'FAIL') { $summary.illegal_failed++ } }
foreach ($r in $equival) { if ($r.verdict -eq 'FAIL') { $summary.equival_failed++ } }

$outObj = [ordered]@{
  gate='qa_geom_gate'; timestamp=(Get-Date -Format 'o'); verdict=$verdict;
  rounds=$Rounds; stop_on_fail=$stop;
  release_exe=$relExe; asan_exe=$asanExe; asan_stage=$AsanStage;
  symbolizer=$symbolizer; symbolizer_available=(Test-Path $symbolizer);
  environment=[ordered]@{ powercfg_note='not asserted by this gate'; verifier_note='not asserted by this gate' };
  equivalence=@($equival.ToArray()); illegal=@($illegal.ToArray());
  cells=@($cells.ToArray()); summary=$summary;
  fail_reasons=@($failReasons.ToArray()); out_json=$OutJson
}
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutJson, ($outObj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8), (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Output "JSON: $OutJson"
Write-Output "GATE: $verdict (cells=$($summary.cells_run) runs=$($summary.total_runs) asan_reports=$($summary.asan_reports_total))"
if ($verdict -eq 'PASS') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }
````

##### `src/scripts/qa_paths.ps1`

````powershell
# qa_paths.ps1 -- resolve QA binary paths from build/sources.manifest.json.
#
# [G19 2026-11-11] Why this file exists.
#
# Five QA drivers hardcoded `<repo>\src\core\build\<exe>`. That directory stopped
# being the artifact location when [140 B3] moved the test hosts from src/core to
# tests/core; the manifest has said `targets.core.outDir = "tests/core/build"`
# ever since, and 60 executables actually live there. The drivers kept pointing
# at the abandoned path, so:
#
#   qa_smoke_wsconc.ps1               exit 1  (test_wsconc.exe not found)
#   qa_sweep_wsconc.ps1               exit 1
#   qa_repeat_concurrency_20261020    exit 1  (7/7 MISSING binary)
#   qa_geom_gate.ps1                  exit 1  (3/3 prerequisites missing)
#   qa_recovery_20261024.ps1          exit 6  (6/6 build failures)
#
# They all fail closed, so nothing was silently green -- but every historical
# smoke / sweep / geometry / recovery claim in the reports names a driver that
# cannot run. That is a broken evidence chain, which is worse than a red gate:
# a red gate gets fixed, a missing reproduction path gets cited forever.
#
# Fixing it by writing `tests/core/build` into five scripts would just move the
# hardcoded path. The manifest is already the single source of truth for build
# outputs (`targets.core.outDir`), so these helpers read it instead. If the
# layout moves again, one JSON field moves with it.
#
# Usage:
#   . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'qa_paths.ps1')
#   $exe = Get-QaBinary 'test_wsconc.exe'      # -> full path or throws
#   $dir = Get-QaOutDir                        # -> <repo>\tests\core\build

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# scripts\ -> repo root is two levels up.
$Script:QaRepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$Script:QaManifestPath = Join-Path $Script:QaRepoRoot 'build\sources.manifest.json'

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Script:QaManifestPath)) {
    throw "sources.manifest.json missing: $Script:QaManifestPath (QA drivers cannot resolve artifacts)"
}

$Script:QaManifest = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($Script:QaManifestPath, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8) |
                      ConvertFrom-Json

function Get-QaCoreTarget {
    $t = $Script:QaManifest.targets.core
    if (-not $t) { throw "manifest targets.core missing -- cannot resolve QA artifacts" }
    if (-not $t.outDir) { throw "manifest targets.core.outDir missing -- cannot resolve QA artifacts" }
    return $t
}

function Get-QaOutDir {
    $t = Get-QaCoreTarget
    $dir = Join-Path $Script:QaRepoRoot ($t.outDir -replace '/', '\')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir)) {
        throw "QA output dir missing: $dir (run build/build.ps1 -Target core first)"
    }
    return $dir
}

function Get-QaBinary([string]$Name) {
    if (-not $Name) { throw "Get-QaBinary: empty name" }
    $dir = Get-QaOutDir
    $exe = Join-Path $dir $Name
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) {
        $have = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter '*.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                  Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
        throw ("QA binary missing: {0}`n  looked in: {1}`n  {2} exe(s) present: {3}" -f
               $Name, $dir, $have.Count, (($have | Sort-Object | Select-Object -First 12) -join ', '))
    }
    return $exe
}

# Same contract as Get-QaBinary but returns $null instead of throwing, for
# callers that want to report a full prerequisite table before giving up.
function Find-QaBinary([string]$Name) {
    try {
        $dir = Get-QaOutDir
        $exe = Join-Path $dir $Name
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe) { return $exe }
        return $null
    } catch {
        return $null
    }
}

function Get-QaOutDirOrNull {
    try { return Get-QaOutDir } catch { return $null }
}
````

````powershell
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet("Baseline", "Green", "W2", "Gates")]
    [string]$Suite = "Baseline",
    [string]$DotNet = "C:\Users\陈\.dotnet\dotnet.exe",
    [string]$OutputRoot = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
$srcRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$repoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $srcRoot
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($OutputRoot)) {
    $OutputRoot = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Temp\rbc-recovery-qa\W0-W1\$Suite"
}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $OutputRoot | Out-Null
$script:ExpectedFailures = 0
$script:UnexpectedFailures = 0

function Invoke-Native {
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        [string]$FilePath,
        [string[]]$Arguments,
        [int]$ExpectedExit = 0
    )
    $stdout = Join-Path $OutputRoot "$Name.stdout.txt"
    $stderr = Join-Path $OutputRoot "$Name.stderr.txt"
    $command = Join-Path $OutputRoot "$Name.command.txt"
    $quoted = @($FilePath) + $Arguments | ForEach-Object { '"' + ($_ -replace '"', '\"') + '"' }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($command, $quoted, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)

    # [G18 2026-11-11] 两处 fail-open：
    # ① `& $FilePath ...` 在文件不存在时抛的是**命令解析错误**，`$LASTEXITCODE`
    #    不会被写入，而是**继承上一条命令的退出码**。实测：上一条 exit 0 → 本步
    #    伪装成 0；上一条 exit 7 → 本步报 7（看似有诊断，其实指错方向）。
    # ② 同理 `$LASTEXITCODE` 本身可能是 $null（从未运行过任何原生命令时），
    #    `[string]$null` 写进 exit.txt 是空串，后续解析会当成"没有退出码"。
    #
    # 注意 ① 的修法**不能**一律 Test-Path：$FilePath 可能是裸命令名
    # (`powershell.exe`、`dotnet`)，由 PATH 解析，字面 Test-Path 必然为假。
    # 因此只在"看起来是路径"时（含 \ 或 / 或盘符冒号）做存在性预检。
    $looksLikePath = ($FilePath -match '[\\/]' -or $FilePath -match '^[A-Za-z]:')
    if ($looksLikePath -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $FilePath)) {
        $actual = 127
        Write-Output "$Name exit=$actual MISSING-EXE $FilePath"
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $OutputRoot "$Name.exit.txt"), [string]$actual, [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
        $script:UnexpectedFailures++
        return
    }
    # 裸命令名先确认可解析；解析不到同样归一为 127。
    if (-not $looksLikePath) {
        $cmd = Get-Command $FilePath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if (-not $cmd) {
            $actual = 127
            Write-Output "$Name exit=$actual MISSING-CMD $FilePath (not on PATH)"
            [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $OutputRoot "$Name.exit.txt"), [string]$actual, [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
            $script:UnexpectedFailures++
            return
        }
    }
    & $FilePath @Arguments > $stdout 2> $stderr
    $actual = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($null -eq $actual) {
        Write-Output "$Name exit=<null> (native run never set LASTEXITCODE)"
        $actual = 127
    }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $OutputRoot "$Name.exit.txt"), [string]$actual, [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
    Write-Output "$Name exit=$actual expected=$ExpectedExit"
    if ($actual -ne $ExpectedExit) { $script:UnexpectedFailures++ }
}

if ($Suite -in @("Baseline", "Green", "W2")) {
    # [G19 2026-11-11] $core 原为 <repo>\src\core，[140 B3] 把测试宿主迁到
    # tests/core 后 test_cache/test_bigread/test_sparse_miss 的 .c 一个都不在
    # src/core → build-* 全部 exit=2、run-* 全部 exit=2（实测 unexpected=6）。
    # 现在从 manifest 的 targets.core.workDir 派生，与构建系统同一事实源。
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'qa_paths.ps1')
    $coreTarget = $Script:QaManifest.targets.core
    if (-not $coreTarget.workDir) {
        Write-Output "MISSING manifest targets.core.workDir - cannot locate core sources"
        exit 1
    }
    $core = Join-Path $repoRoot ($coreTarget.workDir -replace '/', '\')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $core)) {
        Write-Output "MISSING core source dir: $core (manifest targets.core.workDir=$($coreTarget.workDir))"
        exit 1
    }
    # 编译输入仍在 $core，但链接产物统一落到 manifest 声明的 outDir，
    # 避免再出现"宿住在 A、产物在 B"的第二套布局。
    $coreBuild = Join-Path $repoRoot ($coreTarget.outDir -replace '/', '\')
    Write-Output "core sources: $core"
    Write-Output "core build  : $coreBuild"

    $vc = "C:\Program1\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.44.35207"
    $sdk = "C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10"
    $sdkVersion = "10.0.26100.0"
    $env:INCLUDE = "$vc\include;$sdk\Include\$sdkVersion\ucrt;$sdk\Include\$sdkVersion\um;$sdk\Include\$sdkVersion\shared"
    $env:LIB = "$vc\lib\x64;$sdk\Lib\$sdkVersion\ucrt\x64;$sdk\Lib\$sdkVersion\um\x64"
    $env:PATH = "$vc\bin\Hostx64\x64;$env:SystemRoot\System32;$env:SystemRoot;$env:PATH"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $coreBuild | Out-Null
    $cl = Join-Path $vc "bin\Hostx64\x64\cl.exe"

    # W2: the shared read-plan harness is Green while preserving a legacy Red control.
````

##### `src/scripts/qa_repeat_concurrency_20261020.ps1`

````powershell
# [FIX QA5-7] repeat/concurrency harness — fail-closed rewrite
# Original defects (2026-10-21 QA round): missing binaries reported fails=0 (fake
# green, $p was $null and its ExitCode access was swallowed), fixed TEMP names
# (concurrent instances overwrote each other's evidence), no timeout (a hung test
# hung the QA session forever), always exit 0.
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
foreach ($n in @("https_proxy","http_proxy")) { if (Test-Path "Env:$n") { Remove-Item "Env:$n" } }
# [G19 2026-11-11] 原产物目录硬编码 <repo>\src\core\build，[140 B3] 后产物在
# tests/core/build。改为经 qa_paths.ps1 从 manifest targets.core.outDir 解析。
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'qa_paths.ps1')
$out = Get-QaOutDirOrNull
if (-not $out) {
    Write-Output "MISSING output dir (manifest targets.core.outDir) - run build/build.ps1 -Target core first"
    exit 1
}
# [FIX QA5-5] cover the new test wave too (write_ex / wsconc / auditfix).
$tests = @("test_parflush","test_flush_many","stress_v3","stress_v4","test_write_ex","test_wsconc","test_auditfix")
$fails = 0
foreach ($t in $tests) {
    $exe = Join-Path $out "$t.exe"
    # [FIX QA5-7a] missing/corrupt binary = failure, never fake green.
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) {
        Write-Output "$t`: MISSING binary $exe"
        $fails++
        continue
    }
    for ($i=1; $i -le 10; $i++) {
        # [FIX QA5-7b] instance-unique temp files (PID + test + iter).
        $tmpO = Join-Path $env:TEMP "qa_rep_${PID}_${t}_$i.txt"
        $tmpE = Join-Path $env:TEMP "qa_repe_${PID}_${t}_$i.txt"
        try {
            $p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -WorkingDirectory $out -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru `
                 -RedirectStandardOutput $tmpO -RedirectStandardError $tmpE
        } catch {
            Write-Output "$t iter $i`: START-FAIL $($_.Exception.Message)"
            $fails++
            continue
        }
        if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            Write-Output "$t iter $i`: FAIL rc=$($p.ExitCode)"
            if (Test-Path $tmpO) { Get-Content $tmpO | Select-Object -Last 6 }
            $fails++
        }
        Remove-Item $tmpO,$tmpE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    Write-Output "$t`: 10 iterations done"
}
Write-Output "=== repeat-10 done: fails=$fails ==="
# [FIX QA5-7c] real exit code: any failure -> non-zero.
if ($fails -gt 0) { exit 1 }
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/qa_smoke_wsconc.ps1`

````powershell
# qa_smoke_wsconc.ps1 - [FIX #2] test_wsconc 冒烟矩阵驱动（6 组合 x 1 轮，退出码聚合）
#
# 背景：round5 备案"smoke 5-6 组合宣称不可复现"——smoke_runs.log/smoke2.log 在仓、
# 驱动脚本缺失。本脚本固化为可复现入口（与 qa_sweep_wsconc.ps1 同构，轻量版）。
#
# 用法：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File src\scripts\qa_smoke_wsconc.ps1
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
# [G19 2026-11-11] 原写法把产物目录硬编码为 <repo>\src\core\build，而 [140 B3]
# 已把测试宿主迁到 tests/core，产物在 tests/core/build（manifest targets.core.outDir
# 一直这么写）。五个 QA 驱动因此全部不可运行。现在统一经 qa_paths.ps1 从
# manifest 解析，路径再漂移只改一个 JSON 字段。
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'qa_paths.ps1')
$exe = Get-QaBinary 'test_wsconc.exe'

$combos = @(
    @{ n='default';     a=@() },
    @{ n='p21';         a=@('p21') },
    @{ n='mirrorall';   a=@('mirrorall') },
    @{ n='overlap-p21'; a=@('overlap','p21') },
    @{ n='slowwb-p21';  a=@('slowwb','p21') },
    @{ n='p21-bigwrite';a=@('p21','bigwrite') }
)

$fails = 0
foreach ($c in $combos) {
    $out = & $exe @($c.a) 2>&1
    $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($rc -ne 0) {
        $fails++
        # [FIX #9] 格式串必须先算后传：Write-Host "..." -f $x 的 -f 会被解析成
        # -ForegroundColor 的缩写前缀（组合名 default 当颜色值转换即崩，实测）。
        Write-Host ("[{0,-12}] exit={1}  FAIL" -f $c.n, $rc) -ForegroundColor Red
        ($out -split "`n" | Select-Object -Last 6) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "    $_" }
    } else {
        Write-Host ("[{0,-12}] exit=0  ok" -f $c.n) -ForegroundColor Green
    }
}
Write-Host "`nSMOKE_RESULT: fails=$fails"
if ($fails -gt 0) { Write-Host "qa_smoke: FAIL" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
Write-Host "qa_smoke: PASS" -ForegroundColor Green
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/qa_sweep_wsconc.ps1`

````powershell
# qa_sweep_wsconc.ps1 - [FIX #2] test_wsconc 模式矩阵驱动（退出码聚合，替代不入仓的手跑矩阵）
#
# 背景：round5 备案"SWEEP 60/60 宣称不可复现"——日志（build/qa4_final.log）在仓、
# 驱动脚本缺失。本脚本把模式矩阵固化为可复现入口：10 模式 x N 轮，逐轮取
# 退出码，fails>0 即 exit 1（与 build_all/run_all 的 QA5-1 退出码纪律同构）。
# 模式表在脚本顶部显式列出——日志与实现永不漂移。
#
# 用法：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File src\scripts\qa_sweep_wsconc.ps1 [-Rounds N]
param([int]$Rounds = 6)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
# [G19 2026-11-11] 原写法把产物目录硬编码为 <repo>\src\core\build（[140 B3] 后
# 产物在 tests/core/build）。改为经 qa_paths.ps1 从 manifest 解析。
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'qa_paths.ps1')
$exe = Get-QaBinary 'test_wsconc.exe'

# [FIX R9-13] overlap-p21 每模式独立轮数（r 字段，缺省 = -Rounds）：该组合是
# "失效销毁+同起点重建+stage 快照过期"竞态的唯一密集爆点（p21 下每笔多区间写
# 都走 -2→失效→销毁→重建），且单轮仅 ~0.09s；100 轮 ≈ 9s，对 ~0.8%/轮的静默
# 写坏回归率有实质捕获概率（test_wsconc.c 的 wb_fn oracle 会在第一笔污染回写
# 即硬失败并打印现场）。
$modes = @(
    @{ n='default';        a=@() },
    @{ n='noflush';        a=@('noflush') },
    @{ n='bigcache';       a=@('bigcache') },
    @{ n='mirrorall';      a=@('mirrorall') },
    @{ n='bigwrite';       a=@('bigwrite') },
    @{ n='p21';            a=@('p21') },
    @{ n='p21-bigwrite';   a=@('p21','bigwrite') },
    @{ n='overlap';        a=@('overlap') },
    @{ n='overlap-p21';    a=@('overlap','p21'); r=100 },
    @{ n='slowwb-p21';     a=@('slowwb','p21') }
)

$logDir = Get-QaOutDir
$log = Join-Path $logDir ("qa_sweep_{0:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.log" -f (Get-Date))
$fails = 0; $runs = 0
# [FIX #9 2026-10-21] 原此处有一行 Start-Process --help "预热"——两个缺陷：
# ① test_wsconc 无 help 模式、未知参数忽略，该行白跑一轮完整测试，零验证价值；
# ② 本会话环境同时存在 HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy 大小写重复键，Start-Process
# 构建环境块抛 ArgumentException 直接终断脚本（qa_run_core_20261020.ps1 头部
# 注释记录过同坑）。主循环首轮即是发射检查（& 直接调用 + 退出码捕获），移除。

foreach ($m in $modes) {
    # [FIX R9-14] hashtable 原生 ContainsKey——$m.PSObject.Properties.Name 对
    # hashtable 的键适配不可靠（实测 -contains 'r' 恒假，100 轮覆盖静默失效）。
    $mrounds = $Rounds
    if ($m.ContainsKey('r')) { $mrounds = [int]$m.r }
    for ($r = 1; $r -le $mrounds; $r++) {
        $out = & $exe @($m.a) 2>&1
        $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
        $runs++
        $line = "[{0,-14} round {1,2}] exit={2}" -f $m.n, $r, $rc
        if ($rc -ne 0) {
            $fails++
            Write-Host "$line  FAIL" -ForegroundColor Red
            ($out -split "`n" | Select-Object -Last 8) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "    $_" }
        } else {
            Write-Host "$line  ok" -ForegroundColor Green
        }
        Add-Content -Path $log -Value $line
        if ($rc -ne 0) { ($out -split "`n") | ForEach-Object { Add-Content -Path $log -Value "    $_" } }
    }
}

Write-Host "`nSWEEP_RESULT: runs=$runs fails=$fails (log: $log)"
if ($fails -gt 0) { Write-Host "qa_sweep: FAIL" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
Write-Host "qa_sweep: PASS ($runs runs)" -ForegroundColor Green
exit 0
````
