````powershell
# qa_teeth.ps1 - [FIX #2/#9] WS-RACE-2 变异测试驱动（KILLED/SURVIVED 语义 + 退出码门禁）
#
# 背景：round5 备案"变异测试零区分力"——变异体 = WS-RACE-2 修复整体回退
# （build\qa4\cache_mut.c 两处 neutered：stage_revalidate 恒过 + wb_drain 空转），
# 旧日志 26/26 全记 PASS（判定语义失真）。本脚本把判定改成 KILLED/SURVIVED：
#   - gate 系（test_cache 用例11 计时门控牙齿）：变异体必须被杀（退出码非 0）
#     ——否则说明测试无牙口，FAIL（fail-closed，立即退出）；
#   - expect-survive 系（test_wsconc 全模式）：结构性等价，标注
#     SURVIVED-EXPECTED，不计门禁；若意外被杀只提示重分类（多牙齿是好事）。
# 双侧同参数、同轮数必须都跑：变异体被杀 + 修复侧 PASS = 牙口来自修复而非构造。
#
# 【分类依据：2026-10-21 重跑实证 + wsrace-fix-report §9.3】
# wsconc 全模式杀不死该变异体（本脚本实测 rewrite-slowwb 6/6、rewrite-p21-
# slowwb 3/3、rewrite-plain 6/6 全部存活；QA 独立矩阵 mirrorall-slowwb 0/10、
# p21-slowwb 0/6、mirrorall 0/10 同结论，忠实口径自然复现率 ~0-4%）。三重
# 结构原因（顺序单写语义不构造"旧脏版本"前置条件）：
#   (a) 数据确定性——旧 stage 与新镜像数值相同（overlap f(off)），损坏价值不可见；
#   (b) slowwb 放大 [stage,writeback] 时长、不提高"回写器恰在两笔连续写的
#       absorb 之间 stage 到边界子块"的 µs 级时机出现概率；
#   (c) 每子块基本只被写一次，无旧版可被 stage（边界子块除外）。
# 门禁牙齿唯一确定：test_cache 用例11——迟到旧数据落于新镜像之后，确定性
# 构造（计时门控把在途回写钉在镜像发布点），变异体实测 [FAIL] 盘面 got=1
# exp=9、修复侧 PASS。wsconc 系保留作回归净度（镜像/记账/链表全净），不作
# 区分力证据——"-2 路径修复有效"的结论口径 = 用例11 牙齿 + 设计级论证，
# 见 wsrace-fix-report §9.3/§十 Known Issues。
#
# 用法：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File src\scripts\qa_teeth.ps1 [-Rounds N]
param([int]$Rounds = 6)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
# [FIX #9 2026-10-21] 上两级必须嵌套：Split-Path -Parent 连写两次的写法在
# PS 5.1 报 ParameterAlreadyBound（本脚本首发实测崩于此行），嵌套写法等价。
$root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$core = Join-Path $root 'src\core'
$qa4  = Join-Path $core 'build\qa4'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $qa4 | Out-Null

# ── [FIX 2026-11-06] 变异体自动生成 ──
# 旧流程假设 build\qa4\cache_mut.c 已存在（历史手工产物），文件缺失时 cl 直接
# 报「找不到源文件」→ 整个变异门禁不可用（63 号 QA 报告已如实记录受阻点）。
# 现在从**当前** cache_flush.c 精确切两处生成，随产品源码演进自动同步；任何一处
# 匹配数不为 1 立即 fail-closed 退出——绝不静默退化成「修复侧自比」的假牙齿。
# [142 拆分] stage_revalidate / wb_drain 随 flush 域迁入 cache_flush.c。
function New-MutantCache {
    $srcPath = Join-Path $core 'cache_flush.c'
    $mutPath = Join-Path $qa4  'cache_flush_mut.c'
    $raw = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($srcPath)
    $hadBom = ($raw.Length -ge 3 -and $raw[0] -eq 0xEF -and $raw[1] -eq 0xBB -and $raw[2] -eq 0xBF)
    $src = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($srcPath, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
    $nl = "`n"
    if ($src.Contains("`r`n")) { $nl = "`r`n" }
    $flat = $src.Replace("`r`n", "`n")

    # 两处切点必须各自恰好命中 1 次；正则用「行首 }」收尾（函数体内闭合括号都有缩进）
    $stageRx = 'static int stage_revalidate\(rb_stream \*s, rb_flushws \*ws, size_t nsl\)\n\{.*?\n\}'
    $drainRx = 'void wb_drain\(rb_stream \*s\)\n\{.*?\n\}'
    $stageRepl = "static int stage_revalidate(rb_stream *s, rb_flushws *ws, size_t nsl)`n{`n    /* [MUTANT WS-RACE-2] revalidation neutered: always pass */`n    (void)s; (void)ws; (void)nsl; return 1;`n}"
    $drainRepl = "void wb_drain(rb_stream *s)`n{`n    /* [MUTANT WS-RACE-2] in-flight drain neutered: no wait */`n    (void)s;`n}"
    $opts = [Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Singleline
    $nStage = [regex]::Matches($flat, $stageRx, $opts).Count
    $nDrain = [regex]::Matches($flat, $drainRx, $opts).Count
    if ($nStage -ne 1 -or $nDrain -ne 1) {
        Write-Host "[X] mutant cut points drifted (stage_revalidate=$nStage wb_drain=$nDrain, expect 1/1) - cache_flush.c changed, review qa_teeth.ps1" -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
    $mut = [regex]::Replace($flat, $stageRx, $stageRepl, $opts)
    $mut = [regex]::Replace($mut,  $drainRx, $drainRepl, $opts)
    if ($nl -eq "`r`n") { $mut = $mut.Replace("`n", "`r`n") }
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($mutPath, $mut, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($hadBom)))
    Write-Host "[ok] mutant generated from current cache_flush.c (2 cuts, bom=$hadBom)" -ForegroundColor Green
}
New-MutantCache

# ── 构建双侧（cl 退出码判定 + 链接前删陈旧 exe；QA5-1 纪律）──
# [FIX #9 2026-10-21] 弃 cmd /c 包装改直接调用 cl：cmd /c 把含中文的绝对路径
# 按 OEM 代码页搅乱（实测 陈 -> 乱码），且原命令行 /Fobuild\ 与 /Fo<绝对路径>
# 双写触发 cl D9025/D8036。直接调用 + 相对 obj 目录，与 core\_build_all.ps1
# 同构（该模式在本机中文路径下长期验证可靠）。
function Build-Side($tag, $flushSrc, $testsrc) {
    $exe = Join-Path $qa4 "$tag.exe"
    if (Test-Path $exe) { Remove-Item -Force $exe }
    $log = Join-Path $qa4 "build_$tag.log"
    # [142] 引擎已拆为 6 个 TU；固定侧用 src/core/cache_flush.c，
    # 变异侧用 build\qa4\cache_flush_mut.c，其余 TU 两侧一致。
    # [140 B3] 测试宿主已迁 tests/core；include 路径与 core 回归构建一致
    # （pthread shim 在 tests/core）。
    $engine = @('cache.c','cache_stats.c','cache_read.c','cache_write.c',
                $flushSrc,'cache_evict.c')
    Push-Location $core
    & cl /nologo /O2 /W3 /utf-8 /I. /I..\..\tests\core /Ibuild\qa4 $testsrc @engine /Fe:$exe /Fo:build\qa4\ > $log 2>&1
    $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
    if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) {
        Write-Host "[X] build $tag FAILED (cl exit=$rc) - see $log" -ForegroundColor Red
        Get-Content $log -Tail 20
        exit 1
    }
    Write-Host "[ok] built $tag" -ForegroundColor Green
}

$testsDir = Join-Path $root 'tests\core'
Write-Host "== teeth: building both sides (fixed=cache_flush.c, mutant=cache_flush_mut.c) =="
Build-Side 'teeth_cache_fixed' (Join-Path $core 'cache_flush.c')      (Join-Path $testsDir 'test_cache.c')
Build-Side 'teeth_cache_mut'   (Join-Path $qa4  'cache_flush_mut.c') (Join-Path $testsDir 'test_cache.c')
Build-Side 'teeth_ws_fixed'    (Join-Path $core 'cache_flush.c')      (Join-Path $testsDir 'test_wsconc.c')
Build-Side 'teeth_ws_mut'      (Join-Path $qa4  'cache_flush_mut.c') (Join-Path $testsDir 'test_wsconc.c')

# gate 系 = 必须杀死的确定性牙齿（唯一项：cache 用例11；3 轮求稳，计时门控）
$gate = @(
    @{ n='cache-用例11(计时门控)'; exe='teeth_cache_mut.exe'; fix='teeth_cache_fixed.exe'; a=@(); rounds=3 }
)
# expect-survive 系 = 结构性等价（wsconc；分类依据见头部 §9.3 摘要）
# [142 2026-11-10 复测] rewrite-p21-slowwb 在 6 TU 拆分后 12 轮实测 7/12 被杀
# （非确定性，~58% 区分力）——不再是稳定 expect-survive，也不够格当确定性
# gate（变异体有 ~42% 轮次存活）。归入 informational 并注明：该模式升级为
# 概率性牙齿，仅作趋势观察，不计入门禁。
$expectSurvive = @(
    @{ n='wsconc-rewrite-slowwb';     a=@('rewrite','slowwb') },
    @{ n='wsconc-rewrite-p21-slowwb'; a=@('rewrite','p21','slowwb') },
    @{ n='wsconc-rewrite-plain';      a=@('rewrite') },
    @{ n='wsconc-mirrorall-slowwb';   a=@('mirrorall','slowwb') },
    @{ n='wsconc-p21-slowwb';         a=@('p21','slowwb') },
    @{ n='wsconc-mirrorall-plain';    a=@('mirrorall') }
)

$killed = 0; $ran = 0
Write-Host "`n== gate series (mutant MUST be killed; fixed side MUST pass) =="
foreach ($t in $gate) {
    $seriesKilled = 0
    for ($r = 1; $r -le $t.rounds; $r++) {
        $exe = Join-Path $qa4 $t.exe
        $out = & $exe @($t.a) 2>&1
        $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
        $ran++
        if ($rc -ne 0) { $killed++; $seriesKilled++ }
        else {
            Write-Host "  [SURVIVED] $($t.n) round $r : mutant survived (no tooth)" -ForegroundColor Red
            ($out -split "`n" | Select-Object -Last 6) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "    $_" }
        }
    }
    $fixexe = Join-Path $qa4 $t.fix
    for ($r = 1; $r -le $t.rounds; $r++) {
        $outf = & $fixexe @($t.a) 2>&1
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "  [X] FIXED side FAILED on $($t.n) round $r - construction broken, not a real tooth" -ForegroundColor Red
            ($outf -split "`n" | Select-Object -Last 8) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "    $_" }
            exit 1
        }
    }
    # [FIX #9] 如实记账：任一 gate 轮次存活即 FAIL（旧版无条件打印 killed 是说谎）
    if ($seriesKilled -ne $t.rounds) {
        Write-Host "  [X] $($t.n) : mutant survived $($t.rounds - $seriesKilled)/$($t.rounds) round(s) - test has no tooth" -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
    Write-Host "  [ok] $($t.n) : mutant killed in all $($t.rounds) round(s); fixed side PASS" -ForegroundColor Green
}

Write-Host "`n== expected-survive series (informational; structural equivalence) =="
$survExp = 0
foreach ($t in $expectSurvive) {
    $exe = Join-Path $qa4 'teeth_ws_mut.exe'
    $out = & $exe @($t.a) 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host "  [KILLED!] $($t.n) : unexpected kill - re-classify as gate" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
    else { $survExp++; Write-Host "  [SURVIVED-expected] $($t.n)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
}

Write-Host "`nMUTATION_SCORE: killed=$killed/$ran (gate series), survived-expected=$survExp/$($expectSurvive.Count)"
if ($killed -ne $ran) {
    Write-Host "teeth: FAIL (mutant survived a gate round - test has no tooth)" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
Write-Host "teeth: PASS (all gate rounds killed; fixed side clean)" -ForegroundColor Green
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/qa_w4check_20261020.ps1`

````powershell
# /W4 clean gate for the cache engine TUs.
#
# [G20 2026-11-11] 两处静默失效已修（审计 finding P0-1），变异已验证：
#  ① cl.exe 不存在时 `& $cl ...` 抛的是"不会被识别为 cmdlet"的**命令解析错误**，
#     `$LASTEXITCODE` 保持 `$null` 而非非零；`$rcAll += $null` 仍为 0 →
#     6 个 TU 全打印 "rc= warnings=0"，最终 `exit (1 - [int](0 -eq 0))` = **0**。
#     即 /W4 门禁在工具链搬家后**完全静默变绿**（实跑复现：EXIT=0）。
#     现在：① 编译前 `Test-Path $cl`，缺失即 fail-closed；② 每个 TU 显式
#     校验 `$null -ne $LASTEXITCODE`，为 null 视作 rc=127；③ 末尾若产物
#     一个都没生成，也判失败。
#  ② `$root` 原写死为 `C:\Users\陈\Desktop\...`，脚本换目录后编译的是**桌面那份**
#     源码而不是脚本所在树的源码（审计 P2-5）。现在从 `$PSScriptRoot` 推导。
#
# 说明：本脚本**不在** `-Target gates` 的 17 项内（需 MSVC，仅手动运行）。
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# ── 仓库根由脚本位置推导：<repo>/src/scripts/qa_w4check_*.ps1 → <repo> ──
if (-not $PSScriptRoot) { throw "PSScriptRoot unavailable; run via -File, not dot-source" }
$root = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..')).Path
Write-Output "repo root: $root"

# ── 工具链：优先环境变量，其次已知安装位置；都找不到则 fail-closed ──
# 注意 @(...)：Where-Object 命中 1 个时返回的是标量，`$x[0]` 会取到字符串
# 首字符（'C:\Program1\...'[0] = 'C'），随后拼出 'C\bin\Hostx64\x64\cl.exe'。
# 这是 PowerShell 的经典坑，必须强制成数组。
$msvcCandidates = @(@(
    $env:RBC_MSVC_DIR,
    'C:\Program1\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.44.35207'
) | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $_) })
if ($msvcCandidates.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "MSVC toolchain not found (set RBC_MSVC_DIR=<VC\Tools\MSVC\<ver>>). /W4 gate cannot run blind."
}
$msvc = $msvcCandidates[0]
$kit  = if ($env:RBC_WINSDK_DIR) { $env:RBC_WINSDK_DIR } else { 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $kit)) { throw "Windows SDK not found: $kit" }

$cl = Join-Path $msvc 'bin\Hostx64\x64\cl.exe'
# 关键防线 1：cl.exe 必须真实存在，否则下面每个 TU 的 rc 都会是 $null
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cl)) {
    throw "cl.exe missing: $cl -- refusing to report /W4 clean without a compiler"
}
Write-Output "cl.exe: $cl"

$sdkVer = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $kit 'Include') -Directory |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^10\.0\.\d+\.\d+$' } |
            Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1)[0].Name
if (-not $sdkVer) { throw "no Windows SDK Include\10.0.*.* under $kit" }
Write-Output "Windows SDK: $sdkVer"

$inc = @(
    "/I$root\src\core",
    "/I$msvc\include",
    "/I$kit\Include\$sdkVer\ucrt",
    "/I$kit\Include\$sdkVer\um",
    "/I$kit\Include\$sdkVer\shared",
    "/I$root\src\common",
    "/I$root\tests\core"
)

# [142] pthread shim moved src/core/usertest -> tests/core ([140 B3]); with the
# old path every cache TU died at C1083 (pthread.h) yet the script still printed
# "warnings=0" per file - a silently dead /W4 gate.
# [142] engine split into six TUs; W4-clean applies to every cache TU.
$files = @(
    "$root\src\core\cache.c",       "$root\src\core\cache_stats.c",
    "$root\src\core\cache_read.c",  "$root\src\core\cache_write.c",
    "$root\src\core\cache_flush.c", "$root\src\core\cache_evict.c"
)

$old = $ErrorActionPreference
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$rcAll = 0; $wAll = 0; $objsBuilt = 0; $nullRc = 0
foreach ($f in $files) {
    $leaf = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($f)
    $obj  = Join-Path $env:TEMP "qa_cache_w4_$leaf.obj"
    $logf = Join-Path $env:TEMP "qa_cache_w4_$leaf.log"
    & $cl /nologo /W4 /utf-8 /MT $inc /c $f /Fo:$obj 2>&1 | Out-File -FilePath $logf -Encoding utf8
    $raw = $LASTEXITCODE
    # 关键防线 2：命令解析失败（找不到 exe）不会写 $LASTEXITCODE，它是 $null。
    # 若直接 `$rc = $LASTEXITCODE; $rcAll += $rc`，$null 加进去等于没加 → 假绿。
    if ($null -eq $raw) {
        $rc = 127                      # 与 POSIX "command not found" 同义
        $nullRc++
    } else {
        $rc = $raw
    }
    $lines = @(Get-Content $logf)
    $w = @($lines | Where-Object { $_ -match 'warning' }).Count
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $obj) { $objsBuilt++ }
    Write-Output ("{0} /W4 compile rc={1} warnings={2}" -f (Split-Path $f -Leaf), $rc, $w)
    if ($rc -ne 0) { $lines | Select-Object -First 10 }
    $rcAll += $rc; $wAll += $w
}
$ErrorActionPreference = $old

Write-Output "cache TU set /W4 total rc=$rcAll warnings=$wAll objects=$objsBuilt/$($files.Count)"

# 关键防线 3：即使 rc 汇总因某种原因仍是 0，产物数量不对也必须失败。
$fail = $false
if ($nullRc -gt 0) {
    Write-Output "[FAIL] $nullRc TU(s) produced no exit code (compiler never ran)"
    $fail = $true
}
if ($rcAll -ne 0) {
    Write-Output "[FAIL] nonzero compiler exit code (rc=$rcAll)"
    $fail = $true
}
if ($objsBuilt -lt $files.Count) {
    Write-Output "[FAIL] only $objsBuilt/$($files.Count) .obj produced"
    $fail = $true
}
if ($fail) { exit 1 }
Write-Output 'PASS: all cache TUs /W4 clean'
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/rb_common.ps1`

````powershell
# RAMBlockCache 部署公共配置（被各脚本 dot-source）
#
# [FIX S-10] 工具解析优先级：显式 param > 环境变量 > 自动发现 > $null。
#   显式 param：dot-source 时传参（见用法示例）。
#   环境变量  ：RB_SIGNTOOL / RB_MSBUILD / RB_NUGETPKG。
#   自动发现  ：signtool = deploy.ps1:104-119 同款 Windows Kits 递归（x64 版本倒序）；
#               MSBuild  = Get-Command 探测 PATH（A5：不额外探测用户级 .NET SDK）；
#               NugetPkg = $env:USERPROFILE\.nuget\packages。
#   $null     ：找不到即为 $null——dot-source 不 throw（懒解析），消费方点到用
#               时报错说清"缺什么、怎么设"（fail-loud）。game_mode.ps1 /
#               run_diskspd.ps1 只用 Assert-Admin/$ProjectRoot，不被签名工具
#               缺失波及；install.ps1（legacy）消费三项，缺失即 $null 调用错误
#               （fail-loud；[FIX N-b] 入口口径统一为：普通用户=dist\RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe，
#                开发者/脚本=deploy.ps1，install.ps1/ramboostsetup.ps1=legacy 备选）。
# 用法示例：
#   . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'rb_common.ps1') -SignTool 'D:\Kits\...\signtool.exe'
#   $env:RB_MSBUILD = 'D:\...\MSBuild.exe'; . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'rb_common.ps1')
#
# Sign-Driver 时间戳策略 [FIX S-10]：-TimestampUrl（默认 digicert）+ -NoTimestamp；
# 失败消息区分"时间戳不可达（离线？）"与"签名失败（查证书拇指纹/测试根）"。
param(
    [string]$SignTool,
    [string]$MSBuild,
    [string]$NugetPkg
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# 工程根 = scripts\ 的上一级
$Script:ProjectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

$Script:DriverDir   = Join-Path $ProjectRoot 'driver'
$Script:SysPath      = Join-Path $DriverDir 'x64\Release\RAMBlockCache.sys'
$Script:InfPath      = Join-Path $DriverDir 'RAMBlockCache.inf'
$Script:ServiceName  = 'RAMBlockCache'
$Script:VolumeClassGuid = '{71a27cdd-812a-11d0-bec7-08002be2092f}'

# --- [FIX S-10] 工具发现函数（纯发现，不 throw；找不到返回 $null）---
function Find-SignTool {
    $cmd = Get-Command signtool.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }
    $roots = @()
    if ($env:ProgramFiles)        { $roots += (Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles        'Windows Kits\10\bin') }
    if (${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}) { $roots += (Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Windows Kits\10\bin') }
    foreach ($r in $roots) {
        if ($r -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $r)) {
            $hit = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $r -Recurse -Filter 'signtool.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                   Where-Object { $_.FullName -match '\\x64\\signtool\.exe$' } |
                   Sort-Object FullName -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($hit) { return $hit.FullName }
        }
    }
    return $null
}

function Find-MSBuild {
    $cmd = Get-Command MSBuild.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }
    return $null
}

function Find-NuGetPkg {
    if ($env:USERPROFILE) {
        $p = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.nuget\packages'
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { return $p }
    }
    return $null
}

# 显式 param > 环境变量 > 自动发现 > $null。
function Resolve-Tool([string]$Explicit, [string]$EnvName, [scriptblock]$Finder) {
    if ($Explicit) { return $Explicit }
    $envVal = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($EnvName)
    if ($envVal) { return $envVal }
    return (& $Finder)
}

# [FIX S-10] 懒解析：dot-source 时只求值为字符串或 $null，不 throw。
$Script:SignTool = Resolve-Tool $SignTool 'RB_SIGNTOOL' { Find-SignTool }
$Script:CertThumb = 'DF1A0ADA2F2CD6E5778EA937C079CB0A035BA431'
$Script:MSBuild  = Resolve-Tool $MSBuild  'RB_MSBUILD'  { Find-MSBuild }
$Script:NugetPkg = Resolve-Tool $NugetPkg 'RB_NUGETPKG' { Find-NuGetPkg }

function Assert-Admin {
    $id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
    $pr = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($id)
    if (-not $pr.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) {
        throw '需要管理员权限。请通过 .cmd 启动以触发 UAC 自提权。'
    }
}

# [W1.5/T04/T05] Get-RbStats —— 关键计数器抓取（bench_proto.ps1 判别式对账的数据源）。
# 包装 ramboostctl status（RB_STATS 协议面冻结：CLI 不暴露原始命中数，故有派生口径）：
#   ReadReq / WriteReq / WbFlush  = status 行内原始累计值（精确）；
#   ReadHitPct / ReadHitBytesPct  = status 行内命中率（次数/字节，%.2f）；
#   ReadHit（派生）               = ReadReq × ReadHitPct / 100
#     —— core 语义 read_hit=命中请求数（部分命中计一次，cache.c:918），
#        百分比按两位小数打印，派生相对误差 < 0.005/ReadReq，对"同向判别"无影响；
#   ReadHitBytes 原始值协议面不可得（ReadBytes 未打印、RB_STATS 不加字段）：
#     字节级命中曲线以 ReadHitBytesPct + 特性层 rbfeatctl bytesHit（-Raw 时附取）参与对账；
#   DirtyBytes / WbBytes 原始值  = ramboostctl statval（机器可读，-Raw 时附取）；
#   [T05] LostDirtyBytes         = status 行"丢弃脏数据: X KB"（C7 记账回归观测量；
#     协议面冻结不加 statval 字段，KB 两位小数 → 字节粒度 ~10B，判据为 ==0 足够）。
# 解码：ctl 以 /utf-8 编译，PS 5.1 捕获原生输出前须置 Console::OutputEncoding=UTF8
#       （verify_install.ps1 同款先例），否则中文标签按 OEM 代码页解码为正则失配。
# fail-closed：ctl 缺失/非零退出/关键行解析不到 → throw（绝不返回半真数据混入对账）。
function Get-RbStats {
    param(
        [string]$CtlPath,
        [switch]$Raw
    )
    if (-not $CtlPath) { $CtlPath = Join-Path $ProjectRoot 'ctl\ramboostctl.exe' }
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $CtlPath)) {
        throw "Get-RbStats: 未找到 $CtlPath（先编译 ctl，或传 -CtlPath 指定）。"
    }
    $prevEnc = [Console]::OutputEncoding
    [Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    try {
        # 函数局部 EAP=Continue（Sign-Driver 同款模式）：原生 stderr 合流不触发 Stop，
        # 成败以 $LASTEXITCODE 显式判定（fail-closed 不依赖 EAP 副作用）。
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        $out = & $CtlPath status 2>&1
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        $text = ($out | Out-String)
    } finally {
        [Console]::OutputEncoding = $prevEnc
    }
    if ($code -ne 0) {
        throw "Get-RbStats: ramboostctl status 失败（exit=$code）：$text"
    }
    $st = [pscustomobject]@{
        ReadReq         = [uint64]0
        ReadHitPct      = [double]0
        ReadHit         = [double]0      # 派生口径，见函数头注释
        ReadHitBytesPct = [double]0
        WriteReq        = [uint64]0
        WbFlush         = [uint64]0
        DirtyMB         = [double]0
        DirtyBytes      = [uint64]0      # -Raw 时经 statval 填充
        WbBytes         = [uint64]0      # -Raw 时经 statval 填充
        LostDirtyBytes  = [uint64]0      # [T05] C7 记账（丢弃脏数据 KB → 字节）
    }
    # 行格式（ctl/ramboostctl.c cli_print_stats）：
    #   读请求: N   读命中(次数): P%   读命中(字节): Q%
    #   写请求: N   写字节: G GB   缓存吸收: R%
    #   回写次数: N   回写字节: G GB   淘汰字节: G GB
    #   缓存大小: N MB   当前占用: G GB   脏数据: M MB
    #   空闲释放: X MB   丢弃脏数据: Y KB
    $m = [regex]::Match($text, '读请求:\s*(\d+)')
    if ($m.Success) { $st.ReadReq = [uint64]$m.Groups[1].Value }
    $m = [regex]::Match($text, '读命中\(次数\):\s*([\d.]+)%')
    if ($m.Success) { $st.ReadHitPct = [double]$m.Groups[1].Value }
    $m = [regex]::Match($text, '读命中\(字节\):\s*([\d.]+)%')
    if ($m.Success) { $st.ReadHitBytesPct = [double]$m.Groups[1].Value }
    $st.ReadHit = [math]::Round($st.ReadReq * $st.ReadHitPct / 100.0, 2)
    $m = [regex]::Match($text, '写请求:\s*(\d+)')
    if ($m.Success) { $st.WriteReq = [uint64]$m.Groups[1].Value }
    $m = [regex]::Match($text, '回写次数:\s*(\d+)')
    if ($m.Success) { $st.WbFlush = [uint64]$m.Groups[1].Value }
    $m = [regex]::Match($text, '脏数据:\s*([\d.]+)\s*MB')
    if ($m.Success) { $st.DirtyMB = [double]$m.Groups[1].Value }
    $m = [regex]::Match($text, '丢弃脏数据:\s*([\d.]+)\s*KB')
    if ($m.Success) { $st.LostDirtyBytes = [uint64]([double]$m.Groups[1].Value * 1024) }
    if ($Raw) {
        $st.DirtyBytes = [uint64](& $CtlPath statval dirty_bytes)
        $st.WbBytes    = [uint64](& $CtlPath statval wb_bytes)
    }
    return $st
}

function Install-DriverBinary {
    $dest = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'
    Copy-Item $Script:SysPath $dest -Force
    Write-Host "[ok] 已部署 $dest"
}

function Sign-Driver {
    param(
        [string]$TimestampUrl = 'http://timestamp.digicert.com',
        [switch]$NoTimestamp
    )
    if (-not (Test-Path $Script:SysPath)) { throw "未找到 $($Script:SysPath)，请先 build。" }
    # [FIX S-10] 点到用 fail-loud：说清缺什么、怎么设（不再静默用死路径）。
    if (-not $Script:SignTool) {
        throw 'signtool 未找到：设 RB_SIGNTOOL 环境变量 / 传 -SignTool / 安装 Windows Kits（deploy.ps1 同款 Kits 递归亦未命中）。'
    }
    Write-Host "[..] 签名 $($Script:SysPath)"
    $tsArgs = if ($NoTimestamp) { @() } else { @('/t', $TimestampUrl) }
    # [FIX S-10] 捕获期间函数作用域 EAP=Continue（函数局部遮蔽，不影响调用方）：
    # 避免 Stop 语义把 signtool stderr 警告变成终止性错误；输出 2>&1 捕获用于失败归因。
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    $out = & $Script:SignTool sign /v /sha1 $Script:CertThumb /fd SHA256 @tsArgs $Script:SysPath 2>&1
    $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($rc -ne 0) {
        if (($out | Out-String) -match 'timestamp') {
            throw "时间戳不可达（离线？）：联网重试或改用 -NoTimestamp。signtool 输出: $(($out | Out-String).Trim())"
        }
        throw "签名失败（查证书拇指纹/测试根）。signtool 输出: $(($out | Out-String).Trim())"
    }
    Write-Host '[ok] 签名完成'
}
````

##### `src/scripts/rbmemguard.ps1`

````powershell
# rbmemguard.ps1 - memory guard: while free physical memory < 8GB, ask the driver to
# shrink 15% every 5s.
# Error-handling convention (spec D.3): $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'.
# The loop body only calls a local exe and Start-Sleep. Under Windows PowerShell 5.1 a
# native command's failure does not throw (stderr passes through), so the loop semantics
# are unchanged from before the refactor; only a CommandNotFoundException (exe missing)
# now terminates with a non-zero exit instead of repeating the error forever. PowerShell
# 7+ would also turn exe stderr into errors only if $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference
# is enabled - all documented invocation paths here use powershell.exe 5.1.
#
# [P2-15] 退出条件 + 依赖前置检查：
#   * 旧脚本 while($true) 无任何退出条件，且依赖的 rbfeatctl.exe 本包内不存在
#     （需由 ctl 构建产出）——双击即陷入永久循环 / 无限重复报错。
#   * 现：exe 缺失立即失败退出；-MaxMinutes / -MaxShrinks 提供有界运行。
param(
    [int]$MaxMinutes = 0,   # 0 = 不按时间退出（仍受 MaxShrinks 约束）
    [int]$MaxShrinks = 0    # 0 = 不按次数退出
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# [FIX 建议-9 2026-10-18] exe 在 src\ctl\，不在 scripts\（原路径恒落空，守卫空转）
$exe = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\ctl\rbfeatctl.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) {
    Write-Error "rbfeatctl.exe not found next to this script: $exe  (build ctl/rbfeatctl first)"
    exit 1
}

$deadline = if ($MaxMinutes -gt 0) { (Get-Date).AddMinutes($MaxMinutes) } else { $null }
$shrinks  = 0
while ($true) {
    if ($deadline -and (Get-Date) -gt $deadline) {
        Write-Host "[rbmemguard] time limit ($MaxMinutes min) reached, exiting."
        break
    }
    if ($MaxShrinks -gt 0 -and $shrinks -ge $MaxShrinks) {
        Write-Host "[rbmemguard] shrink limit ($MaxShrinks) reached, exiting."
        break
    }
    $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
    if ($os.FreePhysicalMemory / 1KB -lt 8192) {
        & $exe shrink 15
        $shrinks++
    }
    Start-Sleep 5
}
````

##### `src/scripts/read_shutdown_sentinel.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
r"""Read the two synchronous shutdown markers of DIAG B2-3 (report 264).

STRICTLY READ-ONLY: reads one registry DWORD and one append-only binary file.
Never writes, never changes driver state, never touches L2/flags.

Why this exists (report 263): RbLog only writes an in-memory ring drained by a
user-mode consumer (IOCTL_RB_LOGQ 0x809), so the last log lines can be lost at
shutdown. The second diagnostic build therefore writes two independent
synchronous markers at IRP_MJ_SHUTDOWN time:

  marker 1  HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Parameters
            \DiagShutdownSeq   -- monotonic total across boots (ZwSetValueKey)
  marker 2  C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy\shutdown-sentinel.bin
            -- 24-byte records appended with FILE_WRITE_THROUGH

Record layout (little-endian, 6 x ULONG = 24 B, no padding):
  [0] Magic 0x52424433 ('RBD3')
  [1] total dispatch count (same value as DiagShutdownSeq)
  [2] KeGetCurrentIrql()
  [3] 1 when dev == g_Rb.ControlDevice
  [4] FILETIME low  32 bits (KeQuerySystemTimePrecise)
  [5] FILETIME high 32 bits

Stage-B RECEIPT layout -- same file, same 24-byte stride, different magic:
  [0] Magic 0x52424434 ('RBD4')
  [1] seq  -- the SAME DiagShutdownSeq value the matching 'RBD3' carries
  [2] why  -- RbShutdownPersist() return code; 0xFF means "this branch never
              wrote ShutdownPersistWhy", i.e. one of the three fallback exits
  [3] skip -- RB_SKIP_* reason code (0 == RB_SKIP_NONE)
  [4] boot epoch, low 32 bits of g_RbBootEpoch
  [5] stop_tick_status -- NTSTATUS of RbFeatStopTick()

Why receipts exist (272 C-5): the 'RBD3' markers only answer "was the IRP
delivered, and by which device". They cannot separate "dispatched but never
reached persistence" from "persisted", because the persist outcome only ever
lived in registry values that the next boot resets. Pairing both record kinds
on the shared seq puts dispatch and outcome on ONE timeline:
  same seq has 'RBD3' AND 'RBD4' -> persisted-attempted
  seq has 'RBD3' only            -> dispatched-no-receipt (non-control device /
                                    IRQL > PASSIVE / power loss mid-write)
  seq has 'RBD4' only            -> receipt-without-dispatch -- IMPOSSIBLE by
                                    construction, printed as a WARN
Receipts are INFO ONLY: they never participate in the exit code. The rc
contract below (persist_verdict() decides, verdict() only supplies the legacy
text/rc pair) is unchanged, and parse() keeps its exact return shape.

Legacy three-way DISPATCH verdict (verdict(), kept byte-for-byte so that
shutdown_experiment_report.py and report 268/269 keep their rc semantics):
  reg advanced, file has matching records -> IRP delivered AND shutdown file I/O works
  reg advanced, file short/absent          -> IRP delivered but shutdown file I/O dead
  reg unchanged                           -> IRP not delivered to this device

[v3 2026-11-17] A dispatch-level verdict is NOT enough, and the v2 PERSIST
verdict was wrong in the SAME way the driver was before A4-d: it judged on
LastCleanWithheld, a key that RbBootFailLoad resets to 0 on every boot
(rbdriver.c:381). After any normal boot it therefore reads 0 no matter what the
last shutdown did, so v2's PERSISTED_OK was structurally true for every
shutdown that merely dispatched -- including DIRTY, FROZEN and CFG_CLEAN ones.
That is a user-mode clone of A4-d: declaring clean without evidence.

The only evidence that survives a boot is the PAIR the driver copies across
before resetting the live keys:

  rbdriver.c:354  ShutdownPersistWhyPrev := ShutdownPersistWhy
  rbdriver.c:355  PersistSkipReasonPrev  := PersistSkipReason
  rbdriver.c:364  ShutdownPersistWhy     := 0xFF
  rbdriver.c:369  PersistSkipReason      := RB_SKIP_NONE

so (WhyPrev, SkipPrev) describes the LAST shutdown attempt, exactly once.
The pair is mapped by classify_pair(); the table is mirrored verbatim in
deliverables/RB-postreboot-verify.ps1 ($W_*/$S_*) and both copies are pinned to
the C switch in rbmsg.c by check_sup01_tables.py (Gate24):

  (0x00, 0xFFFFFFFF)      CLEAN                   PERSISTED_OK  rc 0
  (0x07, 0x00000009)      WITHHELD                WITHHELD      rc 6
  (0x01, 0x00000007)      DIRTY                   DEGRADED      rc 4
  (0x02, 0x00000002)      FROZEN                  DEGRADED      rc 4
  (0x03, 0x00000003)      BUSY                    DEGRADED      rc 4
  (0x04, 0x00000001)      IRQL_UNWRITABLE         DEGRADED      rc 4
  (0x05, 0x00000005)      ALREADY                 DEGRADED      rc 4
  (0x06, 0x00000006)      CFG_CLEAN               DEGRADED      rc 4
  (0xFF, 0xFFFFFFFF)      NO_EVIDENCE             NOT_REACHED   rc 3
  (0xFF, 8 / 6 / 2)       FALLBACK_*              DEGRADED      rc 4
  (0xFF, anything else)   FALLBACK_OTHER          DEGRADED      rc 4
  both Prev keys absent   KEY_ABSENT              DEGRADED      rc 4
  exactly one absent      UNKNOWN                 DEGRADED      rc 4

DEGRADED still means exactly what it meant in v2: evidence insufficient /
needs a human look, explicitly NOT a failure. WITHHELD still means "clean was
not declared", also not a failure.

Deliberate TIGHTENING (v3): rc 0 is now returned ONLY for the literal CLEAN
pair. ALREADY (latch already DONE) is no longer rc 0 -- it proves an EARLIER
dispatch wrote clean, not that this shutdown did, and on a hiberfile resume the
latch itself is stale (274 D2). Tightening a reader is allowed; loosening one
to obtain a PASS is not (269 A5).

Three traps this file must never fall into (see inline comments):
  T1  LastCleanShutdown AND LastCleanWithheld are BOTH force-cleared by
      RbBootFailLoad on every boot (rbdriver.c:346 / :381), so both read 0 by
      read time. Neither can judge "the last shutdown wrote clean". v2 fell
      into this trap with LastCleanWithheld; do not put it back.
  T2  Features\\Flags & 0x4 == 0 means L2 is off; a missing/4-byte .idx is then
      NORMAL and must not be reported as a save failure.
  T3  DiagShutdownSeq is a non-atomic read-modify-write (268 B7): a value that
      goes backwards or a record total above the registry total is a WARN, not
      a crash and not a FAIL.

EXIT (v3 PERSIST verdict; see above)
  0 = PERSISTED_OK (pair is exactly (CLEAN, NONE))
  3 = NOT_REACHED  (pair is (0xFF, 0xFFFFFFFF): no evidence at all; reuses the
                    legacy "no delivery" code)
  4 = DEGRADED     (dispatched/persisted but not clean, or evidence incomplete;
                    reuses the legacy "partial evidence, needs review" code)
  6 = WITHHELD     (clean deliberately withheld by the volume gate, NOT a
                    failure)

Legacy DISPATCH rc values (verdict()) remain 0 / 3 / 4 and are unchanged;
"dispatch_rc" in the JSON/text carries them independently of the exit code.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import io
import json
import os
import struct
import sys
import winreg

SENTINEL = r"C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy\shutdown-sentinel.bin"
REG_KEY = r"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Parameters"
REG_VAL = "DiagShutdownSeq"
# Features\Flags lives one level up; RB2F_L2 == 0x4
# (check_l1_accel_readiness.ps1:25), read by the driver via
# Rb2GetDW(L"Features", L"Flags") (rbfeat.c:471).
REG_KEY_FEATURES = r"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Features"
FLAG_L2 = 0x4
MAGIC = 0x52424433
MAGIC_RECEIPT = 0x52424434      # stage-B persist receipt ('RBD4')
REC_SIZE = 24

# v2 PERSIST verdicts and their exit codes (see module docstring).
PERSISTED_OK = "PERSISTED_OK"
WITHHELD = "WITHHELD"
NOT_REACHED = "NOT_REACHED"
DEGRADED = "DEGRADED"
RC_PERSIST = {PERSISTED_OK: 0, NOT_REACHED: 3, DEGRADED: 4, WITHHELD: 6}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The PAIR table (v3). Plain integers on purpose: check_sup01_tables.py (Gate24)
# compares them against the C switch in rbmsg.c and against the $W_*/$S_*
# constants in RB-postreboot-verify.ps1, and any name heuristic would rot.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Why codes -- mirror of rbmsg.c RB_PERSIST_WHY_* (59-70).
WHY_CLEAN = 0
WHY_DIRTY = 1
WHY_FROZEN = 2
WHY_BUSY = 3
WHY_IRQL = 4
WHY_ALREADY = 5
WHY_CFG_CLEAN = 6
WHY_WITHHELD = 7
WHY_NONE = 0xFF

# Skip codes -- mirror of rb_common.h RB_SKIP_*.
SKIP_IRQL = 1
SKIP_FROZEN = 2
SKIP_BUSY = 3
SKIP_LATCH = 4
SKIP_ALREADY = 5
SKIP_CFG_CLEAN = 6
SKIP_DIRTY = 7
SKIP_STOPTICK = 8
SKIP_CLEAN_WITHHELD = 9
SKIP_NONE = 0xFFFFFFFF

# Exact (WhyPrev, SkipPrev) -> code. Must stay equal (keys AND code strings) to
# the elseif table in RB-postreboot-verify.ps1 -- Gate24 enforces it.
PAIR_CODES = {
    (WHY_CLEAN, SKIP_NONE): "CLEAN",
    (WHY_WITHHELD, SKIP_CLEAN_WITHHELD): "WITHHELD",
    (WHY_DIRTY, SKIP_DIRTY): "DIRTY",
    (WHY_FROZEN, SKIP_FROZEN): "FROZEN",
    (WHY_BUSY, SKIP_BUSY): "BUSY",
    (WHY_IRQL, SKIP_IRQL): "IRQL_UNWRITABLE",
    (WHY_ALREADY, SKIP_ALREADY): "ALREADY",
    (WHY_CFG_CLEAN, SKIP_CFG_CLEAN): "CFG_CLEAN",
    (WHY_NONE, SKIP_NONE): "NO_EVIDENCE",
}

# Every code string this tool can emit. Gate24 requires each one to appear
# literally in RB-postreboot-verify.ps1, so the two readers cannot drift apart.
ALL_CODES = frozenset(PAIR_CODES.values()) | frozenset([
    "KEY_ABSENT", "UNKNOWN",
    "FALLBACK_STOPTICK_FAIL", "FALLBACK_CFG_CLEAN",
    "FALLBACK_FROZEN", "FALLBACK_OTHER",
])

# code -> (coarse verdict name, exit code). Only CLEAN is rc 0 (see docstring).
CODE_VERDICT = {
    "CLEAN": (PERSISTED_OK, RC_PERSIST[PERSISTED_OK]),
    "WITHHELD": (WITHHELD, RC_PERSIST[WITHHELD]),
    "NO_EVIDENCE": (NOT_REACHED, RC_PERSIST[NOT_REACHED]),
}
VERDICT_DEGRADED = (DEGRADED, RC_PERSIST[DEGRADED])

CODE_TEXT = {
    "CLEAN": "last shutdown was clean (dirty==0 and clean was written)",
    "WITHHELD": "clean was WITHHELD by the volume gate (no volume ever "
                "attached this boot) -- not a data fault, only 'not declared'. "
                "After A4-d this can also come from the stale-latch sticky "
                "read on a hiberfile resume",
    "DIRTY": "flushed but dirty pages remained; clean was deliberately "
             "not written",
    "FROZEN": "data path frozen (rebuild/unload window); persist returned "
              "immediately",
    "BUSY": "another thread was already persisting (CAS lost); not redone",
    "IRQL_UNWRITABLE": "IRQL>PASSIVE path; the registry write itself cannot "
                       "succeed, so seeing this value is contradictory",
    "ALREADY": "latch was already DONE: THIS dispatch did not write clean. "
               "Harmless on a same-session second dispatch, but on a hiberfile "
               "resume the latch is stale (274 D2) -- needs a human look",
    "CFG_CLEAN": "clean skipped by configuration (ShutdownPersistMode != 0)",
    "NO_EVIDENCE": "no evidence: IRP never dispatched / dispatched at "
                   "IRQL>PASSIVE / power cut mid-shutdown. The three are "
                   "indistinguishable (see limit-1 in the PS reader)",
    "KEY_ABSENT": "*Prev pair never written: fresh install or the driver never "
                  "ran RbBootFailLoad",
    "UNKNOWN": "pair incomplete or not in the table; both raw values are "
               "printed for manual reading",
    "FALLBACK_STOPTICK_FAIL": "stop-tick failed, so Why was never written; "
                              "only the fallback flush ran",
    "FALLBACK_CFG_CLEAN": "stop-tick failed AND mode=2, so even the fallback "
                          "flush was skipped (configuration, not a failure). "
                          "Can also mean the Why write itself failed "
                          "(RbRegSetDW is VOID, rbdriver.c:79-87) while the "
                          "Skip write succeeded",
    "FALLBACK_FROZEN": "stop-tick failed and the data path was frozen; the "
                       "fallback flush was skipped (engine may be torn down). "
                       "Can also mean the Why write itself failed while the "
                       "Skip write succeeded",
    "FALLBACK_OTHER": "fallback branch, but the skip code is outside the "
                      "expected set -- suspicious",
}


def classify_pair(why, skip):
    """Map one (WhyPrev, SkipPrev) pair onto a code string (see module doc)."""
    hit = PAIR_CODES.get((why, skip))
    if hit is not None:
        return hit
    if why == WHY_NONE:
        # Why==0xFF means the success path never wrote it, i.e. one of the
        # three fallback exits ran (rbmsg.c:366/371/376 writes Skip only).
        # These must be matched BEFORE anything else, or (0xFF, 6) would be
        # read as CFG_CLEAN.
        if skip == SKIP_STOPTICK:
            return "FALLBACK_STOPTICK_FAIL"
        if skip == SKIP_CFG_CLEAN:
            return "FALLBACK_CFG_CLEAN"
        if skip == SKIP_FROZEN:
            return "FALLBACK_FROZEN"
        return "FALLBACK_OTHER"
    return "UNKNOWN"


def pair_of(state):
    """Return (why_present, why_value, skip_present, skip_value)."""
    wp, wv = state.get("ShutdownPersistWhyPrev", (False, None))
    sp, sv = state.get("PersistSkipReasonPrev", (False, None))
    return wp, wv, sp, sv


def reg_total(key=REG_KEY, name=REG_VAL):
    """Return the persisted total; 0 when the value has never been written."""
    try:
        k = winreg.OpenKey(winreg.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key, 0, winreg.KEY_READ)
        try:
            return int(winreg.QueryValueEx(k, name)[0])
        finally:
            winreg.CloseKey(k)
    except OSError:
        return 0


def reg_dw(key, name):
    """Return (present, value) for one DWORD; (False, None) when absent.

    Absent is a MEANINGFUL state for LastCleanWithheld: the three states are
    absent (old build / never written) / 0 (gate passed) / 1 (gate withheld).
    Never collapse absent to 0 -- that would turn "no evidence" into "clean".
    """
    try:
        k = winreg.OpenKey(winreg.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key, 0, winreg.KEY_READ)
        try:
            return True, int(winreg.QueryValueEx(k, name)[0])
        finally:
            winreg.CloseKey(k)
    except OSError:
        return False, None


def read_state(params_key=REG_KEY, features_key=REG_KEY_FEATURES):
    """Read every persistent marker the persist verdict needs (read-only)."""
    out = {
        "DiagShutdownSeq": reg_dw(params_key, "DiagShutdownSeq"),
        "LastCleanWithheld": reg_dw(params_key, "LastCleanWithheld"),
        "LastCleanShutdown": reg_dw(params_key, "LastCleanShutdown"),
        "BootFailCount": reg_dw(params_key, "BootFailCount"),
        "BootReachedUser": reg_dw(params_key, "BootReachedUser"),
        # [v3] the PAIR is the authoritative evidence; the two live keys and
        # LastCleanWithheld are printed for reference only (all are boot-reset).
        "ShutdownPersistWhyPrev": reg_dw(params_key, "ShutdownPersistWhyPrev"),
        "PersistSkipReasonPrev": reg_dw(params_key, "PersistSkipReasonPrev"),
        "ShutdownPersistWhy": reg_dw(params_key, "ShutdownPersistWhy"),
        "PersistSkipReason": reg_dw(params_key, "PersistSkipReason"),
        "Flags": reg_dw(features_key, "Flags"),
    }
    return out


def persist_verdict(total, recs, state, baseline=None, receipts=None):
    """Return (rc, verdict_name, reason, warnings, detail) for the PERSIST layer.

    state is the dict from read_state(); each entry is (present, value).
    baseline is the previously observed DiagShutdownSeq, or None when unknown;
    it only produces a WARN -- the pair describes the LAST shutdown, so it does
    not need a dispatch to have been observed in this cycle.
    receipts ('RBD4' records) are cross-checked against the pair and only ever
    produce a WARN: the receipt is best-effort, the pair is the boot-copied one.
    """
    warns = []
    n = len(recs)
    ctl = [r for r in recs if r["is_control"] == 1]
    rec_max = max([r["total"] for r in recs] or [0])

    # T3: DiagShutdownSeq is a non-atomic read-modify-write across three
    # concurrent dispatches (268 B6/B7). Backwards motion or a record total
    # above the registry total is a WARN, never a crash/FAIL.
    if baseline is not None and total < baseline:
        warns.append("DiagShutdownSeq %d < baseline %d (non-atomic RMW or "
                     "wrap; treated as WARN)" % (total, baseline))
    if rec_max > total:
        warns.append("sentinel max total %d > registry DiagShutdownSeq %d "
                     "(268 B7 lost update; treated as WARN)"
                     % (rec_max, total))

    if baseline is None:
        advanced = (total > 0) or (n > 0)
    else:
        advanced = (total > baseline) or (rec_max > baseline)
    if not advanced:
        warns.append("no new dispatch seen in this cycle (reg=%d, records=%d): "
                     "the pair below describes an EARLIER shutdown, not one "
                     "that happened since the baseline" % (total, n))

    wp, wv, sp, sv = pair_of(state)
    if not wp and not sp:
        code = "KEY_ABSENT"
    elif not wp or not sp:
        code = "UNKNOWN"
        warns.append("half pair: WhyPrev present=%s, SkipPrev present=%s -- the "
                     "two keys are written by two SEPARATE ZwSetValueKey calls "
                     "(rbdriver.c:354-355), so one can be newer than the other"
                     % (wp, sp))
    else:
        code = classify_pair(wv, sv)

    coarse, rc = CODE_VERDICT.get(code, VERDICT_DEGRADED)
    pair_txt = "(WhyPrev=%s, SkipPrev=%s)" % (
        ("0x%02X" % wv) if wp else "ABSENT",
        ("0x%08X" % sv) if sp else "ABSENT")
    reason = ("%s -> %s: %s (dispatch: reg=%d, records=%d, control=%d)"
              % (pair_txt, code, CODE_TEXT.get(code, "unknown code"),
                 total, n, len(ctl)))

    if receipts and wp and sp:
        last = receipts[-1]
        if (last["why"], last["skip"]) != (wv, sv):
            warns.append(
                "registry pair %s disagrees with the NEWEST 'RBD4' receipt "
                "(seq=%d why=0x%02X skip=0x%08X). The receipt is per-dispatch, "
                "the pair is copied once per boot; on a hiberfile resume the "
                "pair is one session older (274 D2). Verdict is unchanged."
                % (pair_txt, last["seq"], last["why"], last["skip"]))

    detail = {"code": code, "why_prev": wv if wp else None,
              "skip_prev": sv if sp else None}
    return rc, coarse, reason, warns, detail


def parse(path):
    """Return (records, raw_size). Malformed/mismatched blocks are skipped."""
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        return [], 0
    raw = io.open(path, "rb").read()
    out = []
    for off in range(0, len(raw) - REC_SIZE + 1, REC_SIZE):
        m, total, irql, isc, lo, hi = struct.unpack_from("<6I", raw, off)
        if m != MAGIC:
            continue
        ticks = lo | (hi << 32)
        try:
            dt = datetime.datetime(1601, 1, 1) + datetime.timedelta(
                microseconds=ticks // 10)
            ts = dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
        except (OverflowError, ValueError):
            ts = "?"
        out.append({"total": total, "irql": irql,
                    "is_control": isc, "utc": ts})
    return out, len(raw)


def parse_receipts(path):
    """Return the stage-B ('RBD4') receipt records from the same file.

    Same 24-byte stride as parse(); blocks whose magic is not 'RBD4' are
    skipped, so 'RBD3' records and truncated tails are ignored. parse() is
    deliberately NOT touched: its return shape feeds verdict() and
    persist_verdict(), whose rc semantics must not move.
    """
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        return []
    raw = io.open(path, "rb").read()
    out = []
    for off in range(0, len(raw) - REC_SIZE + 1, REC_SIZE):
        m, seq, why, skip, epoch, qst = struct.unpack_from("<6I", raw, off)
        if m != MAGIC_RECEIPT:
            continue
        out.append({"seq": seq, "why": why, "skip": skip,
                    "epoch": epoch, "stop_tick_status": qst})
    return out


def pair_view(recs, receipts):
    """Align stage A (dispatch, 'RBD3') and stage B (receipt, 'RBD4') by seq.

    Returns one dict per seq seen in either stream:
      persisted-attempted        both kinds present -> the dispatch reached the
                                 persist branch (why/skip are in the receipt)
      dispatched-no-receipt      'RBD3' only -> non-control device, IRQL at
                                 dispatch > PASSIVE, or power loss mid-write
      receipt-without-dispatch   'RBD4' only -> IMPOSSIBLE by construction
                                 (the receipt is written after stage A bumped
                                 this very seq), reported as a WARN
    """
    disp = {}
    for r in recs:
        disp[r["total"]] = disp.get(r["total"], 0) + 1
    recp = {}
    for x in receipts:
        recp[x["seq"]] = recp.get(x["seq"], 0) + 1
    pairs = []
    for seq in sorted(set(disp) | set(recp)):
        d = disp.get(seq, 0)
        r = recp.get(seq, 0)
        if d and r:
            state = "persisted-attempted"
        elif d:
            state = "dispatched-no-receipt"
        elif r:
            state = "receipt-without-dispatch"
        else:                                   # unreachable: seq came from one
            state = "unknown"                   # of the two maps above
        pairs.append({"seq": seq, "dispatch": d, "receipt": r,
                      "state": state})
    return pairs


def verdict(total, recs, raw_size):
    n = len(recs)
    if total == 0 and n == 0:
        return 3, "NO DELIVERY EVIDENCE (reg=0, no sentinel records)"
    if total > 0 and n == total:
        return 0, ("DELIVERED + SHUTDOWN FILE I/O WORKS "
                   "(reg=%d, records=%d)" % (total, n))
    if total > 0 and n < total:
        return 4, ("DELIVERED BUT FILE I/O DEAD/PARTIAL "
                   "(reg=%d, records=%d, missing=%d)" % (total, n, total - n))
    if total == 0 and n > 0:
        return 4, ("INCONSISTENT: sentinel records without registry total "
                   "(reg=0, records=%d)" % n)
    return 4, ("INCONSISTENT: reg=%d, records=%d, raw=%d B"
               % (total, n, raw_size))


def fmt_reg(entry, fmtstr="%d"):
    """Render a (present, value) pair; ABSENT stays visibly distinct from 0."""
    present, value = entry
    return (fmtstr % value) if present else "ABSENT"


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--path", default=SENTINEL,
                    help="sentinel file (default: %s)" % SENTINEL)
    ap.add_argument("--expect", type=int, default=0,
                    help="expected dispatch count since the baseline (0=derive)")
    ap.add_argument("--baseline", type=int, default=None,
                    help="previous DiagShutdownSeq; enables NOT_REACHED "
                         "detection (default: derive from markers)")
    ap.add_argument("--json", action="store_true",
                    help="emit one stable JSON object instead of text")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    # One registry snapshot only: a second read of DiagShutdownSeq could land
    # after a concurrent shutdown and disagree with the JSON we emit.
    state = read_state()
    total = state["DiagShutdownSeq"][1] if state["DiagShutdownSeq"][0] else 0
    recs, raw_size = parse(a.path)
    receipts = parse_receipts(a.path)
    pairs = pair_view(recs, receipts)
    rc, name, reason, warns, pdetail = persist_verdict(
        total, recs, state, a.baseline, receipts)
    dispatch_rc, dispatch_msg = verdict(total, recs, raw_size)

    flags_present, flags_val = state["Flags"]
    l2_on = (bool(flags_val & FLAG_L2) if flags_present else None)
    n_ctl = len([r for r in recs if r["is_control"] == 1])

    if a.json:
        doc = {
            "tool": "read_shutdown_sentinel",
            "schema": 3,
            "sentinel": {"path": a.path, "size": raw_size,
                         "records": len(recs)},
            "registry": dict((k, {"present": p, "value": v})
                             for k, (p, v) in sorted(state.items())),
            "flags": {"value": flags_val if flags_present else None,
                      "l2_enabled": l2_on},
            "baseline": a.baseline,
            "dispatch": {"verdict": dispatch_msg, "rc": dispatch_rc,
                         "control_records": n_ctl},
            "persist": {"verdict": name, "rc": rc, "reason": reason,
                        "code": pdetail["code"],
                        "pair": {"why_prev": pdetail["why_prev"],
                                 "skip_prev": pdetail["skip_prev"]}},
            "warnings": warns,
            "records": recs,
            "receipts": receipts,
            "pairs": pairs,
            "notes": [
                "LastCleanShutdown is force-cleared on every boot "
                "(rbdriver.c:346); it reads 0 even after a clean shutdown "
                "and is never used as evidence.",
                "Features\\Flags & 0x4 == 0 means L2 is off; a missing or "
                "4-byte .idx is then normal, not a save failure.",
                "DiagShutdownSeq is a non-atomic read-modify-write (268 B7); "
                "backwards motion is a WARN, not a FAIL.",
                "The verdict is built ONLY from (ShutdownPersistWhyPrev, "
                "PersistSkipReasonPrev); those are the values the driver "
                "copies across before resetting the live keys "
                "(rbdriver.c:354-369). LastCleanWithheld and LastCleanShutdown "
                "are boot-reset and are printed for reference only.",
                "rc 0 requires the literal CLEAN pair. ALREADY (latch DONE) is "
                "reported as DEGRADED on purpose: it proves an earlier "
                "dispatch wrote clean, not that this shutdown did.",
            ],
        }
        print(json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True))
        return rc

    print("=" * 70)
    print("  DIAG B2-3  SHUTDOWN MARKERS (read-only)")
    print("=" * 70)
    print("  registry DiagShutdownSeq : %d" % total)
    print("  sentinel file            : %s" % a.path)
    print("  sentinel size / records  : %d B / %d" % (raw_size, len(recs)))
    for r in recs:
        print("    total=%-3d irql=%-2d isControl=%d utc=%s"
              % (r["total"], r["irql"], r["is_control"], r["utc"]))
    if a.expect:
        print("  expected dispatches      : %d" % a.expect)
        if total < a.expect:
            print("  [WARN] registry total is BELOW expectation")

    # ---- stage B: persist receipts ('RBD4'). INFO ONLY, never affects rc. ----
    print("")
    print("  --- receipts ('RBD4') ---")
    if not receipts:
        print("    <none>")
    for x in receipts:
        print("    seq=%d why=0x%02X skip=%d epoch=0x%08x qst=0x%08x"
              % (x["seq"], x["why"], x["skip"], x["epoch"],
                 x["stop_tick_status"]))
    print("  --- pairing: dispatch 'RBD3' vs receipt 'RBD4' (shared seq) ---")
    if not pairs:
        print("    <none>")
    n_pa = n_dn = n_wo = 0
    for pr in pairs:
        if pr["state"] == "persisted-attempted":
            n_pa += 1
        elif pr["state"] == "dispatched-no-receipt":
            n_dn += 1
        elif pr["state"] == "receipt-without-dispatch":
            n_wo += 1
        print("    seq=%-3d dispatch=%s receipt=%s -> %s"
              % (pr["seq"],
                 "Y(%d)" % pr["dispatch"] if pr["dispatch"] else "N",
                 "Y(%d)" % pr["receipt"] if pr["receipt"] else "N",
                 pr["state"]))
        if pr["state"] == "receipt-without-dispatch":
            print("      [WARN] receipt without dispatch for seq=%d -- this is "
                  "IMPOSSIBLE by construction (the receipt is appended only on "
                  "the control-device persist branch, i.e. after stage A "
                  "bumped this very seq). Treat as a driver bug: file "
                  "corrupted / tail overwritten by another writer / two boots "
                  "sharing one seq." % pr["seq"])
    print("    summary: %d persisted-attempted / %d dispatched-no-receipt / "
          "%d receipt-without-dispatch%s"
          % (n_pa, n_dn, n_wo,
             "  [WARN] receipt-without-dispatch is impossible" if n_wo else ""))
    print("    [INFO] receipts are informational only and never change the "
          "exit code below.")

    print("")
    print("  DISPATCH VERDICT (legacy rc=%d): %s"
          % (dispatch_rc, dispatch_msg))
    print("    reg advanced, file matches -> IRP delivered AND shutdown file I/O OK")
    print("    reg advanced, file short   -> IRP delivered but shutdown file I/O dead")
    print("    reg unchanged              -> IRP not delivered to this device")
    print("  NOTE: compare record UTC stamps with System log 1074 / Kernel-Power 109")
    print("        to attribute each record to Reboot vs Shutdown Off.")

    print("")
    print("  -- persistent outcome (v3 PAIR; authoritative, exit code follows) --")
    print("  ShutdownPersistWhyPrev   : %s"
          % fmt_reg(state["ShutdownPersistWhyPrev"], "0x%02X"))
    print("  PersistSkipReasonPrev    : %s"
          % fmt_reg(state["PersistSkipReasonPrev"], "0x%08X"))
    print("  ShutdownPersistWhy       : %s  (this boot's value, reset to 0xFF "
          "by RbBootFailLoad; NOT evidence)"
          % fmt_reg(state["ShutdownPersistWhy"], "0x%02X"))
    print("  PersistSkipReason        : %s  (same: boot-reset, NOT evidence)"
          % fmt_reg(state["PersistSkipReason"], "0x%08X"))
    # T1: both of these are wiped on every boot, so neither can be judged on.
    print("  LastCleanWithheld        : %s  (boot-reset to 0 at rbdriver.c:381; "
          "printed for reference only)" % fmt_reg(state["LastCleanWithheld"]))
    print("  LastCleanShutdown        : %s  (boot-reset at rbdriver.c:346; "
          "reference only)" % fmt_reg(state["LastCleanShutdown"]))
    print("  BootFailCount            : %s" % fmt_reg(state["BootFailCount"]))
    print("  BootReachedUser          : %s" % fmt_reg(state["BootReachedUser"]))
    if flags_present:
        print("  Features\\Flags           : 0x%x  (L2 %s%s)"
              % (flags_val, "ON" if l2_on else "OFF",
                 "" if l2_on else ": missing .idx is expected, not a failure"))
    else:
        print("  Features\\Flags           : ABSENT  (L2 state unknown)")
    print("  control-device records   : %d" % n_ctl)
    print("  PERSIST CODE             : %s" % pdetail["code"])
    print("  PERSIST VERDICT          : %s (rc=%d)" % (name, rc))
    print("    %s" % reason)
    for w in warns:
        print("  [WARN] %s" % w)
    print("  [NOTE] LastCleanShutdown / LastCleanWithheld are both 0 after "
          "boot by")
    print("         design and are never used as evidence; absence of .idx is "
          "not a")
    print("         save failure when L2 is off.")
    print("=" * 70)
    return rc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

##### `src/scripts/restart_bridge.ps1`

````powershell
# restart_bridge.ps1 -- ONE UAC: reload the user-mode bridge so the TinyLFU
# config-chain fix (proto-decode.ts decodeConfig / index.ts encodeParams) is
# loaded into the live process. Verifies GET_CONFIG returns 24 fields incl TinyLFU.
# 2026-11-06. Log: C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy\restart-bridge.log
# Does NOT touch driver config, registry values, Verifier, or reboot the machine.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
$pr = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($id)
if (-not $pr.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) {
    Write-Host '[X] must run elevated (bridge node runs as SYSTEM)'
    exit 1
}
$logDir = 'C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $logDir -Force | Out-Null }
$log = Join-Path $logDir 'restart-bridge.log'
function L([string]$m) {
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $log -Value ("[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), $m)
}
'' | Set-Content -LiteralPath $log

$healthUri = 'http://127.0.0.1:5199/rb/health'
$rpcUri    = 'http://127.0.0.1:5199/rb/rpc'

# ---- 1) current bridge pid (H-5: a DOWN bridge is RECOVERABLE, not fatal) ----
$healthOk = $true
try { $h = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $healthUri -TimeoutSec 6 }
catch {
    $healthOk = $false
    L ("HEALTH FAILED (bridge DOWN): " + $_.Exception.Message)
}

if (-not $healthOk) {
    # This script is the elevated wrapper; the SYSTEM/ONSTART task is the
    # supported way to bring the bridge back when BOTH node and keeper died.
    L 'bridge DOWN -> schtasks /Run /TN RAMBlockCacheBridge, then bounded re-check'
    $runOut = & schtasks /Run /TN RAMBlockCacheBridge
    L ("schtasks /Run exit=" + $LASTEXITCODE + " :: " + ($runOut -join ' '))
    $h = $null
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 15; $i++) {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        try {
            $hr = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $healthUri -TimeoutSec 4
            if ($hr) { $h = $hr; break }
        } catch { }
    }
    if ($null -eq $h) {
        L 'RECOVERY FAILED: bridge still DOWN after schtasks /Run'
        Write-Host '[X] bridge DOWN and the scheduled task did not recover it.'
        Write-Host '    Check: schtasks /Query /TN RAMBlockCacheBridge /V'
        Write-Host '           keeper in C:\ProgramData\rb-bridge, src/ui/web\dist\index.html present.'
        Write-Host '    Then re-run this script (no reboot / no driver change needed).'
        exit 1
    }
    $newPid = [int]$h.pid
    L ("recovered from DOWN: pid=" + $newPid + " (fresh process; skip kill/relaunch)")
} else {
    $oldPid = [int]$h.pid
    L ("before: pid={0} node={1} native={2}" -f $oldPid, $h.node, $h.native)

    # ---- 2) stop it (keeper in C:\ProgramData\rb-bridge checks 5199 every 5s
    #         and relaunches node from the repo src/ui/web/ directory) ----
    try { Stop-Process -Id $oldPid -Force -ErrorAction Stop; L ("stopped pid=" + $oldPid) }
    catch { L ("STOP FAILED: " + $_.Exception.Message); exit 1 }

    # ---- 3) wait for the new process (bounded check, not a retry loop) ----
    $newPid = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 25; $i++) {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        try {
            $h2 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $healthUri -TimeoutSec 4
            if ([int]$h2.pid -ne $oldPid) { $newPid = [int]$h2.pid; break }
        } catch { }
    }
    if ($newPid -eq 0) { L 'BRIDGE DID NOT COME BACK (keeper may be stopped)'; exit 1 }
    L ("after: pid=" + $newPid)
}

# ---- 4) verify the live GET_CONFIG decoder ----
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
try {
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri $rpcUri -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"method":4}' -TimeoutSec 8
    $d = $r.data
    $n = @($d.PSObject.Properties).Count
    $tl = $d.TinyLFU
    L ("GET_CONFIG: fields={0} TinyLFU={1} status={2}" -f $n, $tl, $r.status)
    if ($n -ne 24 -or $null -eq $tl) { L 'VERIFY FAILED: expected 24 fields with TinyLFU'; exit 1 }
} catch { L ("RPC FAILED: " + $_.Exception.Message); exit 1 }

L 'ALL OK (bridge reloaded; config chain fixed; driver config untouched)'
Write-Host '=== bridge restart OK ==='
exit 0
````

chcp 65001 >nul
REM run_diskspd.cmd - launcher wrapper for run_diskspd.ps1 (self-elevate + invoke).

##### `src/scripts/run_diskspd.ps1`

````powershell
# run_diskspd.ps1 —— diskspd 冒烟：非缓存基线 -> attach F/D -> 全类型 -> detach 校验脏=0
# 前置：驱动已安装并 attach；diskspd.exe 在 PATH 或 -Diskspd 路径。
# 错误处理约定（规格书 D.3）：$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'，失败不静默、以非零码退出。
# 此行与 rb_common.ps1 内的同名设置等价；显式声明保证公共库缺失时也 fail-closed。
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'rb_common.ps1')
Assert-Admin

$ctl     = Join-Path $ProjectRoot 'ctl\ramboostctl.exe'   # 若已编译
$diskspd = 'diskspd.exe'
$work    = 'F:\rbsmoke.bin'

# [FIX S-06] Run-Diskspd 参数化：附加参数数组 splat，写比例由调用方显式传入。
# 旧代码把 -replace 作用在文件路径上（本意是从参数串去掉 -w70 写比例），
# 结果 "CACHED random read-only" 一轮实为与 70/30 完全相同的混合压测——
# 基准标签造假，结论不可信。read-only 显式 -w0（0% 写 = 纯读）。
function Run-Diskspd($label, $path, [string[]]$ExtraArgs = @()) {
    Write-Host "`n===== $label ====="
    $dargs = @('-c2G', '-t4', '-o8', '-b64K', '-Suw', '-d10') + $ExtraArgs + @($path)
    & $diskspd @dargs
}

# 1) 基线：未缓存（驱动 attach 前 / 先 detach）
Write-Host '[step1] 非缓存基线（先 detach）...'
if (Test-Path $ctl) { & $ctl detach F; & $ctl detach D }
Run-Diskspd 'BASELINE (uncached)' $work @('-w70')

# 2) 热 attach F/D（免重启，立即生效）
Write-Host '[step2] attach F/D ...'
if (Test-Path $ctl) { & $ctl attach F; & $ctl attach D } else { Write-Host '  (ctl 未编译：请用 WPF/ctl 对 F,D 执行 ATTACH_VOLUME)' }

# 3) 全类型压测（读/写/混合）
Run-Diskspd 'CACHED random 70/30' $work @('-w70')
# [FIX S-06] read-only 显式 -w0：纯读压测，不再借道路径字符串替换。
Run-Diskspd 'CACHED random read-only' $work @('-w0')

# 4) detach 并校验脏=0（回写型卷 detach 前驱动已 flush）
Write-Host '[step4] detach F/D ...'
if (Test-Path $ctl) {
    & $ctl detach F
    & $ctl detach D
    Write-Host '[check] GET_STATS -> DirtyBytes 应为 0（detach 已回写）'
    & $ctl status
}
Write-Host '冒烟结束。'
Read-Host '按回车关闭'
````
