````powershell
# set_node27_path.ps1 -- pin Node 27 + npm 12.2.1 GLOBALLY (Machine + User PATH).
# 2026-11-06, user decision "system path too, all built in".
# Requires elevation (Machine scope). Run via RB-finalize-node27.cmd.
# Log: C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy\node27-path.log
param([string]$Node27 = 'D:\node-v27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0-win-x64')
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
$pr = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal($id)
if (-not $pr.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) {
    Write-Host '[X] must run elevated (Machine PATH)'
    exit 1
}
$logDir = 'C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $logDir -Force | Out-Null }
$log = Join-Path $logDir 'node27-path.log'
function L([string]$m) {
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $log -Value ("[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), $m)
}
'' | Set-Content -LiteralPath $log

$nodeExe = Join-Path $Node27 'node.exe'
$npmCli  = Join-Path $Node27 'node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $nodeExe) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $npmCli)) {
    L ("MISSING node27 toolchain at " + $Node27); exit 1
}
$nv = (& $nodeExe --version 2>$null)
$np = (& $nodeExe $npmCli --version --loglevel=error 2>$null | Select-Object -Last 1)
if ("$nv" -notlike 'v27.*' -or "$np" -notlike '12.2.1*') {
    L ("BAD TOOLCHAIN node=$nv npm=$np"); exit 1
}
L ("toolchain OK: node=$nv npm=$np dir=$Node27")

$target = $Node27.TrimEnd('\')
foreach ($scope in @('Machine', 'User')) {
    $cur = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', $scope)
    if (-not $cur) { $cur = '' }
    $parts = @()
    foreach ($p in ($cur -split ';')) {
        if (-not $p) { continue }
        if ($p.TrimEnd('\') -ieq $target) { continue }   # de-dup, we re-add at front
        if ($p.StartsWith(':\')) { $p = 'C' + $p }        # repair known broken drive letter
        $parts += $p
    }
    $new = (@($Node27) + $parts) -join ';'
    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', $new, $scope)
    L ("[$scope] PATH len " + $cur.Length + " -> " + $new.Length + "; head=" + $Node27)
}
foreach ($scope in @('Machine', 'User')) {
    $back = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', $scope)
    if (-not $back.StartsWith($Node27)) { L ("[$scope] VERIFY FAILED: " + $back.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(80, $back.Length))); exit 1 }
    L ("[$scope] verify OK")
}
L 'ALL OK (new terminals pick up Node 27 + npm 12.2.1)'
Write-Host '=== Node 27 global PATH OK ==='
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/shutdown_experiment_report.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
r"""One-shot shutdown experiment report (report 267).

STRICTLY READ-ONLY with respect to the machine, except for writing its own
report files under C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy. Never touches driver state,
registry values, L2 files, flags, or power configuration.

Why this exists: the user asked to batch every experiment that needs a
power cycle into ONE pass, and to remove all command-line work afterwards.
This script aggregates EVERYTHING that is only observable after boot:

  1. registry DiagShutdownSeq            (synchronous marker 1)
  2. shutdown-sentinel.bin records      (synchronous marker 2)
  3. Windows System events 1074 / 109 / 13  -> attribute each record to
     'Power Action Reboot' vs 'Power Action Shutdown Off' vs hybrid
  4. driver log 'diag: IRP_MJ_SHUTDOWN seen' lines  (best-effort only;
     report 263 proved RbLog is an in-memory ring and may lose last lines)
  5. HiberbootEnabled (informational: was hybrid shutdown even possible)

Three-way verdict is delegated to read_shutdown_sentinel.py (report 264).
Event-log attribution is FAIL-SOFT: if the event query is unavailable, the
verdict still stands and records are labelled UNATTRIBUTED.

EXIT
  0 = verdict code 0 (delivered + shutdown file I/O works), >=1 record
  3 = no delivery evidence
  4 = partial / inconsistent evidence (needs human review)
  2 = could not run (unexpected error)
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import glob
import io
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import winreg

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import read_shutdown_sentinel as s

REPORT_DIR = r"C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy"
LOG_DIR = r"C:\ProgramData\RAMBlockCache\logs"
PWSH = r"C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe"
HYBER_KEY = r"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power"
HYBER_VAL = "HiberbootEnabled"

# Boot of the currently deployed v2 diagnostic image (report 266). Driver-log
# lines older than this belong to the PREVIOUS image and are NOT evidence for
# this experiment - they are still printed, explicitly labelled historical.
DEPLOY_BOOT_UTC = "2026-11-15T17:41:19Z"


def utc_naive():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)


PS_EVENTS = r'''
$ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$OutputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding
$start = (Get-Date).AddHours(-12)
$e = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=1074,109,13; StartTime=$start} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
foreach ($x in $e) {
  $m = ($x.Message -replace "`r?`n", ' ') -replace '\s+', ' '
  if ($m.Length -gt 300) { $m = $m.Substring(0, 300) }
  # Classify INSIDE the shell to avoid cross-process encoding damage.
  # Chinese 1074 messages use '关机类型: 重启' / '关机类型: 关机';
  # Kernel-Power 109 messages carry 'Power Action Reboot' / '... Shutdown'.
  $cnHybrid = [string][char]0x6DF7 + [string][char]0x5408
  $cnReboot = [string][char]0x91CD + [string][char]0x542F
  $cnShut   = [string][char]0x5173 + [string][char]0x673A
  $act = 'Unknown'
  if ($m -match '(?i)hybrid' -or $m.Contains($cnHybrid)) { $act = 'Hybrid' }
  elseif ($m -match '(?i)reboot' -or $m.Contains($cnReboot)) { $act = 'Reboot' }
  elseif ($m -match '(?i)shutdown' -or $m.Contains($cnShut)) { $act = 'ShutdownOff' }
  [pscustomobject]@{
    local = $x.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
    id = [int]$x.Id
    provider = [string]$x.ProviderName
    message = [string]$m
    action = $act
  } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
}
'''


def utc_now():
    return utc_naive().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def local_offset():
    """Local wall clock minus UTC, as a timedelta (handles DST at run time)."""
    return datetime.datetime.now() - utc_naive()


def to_local(utc_str):
    try:
        dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(utc_str, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
        return (dt + local_offset()).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return ""


def parse_local(text):
    try:
        return datetime.datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None


def query_events():
    """Return (events, note). Never raises; event log is optional evidence."""
    if not os.path.isfile(PWSH):
        return [], "event query skipped: pwsh 7 not found"
    try:
        r = subprocess.run([PWSH, "-NoProfile", "-Command", PS_EVENTS],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90,
                           encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        out = []
        for line in (r.stdout or "").splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if not line.startswith("{"):
                continue
            try:
                out.append(json.loads(line))
            except ValueError:
                continue
        if out:
            return out, "event query OK (%d events)" % len(out)
        tail = ((r.stderr or "").strip().splitlines() or [""])[-1][:160]
        return [], ("event query returned no rows; stderr=%s" % tail)
    except Exception as exc:
        return [], "event query unavailable: %s: %s" % (type(exc).__name__, exc)


def action_from_message(msg):
    m = msg or ""
    low = m.lower()
    if "hybrid" in low or "\u6df7\u5408" in m:
        return "Hybrid"
    if "reboot" in low or "\u91cd\u542f" in m:
        return "Reboot"
    if "shutdown off" in low or "\u5173\u95ed\u7535\u6e90" in m or "\u5173\u673a" in m:
        return "ShutdownOff"
    return "Unknown"


def attribute(local_str, events):
    """Nearest 1074/109 event within +/-180 s; 1074 preferred over 109."""
    t = parse_local(local_str)
    if t is None or not events:
        return "UNATTRIBUTED", ""
    best = None
    for e in events:
        if e.get("id") not in (1074, 109):
            continue
        et = parse_local(e.get("local", ""))
        if et is None:
            continue
        delta = abs((et - t).total_seconds())
        if delta > 180:
            continue
        # Prefer an event the shell could classify, then 1074, then nearest.
        act = e.get("action") or "Unknown"
        if act in ("Unknown", "UNATTRIBUTED", ""):
            act = action_from_message(e.get("message", ""))
        rank = (0 if act not in ("Unknown", "UNATTRIBUTED", "") else 1,
                0 if e["id"] == 1074 else 1, delta)
        if best is None or rank < best[0]:
            best = (rank, e, act)
    if best is None:
        return "UNATTRIBUTED", ""
    e, act = best[1], best[2]
    return act, e.get("message", "")[:120]


def driver_diag_lines():
    """Best-effort cross evidence only; absence proves nothing (report 263)."""
    out = []
    try:
        files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(LOG_DIR, "driver-*.log")),
                       key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True)[:2]
        for p in files:
            with io.open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                for line in f:
                    if "diag: IRP_MJ_SHUTDOWN seen" in line:
                        stamp = line[:19]
                        era = ("current" if stamp >= DEPLOY_BOOT_UTC
                               else "historical")
                        out.append({"file": os.path.basename(p),
                                    "line": line.strip()[:220],
                                    "era": era})
    except Exception as exc:
        out.append({"file": "-", "line": "log read failed: %s" % exc})
    return out[-12:]


def hiberboot_enabled():
    try:
        k = winreg.OpenKey(winreg.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, HYBER_KEY, 0,
                           winreg.KEY_READ)
        try:
            return int(winreg.QueryValueEx(k, HYBER_VAL)[0])
        finally:
            winreg.CloseKey(k)
    except OSError:
        return None


def group_dispatches(recs):
    """One UTC second == one shutdown transition (report 268).

    The v2 probe is wired to MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_SHUTDOWN] for EVERY device
    object, so a single shutdown transition enters the dispatch more than once
    (control device + volume filter devices). read_shutdown_sentinel.verdict()
    assumes one record per transition and therefore reports INCONSISTENT.
    This function groups by timestamp WITHOUT changing that original verdict.
    """
    groups = {}
    for r in recs:
        g = groups.setdefault(r["utc"], {"utc": r["utc"], "count": 0,
                                         "control": 0, "volume": 0,
                                         "irqls": set(), "totals": set()})
        g["count"] += 1
        if r["is_control"] == 1:
            g["control"] += 1
        else:
            g["volume"] += 1
        g["irqls"].add(r["irql"])
        g["totals"].add(r["total"])
    out = []
    for key in sorted(groups):
        g = groups[key]
        g["irqls"] = sorted(g["irqls"])
        g["totals"] = sorted(g["totals"])
        out.append(g)
    return out


def corrected_reading(total, recs, groups):
    """Read-only interpretation layer; does NOT alter verdict() or its rc."""
    if total == 0 and not recs:
        return "NO DELIVERY EVIDENCE (clean baseline unchanged)"
    if not recs:
        return ("INCONCLUSIVE: registry advanced to %d but no sentinel "
                "records -> file I/O unavailable at shutdown" % total)
    n = len(groups)
    ctrl = sum(1 for r in recs if r["is_control"] == 1)
    return ("DELIVERED + SHUTDOWN FILE I/O WORKS: %d distinct shutdown "
            "transition(s), %d synchronous FILE_WRITE_THROUGH records "
            "(%d control-device, %d volume-filter), registry total=%d. "
            "NOTE: one transition enters the dispatch multiple times, so the "
            "raw verdict() rc=4 is a B5 tool-assumption artefact, not data "
            "corruption. v2 must gate persistence on dev==ControlDevice "
            "(no static latch - report 259 F2)." % (n, len(recs), ctrl,
                                                   len(recs) - ctrl, total))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true",
                    help="read-only dry run: print, write NO report files")
    ap.add_argument("--no-events", action="store_true",
                    help="skip the optional Windows event query (fast)")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    total = s.reg_total()
    recs, raw_size = s.parse(s.SENTINEL)
    rc, msg = s.verdict(total, recs, raw_size)

    events, event_note = ([], "event query skipped by flag") \
        if (a.check or a.no_events) else query_events()

    for r in recs:
        r["local"] = to_local(r["utc"])
        action, ev = attribute(r["local"], events)
        r["action"] = action
        r["event"] = ev

    coverage = {
        "Reboot": any(r["action"] == "Reboot" for r in recs),
        "ShutdownOff": any(r["action"] == "ShutdownOff" for r in recs),
        "Hybrid": any(r["action"] == "Hybrid" for r in recs),
        "Unattributed": any(r["action"] in ("UNATTRIBUTED", "Unknown")
                            for r in recs),
    }

    groups = group_dispatches(recs)
    corrected = corrected_reading(total, recs, groups)
    diag = driver_diag_lines()
    hiber = hiberboot_enabled()

    notes = [
        "Three-way verdict relies ONLY on the two synchronous markers; "
        "event attribution and driver log are supplementary.",
        "Driver log lines are best-effort: report 263 proved RbLog is an "
        "in-memory ring drained by IOCTL_RB_LOGQ, so absence is NOT evidence "
        "of non-delivery.",
        "This build is OBSERVATIONAL ONLY: it performs no production "
        "shutdown persistence. B2 / J6 remain open regardless of this verdict.",
        "Hybrid (Fast Startup) is NOT covered when HiberbootEnabled=0 or "
        "absent; report 263 Q2 remains unanswered in that case.",
        "Driver-log lines older than %s are labelled 'historical': they came "
        "from the previous diagnostic image and are NOT this batch's evidence."
        % DEPLOY_BOOT_UTC,
        "B5 (report 268): verdict() assumes one sentinel record per shutdown "
        "transition. The v2 dispatch is registered for EVERY device object, "
        "so one transition yields several records. verdict() rc=4 is a tool "
        "assumption artefact; group_dispatches()/corrected_reading() are "
        "READ-ONLY interpretation and do NOT change the original verdict.",
    ]
    if event_note:
        notes.append("Event log: " + event_note)

    report = {
        "report": "267 shutdown experiment one-shot verdict",
        "utc_now": utc_now(),
        "mode": "check" if a.check else "run",
        "registry_total": total,
        "sentinel_path": s.SENTINEL,
        "sentinel_size": raw_size,
        "records": recs,
        "verdict_code": rc,
        "verdict": msg,
        "dispatch_groups": groups,
        "corrected_reading": corrected,
        "coverage": coverage,
        "hiberboot_enabled": hiber,
        "events_found": len(events),
        "driver_diag_lines": diag,
        "notes": notes,
    }

    print("=" * 72)
    print("  RAMBlockCache  SHUTDOWN EXPERIMENT  ONE-SHOT VERDICT  (read-only)")
    print("=" * 72)
    print("  utc now            : %s" % report["utc_now"])
    print("  DiagShutdownSeq    : %d" % total)
    print("  sentinel           : %d B / %d records" % (raw_size, len(recs)))
    print("  HiberbootEnabled   : %s" % ("0 (hybrid OFF)" if hiber == 0
                                        else str(hiber)))
    print("  Windows events     : %d  (%s)" % (len(events), event_note[:80]))
    print("")
    if recs:
        print("  -- records (UTC -> local, attributed action) --")
        for r in recs:
            print("    total=%-3d irql=%-2d ctrl=%d %s -> %s  [%s]"
                  % (r["total"], r["irql"], r["is_control"], r["utc"],
                     r["local"], r["action"]))
            if r["event"]:
                print("      event: %s" % r["event"])
    else:
        print("  -- no sentinel records yet (clean baseline) --")
    print("")
    print("  -- coverage --")
    for k, v in coverage.items():
        print("    %-14s %s" % (k, "YES" if v else "no"))
    print("")
    print("  -- dispatch groups (one UTC second = one shutdown transition) --")
    for g in groups:
        print("    %s  count=%-2d control=%-2d volume=%-2d irql=%s totals=%s"
              % (g["utc"], g["count"], g["control"], g["volume"],
                 g["irqls"], g["totals"]))
    if not groups:
        print("    (none)")
    print("")
    print("  -- driver log diag lines (best-effort, %d) --" % len(diag))
    for d in diag[-6:]:
        print("    [%s] %s | %s" % (d.get("era", "?"), d["file"],
                                    d["line"][:120]))
    print("")
    print("  VERDICT (%d): %s" % (rc, msg))
    print("    0 = delivered + shutdown file I/O works")
    print("    3 = no delivery evidence   4 = partial / inconsistent")
    print("")
    print("  CORRECTED READING (read-only; original verdict/rc unchanged):")
    print("    %s" % corrected)
    print("=" * 72)

    if a.check:
        print("  [check mode] no report file written")
        return rc

    stamp = utc_naive().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    jpath = os.path.join(REPORT_DIR, "shutdown-verdict-%s.json" % stamp)
    tpath = os.path.join(REPORT_DIR, "shutdown-verdict-%s.txt" % stamp)
    with io.open(jpath, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    with io.open(tpath, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write("VERDICT (%d): %s\n\n" % (rc, msg))
        f.write("CORRECTED READING: %s\n\n" % corrected)
        f.write("registry_total=%d  sentinel=%d B / %d records\n"
                % (total, raw_size, len(recs)))
        f.write("HiberbootEnabled=%s  events=%d\n\n" % (hiber, len(events)))
        f.write("dispatch groups:\n")
        for g in groups:
            f.write("  %s count=%d control=%d volume=%d irqls=%s totals=%s\n"
                    % (g["utc"], g["count"], g["control"], g["volume"],
                       g["irqls"], g["totals"]))
        f.write("\n")
        for r in recs:
            f.write("  total=%d utc=%s local=%s action=%s\n"
                    % (r["total"], r["utc"], r["local"], r["action"]))
        f.write("\ncoverage: %s\n\n" % json.dumps(coverage))
        for n in notes:
            f.write("NOTE: %s\n" % n)
    print("  evidence JSON : %s" % jpath)
    print("  summary  TXT  : %s" % tpath)
    print("  Send me only the phrase 'verdict ready'; I read these files.")
    return rc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except Exception as exc:
        print("*** FATAL: %s: %s" % (type(exc).__name__, exc))
        sys.exit(2)
````

##### `src/scripts/sign_driver.ps1`

````powershell
# sign_driver.ps1 - sign the freshly built RAMBlockCache.sys, install it into
# dist\, write the sidecar, then re-sync the three deploy anchors.
#
# WHY (report 252, 2026-11-15): the A-batch patch (report 251) compiles and
# passes core/gates, but the deliverable is only "signable", not signed. Two
# hard constraints force this into a separate, elevated step:
#   1. signtool needs the LocalMachine\My private key  => must be elevated.
#   2. signtool plus PKCS#7 over a CJK path has failed on this host before
#      => sign in an ASCII stage directory, then copy back.
#
# Contract (all fail-closed):
#   * If signing, verification, or the Authenticode status check fails, dist\
#     is NOT touched.
#   * If the anchor sync fails AFTER dist\ was replaced, the previous binary
#     and sidecar are restored and the anchors are re-synced back, so the tree
#     never stays in a half-signed state (a half-signed tree makes deploy.ps1
#     fail closed and leaves the operator without a clear exit).
#   * No deploy, no service control, no registry write, no reboot. Deployment
#     stays a separate, explicitly approved step.
#
# Usage:
#   deliverables\RB-sign-driver.cmd              (self-elevating wrapper)
#   pwsh -File src\scripts\sign_driver.ps1 -Check   (read-only preflight)
#
# Exit: 0 = signed + anchors synced + read-back verified
#       1 = aborted (dist\ restored if it had been touched)
#       2 = aborted before any change (environment problem)

param(
    [string]$Sys = "",
    [string]$Thumbprint = 'DF1A0ADA2F2CD6E5778EA937C079CB0A035BA431',
    [string]$StageDir = 'C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy\sign-stage',
    [switch]$Check,
    [switch]$KeepStage
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$script:LogLines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$script:LogPath = $null
$script:DistTouched = $false
$script:BackupSys = $null
$script:BackupSidecar = $null
$script:DistSys = $null
$script:Sidecar = $null
$script:NewSha = $null
$script:OldSha = $null
$script:OldSidecarText = $null

function Say([string]$Text, [string]$Tag = 'info') {
    $line = ('[{0,-5}] {1}' -f $Tag, $Text)
    Write-Host $line
    $script:LogLines.Add($line)
}

function Flush-Log {
    if (-not $script:LogPath) { return }
    try {
        [IO.File]::WriteAllLines($script:LogPath, $script:LogLines.ToArray(),
            (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    } catch { }
}

function Get-Sha256Hex([string]$Path) {
    $sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    $fs = $null
    try {
        $fs = [IO.File]::Open($Path, [IO.FileMode]::Open, [IO.FileAccess]::Read,
            [IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
        return ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($fs)) -replace '-', '').ToLower()
    } finally {
        if ($fs) { $fs.Dispose() }
        $sha.Dispose()
    }
}

function Find-RepoRoot([string]$Start) {
    $d = $Start
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 8 -and $d; $i++) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'build\build.ps1')) { return $d }
        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $d
        if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $d) { break }
        $d = $parent
    }
    return $null
}

function Resolve-SignTool {
    $c = Get-Command signtool.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($c) { return $c.Source }
    $pf86 = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ProgramFiles(x86)')
    $pf = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ProgramFiles')
    $roots = @()
    if ($pf86) { $roots += (Join-Path $pf86 'Windows Kits\10\bin') }
    if ($pf) { $roots += (Join-Path $pf 'Windows Kits\10\bin') }
    foreach ($r in $roots) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $r)) { continue }
        $hit = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $r -Recurse -Filter 'signtool.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.FullName -match '\\x64\\signtool\.exe$' } |
            Sort-Object FullName -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($hit) { return $hit.FullName }
    }
    return $null
}

function Restore-Dist {
    # Put the previous binary + sidecar back and re-anchor to the old hash.
    if (-not $script:DistTouched) { return }
    Say 'rollback: restoring the previous dist\ binary and sidecar' 'warn'
    try {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $script:BackupSys -Destination $script:DistSys -Force
        if ($null -ne $script:OldSidecarText) {
            [IO.File]::WriteAllText($script:Sidecar, $script:OldSidecarText,
                (New-Object System.Text.ASCIIEncoding))
        } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:Sidecar) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script:Sidecar -Force
        }
        $back = Get-Sha256Hex $script:DistSys
        if ($back -eq $script:OldSha) {
            Say ("rollback: dist\ restored, sha256=$back (matches the pre-sign hash)") 'ok'
        } else {
            Say ("rollback: dist\ restored but hash=$back != expected $($script:OldSha)") 'FAIL'
        }
        $sync = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'sync_anchors.ps1'
        $hostExe = (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path
        & $hostExe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $sync -Sys $script:DistSys
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            Say 'rollback: anchors re-synced to the restored binary' 'ok'
        } else {
            Say "rollback: anchor re-sync FAILED (exit $LASTEXITCODE) - tree needs manual fixing" 'FAIL'
        }
    } catch {
        Say "rollback: FAILED - $($_.Exception.Message)" 'FAIL'
    }
}

function Abort([string]$Message, [int]$Code = 1) {
    Say $Message 'FAIL'
    if ($Code -ne 2) { Restore-Dist }
    Flush-Log
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '=================================================================='
    if ($Code -eq 2) {
        Write-Host '  ABORTED BEFORE ANY CHANGE - dist\ and anchors untouched'
    } else {
        Write-Host '  SIGNING ABORTED - see the rollback lines above'
    }
    Write-Host '=================================================================='
    exit $Code
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ preamble
$root = Find-RepoRoot $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $root) {
    Write-Host '[FAIL ] cannot locate the repo root (no build\build.ps1 above src\scripts)'
    exit 2
}

$logDir = 'C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $logDir -Force | Out-Null
}
$stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')
$script:LogPath = Join-Path $logDir ('sign-driver-' + $stamp + '.log')

Write-Host '=================================================================='
Write-Host '  RAMBlockCache DRIVER SIGN + ANCHOR SYNC'
if ($Check) { Write-Host '  MODE: read-only preflight (nothing will be signed or copied)' }
else { Write-Host '  MODE: sign + install into dist\ + re-sync anchors (no deploy)' }
Write-Host '=================================================================='
Write-Host ''

Say "repo     : $root"
Say "log      : $($script:LogPath)"
Say "utc      : $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- elevation
$isAdmin = $false
try {
    $isAdmin = (New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal(
        [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent())).IsInRole(
        [Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
} catch { }
Say ("elevated : {0}" -f $isAdmin)
if (-not $isAdmin -and -not $Check) {
    Abort 'not elevated - the LocalMachine\My private key is unreachable. Launch deliverables\RB-sign-driver.cmd instead.' 2
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- source sys
if (-not $Sys) { $Sys = Join-Path $root 'src\driver\x64\Release\RAMBlockCache.sys' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Sys)) {
    Abort "source sys not found: $Sys (run: build\build.ps1 -Target driver)" 2
}
$srcSize = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $Sys).Length
$srcSha = Get-Sha256Hex $Sys
Say "source   : $Sys"
Say ("           {0:N0} B   sha256={1}" -f $srcSize, $srcSha)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- signtool
$signtool = Resolve-SignTool
if (-not $signtool) { Abort 'signtool.exe not found (PATH / Windows Kits)' 2 }
Say "signtool : $signtool"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- certificate
$cert = $null
try {
    $cert = Get-ChildItem Cert:\LocalMachine\My -ErrorAction Stop |
        Where-Object { $_.Thumbprint -eq $Thumbprint }
} catch {
    Say "cert store read failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'warn'
}
if (-not $cert) {
    Abort "signing cert not found in LocalMachine\My (thumbprint $Thumbprint)" 2
}
$certSubject = ($cert.Subject -replace '\s+', ' ')
Say "cert     : $certSubject"
Say ("           thumbprint=$($cert.Thumbprint)  NotAfter=$($cert.NotAfter)  HasPrivateKey=$($cert.HasPrivateKey)")
if (-not $cert.HasPrivateKey) {
    Abort 'cert present but HasPrivateKey=False - the private key ACL or CSP is not available to this account' 2
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------- current dist
$distDir = Join-Path $root 'dist'
$script:DistSys = Join-Path $distDir 'RAMBlockCache.sys'
$script:Sidecar = "$($script:DistSys).sha256"
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:DistSys) {
    $script:OldSha = Get-Sha256Hex $script:DistSys
    Say "dist now : $($script:OldSha) ($((Get-Item -LiteralPath $script:DistSys).Length) B)"
} else {
    Say 'dist now : (absent)' 'warn'
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:Sidecar) {
    $script:OldSidecarText = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($script:Sidecar)
    Say ("sidecar  : {0}" -f ($script:OldSidecarText.Trim()))
} else {
    Say 'sidecar  : (absent)' 'warn'
}

if ($srcSha -eq $script:OldSha) {
    Say 'source hash == dist hash: this binary is ALREADY the signed deliverable' 'ok'
    if ($Check) {
        Say 'preflight complete - nothing to do' 'ok'
        Flush-Log
        exit 0
    }
}

if ($Check) {
    Say 'preflight OK: cert usable, signtool present, stage dir writable?' 'ok'
    $probe = Join-Path $StageDir '.probe'
    try {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $StageDir)) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $StageDir -Force | Out-Null
        }
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($probe, 'ok')
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $probe -Force
        Say "stage    : $StageDir (writable)" 'ok'
    } catch {
        Say "stage    : $StageDir NOT writable - $($_.Exception.Message)" 'FAIL'
        exit 2
    }
    Say 'preflight complete - nothing was signed, dist\ untouched' 'ok'
    Flush-Log
    exit 0
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------- stage
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $StageDir) {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $StageDir -Recurse -Force
}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $StageDir -Force | Out-Null
$staged = Join-Path $StageDir 'RAMBlockCache.sys'
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $Sys -Destination $staged -Force
Say "staged   : $staged"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- sign
Say "sign     : signtool sign /sm /s My /sha1 $Thumbprint /fd SHA256"
$prevEap = $ErrorActionPreference
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$signOut = & $signtool sign /sm /s My /sha1 $Thumbprint /fd SHA256 $staged 2>&1
$signRc = $LASTEXITCODE
$ErrorActionPreference = $prevEap
foreach ($o in @($signOut)) { if ("$o".Trim()) { Say "  sign| $o" } }
if ($signRc -ne 0) { Abort "signtool sign FAILED (exit $signRc)" 1 }

# -------------------------------------------------------------------- verify
Say 'verify   : signtool verify /pa /v'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$verOut = & $signtool verify /pa /v $staged 2>&1
$verRc = $LASTEXITCODE
$ErrorActionPreference = $prevEap
foreach ($o in @($verOut)) { if ("$o".Trim()) { Say "  vrfy| $o" } }
if ($verRc -ne 0) { Abort "signtool verify FAILED (exit $verRc)" 1 }

$authStatus = 'SIGNTOOL-ONLY'
if (Get-Command Get-AuthenticodeSignature -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    try {
        $a = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $staged
        $authStatus = "$($a.Status)"
        if ($a.Status -eq 'Valid') {
            Say ("authenti : Valid  signer={0}" -f ($a.SignerCertificate.Subject -replace '\s+', ' ')) 'ok'
        } else {
            Abort "Authenticode status=$($a.Status) on the staged binary" 1
        }
    } catch {
        Say "authenti : cmdlet check skipped - $($_.Exception.Message)" 'warn'
    }
} else {
    Say 'authenti : Get-AuthenticodeSignature unavailable; signtool /pa is the authoritative check' 'warn'
}

$signedSize = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $staged).Length
$signedSha = Get-Sha256Hex $staged
Say ("signed   : {0:N0} B  sha256={1}" -f $signedSize, $signedSha)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ dist swap
$bakDir = Join-Path $logDir ('sign-backup-' + $stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $bakDir -Force | Out-Null
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:DistSys) {
    $script:BackupSys = Join-Path $bakDir 'RAMBlockCache.sys'
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $script:DistSys -Destination $script:BackupSys -Force
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:Sidecar) {
    $script:BackupSidecar = Join-Path $bakDir 'RAMBlockCache.sys.sha256'
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $script:Sidecar -Destination $script:BackupSidecar -Force
}
Say "backup   : $bakDir"

try {
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $staged -Destination $script:DistSys -Force
    $script:DistTouched = $true
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($script:Sidecar, "SHA256: $signedSha" + "`r`n",
        (New-Object System.Text.ASCIIEncoding))
    Say "dist     : replaced with the signed binary; sidecar written" 'ok'
} catch {
    Abort "could not install into dist\ - $($_.Exception.Message)" 1
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------- anchor sync
$sync = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'sync_anchors.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sync)) {
    Abort "sync_anchors.ps1 missing: $sync" 1
}
Say 'anchors  : running sync_anchors.ps1'
$hostExe = (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$syncOut = & $hostExe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $sync -Sys $script:DistSys 2>&1
$syncRc = $LASTEXITCODE
$ErrorActionPreference = $prevEap
foreach ($o in @($syncOut)) { if ("$o".Trim()) { Say "  anch| $o" } }
if ($syncRc -ne 0) { Abort "sync_anchors.ps1 FAILED (exit $syncRc)" 1 }

# ------------------------------------------------------------- read-back gate
$anchorFiles = @(
    (Join-Path $root 'src\scripts\deploy.ps1'),
    (Join-Path $root 'src\scripts\verify_deploy_signature.ps1')
)
$bad = 0
foreach ($f in $anchorFiles) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Say "anchor missing: $f" 'FAIL'; $bad++; continue }
    $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)
    $m = [regex]::Match($text, 'DefaultExpectedSha256\s*=\s*''?([0-9a-fA-F]{64})''?')
    if (-not $m.Success) { Say "no DefaultExpectedSha256 in $f" 'FAIL'; $bad++; continue }
    $got = $m.Groups[1].Value.ToLower()
    if ($got -eq $signedSha) {
        Say ("anchor   : {0} = {1}" -f (Split-Path -Leaf $f), $got) 'ok'
    } else {
        Say ("anchor   : {0} = {1} != {2}" -f (Split-Path -Leaf $f), $got, $signedSha) 'FAIL'
        $bad++
    }
}
$sideText = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($script:Sidecar)
$sm = [regex]::Match($sideText, '([0-9a-fA-F]{64})')
if ($sm.Success -and $sm.Groups[1].Value.ToLower() -eq $signedSha) {
    Say ("anchor   : dist sidecar = {0}" -f $sm.Groups[1].Value.ToLower()) 'ok'
} else {
    Say 'anchor   : dist sidecar mismatch' 'FAIL'
    $bad++
}
$liveSha = Get-Sha256Hex $script:DistSys
if ($liveSha -eq $signedSha) {
    Say ("live     : dist\RAMBlockCache.sys = {0}" -f $liveSha) 'ok'
} else {
    Say ("live     : dist file hash {0} != signed {1}" -f $liveSha, $signedSha) 'FAIL'
    $bad++
}
if ($bad -ne 0) { Abort "read-back gate: $bad anchor(s) do not match the signed binary" 1 }

# deck: the deployed copy under System32 is intentionally NOT touched here.
$live = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $live) {
    Say ("deployed : {0}" -f (Get-Sha256Hex $live)) 'info'
    Say '           (unchanged on purpose - deploy.ps1 is a separate approval)' 'info'
}

if (-not $KeepStage) {
    try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $StageDir -Recurse -Force } catch { }
}

Flush-Log
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=================================================================='
Write-Host '  SIGN + ANCHOR SYNC COMPLETE'
Write-Host ('  signed sha256 : ' + $signedSha)
Write-Host ('  size          : ' + $signedSize + ' B')
Write-Host ('  authenticode  : ' + $authStatus)
Write-Host ('  log           : ' + $script:LogPath)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '  dist\ and the three anchors now point at the new binary.'
Write-Host '  The running driver and System32 copy are UNCHANGED.'
Write-Host '  Next (separate approval): verify_deploy_signature.ps1, then deploy.ps1'
Write-Host '=================================================================='
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/sync_anchors.ps1`

````powershell
# sync_anchors.ps1 - re-sync the deploy SHA256 anchors after rebuilding+signing the driver.
# Why: any source change -> rebuild -> new sys -> new hash. The three anchors below
# must match the DEPLOYED (signed) sys, or deploy.ps1 / verify_deploy_signature.ps1
# fail-closed (by design). This script computes the hash and rewrites all three.
# Usage (after signtool sign):
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File src\scripts\sync_anchors.ps1 [-Sys <path>]
# Default -Sys: <repo>\dist\RAMBlockCache.sys
# Preserves each file's original BOM state (scripts/*.ps1 must keep BOM per
# check_ps_syntax gate; README.txt is whatever it was).
param(
    [string]$Sys = ""
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
if (-not $Sys) { $Sys = Join-Path $root "dist\RAMBlockCache.sys" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Sys)) { throw "sys not found: $Sys (sign first, then sync)" }

# fail-closed guard: refuse to anchor an unsigned binary
$sig = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $Sys
if ($sig.Status -ne "Valid") {
    throw "sys signature status = $($sig.Status) - REFUSING to anchor an unsigned/invalid binary. Sign it first."
}

$hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Sys -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
Write-Host "sys   : $Sys"
Write-Host "sha256: $hash"
Write-Host "status: $($sig.Status) ($($sig.SignerCertificate.Subject -replace '\s+',' '))"

$targets = @(
    (Join-Path $root "src\scripts\deploy.ps1"),
    (Join-Path $root "src\scripts\verify_deploy_signature.ps1")
)
# [140 B3 2026-11-10] README.txt is no longer a tracked root file: the payload
# README is GENERATED by build_setup.ps1 from
# src\ui\installer\RAMBlockCache.Setup\Assets\README.payload.template.txt with a
# {{SYS_SHA256}} placeholder. Verify the placeholder survived (it is what keeps
# Gate11's format check meaningful); the real hash is interpolated at package
# time from the signed sys, so it is never stored in the repo.
$tpl = Join-Path $root "src\ui\installer\RAMBlockCache.Setup\Assets\README.payload.template.txt"
# [G12 2026-11-11] 原实现在这里置 $bad=1，紧接着第 46 行 `$bad = 0` 无条件清零，
# 于是「模板缺失」「占位符丢失」两种失败都只打印一行 [FAIL]，脚本仍以 exit 0
# 结束并打印 "anchors synced"。发布者会据此认为锚点同步成功 → 打出的包里
# README 的 hash 行是坏的（Gate11 的 format 检查也就失去意义）。
# 修法：模板问题是**前置契约**，直接早退 exit 1，不与后续循环共用 $bad。
$bad = 0
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tpl)) {
    Write-Host "  [FAIL] payload README template missing: $tpl"
    Write-Host "=== anchors NOT synced (template contract broken) ==="
    exit 1
}
elseif (-not ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($tpl)).Contains("{{SYS_SHA256}}")) {
    Write-Host "  [FAIL] template lost its {{SYS_SHA256}} placeholder: $tpl"
    Write-Host "=== anchors NOT synced (template contract broken) ==="
    exit 1
}
else { Write-Host "  [ok] payload README template placeholder present" }
$rx = [regex]'(?m)^(?<pre>.*DefaultExpectedSha256\s*=\s*''?)(?<old>[0-9a-fA-F]{64})(?<post>''?.*)$'
foreach ($f in $targets) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] missing: $f"; $bad = 1; continue }
    $bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($f)
    $hadBom = ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF)
    $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)
    $m = $rx.Match($text)
    # [FIX 2026-11-06] 旧版把「已一致」也打印成 "[warn] no line changed"，
    # 与「没匹配到锚点行」无法区分，发布验收时造成误判。现在三态分明。
    if (-not $m.Success) { Write-Host "  [FAIL] no DefaultExpectedSha256 line in $f"; $bad = 1; continue }
    $old = $m.Groups['old'].Value.ToLower()
    if ($old -eq $hash) {
        Write-Host "  [ok] already in sync: $f"
    } else {
        $new = $rx.Replace($text, { param($mm) $mm.Groups["pre"].Value + $hash + $mm.Groups["post"].Value })
        $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($hadBom)
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, $new, $enc)
        Write-Host ("  [ok] updated {0}: {1} -> {2} (bom={3})" -f $f, $old, $hash, $hadBom)
    }
}
# fail-closed：回读锚点，必须都等于本次哈希，否则拒绝宣告成功
foreach ($f in $targets) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
    $back = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)
    $mb = [regex]::Match($back, 'DefaultExpectedSha256\s*=\s*''?([0-9a-fA-F]{64})''?')
    if (-not $mb.Success -or $mb.Groups[1].Value.ToLower() -ne $hash) {
        Write-Host "  [FAIL] read-back mismatch: $f"; $bad = 1
    }
}
if ($bad -ne 0) { Write-Host '=== anchors NOT synced ==='; exit 1 }
Write-Host "=== anchors synced + read-back verified. Now run: powershell -File src\scripts\deploy.ps1 (or deploy.cmd), then reboot ==="
````

##### `src/scripts/sync_setup_hash.ps1`

````powershell
# sync_setup_hash.ps1 -- post-UAC: sync the NEW Setup AND sys SHA256/size into docs.
# 2026-11-06, see deliverables/71-harvest-closeout-2026-11-06.md section 6.
# Updated 2026-11-07 (qa-s2-preflight BLOCKER-2/3):
#   * Added -RequireSetupChanged for the post-UAC call. Without it, running the
#     tool BEFORE the Setup is re-signed takes the idempotent "ALREADY IN SYNC"
#     branch, prints success, writes nothing, and section 7 of
#     verify_final_reboot.ps1 then fails on a stale README hash.
#   * Added the two SYS baseline rows (README.md / 67). They were still pinned
#     to ed1bd99c... -- one generation behind even the current 63ad0fa8... --
#     and 67 #9 said "sys 未变", which becomes false once S2 rebuilds + re-signs
#     the driver. sync_anchors.ps1 only touches the three DEPLOY anchors and
#     never fixes these documentation rows.
#
# WHY: Authenticode signing changes both the file hash and its size. Gate5 only
# verifies the SYS hash and its three anchors; it does NOT check the Setup hash.
# So after the UAC signs the rebuilt Setup, the "current baseline" rows in
# README.md and 67-freeze-closure would otherwise stay stale and mislead users.
#
# SAFETY:
#   * Reads hashes/sizes from the actual dist artifacts (single source of truth)
#     and cross-checks the FINAL_SETUP_SHA256 recorded by the UAC chain.
#   * Refuses to write unless BOTH artifacts have a Valid Authenticode signature.
#   * NEVER touches README.txt (one of the three SYS hash anchors; editing it
#     breaks gate5). It only READS it for the read-back assertion.
#   * Only rewrites the 5 "current baseline" rows. Historical ledger rows are
#     deliberately left alone.
#   * Preserves each file's original encoding: README.md is UTF-8 no BOM + CRLF,
#     67-freeze-closure is UTF-8 no BOM + LF.
#   * Idempotent, with three-state output and read-back assertions.
#
# Usage: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File src\scripts\sync_setup_hash.ps1 [-RequireSetupChanged]
param(
    [switch]$RequireSetupChanged
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$setup = Join-Path $root 'dist\RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe'
$sys   = Join-Path $root 'dist\RAMBlockCache.sys'
# Dynamic current-baseline resolution: parse the CURRENT rows from the two
# baseline docs instead of hardcoding any generation's SHA/size. Both docs must
# agree (fail-closed) before a single byte is edited.
$hashLog = 'C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy\batch-hashes.txt'
$readme  = Join-Path $root 'README.md'
$d67     = Join-Path $root 'deliverables\67-freeze-closure-2026-11-06.md'
foreach ($p in @($readme, $d67, $setup, $sys)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { Write-Host ('[FAIL] missing: ' + $p); exit 1 }
}
$enc = New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$readmeText = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($readme, $enc)
$d67Text    = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($d67, $enc)

# --- Setup baseline -------------------------------------------------------
$rxReadme = [regex]'\|\s*`dist/RAMBlockCache-Setup\.exe`\s*\|\s*`([0-9a-fA-F]{64})`\s*·\s*\*\*签名 Valid\*\*\s*\|'
$rx67     = [regex]'\|\s*Setup\s*\|\s*`([0-9a-fA-F]{64})`\s*·\s*([0-9,]+)\s*B\s*·\s*\*\*签名 Valid\*\*\s*\|'
$rm = $rxReadme.Match($readmeText)
$m67 = $rx67.Match($d67Text)
if (-not $rm.Success -or -not $m67.Success) { Write-Host '[FAIL] cannot parse current Setup baseline rows'; exit 1 }
$oldSha = $rm.Groups[1].Value.ToLower()
$old67Sha = $m67.Groups[1].Value.ToLower()
$oldSize = $m67.Groups[2].Value
if ($oldSha -ne $old67Sha) { Write-Host ('[FAIL] baseline sha disagrees: README=' + $oldSha + ' 67=' + $old67Sha); exit 1 }
Write-Host ('[info] current Setup baseline: sha=' + $oldSha + ' size=' + $oldSize)

# --- Sys baseline (BLOCKER-3) ---------------------------------------------
$rxReadmeSys = [regex]'\| `dist/RAMBlockCache\.sys` \| `[0-9a-fA-F]{64}` · \*\*签名 Valid\*\*[^|]*\|'
$rx67Sys     = [regex]'\| sys \| `[0-9a-fA-F]{64}` · [0-9,]+ B · \*\*签名 Valid\*\*[^|]*\|'
$rmSys = $rxReadmeSys.Match($readmeText)
$m67Sys = $rx67Sys.Match($d67Text)
if (-not $rmSys.Success -or -not $m67Sys.Success) { Write-Host '[FAIL] cannot parse current sys baseline rows'; exit 1 }
$readmeSysLine = $rmSys.Value
$d67SysLine    = $m67Sys.Value
$rxSha = [regex]'[0-9a-fA-F]{64}'
$oldSysSha = $rxSha.Match($readmeSysLine).Value.ToLower()
$old67SysSha = $rxSha.Match($d67SysLine).Value.ToLower()
if ($oldSysSha -ne $old67SysSha) { Write-Host ('[FAIL] sys baseline disagrees: README=' + $oldSysSha + ' 67=' + $old67SysSha); exit 1 }
Write-Host ('[info] current sys baseline  : sha=' + $oldSysSha + ' (dist may already be newer)')

# --- Actual signed artifacts ----------------------------------------------
$sigSetup = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $setup
if ($sigSetup.Status -ne 'Valid') { Write-Host ("[FAIL] Setup signature is " + $sigSetup.Status + ", refuse to sync an unsigned artifact"); exit 1 }
$sigSys = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $sys
if ($sigSys.Status -ne 'Valid') { Write-Host ("[FAIL] sys signature is " + $sigSys.Status + ", refuse to sync an unsigned artifact"); exit 1 }
$newSha = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $setup -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
$newSize = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $setup).Length.ToString('N0', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
$sysShaNow = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $sys -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
$sysSizeNow = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $sys).Length.ToString('N0', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
Write-Host ("[info] setup sha256=" + $newSha + " size=" + $newSize)
Write-Host ("[info] sys   sha256=" + $sysShaNow + " size=" + $sysSizeNow)

# Post-UAC guard: the Setup MUST have changed. Otherwise the UAC chain did not
# complete and an "ALREADY IN SYNC" would be a silent false green.
if ($RequireSetupChanged -and $oldSha -eq $newSha) {
    Write-Host '[FAIL] -RequireSetupChanged: dist Setup hash is unchanged from the documented baseline -- the UAC replay may not have run'
    exit 1
}

# Cross-check the value recorded during the UAC run, if present.
# finalize_geom_rebuild.ps1 now treats the ledger append as FATAL and verifies
# its own read-back, so a mismatch here is a real defect, not a warning.
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hashLog) {
    $recorded = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $hashLog | Where-Object { $_ -match '^FINAL_SETUP_SHA256=' }) | Select-Object -Last 1
    if ($recorded) {
        $rv = ($recorded -split '=', 2)[1].Trim().ToLower()
        if ($rv -ne $newSha) {
            Write-Host ("[FAIL] batch-hashes.txt FINAL_SETUP_SHA256=" + $rv + " does not match dist=" + $newSha)
            exit 1
        }
        Write-Host '[ok] cross-check with batch-hashes.txt FINAL_SETUP_SHA256: MATCH'
    } else {
        Write-Host '[warn] no FINAL_SETUP_SHA256 in batch-hashes.txt (UAC may not have run) - dist is authoritative'
    }
}

# --- Build the exact row replacements ------------------------------------
$newReadmeSysLine = $rxSha.Replace($readmeSysLine, $sysShaNow, 1)
$new67SysLine = $rxSha.Replace($d67SysLine, $sysShaNow, 1)
$rxSize = [regex]'[0-9,]+ B'
$new67SysLine = $rxSize.Replace($new67SysLine, ($sysSizeNow + ' B'), 1)
$new67SysLine = $new67SysLine.Replace('本轮未变，三锚点不动', '本轮重编重签，三锚点已同步')

# The 67 #9 "发布物" line changes BOTH its 8-char Setup prefix and its sys
# wording. Parse the CURRENT line instead of pinning the old "sys 未变" text,
# otherwise the second (idempotent) run cannot find its own output and fails.
$rxPublish = [regex]'\*\*发布物\*\*：`dist/RAMBlockCache-Setup\.exe`（`[0-9a-fA-F]{8}…`，Valid）；`dist/RAMBlockCache\.sys`[^\r\n]*。'
$mPub = $rxPublish.Match($d67Text)
if (-not $mPub.Success) { Write-Host '[FAIL] cannot parse 67 #9 publish line'; exit 1 }
$publishLine = $mPub.Value
$newPublishLine = '**发布物**：`dist/RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe`（`' + $newSha.Substring(0,8) + '…`，Valid）；`dist/RAMBlockCache.sys` 已重编重签（`' + $sysShaNow.Substring(0,8) + '…`）。'

$targets = @(
    @{
        Path = $readme; NL = "`r`n"
        Old  = '| `dist/RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe` | `' + $oldSha + '` · **签名 Valid** |'
        New  = '| `dist/RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe` | `' + $newSha + '` · **签名 Valid** |'
    },
    @{
        Path = $d67; NL = "`n"
        Old  = '| Setup | `' + $oldSha + '` · ' + $oldSize + ' B · **签名 Valid** |'
        New  = '| Setup | `' + $newSha + '` · ' + $newSize + ' B · **签名 Valid** |'
    },
    @{
        Path = $d67; NL = "`n"
        Old  = $publishLine
        New  = $newPublishLine
    },
    @{
        Path = $readme; NL = "`r`n"
        Old  = $readmeSysLine
        New  = $newReadmeSysLine
    },
    @{
        Path = $d67; NL = "`n"
        Old  = $d67SysLine
        New  = $new67SysLine
    }
)

# Preflight: every old row must exist exactly once. Nothing is written unless
# all five are found. This is the "fail closed before any edit" guarantee.
foreach ($t in $targets) {
    $txt = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($t.Path, $enc)
    $hits = @([regex]::Matches($txt, [regex]::Escape($t.Old)))
    if ($hits.Count -ne 1) {
        Write-Host ("[FAIL] " + (Split-Path -Leaf $t.Path) + ": expected exactly 1 old row, found " + $hits.Count)
        Write-Host ("       row: " + $t.Old)
        exit 1
    }
}
Write-Host ('[ok] preflight: ' + $targets.Count + ' current-baseline rows found exactly once each')

# Apply (each path has multiple rows -> do all replacements on one in-memory text).
$byPath = @{}
foreach ($t in $targets) { if (-not $byPath.ContainsKey($t.Path)) { $byPath[$t.Path] = $t.NL } }
$changed = 0
foreach ($p in $byPath.Keys) {
    $txt = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p, $enc)
    $orig = $txt
    foreach ($t in @($targets | Where-Object { $_.Path -eq $p })) {
        $txt = $txt.Replace($t.Old, $t.New)
    }
    $txt = $txt -replace "`r`n", "`n" -replace "`n", $byPath[$p]
    if ($txt -ne $orig) {
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $txt, $enc)
        $changed++
        Write-Host ("[ok] updated " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p))
    } else {
        Write-Host ("[ok] already in sync " + (Split-Path -Leaf $p))
    }
}

# Read-back: new hashes must appear; old hashes must be gone when a real change
# was requested; README.txt SYS anchor must still match the CURRENT dist sys.
$fail = 0
foreach ($p in @($readme, $d67)) {
    $txt = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p, $enc)
    if ($txt.IndexOf($newSha, [StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) { Write-Host ("[FAIL] read-back missing new Setup sha in " + $p); $fail++ }
    if ($txt.IndexOf($sysShaNow, [StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) { Write-Host ("[FAIL] read-back missing current sys sha in " + $p); $fail++ }
    if ($oldSha -ne $newSha -and $txt.IndexOf($oldSha, [StringComparison]::Ordinal) -ge 0) {
        Write-Host ("[FAIL] read-back still has old Setup sha in " + $p); $fail++
    }
    if ($oldSysSha -ne $sysShaNow -and $txt.IndexOf($oldSysSha, [StringComparison]::Ordinal) -ge 0) {
        Write-Host ("[FAIL] read-back still has old sys sha in " + $p); $fail++
    }
}
$rt = Join-Path $root 'README.txt'
$anchorLine = Select-String -LiteralPath $rt -Pattern $sysShaNow -SimpleMatch -Quiet
if (-not $anchorLine) { Write-Host ('[FAIL] README.txt sys anchor does not match current dist sys ' + $sysShaNow); $fail++ }
else { Write-Host ('[ok] README.txt sys anchor intact and matches current sys ' + $sysShaNow) }
if ($fail -gt 0) { Write-Host ("[FAIL] read-back failed (" + $fail + ")"); exit 1 }

Write-Host ("== sync_setup_hash: " + $(if ($changed -gt 0) { 'UPDATED' } else { 'ALREADY IN SYNC' }) + " ==")
Write-Host 'NOTE: historical ledger rows intentionally untouched; see 71-harvest-closeout section 6.'
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/uninstall.ps1`

````powershell
# RAMBlockCache 卸载 V10
# 顺序：停止服务（DriverUnload 会 flush 全部脏数据）→ 上层过滤器摘除（保留 volsnap）
#      → 删服务 → 删驱动文件 → 提示重启（重启后过滤器彻底退出所有卷栈）
#Requires -RunAsAdministrator
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

Write-Host "== RAMBlockCache uninstaller V10 =="

# 1) 停服务（干净卸载：flush 全部脏块，回写窗口清零）
# [FIX S7-18] 停服必须确认真正停止：原实现 Stop-Service -Force + Start-Sleep 2 即继续
# ——驱动按设计在"停服超时（~15s 排不净在途 I/O）"时中止卸载保数据，此时服务仍在运行，
# 后续摘 UpperFilters/删服务/删 sys 会把脏数据未回写的驱动拆栈（用户重启后丢已确认写入，
# 与安装器 GUI [FIX 高-1] 同型缺陷在脚本侧未同步）。现按 install.ps1:48-54 同款
# 15s 有界确认，未停止即 fail-closed 中止（系统保持原状）。
$s = Get-Service RAMBlockCache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($s) {
    if ($s.Status -ne "Stopped") {
        Stop-Service RAMBlockCache -Force
        $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
        $stopped = $false
        while ($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds -lt 15) {
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
            $s.Refresh()
            if ($s.Status -eq "Stopped") { $stopped = $true; break }
        }
        if (-not $stopped) {
            Write-Host "[X] service stop timeout (~15s): driver aborted unload by design to protect dirty data."
            Write-Host "    Reboot once, then re-run this uninstaller. System left unchanged."
            exit 1
        }
    }
    Write-Host "[ok] service stopped (dirty flushed by DriverUnload)"
}

# 2) 上层过滤器摘除（读-改-写，保留 volsnap）
$cls = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{71a27cdd-812a-11d0-bec7-08002be2092f}"
$v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name UpperFilters -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).UpperFilters
if ($v) {
    $keep = @($v | Where-Object { $_ -ne "RAMBlockCache" })
    if ($keep.Count -gt 0) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name UpperFilters -Value $keep -Type MultiString }
    else                   { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $cls -Name UpperFilters }
    Write-Host "[ok] UpperFilters cleaned (volsnap kept): $($keep -join ',')"
}
# 旧非标准 GUID 残留清理（BUG-009）
$bad = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{536670a4-367c-463f-8b14-fa40f6d6fc1f}"
if (Test-Path $bad) {
    $bv = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $bad -Name UpperFilters -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).UpperFilters
    if ($bv) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $bad -Name UpperFilters -Value @($bv | Where-Object { $_ -ne "RAMBlockCache" }) -Type MultiString }
    Write-Host "[ok] legacy class GUID cleaned"
}

# 2b) [FIX S7-22] 摘武装基线与看门计划任务：原卸载不清 FilterArmed 与两个
# 计划任务——已卸载产品若将来因故重新武装（boot_guard 见 FilterArmed=1 且
# 确认启动失败）会回滚 UpperFilters；看门任务继续为已卸载产品看门。
$svcKey = "HKLM://SYSTEM//CurrentControlSet//Services//RAMBlockCache"
if (Test-Path $svcKey) {
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $svcKey -Name FilterArmed -Value 0 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-Host "[ok] FilterArmed baseline cleared"
}
# 任务名与 deploy.ps1:490/496 注册的一致（RAMBoost 前缀）
foreach ($task in @("RAMBoostBootGuard", "RAMBoostLogonDisarm")) {
    $null = schtasks /Delete /TN $task /F 2>$null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host "[ok] scheduled task removed: $task" }
}

# 3) 删服务、删文件
if ($s) { sc.exe delete RAMBlockCache | Out-Null; Write-Host "[ok] service deleted" }
$drv = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys"
if (Test-Path $drv) { Remove-Item $drv -Force; Write-Host "[ok] driver file removed" }

Write-Host ">>> DONE. Reboot to fully detach the filter from all volume stacks."
````

##### `src/scripts/use_node27.ps1`

````powershell
# use_node27.ps1 -- dot-source this to pin the CURRENT shell to Node 27 + npm 12.2.1.
# Usage (PowerShell):  . .\src\scripts\use_node27.ps1
# Then: node --version ; npm --version ; npm run build
# npm 12.2.1 prints a known false-positive engines warning on Node 27 alpha.
# We set npm_config_loglevel=error so that single warning is suppressed.
$node27 = if ($env:RBC_NODE27) { $env:RBC_NODE27 } else { 'D:\node-v27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0-win-x64' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $node27 'node.exe'))) {
    Write-Host "[X] Node 27 not found at $node27 (set RBC_NODE27 to override)" -ForegroundColor Red
    return
}
$env:PATH = "$node27;$env:PATH"
$env:npm_config_loglevel = 'error'
$nv = & (Join-Path $node27 'node.exe') --version
$np = & (Join-Path $node27 'node.exe') (Join-Path $node27 'node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js') --version --loglevel=error
Write-Host ("[ok] Node 27 shell: node={0} npm={1}" -f $nv, $np) -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "     npm alpha engines warning suppressed via npm_config_loglevel=error"
````

##### `src/scripts/verifier_enable.cmd`

````bat
@echo off
rem ============================================================
rem  verifier_enable.cmd - Driver Verifier for RAMBlockCache (P1.4)
rem  2026-11-06. Pure ASCII + CRLF (C1 discipline).
rem
rem  PURPOSE: upgrade "gated + window closed" to instruction-level
rem  attribution. Verifier bugchecks ON PURPOSE at the fault point -
rem  EXPECT POSSIBLE BSODs. That is the harvest, not a failure.
rem
rem  BEFORE rebooting: keep offline_rollback.cmd at hand (WinRE).
rem  AFTER the cycle  : run verifier_disable.cmd, reboot again.
rem
rem  REQUIRES: elevated console. A reboot activates the settings.
rem ============================================================
net session >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
  echo [X] Run as Administrator.
  exit /b 1
)

echo [*] Enabling Driver Verifier (standard flags) for RAMBlockCache ...
verifier /standard /driver RAMBlockCache.sys
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
  echo [X] verifier enable failed (exit %errorlevel%).
  echo     Try: verifier /query  to inspect current state.
  exit /b 1
)

echo [ok] Verifier enabled for RAMBlockCache. REBOOT to activate.
echo [*] Suggested cycle: reboot - run workload (apps + benchmark.ps1)
echo     - let it run 15-60 min - collect dumps - disable - reboot.
echo [*] Dumps land in C:\Windows\Minidump\*.dmp or C:\Windows\MEMORY.DMP.
echo [!] Boot loop escape (WinRE console):
echo     reg load HKLM\TMPSYS C:\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM
echo     reg delete "HKLM\TMPSYS\ControlSet001\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v VerifyDrivers /f
echo     reg unload HKLM\TMPSYS
echo     (then run offline_rollback.cmd and reboot)
exit /b 0
````

##### `src/scripts/verifier_harvest_check.ps1`

````powershell
# verifier_harvest_check.ps1 -- READ-ONLY pre-harvest gate for Driver Verifier cycle
# 2026-11-06 PF-16 batch. Pure ASCII + UTF-8 BOM (check_ps_syntax gate 4).
# Usage: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File src\scripts\verifier_harvest_check.ps1 [-Hours 1]
# It never changes registry, services, files or Verifier settings.
param([int]$Hours = 1)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'

Write-Host '== RAMBlockCache Verifier harvest pre-check (READ ONLY) =='
Write-Host ("checked at : " + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'))
Write-Host ("window     : last " + $Hours + " hour(s)")

# --- 1) which binary is actually on disk / running ---
$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($os) { Write-Host ("last boot   : " + $os.LastBootUpTime) }
$sys = Join-Path $env:windir 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sys) {
    $h = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $sys -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    $sg = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $sys
    Write-Host ("System32 sys: " + $h)
    Write-Host ("signature   : " + $sg.Status)
} else {
    Write-Host 'System32 sys: MISSING'
}
$svc = Get-Service RAMBlockCache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($svc) {
    Write-Host ("service     : " + $svc.Status + " / " + $svc.StartType)
} else {
    Write-Host 'service     : MISSING'
}
$p = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Parameters' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($p) {
    Write-Host ("guard       : Seq=" + $p.DeploySeq + " Ack=" + $p.DeployAck + " Armed=" + $p.FilterArmed + " Healthy=" + $p.LastBootHealthy + " BootFails=" + $p.BootFailCount)
}

# --- 2) Verifier state ---
$mm = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host ("VerifyDrivers: [" + $mm.VerifyDrivers + "]")
Write-Host ("VerifyType   : [" + $mm.VerifyDriversType + "]")

# --- 3) crash evidence in the window ---
$since = (Get-Date).AddHours(-$Hours)
$evts = @()
try {
    $evts = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'System'; StartTime = $since; Id = 1001,41,6008 } -ErrorAction Stop)
} catch {
    Write-Host ("event query : no matching events / channel unavailable (" + $_.Exception.Message + ")")
}
Write-Host ("bugcheck/power/unexpected-shutdown events: " + $evts.Count)
foreach ($e in ($evts | Select-Object -First 8)) {
    Write-Host ("  " + $e.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') + " id=" + $e.Id + " src=" + $e.ProviderName)
}
$whea = @()
try {
    $whea = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'System'; StartTime = $since; ProviderName = 'Microsoft-Windows-WHEA-Logger' } -ErrorAction Stop)
} catch {
    $whea = @()
}
Write-Host ("WHEA hardware-error events: " + $whea.Count)

# --- 4) dumps produced in the window ---
$dumpList = @()
$md = Join-Path $env:windir 'Minidump'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $md) {
    $dumpList += @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $md -Filter '*.dmp' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -ge $since })
}
$memDump = Join-Path $env:windir 'MEMORY.DMP'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $memDump) {
    $mi = Get-Item -LiteralPath $memDump
    if ($mi.LastWriteTime -ge $since) { $dumpList += $mi }
}
Write-Host ("new dumps: " + $dumpList.Count)
foreach ($d in $dumpList) {
    Write-Host ("  " + $d.FullName + "  " + $d.Length + " B  " + $d.LastWriteTime)
}

# --- 5) human-readable gate hint (never auto-disables anything) ---
if ($evts.Count -gt 0 -or $whea.Count -gt 0 -or $dumpList.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host 'VERDICT: NOT CLEAN - crash evidence in window. DO NOT disable Verifier yet.'
    Write-Host '  Collect dumps, then run cdb -z <dump> -c "!analyze -v; ln rbc+0xBCC; q"'
    Write-Host '  with the current build PDB for exact attribution.'
} else {
    Write-Host 'VERDICT: no crash evidence in window.'
    Write-Host '  If the 1h daily-load cycle is COMPLETE, run verifier_disable.cmd then reboot.'
    Write-Host '  If the boot shown above predates the PF-16 deploy, reboot once first: the'
    Write-Host '  running image is still the old driver, so this hour did NOT cover the new build.'
}
exit 0
````

##### `src/scripts/verify_deploy_signature.ps1`

````powershell
# verify_deploy_signature.ps1  [V10.4.3] Patch F: hard gate for the deployed sys
# Pure ASCII. Fail-closed verification of the driver BEFORE any reboot.
#
# Checks (all must pass, otherwise exit non-zero):
#   1. Source sys resolves (dist\RAMBlockCache.sys OR driver\x64\Release\RAMBlockCache.sys).
#   2. SHA256(source) == expected pin  (param > <sys>.sha256 sidecar > build pin).
#   3. signtool.exe present AND `signtool verify /pa` succeeds on the source sys.
#      A missing signtool is a FAILURE (no silent best-effort pass).
#   4. Deployed System32 copy matches the source hash. If it does not match, the
#      only accepted case is a queued replace-on-reboot (-AllowPendingReplace with a
#      PendingFileRenameOperations entry for the destination).
#
# Exit codes: 0 = verified, 2 = hash/deployed mismatch, 3 = signature/signtool failure,
#             1 = usage / missing input, 4 = I/O failure (source sys missing/unreadable,
#             Get-FileHash threw). [FIX S-03] 4 = I/O failure added; source-unreachable
#             used to fall into 1 (usage) with a raw exception stack.

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$SourcePath        = "",
    [string]$ExpectedSha256    = "",
    [switch]$AllowPendingReplace
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$DefaultExpectedSha256 = '2c1096d86372c5880e702eb5781d3be9f6f6b7ade7915660105423c74cc786de'

$scriptsDir = $PSScriptRoot
$root       = Split-Path -Parent $scriptsDir   # = src\
# [FIX 2026-10-17] 包根 = src\ 的上一级（dist\ 在包根，不在 src\ 下）——
# 与 deploy.ps1 同步修正，原 "$root\dist\..." 恒落空。
$repoRoot   = Split-Path -Parent $root
$dest       = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'
$smKey      = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager'

# [FIX S-04] PFRO 纯函数库（无顶层副作用）：dot-source 供下方 -AllowPendingReplace
# 成对匹配使用；QA 亦可独立 dot-source 本库做内存正/负例断言（不碰注册表）。
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'pfro_pending.ps1')

function Resolve-SysSource([string]$Explicit) {
    if ($Explicit) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit) { return (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Explicit).Path }
        throw "specified source sys not found: $Explicit"
    }
    $cands = @(
        (Join-Path $repoRoot 'dist\RAMBlockCache.sys'),            # 包根\dist = 签名部署产物（优先）
        (Join-Path $root 'driver\x64\Release\RAMBlockCache.sys')   # src\driver 编译产物（兜底，须经签名门禁）
    )
    foreach ($c in $cands) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c) { return (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $c).Path }
    }
    throw "source sys not found; looked in: $($cands -join ' ; ')"
}

function Resolve-ExpectedSha([string]$Sys, [string]$Explicit) {
    if ($Explicit) { return $Explicit.Trim().ToLower() }
    $sidecar = "$Sys.sha256"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sidecar) {
        $first = Get-Content -LiteralPath $sidecar -TotalCount 1
        # [FIX S-02] sidecar 首行哈希正则三处统一（deploy.ps1 / verify_deploy_signature.ps1 /
        # check_signature.ps1）：词边界匹配，禁行内任意位置取首条——"SHA256: <hash>" 格式
        # 必须三处同解；改此正则必须同步另两处。
        if ($first -match '(?<![0-9a-fA-F])[0-9a-fA-F]{64}(?![0-9a-fA-F])') { return $matches[0].ToLower() }
        throw "sidecar hash file has no 64-hex SHA256: $sidecar"
    }
    if ($DefaultExpectedSha256) { return $DefaultExpectedSha256.ToLower() }
    return $null
}

function Resolve-SignTool {
    $cmd = Get-Command signtool.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }
    $roots = @()
    if (${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}) { $roots += (Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Windows Kits\10\bin') }
    if ($env:ProgramFiles)        { $roots += (Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles        'Windows Kits\10\bin') }
    foreach ($r in $roots) {
        if ($r -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $r)) {
            $hit = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $r -Recurse -Filter 'signtool.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                   Where-Object { $_.FullName -match '\\x64\\signtool\.exe$' } |
                   Sort-Object FullName -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($hit) { return $hit.FullName }
        }
    }
    return $null
}

# [FIX G1 2026-11-15] Cmdlet-free SHA256 —— 与 deploy.ps1 同名函数保持逐字同解。
# 现场出现过 Get-FileHash 不可解析的宿主（Utility 模块未提供该 cmdlet），此时本脚本会
# 以 exit 4 报 "cannot hash" 并让部署链在最后一步失败。哈希改用 .NET API 后不再依赖
# 模块自动加载；FileShare.ReadWrite 用于目标可能被驱动/PFRO 持有的场景。
function Get-Sha256Hex([string]$Path) {
    $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($Path,
            [System.IO.FileMode]::Open,
            [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read,
            [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
    try {
        $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
        try {
            $bytes = $sha.ComputeHash($fs)
            return ([System.BitConverter]::ToString($bytes) -replace '-', '').ToLowerInvariant()
        } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
    } finally { $fs.Dispose() }
}

try {
    $srcSys = Resolve-SysSource $SourcePath
} catch {
    # [FIX S-03] 源不可达归 I/O 失败（exit 4），不再混作 usage（exit 1）。
    Write-Host "[X] source sys not readable (I/O): $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 4
}
Write-Host "[..] source sys   : $srcSys"

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest)) {
    Write-Host "[X] deployed sys not found: $dest" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 2
}

# --- expected hash resolution ---
try { $expected = Resolve-ExpectedSha $srcSys $ExpectedSha256 }
catch { Write-Host "[X] $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
if (-not $expected) {
    Write-Host '[X] no expected SHA256 available (pass -ExpectedSha256 or add <sys>.sha256).' -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

# [FIX S-03] 两处哈希包 try/catch：文件不可读归 I/O 失败（exit 4），
# 不再让裸异常栈冒充 usage 错误。[FIX G1] 哈希实现改 .NET，不再走 Get-FileHash cmdlet。
try { $srcHash = Get-Sha256Hex $srcSys }
catch {
    Write-Host "[X] cannot hash source sys (I/O): $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 4
}
try { $depHash = Get-Sha256Hex $dest }
catch {
    Write-Host "[X] cannot hash deployed sys (I/O): $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 4
}
Write-Host "source    : $srcHash"
Write-Host "deployed  : $depHash"
Write-Host "expected  : $expected"

# --- 1. source must match the expected pin ---
if ($srcHash -ne $expected) {
    Write-Host "[X] source SHA256 mismatch (source=$srcHash expected=$expected)." -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 2
}
Write-Host '[ok] source SHA256 matches expected pin.'

# --- 2. signature verification (hard requirement) ---
$signtool = Resolve-SignTool
if (-not $signtool) {
    Write-Host '[X] signtool.exe not found (PATH / Windows Kits). Signature cannot be verified.' -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 3
}
Write-Host "[..] signtool : $signtool"
& $signtool verify /pa /v $srcSys | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Host "[X] signtool verify FAILED on source (exit $LASTEXITCODE)." -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 3
}
Write-Host '[ok] Authenticode signature verified.'

# --- 3. deployed copy must match the source ---
if ($depHash -eq $srcHash) {
    Write-Host '[ok] SHA256 match; deployed sys verified.'
    exit 0
}

# mismatch: accept only a queued replace-on-reboot
if ($AllowPendingReplace) {
    # [FIX S-04] 成对匹配：PFRO REG_MULTI_SZ 按 (源,目标) 步长 2 切对，源（归一化）==
    # 本次 $srcSys 且 目标 == $dest 才放行；陈旧队列（源是旧 dist 路径）/空队列 -> exit 2。
    # 旧实现：任意条目 -like '*RAMBlockCache.sys*' 即放行——陈旧部署队列可制造假 PASS。
    $pfro = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $smKey -Name PendingFileRenameOperations -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).PendingFileRenameOperations
    if (Test-PfroPendingReplace -PfroEntries @($pfro) -ExpectedSource $srcSys -ExpectedTarget $dest) {
        Write-Host '[ok] deployed copy differs but a matching (source,target) replace-on-reboot pair is queued; source verified.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
        exit 0
    }
}

Write-Host '[X] deployed SHA256 differs from source and no queued replace found; DO NOT REBOOT.' -ForegroundColor Red
exit 2
````

##### `src/scripts/verify_final_reboot.ps1`

````powershell
# verify_final_reboot.ps1 -- READ-ONLY acceptance after the harvest reboot.
# Implements deliverables/64-verifier-harvest-2026-11-06.md section 7.
# 2026-11-06. Run 60-90s AFTER the reboot (RbAutoAttachSweep fires ~+30s).
#
# HARD RULE (64 #7.5): only naked GET /rb/bootcfg and POST /rb/rpc method=7.
# NEVER issue method=2 (SET_CONFIG) and never use the Web settings Save button
# during this window -- either would silently zero TinyLFU / clobber bootcfg.
# method=4 (GET_CONFIG) and /rb/health are read-only and explicitly required
# by 64 #7.4, so they are included here.
#
# This script changes NOTHING: no registry writes, no config writes, no reboot.
# Exit 0 = all gates PASS, 1 = at least one FAIL, 2 = degraded (WARN only).
#
# [QA Round 2 fixes, 2026-11-06]
#   X1: registry read failure must NOT be read as "Verifier off" (fail-open).
#   X2: require a real reboot AFTER the finalize UAC (marker file), otherwise
#       "verifier /reset + no reboot" could print a false VERDICT: PASS.
#   X3: the "[630] resume: boot-critical volume" log tag drifted to 631 in the
#       current rbattach.c and is conditionally emitted (only when
#       RbIsBootCriticalPdo hits). Match by TEXT, not line number, and treat it
#       as a conditional INFO gate instead of a hard FAIL. The hard evidence
#       for D: auto-resume remains "resume list loaded" + "volume attached"
#       + D.Attached=1.
#   X4 [S2 2026-11-07, qa-s2-preflight]: EVERY "[NNN]" tag is a compile-time
#       __LINE__ value (rbdriver.c:78-100 RbLog stores Src=__LINE__; call sites
#       pass __LINE__). The 11-07 driver rebuild moves "resume list loaded"
#       562 -> 676 and "volume attached" 1076 -> 1202 (rbattach.c). Pinning the
#       old numbers would produce TWO deterministic false FAILs after the S2
#       reboot. Match '[<digits>] TEXT' instead of a literal line number.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
# [2026-11-06 23:2x, lead] DYNAMIC sys baseline.
# The 19:22 acceptance pinned ed1bd99c... here. The 23:22 UAC rebuilt the
# driver (63ad0fa8...), so a hardcoded hash would give a permanent false FAIL
# after the reboot. Source of truth = the SIGNED dist sys; gate5 separately
# proves its three deploy anchors agree. Fail-closed if missing/unsigned.
$distSys = Join-Path $root 'dist\RAMBlockCache.sys'
$expectSys = ''
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $distSys) {
    $ds = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $distSys -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($ds -and $ds.Status -eq 'Valid') {
        $expectSys = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $distSys -Algorithm SHA256 -ErrorAction Stop).Hash.ToLower()
    }
}
$base = 'http://127.0.0.1:5199'
$markerPath = 'C:\ProgramData\rb-deploy\finalize-utc.txt'
$fails = 0
$warns = 0
function G([string]$name, [bool]$ok, [string]$detail) {
    if ($ok) { Write-Host ("[PASS] " + $name + " -> " + $detail) }
    else { Write-Host ("[FAIL] " + $name + " -> " + $detail); $script:fails++ }
}
function W([string]$name, [string]$detail) {
    Write-Host ("[WARN] " + $name + " -> " + $detail); $script:warns++
}
function I([string]$name, [string]$detail) {
    Write-Host ("[INFO] " + $name + " -> " + $detail)
}
Write-Host '== final reboot acceptance (64 #7) =='

# --- 1) boot time + X2: prove a reboot happened AFTER the finalize UAC ---
$boot = (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime
$bootUtcStr = $boot.ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
Write-Host ("[INFO] boot_local=" + $boot.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') + " boot_utc=" + $bootUtcStr)
Write-Host ('[INFO] now=' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'))
$elapsed = (Get-Date) - $boot
if ($elapsed.TotalSeconds -lt 60) {
    W 'sampling too early' ("only " + [int]$elapsed.TotalSeconds + "s since boot; 64 #7.1 asks for 60-90s before sampling")
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $markerPath)) {
    G 'reboot after finalize (marker)' $false 'finalize-utc.txt missing - the RB-finalize-geom-rebuild.cmd UAC did not complete'
} else {
    try {
        $markerText = ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($markerPath, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))).Trim()
        $markerOk = ($markerText.Length -eq 24 -and $markerText.EndsWith('Z'))
        # Both are fixed-width ISO-8601 UTC -> lexicographic == chronological.
        # A boot BEFORE the marker means /reset was issued but the machine was
        # never rebooted: kernel Verifier is still on and D: resume untested.
        G 'reboot after finalize' ($markerOk -and ($bootUtcStr -gt $markerText)) ("boot_utc=" + $bootUtcStr + " finalize_utc=" + $markerText)
    } catch {
        G 'reboot after finalize (marker read)' $false $_.Exception.Message
    }
}

# --- 2) X1: Verifier must be OFF; a failed registry read is a FAIL, not a PASS ---
$mmKey = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management'
$mm = $null
try { $mm = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $mmKey -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $mm = $null }
if ($null -eq $mm) {
    G 'Verifier off' $false 'Memory Management registry read failed - cannot conclude Verifier is off'
} else {
    $vd = @($mm.VerifyDrivers)
    $lvl = $mm.VerifyDriverLevel
    $vdEmpty = ($vd.Count -eq 0 -or [string]::Join(',', $vd) -eq '')
    $lvlZero = ($null -eq $lvl -or [int]$lvl -eq 0)
    G 'Verifier off' ($vdEmpty -and $lvlZero) ("VerifyDrivers=[" + [string]::Join(',', $vd) + "] VerifyDriverLevel=" + $lvl)
}

# --- 3) running driver image ---
$sys32 = 'C:\Windows\System32\drivers\RAMBlockCache.sys'
if (-not $expectSys) {
    G 'System32 sys' $false 'dist sys missing or not signed - cannot establish expected hash'
} elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sys32) {
    $h = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $sys32 -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    $sg = (Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $sys32).Status
    G 'System32 sys' ($h -eq $expectSys -and $sg -eq 'Valid') ("sha=" + $h + " sig=" + $sg + " expected=" + $expectSys)
} else { G 'System32 sys' $false 'file missing' }
$svc = Get-Service RAMBlockCache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
G 'service' ($null -ne $svc -and $svc.Status -eq 'Running' -and $svc.StartType -eq 'Boot') ("status=" + $svc.Status + " start=" + $svc.StartType)

# --- 4) watchdog full cycle + resume policy (baseline for the post-RPC recheck) ---
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\RAMBlockCache\Parameters'
$p = $null
try { $p = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $p = $null }
# [2026-11-06 23:2x, lead] Structural watchdog judgement, no hardcoded Seq.
# The 19:22 cycle closed at Seq/Ack=10/10. deploy.ps1 increments DeploySeq on
# every deployment, so the 23:22 replay armed Seq=11/Ack=10; after the reboot
# the logon task disarms and Ack catches up to 11. The invariant is
#   Seq == Ack (caught up) + Armed=0 (disarmed) + Healthy=1 + BootFails=0,
# NOT a literal counter value. A failed registry read must FAIL (QA X1).
$watchOk = ($null -ne $p -and
            $null -ne $p.DeploySeq -and $null -ne $p.DeployAck -and
            [int]$p.DeploySeq -eq [int]$p.DeployAck -and
            $p.FilterArmed -eq 0 -and $p.LastBootHealthy -eq 1 -and $p.BootFailCount -eq 0)
G 'watchdog' $watchOk ("Seq=" + $p.DeploySeq + " Ack=" + $p.DeployAck + " Armed=" + $p.FilterArmed + " Healthy=" + $p.LastBootHealthy + " BootFails=" + $p.BootFailCount)
# [101] 不再硬编码 Letters='D'：用户可自行在其它卷开启加速，开机恢复列表是其
# 配置权（红线：本脚本只读，不改）。判据 = AutoAttach=0 且 ResumeOnBoot=1 且

$lettersOk = ($null -ne $p -and "$($p.ResumeLetters)" -match 'D' -and "$($p.ResumeLetters)".Length -gt 0)
G 'bootcfg reg' ($null -ne $p -and $p.AutoAttach -eq 0 -and $p.ResumeOnBoot -eq 1 -and $lettersOk) ("AA=" + $p.AutoAttach + " RB=" + $p.ResumeOnBoot + " Letters=" + $p.ResumeLetters + " (user config: any subset containing D)")
$seqBefore = [string]$p.DeploySeq
$ackBefore = [string]$p.DeployAck
$armedBefore = [string]$p.FilterArmed

} else {

        $items = @($r7.data.Items)

        # [101] 基线对齐：用户可自行开启任意卷的加速（配置权）。本条判据改为
        # 「RPC 前后卷集合零漂移」——回归保护等价（66 号 #7.3 的原意=检测挂载泄漏），

        $n = @($r4.data.PSObject.Properties).Count
````
