````powershell
    } catch { G 'GET_CONFIG' $false $_.Exception.Message }
    # 64 #7.3: the read-only RPC path must not change DeploySeq/Ack/FilterArmed.
    $p2 = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $k -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    G 'watchdog unchanged after RPC' ($null -ne $p2 -and [string]$p2.DeploySeq -eq $seqBefore -and [string]$p2.DeployAck -eq $ackBefore -and [string]$p2.FilterArmed -eq $armedBefore) ("before Seq/Ack/Armed=" + $seqBefore + "/" + $ackBefore + "/" + $armedBefore + " after=" + $p2.DeploySeq + "/" + $p2.DeployAck + "/" + $p2.FilterArmed)
}

# --- 7) distribution artifact ---
$setup = Join-Path $root 'dist\RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setup) {
    $ss = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $setup
    $sh = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $setup -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    G 'Setup signed' ($ss.Status -eq 'Valid') ("sha=" + $sh + " sig=" + $ss.Status)
    $rd = Join-Path $root 'README.md'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $rd) {
        $hit = [bool](Select-String -LiteralPath $rd -Pattern $sh -SimpleMatch -Quiet)
        G 'README Setup hash in sync' $hit ("README contains " + $sh)
    } else { G 'README Setup hash in sync' $false 'README.md missing' }
} else { G 'Setup' $false 'dist\RAMBlockCache-Setup.exe missing' }

Write-Host ("== RESULT: FAIL=" + $fails + " WARN=" + $warns + " ==")
if ($fails -gt 0) { exit 1 }
if ($warns -gt 0) { exit 2 }
Write-Host 'VERDICT: PASS - harvest closed, Verifier off, D: auto-resumed, bridge healthy'
exit 0
````

````powershell
function Bad  ([string]$m) { Write-Host "[FAIL] $m" -ForegroundColor Red;    $script:fail++ }

    $sig = (Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $sysDest).Status

# 2) 服务

if (-not $svc) { Bad 'service RAMBlockCache not found' }
else {
    Info "service: $($svc.Status) / $($svc.StartType)"
    if ($svc.Status -eq 'Running') { Ok 'service Running' } else { Bad "service status = $($svc.Status) (expect Running)" }
    if ($svc.StartType -eq 'Boot')  { Ok 'start type = Boot' } else { Bad "start type = $($svc.StartType) (expect Boot)" }
}

# 3) UpperFilters（volsnap 必须保留）——[FIX 建议-12] OpenSubKey 返回 null 时安全处理

$ufStr = if ($uf) { [string]::Join(',', $uf) } else { '(key/value missing)' }
Info "UpperFilters: $ufStr"
if ($uf -contains 'volsnap') { Ok 'volsnap kept' } else { Bad 'volsnap missing from UpperFilters' }
if ($uf -contains 'RAMBlockCache') { Ok 'RAMBlockCache in UpperFilters' } else { Bad 'RAMBlockCache not in UpperFilters' }

# 4) testsigning

if ($ts -match 'Yes') { Ok 'testsigning: Yes' } else { Bad "testsigning not Yes ($ts) - self-signed driver will not load at boot" }

# 5) CLI 三通道（rb 通道 / RB2 通道 / 配置回读）
function RunCli([string]$exe, [string]$argsLine) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) { Bad "tool missing: $exe"; return $null }
    $out = & $exe $argsLine.Split(' ') 2>&1 | Out-String
    return @{ out = $out; code = $LASTEXITCODE }
}
$r1 = RunCli $feat 'stats'

$r2 = RunCli $feat 'vols'

$r3 = RunCli $ctl 'get-config'

# 6) 特性开关默认值（红线：Features\Flags 全关）

if ($null -eq $flags) { Info 'Features\Flags not present (driver defaults to 0 = all off)'; Ok 'flags default off' }
elseif ($flags -eq 0) { Ok 'Features\Flags = 0 (all features off, safe default)' }
else { Bad ("Features\Flags = 0x{0:X} (expect 0 unless intentionally enabled)" -f $flags) }

# 7) WPF 可执行性
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $wpf) { Ok "WPF exe present: $wpf" } else { Bad "WPF exe missing: $wpf" }

# 汇总
Write-Host ''
Write-Host ("== RESULT: {0} pass, {1} fail ==" -f $pass, $fail) -ForegroundColor $(if ($fail -eq 0) { 'Green' } else { 'Red' })
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'Next steps:' -ForegroundColor Cyan

Write-Host "  - Deploy new build: powershell -File `"$(Join-Path $root 'src\scripts\deploy.ps1')`"  then reboot"
Write-Host "  - Raw stats:    & `"$feat`" stats"
exit $(if ($fail -eq 0) { 0 } else { 1 })
````

##### `src/tools/rbbench/Program.cs`

````csharp
// rbbench - block-level benchmark for RAMBlockCache bring-up.
// No admin required, no driver IOCTL: pure aligned I/O with FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING
// so the OS cache never hides the driver's effect. Only the block layer matters.
//
// Tests: SEQ1M_R/W, SEQ4K_R/W, RND4K_R/W (QD1) and RND4K_R/W (QD32).
// Usage: rbbench --file D:\rbbench.bin --size 1024 [--seq4k 256] [--ops 16384] [--keep] [--tag cold]
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

namespace RbBench
{
    internal static unsafe class Program
    {
        const uint GENERIC_READ = 0x80000000;
        const uint GENERIC_WRITE = 0x40000000;
        const uint FILE_SHARE_RW = 0x00000003;
        const uint OPEN_ALWAYS = 4;
        const uint FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING = 0x20000000;
        const uint FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL = 0x80;

        [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        private static extern SafeFileHandle CreateFileW(string name, uint access, uint share,
            IntPtr sa, uint disposition, uint flags, IntPtr template);

        private static string _tag = "";
        private static int _repeat = 2;
        private static int _threads = 1;

        private static void Line(string s)
        {
            string prefix = _tag.Length > 0 ? "[" + _tag + "] " : "";
            Console.WriteLine(prefix + s);
        }

        private static int Main(string[] args)
        {
            string file = null;
            int sizeMB = 1024, seq4kMB = 256, ops = 16384;
            bool keep = false;

            for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
            {
                switch (args[i].ToLowerInvariant())
                {
                    case "--file": if (i + 1 < args.Length) file = args[++i]; break;
                    case "--size": if (i + 1 < args.Length) int.TryParse(args[++i], out sizeMB); break;
                    case "--seq4k": if (i + 1 < args.Length) int.TryParse(args[++i], out seq4kMB); break;
                    case "--ops": if (i + 1 < args.Length) int.TryParse(args[++i], out ops); break;
                    case "--keep": keep = true; break;
                    case "--repeat": if (i + 1 < args.Length) int.TryParse(args[++i], out _repeat); break;
                    case "--threads": if (i + 1 < args.Length) int.TryParse(args[++i], out _threads); break;
                    case "-t": if (i + 1 < args.Length) int.TryParse(args[++i], out _threads); break;
                    case "--tag": if (i + 1 < args.Length) _tag = args[++i]; break;
                    default: break;
                }
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(file))
            {
                Console.Error.WriteLine("usage: rbbench --file <path> [--size MB] [--seq4k MB] [--ops N] [--keep] [--tag label]");
                return 2;
            }
            if (sizeMB < 16) sizeMB = 16;
            if (seq4kMB < 16) seq4kMB = 16;
            if (seq4kMB > sizeMB) seq4kMB = sizeMB;

            Line($"file={file} size={sizeMB}MiB seq4k={seq4kMB}MiB rnd4kOps={ops}");
            SafeFileHandle h = CreateFileW(file, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_RW, IntPtr.Zero,
                OPEN_ALWAYS, FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING, IntPtr.Zero);
            if (h.IsInvalid)
            {
                int err = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] CreateFile failed Win32={err} (32=sharing, 5=access)");
                return 3;
            }
            try
            {
                long total = (long)sizeMB * 1024 * 1024;
                RandomAccess.SetLength(h, total);

                long seq4k = (long)seq4kMB * 1024 * 1024;

                // --- 1M sequential ---
                RunSeq(h, "SEQ1M_W", 1 << 20, total, write: true);
                RunSeq(h, "SEQ1M_R", 1 << 20, total, write: false);

                // --- 4K sequential (fresh file content first, order matters for cache) ---
                RunSeq(h, "SEQ4K_W", 4096, seq4k, write: true);
                RunSeq(h, "SEQ4K_R", 4096, seq4k, write: false);

                // --- 4K random ---
                RunRand(h, "RND4K_R_QD1", 4096, total, ops, 1, write: false);
                RunRand(h, "RND4K_R_QD32", 4096, total, ops, 32, write: false);
                RunRand(h, "RND4K_W_QD1", 4096, total, ops, 1, write: true);
                RunRand(h, "RND4K_W_QD32", 4096, total, ops, 32, write: true);
            }
            finally
            {
                h.Dispose();
                if (!keep)
                {
                    try { File.Delete(file); } catch { }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        private static IntPtr AllocAligned(int bytes, out IntPtr raw)
        {
            raw = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(bytes + 4096);
            long aligned = (raw.ToInt64() + 4095) & ~4095L;
            return new IntPtr(aligned);
        }

        private static void RunSeq(SafeFileHandle h, string name, int block, long bytes, bool write)
        {
            IntPtr raw;
            IntPtr buf = AllocAligned(block * Math.Max(1, _threads), out raw);
            try
            {
                for (int t = 0; t < Math.Max(1, _threads); t++)
                    new Span<byte>((void*)IntPtr.Add(buf, t * block), block).Fill((byte)(write ? 0x5A : 0));
                double best = double.MaxValue;
                for (int r = 0; r < Math.Max(1, _repeat); r++)
                {
                    var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                    int nt = Math.Max(1, _threads);
                    if (nt == 1)
                    {
                        long done = 0;
                        while (done < bytes)
                        {
                            var span = new Span<byte>((void*)buf, block);
                            if (write) RandomAccess.Write(h, span, done);
                            else RandomAccess.Read(h, span, done);
                            done += block;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        long per = (bytes / nt / block) * block;
                        var tasks = new Task[nt];
                        for (int t = 0; t < nt; t++)
                        {
                            int slot = t;
                            long from = slot * per;
                            long to = slot == nt - 1 ? bytes : from + per;
                            tasks[t] = Task.Run(() =>
                            {
                                var span = new Span<byte>((void*)IntPtr.Add(buf, slot * block), block);
                                for (long off = from; off < to; off += block)
                                {
                                    if (write) RandomAccess.Write(h, span, off);
                                    else RandomAccess.Read(h, span, off);
                                }
                            });
                        }
                        Task.WaitAll(tasks);
                    }
                    sw.Stop();
                    best = Math.Min(best, sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds);
                }
                Report(name, bytes, best);
            }
            finally { Marshal.FreeHGlobal(raw); }
        }

        private static void RunRand(SafeFileHandle h, string name, int block, long spanBytes, int ops, int qd, bool write)
        {
            IntPtr raw;
            IntPtr buf = AllocAligned(block * qd, out raw);
            try
            {
                long blocks = spanBytes / block;
                var rnd = new Random(12345);
                var offsets = new long[ops];
                for (int i = 0; i < ops; i++) offsets[i] = (long)(rnd.NextDouble() * (blocks - 1)) * block;

                double sec = double.MaxValue;
                for (int r = 0; r < Math.Max(1, _repeat); r++)
                {
                    var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                if (qd <= 1)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < ops; i++)
                    {
                        var span = new Span<byte>((void*)IntPtr.Add(buf, (i % qd) * block), block);
                        if (write) RandomAccess.Write(h, span, offsets[i]);
                        else RandomAccess.Read(h, span, offsets[i]);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    int chunk = ops / qd;
                    var tasks = new Task[qd];
                    for (int t = 0; t < qd; t++)
                    {
                        int slot = t;
                        tasks[t] = Task.Run(() =>
                        {
                            var span = new Span<byte>((void*)IntPtr.Add(buf, slot * block), block);
                            int from = slot * chunk;
                            int to = slot == qd - 1 ? ops : from + chunk;
                            for (int i = from; i < to; i++)
                            {
                                if (write) RandomAccess.Write(h, span, offsets[i]);
                                else RandomAccess.Read(h, span, offsets[i]);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    Task.WaitAll(tasks);
                }
                sw.Stop();
                sec = Math.Min(sec, sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds);
                }
                Report(name, (long)(ops * (long)block), sec);
                Line($"          -> {ops / sec:N0} IOPS");
            }
            finally { Marshal.FreeHGlobal(raw); }
        }

        private static void Report(string name, long bytes, double sec)
        {
            double mb = bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
            double mbps = sec > 0 ? mb / sec : 0;
            Line($"{name,-12} {mb,8:N1} MiB  {sec,7:N3} s  {mbps,9:N1} MiB/s");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
// 黑盒缓存验证：NO_BUFFERING 绕过 Windows 文件缓存，直读卷。
// 若驱动块层缓存生效，第二遍读应显著快于第一遍（内存 vs SSD）。
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

namespace RbProbe;

internal static class Bench
{
    private const uint GENERIC_READ = 0x80000000u;
    private const uint GENERIC_WRITE = 0x40000000u;
    private const uint SHARE_ALL = 0x7u;
    private const uint OPEN_EXISTING = 3u;
    private const uint CREATE_ALWAYS = 2u;
    private const uint ATTR_NORMAL = 0x80u;
    private const uint FLAG_NO_BUFFERING = 0x20000000u;
    private const uint FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH = 0x80000000u;
    private const uint FLAG_SEQUENTIAL = 0x08000000u;
    private const int BlockBytes = 4 * 1024 * 1024;      // 4MiB，4KiB 对齐

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private static extern SafeFileHandle CreateFileW(string name, uint access, uint share,
        IntPtr sec, uint disp, uint flags, IntPtr tmpl);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool ReadFile(SafeFileHandle h, IntPtr buf, int n, out int got, IntPtr ov);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool WriteFile(SafeFileHandle h, IntPtr buf, int n, out int put, IntPtr ov);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool FlushFileBuffers(SafeFileHandle h);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern IntPtr VirtualAlloc(IntPtr addr, IntPtr size, uint type, uint prot);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool VirtualFree(IntPtr addr, IntPtr size, uint type);

    private const uint MEM_COMMIT_RESERVE = 0x3000u;
    private const uint PAGE_READWRITE = 0x04u;
    private const uint MEM_RELEASE = 0x8000u;

    public static int Run(char drive, int sizeMB, bool keep)
    {
        if (sizeMB < 16) sizeMB = 16;
        string path = $"{drive}:\\rbprobe-bench.bin";
        long total = (long)sizeMB * 1024 * 1024;

        Console.WriteLine($"目标卷 {drive}:  文件 {path}  大小 {sizeMB} MiB");
        if (!DriveInfo.GetDrives().Any(d => d.Name.StartsWith($"{drive}:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] {drive}: 不存在");
            return 2;
        }

        IntPtr raw = VirtualAlloc(IntPtr.Zero, (IntPtr)(BlockBytes + 4096), MEM_COMMIT_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
        if (raw == IntPtr.Zero) { Console.Error.WriteLine("[x] VirtualAlloc 失败"); return 3; }
        try
        {
            // ---------- 1) NO_BUFFERING 写：不绕驱动，只绕 NTFS 缓存 ----------
            // 若驱动 write-back 生效，写应显著快于物理盘序写（数据被内存 chunk 吸收）。
            double wMiB;
            using (var wh = CreateFileW(path, GENERIC_WRITE, SHARE_ALL, IntPtr.Zero, CREATE_ALWAYS,
                                        ATTR_NORMAL | FLAG_NO_BUFFERING | FLAG_SEQUENTIAL, IntPtr.Zero))
            {
                if (wh.IsInvalid)
                {
                    Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] 创建文件失败 Win32={Marshal.GetLastWin32Error()}（磁盘满/权限）");
                    return 4;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < BlockBytes; i += 8) Marshal.WriteInt64(raw, i, 0x5A5A5A5A5A5A5A5A);
                var swW = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                long written = 0;
                while (written < total)
                {
                    int n = (int)Math.Min(BlockBytes, total - written);
                    if (!WriteFile(wh, raw, n, out int put, IntPtr.Zero) || put != n)
                    {
                        Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] 写失败 Win32={Marshal.GetLastWin32Error()}");
                        return 5;
                    }
                    written += put;
                }
                swW.Stop();
                wMiB = written / 1048576.0 / Math.Max(0.0001, swW.Elapsed.TotalSeconds);
                Console.WriteLine($"  写（NO_BUFFERING 顺序）：{written / 1048576.0:F0} MiB / " +
                                  $"{swW.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms = {wMiB:F0} MiB/s");

                var swF = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                FlushFileBuffers(wh);              // 真正落盘：write-back 的代价在这里体现
                Console.WriteLine($"  落盘（FlushFileBuffers）：{swF.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms");
            }

            Thread.Sleep(500);   // 让卷级写缓存沉淀

            // ---------- 2) NO_BUFFERING 顺序读两遍 ----------
            using var rh = CreateFileW(path, GENERIC_READ, SHARE_ALL, IntPtr.Zero, OPEN_EXISTING,
                                       ATTR_NORMAL | FLAG_NO_BUFFERING | FLAG_SEQUENTIAL, IntPtr.Zero);
            if (rh.IsInvalid)
            {
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] 打开失败 Win32={Marshal.GetLastWin32Error()}");
                return 6;
            }

            double p1 = Pass(rh, raw, total, "第 1 遍（冷：绕过 OS 缓存直读卷）");
            Thread.Sleep(300);
            double p2 = Pass(rh, raw, total, "第 2 遍（热：应命中驱动块缓存）");

            double speedup = p1 > 0 ? p2 / p1 : 0;
            Console.WriteLine();
            Console.WriteLine($"结论：读 {p1:F0} → {p2:F0} MiB/s（加速 {speedup:F2}×），写 {wMiB:F0} MiB/s");
            if (speedup >= 1.6) Console.WriteLine("  → 读缓存生效（数据面已接通）");
            else if (speedup >= 1.15) Console.WriteLine("  → 部分命中，未达块缓存预期（可能仅部分区间）");
            else Console.WriteLine("  → 读未命中缓存：该卷未 Attach，或数据面仍旁路");
            return 0;
        }
        finally
        {
            VirtualFree(raw, IntPtr.Zero, MEM_RELEASE);
            if (!keep)
            {
                try { File.Delete(path); Console.WriteLine("（测试文件已删除）"); }
                catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine($"（删除失败，请手动清理 {path}：{ex.Message}）"); }
            }
            else Console.WriteLine($"（--keep：文件保留在 {path}）");
        }
    }

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool SetFilePointerEx(SafeFileHandle h, long move, out long newPos, uint method);

    private const uint FILE_BEGIN = 0u;

    private static double Pass(SafeFileHandle h, IntPtr buf, long total, string label)
    {
        // 每次测量前归零：上一遍读完停在 EOF，不重置会读 0 字节
        if (!SetFilePointerEx(h, 0, out _, FILE_BEGIN))
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"[!] SetFilePointerEx 失败 Win32={Marshal.GetLastWin32Error()}");
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        long got = 0;
        while (got < total)
        {
            int n = (int)Math.Min(BlockBytes, total - got);
            if (!ReadFile(h, buf, n, out int r, IntPtr.Zero) || r <= 0)
            {
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] 读失败 Win32={Marshal.GetLastWin32Error()} 已读 {got}");
                break;
            }
            got += r;
        }
        sw.Stop();
        double mib = got / 1048576.0;
        double sec = sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;
        Console.WriteLine($"  {label}: {mib:F0} MiB / {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms = {mib / Math.Max(0.0001, sec):F0} MiB/s");
        return mib / Math.Max(0.0001, sec);
    }
}
````

##### `src/tools/rbprobe/Program.cs`

````csharp
// rbprobe — 驱动控制面探针：GET_STATS / GET_VOLUMES / GET_VERSION
// 用途：验证 F5（UpperFilters）修复后数据面是否真正接通（ReadReq/WriteReq 是否增长）
// 协议：rb_proto.h，IOCTL_RB_REQUEST = CTL_CODE(0x22, 0x800, BUFFERED, ANY) = 0x00222000
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

namespace RbProbe;

internal static class Program
{
    private const uint IOCTL_RB_REQUEST = 0x00222000;   // (0x22<<16)|(0x800<<2)|0
    private const int MsgSize = 8224;                   // sizeof(RB_MSG) = 16 + 8208
    private const int DataOff = 16;                     // Type/Size/Status/Reserved

    private const uint RB_MSG_GET_STATS = 1;
    private const uint RB_MSG_GET_VOLUMES = 7;
    private const uint RB_MSG_GET_LOG = 9;
    private const uint RB_MSG_GET_VERSION = 10;

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private static extern SafeFileHandle CreateFileW(string name, uint access, uint share,
        IntPtr sec, uint disp, uint flags, IntPtr tmpl);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool DeviceIoControl(SafeFileHandle h, uint code,
        byte[] inBuf, int inSize, byte[] outBuf, int outSize, out int ret, IntPtr ov);

    private static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        try { Console.OutputEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8; } catch { /* 重定向时可能失败 */ }
        bool watch = args.Any(a => a.Equals("--watch", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        int intervalMs = 1000;
        for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
            if (args[i].Equals("--interval", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && i + 1 < args.Length)
                int.TryParse(args[i + 1], out intervalMs);

        // 黑盒模式：不需要管理员，直接用 NO_BUFFERING 读文件判断驱动缓存是否生效
        int bi = Array.FindIndex(args, a => a.Equals("--bench", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        if (bi >= 0)
        {
            char drive = bi + 1 < args.Length ? char.ToUpperInvariant(args[bi + 1][0]) : 'D';
            int sizeMB = 256;
            for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
                if (args[i].Equals("--size", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && i + 1 < args.Length)
                    int.TryParse(args[i + 1], out sizeMB);
            bool keep = args.Any(a => a.Equals("--keep", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            return Bench.Run(drive, sizeMB, keep);
        }

        using var h = CreateFileW(@"\\.\RAMBlockCache", 0xC0000000u, 0x3u,
            IntPtr.Zero, 3 /*OPEN_EXISTING*/, 0, IntPtr.Zero);
        if (h.IsInvalid)
        {
            int e = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] 打开 \\\\.\\RAMBlockCache 失败 Win32={e}（5=需要管理员权限，2=驱动未加载）");
            return 2;
        }
        Console.WriteLine("[ok] 控制设备已打开");
        PrintVersion(h);
        PrintVolumes(h);
        PrintLog(h);

        if (!watch) { PrintStats(h, null); return 0; }

        Console.WriteLine("\n--- 监视模式（Ctrl+C 退出，观察 ReadReq/WriteReq 是否增长）---");
        Stats prev = default;
        while (true)
        {
            var cur = PrintStats(h, prev);
            prev = cur;
            Thread.Sleep(intervalMs);
        }
    }

    private static byte[] Call(SafeFileHandle h, uint type, int outSize = MsgSize)
    {
        var buf = new byte[outSize];
        BitConverter.GetBytes(type).CopyTo(buf, 0);
        BitConverter.GetBytes((uint)MsgSize).CopyTo(buf, 4);
        if (!DeviceIoControl(h, IOCTL_RB_REQUEST, buf, outSize, buf, outSize, out _, IntPtr.Zero))
        {
            int e = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] IOCTL type={type} 失败 Win32={e}（87=参数/SIZE 不符，31=设备故障）");
            return null;
        }
        int st = BitConverter.ToInt32(buf, 8);
        if (st != 0) { Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] type={type} NTSTATUS=0x{st:X8}"); return null; }
        return buf;
    }

    private static void PrintVersion(SafeFileHandle h)
    {
        var b = Call(h, RB_MSG_GET_VERSION);
        if (b == null) return;
        int o = DataOff;
        Console.WriteLine($"协议版本 v{BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o)}  驱动 {BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 4)}." +
                          $"{BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 8)}.{BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 12)}  " +
                          $"块过滤={BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 16)}");
    }

    private static void PrintVolumes(SafeFileHandle h)
    {
        var b = Call(h, RB_MSG_GET_VOLUMES);
        if (b == null) return;
        uint n = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, DataOff);
        Console.WriteLine($"\n卷列表 Count={n}（Attached=1 才代表数据面在加速）");
        Console.WriteLine("  盘  绑定 Attach Read Write 写模式  容量GB   空闲GB  扇区");
        for (uint i = 0; i < Math.Min(n, 16u); i++)
        {
            int o = DataOff + 8 + (int)i * 56;
            char letter = (char)BitConverter.ToUInt16(b, o);
            uint bound = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 40);
            uint attached = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 4);
            uint rd = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 8);
            uint wr = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 12);
            uint wm = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 44);
            ulong capMB = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 24);
            ulong freeMB = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 32);
            uint ls = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 48);
            Console.WriteLine($"  {letter}:  {bound,4} {attached,6} {rd,4} {wr,5} {wm,6}  " +
                              $"{capMB / 1024.0,7:F1} {freeMB / 1024.0,8:F1}  {ls}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>GET_LOG：驱动内部最近 64 条环形日志，attach 失败原因就在这里。</summary>
    private static void PrintLog(SafeFileHandle h)
    {
        var b = Call(h, RB_MSG_GET_LOG);
        if (b == null) return;
        uint n = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, DataOff);
        uint cursor = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, DataOff + 4);
        if (n > 64) n = 64;
        Console.WriteLine($"\n驱动日志 {n} 条（写入序号 {cursor}）");
        for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            int o = DataOff + 8 + (int)i * 120;      // RB_LOG_REC: 8 ticks + 3×4 + wchar[48]
            uint level = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 8);
            int status = BitConverter.ToInt32(b, o + 16);
            string text = System.Text.Encoding.Unicode.GetString(b, o + 20, 96).TrimEnd('\0');
            string lv = level switch { 0 => "信息", 1 => "警告", 2 => "错误", _ => level.ToString() };
            Console.WriteLine($"  [{lv}] {text}" + (status != 0 ? $"  (0x{status:X8})" : ""));
        }
    }

    private struct Stats
    {
        public ulong ReadReq, ReadHit, ReadBytes, ReadHitBytes;
        public ulong WriteReq, WriteBytes, WriteCached;
        public ulong CurBytes, DirtyBytes, ChunkCount;
        public uint InstanceCount, CacheSizeMB, EffectiveCacheMB, WriteBackMode, Enabled, SafeMode;
        public ulong LostDirtyBytes;
        public uint PressureLevel, PanicActive, BootFails;
    }

    private static Stats PrintStats(SafeFileHandle h, Stats? prev)
    {
        var b = Call(h, RB_MSG_GET_STATS);
        if (b == null) return default;
        int o = DataOff;
        var s = new Stats
        {
            ReadReq = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 0),
            ReadHit = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 8),
            ReadBytes = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 16),
            ReadHitBytes = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 24),
            WriteReq = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 32),
            WriteBytes = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 40),
            WriteCached = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 48),
            CurBytes = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 80),
            DirtyBytes = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 88),
            ChunkCount = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 96),
            InstanceCount = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 104),
            CacheSizeMB = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 108),
            EffectiveCacheMB = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 112),
            WriteBackMode = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 116),
            Enabled = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 120),
            SafeMode = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 124),
            LostDirtyBytes = BitConverter.ToUInt64(b, o + 144),
            PressureLevel = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 1180),
            PanicActive = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 1236),
            BootFails = BitConverter.ToUInt32(b, o + 1240),
        };

        double hitPct = s.ReadReq == 0 ? 0 : 100.0 * s.ReadHit / s.ReadReq;
        Console.WriteLine();
        Console.WriteLine($"读  req={s.ReadReq:N0}  hit={s.ReadHit:N0} ({hitPct:F1}%)  " +
                          $"bytes={s.ReadBytes / 1048576.0:F1}MiB  命中={s.ReadHitBytes / 1048576.0:F1}MiB");
        Console.WriteLine($"写  req={s.WriteReq:N0}  bytes={s.WriteBytes / 1048576.0:F1}MiB  " +
                          $"cached={s.WriteCached / 1048576.0:F1}MiB");
        Console.WriteLine($"缓存  cur={s.CurBytes / 1048576.0:F1}MiB  dirty={s.DirtyBytes / 1048576.0:F1}MiB  " +
                          $"chunks={s.ChunkCount:N0}  实例={s.InstanceCount}  上限={s.EffectiveCacheMB}MiB");
        Console.WriteLine($"状态  Enabled={s.Enabled}  写模式={s.WriteBackMode}(0=直写 1=回写)  " +
                          $"SafeMode={s.SafeMode}  Panic={s.PanicActive}  BootFails={s.BootFails}  " +
                          $"LostDirty={s.LostDirtyBytes}");

        if (prev.HasValue)
        {
            var p = prev.Value;
            Console.WriteLine($"Δ  读+{s.ReadReq - p.ReadReq:N0}  写+{s.WriteReq - p.WriteReq:N0}  " +
                              $"读字节+{(s.ReadBytes - p.ReadBytes) / 1048576.0:F1}MiB  " +
                              $"写字节+{(s.WriteBytes - p.WriteBytes) / 1048576.0:F1}MiB");
        }
        return s;
    }
}
````

##### `src/tools/rbtempguard/DriverClient.cs`

````csharp
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

namespace RbTempGuard;

/// <summary>
/// 控制面客户端：把排除区间下发给 \\.\RAMBlockCache（IOCTL_RB_EXCLUDE）。
/// ABI 见 ctl/rb_excl.h —— 常量必须与之逐字一致。
/// </summary>
internal static class DriverClient
{
    // CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN=0x22, 0x808, METHOD_BUFFERED=0, FILE_ANY_ACCESS=0)
    private const uint IOCTL_RB_EXCLUDE = (0x22u << 16) | (0x808u << 2);
    private const int HdrSize = 32;
    private const int EntSize = 16;
    public const int MaxExtents = 1024;

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern SafeFileHandle CreateFileW(
        string lpFileName, uint dwDesiredAccess, uint dwShareMode, IntPtr lpSecurityAttributes,
        uint dwCreationDisposition, uint dwFlagsAndAttributes, IntPtr hTemplateFile);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool DeviceIoControl(
        SafeFileHandle hDevice, uint dwIoControlCode,
        byte[] lpInBuffer, int nInBufferSize,
        byte[] lpOutBuffer, int nOutBufferSize,
        out int lpBytesReturned, IntPtr lpOverlapped);

    public static bool TryOpen(out SafeFileHandle h, out string why)
    {
        h = CreateFileW(@"\\.\RAMBlockCache", 0xC0000000u, 0x3u, IntPtr.Zero, 3, 0, IntPtr.Zero);
        if (h.IsInvalid)
        {
            int e = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
            why = e switch
            {
                2 => "驱动未加载（找不到 \\\\.\\RAMBlockCache）",
                5 => "拒绝访问：需要以管理员身份运行",
                _ => "CreateFile 失败 0x" + e.ToString("X")
            };
            h.Dispose();
            h = null;
            return false;
        }
        why = null;
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>发送排除集（count==0 即清空）。返回 NTSTATUS 或抛 Win32Exception。</summary>
    public static int Send(SafeFileHandle h, char driveLetter, IReadOnlyList<(ulong Start, ulong Len)> ents)
    {
        if (ents.Count > MaxExtents) throw new ArgumentException($"区间数 {ents.Count} > {MaxExtents}");
        int size = HdrSize + ents.Count * EntSize;
        byte[] buf = new byte[size];
        BitConverter.GetBytes((uint)driveLetter).CopyTo(buf, 0);
        BitConverter.GetBytes((uint)ents.Count).CopyTo(buf, 4);
        BitConverter.GetBytes(0u).CopyTo(buf, 8);      // Flags 必须 0
        BitConverter.GetBytes(0u).CopyTo(buf, 12);     // Reserved
        for (int i = 0; i < ents.Count; i++)
        {
            BitConverter.GetBytes(ents[i].Start).CopyTo(buf, HdrSize + i * EntSize);
            BitConverter.GetBytes(ents[i].Len).CopyTo(buf, HdrSize + i * EntSize + 8);
        }
        if (!DeviceIoControl(h, IOCTL_RB_EXCLUDE, buf, size, null, 0, out _, IntPtr.Zero))
        {
            int e = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
            // 87=参数错误 1167=设备未就绪 2=找不到设备
            return e switch
            {
                87 => unchecked((int)0xC000000D),
                1167 => unchecked((int)0xC00000A3),
                2 => unchecked((int)0xC0000034),
                _ => unchecked((int)0xC0000001)
            };
        }
        return 0;
    }
}
````

##### `src/tools/rbtempguard/ExtentResolver.cs`

````csharp
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

namespace RbTempGuard;

/// <summary>
/// 把文件在卷上的物理簇范围（LCN 区间）解析为卷内字节区间。
///
/// 为什么需要它：RAMBlockCache 是卷块层过滤驱动，看不到文件名。要在块层
/// "排除临时文件/软件缓存"，唯一可行的路径是：用户态用
/// FSCTL_GET_RETRIEVAL_POINTERS 拿到文件的数据区映射（VCN→LCN），
/// 换算成卷内字节偏移后下推给驱动（见 ctl/rb_excl.h）。
///
/// 注意点：
///  - 稀疏/压缩文件的 Extent 里 Lcn == -1 表示"无物理簇"，必须跳过；
///  - 常驻（resident）小文件没有数据区映射，调用会返回 0 个 extent；
///  - 文件在两次枚举之间被改写会导致映射过期——这是"缓存放置提示"，
///    过期最坏结果是多/少排除几个块，不会造成数据错误（见 cache.h 契约）。
/// </summary>
internal static class ExtentResolver
{
    private const uint FSCTL_GET_RETRIEVAL_POINTERS = 0x00090073; // CTL_CODE(FILE_DEVICE_FILE_SYSTEM, 28, METHOD_NEITHER, ANY)
    private const int ErrorMoreData = 234;
    private const int ErrorHandleEof = 38;

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern SafeFileHandle CreateFileW(
        string lpFileName, uint dwDesiredAccess, uint dwShareMode, IntPtr lpSecurityAttributes,
        uint dwCreationDisposition, uint dwFlagsAndAttributes, IntPtr hTemplateFile);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool DeviceIoControl(
        SafeFileHandle hDevice, uint dwIoControlCode,
        IntPtr lpInBuffer, int nInBufferSize,
        IntPtr lpOutBuffer, int nOutBufferSize,
        out int lpBytesReturned, IntPtr lpOverlapped);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool GetDiskFreeSpaceW(
        string lpRootPathName, out uint lpSectorsPerCluster, out uint lpBytesPerSector,
        out uint lpNumberOfFreeClusters, out uint lpTotalNumberOfClusters);

    /// <summary>每簇字节数（同一卷内恒定）。</summary>
    public static long GetClusterSize(string root)
    {
        if (!GetDiskFreeSpaceW(root, out uint spc, out uint bps, out _, out _))
            return 4096; // 保守缺省：NTFS 常见值，最坏只是区间对齐偏差
        long v = (long)spc * bps;
        return v > 0 ? v : 4096;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 取单个文件的物理区间（卷内字节偏移）。失败返回 false 并通过 <paramref name="why"/> 说明。
    /// <paramref name="maxAdd"/> 限制本次最多追加多少区间（调用方预算控制，避免超大碎片文件把预算吃光）。
    /// </summary>
    public static bool TryGetFileExtents(string path, long clusterSize,
                                         List<(ulong Start, ulong Len)> sink, int maxAdd,
                                         out string why)
    {
        why = null;
        // 只读属性访问即可：FSCTL_GET_RETRIEVAL_POINTERS 不读文件数据
        using SafeFileHandle h = CreateFileW(path, 0x80000000u /*GENERIC_READ*/,
            0x7u /*SHARE_READ|WRITE|DELETE*/, IntPtr.Zero, 3 /*OPEN_EXISTING*/,
            0x02000000u /*FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS*/, IntPtr.Zero);
        if (h.IsInvalid)
        {
            int e = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
            why = e switch
            {
                5 => "access denied",
                32 => "in use",
                2 => "not found",
                _ => "open 0x" + e.ToString("X")
            };
            return false;
        }

        long startVcn = 0;
        int guard = 0;
        int outSize = 16 * 1024;
        while (guard++ < 4096 && startVcn >= 0)
        {
            byte[] inBuf = BitConverter.GetBytes(startVcn);
            byte[] outBuf = new byte[outSize];
            GCHandle hIn = GCHandle.Alloc(inBuf, GCHandleType.Pinned);
            GCHandle hOut = GCHandle.Alloc(outBuf, GCHandleType.Pinned);
            bool ok;
            int ret = 0;
            try
            {
                ok = DeviceIoControl(h, FSCTL_GET_RETRIEVAL_POINTERS,
                    hIn.AddrOfPinnedObject(), inBuf.Length,
                    hOut.AddrOfPinnedObject(), outBuf.Length,
                    out ret, IntPtr.Zero);
            }
            finally
            {
                hIn.Free();
                hOut.Free();
            }

            int err = ok ? 0 : Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
            if (!ok && err != ErrorMoreData && err != ErrorHandleEof)
            {
                // 常驻文件 / 卷已卸载 / 无权限：都不是致命错误，跳过该文件
                why = "fsctl 0x" + err.ToString("X");
                return false;
            }

            // RETRIEVAL_POINTERS_BUFFER: DWORD ExtentCount; LARGE_INTEGER StartingVcn;
            //   { LARGE_INTEGER NextVcn; LARGE_INTEGER Lcn; } Extents[];
            int count = BitConverter.ToInt32(outBuf, 0);
            int maxFit = (outBuf.Length - 16) / 16;
            if (count > maxFit) count = maxFit;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                if (sink.Count >= maxAdd) return true;      // 预算用尽：保留已解析部分即可
                int off = 16 + i * 16;
                long nextVcn = BitConverter.ToInt64(outBuf, off);
                long lcn = BitConverter.ToInt64(outBuf, off + 8);
                long prevVcn = (i == 0) ? startVcn : BitConverter.ToInt64(outBuf, off - 16);
                long clusters = nextVcn - prevVcn;
                if (clusters <= 0) continue;
                if (lcn < 0) continue;                     // 稀疏段：无物理簇
                sink.Add(((ulong)(lcn * clusterSize), (ulong)(clusters * clusterSize)));
            }

            if (!ok && err == ErrorMoreData && count > 0)
            {
                startVcn = BitConverter.ToInt64(outBuf, 16 + (count - 1) * 16); // 最后一条的 NextVcn
                if (outSize < 1024 * 1024) outSize *= 2;   // 碎片化严重时放大缓冲
                continue;
            }
            return true;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

namespace RbTempGuard;

/// <summary>
/// rbtempguard —— 把"软件临时缓存目录"从 RAMBlockCache 的写缓存里排除。
///
/// 解决的问题：临时文件（%TEMP%、浏览器 Cache、Windows\Temp…）写进去基本不会再读，
/// 却会占满写缓存、把真正有用的热数据挤出去，还要额外产生一次回写 I/O。
/// 块层看不到文件名，所以本工具负责把目录里的文件解析成物理簇区间并下推给驱动；
/// 驱动的 core 让这些区间直写、不建块、不产生脏数据（见 cache.h rb_stream_set_exclude）。
///
/// 用法：
///   rbtempguard --drive C                一次扫描并下发，然后退出
///   rbtempguard --drive C --watch 300    常驻，每 300 秒刷新一次
///   rbtempguard --drive C --dry-run      只打印统计，不下发
///   rbtempguard --drive C --clear        清空该卷排除集
///   rbtempguard --drive C --dir D:\tmp   追加自定义目录（可多次）
///
/// 退出码：0 正常；2 参数错误；3 驱动不可用
/// </summary>
internal static class Program
{
    private sealed class Options
    {
        public char Drive = '\0';
        public int IntervalSec;
        public int ScanBudgetSec = 12;
        public int MaxDepth = 4;
        public bool DryRun;
        public bool Verbose;
        public bool Clear;
        public readonly List<string> ExtraDirs = new();
    }

    private static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        try { Console.OutputEncoding = Encoding.UTF8; } catch { /* 重定向/旧控制台：忽略 */ }
        Options o;
        try { o = ParseArgs(args); }
        catch (ArgumentException ex)
        {
            Console.Error.WriteLine("参数错误: " + ex.Message);
            PrintUsage();
            return 2;
        }
        if (o.Drive == '\0') { PrintUsage(); return 2; }

        SafeFileHandle dev = null;
        if (!o.DryRun)
        {
            if (!DriverClient.TryOpen(out dev, out string why))
            {
                Console.Error.WriteLine("[x] " + why);
                return 3;
            }
        }

        try
        {
            string root = o.Drive + ":\\";
            if (!Directory.Exists(root))
            {
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] 卷不存在: {root}");
                return 2;
            }
            long cluster = ExtentResolver.GetClusterSize(root);
            Console.WriteLine($"[i] 卷 {o.Drive}: 簇大小 {cluster} 字节；区间上限 {DriverClient.MaxExtents}");

            if (o.Clear)
            {
                int st = o.DryRun ? 0 : DriverClient.Send(dev, o.Drive, Array.Empty<(ulong, ulong)>());
                Console.WriteLine(st == 0 ? "[ok] 已清空该卷排除集" : $"[x] 清空失败 NTSTATUS=0x{st:X8}");
                return st == 0 ? 0 : 3;
            }

            do
            {
                RunOnce(o, dev, cluster);
                if (o.IntervalSec <= 0) break;
                try { Thread.Sleep(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(o.IntervalSec)); }
                catch (ThreadInterruptedException) { break; }
            } while (true);
        }
        finally
        {
            dev?.Dispose();
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static void RunOnce(Options o, SafeFileHandle dev, long cluster)
    {
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var dirs = CollectDirs(o);
        var bag = new System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentBag<(long Size, string Path)>();
        int skippedDirs = 0;
        var deadline = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(o.ScanBudgetSec);

        // 各根目录互不依赖：并行扫（8 路），实测把 20 万条目的元数据扫描从
        // 8s+ 压到 2s 以内；单目录内部仍串行，避免 SSD 上排队反而更慢。
        Parallel.ForEach(dirs, new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = 8 }, d =>
        {
            if (!Directory.Exists(d)) return;
            var local = new List<(long, string)>();
            int sk = 0;
            EnumerateInto(d, local, deadline, o.MaxDepth, ref sk);
            foreach (var x in local) bag.Add(x);
            Interlocked.Add(ref skippedDirs, sk);
        });

        var files = bag.ToList();

        // 大文件优先占预算：一个 4GiB 的缓存文件远比 5000 个 1KiB 锁文件重要
        files.Sort((a, b) => b.Size.CompareTo(a.Size));

        var ents = new List<(ulong Start, ulong Len)>(DriverClient.MaxExtents * 2);
        int done = 0, failed = 0;
        long covered = 0;
        foreach (var (size, path) in files)
        {
            if (ents.Count >= DriverClient.MaxExtents) break;
            if (ExtentResolver.TryGetFileExtents(path, cluster, ents,
                                                 DriverClient.MaxExtents, out string why))
            {
                done++;
                covered += size;
            }
            else
            {
                failed++;
                if (o.Verbose) Console.WriteLine($"    [skip] {path} ({why})");
            }
        }

        var merged = Merge(ents);
        long mergedBytes = merged.Sum(x => (long)x.Len);

        Console.WriteLine($"[i] 候选文件 {files.Count}（成功 {done} / 失败 {failed}），跳过目录 {skippedDirs}；" +
                          $"区间 {ents.Count} → {merged.Count}，覆盖 {mergedBytes / 1048576.0:F1} MiB，" +
                          $"文件总量 {covered / 1048576.0:F1} MiB，{sw.ElapsedMilliseconds} ms");

        if (o.DryRun)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(merged.Count, 5); i++)
                Console.WriteLine($"    #{i} off=0x{merged[i].Start:X} len=0x{merged[i].Len:X}");
            if (merged.Count > 5) Console.WriteLine("    ...");
            return;
        }

        int st = DriverClient.Send(dev, o.Drive, merged);
        if (st == 0)
            Console.WriteLine($"[ok] 已下发（{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss}）");
        else
            Console.Error.WriteLine($"[x] 下发失败 NTSTATUS=0x{st:X8}（1167=该卷未挂载缓存，87=参数被拒）");
    }

    private static List<string> CollectDirs(Options o)
    {
        var set = new List<string>();
        void add(string p)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p) && !set.Contains(p, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                set.Add(p);
        }

        string local = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData);
        add(Path.GetTempPath());
        add(Path.Combine(local, "Temp"));
        add(Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.Windows), "Temp"));
        add(Path.Combine(local, "Microsoft", "Windows", "INetCache"));
        add(Path.Combine(local, "Google", "Chrome", "User Data", "Default", "Cache"));
        add(Path.Combine(local, "Google", "Chrome", "User Data", "Default", "Code Cache"));
        add(Path.Combine(local, "Microsoft", "Edge", "User Data", "Default", "Cache"));
        add(Path.Combine(local, "Microsoft", "Edge", "User Data", "Default", "Code Cache"));
        add(Path.Combine(local, "Mozilla", "Firefox", "Profiles"));
        foreach (var d in o.ExtraDirs) add(d);
        return set;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 逐层枚举并把"够大的普通文件"加入候选。
    /// 关键性能点：用 DirectoryInfo.EnumerateFiles 读的是 Win32 查找结果里自带的
    /// 文件长度/属性，不额外发 stat——实测同样 21 万文件，逐路径 new FileInfo()
    /// 要 92 秒，本方式在秒级。同时用 deadline 给每轮扫描设硬上限。
    /// </summary>
    private static void EnumerateInto(string root, List<(long Size, string Path)> sink,
                                      TimeSpan deadline, int maxDepth, ref int skippedDirs)
    {
        const long MinFileSize = 64 * 1024;      // 小于 64KiB 的缓存碎片不值得占用排除预算
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var stack = new Stack<(string Dir, int Depth)>();
        stack.Push((root, 0));
        var opts = new EnumerationOptions
        {
            RecurseSubdirectories = false,
            IgnoreInaccessible = true,
            AttributesToSkip = FileAttributes.ReparsePoint,
            ReturnSpecialDirectories = false
        };
        int guard = 0;
        while (stack.Count > 0 && guard++ < 100000)
        {
            if (sw.Elapsed > deadline) return;
            var (cur, depth) = stack.Pop();
            DirectoryInfo di;
            try { di = new DirectoryInfo(cur); }
            catch { skippedDirs++; continue; }

            /* 深度上限的意义：缓存目录普遍在 1~4 层内，而浏览器/包的目录树可以深达
             * 十几层、上千个子目录——每层都是一次目录句柄打开（实测 21 万条目、
             * 全树遍历 28s，其中用户态 CPU 仅 0.09s，全在等 IO）。限深后保持一致
             * 覆盖率而耗时降一个数量级。 */
            if (depth < maxDepth)
            {
                try
                {
                    foreach (var d in di.EnumerateDirectories("*", opts)) stack.Push((d.FullName, depth + 1));
                }
                catch { skippedDirs++; }
            }

            try
            {
                foreach (var f in di.EnumerateFiles("*", opts))
                {
                    long len;
                    FileAttributes attr;
                    try { len = f.Length; attr = f.Attributes; }
                    catch { continue; }               // 枚举后被删除
                    if (len < MinFileSize) continue;
                    if ((attr & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0) continue;
                    sink.Add((len, f.FullName));
                }
            }
            catch { skippedDirs++; }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>排序 + 合并，保证区间有序不重叠（驱动侧还会再合并一次）。</summary>
    private static List<(ulong Start, ulong Len)> Merge(List<(ulong Start, ulong Len)> src)
    {
        var list = src.Where(x => x.Len > 0).OrderBy(x => x.Start).ToList();
        var outp = new List<(ulong Start, ulong Len)>();
        foreach (var (s, l) in list)
        {
            if (outp.Count > 0)
            {
                var last = outp[^1];
                ulong lastEnd = last.Start + last.Len;
                if (s <= lastEnd)
                {
                    ulong newEnd = Math.Max(lastEnd, s + l);
                    outp[^1] = (last.Start, newEnd - last.Start);
                    continue;
                }
            }
            outp.Add((s, l));
        }
        return outp;
    }

    private static Options ParseArgs(string[] args)
    {
        var o = new Options();
        for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
        {
            switch (args[i])
            {
                case "--drive":
                case "-d":
                    if (++i >= args.Length) throw new ArgumentException("--drive 需要盘符");
                    string v = args[i].TrimEnd(':', '\\');
                    if (v.Length != 1 || !char.IsLetter(v[0])) throw new ArgumentException("盘符格式应为 C");
                    o.Drive = char.ToUpperInvariant(v[0]);
                    break;
                case "--watch":
                case "-w":
                    if (++i >= args.Length || !int.TryParse(args[i], out o.IntervalSec) || o.IntervalSec <= 0)
                        throw new ArgumentException("--watch 需要正整数秒");
                    break;
                case "--dir":
                    if (++i >= args.Length) throw new ArgumentException("--dir 需要路径");
                    o.ExtraDirs.Add(args[i]);
                    break;
                case "--max-depth":
                    if (++i >= args.Length || !int.TryParse(args[i], out o.MaxDepth) || o.MaxDepth < 1)
                        throw new ArgumentException("--max-depth 需要正整数");
                    break;
                case "--budget":
                    if (++i >= args.Length || !int.TryParse(args[i], out o.ScanBudgetSec) || o.ScanBudgetSec <= 0)
                        throw new ArgumentException("--budget 需要正整数秒");
                    break;
                case "--dry-run": o.DryRun = true; break;
                case "--verbose":
                case "-v": o.Verbose = true; break;
                case "--clear": o.Clear = true; break;
                case "--help":
                case "-h":
                case "/?":
                    PrintUsage();
                    Environment.Exit(0);
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentException("未知参数 " + args[i]);
            }
        }
        return o;
    }

    private static void PrintUsage()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("rbtempguard -- 把临时文件/软件缓存排除出 RAMBlockCache 写缓存");
        sb.AppendLine("用法:");
        sb.AppendLine("  rbtempguard --drive C [--watch 秒] [--dir <额外目录>] [--dry-run] [-v]");
        sb.AppendLine("  rbtempguard --drive C --clear        清空该卷排除集（恢复全量缓存）");
        sb.AppendLine("默认目录: %TEMP%, %LOCALAPPDATA%\\Temp, %SystemRoot%\\Temp,");
        sb.AppendLine("          INetCache, Chrome/Edge Cache+Code Cache, Firefox Profiles");
        Console.Error.Write(sb.ToString());
    }
}
````

### 8.9 唯一构建入口（4 文件 / 50700 B）

##### `build/build.ps1`

````powershell
# build.ps1 -- THE single build entry point for the repository.
#
# Product chains (everything else is a shim that calls this script):
#   driver     RAMBlockCache.sys        (cl+link, reads sources.manifest.json)
#   core       tests/core regression    (Release + ASan, build + run)
#   core-asan  ASan only
#   ctl        ramboostctl.exe / rbfeatctl.exe (+ contract string check)
#   setup      ramboostsetup.exe to temp (never overwrites the signed one)
#   ui         dotnet solution build/RAMBlockCache.sln
#   web        npm run build in src/ui/web
#   gates      Gate1..Gate22 + models (local, strict signature)
#   all        driver + core + ctl + setup + ui + web
#   clean      remove intermediate build outputs (never dist/, never signed exes)
#
# Contract:
#   - No source list may be inlined here: it comes from build/sources.manifest.json.
#   - The driver output is UNSIGNED by design. Never deploy without signtool.
#   - Exit code is fail-closed: any non-zero step aborts the target.
#
# ASCII only (PS 5.1 GBK console lesson). Requires PowerShell 5.1+.
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet('all', 'driver', 'core', 'core-asan', 'ctl', 'setup', 'ui', 'web', 'gates', 'clean')]
    [string]$Target = 'all',
    [switch]$NoRun,
    [string]$OutFile = ''
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'paths.ps1')

$script:Failures = 0

function Fail([string]$Message) {
    Write-Host "[X] $Message" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

function Step([string]$Message) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "=== $Message ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}

function Invoke-Native([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Arguments, [string]$LogPath) {
    & $Exe @Arguments > $LogPath 2>&1
    return $LASTEXITCODE
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# driver
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Build-Driver {
    Step 'driver: RAMBlockCache.sys'
    $t = $Manifest.targets.driver
    $workRel = ($t.workDir -replace '/', '\')
    $wd = Join-Path $RepoRoot $workRel
    $outRel = ($t.outDir.Substring($t.workDir.Length).TrimStart('/') -replace '/', '\')
    $objRel = Join-Path $outRel 'obj'

    Set-ToolchainEnv 'kernel'
    Push-Location $wd
    try {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $objRel | Out-Null
        # Link pulls $objRel\*.obj implicitly through the explicit list below; a
        # source deleted since the last build must not survive as a stale object.
        # [2026-11-12] Changed from `Get-ChildItem | Remove-Item -Force` to an
        # explicit foreach: on hosts with a safe-delete hook, the wrapped
        # Remove-Item does not accept pipeline input ("command cannot take
        # pipeline input") and the build aborts before compiling anything.
        # Passing -LiteralPath explicitly is semantically identical and also
        # handles the empty-set case that the old pipeline form left implicit.
        foreach ($o in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $objRel -Filter '*.obj' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $o.FullName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
        # Deterministic link [154]: link.exe REUSES an existing PDB and bumps the
        # CodeView RSDS Age, so the image differs on every rebuild even with
        # /Brepro (measured 2026-11-11: Age 26->27->28 across three builds of
        # identical sources). Start from no PDB so Age is always 1 and the GUID
        # stays content-derived. Verified: two consecutive links byte-identical.
        # Same reason as above: both pdb sweeps are explicit foreach loops.
        foreach ($p in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $outRel -Filter '*.pdb' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p.FullName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
        foreach ($p in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '.' -Filter '*.pdb' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p.FullName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }

        $inc = @()
        foreach ($d in $t.compile.includes) { $inc += "/I" + (Get-RelFrom $t.workDir $d) }
        $defs = @()
        foreach ($d in $t.compile.defines) { $defs += "/D$d" }
        $wds = @()
        foreach ($w in $t.compile.disabledWarnings) { $wds += "/wd$w" }
        $common = @($t.compile.flags) + @($t.compile.standard) + $defs + $wds + $inc

        Write-Host ("  sources: {0} (manifest)  includes: {1}" -f $t.sources.Count, ($t.compile.includes -join ', '))
        $objs = @()
        foreach ($s in $t.sources) {
            $srcRel = $s -replace '/', '\'
            $stem = Get-Stem $srcRel
            $log = Join-Path $objRel "$stem.cl.log"
            $rc = Invoke-Native (Join-Path $Msvc 'bin\Hostx64\x64\cl.exe') ($common + @(("/Fo{0}\" -f $objRel), $srcRel)) $log
            if ($rc -ne 0) {
                Write-Host "  [X] $srcRel (exit $rc)" -ForegroundColor Red
                Get-Content -LiteralPath $log | Select-Object -First 12
                Fail "driver compile failed: $srcRel"
            }
            $obj = Join-Path $objRel "$stem.obj"
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $obj)) { Fail "compiler produced no object for $srcRel" }
            $objs += $obj
            Write-Host "  [ok] $srcRel"
        }

        $libRel = (Get-RelFrom $t.workDir ($t.link.libDir))
        $linkArgs = @($t.link.flags) + @("/LIBPATH:$libRel") + $t.link.libs +
                    @("/OUT:$outRel\$($t.output)") + $objs
        $linkLog = Join-Path $outRel 'link.log'
        $rc = Invoke-Native (Join-Path $Msvc 'bin\Hostx64\x64\link.exe') $linkArgs $linkLog
        if ($rc -ne 0) {
            Get-Content -LiteralPath $linkLog | Select-Object -First 20
            Fail "driver link failed (exit $rc)"
        }

        $sys = Join-Path $outRel $t.output
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sys)) { Fail "link produced no $($t.output)" }
        Write-Host "  BUILD OK"
        $h = Write-Sha256 $sys
        Write-Host "  NOTE: UNSIGNED. Sign before deploy; then re-sync the anchors:"
        foreach ($a in $t.deployAnchors) { Write-Host "        $a" }
        return $h
    }
    finally { Pop-Location }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# core regression (Release and/or ASan)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Build-Core([ValidateSet('both', 'release', 'asan')][string]$Mode = 'both') {
    Step "core: regression ($Mode)"
    $c = $Manifest.targets.core
    $workRel = ($c.workDir -replace '/', '\')
    $wd = Join-Path $RepoRoot $workRel
    # [162 2026-11-12] No hardcoded 'build': the out dir comes from the manifest,
    # same source qa_paths.ps1 uses (targets.core.outDir). 161 section 4.3: a
    # manifest outDir change used to split this script from every QA driver.
    if (-not $c.outDir.StartsWith($c.workDir)) {
        Fail "manifest targets.core.outDir '$($c.outDir)' is not under workDir '$($c.workDir)'"
    }
    $buildRel = ($c.outDir.Substring($c.workDir.Length).TrimStart('/') -replace '/', '\')

    Set-ToolchainEnv 'user'
    Push-Location $wd
    try {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $buildRel | Out-Null
        # cl resolves quoted #include relative to the SOURCE FILE DIR only when
        # the source is named without a directory prefix; a "..\..\tests\core\"
        # prefix makes /I. fail to cover the include of the sibling stub headers.
        # Pass bare names and put the work dir on the include path (dbg A-D round).
        # NOTE: build with += elements, NOT @('a'+f(), 'b') inline construction:
        # 'string' + Object[] there coerces the array to one space-joined token
        # ("/I..\..\src\core /I.") and cl then loses both include dirs.
        $inc = @()
        $inc += '/I' + (Get-RelFrom $c.workDir 'src/core')
        $inc += '/I.'

        $hosts = @($Manifest.tests.hosts | Where-Object { $_.suite -eq 'regression' })
        $built = @()
        $skipped = 0
        foreach ($h in $hosts) {
            if ($h.skip) { Write-Host "[SKIP] $($h.name) : $($h.skip)"; $skipped++; continue }
            $engine = @()
            foreach ($e in $c.engineSources) { $engine += (Get-RelFrom $c.workDir $e) }
            if ($h.extraSources) { foreach ($e in $h.extraSources) { $engine += (Get-RelFrom $c.workDir $e) } }
            $srcName = (Get-BaseName $h.file)
            $srcArgs = @($srcName) + $engine
            $defs = @()
            if ($h.defines) { foreach ($d in $h.defines) { $defs += "/D$d" } }

            if ($Mode -ne 'asan') {
                $exe = "$buildRel\$($h.name).exe"
                $log = "$buildRel\$($h.name).rc.log"
                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $exe -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                $rc = Invoke-Native 'cl.exe' (@($c.compile.release) + $inc + $defs + $srcArgs + @("/Fe:$exe", "/Fo$buildRel\")) $log
                if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) {
                    Get-Content -LiteralPath $log | Select-Object -First 10
                    Fail "release build failed: $($h.name)"
                }
                $built += $h.name
                Write-Host "  [ok-rel] $($h.name)"
            }
            if ($Mode -ne 'release') {
                $exe = "$buildRel\asan_$($h.name).exe"
                $log = "$buildRel\asan_$($h.name).rc.log"
                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $exe -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                $rc = Invoke-Native 'cl.exe' (@($c.compile.asan) + $inc + $defs + $srcArgs + @("/Fe:$exe", "/Fo$buildRel\")) $log
                if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) {
                    Get-Content -LiteralPath $log | Select-Object -First 10
                    Fail "ASan build failed: $($h.name)"
                }
                $built += "asan_$($h.name)"
                Write-Host "  [ok-asan] $($h.name)"
            }
        }
        Write-Host ("  compiled={0} skipped={1}" -f $built.Count, $skipped)

        if ($NoRun) { Write-Host '  -NoRun: skipping execution'; return }
        Step "core: run ($Mode)"
        $runFail = 0
        foreach ($n in $built) {
            $exe = "$buildRel\$n.exe"
            # check_repo pairs the Release log as rel_<t>.out and the ASan log as
            # asan_<t>.out; keep those exact names (R9-15 lesson: a renamed log
            # makes the freshness gate read a stale file forever).
            $out = if ($n -like 'asan_*') { "$buildRel\$n.out" } else { "$buildRel\rel_$n.out" }
            $err = if ($n -like 'asan_*') { "$buildRel\$n.err" } else { "$buildRel\rel_$n.err" }
            & $exe > $out 2> $err
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                Write-Host "  [X] $n exit=$LASTEXITCODE" -ForegroundColor Red
                Get-Content -LiteralPath $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 8
                $runFail++
            }
        }
        if ($runFail -gt 0) { Fail "$runFail core host(s) exited non-zero" }
        Write-Host "  RUN_FAIL=0"
    }
    finally { Pop-Location }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ctl
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Build-Ctl {
    Step 'ctl: ramboostctl.exe / rbfeatctl.exe'
    $t = $Manifest.targets.ctl
    $workRel = ($t.workDir -replace '/', '\')
    $wd = Join-Path $RepoRoot $workRel
    Set-ToolchainEnv 'user'
    Push-Location $wd
    try {
        foreach ($n in @('ramboostctl.c', 'bench_policy.c', 'rbfeatctl.c')) {
            Assert-Path (Join-Path $wd $n) "ctl source $n"
        }
        foreach ($p in $t.products) {
            $inc = @()
            foreach ($d in $t.compile.includes) { $inc += '/I' + (Get-RelFrom $t.workDir $d) }
            $args = @($t.compile.flags) + $inc + @($p.sources) + @("/Fe:$($p.output)") + @($p.libs)
            $log = "build_$($p.output).log"
            $rc = Invoke-Native 'cl.exe' $args $log
            if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $wd $p.output))) {
                Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 10
                Fail "ctl build failed: $($p.output)"
            }
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $log -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if ($p.requiredStrings) {
                $txt = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path $wd $p.output)))
                foreach ($k in $p.requiredStrings) {
                    if (-not $txt.Contains($k)) { Fail "$($p.output) is missing required string '$k' (stale/misbuilt)" }
                }
                Write-Host ("  [ok] {0} carries {1} contract strings" -f $p.output, $p.requiredStrings.Count)
            }
            Write-Sha256 (Join-Path $wd $p.output) | Out-Null
        }
        Write-Host '  CTL BUILD OK'
    }
    finally { Pop-Location }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# setup (verification-only by default)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Build-Setup {
    Step 'setup: ramboostsetup.exe (temp by default)'
    $t = $Manifest.targets.setup
    $workRel = ($t.workDir -replace '/', '\')
    $wd = Join-Path $RepoRoot $workRel
    $p = $t.products[0]
    Set-ToolchainEnv 'user'

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($OutFile)) {
        $tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('rbc-setup-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tmp | Out-Null
        $dest = Join-Path $tmp $p.output
    }
    else {
        $dest = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($OutFile)
        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dest
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null }
        Write-Host "  WARNING: -OutFile given; this may overwrite a signed engine." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }

    Push-Location $wd
    try {
        $inc = @()
        foreach ($d in $t.compile.includes) { $inc += '/I' + (Get-RelFrom $t.workDir $d) }
        $tmpExe = 'rbc_setup_build.exe'
        $args = @($t.compile.flags) + $inc + @($p.sources) +
                @("/Fe:$tmpExe", "/Fo:rbc_setup_build.obj", '/link') + @($p.libs)
        $log = 'rbc_setup_build.log'
        $rc = Invoke-Native 'cl.exe' $args $log
        try {
            if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmpExe)) {
                Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 10
                Fail 'setup build failed'
            }
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $tmpExe -Destination $dest -Force
        }
        finally {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmpExe -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'rbc_setup_build.obj' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $log -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
        Write-Sha256 $dest | Out-Null
        Write-Host "  OUT=$dest"
        Write-Host '  NOTE: verification-only; the signed delivered engine is untouched.'
    }
    finally { Pop-Location }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ui (.NET solution)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Build-Ui {
    Step 'ui: dotnet solution'
    $sln = Join-Path $BuildRoot 'RAMBlockCache.sln'
    Assert-Path $sln 'solution file'
    $dotnet = Set-DotnetEnv
    Push-Location $RepoRoot
    try {
        & $dotnet build $sln -c Release --nologo
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Fail "dotnet build failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
    }
    finally { Pop-Location }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# web
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Build-Web {
    Step 'web: npm run build'
    $t = $Manifest.targets.web
    $wd = Join-Path $RepoRoot ($t.workDir -replace '/', '\')
    Assert-Path $wd 'web project dir'
    Push-Location $wd
    try {
        & npm run build
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Fail "npm run build failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
    }
    finally { Pop-Location }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# gates
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Gates {
    Step 'gates: static contracts + signature (local, strict)'
    Push-Location $RepoRoot
    try {
        $py = @(
            @('src/scripts/check_repo.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_proto_sync.py', @('--strict')),
            @('deliverables/gstack/model/refcount_model.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_xaml_resources.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_node_contract.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_geom_contract.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_stats_contract.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_ctl_freshness.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_blocksize_contract.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_installer_contract.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_config_decode_contract.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_poolcopy_contract.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_buffer_write_contract.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_layout.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_build_manifest.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_ioctl_registry.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_proto_codegen.py', @()),
            # [Gate23 2026-11-14] C <-> TS protocol parity for Web/Bridge layer.
            @('src/scripts/check_ts_proto_sync.py', @()),
            @('src/scripts/check_l2_contract.py', @()),
            # [Gate21 2026-11-13] Whole-repo heuristic sweep: 30 defect classes
            # (C01-08 / T01-08 / S01-08 / P01-06). Fails on HIGH only: MED/LOW are
            # leads for human triage, not build blockers. Rules are heuristic, so
            # HIGH=0 means "no high-confidence defect of these classes", not "clean".
            # Single round: python tools/audit_sweep.py --round C08 [--json out.json]
            # NOTE: this file is ASCII-only on purpose (PS 5.1 GBK console) -- no CJK.
            @('tools/audit_sweep.py', @('--all', '--fail-on-high')),
            # [Gate22 2026-11-13] Deliverable numbering contract: every "next number"
            # claim in AGENTS.md / HANDOVER-CURRENT.md must equal real max + 1.
            # It was stuck at 143/144 while deliverables/ was at 221, and
            # 144-*.md already existed -- i.e. the protocol told readers to
            # overwrite a real report. Docs that instruct wrong actions are gated.
            @('src/scripts/check_docs_numbering.py', @()),
            # [A4 2026-11-16] BootLoopGuard pre-req: RbRegSetClean(1) must have exactly
            # ONE call site (rbmsg.c shutdown path) and the "a volume was attached at
            # least once this boot" gate must stay inside the RbRegSetClean body
            # (count -> v==0 && !BootAttachedAny -> LastCleanWithheld + return).
            # Without it, a boot that never attached a volume still reports clean=1
            # (dirty==0 is trivially true) and fails>=2 can never hold -- 269 A4.
            @('src/scripts/check_a4_clean_gate.py', @()),
            # [v2 2026-11-16] Shutdown persist wiring: RbShutdownPersist must keep
            # the order Quiesce -> Flush -> HotSnapshot -> IdxSaveGuarded ->
            # RegSetClean, the one-shot latch must survive (259 F1 hiberfile
            # restore), RbDispatchShutdownDiag must stop Rb2Tick BEFORE persisting
            # (259 F3) and must de-dup on g_Rb.ControlDevice (268 B6), and
            # RbL2Close must never appear in the persist body. Details in 271.
            @('src/scripts/check_shutdown_persist_order.py', @()),
            # [Gate24 2026-11-17] SUP-01 (why, skip) code table exists in THREE
            # files: the C switch (rbmsg.c), the PS acceptance reader and the
            # Python evidence reader. A4-d added WHY_WITHHELD=7 ->
            # SKIP_CLEAN_WITHHELD=9 and neither reader knew: the Python verdict
            # was built on a boot-reset key, and the PS table printed UNKNOWN
            # for the one outcome A4-d exposes. This gate pins the three copies
            # key-for-key and code-for-code (275).
            @('src/scripts/check_sup01_tables.py', @()),
            # [Gate25 2026-11-18] Control-plane closure for the two new codes
            # 0x906 (read-only shutdown diag) and 0x907 (health commit, V10.5 3.1).
            # Gate17 compares declarations only: a code that is declared on both
            # sides but never dispatched passes it silently. This one pins
            # declare -> dispatch -> user-mode consumer, forbids double dispatch
            # (forward chain vs RbCtl* handler), keeps the 24-byte diag struct
            # layout equal on both sides, whitelists every BootFailCount clear
            # site, and checks the why/skip tables in the CLI mirror against the
            # authoritative ones (rbmsg.c / rb_common.h). 16 mutations, all KILL.
            @('src/scripts/check_ctl_codes.py', @())
        )
        foreach ($g in $py) {
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $g[0])) { Fail "gate script missing: $($g[0])" }
            $rc = Invoke-Native 'python' (@($g[0]) + $g[1]) (Join-Path $env:TEMP ('rbc-gate-' + (Get-Stem $g[0]) + '.log'))
            if ($rc -ne 0) {
                Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:TEMP ('rbc-gate-' + (Get-Stem $g[0]) + '.log')) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 15
                Fail "gate FAILED: $($g[0])"
            }
            Write-Host "  [ok] $($g[0])"
        }
        $ps = @('src/scripts/check_ps_syntax.ps1', 'src/scripts/check_signature.ps1')
        foreach ($g in $ps) {
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $g)) { Fail "gate script missing: $g" }
            & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $g
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Fail "gate FAILED: $g" }
            Write-Host "  [ok] $g"
        }
        Write-Host '  ALL GATES PASS'
    }
    finally { Pop-Location }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# clean
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Clean {
    Step 'clean: intermediates only'
    $targets = @(
        'src/driver/x64',
        $Manifest.targets.core.outDir,
        'src/setup/rbc_setup_build.obj',
        'src/ctl/build_ramboostctl.exe.log',
        'src/ctl/build_rbfeatctl.exe.log'
    )
    foreach ($rel in $targets) {
        $p = Join-Path $RepoRoot ($rel -replace '/', '\')
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Recurse -Force
            Write-Host "  removed $rel"
        }
    }
    Write-Host '  NOTE: dist/, signed .sys, CLI exes and node_modules are preserved.'
}

switch ($Target) {
    'driver'    { Build-Driver | Out-Null }
    'core'      { Build-Core 'both' }
    'core-asan' { Build-Core 'asan' }
    'ctl'       { Build-Ctl }
    'setup'     { Build-Setup }
    'ui'        { Build-Ui }
    'web'       { Build-Web }
    'gates'     { Invoke-Gates }
    'clean'     { Invoke-Clean }
    'all' {
        Build-Driver | Out-Null
        Build-Core 'both'
        Build-Ctl
        Build-Ui
        Build-Web
        Build-Setup
    }
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host "BUILD TARGET '$Target' OK"
exit 0
````

##### `build/paths.ps1`

````powershell
# paths.ps1 -- repo path + toolchain constants, dot-sourced by build/build.ps1.
# ASCII only (PS 5.1 reads BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI; repo path itself is non-ASCII).
#
# Rule: no build script may hardcode a source list, an include dir, or a
# toolchain root. Everything comes from sources.manifest.json through here.

$BuildRoot    = $PSScriptRoot
$RepoRoot     = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$ManifestPath = Join-Path $BuildRoot 'sources.manifest.json'

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ManifestPath)) {
    throw "sources.manifest.json missing: $ManifestPath"
}
$Manifest  = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($ManifestPath, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8) | ConvertFrom-Json
$Toolchain = $Manifest.toolchain
$Msvc      = $Toolchain.msvcRoot
$WinSdk    = $Toolchain.winSdkRoot
$SdkVer    = $Toolchain.winSdkVersion
$Wdk       = Join-Path $RepoRoot ($Toolchain.wdkRoot -replace '/', '\')

function Assert-Path([string]$Path, [string]$What) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { throw "$What missing: $Path" }
}

function Get-RepoPath([string]$Relative) {
    return (Join-Path $RepoRoot ($Relative -replace '/', '\'))
}

# Relative path from a repo-relative work dir to a repo-relative target.
# Example: workDir=src/driver, target=src/core -> ..\..\src\core
function Get-RelFrom([string]$WorkDir, [string]$Target) {
    $depth = @($WorkDir -split '/').Count
    return (('..\' * $depth) + ($Target -replace '/', '\'))
}

function Get-BaseName([string]$Path) {
    return (($Path -replace '/', '\').Split('\')[-1])
}

function Get-Stem([string]$Path) {
    $n = Get-BaseName $Path
    return [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($n)
}

# Toolchain env for the compiler/linker.
#   Mode=user   : SDK ucrt/um/shared (cl.exe for user-mode exes)
#   Mode=kernel : WDK km + SDK shared/ucrt (WDM driver)
function Set-ToolchainEnv([ValidateSet('user', 'kernel')][string]$Mode) {
    Assert-Path $Msvc 'MSVC root'
    Assert-Path $WinSdk 'Windows SDK root'
    Assert-Path (Join-Path $Msvc 'bin\Hostx64\x64\cl.exe') 'cl.exe'

    $sdkInc = Join-Path $WinSdk "Include\$SdkVer"
    $sdkLib = Join-Path $WinSdk "Lib\$SdkVer"
    if ($Mode -eq 'kernel') {
        Assert-Path $Wdk 'WDK package root'
        $wdkInc = Join-Path $Wdk "Include\$SdkVer"
        $wdkLib = Join-Path $Wdk "Lib\$SdkVer\km\x64"
        Assert-Path $wdkInc 'WDK include dir'
        Assert-Path $wdkLib 'WDK kernel lib dir'
        $env:INCLUDE = "$sdkInc\shared;$sdkInc\ucrt;$wdkInc\km;$wdkInc\shared;$Msvc\include"
        $env:LIB     = "$wdkLib;$Msvc\lib\x64"
    }
    else {
        Assert-Path $sdkInc 'SDK include dir'
        Assert-Path $sdkLib 'SDK lib dir'
        $env:INCLUDE = "$Msvc\include;$sdkInc\ucrt;$sdkInc\um;$sdkInc\shared"
        $env:LIB     = "$Msvc\lib\x64;$sdkLib\ucrt\x64;$sdkLib\um\x64"
    }
    $env:PATH = "$Msvc\bin\HostX64\x64;$env:SystemRoot\System32;$env:SystemRoot;$env:PATH"
}

function Write-Sha256([string]$Path) {
    $h = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    $len = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path).Length
    Write-Host ("  {0} | size={1} | sha256={2}" -f (Get-BaseName $Path), $len, $h)
    return $h
}

# .NET SDK resolution.
# The machine-wide C:\Program Files\dotnet host has NO sdk\ folder on this host
# (only the runtime), so `dotnet build` there reports "No .NET SDKs were found".
# Prefer any dotnet.exe that actually owns an sdk\ directory next to it.
function Resolve-Dotnet {
    $candidates = @()
    if ($env:DOTNET_ROOT) { $candidates += (Join-Path $env:DOTNET_ROOT 'dotnet.exe') }
    $candidates += (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dotnet\dotnet.exe')
    $candidates += 'C:\Program Files\dotnet\dotnet.exe'
    foreach ($c in $candidates) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $c)) { continue }
        $sdkDir = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $c) 'sdk'
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sdkDir) { return $c }
    }
    return $null
}

function Set-DotnetEnv {
    $exe = Resolve-Dotnet
    if (-not $exe) {
        throw 'no .NET SDK found (looked for DOTNET_ROOT, %USERPROFILE%\.dotnet, C:\Program Files\dotnet)'
    }
    $root = Split-Path -Parent $exe
    $env:DOTNET_ROOT = $root
    $env:PATH = "$root;$env:PATH"
    return $exe
}
````
