### 8.10 core QA 与端到端（91 文件 / 937142 B）

##### `tests/core/bench_5g.c`

````c
/*
 * RAMBoostFS 5GB 量级基准（Linux/gcc 可编译运行）
 *
 * 目的：在 5GB 工作集上量化"裸盘直写/直读"与"RAMBoostFS 缓存"的差距，
 * 检验延迟写入（写吸收）、回写合并、读命中的实际收益。
 *
 * 方法：纯模拟磁盘（只计延迟、不做真实存储）。数据正确性由测试套件
 * （test_v6 等）保证，基准只测时间，因此结果不受宿主真实磁盘/内存污染，
 * 干净、可复现。
 *
 * 磁盘模型（模拟主流笔记本 NVMe，参数可调，见下）：
 *  - 顺序带宽 3.5 GB/s；
 *  - 随机 IO：4K 单次 200us（≈5000 IOPS 单队列），64K 按 1.5GB/s 与 200us 取大；
 *  - 内存命中：纯 memcpy（宿主内存速度）。
 *
 * 口径：这是"核心引擎"在模拟磁盘上的架构收益；PrimoCache 同机对比需在
 * Windows 上用附带的 diskspd 脚本实测（见 docs/12）。
 *
 * 工作集 5GB：
 *  W1 顺序写 5GB（512K 块）
 *  W2 随机 64K 写 2GB（地址在 5GB 内）
 *  W3 随机 4K 写 512MB（地址在 5GB 内）
 *  R1 顺序重读 5GB（热）
 *  R2 随机 64K 读 2GB（热）
 */

#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#define WORKSET (5ull * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
static unsigned g_cache_mb = 16384u;   /* 默认 16GB（用户机器）；小内存机器可传参 */

#define SEQ_BW       (3.5e9)   /* 顺序 3.5GB/s，字节/秒 */
#define RND_LAT_NS   (200000)  /* 随机 IO 固定延迟 200us */
#define RND64_BW     (1.5e9)   /* 随机 64K 带宽 */

/* ---------------- 时钟 ---------------- */
static rb_u64 now_ns(void)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (rb_u64)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + ts.tv_nsec;
}
static void sleep_ns(rb_u64 ns)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    if (ns < 1000) return;
    ts.tv_sec = (time_t)(ns / 1000000000ull);
    ts.tv_nsec = (long)(ns % 1000000000ull);
    nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
}

/* ---------------- 模拟磁盘（纯计时） ---------------- */
static rb_u64 g_disk_next_seq;   /* 顺序预期位置 */

static void disk_cost(rb_u64 off, size_t len)
{
    rb_u64 sequential = (off == g_disk_next_seq);
    rb_u64 cost;
    if (sequential) {
        cost = (rb_u64)((double)len / SEQ_BW * 1e9);
    } else {
        rb_u64 lat = RND_LAT_NS;
        rb_u64 bw = (len >= 64 * 1024)
                    ? (rb_u64)((double)len / RND64_BW * 1e9) : 0;
        cost = lat > bw ? lat : bw;
    }
    g_disk_next_seq = off + len;
    sleep_ns(cost);
}

/* 核心回调：写盘 / 读盘（核心 flush 与 RMW 走这里）。纯计时，不做真实存储。 */
static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id; (void)data;
    disk_cost(off, len);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    disk_cost(off, len);
    memset(buf, 0, len);
    return 0;
}

/* 直写路径：模拟应用直接写盘 / 读盘 */
static void direct_write(rb_u64 off, const void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)buf;
    disk_cost(off, len);
}
static void direct_read(rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    disk_cost(off, len);
    memset(buf, 0xAB, len);
}

/* ---------------- 随机偏移序列（可复现） ---------------- */
static rb_u64 rng_state = 0x123456789abcdef0ull;
static rb_u64 rnd_u64(void)
{
    rng_state ^= rng_state << 13;
    rng_state ^= rng_state >> 7;
    rng_state ^= rng_state << 17;
    return rng_state;
}
static rb_u64 rnd_off(rb_u64 block)
{
    return (rnd_u64() % (WORKSET / block)) * block;
}

/* ---------------- 辅助：写核心（直写区间在真实驱动里直接落盘，这里计为磁盘成本） ---------------- */
static void core_write(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 off, const void *buf, size_t len)
{
    rb_direct_range direct[64]; int dc = 0;
    int k;
    rb_write(s, off, buf, len, direct, &dc, 64);
    for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
        disk_cost(direct[k].offset, direct[k].len);
}

static void core_read(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    rb_direct_range miss[64]; int mc = 0;
    int k;
    rb_read(s, off, buf, len, miss, &mc, 64);
    for (k = 0; k < mc; k++) {
        char *tmp = (char *)malloc(miss[k].len);
        disk_cost(miss[k].offset, miss[k].len);
        memset(tmp, 0, miss[k].len);
        rb_read_commit(s, miss[k].offset, tmp, miss[k].len);
        {
            rb_u64 lo = miss[k].offset > off ? miss[k].offset : off;
            rb_u64 hi = (miss[k].offset + miss[k].len < off + len)
                        ? miss[k].offset + miss[k].len : off + len;
            if (hi > lo)
                memcpy((char *)buf + (lo - off),
                       tmp + (lo - miss[k].offset), hi - lo);
        }
        free(tmp);
    }
}

/* ---------------- 场景 ---------------- */
static void *g_blk;      /* 复用块缓冲 */
static size_t g_blkcap = 512 * 1024;

static rb_u64 run_direct(int mode)
{
    rb_u64 t0 = now_ns();
    rb_u64 i;
    if (mode == 0) {                       /* W1 顺序写 5GB */
        for (i = 0; i < WORKSET; i += 512 * 1024)
            direct_write(i, g_blk, 512 * 1024);
    } else if (mode == 1) {                /* W2 随机 64K 写 2GB */
        for (i = 0; i < 2ull * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; i += 64 * 1024)
            direct_write(rnd_off(64 * 1024), g_blk, 64 * 1024);
    } else if (mode == 2) {                /* W3 随机 4K 写 512MB */
        for (i = 0; i < 512ull * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096)
            direct_write(rnd_off(4096), g_blk, 4096);
    } else if (mode == 3) {                /* R1 顺序读 5GB */
        for (i = 0; i < WORKSET; i += 512 * 1024)
            direct_read(i, g_blk, 512 * 1024);
    } else {                               /* R2 随机 64K 读 2GB */
        for (i = 0; i < 2ull * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; i += 64 * 1024)
            direct_read(rnd_off(64 * 1024), g_blk, 64 * 1024);
    }
    return now_ns() - t0;
}

/* 缓存模式：front=前台完成时间（写吸收），返回值=含后台回写总时间 */
static rb_u64 run_cached(int mode, rb_u64 *front)
{
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    rb_u64 t0 = now_ns(), t1;
    rb_u64 i;

    cfg.max_bytes = (rb_u64)g_cache_mb * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 1);

    if (mode == 0) {
        for (i = 0; i < WORKSET; i += 512 * 1024)
            core_write(s, i, g_blk, 512 * 1024);
    } else if (mode == 1) {
        for (i = 0; i < 2ull * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; i += 64 * 1024)
            core_write(s, rnd_off(64 * 1024), g_blk, 64 * 1024);
    } else if (mode == 2) {
        for (i = 0; i < 512ull * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096)
            core_write(s, rnd_off(4096), g_blk, 4096);
    } else if (mode == 3) {
        for (i = 0; i < WORKSET; i += 512 * 1024)
            core_read(s, i, g_blk, 512 * 1024);
    } else {
        for (i = 0; i < 2ull * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; i += 64 * 1024)
            core_read(s, rnd_off(64 * 1024), g_blk, 64 * 1024);
    }
    t1 = now_ns();
    *front = t1 - t0;

    /* 后台回写（写场景）：把脏数据落盘 */
    if (mode < 3)
        rb_engine_flush(eng, 1);

    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
    return now_ns() - t0;
}

static const char *NAMES[5] = {
    "W1 顺序写 5GB", "W2 随机64K写 2GB", "W3 随机4K写 512MB",
    "R1 顺序读 5GB(热)", "R2 随机64K读 2GB(热)"
};

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    int m;
    if (argc >= 2) {
        unsigned v = (unsigned)strtoul(argv[1], NULL, 10);
        if (v >= 256) g_cache_mb = v;
    }

    g_blk = malloc(g_blkcap);
    if (!g_blk) { printf("分配失败\n"); return 1; }
    memset(g_blk, 0xAB, g_blkcap);

    printf("RAMBoostFS 5GB 基准（缓存 %uMB；模拟 NVMe：顺序3.5GB/s / 随机4K 200us / 随机64K 1.5GB/s）\n",
           g_cache_mb);
    printf("%-22s %12s %12s %12s %10s\n",
           "场景", "裸盘(ms)", "缓存前台(ms)", "缓存含回写", "前台加速");

    for (m = 0; m < 5; m++) {
        rb_u64 td, tc, tf;
        g_disk_next_seq = 0; rng_state = 0x123456789abcdef0ull;
        td = run_direct(m);
        g_disk_next_seq = 0; rng_state = 0x123456789abcdef0ull;
        tc = run_cached(m, &tf);
        printf("%-22s %12.0f %12.0f %12.0f %9.1fx\n",
               NAMES[m], td / 1e6, tf / 1e6, tc / 1e6,
               (double)td / (double)tf);
    }
    printf("\n说明：\n");
    printf(" - 缓存前台=应用实际等待时间（写吸收/读命中）；缓存含回写=含后台落盘总时间。\n");
    printf(" - 缓存小于数据集时，写满后前台按磁盘速度回写（属正常）；缓存≥数据集时写全吸收。\n");
    printf(" - 写场景含回写时间与裸盘接近（数据最终都要落盘），但应用在前台已完成，\n");
    printf("   编译/解压等突发写不再被磁盘阻塞；读场景热数据由内存服务。\n");
    printf(" - 这是核心引擎在模拟磁盘上的架构收益；PrimoCache 同机对比见 docs/12 的 diskspd 脚本。\n");

    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/bench_read_plan.c`

````c
/* User-mode read-plan microbenchmark. Memory-only; no volume/driver IO. */
#include "cache.h"
#include "read_plan.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <windows.h>

#define MAX_MISS 32
#define SUB_SIZE 4096ULL
#define SPARSE_SUBS 67
#define SPARSE_LEN (SPARSE_SUBS * SUB_SIZE)
#define MAX_SOURCE (64ULL * 1024 * 1024)

static unsigned char *g_source;
static LARGE_INTEGER g_qpc;

static int writeback_noop(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 offset,
                          const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id; (void)offset; (void)data; (void)len;
    return 0;
}

static rb_engine *make_engine(rb_u64 max_bytes)
{
    rb_config config;
    memset(&config, 0, sizeof(config));
    config.max_bytes = max_bytes;
    config.block_size = SUB_SIZE;
    config.writeback = writeback_noop;
    return rb_engine_create(&config);
}

static double now_us(void)
{
    LARGE_INTEGER now;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    return (double)now.QuadPart * 1000000.0 / (double)g_qpc.QuadPart;
}

static int compare_double(const void *a, const void *b)
{
    double da = *(const double *)a, db = *(const double *)b;
    return da < db ? -1 : da > db ? 1 : 0;
}

static double percentile(double *values, int count, double p)
{
    int rank;
    qsort(values, (size_t)count, sizeof(double), compare_double);
    rank = (int)ceil(p * count) - 1;
    if (rank < 0) rank = 0;
    if (rank >= count) rank = count - 1;
    return values[rank];
}

static double median_of(const double *values, int count)
{
    double *copy = (double *)malloc((size_t)count * sizeof(double));
    double result;
    memcpy(copy, values, (size_t)count * sizeof(double));
    qsort(copy, (size_t)count, sizeof(double), compare_double);
    result = copy[count / 2];
    free(copy);
    return result;
}

static double p95_of(const double *values, int count)
{
    double *copy = (double *)malloc((size_t)count * sizeof(double));
    double result;
    memcpy(copy, values, (size_t)count * sizeof(double));
    result = percentile(copy, count, 0.95);
    free(copy);
    return result;
}

static double mbps(size_t bytes, double us)
{
    return us > 0 ? (double)bytes * 1000000.0 / (us * 1048576.0) : 0.0;
}

typedef struct _HOT_CASE {
    rb_engine *engine;
    rb_stream *stream;
    rb_u64 offset;
    size_t length;
    unsigned char *out;
} HOT_CASE;

static int hot_single(HOT_CASE *c)
{
    rb_direct_range miss[MAX_MISS];
    int count = 0, rc;
    rc = rb_read(c->stream, c->offset, c->out, c->length, miss, &count, MAX_MISS);
    return rc < 0 || count != 0 ? -1 : 0;
}

static int hot_planned(HOT_CASE *c)
{
    rb_u64 cur = c->offset;
    size_t remaining = c->length;
    while (remaining > 0) {
        size_t chunk = rb_read_plan_chunk(cur, remaining);
        rb_direct_range miss[MAX_MISS];
        int count = 0, rc;
        if (chunk == 0) return -1;
        rc = rb_read(c->stream, cur, c->out + (cur - c->offset), chunk,
                     miss, &count, MAX_MISS);
        if (rc < 0 || count != 0) return -2;
        cur += chunk;
        remaining -= chunk;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int measure_hot(const char *name, rb_u64 offset, size_t length,
                       int samples, rb_u64 engine_bytes)
{
    HOT_CASE c;
    double *base = NULL, *planned = NULL;
    size_t pre_len = ((size_t)offset + length + SUB_SIZE - 1) & ~(size_t)(SUB_SIZE - 1);
    int i, failed = 0;
    double base_median, base_p95, plan_median, plan_p95, overhead;
    memset(&c, 0, sizeof(c));
    c.offset = offset;
    c.length = length;
    c.engine = make_engine(engine_bytes);
    if (!c.engine) return 1;
    c.stream = rb_stream_create(c.engine, 100);
    c.out = (unsigned char *)malloc(length);
    base = (double *)malloc((size_t)samples * sizeof(double));
    planned = (double *)malloc((size_t)samples * sizeof(double));
    if (!c.stream || !c.out || !base || !planned) {
        printf("SETUP_ERROR %s allocation\n", name);
        failed = 1;
        goto done;
    }
    rb_read_commit(c.stream, 0, g_source, pre_len);
    if (hot_single(&c) != 0 || hot_planned(&c) != 0 ||
        memcmp(c.out, g_source + offset, length) != 0) {
        printf("SETUP_ERROR %s full-hit fixture\n", name);
        failed = 1;
        goto done;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (hot_single(&c) != 0 || hot_planned(&c) != 0) failed = 1;
    }
    if (failed) goto done;
    for (i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
        double t0 = now_us(), t1, t2;
        if (hot_single(&c) != 0) { failed = 1; goto done; }
        t1 = now_us();
        if (hot_planned(&c) != 0) { failed = 1; goto done; }
        t2 = now_us();
        base[i] = t1 - t0;
        planned[i] = t2 - t1;
        printf("RAW %s sample=%d baseline_us=%.3f planned_us=%.3f\n",
               name, i + 1, base[i], planned[i]);
    }
    base_median = median_of(base, samples);
    base_p95 = p95_of(base, samples);
    plan_median = median_of(planned, samples);
    plan_p95 = p95_of(planned, samples);
    overhead = base_median > 0 ? (plan_median - base_median) * 100.0 / base_median : 0;
    printf("SUMMARY %s samples=%d bytes=%llu baseline_median_us=%.3f baseline_p95_us=%.3f "
           "planned_median_us=%.3f planned_p95_us=%.3f baseline_MBps=%.1f planned_MBps=%.1f overhead_pct=%.2f\n",
           name, samples, (unsigned long long)length, base_median, base_p95,
           plan_median, plan_p95, mbps(length, base_median), mbps(length, plan_median), overhead);
    if (length == MAX_SOURCE) {
        printf("WORST_64MB_CALLS=512 OVERHEAD_GT_5_PCT=%s\n",
               overhead > 5.0 ? "YES" : "NO");
    }

done:
    free(base);
    free(planned);
    free(c.out);
    if (c.stream) rb_stream_destroy(c.stream);
    if (c.engine) rb_engine_destroy(c.engine);
    return failed;
}

static void sparse_preload_even(rb_stream *stream)
{
    unsigned int i;
    for (i = 0; i < SPARSE_SUBS; i += 2)
        rb_read_commit(stream, (rb_u64)i * SUB_SIZE,
                       g_source + (size_t)i * SUB_SIZE, SUB_SIZE);
}

static void sparse_invalidate_odd(rb_stream *stream)
{
    unsigned int i;
    for (i = 1; i < SPARSE_SUBS; i += 2)
        rb_stream_invalidate_range(stream, (rb_u64)i * SUB_SIZE, SUB_SIZE);
}

static int sparse_planned(rb_stream *stream, unsigned char *out)
{
    rb_u64 cur = 0;
    size_t remaining = SPARSE_LEN;
    while (remaining > 0) {
        size_t chunk = rb_read_plan_chunk(cur, remaining);
        rb_direct_range miss[MAX_MISS];
        int count = 0, i, rc;
        if (chunk == 0) return -1;
        rc = rb_read(stream, cur, out + cur, chunk, miss, &count, MAX_MISS);
        if (rc < 0 || count < 0 || count > MAX_MISS) return -2;
        for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            rb_u64 ms = miss[i].offset, me = ms + miss[i].len;
            rb_u64 lo = ms > cur ? ms : cur;
            rb_u64 hi = me < cur + chunk ? me : cur + chunk;
            rb_read_commit(stream, ms, g_source + ms, miss[i].len);
            if (hi > lo) memcpy(out + lo, g_source + lo, (size_t)(hi - lo));
        }
        cur += chunk;
        remaining -= chunk;
    }
    return memcmp(out, g_source, SPARSE_LEN) == 0 ? 0 : -3;
}

static int measure_sparse(int samples)
{
    rb_engine *engine = make_engine(16ULL * 1024 * 1024);
    rb_stream *stream = engine ? rb_stream_create(engine, 200) : NULL;
    unsigned char *out = (unsigned char *)malloc(SPARSE_LEN);
    double *first = (double *)malloc((size_t)samples * sizeof(double));
    double *second = (double *)malloc((size_t)samples * sizeof(double));
    rb_direct_range miss[MAX_MISS];
    int i, failed = 0, count = 0, old_rc;
    if (!engine || !stream || !out || !first || !second) {
        printf("SETUP_ERROR sparse33 allocation\n");
        failed = 1;
        goto done;
    }
    sparse_preload_even(stream);
    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        sparse_invalidate_odd(stream);
        if (sparse_planned(stream, out) != 0 || sparse_planned(stream, out) != 0) {
            failed = 1;
            goto done;
        }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
        double t0, t1, t2;
        sparse_invalidate_odd(stream);
        t0 = now_us();
        if (sparse_planned(stream, out) != 0) { failed = 1; goto done; }
        t1 = now_us();
        if (sparse_planned(stream, out) != 0) { failed = 1; goto done; }
        t2 = now_us();
        first[i] = t1 - t0;
        second[i] = t2 - t1;
        printf("RAW sparse33 sample=%d first_us=%.3f second_us=%.3f\n",
               i + 1, first[i], second[i]);
    }
    {
        double first_median = median_of(first, samples);
        double second_median = median_of(second, samples);
        printf("SUMMARY sparse33 samples=%d bytes=%llu first_median_us=%.3f first_p95_us=%.3f "
               "second_median_us=%.3f second_p95_us=%.3f first_MBps=%.1f second_MBps=%.1f\n",
               samples, (unsigned long long)SPARSE_LEN,
               first_median, p95_of(first, samples), second_median, p95_of(second, samples),
               mbps(SPARSE_LEN, first_median), mbps(SPARSE_LEN, second_median));
    }
    sparse_invalidate_odd(stream);
    old_rc = rb_read(stream, 0, out, SPARSE_LEN, miss, &count, MAX_MISS);
    printf("LEGACY_SPARSE result=%d miss_count=%d comparable_performance=NO\n", old_rc, count);
    if (old_rc != -2 || count != 33) failed = 1;

done:
    free(first);
    free(second);
    free(out);
    if (stream) rb_stream_destroy(stream);
    if (engine) rb_engine_destroy(engine);
    return failed;
}

static void environment_text(const char *name, char *out, DWORD capacity)
{
    DWORD count = GetEnvironmentVariableA(name, out, capacity);
    if (count == 0 || count >= capacity) strcpy_s(out, (size_t)capacity, "unknown");
}

int main(void)
{
    MEMORYSTATUSEX memory;
    size_t i;
    int failures = 0;
    char cpu[256], processors[16];
    environment_text("PROCESSOR_IDENTIFIER", cpu, (DWORD)sizeof(cpu));
    environment_text("NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS", processors, (DWORD)sizeof(processors));
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&g_qpc);
    memory.dwLength = sizeof(memory);
    GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&memory);
    printf("METADATA cpu=\"%s\" processors=%s qpc_hz=%lld physical_memory_MB=%llu mode=usermode-memory\n",
           cpu, processors, (long long)g_qpc.QuadPart,
           (unsigned long long)(memory.ullTotalPhys / 1048576));
    g_source = (unsigned char *)malloc(MAX_SOURCE);
    if (!g_source) {
        printf("SETUP_ERROR source allocation\n");
        return 2;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < MAX_SOURCE; i++) g_source[i] = (unsigned char)((i * 13 + 7) & 0xFF);
    failures += measure_hot("small4k", 0, SUB_SIZE, 9, 8ULL * 1024 * 1024);
    failures += measure_hot("small128k", 0, 32 * SUB_SIZE, 9, 8ULL * 1024 * 1024);
    failures += measure_hot("boundary32_unaligned", 100, 32 * SUB_SIZE - 100, 9, 8ULL * 1024 * 1024);
    failures += measure_hot("fullhit64m", 0, MAX_SOURCE, 7, 256ULL * 1024 * 1024);
    failures += measure_sparse(9);
    free(g_source);
    printf("READ_PLAN_BENCH_FAILURES=%d\n", failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
````

##### `tests/core/bench_readhit.c`

````c
/*
 * 4K 读命中微基准（MSVC 兼容）：量化纯读命中每 4K 子块的核心引擎开销。
 * 方法：写满一个 64KB chunk（16 个 4K 子块全脏后回写干净），随后对热 chunk
 * 做 N 次 4K 读命中（mc==0 全命中），用 QueryPerformanceCounter 测 ns/op。
 * 结果不受磁盘/内存带宽污染（命中路径纯 memcpy + 分片锁），用于前后对比
 * 读热路径的 ERESOURCE/原子操作开销。
 *
 * [D2/D3] 追加并发段（memlevel 专项 F8）：
 *   B) 并发写创建：8 线程各自对独占区间做 4KB 首写（chunk_create +
 *      chunk_mark_dirty —— chain 分片锁（D2）的目标路径），测 ns/op；
 *   C) 读命中受压：8 写者并发跑动期间测热 chunk 读命中 ns/op（D4：分片后
 *      读热路径不劣化）。
 * 口径：QueryPerformanceCounter，ns/op；仅用户态微基准，真机判据以
 * bench_proto.ps1 + CDM 为准（本数字只证明"无用户态回归"）。
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include "cache.h"

static int wb(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *d, size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;(void)off;(void)d;(void)n; return 0; }
static int rb(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;(void)off; memset(b,0,n); return 0; }

static double now_ns(void){
    LARGE_INTEGER f, c; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f); QueryPerformanceCounter(&c);
    return (double)c.QuadPart * 1e9 / (double)f.QuadPart;
}

/* ---- 并发段状态（D2/D4） ---- */
#define BENCH_WRITERS   8
#define BENCH_CREATES   512                     /* 每写者首写次数（8×512×64KB=256MB 驻留） */
#define BENCH_WREGION   (32ull*1024*1024)       /* 每写者独占区间（跨多条纹） */
static rb_engine    *g_be;
static rb_stream    *g_bw;                      /* 写者流（与读热流分离） */
static unsigned char g_bhot[65536];
static volatile LONG g_bstop;
static volatile LONG g_loop_writers;   /* 1=循环到停止信号；0=单遍（B 段） */

typedef struct { int id; } BWArg;

/* 写者：对独占区间做 4KB 首写/覆写（chunk_create + mark_dirty 路径）；
 * loop=1 时循环到 g_bstop（供"读命中受压"段提供持续写负载）。 */
static void *bench_writer(void *p)
{
    BWArg *a=(BWArg*)p; int id=a->id;
    rb_u64 base=(rb_u64)id*BENCH_WREGION;
    unsigned char blk[4096];
    int op;
    memset(blk,(unsigned char)(0x40+id),sizeof(blk));
    for(op=0; !g_bstop; op++){
        rb_u64 off=base+(rb_u64)(op%BENCH_CREATES)*65536ull;
        rb_direct_range dr[4]; int dc=0;
        if(rb_write(g_bw,off,blk,sizeof(blk),dr,&dc,4)!=0){
            printf("bench writer %d fail @%llu\n",id,(unsigned long long)off);
            break;
        }
        if(!g_loop_writers) break;   /* 单遍模式：跑完 BENCH_CREATES 即退 */
    }
    return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv){
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg,0,sizeof(cfg));
    /* [S2 16K 实验 2026-11-06] 第 2 个参数 = 块大小（4096/8192/16384/32768，
     * 与 F1 后白名单一致）；省略时行为与历史完全一致（4096），保证回归零漂移。 */
    unsigned bs = (argc>=3) ? (unsigned)strtol(argv[2],NULL,0) : 4096;
    if(bs!=4096 && bs!=8192 && bs!=16384 && bs!=32768){
        printf("bs must be one of 4096/8192/16384/32768\n"); return 2;
    }
    cfg.max_bytes=256ull*1024*1024; cfg.writeback=wb; cfg.readback=rb; cfg.block_size=bs;
    rb_engine *e=rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    if(!e){ printf("engine create fail (bs=%u)\n",bs); return 1; }
    rb_stream *s=rb_stream_create(e,1);
    unsigned char *wr=(unsigned char*)malloc(bs); memset(wr,0x5a,bs);
    unsigned char *rd=(unsigned char*)malloc(bs);
    int i;
    for(i=0;i<16;i++){ rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dc=0;
        if(rb_write(s,(rb_u64)i*bs,wr,bs,dr,&dc,8)!=0){ printf("write fail\n"); return 1; } }
    rb_engine_flush(e,1);   /* 落盘干净，chunk 变干净缓存块 */
    /* warmup */
    for(i=0;i<100000;i++){ rb_direct_range m[8]; int mm=0;
        rb_read(s,(rb_u64)(i%16)*bs,rd,bs,m,&mm,8); }

    long N = (argc>=2)? strtol(argv[1],NULL,0) : 20000000;
    double t0=now_ns();
    long h=0;
    for(i=0;i<N;i++){
        rb_direct_range m[8]; int mm=0;
        int r=rb_read(s,(rb_u64)(i%16)*bs,rd,bs,m,&mm,8);
        if(r==1 && mm==0) h++;
    }
    double t1=now_ns();
    double rh_nsop=(t1-t0)/(double)N;
    /* 1 byte/ns = 1 GB/s（十进制 GB）；故 N*bs/耗时(ns) 即 GB/s */
    double gbps=(double)N*(double)bs/(t1-t0);
    printf("read-hit %uK: ops=%ld  hits=%ld  total_ms=%.1f  ns/op=%.2f  GB/s=%.2f\n",
           bs/1024, N, h, (t1-t0)/1e6, rh_nsop, gbps);

    /* ============ 并发段（D2/D4 验收） ============ */
    {
        pthread_t th[BENCH_WRITERS]; BWArg ba[BENCH_WRITERS];
        double b0,b1;
        g_be=e; g_bw=rb_stream_create(e,2);
        memset(g_bhot,0x5a,sizeof(g_bhot));
        if(!g_bw){ printf("bench: writer stream create fail\n"); }
        else{
            /* ---- B) 并发写创建：8 线程 × 512 次 4K 首写（chunk_create 路径） ---- */
            g_bstop=0; g_loop_writers=0;
            b0=now_ns();
            for(i=0;i<BENCH_WRITERS;i++){ ba[i].id=i; pthread_create(&th[i],NULL,bench_writer,&ba[i]); }
            for(i=0;i<BENCH_WRITERS;i++) pthread_join(th[i],NULL);
            b1=now_ns();
            { long ops=(long)BENCH_WRITERS*BENCH_CREATES;
              printf("write-create 4K (%d thr): ops=%ld  total_ms=%.1f  ns/op=%.2f\n",
                     BENCH_WRITERS, ops, (b1-b0)/1e6, (b1-b0)/(double)ops); }

            /* ---- C) 读命中受压：8 写者循环跑动期间测热 chunk 命中 ---- */
            g_bstop=0; g_loop_writers=1;
            for(i=0;i<BENCH_WRITERS;i++) pthread_create(&th[i],NULL,bench_writer,&ba[i]);
            { long M=N/4>1000000?1000000:N/4; long h2=0;
              b0=now_ns();
              for(i=0;i<M;i++){
                  rb_direct_range m[8]; int mm=0;
                  int r=rb_read(s,(rb_u64)(i%16)*4096,rd,4096,m,&mm,8);
                  if(r==1 && mm==0) h2++;
              }
              b1=now_ns();
              printf("read-hit 4K under %d writers: ops=%ld  hits=%ld  total_ms=%.1f  ns/op=%.2f\n",
                     BENCH_WRITERS, M, h2, (b1-b0)/1e6, (b1-b0)/(double)M); }
            g_bstop=1;
            for(i=0;i<BENCH_WRITERS;i++) pthread_join(th[i],NULL);
        }
        printf("== bench summary: read-hit=%.2f ns/op (baseline, single-thread) ==\n", rh_nsop);
        if(g_bw) rb_stream_destroy(g_bw);
    }
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/bench_write_absorb.c`

````c
/* User-mode write-absorption microbenchmark [OPT-PROF 2026-11-01].
 * Memory-only; no volume/driver IO. Purpose: locate the ~280us/1MB write cost
 * between (a) raw memcpy bandwidth, (b) per-chunk lock/list cost, (c) per-call
 * stripe-lock/stats cost. Steady state = repeatedly overwriting a warm 8MB
 * region whose chunks are already loaded and fully dirty (the sequential-write
 * workload that measured 3.6GB/s in the live matrix).
 *
 * Isolation method:
 *   A  rb_write_ex(1MB)      -> 16 chunks x 16 subs per call
 *   B  rb_write_ex(64KB) x16 -> same data, 16 calls
 *   C  rb_write_ex(4KB) x256 -> same data, 256 calls
 *   D  pure memcpy(1MB)      -> memory bandwidth floor
 * Then: per-call cost = (A-B)/15, per-chunk cost = (B-C)/240, engine cost = A-D.
 * A is the only number directly comparable to the driver path.
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <windows.h>

#define SUB_SIZE   4096ULL
#define CHUNK_SIZE (64ULL * 1024ULL)
#define REGION     (8ULL * 1024ULL * 1024ULL)
#define BIG_IO     (1024ULL * 1024ULL)
#define ROUNDS     200

static unsigned char *g_buf;      /* source data */
static LARGE_INTEGER  g_qpc;

static int writeback_noop(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 offset,
                          const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id; (void)offset; (void)data; (void)len;
    return 0;
}

static rb_engine *make_engine(rb_u64 max_bytes)
{
    rb_config config;
    memset(&config, 0, sizeof(config));
    config.max_bytes = max_bytes;
    config.block_size = SUB_SIZE;
    config.writeback = writeback_noop;
    return rb_engine_create(&config);
}

static double now_us(void)
{
    LARGE_INTEGER now;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    return (double)now.QuadPart * 1000000.0 / (double)g_qpc.QuadPart;
}

static int cmp_d(const void *a, const void *b)
{
    double da = *(const double *)a, db = *(const double *)b;
    return da < db ? -1 : da > db ? 1 : 0;
}

static double median_of(double *v, int n)
{
    double *c = (double *)malloc((size_t)n * sizeof(double));
    double r;
    memcpy(c, v, (size_t)n * sizeof(double));
    qsort(c, (size_t)n, sizeof(double), cmp_d);
    r = c[n / 2];
    free(c);
    return r;
}

static double p95_of(double *v, int n)
{
    double *c = (double *)malloc((size_t)n * sizeof(double));
    double r;
    int rank;
    memcpy(c, v, (size_t)n * sizeof(double));
    qsort(c, (size_t)n, sizeof(double), cmp_d);
    rank = (int)ceil(0.95 * n) - 1;
    if (rank < 0) rank = 0;
    if (rank >= n) rank = n - 1;
    r = c[rank];
    free(c);
    return r;
}

static double mibs(rb_u64 bytes, double us)
{
    return (double)bytes * 1000000.0 / us / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
}

/* one steady-state pass over the whole region at the given granularity */
static double run_pass(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 gran, double *samples, int rounds)
{
    rb_direct_range dr[64];
    int i, k;
    double t0, t1;
    for (k = 0; k < rounds; k++) {
        rb_u64 off = 0;
        t0 = now_us();
        while (off < REGION) {
            int dc = 0;
            (void)rb_write_ex(s, off, g_buf + off, (size_t)gran,
                              dr, &dc, 64, NULL);
            off += gran;
        }
        t1 = now_us();
        samples[k] = t1 - t0;      /* per full region pass */
    }
    return median_of(samples, rounds);
}

/* cold-write: sequential 1MB writes into fresh chunks. budget controls whether
 * eviction kicks in (total > budget -> evict+flush cycle becomes the cost). */
static void run_cold(rb_u64 budget, rb_u64 total, const char *label)
{
    rb_engine *e = make_engine(budget);
    rb_stream *s;
    rb_stats st0, st1;
    double t0, t1;
    rb_u64 o;
    if (!e) { printf("%s: engine create failed\n", label); return; }
    s = rb_stream_create(e, 2ULL);
    if (!s) { printf("%s: stream create failed\n", label); rb_engine_destroy(e); return; }
    memset(&st0, 0, sizeof(st0));
    rb_engine_get_stats(e, &st0);
    t0 = now_us();
    o = 0;
    while (o < total) {
        rb_direct_range dr[64]; int dc = 0;
        (void)rb_write_ex(s, o, g_buf + (o & (REGION - BIG_IO)), (size_t)BIG_IO,
                          dr, &dc, 64, NULL);
        o += BIG_IO;
    }
    t1 = now_us();
    rb_engine_get_stats(e, &st1);
    printf("%s: %9.2f us  %8.1f MiB/s  chunks+%llu  dirty=%llu MiB  wb_bytes=%llu MiB  evict=%llu MiB\n",
           label, t1 - t0, mibs(total, t1 - t0),
           (unsigned long long)(st1.chunk_count - st0.chunk_count),
           (unsigned long long)(st1.dirty_bytes >> 20),
           (unsigned long long)(st1.wb_bytes >> 20),
           (unsigned long long)(st1.evict_bytes >> 20));
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(e);
}

/* allocation probe: is the 22us/chunk cold-write cost page-fault or allocator? */
static void probe_alloc(void)
{
    const int n = 16384;              /* 1GiB of 64KiB chunks */
    void **p = (void **)malloc(sizeof(void *) * (size_t)n);
    unsigned char *pool = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)n * CHUNK_SIZE);
    double t0, t1;
    int i;
    if (!p || !pool) { free(p); free(pool); return; }
    t0 = now_us();
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { p[i] = malloc((size_t)CHUNK_SIZE); memset(p[i], 0, (size_t)CHUNK_SIZE); }
    t1 = now_us();
    printf("malloc+memset cold : %8.2f ms  %6.2f us each\n", (t1 - t0) / 1000.0, (t1 - t0) / n);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) free(p[i]);
    t0 = now_us();
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { p[i] = malloc((size_t)CHUNK_SIZE); memset(p[i], 0, (size_t)CHUNK_SIZE); }
    t1 = now_us();
    printf("malloc+memset warm : %8.2f ms  %6.2f us each\n", (t1 - t0) / 1000.0, (t1 - t0) / n);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) free(p[i]);
    memset(pool, 0xAA, (size_t)n * CHUNK_SIZE);   /* fault the pool in first */
    t0 = now_us();
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) memset(pool + (size_t)i * CHUNK_SIZE, 0, (size_t)CHUNK_SIZE);
    t1 = now_us();
    printf("pooled memset only : %8.2f ms  %6.2f us each\n", (t1 - t0) / 1000.0, (t1 - t0) / n);

    /* batch-grow cost: one big malloc sliced into 64KiB blocks vs block-at-a-time */
    {
        const int batch = 16;                 /* 1MiB per grow */
        const int grows = 1024;               /* 1024 grows = 16384 blocks */
        unsigned char **big = (unsigned char **)malloc(sizeof(void *) * grows);
        t0 = now_us();
        for (i = 0; i < grows; i++) big[i] = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)batch * CHUNK_SIZE);
        t1 = now_us();
        printf("malloc(1MiB) x1024  : %8.2f ms  %6.2f us per 16 blocks\n", (t1 - t0) / 1000.0, (t1 - t0) / grows);
        for (i = 0; i < grows; i++) free(big[i]);
        free(big);
    }
    free(p); free(pool);
}

/* read-hit path: the second optimisation target (ERESOURCE -> spin). Measure the
 * full-hit 1MB read against memcpy before touching any locking design. */
static void run_read_hit(void)
{
    rb_engine *e = make_engine(4ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024);
    rb_stream *s;
    unsigned char *dst;
    double *rs, *ms;
    double R, M;
    int i, k;
    rb_u64 off;
    if (!e) { printf("read-hit: engine create failed\n"); return; }
    s = rb_stream_create(e, 3ULL);
    dst = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)BIG_IO);
    rs = (double *)malloc(sizeof(double) * ROUNDS);
    ms = (double *)malloc(sizeof(double) * ROUNDS);
    if (!s || !dst || !rs || !ms) { printf("read-hit: alloc failed\n"); return; }

    /* fill 8MiB so every read is a full hit */
    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        off = 0;
        while (off < REGION) {
            rb_direct_range dr[64]; int dc = 0;
            (void)rb_write_ex(s, off, g_buf + off, (size_t)BIG_IO, dr, &dc, 64, NULL);
            off += BIG_IO;
        }
    }
    for (k = 0; k < ROUNDS; k++) {
        double t0, t1; rb_u64 o = 0; int bad = 0;
        t0 = now_us();
        while (o < REGION) {
            rb_direct_range miss[32]; int mc = 0;
            /* contract (test_cache.c): full/partial hit returns 1, zero-hit 0, error -2 */
            if (rb_read(s, o, dst, (size_t)BIG_IO, miss, &mc, 32) != 1 || mc != 0) bad++;
            o += BIG_IO;
        }
        t1 = now_us();
        rs[k] = t1 - t0;
        if (bad) printf("read-hit: unexpected miss on round %d\n", k);
    }
    R = median_of(rs, ROUNDS);
    for (k = 0; k < ROUNDS; k++) {
        double t0, t1; rb_u64 o = 0;
        t0 = now_us();
        while (o < REGION) { memcpy(dst, g_buf + o, (size_t)BIG_IO); o += BIG_IO; }
        t1 = now_us();
        ms[k] = t1 - t0;
    }
    M = median_of(ms, ROUNDS);
    printf("\n=== read-hit path (8MiB fully cached, 1MB reads) ===\n");
    printf("rb_read 1MB : median %9.2f us  %8.1f MiB/s  (%6.2f us per 1MB)\n",
           R, mibs(REGION, R), R / (double)(REGION / BIG_IO));
    printf("memcpy 1MB  : median %9.2f us  %8.1f MiB/s\n", M, mibs(REGION, M));
    printf("read overhead over memcpy: %8.2f us per region (%.1f%%)\n",
           R - M, (R - M) * 100.0 / R);

    free(rs); free(ms); free(dst);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(e);
}

int main(void)
{
    rb_engine *eng;
    rb_stream *st;
    double *sa, *sb, *sc, *sd;
    double A, B, C, D;
    int i;
    rb_u64 off;
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&g_qpc);
    g_buf = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)REGION);
    if (!g_buf) { printf("alloc failed\n"); return 1; }
    for (i = 0; i < (int)REGION; i++) g_buf[i] = (unsigned char)((i * 13 + 7) & 0xFF);

    eng = make_engine(4ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024);
    if (!eng) { printf("engine create failed\n"); return 1; }
    st = rb_stream_create(eng, 1ULL);
    if (!st) { printf("stream create failed\n"); return 1; }

    /* warm-up: fill region (chunks created, fully dirty), two passes */
    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        off = 0;
        while (off < REGION) {
            rb_direct_range dr[64]; int dc = 0;
            (void)rb_write_ex(st, off, g_buf + off, (size_t)BIG_IO, dr, &dc, 64, NULL);
            off += BIG_IO;
        }
    }
    {
        rb_stats s; memset(&s, 0, sizeof(s));
        rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &s);
        printf("warm: write_req=%llu write_bytes=%llu write_cached=%llu dirty=%llu bytes=%llu\n",
               (unsigned long long)s.write_req, (unsigned long long)s.write_bytes,
               (unsigned long long)s.write_cached,
               (unsigned long long)s.dirty_bytes, (unsigned long long)s.cur_bytes);
    }

    sa = (double *)malloc(sizeof(double) * ROUNDS);
    sb = (double *)malloc(sizeof(double) * ROUNDS);
    sc = (double *)malloc(sizeof(double) * ROUNDS);
    sd = (double *)malloc(sizeof(double) * ROUNDS);
    if (!sa || !sb || !sc || !sd) { printf("alloc failed\n"); return 1; }

    /* warm the measurement path once per shape */
    (void)run_pass(st, BIG_IO, sa, 3);
    A = run_pass(st, BIG_IO, sa, ROUNDS);
    (void)run_pass(st, CHUNK_SIZE, sb, 3);
    B = run_pass(st, CHUNK_SIZE, sb, ROUNDS);
    (void)run_pass(st, SUB_SIZE, sc, 3);
    C = run_pass(st, SUB_SIZE, sc, ROUNDS);

    /* D: pure memcpy floor, same total bytes */
    for (i = 0; i < ROUNDS; i++) {
        double t0, t1; rb_u64 o = 0;
        t0 = now_us();
        while (o < REGION) { memcpy(g_buf + o, g_buf + o, (size_t)BIG_IO); o += BIG_IO; }
        t1 = now_us();
        sd[i] = t1 - t0;
    }
    D = median_of(sd, ROUNDS);

    printf("\n=== steady-state region pass (8MiB, dirty-full, 200 rounds) ===\n");
    printf("A 1MB/call : median %9.2f us  p95 %9.2f us  %8.1f MiB/s  (%6.2f us per 1MB IO)\n",
           A, p95_of(sa, ROUNDS), mibs(REGION, A), A / (double)(REGION / BIG_IO));
    printf("B 64KB/call: median %9.2f us  p95 %9.2f us  %8.1f MiB/s  (%6.2f us per 64KB IO)\n",
           B, p95_of(sb, ROUNDS), mibs(REGION, B), B / (double)(REGION / CHUNK_SIZE));
    printf("C 4KB/call : median %9.2f us  p95 %9.2f us  %8.1f MiB/s  (%6.3f us per 4KB IO)\n",
           C, p95_of(sc, ROUNDS), mibs(REGION, C), C / (double)(REGION / SUB_SIZE));
    printf("D memcpy   : median %9.2f us  p95 %9.2f us  %8.1f MiB/s\n",
           D, p95_of(sd, ROUNDS), mibs(REGION, D));

    printf("\n=== cost decomposition ===\n");
    printf("engine total over memcpy : %8.2f us per region (%.1f%% of A)\n", A - D, (A - D) * 100.0 / A);
    printf("per-call (A vs B)        : %8.2f us per call   (= (A-B)/120)\n", (A - B) / 120.0);
    printf("per-chunk (B vs C)       : %8.2f us per chunk  (= (B-C)/240)\n", (B - C) / 240.0);
    printf("per-sub estimate         : %8.3f us per 4KB    (= (C-D)/2048)\n", (C - D) / 2048.0);
    printf("chunks per 1MB IO        : %d\n", (int)(BIG_IO / CHUNK_SIZE));
    printf("subs   per 1MB IO        : %d\n", (int)(BIG_IO / SUB_SIZE));

    /* cold sequential write: the live 63GB-through-4GB-cache workload shape */
    printf("\n=== cold sequential write (fresh chunks, no eviction vs eviction) ===\n");
    run_cold(4ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024, 2ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024, "E 2GiB / 4GiB budget ");
    run_cold(512ULL * 1024 * 1024,      2ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024, "F 2GiB / 512MiB budget");

    printf("\n=== allocation cost probe (16384 x 64KiB) ===\n");
    probe_alloc();

    run_read_hit();

    free(sa); free(sb); free(sc); free(sd);
    rb_stream_destroy(st);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
    free(g_buf);
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/build/mut_new_src.c`

````c
/*
 * test_race1106.c -- 2026-11-06 WeChat incident-shape repro (user-mode core)
 *
 * Incident shape (from driver log timeline):
 *   1. write-back ON, readers+writers active on one stream
 *   2. soft detach ("stream kept", dirty flushed) + reattach  [00:21]
 *   3. PANIC passthrough window (all device writes bypass cache,
 *      stream+chunks RETAINED)                                [00:23-00:25]
 *   4. WeChat DLL load reads wrong bytes via cache            [00:22, 00:50]
 *   5. TRIM (0x2d1400) fired seconds before both failures      [00:17, 00:50]
 *   6. reboot = fresh cache = healed
 *
 * Model:
 *   g_disk       = simulated device (64MB), trim reads back zeros
 *   F region     [0,4MB)     : immutable "DLL" content, readers verify forever
 *   CHURN region [8MB,24MB)  : 4KB blocks, gen-numbered content; shadow g_gen[]
 *   TRIMV region [32MB,40MB): trimmer deletes ranges (device zeroes them)
 *
 * Threads:
 *   4 readers : verify F (try_cache -> rb_read+commit fallback), verify churn
 *               blocks against shadow gen
 *   2 writers : advance churn gens via rb_write_ex (absorbed, write-back ON)
 *   1 passthrough cycler: every ~2s -> flush force; g_passthrough=1 for 150ms
 *               (writers then write g_disk DIRECTLY + advance gen; device
 *               writes bypass the cache while stream/chunks are RETAINED);
 *               g_passthrough=0. Readers must now see NEW gens through the
 *               kept cache -- stale serve here = THE BUG.
 *   1 trimmer : every ~1.7s -> [FIX 2026-11-06] range-targeted TRIM model
 *               (driver parity): view_mutating window ON -> flush force ->
 *               zero ONE 1MB TRIMV range on g_disk -> invalidate ONLY that
 *               range -> window OFF. The old whole-stream discard_all here
 *               was removed; discard_all now belongs to the relocator (mode 4).
 *
 * Verdicts (exit codes, [170 2026-11-12] 加严后):
 *   0  = clean: f_err==0 && churn_err==0 && final F sweep clean.
 *   2  = mode3 专属「已知不稳定」：f_err==0 && final F sweep clean &&
 *        churn_err>0（存量 C7 时序敏感，判据不变、不并入其它码）。
 *   1  = 真失败：final F sweep MISMATCH（bad，含读失败）或 f_err>0 或
 *        churn_err>0（mode3 的 exit 2 例外之外），逐条打印命中的断言。
 *   旧判据（<= 169）只看 30s 窗口结束时的 f_err0/c_err0 快照：最终扫描的
 *   MISMATCH 与快照之后才发生的错误都不影响 exit code，属已修缺陷。
 *   f_err>0        -> immutable-region serve corruption (THE core serve bug).
 *   churn_err>0    -> stale/wrong serve observation. In mode 0 (passthrough
 *                     cycler) this is the expected tooth for the kept-stream
 *                     staleness. Mode 3 has NO passthrough cycler; its
 *                     churn_err is a KNOWN timing-sensitive observation:
 *                     2026-11-06 reproduced 2 of 6 runs (4662 / 2909 errors),
 *                     always with f_err=0 and a clean final F sweep = no
 *                     application-visible stale DLL. See KNOWN_ISSUES C7.
 *                     The hard verdict (exit 2) is kept ON PURPOSE - never
 *                     weaken the judge to make a run look green.
 *   all zero @30s  -> core exonerated at this shape; suspect moves to driver layer
 */
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "cache.h"

#define DISK_SZ   (64u<<20)
#define F_OFF     0u
#define F_SZ      (4u<<20)
#define CH_OFF    (8u<<20)
#define CH_SZ     (16u<<20)
#define CH_BLKS   (CH_SZ/4096)
#define TR_OFF    (32u<<20)
#define TR_SZ     (8u<<20)

static unsigned char *g_disk;
static volatile LONG  *g_gen;         /* expected generation per churn block */
static volatile LONG   g_passthrough = 0;
static volatile LONG   g_mutating = 0;   /* metadata-hook window (driver parity) */
static volatile LONG   g_relocating = 0; /* F owned by relocator (app-level exclusivity) */
static volatile LONG   g_stop = 0;
static volatile LONG   g_fgen = 0;    /* F region generation (relocator advances) */
static volatile LONG   g_gated = 1;   /* 1 = commit_gen (post-fix), 0 = legacy ungated (pre-fix parity) */
static volatile LONG   g_f_err = 0, g_churn_err = 0, g_reads = 0, g_f_reads = 0;
static rb_engine *g_eng;
static rb_stream *g_st;

static unsigned char pat_f(rb_u64 off, LONG gen)
{ return (unsigned char)(((off * 2654435761u) >> 13) + (unsigned)gen * 37u); }
static unsigned char pat_churn(rb_u32 blk, LONG gen, rb_u64 off_in_blk)
{ return (unsigned char)((blk * 2246822519u + (unsigned)gen * 3266489917u + (unsigned)off_in_blk) >> 11); }

static int rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{ (void)ctx; (void)fid; if (off + len > DISK_SZ) return 1; memcpy(buf, g_disk + off, len); return 0; }
static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *buf, size_t len)
{ (void)ctx; (void)fid; if (off + len > DISK_SZ) return 1; memcpy(g_disk + off, buf, len); return 0; }

/* driver-shaped read: try_cache fast path, fallback rb_read(miss plan)+disk+commit.
   gated=1 captures view gen pre-plan and commits via commit_gen (post-fix parity);
   gated=0 uses the legacy ungated commit (pre-fix parity, for A/B demonstration).
   Mutating-window parity: while the metadata-hook window is open the driver
   passes ALL reads through -- model: direct g_disk read, no cache involvement. */
static int read_like_driver(rb_u64 off, unsigned char *out, size_t len, int gated)
{
    if (g_mutating) { memcpy(out, g_disk + off, len); return 0; }
    if (rb_read_try_cache(g_st, off, out, len) == 1) return 0;
    {   rb_direct_range miss[64]; int nmiss = 0, i;
        unsigned char *tmp;
        rb_u64 vgen = gated ? rb_stream_view_gen(g_st) : 0;
        int rc = rb_read(g_st, off, out, len, miss, &nmiss, 64);
        if (rc == -2 && nmiss > 64) return 1;           /* overflow: give up this round */
        for (i = 0; i < nmiss; i++) {
            tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(miss[i].len);
            if (!tmp) return 1;
            memcpy(tmp, g_disk + miss[i].offset, miss[i].len);   /* device read */
            if (gated) rb_read_commit_gen(g_st, miss[i].offset, tmp, miss[i].len, vgen);
            else       rb_read_commit(g_st, miss[i].offset, tmp, miss[i].len);
            /* copy the just-read miss range into the user buffer */
            {   size_t o = 0;
                if (miss[i].offset < off) o = (size_t)(off - miss[i].offset);
                if (o < miss[i].len) {
                    size_t cp = miss[i].len - o;
                    if ((size_t)(miss[i].offset + o + cp) > (size_t)(off + len)) cp = (size_t)(off + len) - (size_t)(miss[i].offset + o);
                    memcpy(out + (size_t)(miss[i].offset + o - off), tmp + o, cp);
                }
            }
            free(tmp);
        }
        rb_read_copy_dirty(g_st, off, out, len);        /* overlay dirty (driver parity) */
    }
    return 0;
}

/* F verify with PERSISTENCE discriminator: a mismatch is only counted if a
   re-read (after 1ms) mismatches again -- transient in-flight reads straddling
   a relocation are legal; PERSISTENT stale serve (cache poisoning) is the bug. */
static int verify_f(rb_u64 off, unsigned char *buf)
{
    size_t k; int bad = 0; LONG gen = g_fgen;
    if (read_like_driver(off, buf, 65536, g_gated) == 0) {
        for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
            if (buf[k] != pat_f(off + k, gen)) { bad = 1; break; }
        if (bad) {
            Sleep(1);
            bad = 0;
            if (read_like_driver(off, buf, 65536, g_gated) == 0) {
                for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
                    if (buf[k] != pat_f(off + k, g_fgen)) { bad = 1; break; }
            }
            if (bad) {
                InterlockedIncrement(&g_f_err);
                if (g_f_err <= 3)
                    printf("  [F-ERR-PERSISTENT] off=%llu+%zu got=%02X want(gen=%ld)=%02X\n",
                           (unsigned long long)off, k, buf[k], g_fgen, pat_f(off + k, g_fgen));
            }
        }
        InterlockedIncrement(&g_f_reads);
    }
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI reader(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc(256 * 1024);   /* PER-THREAD: static buf = threads stomp each other */
    if (!buf) return 1;
    while (!g_stop) {
        /* F verify: 64KB slices (skipped while relocator owns F: app-level exclusivity) */
        if (!g_relocating) {
            rb_u64 off = F_OFF + (rb_u64)(InterlockedIncrement(&g_reads) % (F_SZ / 65536)) * 65536;
            verify_f(off, buf);
        }
        /* churn verify: 8 random blocks; gen-stable check (writer may advance
           between our shadow snapshot and the read -- retry once on gen change,
           only count as error if content matches NEITHER generation) */
        {   int b; for (b = 0; b < 8; b++) {
                rb_u32 blk = (rb_u32)(((rand() << 8) ^ GetCurrentThreadId()) % CH_BLKS);
                rb_u64 off = CH_OFF + (rb_u64)blk * 4096;
                LONG gen = g_gen[blk]; size_t k; int bad = 0;
                if (read_like_driver(off, buf, 4096, g_gated) == 0) {
                    for (k = 0; k < 4096; k++)
                        if (buf[k] != pat_churn(blk, gen, k)) { bad = 1; break; }
                    if (bad) {
                        LONG gen2 = g_gen[blk]; int bad2 = 0;
                        if (gen2 != gen) {          /* gen advanced: re-check against new gen */
                            for (k = 0; k < 4096; k++)
                                if (buf[k] != pat_churn(blk, gen2, k)) { bad2 = 1; break; }
                            if (!bad2) bad = 0;      /* content == new gen: benign ordering */
                        }
                        if (bad) {                   /* matches neither: real wrong-serve */
                            InterlockedIncrement(&g_churn_err);
                            if (g_churn_err <= 8)
                                printf("  [CHURN-ERR] blk=%u gen=%ld got=%02X want=%02X (off=%llu)\n",
                                       blk, gen, buf[k], pat_churn(blk, gen, k),
                                       (unsigned long long)(off + k));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Sleep(1);
    }
    free(buf);
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI writer(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    static unsigned char blk[4096];
    while (!g_stop) {
        rb_u32 b = (rb_u32)(((rand() << 8) ^ GetCurrentThreadId()) % CH_BLKS);
        LONG g = g_gen[b] + 1; size_t k;
        for (k = 0; k < 4096; k++) blk[k] = pat_churn(b, g, k);
        if (g_passthrough || g_mutating) {
            /* passthrough (panic) / mutating-window: device write bypassing the
               cache -- exactly the driver's passthrough semantics for both */
            memcpy(g_disk + CH_OFF + (rb_u64)b * 4096, blk, 4096);
            g_gen[b] = g;
        } else {
            rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dn = 0;
            if (rb_write_ex(g_st, CH_OFF + (rb_u64)b * 4096, blk, 4096, dr, &dn, 8, NULL) >= 0)
                g_gen[b] = g;   /* absorbed (or direct-listed) */
            else
                g_gen[b] = g;   /* write failed at core level; keep shadow consistent with intent */
        }
        Sleep(2);
    }
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI passthrough_cycler(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    int cyc = 0;
    while (!g_stop) {
        Sleep(2000);
        if (g_stop) break;
        rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);           /* soft-detach parity: dirty flushed */
        /* NOTE: chunks + stream RETAINED (the "stream kept" semantic) */
        InterlockedExchange(&g_passthrough, 1);
        Sleep(150);                          /* device writes bypass cache here */
        InterlockedExchange(&g_passthrough, 0);
        printf("  [pt-cycle %d] passthrough window closed (cycle %d, errors so far f=%ld churn=%ld)\n",
               ++cyc, cyc, g_f_err, g_churn_err);
    }
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI trimmer(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    int n = 0;
    while (!g_stop) {
        Sleep(1700);
        if (g_stop) break;
        /* [FIX 2026-11-06] faithful TRIM model (range-targeted, driver parity):
           window open -> flush dirty -> zero the trimmed range (device effect)
           -> invalidate THAT range only -> window close */
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(g_st, 1);
        rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);
        {   rb_u64 off = TR_OFF + (rb_u64)(rand() % (TR_SZ / (1 << 20))) * (1 << 20);
            memset(g_disk + off, 0, 1 << 20);          /* forwarded trim: device zeroes */
            rb_stream_invalidate_range(g_st, off, 1 << 20); }
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(g_st, 0);
        n++;
    }
    (void)n;
    return 0;
}

/* [FIX 2026-11-06] relocator: models the app-updater sequence that produces the
   incident -- device-level content replacement under F (rename materializes new
   file content; mtime may even be preserved) + the hook's flush+discard_all
   BEFORE the replacement lands. In-flight reads (disk read issued pre-replace)
   that COMMIT after the discard re-poison the view with pre-replace bytes =
   persistent stale serve (the 11-04/11-06 "DLL entry point" family). */
static DWORD WINAPI relocator(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    static unsigned char tmp[65536];
    int cyc = 0;
    while (!g_stop) {
        Sleep(3000);
        if (g_stop) break;
        /* hook parity with app-level exclusivity: F is owned by the updater
           for the whole transition (readers skip verification), window open
           (all cache traffic passthrough), then window closes. */
        g_relocating = 1;
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(g_st, 1);
        rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);            /* hook parity: dirty flushed */
        rb_stream_discard_all(g_st);         /* hook parity: view dropped (bumps gen) */
        {   LONG gen = g_fgen + 1;
            rb_u64 off; int s;
            for (s = 0; s < (int)(F_SZ / 65536); s++) {
                off = F_OFF + (rb_u64)s * 65536;
                { size_t k; for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++) tmp[k] = pat_f(off + k, gen); }
                memcpy(g_disk + off, tmp, 65536);   /* rename materializes new content */
            }
            InterlockedExchange(&g_fgen, gen);
        }
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(g_st, 0);
        g_relocating = 0;
        cyc++;
        printf("  [reloc %d] F generation -> %ld (errors f=%ld churn=%ld)\n",
               cyc, g_fgen, g_f_err, g_churn_err);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ===== mode 5: dual-stream isolation (the C:+D: co-attach suspicion) =====
 * Two streams over TWO simulated devices (per-file_id dispatch in callbacks),
 * each with its own immutable region, generation, and relocator phase.
 * Any cross-stream serve (R6-01 key-collision class) is caught: reader A must
 * NEVER see pattern-B bytes and vice versa, at ANY generation. */
static unsigned char *g_diskA, *g_diskB;
static volatile LONG  g_fgenA = 0, g_fgenB = 0;
static volatile LONG  g_x_err = 0, g_x_reads = 0;
static volatile LONG  g_reloc_busy = 0;   /* relocators rewriting device: readers skip (torn device state is legal transient) */
static rb_stream *g_stB;

static unsigned char pat_b(rb_u64 off, LONG gen)
{ return (unsigned char)(((off * 40503u) >> 9) + (unsigned)gen * 91u); }

static int rb_fn5(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{ (void)ctx; unsigned char *d = (fid == 424243) ? g_diskB : g_diskA;
  if (off + len > 8u << 20) return 1; memcpy(buf, d + off, len); return 0; }
static int wb_fn5(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *buf, size_t len)
{ (void)ctx; unsigned char *d = (fid == 424243) ? g_diskB : g_diskA;
  if (off + len > 8u << 20) return 1; memcpy(d + off, buf, len); return 0; }

static LONG gen_of_stream(rb_stream *st) { return (st == g_stB) ? g_fgenB : g_fgenA; }

/* per-stream read with device dispatch: like read_like_driver but explicit stream+disk */
static int read_like_driver_st(rb_stream *st, unsigned char *disk,
                               rb_u64 off, unsigned char *out, size_t len)
{
    if (rb_read_try_cache(st, off, out, len) == 1) return 0;
    {   rb_direct_range miss[16]; int nmiss = 0, i;
        unsigned char *tmp;
        /* [FIX] 世代必须在 miss 计划【前】捕获（驱动同序）——提交时才捕获恒通过=门控失效 */
        rb_u64 vgen = rb_stream_view_gen(st);
        int rc = rb_read(st, off, out, len, miss, &nmiss, 16);
        if (rc == -2) return 1;
        for (i = 0; i < nmiss; i++) {
            tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(miss[i].len);
            if (!tmp) return 1;
            memcpy(tmp, disk + miss[i].offset, miss[i].len);
            rb_read_commit_gen(st, miss[i].offset, tmp, miss[i].len, vgen);
            {   size_t o = 0;
                if (miss[i].offset < off) o = (size_t)(off - miss[i].offset);
                if (o < miss[i].len) {
                    size_t cp = miss[i].len - o;
                    if ((size_t)(miss[i].offset + o + cp) > (size_t)(off + len)) cp = (size_t)(off + len) - (size_t)(miss[i].offset + o);
                    memcpy(out + (size_t)(miss[i].offset + o - off), tmp + o, cp);
                }
            }
            free(tmp);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static int verify5(rb_stream *st, unsigned char *disk, unsigned char *out,
                   rb_u64 off, LONG gen,
                   unsigned char (*pat)(rb_u64, LONG), const char *tag)
{
    size_t k; int bad = 0;
    if (read_like_driver_st(st, disk, off, out, 65536) == 0) {
        for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
            if (out[k] != pat(off + k, gen)) { bad = 1; break; }
        if (bad) {
            Sleep(1); bad = 0;
            if (read_like_driver_st(st, disk, off, out, 65536) == 0)
                for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
                    if (out[k] != pat(off + k, gen_of_stream(st))) { bad = 1; break; }
            if (bad) {
                InterlockedIncrement(&g_x_err);
                if (g_x_err <= 8)
                    printf("  [X-ERR %s] off=%llu+%zu got=%02X want=%02X ownDisk=%02X otherPat=%02X\n",
                           tag, (unsigned long long)(off + k), k, out[k],
                           pat(off + k, gen), disk[off + k],
                           (st == g_stB) ? pat_f(off + k, g_fgenA) : pat_b(off + k, g_fgenB));
            }
        }
        InterlockedIncrement(&g_x_reads);
    }
    return 0;
}

typedef struct { rb_stream *st; unsigned char *disk; volatile LONG *genp;
                 unsigned char (*pat)(rb_u64, LONG); const char *tag; } R5ARG;

static DWORD WINAPI reader5(LPVOID p)
{
    R5ARG *a = (R5ARG *)p;
    unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc(256 * 1024);
    if (!buf) return 1;
    while (!g_stop) {
        if (g_reloc_busy) { Sleep(1); continue; }   /* device mid-relocation: torn state legal, skip */
        {   rb_u64 off = (rb_u64)(InterlockedIncrement(&g_x_reads) % 64) * 65536;
            verify5(a->st, a->disk, buf, off, *a->genp, a->pat, a->tag); }
        Sleep(1);
    }
    free(buf);
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI relocator5(LPVOID p)
{
    R5ARG *a = (R5ARG *)p;
    unsigned char *tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(65536);   /* PER-THREAD: static tmp = two relocators interleave (3rd harness bug class) */
    int cyc = 0;
    if (!tmp) return 1;
    while (!g_stop) {
        Sleep(2500);
        if (g_stop) break;
        InterlockedIncrement(&g_reloc_busy);
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(a->st, 1);
        rb_stream_flush(a->st, 1);
        rb_stream_discard_all(a->st);
        {   LONG gen = *a->genp + 1; int s;
            for (s = 0; s < 128; s++) {
                rb_u64 off = (rb_u64)s * 65536;
                size_t k;
                for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++) tmp[k] = a->pat(off + k, gen);
                memcpy(a->disk + off, tmp, 65536);
            }
            InterlockedExchange(a->genp, gen);
        }
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(a->st, 0);
        InterlockedDecrement(&g_reloc_busy);
        cyc++;
        printf("  [reloc5 %s %d] gen->%ld (x_err=%ld)\n", a->tag, cyc, *a->genp, g_x_err);
    }
    free(tmp);
    return 0;
}

static int run_mode5(void)
{
    HANDLE th[12]; int i, nth = 0;
    static R5ARG aa, ab, ba, bb;
    ULONG64 fa = 0;

    g_diskA = (unsigned char *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, 8u << 20, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    g_diskB = (unsigned char *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, 8u << 20, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!g_diskA || !g_diskB) return 1;
    for (fa = 0; fa < (4u << 20); fa++) { g_diskA[fa] = pat_f(fa, 0); g_diskB[fa] = pat_b(fa, 0); }

    {   rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
        cfg.max_bytes = (rb_u64)32 * 1024 * 1024;
        cfg.writeback = wb_fn5; cfg.readback = rb_fn5; cfg.block_size = 4096;
        g_eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
        g_st  = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 424242);
        g_stB = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 424243); }
    if (!g_eng || !g_st || !g_stB) return 1;

    aa.st = g_st;  aa.disk = g_diskA; aa.genp = &g_fgenA; aa.pat = pat_f; aa.tag = "A";
    ab.st = g_st;  ab.disk = g_diskA; ab.genp = &g_fgenA; ab.pat = pat_f; ab.tag = "A2";
    ba.st = g_stB; ba.disk = g_diskB; ba.genp = &g_fgenB; ba.pat = pat_b; ba.tag = "B";
    bb.st = g_stB; bb.disk = g_diskB; bb.genp = &g_fgenB; bb.pat = pat_b; bb.tag = "B2";

    printf("== mode5: dual-stream isolation (A on diskA, B on diskB), 30s ==\n");
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, relocator5, &aa, 0, NULL);   /* A relocator */
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, relocator5, &ba, 0, NULL);   /* B relocator (independent phase) */
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &aa, 0, NULL);
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &ab, 0, NULL);
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &ba, 0, NULL);
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &bb, 0, NULL);

    Sleep(30000);
    InterlockedExchange(&g_stop, 1);
    Sleep(500);
    for (i = 0; i < nth; i++) WaitForSingleObject(th[i], 3000);
    rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1); rb_stream_flush(g_stB, 1);

    printf("== RESULT mode5: x_err=%ld (reads=%ld) ==\n", g_x_err, g_x_reads);
    printf("VERDICT: %s\n", g_x_err ? "CROSS-STREAM CONTAMINATION REPRODUCED" : "streams fully isolated");
    return g_x_err ? 2 : 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    HANDLE th[16]; int i, nth = 0;
    ULONG64 f_err0, c_err0;
    int mode = (argc > 1) ? atoi(argv[1]) : 0;   /* 0=full 1=readers-only 2=+writers 3=+trim 4=+relocator 5=dual-stream */
    if (argc > 2) g_gated = atoi(argv[2]);       /* 1=commit_gen (post-fix) 0=legacy ungated (pre-fix parity) */
    if (mode == 5) return run_mode5();

    g_disk = (unsigned char *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, DISK_SZ, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    g_gen  = (volatile LONG *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, CH_BLKS * sizeof(LONG), MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!g_disk || !g_gen) { printf("alloc fail\n"); return 1; }

    /* device initial state: F pattern; churn gen=0 content; TRIMV garbage */
    for (i = 0; i < (int)F_SZ; i++)  g_disk[F_OFF + i] = pat_f(i, 0);
    {   rb_u32 b; size_t k;
        for (b = 0; b < CH_BLKS; b++)
            for (k = 0; k < 4096; k++)
                g_disk[CH_OFF + (rb_u64)b * 4096 + k] = pat_churn(b, 0, k); }

    {   rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
        cfg.max_bytes = (rb_u64)32 * 1024 * 1024;
        cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn; cfg.block_size = 4096;
        g_eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
        g_st  = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 424242); }
    if (!g_eng || !g_st) { printf("engine/stream fail\n"); return 1; }

    printf("== test_race1106 mode=%d (4 readers%s%s%s%s) gated=%ld, 30s ==\n",
           mode,
           mode >= 2 ? " + 2 writers" : "",
           (mode == 0 || mode == 3 || mode == 4) ? " + trimmer" : "",
           mode == 0 ? " + passthrough" : "",
           mode >= 4 ? " + relocator" : "",
````

````c
 * test_race1106.c -- 2026-11-06 WeChat incident-shape repro (user-mode core)
 *
 * Incident shape (from driver log timeline):
 *   1. write-back ON, readers+writers active on one stream
 *   2. soft detach ("stream kept", dirty flushed) + reattach  [00:21]

 *   4. WeChat DLL load reads wrong bytes via cache            [00:22, 00:50]
 *   5. TRIM (0x2d1400) fired seconds before both failures      [00:17, 00:50]
 *   6. reboot = fresh cache = healed

 *   CHURN region [8MB,24MB)  : 4KB blocks, gen-numbered content; shadow g_gen[]
 *   TRIMV region [32MB,40MB): trimmer deletes ranges (device zeroes them)

 *               g_passthrough=0. Readers must now see NEW gens through the

 *               (driver parity): view_mutating window ON -> flush force ->
 *               zero ONE 1MB TRIMV range on g_disk -> invalidate ONLY that
 *               range -> window OFF. The old whole-stream discard_all here
 *               was removed; discard_all now belongs to the relocator (mode 4).

 *   f_err>0        -> immutable-region serve corruption (THE core serve bug).
 *   churn_err>0    -> stale/wrong serve observation. In mode 0 (passthrough
 *                     cycler) this is the expected tooth for the kept-stream
 *                     staleness. Mode 3 has NO passthrough cycler; its

 *                     2026-11-06 reproduced 2 of 6 runs (4662 / 2909 errors),
 *                     always with f_err=0 and a clean final F sweep = no

#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "cache.h"

#define DISK_SZ   (64u<<20)
#define F_OFF     0u
#define F_SZ      (4u<<20)
#define CH_OFF    (8u<<20)
#define CH_SZ     (16u<<20)
#define CH_BLKS   (CH_SZ/4096)
#define TR_OFF    (32u<<20)
#define TR_SZ     (8u<<20)

static unsigned char *g_disk;
static volatile LONG  *g_gen;         /* expected generation per churn block */
static volatile LONG   g_passthrough = 0;
static volatile LONG   g_mutating = 0;   /* metadata-hook window (driver parity) */
static volatile LONG   g_relocating = 0; /* F owned by relocator (app-level exclusivity) */
static volatile LONG   g_stop = 0;
static volatile LONG   g_fgen = 0;    /* F region generation (relocator advances) */
static volatile LONG   g_gated = 1;   /* 1 = commit_gen (post-fix), 0 = legacy ungated (pre-fix parity) */

static unsigned char pat_f(rb_u64 off, LONG gen)

   passes ALL reads through -- model: direct g_disk read, no cache involvement. */
static int read_like_driver(rb_u64 off, unsigned char *out, size_t len, int gated)
{

            {   size_t o = 0;

                if (o < miss[i].len) {
                    size_t cp = miss[i].len - o;
                    if ((size_t)(miss[i].offset + o + cp) > (size_t)(off + len)) cp = (size_t)(off + len) - (size_t)(miss[i].offset + o);

static int verify_f(rb_u64 off, unsigned char *buf)
{

                           (unsigned long long)off, k, buf[k], g_fgen, pat_f(off + k, g_fgen));

static DWORD WINAPI reader(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;

static DWORD WINAPI passthrough_cycler(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;

static DWORD WINAPI trimmer(LPVOID p)

   file content; mtime may even be preserved) + the hook's flush+discard_all

static DWORD WINAPI reader5(LPVOID p)
{
    R5ARG *a = (R5ARG *)p;
    unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc(256 * 1024);
    if (!buf) return 1;
    while (!g_stop) {
        if (g_reloc_busy) { Sleep(1); continue; }   /* device mid-relocation: torn state legal, skip */
        {   rb_u64 off = (rb_u64)(InterlockedIncrement(&g_x_reads) % 64) * 65536;
            verify5(a->st, a->disk, buf, off, *a->genp, a->pat, a->tag); }
        Sleep(1);
    }
    free(buf);
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI relocator5(LPVOID p)
{
    R5ARG *a = (R5ARG *)p;
    unsigned char *tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(65536);   /* PER-THREAD: static tmp = two relocators interleave (3rd harness bug class) */
    int cyc = 0;
    if (!tmp) return 1;
    while (!g_stop) {
        Sleep(2500);
        if (g_stop) break;
        InterlockedIncrement(&g_reloc_busy);
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(a->st, 1);
        rb_stream_flush(a->st, 1);
        rb_stream_discard_all(a->st);
        {   LONG gen = *a->genp + 1; int s;
            for (s = 0; s < 128; s++) {
                rb_u64 off = (rb_u64)s * 65536;
                size_t k;
                for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++) tmp[k] = a->pat(off + k, gen);
                memcpy(a->disk + off, tmp, 65536);
            }
            InterlockedExchange(a->genp, gen);
        }
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(a->st, 0);
        InterlockedDecrement(&g_reloc_busy);
        cyc++;
        printf("  [reloc5 %s %d] gen->%ld (x_err=%ld)\n", a->tag, cyc, *a->genp, g_x_err);
    }
    free(tmp);
    return 0;
}

static int run_mode5(void)
{
    HANDLE th[12]; int i, nth = 0;
    static R5ARG aa, ab, ba, bb;
    ULONG64 fa = 0;

    g_diskA = (unsigned char *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, 8u << 20, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    g_diskB = (unsigned char *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, 8u << 20, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!g_diskA || !g_diskB) return 1;
    for (fa = 0; fa < (4u << 20); fa++) { g_diskA[fa] = pat_f(fa, 0); g_diskB[fa] = pat_b(fa, 0); }

    {   rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
        cfg.max_bytes = (rb_u64)32 * 1024 * 1024;
        cfg.writeback = wb_fn5; cfg.readback = rb_fn5; cfg.block_size = 4096;
        g_eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
        g_st  = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 424242);
        g_stB = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 424243); }
    if (!g_eng || !g_st || !g_stB) return 1;

    aa.st = g_st;  aa.disk = g_diskA; aa.genp = &g_fgenA; aa.pat = pat_f; aa.tag = "A";
    ab.st = g_st;  ab.disk = g_diskA; ab.genp = &g_fgenA; ab.pat = pat_f; ab.tag = "A2";
    ba.st = g_stB; ba.disk = g_diskB; ba.genp = &g_fgenB; ba.pat = pat_b; ba.tag = "B";
    bb.st = g_stB; bb.disk = g_diskB; bb.genp = &g_fgenB; bb.pat = pat_b; bb.tag = "B2";

    printf("== mode5: dual-stream isolation (A on diskA, B on diskB), 30s ==\n");
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, relocator5, &aa, 0, NULL);   /* A relocator */
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, relocator5, &ba, 0, NULL);   /* B relocator (independent phase) */
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &aa, 0, NULL);
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &ab, 0, NULL);
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &ba, 0, NULL);
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &bb, 0, NULL);

    Sleep(30000);
    InterlockedExchange(&g_stop, 1);
    Sleep(500);
    for (i = 0; i < nth; i++) WaitForSingleObject(th[i], 3000);
    rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1); rb_stream_flush(g_stB, 1);

    printf("== RESULT mode5: x_err=%ld (reads=%ld) ==\n", g_x_err, g_x_reads);
    printf("VERDICT: %s\n", g_x_err ? "CROSS-STREAM CONTAMINATION REPRODUCED" : "streams fully isolated");
    return g_x_err ? 2 : 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    HANDLE th[16]; int i, nth = 0;
    ULONG64 f_err0, c_err0;
    int mode = (argc > 1) ? atoi(argv[1]) : 0;   /* 0=full 1=readers-only 2=+writers 3=+trim 4=+relocator 5=dual-stream */
    if (argc > 2) g_gated = atoi(argv[2]);       /* 1=commit_gen (post-fix) 0=legacy ungated (pre-fix parity) */
    if (mode == 5) return run_mode5();

    g_disk = (unsigned char *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, DISK_SZ, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    g_gen  = (volatile LONG *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, CH_BLKS * sizeof(LONG), MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!g_disk || !g_gen) { printf("alloc fail\n"); return 1; }

    /* device initial state: F pattern; churn gen=0 content; TRIMV garbage */
    for (i = 0; i < (int)F_SZ; i++)  g_disk[F_OFF + i] = pat_f(i, 0);
    {   rb_u32 b; size_t k;
        for (b = 0; b < CH_BLKS; b++)
            for (k = 0; k < 4096; k++)
                g_disk[CH_OFF + (rb_u64)b * 4096 + k] = pat_churn(b, 0, k); }

    {   rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
        cfg.max_bytes = (rb_u64)32 * 1024 * 1024;
        cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn; cfg.block_size = 4096;
        g_eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
        g_st  = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 424242); }
    if (!g_eng || !g_st) { printf("engine/stream fail\n"); return 1; }

    printf("== test_race1106 mode=%d (4 readers%s%s%s%s) gated=%ld, 30s ==\n",
           mode,
           mode >= 2 ? " + 2 writers" : "",
           (mode == 0 || mode == 3 || mode == 4) ? " + trimmer" : "",
           mode == 0 ? " + passthrough" : "",
           mode >= 4 ? " + relocator" : "",
           g_gated);
    if (mode == 0 || mode == 3 || mode == 4) th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, trimmer, NULL, 0, NULL);
    if (mode == 0)                           th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, passthrough_cycler, NULL, 0, NULL);
    if (mode >= 4)                           th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, relocator, NULL, 0, NULL);
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader, NULL, 0, NULL);
    if (mode >= 2) for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, writer, NULL, 0, NULL);

    Sleep(30000);
    f_err0 = g_f_err; c_err0 = g_churn_err;
    InterlockedExchange(&g_stop, 1);
    Sleep(500);
    for (i = 0; i < nth; i++) WaitForSingleObject(th[i], 3000);

    rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);

#ifdef RB_MUT_FINAL_SWEEP
    /* MUTATION 170 self-check: corrupt one byte of the first F cell on the
       simulated device and drop that cell's cached view. Threads are already
       stopped, so the 30s window stays clean; only the final sweep can see it. */
    g_disk[F_OFF + 12345] ^= 0xFF;
    rb_stream_invalidate_range(g_st, F_OFF, 65536);
#endif
#ifdef RB_MUT_DRAIN_ERR
    /* MUTATION 170 self-check: one error lands AFTER the window-end snapshot. */
    InterlockedIncrement(&g_f_err);
#endif
    /* final full verification of F through the cache */
    {   static unsigned char buf[256 * 1024]; int bad = 0;
        rb_u64 off; size_t k;
        for (off = F_OFF; off < F_OFF + F_SZ && !bad; off += 65536) {
            if (read_like_driver(off, buf, 65536, g_gated) == 0)
                for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
                    if (buf[k] != pat_f(off + k, g_fgen)) { bad = 1; printf("  [FINAL-F] off=%llu\n", (unsigned long long)(off + k)); break; }
        }
        printf("final F sweep: %s\n", bad ? "MISMATCH" : "clean");
    }

    printf("== RESULT: f_err=%lu (reads=%lu) churn_err=%lu ==\n",
           g_f_err, g_reads, g_churn_err);
    (void)f_err0; (void)c_err0;
    if (f_err0 || c_err0) {
        printf("VERDICT: PERSISTENT WRONG-SERVE REPRODUCED\n");
        return 2;
    }
    printf("VERDICT: clean (no persistent stale serve)\n");
    return 0;
}
````
