##### `tests/core/edge_v3.c`

````c
/*
 * RAMBoostFS 刁钻场景测试（真实用户视角，"有多刁钻就多刁钻"）
 *  A. 磁盘满 / writeback 持续失败：脏块保留、destroy 计入 lost_dirty、不崩溃不泄漏
 *  B. readback 失败：部分写 RMW 无法补旧数据 -> 直写兜底，盘数据正确
 *  C. 空闲自动释放后重读：数据从盘重读，完全一致
 *  D. 休眠/唤醒时钟大跳变（单调向前）：不崩溃、不误伤
 *  E. 硬上限写满（小缓存）：超限直写，盘最终数据正确
 *  F. writeback 间歇抖动：失败保留脏位，恢复后回写成功，数据一致
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define DISK_SIZE (64u * 1024u * 1024u)
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static int g_wb_fail = 0, g_rb_fail = 0, g_fail = 0;

static int wb_fn(void *c, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *d, size_t len)
{
    (void)c; (void)fid;
    if (g_wb_fail) return -1;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, d, len); return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void *c, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t len)
{
    (void)c; (void)fid;
    if (g_rb_fail) return -1;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(b, g_disk + off, len); return 0;
}
#define CHECK(cond, msg) do { if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] %s\n", msg); g_fail++; } \
    else printf("  [ok]   %s\n", msg); } while (0)

static rb_engine *make_engine(rb_u64 mb, rb_u64 idlems)
{
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = mb;
    cfg.high_water = mb * 60 / 100; cfg.low_water = mb * 40 / 100;
    cfg.evict_high = mb * 80 / 100; cfg.evict_low = mb * 60 / 100;
    cfg.hard_limit = mb * 95 / 100;
    cfg.max_merge_len = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.idle_reclaim_ms = idlems;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn; cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    return rb_engine_create(&cfg);
}
static void pat(unsigned char *p, size_t n, rb_u64 base)
{ size_t i; for (i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = (unsigned char)((base + i) * 31u + 7u); }

/* A. 磁盘满 */
static void case_disk_full(void)
{
    rb_engine *e = make_engine(8*1024*1024, 0);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 1);
    rb_direct_range dr[64]; rb_stats st;
    unsigned char *buf = malloc(1024*1024); int i, dc;
    printf("A. 磁盘满 / 回写持续失败\n");
    pat(buf, 1024*1024, 1);
    g_wb_fail = 1;
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) { dc = 0;
        rb_write(s, (rb_u64)i*1024*1024, buf, 1024*1024, dr, &dc, 64); }
    rb_stream_flush(s, 0);
    rb_engine_get_stats(e, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes > 0, "回写失败后脏数据保留");
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_get_stats(e, &st);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes > 0, "无法落盘脏块计入 lost_dirty_bytes");
    rb_engine_destroy(e); free(buf); g_wb_fail = 0;
}

/* B. readback 失败 -> 直写兜底 */
static void case_readback_fail(void)
{
    rb_engine *e = make_engine(8*1024*1024, 0);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 2);
    rb_direct_range dr[64]; unsigned char *wb = malloc(4096); int dc = 0, k, nd;
    rb_u64 base = 2*1024*1024 + 512;
    printf("B. readback 失败时部分写直写兜底\n");
    pat(wb, 4096, 99);
    g_rb_fail = 1;
    nd = rb_write(s, base, wb, 4096, dr, &dc, 64);
    (void)nd;
    CHECK(dc > 0, "RMW 补读失败 -> 产生直写区间");
    for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
        memcpy(g_disk + dr[k].offset, wb + (dr[k].offset - base), dr[k].len);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + base, wb, 4096) == 0, "直写兜底数据正确落盘");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e); free(wb); g_rb_fail = 0;
}

/* C. 空闲释放后重读一致 */
static void case_idle_reread(void)
{
    rb_engine *e = make_engine(8*1024*1024, 1000);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 3);
    rb_direct_range dr[64], miss[64]; rb_stats st;
    unsigned char *wb = malloc(256*1024), *diskbuf = malloc(256*1024);
    unsigned char *out = malloc(256*1024); int dc = 0, mc = 0, k, rc;
    rb_u64 before, reclaimed;
    printf("C. 空闲自动释放后重读一致\n");
    pat(wb, 256*1024, 7);
    rb_write(s, 0, wb, 256*1024, dr, &dc, 64);
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_engine_tick(e, 100);
    CHECK(rb_stream_idle_reclaim(s) == 0, "未超空闲阈值不释放");
    rb_engine_tick(e, 2000);
    rb_engine_get_stats(e, &st); before = st.cur_bytes;
    reclaimed = rb_stream_idle_reclaim(s);
    rb_engine_get_stats(e, &st);
    CHECK(reclaimed > 0 && st.cur_bytes < before, "超时干净块被释放");
    memset(diskbuf, 0, 256*1024); memset(out, 0, 256*1024);
    rc = rb_read(s, 0, out, 256*1024, miss, &mc, 64);
    (void)rc;
    for (k = 0; k < mc; k++)
        rb_fn(NULL, 3, miss[k].offset, diskbuf + miss[k].offset, miss[k].len);
    rb_read_commit(s, 0, diskbuf, 256*1024);
    /* 交集拷给用户 */
    memcpy(out, diskbuf, 256*1024);
    CHECK(memcmp(out, wb, 256*1024) == 0, "释放后重读数据与原写入一致");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    free(wb); free(diskbuf); free(out);
}

/* D. 时钟大跳变 */
static void case_clock_jump(void)
{
    rb_engine *e = make_engine(8*1024*1024, 1000);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 4);
    rb_direct_range dr[64]; unsigned char *wb = malloc(64*1024); int dc = 0;
    printf("D. 休眠/唤醒时钟大跳变\n");
    pat(wb, 64*1024, 3);
    rb_engine_tick(e, 5000);
    rb_write(s, 0, wb, 64*1024, dr, &dc, 64);
    rb_engine_tick(e, 5000000);
    rb_stream_flush(s, 0);
    rb_engine_tick(e, 5000002);
    rb_stream_idle_reclaim(s);
    CHECK(1, "时钟大跳变全程无崩溃/无溢出");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e); free(wb);
}

/* E. 硬上限写满 */
static void case_hard_limit(void)
{
    rb_engine *e = make_engine(1024*1024, 1024*1024);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 5);
    rb_direct_range dr[128];
    unsigned char *wb = malloc(1024*1024), *expect = malloc(4*1024*1024);
    int i, dc, k;
    printf("E. 小缓存硬上限写满保护\n");
    memset(expect, 0, 4*1024*1024);
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        pat(wb, 1024*1024, (rb_u64)i+1);
        memcpy(expect + i*1024*1024, wb, 1024*1024);
        dc = 0;
        rb_write(s, (rb_u64)i*1024*1024, wb, 1024*1024, dr, &dc, 128);
        for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
            memcpy(g_disk + dr[k].offset,
                   wb + (dr[k].offset - (rb_u64)i*1024*1024), dr[k].len);
    }
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, expect, 4*1024*1024) == 0, "写满后盘数据完整正确");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e); free(wb); free(expect);
}

/* F. 间歇抖动 */
static void case_flaky_wb(void)
{
    rb_engine *e = make_engine(8*1024*1024, 0);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 6);
    rb_direct_range dr[64];
    unsigned char *wb = malloc(64*1024); int i, dc, ok = 1; rb_stats st;
    printf("F. 回写间歇抖动\n");
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        pat(wb, 64*1024, (rb_u64)i+20); dc = 0;
        rb_write(s, (rb_u64)i*64*1024, wb, 64*1024, dr, &dc, 64);
        g_wb_fail = (i % 2 == 0);
        rb_stream_flush(s, 0);
    }
    g_wb_fail = 0;
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(e, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "恢复后全部脏数据回写、无残留");
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        pat(wb, 64*1024, (rb_u64)i+20);
        if (memcmp(g_disk + i*64*1024, wb, 64*1024) != 0) ok = 0;
    }
    CHECK(ok, "抖动后盘数据一致");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e); free(wb);
}

int main(void)
{
    g_disk = calloc(1, DISK_SIZE);
    case_disk_full();   memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);
    case_readback_fail(); memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);
    case_idle_reread(); memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);
    case_clock_jump();  memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);
    case_hard_limit();  memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);
    case_flaky_wb();
    free(g_disk);
    printf("\n刁钻场景测试: %s (失败 %d)\n", g_fail ? "存在失败" : "全部通过", g_fail);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/edge_v4.c`

````c
/*
 * RAMBoostFS V4 跨模块"配合类"刁钻测试（检查长视角）
 *
 * 这些场景单看每个函数都没问题，必须多线程、多模块同时动作才可能暴露：
 *  C1 force flush 与前台同分片读写风暴（force 自旋等待在途回写）
 *  C2 trim 与前台同分片并发
 *  C3 idle reclaim + 时钟大跳变 与前台同分片并发（干净块被释放后再 miss 补回）
 *  C4 跨分片非对齐部分写 RMW 风暴（readback 合并路径高并发）
 *  C5 在线配置变更（max 骤缩/骤增、idle 阈值）与在途 IO 并发
 *  C6 磁盘满 -> 脏保留(此时 lost=0) -> 磁盘恢复 -> 回写成功(lost=0)
 *  C7 磁盘永久满 -> destroy：精确核对 lost == 无法落盘的脏字节
 *
 * 确定性技巧：所有写入字节 = fbyte(off)，磁盘初值也 = fbyte(off)，
 * 因此无论线程怎样交错、RMW 怎样合并、块怎样被释放重建，最终缓存与磁盘
 * 任意位置都必须等于 fbyte(off)，读校验无歧义。
 *
 * 测试自律：偏移严格在界内；共享磁盘 disk_mx 保护；direct/miss 按精确 len；
 * 引擎操作在 disk_mx 之外。死锁由外部 timeout 判定。
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define FILESZ   (24ull * 1024 * 1024)   /* 64KB 整除 */
#define NF       8                        /* 前台线程数 */
#define FOPS     900                      /* 前台每线程操作数 */
#define DROPS    260                      /* 干扰线程迭代数 */
#define MAXLEN   (200 * 1024)             /* 跨多 chunk / stripe */
#define BASEMB   16ull

static unsigned char *g_disk;
static rb_engine     *g_eng;
static rb_stream     *g_st;
static pthread_mutex_t disk_mx;
static atomic_int     g_stop;
static atomic_long    g_bad;
static atomic_llong   g_clk;
static atomic_llong   g_cap;              /* 模拟磁盘容量（off+n>cap 则失败） */

static unsigned nrand(unsigned *s){ *s = *s*1103515245u+12345u; return *s>>1; }
static unsigned char fbyte(rb_u64 off){ return (unsigned char)(off*131u+7u); }

/* ---- 磁盘回调 ---- */
static int wb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 fid,rb_u64 off,const void*b,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    if((rb_u64)atomic_load(&g_cap) < off+n) return -1;   /* 磁盘满 */
    pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
    memcpy(g_disk+off,b,n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 fid,rb_u64 off,void*b,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    if((rb_u64)atomic_load(&g_cap) < off+n) return -1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
    memcpy(b,g_disk+off,n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
    return 0;
}

/* 模拟驱动处理 miss（短持 disk_mx 读盘，释放后再 commit） */
static void serve_miss(void*out,rb_u64 reqoff,size_t reqlen,
                       rb_direct_range*ms,int mc){
    int k; rb_u64 reqend=reqoff+reqlen;
    for(k=0;k<mc;k++){
        unsigned char*tmp=malloc(ms[k].len);
        rb_u64 mend=ms[k].offset+ms[k].len,lo,hi;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
        memcpy(tmp,g_disk+ms[k].offset,ms[k].len);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
        rb_read_commit(g_st,ms[k].offset,tmp,ms[k].len);
        lo=ms[k].offset>reqoff?ms[k].offset:reqoff;
        hi=mend<reqend?mend:reqend;
        if(hi>lo) memcpy((unsigned char*)out+(lo-reqoff),
                         tmp+(lo-ms[k].offset),(size_t)(hi-lo));
        free(tmp);
    }
}

/* 一次确定性写：数据=fbyte；direct 区间也写盘（同样 fbyte） */
static void det_write(rb_u64 off,size_t len){
    unsigned char*data=malloc(len); rb_u64 q; int k,dc=0;
    rb_direct_range dr[160];
    for(q=0;q<len;q++)data[q]=fbyte(off+q);
    rb_write(g_st,off,data,len,dr,&dc,160);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
    if(dc>160) memcpy(g_disk+off,data,len);
    else for(k=0;k<dc;k++) memcpy(g_disk+dr[k].offset,
                data+(dr[k].offset-off),dr[k].len);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
    free(data);
}

/* 前台：随机非对齐读写（部分写触发跨分片 RMW），读校验 fbyte */
static void* fg(void*p){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p ^ 0x1357; int op;
    for(op=0;op<FOPS && !atomic_load(&g_stop);op++){
        rb_u64 off=(rb_u64)(nrand(&seed)%FILESZ);
        size_t maxl=(size_t)(FILESZ-off);
        size_t len=1+(size_t)(nrand(&seed)%(MAXLEN<maxl?MAXLEN:maxl));
        if(nrand(&seed)%10 < 7){
            det_write(off,len);
        } else {
            unsigned char*out=malloc(len); size_t d;
            rb_direct_range ms[160]; int mc=0;
            int r=rb_read(g_st,off,out,len,ms,&mc,160);
            if(r==-2){ pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
                       memcpy(out,g_disk+off,len);
                       pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx); }
            else serve_miss(out,off,len,ms,mc);
            for(d=0;d<len;d++) if(out[d]!=fbyte(off+d))break;
            if(d<len){ printf("  [FAIL] op=%d off=%llu len=%zu @%zu got=%u exp=%u\n",
                        op,(unsigned long long)off,len,d,out[d],fbyte(off+d));
                       atomic_store(&g_stop,1); atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1); }
            free(out);
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* D1：force flush 风暴 */
static void* d_flush(void*p){ int i;(void)p;
    for(i=0;i<DROPS && !atomic_load(&g_stop);i++) rb_stream_flush(g_st,1);
    return NULL;
}
/* D2：trim + 时钟大跳变 + idle reclaim */
static void* d_trimidle(void*p){ int i; unsigned s=(unsigned)(unsigned long long)p;
    for(i=0;i<DROPS && !atomic_load(&g_stop);i++){
        long j=20000+(nrand(&s)%40000);
        long c=atomic_fetch_add(&g_clk,j)+j;
        rb_engine_tick(g_eng,(rb_u64)c);
        rb_stream_trim(g_st);
        rb_stream_idle_reclaim(g_st);
    }
    return NULL;
}
/* D3：在线配置变更（max 骤缩/骤增 + idle 阈值） */
static void* d_config(void*p){ int i; unsigned s=(unsigned)(unsigned long long)p;
    for(i=0;i<DROPS && !atomic_load(&g_stop);i++){
        rb_u64 mb=(nrand(&s)&1)?2ull:BASEMB;
        rb_engine_set_max_bytes(g_eng,mb*1024*1024);
        rb_engine_set_idle_reclaim(g_eng,(nrand(&s)&1)?2000:0);
    }
    return NULL;
}

#define CK(cond,msg) do{ if(!(cond)){printf("  [FAIL] %s\n",msg);atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1);} \
    else printf("  [ok]   %s\n",msg);}while(0)

/* C1~C5 综合：前台 + 三类干扰同时进行 */
static void case_combined(void){
    pthread_t ft[NF],t1,t2,t3; int i; rb_stats st;
    rb_config cfg;
    printf("C1-C5. force flush / trim / idle+时钟跳变 / 跨分片RMW / 在线配置 与前台同分片并发\n");
    memset(&cfg,0,sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes=BASEMB*1024*1024; cfg.max_merge_len=4*1024*1024;
    cfg.idle_reclaim_ms=3000; cfg.readback=rb_fn; cfg.writeback=wb_fn;
    g_eng=rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    g_disk=malloc(FILESZ); { rb_u64 q; for(q=0;q<FILESZ;q++)g_disk[q]=fbyte(q); }
    atomic_store(&g_cap,(long long)FILESZ);
    g_st=rb_stream_create(g_eng,777);

    pthread_create(&t1,NULL,d_flush,(void*)1);
    pthread_create(&t2,NULL,d_trimidle,(void*)2);
    pthread_create(&t3,NULL,d_config,(void*)3);
    for(i=0;i<NF;i++) pthread_create(&ft[i],NULL,fg,(void*)(unsigned long)(i+11));
    for(i=0;i<NF;i++) pthread_join(ft[i],NULL);
    atomic_store(&g_stop,1);
    pthread_join(t1,NULL); pthread_join(t2,NULL); pthread_join(t3,NULL);

    /* 恢复正常配置后终检 */
    rb_engine_set_max_bytes(g_eng,BASEMB*1024*1024);
    rb_engine_set_idle_reclaim(g_eng,0);
    rb_stream_flush(g_st,1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
    CK(st.dirty_bytes==0,"终态脏=0");
    CK(st.lost_dirty_bytes==0,"非预期丢弃=0");
    { rb_u64 q; long bad=0; for(q=0;q<FILESZ;q++) if(g_disk[q]!=fbyte(q)){bad++;if(bad==1)
        printf("  [FAIL] 磁盘@%llu got=%u exp=%u\n",(unsigned long long)q,g_disk[q],fbyte(q));}
      CK(bad==0,"磁盘逐字节==fbyte"); }
    rb_stream_destroy(g_st); g_st=NULL;
    rb_engine_destroy(g_eng); g_eng=NULL;
    free(g_disk); g_disk=NULL;
    atomic_store(&g_stop,0);
}

/* C6：磁盘满 -> 脏保留(lost=0) -> 恢复 -> 回写(lost=0) */
static void case_recover(void){
    rb_engine*e; rb_stream*s; rb_stats st; rb_direct_range dr[64];
    unsigned char*buf=malloc(64*1024); rb_u64 q; int dc=0,i;
    printf("C6. 磁盘满 -> 脏保留 -> 磁盘恢复 -> 回写成功\n");
    { rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg,0,sizeof(cfg));
      cfg.max_bytes=8ull*1024*1024; cfg.max_merge_len=4*1024*1024;
      cfg.readback=rb_fn; cfg.writeback=wb_fn; e=rb_engine_create(&cfg); }
    g_disk=malloc(FILESZ); for(q=0;q<FILESZ;q++)g_disk[q]=fbyte(q);
    s=rb_stream_create(e,888);
    /* 容量只到 256KB：写 1MB（多块），多数回写失败 */
    atomic_store(&g_cap,256*1024);
    for(i=0;i<16;i++){ for(q=0;q<64*1024;q++)buf[q]=fbyte((rb_u64)i*64*1024+q);
        dc=0; rb_write(s,(rb_u64)i*64*1024,buf,64*1024,dr,&dc,64);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx); int k;
        for(k=0;k<dc;k++) if(dr[k].offset+dr[k].len<=(rb_u64)256*1024)
            memcpy(g_disk+dr[k].offset,buf+(dr[k].offset-(rb_u64)i*64*1024),dr[k].len);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
    }
    rb_stream_flush(s,1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
    CK(st.dirty_bytes>0,"磁盘满期间脏数据保留");
    CK(st.lost_dirty_bytes==0,"未销毁前 lost=0");
    /* 磁盘恢复（容量放开） */
    atomic_store(&g_cap,(long long)FILESZ);
    rb_stream_flush(s,1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
    CK(st.dirty_bytes==0,"恢复后脏=0");
    CK(st.lost_dirty_bytes==0,"恢复后 lost=0");
    { long bad=0; for(q=0;q<1024*1024;q++) if(g_disk[q]!=fbyte(q))bad++;
      CK(bad==0,"已写区间磁盘逐字节==fbyte"); }
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    free(g_disk); g_disk=NULL; free(buf);
}

/* C7：永久满 -> destroy，精确核对 lost == 无法落盘的脏字节 */
static void case_permanent_full(void){
    rb_engine*e; rb_stream*s; rb_stats st; rb_direct_range dr[64];
    unsigned char*buf=malloc(64*1024); rb_u64 q; int dc=0,i;
    const rb_u64 CAP=128*1024, WROTE=512*1024;
    printf("C7. 磁盘永久满 -> destroy 精确核对 lost 计数\n");
    { rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg,0,sizeof(cfg));
      cfg.max_bytes=8ull*1024*1024; cfg.max_merge_len=4*1024*1024;
      cfg.readback=rb_fn; cfg.writeback=wb_fn; e=rb_engine_create(&cfg); }
    g_disk=malloc(FILESZ); for(q=0;q<FILESZ;q++)g_disk[q]=fbyte(q);
    s=rb_stream_create(e,999);
    atomic_store(&g_cap,(long long)CAP);
    for(i=0;i<(int)(WROTE/64/1024);i++){ for(q=0;q<64*1024;q++)buf[q]=fbyte((rb_u64)i*64*1024+q);
        dc=0; rb_write(s,(rb_u64)i*64*1024,buf,64*1024,dr,&dc,64);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx); int k;
        for(k=0;k<dc;k++) if(dr[k].offset+dr[k].len<=CAP)
            memcpy(g_disk+dr[k].offset,buf+(dr[k].offset-(rb_u64)i*64*1024),dr[k].len);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
    }
    /* 销毁前应有的脏量（缓存内全部写入量；CAP 内的块在 flush 时会成功） */
    rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
    { rb_u64 dirty_before=st.dirty_bytes;
      rb_stream_destroy(s);
      rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
      /* V7.4：flush_pass 把 0..512K 的脏子块按 offset 排序合并成【单条连续大段】
       * 一次性 FltWriteFile。wb_fn 模拟器按 offset+len>g_cap 整体判失败 → 整段不落盘，
       * destroy 时整段脏记 lost（=全部写入量，比逐块模型更保守，绝不误清）。 */
      CK(st.lost_dirty_bytes==WROTE,"lost 精确==无法落盘脏字节(合并大段整体失败)");
      CK(dirty_before==WROTE,"销毁前脏量==写入量");
      printf("       (lost=%llu, 期望=%llu)\n",(unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes,
             (unsigned long long)(WROTE-CAP));
    }
    rb_engine_destroy(e); free(g_disk); g_disk=NULL; free(buf);
}

int main(void){
    pthread_mutex_init(&disk_mx,NULL);
    atomic_init(&g_stop,0); atomic_init(&g_bad,0);
    atomic_init(&g_clk,1); atomic_init(&g_cap,(long long)FILESZ);
    case_combined();
    case_recover();
    case_permanent_full();
    pthread_mutex_destroy(&disk_mx);
    long bad=atomic_load(&g_bad);
    printf("\nV4 跨模块刁钻测试: %s (失败 %ld)\n",bad?"存在失败":"全部通过",bad);
    return bad?1:0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/offchk.c`

````c
/* offchk.c —— rb_chunk 布局诊断镜像。
 * 同步义务：本结构体必须与 cache.c 的 struct rb_chunk 逐字段一致。
 * 2026-10-15：删 evicting（W18 死字段移除，随 cache.c 同步）。
 * 注：_Static_assert 只能断言本镜像自身，跨 TU 对齐靠本文件与 cache.c 的人工同步纪律。 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stddef.h>
struct rb_chunk {
    rb_u64 start;
    unsigned char *data;
    uint16_t loaded;
    uint16_t dirty;
    rb_u64 last_access;
    uint32_t hits;                   /* [D2] 与 cache.c struct rb_chunk 同步（2026-10-15） */
    rb_u64 epoch;
    uint32_t dseq[16];
    struct rb_chunk *hash_next;
    struct rb_chunk *lru_prev, *lru_next;
    struct rb_chunk *d_prev, *d_next;
};
int main(void){
    printf("sizeof=%zu\n", sizeof(struct rb_chunk));
    printf("start=%zu data=%zu loaded=%zu dirty=%zu last_access=%zu hits=%zu epoch=%zu dseq=%zu hash_next=%zu lru_prev=%zu lru_next=%zu d_prev=%zu d_next=%zu\n",
      offsetof(struct rb_chunk,start), offsetof(struct rb_chunk,data), offsetof(struct rb_chunk,loaded),
      offsetof(struct rb_chunk,dirty), offsetof(struct rb_chunk,last_access), offsetof(struct rb_chunk,hits),
      offsetof(struct rb_chunk,epoch), offsetof(struct rb_chunk,dseq), offsetof(struct rb_chunk,hash_next),
      offsetof(struct rb_chunk,lru_prev), offsetof(struct rb_chunk,lru_next), offsetof(struct rb_chunk,d_prev),
      offsetof(struct rb_chunk,d_next));
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/pthread.h`

````c
/* Minimal pthread subset shim for MSVC userspace test builds (Windows).
 * Only the subset used by core/* tests: mutex init/lock/unlock/trylock/destroy,
 * thread create/join. x64 uses a single calling convention so the void*(*)(void*)
 * worker signature casts cleanly to _beginthreadex's expected prototype. */
#ifndef RB_PTHREAD_SHIM_H
#define RB_PTHREAD_SHIM_H

#include <windows.h>
#include <process.h>
#include <errno.h>

/* (rand_r is provided via cache.h's MSVC shim; do not redefine here.) */

typedef CRITICAL_SECTION pthread_mutex_t;

static __inline int pthread_mutex_init(pthread_mutex_t *m, const void *attr)
{ (void)attr; InitializeCriticalSection(m); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_mutex_lock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
{ EnterCriticalSection(m); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_mutex_unlock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
{ LeaveCriticalSection(m); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_mutex_trylock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
{ return TryEnterCriticalSection(m) ? 0 : EBUSY; }
static __inline int pthread_mutex_destroy(pthread_mutex_t *m)
{ DeleteCriticalSection(m); return 0; }

typedef HANDLE pthread_t;

static __inline int pthread_create(pthread_t *t, const void *attr,
                                   void *(*fn)(void *), void *arg)
{
    uintptr_t h = _beginthreadex(NULL, 0,
        (unsigned (__stdcall *)(void *))fn, arg, 0, NULL);
    (void)attr;
    if (!h) return 1;
    *t = (HANDLE)h;
    return 0;
}
static __inline int pthread_join(pthread_t t, void **res)
{ (void)res; WaitForSingleObject(t, INFINITE); CloseHandle(t); return 0; }

/* Reader/writer lock shim: 测试用恒排他 CRITICAL_SECTION（保证正确性）。
 * 真共享读/排他写语义在内核 ERESOURCE 路径验证；用户态测试只验逻辑正确性。 */
typedef CRITICAL_SECTION pthread_rwlock_t;
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_init(pthread_rwlock_t *l, const void *attr)
{ (void)attr; InitializeCriticalSection(l); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_rdlock(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ EnterCriticalSection(l); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_wrlock(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ EnterCriticalSection(l); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_trywrlock(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ return TryEnterCriticalSection(l) ? 0 : EBUSY; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_unlock(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ LeaveCriticalSection(l); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_destroy(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ DeleteCriticalSection(l); return 0; }

#endif
````

##### `tests/core/rbc_e2e_verify.c`

````c
/*
 * rbc_e2e_verify.c -- 盘面一致性硬 oracle（QA 独立工具，2026-11-07）
 *
 * 用途：给 deliverables/77 §4 的 G3/G4 提供 fail-closed 的硬判据。
 *   写阶段：确定性 pattern = f(绝对文件偏移, seed, pattern名)，N 个线程各写
 *           一段**不重叠**区间；所有 IO 走 FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING |
 *           FILE_FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH，绕过 OS 文件缓存，强制经过块层过滤驱动。
 *   读阶段：关闭全部写句柄后**重新打开** unbuffered 句柄，逐 4096B 块读回，
 *           与独立复算的 pattern 逐字节比对，同时算「期望 / 实际」两份 SHA256。
 *
 * 纪律：
 *   - 本文件独立于产品源码：不 include 任何 src/core / src/driver 头文件，
 *     只依赖 Win32 + Windows CNG(bcrypt，系统内置，非第三方库)。
 *   - 绝不静默回落到 buffered IO；任何对齐/长度/字节/哈希不符一律 [FAIL] + exit 1。
 *   - 所有数据 IO 的偏移、长度、缓冲区地址均按 IO_UNIT=4096 对齐，
 *     且开句柄前先查卷 LogicalSectorBytes 并校验 IO_UNIT 是其整数倍。
 *   - 工具本身不写注册表、不改配置、不碰服务/驱动、不内置任何默认文件路径。
 *
 * 构建（MSVC cl 19.44 + WinSDK 10.0.26100.0，详见 78 号文档 §1）：
 *   cl /nologo /O2 /W4 /utf-8 rbc_e2e_verify.c /Fe:build\rbc_e2e_verify.exe ^
 *      /Fo:build\rbc_e2e_verify.obj bcrypt.lib
 *
 * 用法：
 *   rbc_e2e_verify --file <绝对路径> [--size <MiB>] [--seed <n>]
 *                  [--threads <N>] [--pattern <名称>] [--verify-only] [--help]
 *   --verify-only 必须复传与写入时**完全相同**的 --size/--seed/--pattern，
 *   否则复算出的期望 pattern 不同，会如实 FAIL（不猜、不自动推断）。
 */

#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#include <errno.h>

#pragma comment(lib, "bcrypt.lib")

#define RBC_TOOL_VERSION   "1.0"
#define IO_UNIT            4096u        /* 内部 IO 对齐粒度：512/4096 扇区均整除 */
#define DEFAULT_SIZE_MIB   64u
#define DEFAULT_SEED       ((uint64_t)20261107ULL)
#define MAX_SIZE_MIB       16384u      /* 16 GiB 上限，防误填 */
#define MAX_THREADS        32u
#define SECTOR_MIN          512u
#define SHA256_LEN          32u

#ifndef BCRYPT_SUCCESS
#define BCRYPT_SUCCESS(s)  (((NTSTATUS)(s)) >= 0)
#endif

/* 共享标志：多句柄并行写 + unbuffered + 写穿，绝不带 FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED */
#define SHARE_ALL  (FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE)
#define IO_FLAGS   (FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING | FILE_FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH)

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 输出辅助：全部 ASCII，路径按 UTF-8 转码后打印，避免控制台编码歧义      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

static void print_path(const char *label, const wchar_t *p)
{
    char u8[1024];
    if (!WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, p, -1, u8, (int)sizeof(u8), NULL, NULL)) {
        printf("%s=<path-convert-error>\n", label);
        return;
    }
    printf("%s=%s\n", label, u8);
}

/* 统一 fail-closed 出口：打印 [FAIL] 原因 + 单行 RESULT: FAIL + return 1。
 * 所有调用点都在返回 int 的函数里（wmain / verify_file / write_phase）。 */
#define FAILF(...) do {                                                   \
    fflush(stdout);   /* 先把已缓冲的进度输出排空，保证 [FAIL] 行顺序可读 */ \
    fprintf(stderr, "[FAIL] " __VA_ARGS__);                               \
    fprintf(stderr, "\n");                                                \
    fflush(stderr);                                                       \
    printf("RESULT: FAIL\n");                                             \
    fflush(stdout);                                                       \
    return 1;                                                             \
} while (0)

static void usage(void)
{
    printf("rbc_e2e_verify %s -- unbuffered disk-surface oracle (QA, independent of product sources)\n",
           RBC_TOOL_VERSION);
    printf("usage: rbc_e2e_verify --file <absolute-path> [--size <MiB>] [--seed <n>]\n");
    printf("                      [--threads <N>] [--pattern <name>] [--verify-only]\n");
    printf("  --file        REQUIRED. Absolute drive-letter path only (e.g. D:\\rbc-e2e-work.bin).\n");
    printf("                No default path, no relative path, no guessed path.\n");
    printf("  --size        File size in MiB, 1..%u, default %u. Must be a multiple of %uB.\n",
           MAX_SIZE_MIB, DEFAULT_SIZE_MIB, IO_UNIT);
    printf("  --seed        uint64 decimal, default %llu. Part of the pattern function.\n",
           (unsigned long long)DEFAULT_SEED);
    printf("  --threads    1..%u, default 1. Non-overlapping byte ranges, joined before verify.\n",
           MAX_THREADS);
    printf("  --pattern    splitmix (default) | stripe4k | lcg. Deterministic f(offset,seed).\n");
    printf("  --verify-only Read-only: reopen unbuffered, compare, hash. Never writes.\n");
    printf("  --help        Print this text.\n");
    printf("flags: FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING | FILE_FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH on EVERY data handle.\n");
    printf("exit: 0 = PASS, 1 = FAIL (any alignment/length/byte/hash/argument problem).\n");
    printf("output: TOTAL_BYTES / BLOCKS_COMPARED / FIRST_MISMATCH_* / SHA256_* / RESULT: PASS|FAIL\n");
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* SHA-256 via Windows CNG (bcrypt.lib). 系统 API，无第三方依赖。         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

typedef struct {
    BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE  alg;
    BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE  hash;
    int                open;
} sha256_ctx;

static int sha256_open(sha256_ctx *c)
{
    NTSTATUS s;
    memset(c, 0, sizeof(*c));
    s = BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&c->alg, BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM, NULL, 0);
    if (!BCRYPT_SUCCESS(s)) return 0;
    s = BCryptCreateHash(c->alg, &c->hash, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, 0);
    if (!BCRYPT_SUCCESS(s)) {
        BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(c->alg, 0);
        c->alg = NULL;
        return 0;
    }
    c->open = 1;
    return 1;
}

static int sha256_update(sha256_ctx *c, void *p, size_t n)
{
    NTSTATUS s;
    if (!c->open) return 0;
    /* 单块 4096B，远小于 ULONG 上限；仍显式防御。 */
    if (n == 0) return 1;
    if (n > (size_t)0xFFFFFFFFUL) return 0;
    s = BCryptHashData(c->hash, (PUCHAR)p, (ULONG)n, 0);
    return BCRYPT_SUCCESS(s) ? 1 : 0;
}

static int sha256_final(sha256_ctx *c, unsigned char out[SHA256_LEN])
{
    NTSTATUS s;
    if (!c->open) return 0;
    s = BCryptFinishHash(c->hash, out, SHA256_LEN, 0);
    if (!BCRYPT_SUCCESS(s)) return 0;
    BCryptDestroyHash(c->hash);
    BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(c->alg, 0);
    c->hash = NULL; c->alg = NULL; c->open = 0;
    return 1;
}

static void hex32(const unsigned char b[SHA256_LEN], char out[2 * SHA256_LEN + 1])
{
    static const char hx[] = "0123456789abcdef";
    unsigned i;
    for (i = 0; i < SHA256_LEN; ++i) {
        out[2 * i]     = hx[(b[i] >> 4) & 0xF];
        out[2 * i + 1] = hx[b[i] & 0xF];
    }
    out[2 * SHA256_LEN] = '\0';
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 确定性 pattern：纯函数 f(offset, seed, kind)，无 rand() / 无全局状态  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

enum { PAT_SPLITMIX = 0, PAT_STRIPE4K = 1, PAT_LCG = 2 };
static const char *const PAT_NAMES[] = { "splitmix", "stripe4k", "lcg" };

static uint64_t mix64(uint64_t x)   /* splitmix64 finalizer */
{
    x ^= x >> 30;
    x *= (uint64_t)0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ULL;
    x ^= x >> 27;
    x *= (uint64_t)0x94D049BB133111EBULL;
    x ^= x >> 31;
    return x;
}

static unsigned char pat_byte(uint64_t off, uint64_t seed, int kind)
{
    const uint64_t s = mix64(seed ^ (uint64_t)0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL);
    switch (kind) {
    case PAT_STRIPE4K: {
        /* 块号 + 块内偏移共同参与，突出 4K 子块几何（16K 缓存下 RMW 场景）。 */
        const uint64_t blk = off >> 12;
        const uint64_t inb = off & (IO_UNIT - 1);
        return (unsigned char)(mix64(blk ^ s) + (unsigned char)(mix64(inb ^ s) >> 24));
    }
    case PAT_LCG:
        return (unsigned char)(mix64(off + s) ^ (unsigned char)(off >> 3));
    case PAT_SPLITMIX:
    default:
        return (unsigned char)mix64(off ^ s);
    }
}

static void fill_block(unsigned char *buf, uint64_t base_off, uint64_t seed, int kind)
{
    uint32_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < IO_UNIT; ++i)
        buf[i] = pat_byte(base_off + (uint64_t)i, seed, kind);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 参数 / 环境校验                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/* 只接受显式给出的盘符绝对路径；也支持 \\?\X:\ 前缀。 */
static int is_abs_drive_path(const wchar_t *p)
{
    if (!p || !p[0]) return 0;
    if (p[0] == L'\\' && p[1] == L'\\' && p[2] == L'?' && p[3] == L'\\') p += 4;
    return (p[0] != L'\0' && p[1] == L':') ? 1 : 0;
}

/* 从路径取卷根 "X:\" 后查 LogicalSectorBytes；失败返回 0（绝不猜）。 */
static int volume_sector_size(const wchar_t *path, DWORD *sector)
{
    const wchar_t *p = path;
    wchar_t root[4];
    DWORD spc = 0, bps = 0, nfree = 0, ntotal = 0;
    if (p[0] == L'\\' && p[1] == L'\\' && p[2] == L'?' && p[3] == L'\\') p += 4;
    if (!p[0] || p[1] != L':') return 0;
    root[0] = p[0]; root[1] = L':'; root[2] = L'\\'; root[3] = L'\0';
    if (!GetDiskFreeSpaceW(root, &spc, &bps, &nfree, &ntotal)) return 0;
    *sector = bps;
    return 1;
}

/* 严格十进制解析：不接受 "4096x" / 空串 / 负号 / 十六进制，拒绝静默截断。 */
static int parse_u64(const wchar_t *s, uint64_t *out)
{
    const wchar_t *p;
    unsigned long long v;
    if (!s || !s[0]) return 0;
    for (p = s; *p; ++p)
        if (*p < L'0' || *p > L'9') return 0;
    errno = 0;
    v = _wcstoui64(s, NULL, 10);
    if (errno == ERANGE) return 0;
    *out = (uint64_t)v;
    return 1;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 写阶段：每线程独立句柄 + 独立文件指针 + 不重叠区间                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

typedef struct {
    const wchar_t *path;
    uint64_t  start_block;
    uint64_t  nblocks;
    uint64_t  seed;
    int       pattern;
    uint32_t  tid;
    DWORD     err;          /* 0 = OK；否则 Win32 LastError */
    uint64_t  fail_off;     /* 出错块的文件偏移 */
    DWORD     got;          /* 出错时实际写入字节数 */
    uint64_t  bytes_written;
} THREAD_ARG;

static DWORD WINAPI writer_thread(LPVOID param)
{
    THREAD_ARG *a = (THREAD_ARG *)param;
    unsigned char *buf;
    HANDLE h;
    LARGE_INTEGER li;
    uint64_t b;

    a->err = 0; a->fail_off = 0; a->got = 0; a->bytes_written = 0;

    buf = (unsigned char *)_aligned_malloc(IO_UNIT, IO_UNIT);
    if (!buf) { a->err = ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY; return 1; }

    /* 每线程独立句柄：文件指针独立，线程间零共享、零竞争。 */
    h = CreateFileW(a->path, GENERIC_WRITE, SHARE_ALL, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING,
                     IO_FLAGS, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        a->err = GetLastError();
        _aligned_free(buf);
        return 1;
    }

    li.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)(a->start_block * (uint64_t)IO_UNIT);
    if (!SetFilePointerEx(h, li, NULL, FILE_BEGIN)) {
        a->err = GetLastError();
        CloseHandle(h); _aligned_free(buf);
        return 1;
    }

    for (b = 0; b < a->nblocks; ++b) {
        const uint64_t off = (a->start_block + b) * (uint64_t)IO_UNIT;
        DWORD written = 0;
        fill_block(buf, off, a->seed, a->pattern);
        if (!WriteFile(h, buf, IO_UNIT, &written, NULL) || written != IO_UNIT) {
            a->err = GetLastError();
            if (!a->err) a->err = ERROR_WRITE_FAULT;
            a->fail_off = off;
            a->got = written;
            CloseHandle(h); _aligned_free(buf);
            return 1;
        }
        a->bytes_written += (uint64_t)written;
    }

    /* WRITE_THROUGH 之外再显式 flush，确保关闭句柄前数据已落到块层以下。 */
    if (!FlushFileBuffers(h)) {
        a->err = GetLastError();
        CloseHandle(h); _aligned_free(buf);
        return 1;
    }
    CloseHandle(h);
    _aligned_free(buf);
    return 0;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 校验阶段：重新打开 unbuffered 句柄，逐块读回 + 逐字节比对 + 双 SHA256 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

typedef struct {
    uint64_t total_bytes;
    uint64_t blocks_compared;
    uint64_t mismatch_count;
    int      have_first;
    uint64_t first_off;
    unsigned char first_expected;
    unsigned char first_actual;
} VERIFY_RESULT;

static int verify_phase(const wchar_t *path, uint64_t total_bytes,
                         uint64_t seed, int pattern, DWORD sector,
                         VERIFY_RESULT *vr)
{
    HANDLE h;
    LARGE_INTEGER li, sz;
    unsigned char *io_buf, *expect;
    sha256_ctx sha_exp, sha_act;
    unsigned char dig_exp[SHA256_LEN], dig_act[SHA256_LEN];
    char hex_exp[2 * SHA256_LEN + 1], hex_act[2 * SHA256_LEN + 1];
    uint64_t total_blocks, b;
    int rc = 1;

    memset(vr, 0, sizeof(*vr));
    memset(&sha_exp, 0, sizeof(sha_exp));
    memset(&sha_act, 0, sizeof(sha_act));
    io_buf = NULL; expect = NULL;

    total_blocks = total_bytes / IO_UNIT;   /* 调用前已保证整除 */

    io_buf = (unsigned char *)_aligned_malloc(IO_UNIT, IO_UNIT);
    expect = (unsigned char *)_aligned_malloc(IO_UNIT, IO_UNIT);
    if (!io_buf || !expect) FAILF("aligned buffer allocation failed");

    /* 显式对齐断言：缓冲区地址必须按卷扇区对齐，否则 fail-closed。 */
    if ((((uintptr_t)io_buf) % sector) != 0 || (((uintptr_t)expect) % sector) != 0)
        FAILF("buffer address not sector-aligned (sector=%lu)", (unsigned long)sector);

    if (!sha256_open(&sha_exp) || !sha256_open(&sha_act))
        FAILF("BCrypt SHA256 open failed");

    /* 关闭写句柄之后，重新以 unbuffered 打开；不复用任何旧句柄。 */
    h = CreateFileW(path, GENERIC_READ, SHARE_ALL, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING,
                    IO_FLAGS, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
        FAILF("reopen for verify failed (CreateFileW NO_BUFFERING), LastError=%lu",
              (unsigned long)GetLastError());

    if (!GetFileSizeEx(h, &sz))
        FAILF("GetFileSizeEx failed, LastError=%lu", (unsigned long)GetLastError());
    if (sz.QuadPart != (LONGLONG)total_bytes)
        FAILF("file size mismatch: expected=%llu actual=%lld (refusing to infer size)"
              " -- --verify-only must repeat the exact --size used for writing",
              (unsigned long long)total_bytes, (long long)sz.QuadPart);

    li.QuadPart = 0;
    if (!SetFilePointerEx(h, li, NULL, FILE_BEGIN))
        FAILF("SetFilePointerEx(0) failed, LastError=%lu", (unsigned long)GetLastError());

    printf("PHASE=VERIFY (handle reopened, NO_BUFFERING|WRITE_THROUGH)\n");

    for (b = 0; b < total_blocks; ++b) {
        const uint64_t off = b * (uint64_t)IO_UNIT;
        DWORD got = 0;
        uint32_t i;

        fill_block(expect, off, seed, pattern);

        if (!ReadFile(h, io_buf, IO_UNIT, &got, NULL) || got != IO_UNIT)
            FAILF("short/unfailed read at offset=%llu got=%lu want=%u LastError=%lu"
                  " (no silent fallback to buffered IO)",
                  (unsigned long long)off, (unsigned long)got, IO_UNIT,
                  (unsigned long)GetLastError());

        if (!sha256_update(&sha_exp, expect, IO_UNIT) ||
            !sha256_update(&sha_act, io_buf, IO_UNIT))
            FAILF("BCryptHashData failed at offset=%llu", (unsigned long long)off);

        vr->blocks_compared++;
        for (i = 0; i < IO_UNIT; ++i) {
            if (expect[i] != io_buf[i]) {
                vr->mismatch_count++;
                if (!vr->have_first) {
                    vr->have_first = 1;
                    vr->first_off = off + i;
                    vr->first_expected = expect[i];
                    vr->first_actual = io_buf[i];
                }
            }
        }
        /* 注意：发现差异后仍读完全文件，保证 SHA256_ACTUAL 覆盖全文件。 */
    }

    if (!sha256_final(&sha_exp, dig_exp) || !sha256_final(&sha_act, dig_act))
        FAILF("BCryptFinishHash failed");
    hex32(dig_exp, hex_exp);
    hex32(dig_act, hex_act);

    vr->total_bytes = vr->blocks_compared * (uint64_t)IO_UNIT;

    printf("TOTAL_BYTES=%llu\n", (unsigned long long)vr->total_bytes);
    printf("BLOCKS_COMPARED=%llu\n", (unsigned long long)vr->blocks_compared);
    printf("MISMATCH_COUNT=%llu\n", (unsigned long long)vr->mismatch_count);
    if (vr->have_first) {
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_OFFSET=%llu\n", (unsigned long long)vr->first_off);
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_EXPECTED=0x%02x\n", (unsigned)vr->first_expected);
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_ACTUAL=0x%02x\n", (unsigned)vr->first_actual);
    } else {
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_OFFSET=none\n");
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_EXPECTED=none\n");
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_ACTUAL=none\n");
    }
    printf("SHA256_EXPECTED=%s\n", hex_exp);
    printf("SHA256_ACTUAL=%s\n", hex_act);

    if (vr->blocks_compared != total_blocks)
        FAILF("block count mismatch: compared=%llu expected=%llu",
              (unsigned long long)vr->blocks_compared, (unsigned long long)total_blocks);
    if (vr->mismatch_count != 0)
        FAILF("byte mismatch: count=%llu first_offset=%llu expected=0x%02x actual=0x%02x",
              (unsigned long long)vr->mismatch_count,
              (unsigned long long)vr->first_off,
              (unsigned)vr->first_expected, (unsigned)vr->first_actual);
    if (memcmp(dig_exp, dig_act, SHA256_LEN) != 0)
        FAILF("SHA256 mismatch: expected=%s actual=%s", hex_exp, hex_act);

    /* 所有 FAILF 分支都直接 return 1 使进程退出，OS 回收句柄/内存；
     * 成功路径在此显式释放。不做任何静默降级。 */
    rc = 0;
    if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(h);
    if (io_buf) _aligned_free(io_buf);
    if (expect) _aligned_free(expect);
    return rc;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* main                                                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t **argv)
{
    const wchar_t *file = NULL;
    uint64_t size_mib = DEFAULT_SIZE_MIB, seed = DEFAULT_SEED, threads = 1;
    uint64_t total_bytes, total_blocks;
    int pattern = PAT_SPLITMIX;
    int verify_only = 0, size_given = 0;
    DWORD sector = 0;
    int i;
    VERIFY_RESULT vr;

    /* ---- Arrange: 严格参数解析（未知参数一律 FAIL，不忽略） ---- */
    for (i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        const wchar_t *a = argv[i];
        if (!wcscmp(a, L"--help")) { usage(); return 0; }
        if (!wcscmp(a, L"--verify-only")) { verify_only = 1; continue; }
        if (!wcscmp(a, L"--file")) {
            if (i + 1 >= argc) FAILF("--file requires an explicit path");
            if (file) FAILF("--file specified more than once");
            file = argv[++i];
            if (!file[0] || (file[0] == L'-' && file[1] == L'-'))
                FAILF("--file value is missing or looks like another option");
            continue;
        }
        if (!wcscmp(a, L"--size")) {
            if (i + 1 >= argc) FAILF("--size requires a value");
            if (!parse_u64(argv[++i], &size_mib)) FAILF("--size must be a decimal integer");
            size_given = 1;
            continue;
        }
        if (!wcscmp(a, L"--seed")) {
            if (i + 1 >= argc) FAILF("--seed requires a value");
            if (!parse_u64(argv[++i], &seed)) FAILF("--seed must be a decimal uint64");
            continue;
        }
        if (!wcscmp(a, L"--threads")) {
            if (i + 1 >= argc) FAILF("--threads requires a value");
            if (!parse_u64(argv[++i], &threads)) FAILF("--threads must be a decimal integer");
            continue;
        }
        if (!wcscmp(a, L"--pattern")) {
            const wchar_t *v;
            if (i + 1 >= argc) FAILF("--pattern requires a name");
            v = argv[++i];
            if (!_wcsicmp(v, L"splitmix"))       pattern = PAT_SPLITMIX;
            else if (!_wcsicmp(v, L"stripe4k"))  pattern = PAT_STRIPE4K;
            else if (!_wcsicmp(v, L"lcg"))        pattern = PAT_LCG;
            else FAILF("unknown --pattern name (use splitmix | stripe4k | lcg)");
            continue;
        }
        FAILF("unknown argument (strict parsing; use --help)");
    }

    if (!file) FAILF("--file is REQUIRED (no default path is provided)");
    if (!is_abs_drive_path(file))
        FAILF("--file must be an explicit absolute drive-letter path (no relative path)");
    if (size_mib < 1 || size_mib > MAX_SIZE_MIB)
        FAILF("--size out of range 1..%u MiB (got %llu)", MAX_SIZE_MIB,
              (unsigned long long)size_mib);
    if (threads < 1 || threads > MAX_THREADS)
        FAILF("--threads out of range 1..%u (got %llu)", MAX_THREADS,
              (unsigned long long)threads);

    total_bytes = size_mib * 1024ULL * 1024ULL;
    if ((total_bytes % IO_UNIT) != 0)
        FAILF("size %llu bytes is not a multiple of IO_UNIT=%u", (unsigned long long)total_bytes, IO_UNIT);
    total_blocks = total_bytes / IO_UNIT;
    if (total_blocks == 0) FAILF("size too small: zero IO blocks");

    /* 卷扇区：查不到 / IO_UNIT 不是其整数倍 → FAIL，绝不静默降级到 buffered。 */
    if (!volume_sector_size(file, &sector))
        FAILF("cannot query volume sector size (GetDiskFreeSpaceW failed)");
    if (sector < SECTOR_MIN)
        FAILF("volume sector size %lu < %u (unsupported)", (unsigned long)sector, SECTOR_MIN);
    if ((IO_UNIT % sector) != 0)
        FAILF("IO_UNIT=%u is not a multiple of volume sector=%lu (alignment cannot be met)",
              IO_UNIT, (unsigned long)sector);

    printf("rbc_e2e_verify %s -- unbuffered disk-surface oracle\n", RBC_TOOL_VERSION);
    printf("MODE=%s\n", verify_only ? "verify-only" : "write+verify");
    print_path("FILE", file);
    printf("FLAGS=FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING|FILE_FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH\n");
    printf("IO_UNIT=%u  VOLUME_SECTOR=%lu  ALIGN_OK=1\n", IO_UNIT, (unsigned long)sector);
    printf("SIZE_MIB=%llu  SIZE_SOURCE=%s  TOTAL_BYTES=%llu  TOTAL_BLOCKS=%llu\n",
           (unsigned long long)size_mib, size_given ? "explicit" : "default",
           (unsigned long long)total_bytes, (unsigned long long)total_blocks);
    printf("THREADS=%llu  SEED=%llu  PATTERN=%s\n",
           (unsigned long long)threads, (unsigned long long)seed, PAT_NAMES[pattern]);
    fflush(stdout);

    /* ---- Act (write phase) ---- */
    if (!verify_only) {
        HANDLE hpre;
        LARGE_INTEGER li;
        HANDLE th[MAX_THREADS];
        THREAD_ARG args[MAX_THREADS];
        uint64_t base, rem, cur;
        uint32_t t, started = 0;
        int bad = 0;

        printf("PHASE=WRITE (CREATE_ALWAYS -> preallocate -> %llu threads)\n",
               (unsigned long long)threads);
        fflush(stdout);

        /* 主线程先重建并预分配：CREATE_ALWAYS 杜绝「旧内容残留造成假 PASS」。
         * 预分配保证文件长度精确、无稀疏洞；所有写块长度/偏移天然对齐。 */
        hpre = CreateFileW(file, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, SHARE_ALL, NULL,
                           CREATE_ALWAYS, IO_FLAGS, NULL);
        if (hpre == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
            FAILF("create/preallocate failed, LastError=%lu", (unsigned long)GetLastError());
        li.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)total_bytes;
        if (!SetFilePointerEx(hpre, li, NULL, FILE_BEGIN) || !SetEndOfFile(hpre)) {
            const DWORD e = GetLastError();
            CloseHandle(hpre);
            FAILF("SetEndOfFile(%llu) failed, LastError=%lu",
                  (unsigned long long)total_bytes, (unsigned long)e);
        }
        CloseHandle(hpre);   /* 写线程重新各自打开，验证「关闭后重开」语义 */

        memset(args, 0, sizeof(args));
        memset(th, 0, sizeof(th));
        base = total_blocks / threads;
        rem  = total_blocks % threads;
        cur  = 0;
        for (t = 0; t < (uint32_t)threads; ++t) {
            args[t].path        = file;
            args[t].start_block = cur;
            args[t].nblocks    = base + ((t < rem) ? 1u : 0u);
            args[t].seed       = seed;
            args[t].pattern    = pattern;
            args[t].tid        = t;
            cur += args[t].nblocks;   /* 前缀和：精确覆盖、零重叠 */
        }
        if (cur != total_blocks)
            FAILF("internal range partition error: cur=%llu total=%llu",
                  (unsigned long long)cur, (unsigned long long)total_blocks);

        for (t = 0; t < (uint32_t)threads; ++t) {
            th[t] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, writer_thread, &args[t], 0, NULL);
            if (!th[t]) {
                fprintf(stderr, "[FAIL] CreateThread(%u) failed, LastError=%lu\n",
                        t, (unsigned long)GetLastError());
                bad = 1;
                break;   /* 已启动的线程仍须 join 后再退出，不留后台写入 */
            }
            started = t + 1;
        }
        for (t = 0; t < started; ++t) {
            DWORD rc = 0;
            if (WaitForSingleObject(th[t], INFINITE) != WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "[FAIL] WaitForSingleObject(thread %u) failed\n", t);
                bad = 1;
            }
            if (!GetExitCodeThread(th[t], &rc)) rc = (DWORD)-1;
            CloseHandle(th[t]);
            if (rc != 0) {
                fflush(stdout);
                fprintf(stderr,
                        "[FAIL] writer thread %u failed: err=%lu offset=%llu got=%lu"
                        " blocks=%llu written=%llu\n",
                        t, (unsigned long)args[t].err,
                        (unsigned long long)args[t].fail_off,
                        (unsigned long)args[t].got,
                        (unsigned long long)args[t].nblocks,
                        (unsigned long long)args[t].bytes_written);
                bad = 1;
            } else {
                printf("WRITE_THREAD=%u OK blocks=%llu bytes=%llu\n", t,
                       (unsigned long long)args[t].nblocks,
                       (unsigned long long)args[t].bytes_written);
            }
        }
        fflush(stderr);
        if (bad) {
            printf("RESULT: FAIL\n");
            fflush(stdout);
            return 1;
        }
        printf("PHASE=WRITE DONE (all %llu threads joined)\n", (unsigned long long)threads);
        fflush(stdout);
    } else {
        printf("PHASE=WRITE SKIPPED (--verify-only; file must already exist)\n");
    }

    /* ---- Assert (verify phase) ---- */
    if (verify_phase(file, total_bytes, seed, pattern, sector, &vr) != 0)
        return 1;   /* verify_phase 已打印 [FAIL] 与 RESULT: FAIL */

    printf("RESULT: PASS\n");
    fflush(stdout);
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/stdatomic.h`

````c
/* Minimal C11 stdatomic shim for MSVC userspace test builds.
 * MSVC's own vcruntime_c11_stdatomic.h is unavailable in this environment,
 * so we shadow it via /I core with the small subset the tests use:
 *   atomic_int / atomic_long / atomic_llong, atomic_init/load/store/fetch_add.
 * All storage is 64-bit; on x64 aligned 64-bit reads are naturally atomic. */
#ifndef RB_STDATOMIC_SHIM_H
#define RB_STDATOMIC_SHIM_H

#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct { volatile long long v; } atomic_int;
typedef struct { volatile long long v; } atomic_long;
typedef struct { volatile long long v; } atomic_llong;

#define atomic_init(p, val)      ((void)((p)->v = (long long)(val)))
#define atomic_load(p)           ((p)->v)
#define atomic_store(p, val)     ((void)((p)->v = (long long)(val)))
#define atomic_fetch_add(p, inc) (InterlockedExchangeAdd64(&((p)->v), (long long)(inc)))

#endif
````

##### `tests/core/stress_v3.c`

````c
/* RAMBoostFS V3 多流并发压力测试（锁安全模型，见文件尾说明） */
#include "cache.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define NS        4
#define PART      (8ull*1024*1024)
#define DISKSZ    (NS*PART)
#define OPS       6000
#define SUB       4096
#define SUBS      (PART/SUB)

static unsigned char *g_disk;
static pthread_mutex_t lk[NS];
static rb_engine *eng;
static rb_stream *g_st[NS];

static int wb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *b, size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    if (off+n > DISKSZ) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk+off, b, n); return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n){
    return wb_fn(u,fid,off,b,n);
}

typedef struct { int si; unsigned seed; } Warg;

static void *worker(void *p){
    Warg *a=(Warg*)p; int si=a->si;
    unsigned r=a->seed;
    rb_stream *s=g_st[si];          /* 流已在 main 串行预创建 */
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lk[si]);
    for(int op=0; op<OPS; op++){
        r = r*1103515245u+12345u;
        int kind = (r>>16)%100;
        rb_u64 subi = (r>>3)%SUBS;
        rb_u64 base = (rb_u64)si*PART + subi*SUB;
        char tmp[SUB];
        if(kind<55){
            for(int k=0;k<SUB;k++) tmp[k]=(char)(r>>(k%32))+(char)k;
            rb_direct_range dr[32]; int dc=0;
            rb_write(s, base, tmp, SUB, dr, &dc, 32);
            for(int d=0;d<dc;d++)
                if(dr[d].offset+dr[d].len <= (rb_u64)(si+1)*PART)
                    memcpy(g_disk+dr[d].offset, tmp+(dr[d].offset-base), dr[d].len);
        } else {
            char out[SUB];
            rb_direct_range ms[32]; int mc=0;
            int rr=rb_read(s, base, out, SUB, ms, &mc, 32);
            if(rr==1 && mc==0){
                char out2[SUB]; rb_direct_range m2[32]; int c2=0;
                rb_read(s, base, out2, SUB, m2, &c2, 32);
                if(c2==0 && memcmp(out,out2,SUB)!=0){
                    printf("[流%d] 两次缓存读不一致 op=%d\n",si,op); exit(2);
                }
            }
            for(int m=0;m<mc;m++){
                memcpy(tmp, g_disk+ms[m].offset, ms[m].len);
                rb_read_commit(s, ms[m].offset, tmp, ms[m].len);
            }
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk[si]);
    return NULL;
}

static void *bg(void *p){
    (void)p;
    for(int it=0; it<400; it++){
        usleep(2000);
        rb_engine_tick(eng, (rb_u64)it*500);
        for(int si=0; si<NS; si++)
            if(pthread_mutex_trylock(&lk[si])==0){
                rb_stream_flush(g_st[si], 0);
                if(it%7==0) rb_stream_idle_reclaim(g_st[si]);
                pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk[si]);
            }
    }
    return NULL;
}

int main(void){
    g_disk = malloc(DISKSZ);
    if(!g_disk){printf("oom\n");return 1;}
    for(rb_u64 i=0;i<DISKSZ;i++) g_disk[i]=(unsigned char)(i*131+7);
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg,0,sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes=16ull*1024*1024;
    cfg.readback=rb_fn; cfg.writeback=wb_fn;
    cfg.idle_reclaim_ms=5000;
    eng=rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    for(int i=0;i<NS;i++) pthread_mutex_init(&lk[i],NULL);
    /* 先单线程串行创建全部流（避免并发改引擎流链表），并完成发布 */
    for(int i=0;i<NS;i++) g_st[i]=rb_stream_create(eng,(rb_u64)(i+1));
    pthread_t wt[NS], bgt; Warg wa[NS];
    for(int i=0;i<NS;i++){ wa[i].si=i; wa[i].seed=0x1234+i*999; }
    for(int i=0;i<NS;i++) pthread_create(&wt[i],NULL,worker,&wa[i]);
    pthread_create(&bgt,NULL,bg,NULL);
    for(int i=0;i<NS;i++) pthread_join(wt[i],NULL);
    pthread_join(bgt,NULL);
    for(int si=0;si<NS;si++){ pthread_mutex_lock(&lk[si]); rb_stream_flush(g_st[si],1); pthread_mutex_unlock(&lk[si]); }
    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(eng,&st);
    printf("脏=%llu 回写=%llu 淘汰=%llu trim=%llu 空闲释放=%llu 丢弃=%llu\n",
        (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes,(unsigned long long)st.wb_bytes,
        (unsigned long long)st.evict_bytes,(unsigned long long)st.trim_count,
        (unsigned long long)st.idle_reclaim_bytes,(unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
    if(st.dirty_bytes!=0){printf("FAIL 脏数据\n");return 1;}
    if(st.lost_dirty_bytes!=0){printf("FAIL 丢弃\n");return 1;}
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
    printf("V3 多流并发压力测试通过\n");
    free(g_disk);
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/stress_v4.c`

````c
/*
 * RAMBoostFS V4 多核分片压力测试（同一文件、多线程）
 *
 * 阶段A（分片并行 + 后台并发）：
 *   把文件切成 NW 个互不相交的 SHARD，每个前台线程只读写自己的 shard
 *   （shutdown 后读校验无歧义）；后台线程并发做 flush / reclaim / idle / tick，
 *   覆盖"flush、trim、idle 与前台同分片并发"、跨分片 RMW、时钟前跳。
 * 阶段B（同分片竞争 + 确定性数据）：
 *   所有线程对同一区域做读写，写入数据为偏移的纯函数（初值也相同），
 *   故无论怎样交错，缓存/磁盘/期望都应收敛到同一确定字节，
 *   真正压测同分片锁竞争（无损坏、无死锁）。
 *
 * 死锁探测：本程序若卡死，由外部 `timeout` 杀死并以非零退出判失败。
 * 最终：force flush 后磁盘逐字节 == 影子，脏=0、非预期丢弃=0。
 *
 * 注意（测试代码自律）：所有偏移严格在界内、memcmp 按精确 len、
 * 共享磁盘用 disk_mx 保护；缓存引擎操作在 disk_mx 之外。
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define NW        12
#define SHARD     (5ull*1024*1024)          /* 64KB 整除（80 块） */
#define FILEA     ((rb_u64)NW*SHARD)        /* 阶段A 文件 60MB */
#define FILEB     (8ull*1024*1024)          /* 阶段B 共享区域 */
#define CACHEMB   24ull
#define OPSA      1100                     /* 阶段A 每线程操作数 */
#define OPSB      700                      /* 阶段B 每线程操作数 */
#define MAXLEN    (280*1024)               /* 跨多 chunk / 多 stripe */
#define NBG       3

static unsigned char *g_disk;
static unsigned char *g_shadow;
static rb_engine     *g_eng;
static rb_stream     *g_st;
static rb_u64         g_filesz;
static pthread_mutex_t disk_mx;
static atomic_int     g_stop;
static atomic_long    g_bad;
static atomic_llong   g_clk;
static atomic_int     g_wb_fail;            /* 受控回写失败（默认0） */

static unsigned nrand(unsigned *s){ *s = *s*1103515245u+12345u; return *s>>1; }
static unsigned char fbyte(rb_u64 off){ return (unsigned char)(off*131u+7u); }
static void mkrand(unsigned char*p,size_t n,unsigned*s){
    size_t i; for(i=0;i<n;i++) p[i]=(unsigned char)nrand(s);
}

/* ---- 磁盘回调：stripe -> disk_mx（唯一方向，无环） ---- */
static int wb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 fid,rb_u64 off,const void*b,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    if(atomic_load(&g_wb_fail)) return -1;
    if(off+n>g_filesz) return -1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
    memcpy(g_disk+off,b,n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 fid,rb_u64 off,void*b,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    if(off+n>g_filesz) return -1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
    memcpy(b,g_disk+off,n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
    return 0;
}

/* 模拟驱动处理 miss：读盘（disk_mx，短持，释放后再 commit） */
static void serve_miss(void*out,rb_u64 reqoff,size_t reqlen,
                       rb_direct_range*ms,int mc){
    int k; rb_u64 reqend=reqoff+reqlen;
    for(k=0;k<mc;k++){
        unsigned char*tmp=malloc(ms[k].len);
        rb_u64 mend=ms[k].offset+ms[k].len,lo,hi;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
        memcpy(tmp,g_disk+ms[k].offset,ms[k].len);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
        rb_read_commit(g_st,ms[k].offset,tmp,ms[k].len);
        lo=ms[k].offset>reqoff?ms[k].offset:reqoff;
        hi=mend<reqend?mend:reqend;
        if(hi>lo) memcpy((unsigned char*)out+(lo-reqoff),
                         tmp+(lo-ms[k].offset),(size_t)(hi-lo));
        free(tmp);
    }
}

/* ================= 阶段A：分片私有 ================= */
typedef struct { int wid; unsigned seed; } Wa;
static void* workerA(void*p){
    Wa*w=(Wa*)p; int wid=w->wid; unsigned seed=w->seed;
    rb_u64 lo0=(rb_u64)wid*SHARD;
    rb_stream*s=g_st;
    int op;
    for(op=0;op<OPSA && !atomic_load(&g_stop);op++){
        rb_u64 span=(rb_u64)(nrand(&seed)%(rb_u64)SHARD);
        size_t maxl=(size_t)(SHARD-span);
        size_t len=1+(size_t)(nrand(&seed)%(MAXLEN<maxl?MAXLEN:maxl));
        rb_u64 off=lo0+span;
        if(len==0)continue;
        if(nrand(&seed)&1){
            unsigned char*data=malloc(len); mkrand(data,len,&seed);
            rb_direct_range dr[160]; int dc=0,k;
            rb_write(s,off,data,len,dr,&dc,160);
            pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
            if(dc>160) memcpy(g_disk+off,data,len);
            else for(k=0;k<dc;k++) memcpy(g_disk+dr[k].offset,
                        data+(dr[k].offset-off),dr[k].len);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
            memcpy(g_shadow+off,data,len);   /* shard 私有，无需 shadow 锁 */
            free(data);
        } else {
            unsigned char*out=malloc(len);
            rb_direct_range ms[160]; int mc=0;
            int r=rb_read(s,off,out,len,ms,&mc,160);
            if(r==-2){ pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
                       memcpy(out,g_disk+off,len);
                       pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx); }
            else serve_miss(out,off,len,ms,mc);
            if(memcmp(out,g_shadow+off,len)!=0){
                size_t d; for(d=0;d<len&&out[d]==g_shadow[off+d];d++);
                printf("  [FAIL A] wid=%d op=%d off=%llu len=%zu diff@%zu got=%u exp=%u\n",
                    wid,op,(unsigned long long)off,len,d,
                    d<len?(unsigned char)out[d]:0,d<len?(unsigned char)g_shadow[off+d]:0);
                atomic_store(&g_stop,1); atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1);
            }
            free(out);
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* ================= 阶段B：同区域、确定性数据 ================= */
static void* workerB(void*p){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p ^ 0x9e3779b9u;
    rb_stream*s=g_st; int op,k;
    for(op=0;op<OPSB && !atomic_load(&g_stop);op++){
        rb_u64 off=(rb_u64)(nrand(&seed)%FILEB);
        size_t len=1+(size_t)(nrand(&seed)%(MAXLEN<FILEB?MAXLEN:FILEB));
        if(off+len>FILEB)len=FILEB-off;
        if(len==0)continue;
        if(nrand(&seed)&1){
            /* 数据 = f(偏移)，与初值/其他线程完全一致，结果与交错无关 */
            unsigned char*data=malloc(len); rb_u64 q;
            for(q=0;q<len;q++)data[q]=fbyte(off+q);
            rb_direct_range dr[160]; int dc=0;
            rb_write(s,off,data,len,dr,&dc,160);
            pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
            if(dc>160) memcpy(g_disk+off,data,len);
            else for(k=0;k<dc;k++) memcpy(g_disk+dr[k].offset,
                        data+(dr[k].offset-off),dr[k].len);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
            free(data);
        } else {
            unsigned char*out=malloc(len);
            rb_direct_range ms[160]; int mc=0;
            int r=rb_read(s,off,out,len,ms,&mc,160);
            if(r==-2){ pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
                       memcpy(out,g_disk+off,len);
                       pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx); }
            else serve_miss(out,off,len,ms,mc);
            /* 期望恒为 f */
            size_t d; for(d=0;d<len;d++) if(out[d]!=fbyte(off+d))break;
            if(d<len){ printf("  [FAIL B] op=%d off=%llu diff@%zu got=%u exp=%u\n",
                        op,(unsigned long long)off,d,out[d],fbyte(off+d));
                       atomic_store(&g_stop,1); atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1); }
            free(out);
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* ---- 后台：flush / reclaim / idle / 单调时钟（含受控前跳） ---- */
static void* bg(void*p){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p ^ 0x55aa; long it=0;
    while(!atomic_load(&g_stop)){
        long dt=1+(nrand(&seed)%4);
        long cur=atomic_fetch_add(&g_clk,dt)+dt;
        rb_engine_tick(g_eng,(rb_u64)cur);
        if((it%40)==3){ long jump=30000+(nrand(&seed)%20000);   /* 受控前跳，催老 */
            cur=atomic_fetch_add(&g_clk,jump)+jump;
            rb_engine_tick(g_eng,(rb_u64)cur);
            rb_stream_idle_reclaim(g_st);
        }
        switch(nrand(&seed)%4){
            case 0: rb_engine_flush(g_eng,0); break;
            case 1: rb_engine_reclaim(g_eng); break;
            case 2: rb_stream_flush(g_st,0); break;
            default: break;
        }
        usleep(400+(nrand(&seed)%1200));
        it++;
    }
    return NULL;
}

static int verify(const char*tag){
    rb_stats st; int bad=0; rb_u64 i;
    rb_engine_flush(g_eng,1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
    if(st.dirty_bytes!=0){ printf("  [FAIL %s] 残留脏=%llu\n",tag,
        (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes); bad=1; }
    if(st.lost_dirty_bytes!=0){ printf("  [FAIL %s] 非预期丢弃=%llu\n",tag,
        (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes); bad=1; }
    for(i=0;i<g_filesz;i++) if(g_disk[i]!=g_shadow[i]){
        printf("  [FAIL %s] 磁盘!=影子 @%llu got=%u exp=%u\n",tag,
            (unsigned long long)i,g_disk[i],g_shadow[i]); bad=1; break; }
    if(!bad)printf("  [ok]   %s：脏=0 丢弃=0 磁盘逐字节一致\n",tag);
    return bad;
}

static rb_engine* make_engine(void){
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg,0,sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes=CACHEMB*1024*1024;
    cfg.max_merge_len=4*1024*1024;
    cfg.idle_reclaim_ms=4000;
    cfg.readback=rb_fn; cfg.writeback=wb_fn;
    return rb_engine_create(&cfg);
}

int main(void){
    pthread_mutex_init(&disk_mx,NULL);
    atomic_init(&g_stop,0); atomic_init(&g_bad,0);
    atomic_init(&g_clk,1); atomic_init(&g_wb_fail,0);

    g_eng=make_engine();
    g_disk=malloc(FILEA); g_shadow=malloc(FILEA);
    if(!g_disk||!g_shadow){printf("oom\n");return 1;}

    /* ---- 阶段A ---- */
    g_filesz=FILEA;
    { rb_u64 i; for(i=0;i<FILEA;i++){ g_disk[i]=fbyte(i); g_shadow[i]=g_disk[i]; } }
    g_st=rb_stream_create(g_eng,101);
    pthread_t wt[NW],bt[NBG]; Wa wa[NW]; int i;
    for(i=0;i<NW;i++){ wa[i].wid=i; wa[i].seed=0x1234+i*999; }
    for(i=0;i<NBG;i++) pthread_create(&bt[i],NULL,bg,(void*)(unsigned long)(i+1));
    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) pthread_create(&wt[i],NULL,workerA,&wa[i]);
    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) pthread_join(wt[i],NULL);
    atomic_store(&g_stop,1);
    for(i=0;i<NBG;i++) pthread_join(bt[i],NULL);
    long badA=verify("阶段A");
    rb_stream_destroy(g_st); g_st=NULL;

    /* ---- 阶段B（重建流，磁盘/影子重置为确定性 f） ---- */
    atomic_store(&g_stop,0);
    g_filesz=FILEB;
    { rb_u64 i; for(i=0;i<FILEB;i++){ g_disk[i]=fbyte(i); g_shadow[i]=g_disk[i]; } }
    g_st=rb_stream_create(g_eng,202);
    pthread_t wb[NW],bb[NBG];
    for(i=0;i<NBG;i++) pthread_create(&bb[i],NULL,bg,(void*)(unsigned long)(i+7));
    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) pthread_create(&wb[i],NULL,workerB,(void*)(unsigned long)(i+3));
    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) pthread_join(wb[i],NULL);
    atomic_store(&g_stop,1);
    for(i=0;i<NBG;i++) pthread_join(bb[i],NULL);
    long badB=verify("阶段B");
    rb_stream_destroy(g_st);

    rb_engine_destroy(g_eng);
    free(g_disk); free(g_shadow);
    if(atomic_load(&g_bad)||badA||badB){ printf("\nV4 多核分片压力测试：失败 (bad=%ld A=%ld B=%ld)\n",
        atomic_load(&g_bad),badA,badB); return 1; }
    printf("\nV4 多核分片压力测试通过（同文件 %d 线程分片并行 + 同分片竞争 + 后台并发）\n",NW);
    return 0;
}
````
