##### `tests/core/support/pthread.h`

````c
/* Minimal pthread subset shim for MSVC userspace test builds (Windows).
 * Only the subset used by core/* tests: mutex init/lock/unlock/trylock/destroy,
 * thread create/join. x64 uses a single calling convention so the void*(*)(void*)
 * worker signature casts cleanly to _beginthreadex's expected prototype. */
#ifndef RB_PTHREAD_SHIM_H
#define RB_PTHREAD_SHIM_H

#include <windows.h>
#include <process.h>
#include <errno.h>

/* (rand_r is provided via cache.h's MSVC shim; do not redefine here.) */

typedef CRITICAL_SECTION pthread_mutex_t;

static __inline int pthread_mutex_init(pthread_mutex_t *m, const void *attr)
{ (void)attr; InitializeCriticalSection(m); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_mutex_lock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
{ EnterCriticalSection(m); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_mutex_unlock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
{ LeaveCriticalSection(m); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_mutex_trylock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
{ return TryEnterCriticalSection(m) ? 0 : EBUSY; }
static __inline int pthread_mutex_destroy(pthread_mutex_t *m)
{ DeleteCriticalSection(m); return 0; }

typedef HANDLE pthread_t;

static __inline int pthread_create(pthread_t *t, const void *attr,
                                   void *(*fn)(void *), void *arg)
{
    uintptr_t h = _beginthreadex(NULL, 0,
        (unsigned (__stdcall *)(void *))fn, arg, 0, NULL);
    (void)attr;
    if (!h) return 1;
    *t = (HANDLE)h;
    return 0;
}
static __inline int pthread_join(pthread_t t, void **res)
{ (void)res; WaitForSingleObject(t, INFINITE); CloseHandle(t); return 0; }

/* Reader/writer lock shim: 测试用恒排他 CRITICAL_SECTION（保证正确性）。
 * 真共享读/排他写语义在内核 ERESOURCE 路径验证；用户态测试只验逻辑正确性。 */
typedef CRITICAL_SECTION pthread_rwlock_t;
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_init(pthread_rwlock_t *l, const void *attr)
{ (void)attr; InitializeCriticalSection(l); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_rdlock(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ EnterCriticalSection(l); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_wrlock(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ EnterCriticalSection(l); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_trywrlock(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ return TryEnterCriticalSection(l) ? 0 : EBUSY; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_unlock(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ LeaveCriticalSection(l); return 0; }
static __inline int pthread_rwlock_destroy(pthread_rwlock_t *l)
{ DeleteCriticalSection(l); return 0; }

#endif
````

##### `tests/core/test_a2flush.c`

````c
/*
 * test_a2flush.c -- [A2-FLUSH 2026-11-09] IRP_MJ_FLUSH_BUFFERS 成败判据回归
 *
 * 真机缺陷（125 号）：回写态并发写收到 err=1117 / ERROR_IO_DEVICE，驱动日志
 * `FLUSH IRP failed: dirty writeback incomplete`。根因 rbio.c 的旧判据用
 * 「force flush 返回瞬间的全局 dirty_bytes>0」判定刷脏失败，而并发写线程
 * 会在 force flush 的 64 轮扫描期间持续产生新脏 -> 必然误报。
 *
 * 修复：core 新增单调的「下层 cfg.writeback 返回非 0」序号
 * `rb_stream_flush_fail_seq()`；driver 判据改为
 *     ok = (f1 == f0) && (flushed > 0 || dirty_left == 0)
 * 即：本次 FLUSH 没有下层盘写失败，且确实刷出了字节（或本来就无脏）。
 *
 * 本测试是「修复后进一步压测」的用户态并发回归网，两条判据都带对照：
 *   A 无注入：8 写线程 + 2 force-flush 线程并发 -> 判据误报次数必须为 0，
 *             且 fail_seq 恒 0；最终净帧 dirty_bytes==0。
 *   B 阳性对照：注入下层写失败 -> fail_seq 必须增长、脏必须保留；
 *             关闭注入后再 flush 必须收敛（证明不是把失败吞掉）。
 *
 * 编译：cl /nologo /O2 /W4 /utf-8 /I. test_a2flush.c cache.c
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define DISKSZ   (8u * 1024u * 1024u)
#define BLK      (64u * 1024u)
#define NWRITER  8
#define NFLUSH   2
#define NROUND   64

static unsigned char  g_disk[DISKSZ];
static pthread_mutex_t g_disk_mx;  /* main() 里 pthread_mutex_init（shim 无静态初始化宏） */
static rb_engine      *g_eng;
static rb_stream      *g_st;
static atomic_int      g_fail_inject;  /* 1 = 下层 writeback 返回 -1 */
static atomic_int      g_stop;
static atomic_int      g_false_fail;   /* 并发期判据误报次数 */
static int             g_fail;

#define CHECK(c, ...) do { if(!(c)){ printf("  [FAIL] "); printf(__VA_ARGS__); \
                            printf("\n"); g_fail++; } } while(0)

static int wb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *b, size_t n)
{
    (void)u; (void)fid;
    if (off + n > DISKSZ) return -1;
    if (atomic_load(&g_fail_inject)) return -1;   /* 注入下层写失败 */
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
    memcpy(g_disk + off, b, n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n)
{
    (void)u; (void)fid;
    if (off + n > DISKSZ) return -1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
    memcpy(b, g_disk + off, n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
    return 0;
}

/* driver 侧 RbFlushIrpWorker 的判据，逐字等价（用于并发期取样） */
static int flush_judgement(rb_stream *s)
{
    int f0 = rb_stream_flush_fail_seq(s);
    (void)rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    int f1 = rb_stream_flush_fail_seq(s);
    /* 成败只由「本次是否发生下层盘写失败」决定；并发新脏 / flush 被别的
     * flusher 抢占而跳过，都不构成失败（driver 对后者只记 Warn 留痕）。 */
    return (f1 == f0);
}

static void *writer(void *arg)
{
    int id = (int)(intptr_t)arg;
    unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc(BLK);
    rb_direct_range direct[16];
    int i;
    if (!buf) return NULL;
    for (i = 0; i < NROUND; i++) {
        int dc = 0;
        rb_u64 off = (rb_u64)((id * NROUND + i) % 64) * BLK;
        memset(buf, (unsigned char)((id * 31 + i) & 0xFF), BLK);
        rb_write(g_st, off, buf, BLK, direct, &dc, 16);
        /* 全 64K 对齐写应全部吸收；若产生 direct 区间则镜像落盘 */
        if (dc > 0) {
            int k;
            for (k = 0; k < dc; k++) {
                pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
                /* direct 区间数据即 buf 的对应片段，简化为整段镜像 */
                memcpy(g_disk + off, buf, BLK);
                pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
            }
        }
    }
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
}

static void *flusher(void *arg)
{
    (void)arg;
    while (!atomic_load(&g_stop)) {
        if (!flush_judgement(g_st))
            atomic_fetch_add(&g_false_fail, 1);
    }
    return NULL;
}

int main(void)
{
    rb_config cfg;
    pthread_t wt[NWRITER], ft[NFLUSH];
    int i, f0, f1;
    rb_stats st;
    printf("== A2-FLUSH concurrent FLUSH judgement regression ==\n");
    pthread_mutex_init(&g_disk_mx, NULL);

    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes  = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback  = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback   = rb_fn;
    cfg.block_size = 4096;
    g_eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    g_st  = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 9001);
    if (!g_eng || !g_st) { printf("  [FAIL] engine/stream create\n"); return 1; }

    /* ---- A: 并发写 + 并发 force FLUSH，不得误报 ---- */
    atomic_store(&g_fail_inject, 0);
    atomic_store(&g_stop, 0);
    atomic_store(&g_false_fail, 0);
    for (i = 0; i < NFLUSH; i++) pthread_create(&ft[i], NULL, flusher, NULL);
    for (i = 0; i < NWRITER; i++)
        pthread_create(&wt[i], NULL, writer, (void *)(intptr_t)i);
    for (i = 0; i < NWRITER; i++) pthread_join(wt[i], NULL);
    atomic_store(&g_stop, 1);
    for (i = 0; i < NFLUSH; i++) pthread_join(ft[i], NULL);

    /* 写线程已停：净帧必须收敛，且判据仍成立 */
    CHECK(flush_judgement(g_st), "A: final clean frame judgement must PASS");
    rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "A: dirty_bytes==0 after writers stopped (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0, "A: lost_dirty_bytes==0 (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(atomic_load(&g_false_fail) == 0,
          "A: no false FLUSH failure under %d writers + %d flushers (got %d)",
          NWRITER, NFLUSH, (int)atomic_load(&g_false_fail));
    CHECK(rb_stream_flush_fail_seq(g_st) == 0,
          "A: flush_fail_seq must stay 0 without lower-layer failure (got %d)",
          rb_stream_flush_fail_seq(g_st));
    printf("  A: writers=%d flushers=%d rounds=%d false_fail=%d fail_seq=%d\n",
           NWRITER, NFLUSH, (int)NROUND, (int)atomic_load(&g_false_fail),
           rb_stream_flush_fail_seq(g_st));

    /* ---- B: 阳性对照，注入下层写失败必须被检出 ---- */
    {
        unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc(BLK);
        rb_direct_range direct[16];
        int dc = 0;
        memset(buf, 0x5A, BLK);
        rb_write(g_st, 0, buf, BLK, direct, &dc, 16);
        free(buf);
    }
    atomic_store(&g_fail_inject, 1);
    f0 = rb_stream_flush_fail_seq(g_st);
    (void)rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);
    f1 = rb_stream_flush_fail_seq(g_st);
    CHECK(f1 > f0, "B: lower-layer write failure MUST increase fail_seq (%d -> %d)",
          f0, f1);
    CHECK(!flush_judgement(g_st),
          "B: judgement MUST FAIL while failure injected (no false success)");
    CHECK(rb_stream_dirty_bytes(g_st) > 0,
          "B: dirty must be retained on lower-layer failure (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)rb_stream_dirty_bytes(g_st));
    printf("  B: injected failure detected f0=%d f1=%d dirty_left=%llu\n",
           f0, f1, (unsigned long long)rb_stream_dirty_bytes(g_st));

    /* ---- C: 撤掉注入后必须收敛（证明不是把失败吞了） ---- */
    atomic_store(&g_fail_inject, 0);
    (void)rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "C: dirty converged after failure removed (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0, "C: no lost dirty (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
    printf("  C: dirty_bytes=%llu lost_dirty=%llu\n",
           (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    rb_stream_destroy(g_st);
    rb_engine_destroy(g_eng);
    printf("RESULT: %s (fail=%d)\n", g_fail ? "FAIL" : "PASS", g_fail);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_auditfix.c`

````c
/*
 * test_auditfix.c —— 2026-10-15 全面代码审查报告核心修复的用户态验证
 *
 * 覆盖项（与 deliverables/code-review-full-2026-10-15.md 对应）：
 *   C7  ：invalidate_range_ex 分级失效语义
 *         - 全覆盖 + superseded=1（直写落盘）丢脏不计 lost
 *         - 全覆盖 + 回滚 + 写前已脏（pre_dirty=1）丢脏计 lost
 *         - 全覆盖 + 回滚 + 脏仅来自本次失败写（pre_dirty=0）丢脏不计 lost
 *         - 边缘混合子块：锁外 readback 恢复被覆盖段，未覆盖段早期数据保留
 *   M17 ：读回填受容量上限约束（超限不再建 chunk）
 *   W17 ：读命中刷新 last_access（真 LRU：热块不被空闲回收误杀）
 *   W19 ：rb_read/rb_write 空指针契约守卫（-2）
 *
 * 编译单元 = test_auditfix.c + cache.c（build_all.bat 常规行）。
 */

#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define DISK_SIZE (32u * 1024u * 1024u)
#define CHUNK     (64u * 1024u)          /* 默认几何 4096 x 16 */
#define SUB       4096u
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static int g_fail = 0;

#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); g_fail++; } \
    else { printf("  [ok]   " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); } \
} while (0)

static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(buf, g_disk + off, len);
    return 0;
}
static void fill_pattern(unsigned char *p, size_t n, rb_u64 base)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = (unsigned char)((base + i) * 31u + 7u);
}
static rb_stats eng_stats(rb_engine *eng)
{
    rb_stats st; memset(&st, 0, sizeof(st));
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    return st;
}
/* [FIX R2-W14] dseq 快照缓冲（掩码 API 的证据通道，用户态栈充裕） */
static uint32_t g_dseq[2048];
/* 恢复失败桩：readback 恒失败（模拟坏盘） */
static int fail_rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{ (void)ctx; (void)file_id; (void)off; (void)buf; (void)len; return -1; }
/* 恢复窗口重入桩：readback 期间并发调用 force flush（模拟 R2-M5 窗口竞态） */
static rb_stream *g_reent_s;
static size_t g_reent_flush_bytes = (size_t)-1;
static int reent_rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    if (g_reent_s) g_reent_flush_bytes = rb_stream_flush(g_reent_s, 1);
    return rb_fn(ctx, file_id, off, buf, len);
}

/* miss 直读 + commit + 交集拷贝（模拟驱动行为） */
static void k_miss(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 req_off, void *buf, size_t req_len,
                   rb_direct_range *miss, int mc)
{
    int k;
    rb_u64 req_end = req_off + req_len;
    for (k = 0; k < mc; k++) {
        unsigned char *tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(miss[k].len);
        rb_u64 ms_end = miss[k].offset + miss[k].len;
        memcpy(tmp, g_disk + miss[k].offset, miss[k].len);
        rb_read_commit(s, miss[k].offset, tmp, miss[k].len);
        {
            rb_u64 lo = (miss[k].offset > req_off) ? miss[k].offset : req_off;
            rb_u64 hi = (ms_end < req_end) ? ms_end : req_end;
            if (hi > lo)
                memcpy((unsigned char *)buf + (size_t)(lo - req_off),
                       tmp + (size_t)(lo - miss[k].offset), (size_t)(hi - lo));
        }
        free(tmp);
    }
}

/* 读入整 chunk（miss -> commit -> 入缓存），盘面预置 pattern(base) */
static void read_chunk(rb_engine *eng, rb_stream *s, rb_u64 chunk_idx, int hit_reads)
{
    static unsigned char buf[CHUNK];
    rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    rb_u64 off = chunk_idx * CHUNK;
    int i;
    fill_pattern(g_disk + off, CHUNK, off);
    rb_engine_tick(eng, 1000 + chunk_idx);
    rb_read(s, off, buf, CHUNK, miss, &mc, 16);
    k_miss(s, off, buf, CHUNK, miss, mc);
    for (i = 0; i < hit_reads; i++) {
        rb_engine_tick(eng, 100000 + chunk_idx * 16 + i);
        rb_read(s, off, buf, CHUNK, miss, &mc, 16);
    }
}

/* ============ 用例1：C7 分级失效语义（全覆盖三种情形 + 记账） ============ */
static void test_c7_accounting(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    unsigned char wr[SUB];
    uint8_t mask[256]; rb_u64 base; int bits;
    rb_stats st;

    printf("== 用例1: C7 分级失效语义 ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xA7u);

    /* --- 情形 a：回滚 + 写前未脏 -> 丢脏不计 lost --- */
    fill_pattern(g_disk + 0, SUB, 0x111);
    {   /* 先 commit 干净块（写前不脏） */
        static unsigned char buf[SUB];
        memcpy(buf, g_disk, SUB);
        rb_read_commit(s, 0, buf, SUB);
    }
    fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x222);
    /* [FIX R2-W14] 掩码+dseq 必须在写前快照（驱动契约：rbio.c 以 worker 持久
     * 缓冲同时捕获两者）。dseq 是"脏仅由本次写产生"的免账证据。 */
    bits = rb_stream_dirty_mask(s, 0, SUB, mask, 256 * 8, &base, g_dseq);
    CHECK(bits == 1, "a) 写前掩码：1 个子块");
    { rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0; rb_write(s, 0, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8); }   /* 吸收为脏（模拟随后失败） */
    rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, 0, SUB, 0, mask, bits, base, g_dseq);
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0, "a) 回滚+写前未脏+dseq证据 -> lost==0（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    /* --- 情形 b：回滚 + 写前已脏 -> 丢脏计 lost --- */
    fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x333);
    {   /* 先制造早期已 ack 脏块 */
        rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
        rb_write(s, SUB, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8);
    }
    /* [FIX R2-W14] 掩码时序对齐驱动契约：在早期写之后、失败写之前快照
     * （原快照落在失败写之后属"凑巧正确"——脏位相同但 dseq 证据语义不同） */
    bits = rb_stream_dirty_mask(s, SUB, 2 * SUB, mask, 256 * 8, &base, g_dseq);
    {   /* 再吸收一段失败写（整子块覆盖，覆盖同一子块） */
        rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
        fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x444);
        rb_write(s, SUB, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8);
    }
    CHECK(bits >= 1, "b) 写前掩码：>=1 个子块");
    rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, SUB, SUB, 0, mask, bits, base, g_dseq);
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == SUB, "b) 回滚+写前已脏 -> lost==SUB（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    /* --- 情形 c：superseded=1 全覆盖 -> 丢脏不计 lost --- */
    {
        rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
        fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x555);
        rb_write(s, 2 * SUB, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8);
    }
    rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, 2 * SUB, SUB, 1, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == SUB, "c) superseded 全覆盖 -> lost 不变（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    /* --- 情形 d：回滚 + 无掩码无 dseq（无证据）-> 保守计 lost ---
     * [FIX R2-W14] 与新实现语义对齐：无证据当有早期脏（丢脏必记账纪律） */
    {
        rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
        fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x666);
        rb_write(s, 3 * SUB, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8);
        rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, 3 * SUB, SUB, 0, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);
    }
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 2 * SUB, "d) 回滚无证据（保守）-> lost 再+SUB（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 用例2：C7 混合子块 readback 恢复 ============ */
static void test_c7_restore(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    unsigned char wr[SUB];
    static unsigned char buf[8192];
    rb_stats st;

    printf("== 用例2: C7 边缘混合子块 readback 恢复 ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xA8u);

    /* 盘面旧内容（readback 恢复源） */
    fill_pattern(g_disk + 0, 2 * SUB, 0x900);
    /* 早期 ack 写：整段 [0, 2*SUB) 吸收为脏（模拟已成功写） */
    {
        unsigned char big[2 * SUB];
        fill_pattern(big, 2 * SUB, 0x800);
        {
            rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
            rb_write(s, 0, big, 2 * SUB, d, &dc, 8);
        }
    }
    /* 失败写覆盖中间段 [SUB/2, SUB*3/2)（跨子块边界的部分覆盖），
     * 回滚：被覆盖段从盘恢复（旧内容 0x900），未覆盖段保留早期 ack 数据（0x800） */
    fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x700);
    {
        rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
        rb_write(s, SUB / 2, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8);   /* [2K, 6K) */
    }
    rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, SUB / 2, SUB, 0, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);

    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0, "混合子块恢复路径不计 lost（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    /* 读回验证：[0,2K)=0x800 早期数据，[2K,6K)=0x900 盘面恢复，[6K,8K)=0x800 */
    {
        rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
        static unsigned char expect[8192];
        int bad = 0; size_t i;
        rb_read(s, 0, buf, 8192, miss, &mc, 16);
        k_miss(s, 0, buf, 8192, miss, mc);
        fill_pattern(expect, SUB / 2, 0x800);
        fill_pattern(expect + SUB / 2, SUB, 0x900);
        fill_pattern(expect + SUB / 2 + SUB, SUB / 2, 0x800);
        for (i = 0; i < 8192; i++) if (buf[i] != expect[i]) bad++;
        CHECK(bad == 0, "恢复后读回逐字节一致（违例 %d 字节）", bad);
    }

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 用例2b：R2-M5 恢复窗口并发 flush 不落失败写 ============ */
static void test_c7_restore_race(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    unsigned char wr[SUB];
    static unsigned char buf[8192];
    rb_stats st;

    printf("== 用例2b: R2-M5 恢复窗口 flush 隔离 ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = reent_rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xA9u);
    g_reent_s = s; g_reent_flush_bytes = (size_t)-1;

    fill_pattern(g_disk + 0, 2 * SUB, 0x900);
    {
        unsigned char big[2 * SUB];
        fill_pattern(big, 2 * SUB, 0x800);
        { rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0; rb_write(s, 0, big, 2 * SUB, d, &dc, 8); }
    }
    fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x700);
    { rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0; rb_write(s, SUB / 2, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8); }
    rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, SUB / 2, SUB, 0, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);

    /* 重入 flush 发生在 readback（窗口内）：恢复中的子块必须被剔除。
     * 注意子 0 可能已在子 1 的 readback 前恢复完成（顺序逐项），
     * 此时 flush 写入子 0 是【正确行为】（内容=早期 ack+盘面恢复的组合）——
     * 故不断言 flush 字节数，只断言盘面绝无失败写模式（P2-2 契约） */
    {
        /* 盘面覆盖段仍是旧内容 0x900（未被窗口内 flush 污染） */
        static unsigned char expect[SUB];
        fill_pattern(expect, SUB, 0x900);
        CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + SUB / 2, expect, SUB / 2) == 0 &&
              memcmp(g_disk + SUB, expect + SUB / 2, SUB / 2) == 0,
              "盘面覆盖段未被窗口内 flush 写入");
    }
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0, "恢复成功路径不计 lost（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    /* 恢复完成后读回：与用例2 相同的逐字节期望 */
    {
        rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
        static unsigned char expect[8192];
        int bad = 0; size_t i;
        rb_read(s, 0, buf, 8192, miss, &mc, 16);
        k_miss(s, 0, buf, 8192, miss, mc);
        fill_pattern(expect, SUB / 2, 0x800);
        fill_pattern(expect + SUB / 2, SUB, 0x900);
        fill_pattern(expect + SUB / 2 + SUB, SUB / 2, 0x800);
        for (i = 0; i < 8192; i++) if (buf[i] != expect[i]) bad++;
        CHECK(bad == 0, "竞态后读回逐字节一致（违例 %d 字节）", bad);
    }

    g_reent_s = NULL;
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 用例2c：恢复失败如实记账（R2-W14 补充覆盖） ============ */
static void test_c7_restore_fail(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    unsigned char wr[SUB];
    rb_stats st;

    printf("== 用例2c: R2-M5 恢复失败记账 ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = fail_rb_fn;   /* 坏盘：readback 恒失败 */
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xAAu);

    fill_pattern(g_disk + 0, 2 * SUB, 0x900);
    {
        unsigned char big[2 * SUB];
        fill_pattern(big, 2 * SUB, 0x800);
        { rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0; rb_write(s, 0, big, 2 * SUB, d, &dc, 8); }
    }
    fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x700);
    { rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0; rb_write(s, SUB / 2, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8); }
    rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, SUB / 2, SUB, 0, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);

    /* 恢复失败（readback 错）：两个混合子块均按保守方向丢 + 计账 */
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 2 * SUB, "恢复失败 -> lost==2*SUB（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "失败子块脏位全部清除（dirty=%llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 用例3：M17 读回填容量上限 ============ */
static void test_m17_cap(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char buf[CHUNK];
    rb_stats st;

    printf("== 用例3: M17 读回填容量上限 ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    /* max=96KB -> hard=95%=91KB：第 1 个 chunk(64KB) 可建、第 2 个(64+64>91) 恒被拒 */
    cfg.max_bytes = 96ull * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0x17u);

    /* chunk0 入缓存（占满上限） */
    fill_pattern(g_disk, CHUNK, 0);
    { rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
      rb_read(s, 0, buf, CHUNK, miss, &mc, 16);
      k_miss(s, 0, buf, CHUNK, miss, mc); }
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 1, "chunk0 入缓存（count=%llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.chunk_count);

    /* chunk1 miss 回填：超上限不得建块（读不缓存不影响正确性） */
    fill_pattern(g_disk + CHUNK, CHUNK, 1);
    { rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
      rb_read(s, CHUNK, buf, CHUNK, miss, &mc, 16);
      k_miss(s, CHUNK, buf, CHUNK, miss, mc); }
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    /* [FIX #5.3] 精确边界：原 <=1 容忍"chunk0 也被误拒"的假绿（hard=91KB 时
     * chunk0=64KB 必然可建）。=1 同时证明"该建必建、该拒必拒"。 */
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 1, "M17 超限回填不建块且 chunk0 保留（count=%llu，应=1）",
          (unsigned long long)st.chunk_count);

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 用例4：W17 命中刷新 LRU ============ */
static void test_w17_lru(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char buf[CHUNK];
    rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc;

    printf("== 用例4: W17 命中刷新 last_access（热块留存） ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    /* 批式淘汰一批最多 64 块（RB_EVICT_BATCH）：须用 >64 块才能留幸存者。
     * max=5,760,000 -> hi=4,608,000（70 块=4,587,520 不触发）、hard=5,472,000
     * （71 块=4,653,056 可建且 > hi 触发回收）、lo=3,456,000（逐 64 块后单轮即止）。 */
    cfg.max_bytes = 5760000;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0x17u);

    /* 填 70 个 chunk（A=chunk0 最早，其余 1..69 依次变新） */
    {
        int k;
        for (k = 0; k < 70; k++) read_chunk(eng, s, k, 0);
    }
    {
        rb_stats st1 = eng_stats(eng);
        printf("  [diag] after 70 fills: total=%llu count=%llu\n",
               (unsigned long long)st1.cur_bytes, (unsigned long long)st1.chunk_count);
    }

    /* 命中读 A（更晚 tick）——W17 修复后 A 的 last_access 新于全部填充块 */
    {
        rb_engine *e = eng;
        int rc;
        rb_engine_tick(e, 999999);
        rc = rb_read(s, 0, buf, CHUNK, miss, &mc, 16);
        CHECK(rc == 1, "前置：A 命中读本身命中（rc=%d mc=%d）", rc, mc);
    }

    /* 第 71 块触发回收：单轮批淘汰 64 个最旧。W17 生效 -> 逐 {1..64}，
     * 幸存 {0, 65..70}；W17 失效 -> A(1000) 最旧被逐，幸存 {64..70} */
    read_chunk(eng, s, 70, 0);

    {
        rb_direct_range m2[16]; int m2c = 0;
        int hitA, hitB;
        hitA = rb_read(s, 0, buf, CHUNK, m2, &m2c, 16);
        hitB = rb_read(s, 1 * CHUNK, buf, CHUNK, m2, &m2c, 16);
        CHECK(hitA == 1, "W17 热块 A 命中留存（hit=%d）", hitA);
        CHECK(hitB == 0, "W17 冷块 B 被回收（hit=%d）", hitB);
    }

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 用例5：W19 空指针契约守卫 ============ */
static void test_w19_guards(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char buf[SUB];
    rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;

    printf("== 用例5: W19 契约守卫 ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 1024 * 1024;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0x19u);

    CHECK(rb_read(s, 0, buf, SUB, NULL, NULL, 16) == -2, "rb_read NULL miss -> -2");
    {
        int cnt = 0;
        CHECK(rb_read(s, 0, buf, SUB, NULL, &cnt, 16) == -2, "rb_read NULL miss(2) -> -2");
    }
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, buf, SUB, NULL, NULL, 8) == -2, "rb_write NULL direct -> -2");
    {
        rb_direct_range dd[8]; int dcn = 0;
        (void)dd;
        CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, buf, SUB, dd, NULL, 8) == -2, "rb_write NULL count -> -2");
    }
    (void)d; (void)dc;

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 用例2d：R6C-01 恢复失败销毁后 LRU 链表完整性 ============ */
/* 缺陷形态：恢复失败分支清脏位后直接 chunk_destroy——chunk 实际仍在脏链表上，
 * unlink 按 c->dirty==0 走 lru_remove，把脏链表节点的陈旧 lru 链写进 LRU
 * 头/尾 → 该分片全部干净块对 evict_select 不可见（淘汰饥饿）。
 * 2c 因单 chunk 恰好掩盖；本用例用多 chunk + 事后淘汰验证链表仍可用。 */
static void test_c7_restore_fail_lru(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char big[CHUNK * 4];
    rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
    rb_stats st; rb_u64 before;

    printf("== 用例2d: R6C-01 恢复失败销毁后 LRU 完整性 ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = fail_rb_fn;   /* 坏盘：readback 恒失败 */
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xAAu);

    /* 铺 3 个干净 chunk（同 chain 分片，互为 LRU 邻居） */
    fill_pattern(big, sizeof(big), 0x100);
    { int i; for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) rb_write(s, (rb_u64)i * CHUNK, big, CHUNK, d, &dc, 8); }
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);                       /* 全部回写干净 → 进 LRU */
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 3, "3 个干净 chunk 在册（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.chunk_count);

    /* 触发恢复失败销毁：对 chunk#1 的中部做混合子块失效（readback 恒失败） */
    { unsigned char wr[SUB]; fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x200);
      rb_write(s, CHUNK + SUB / 2, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8); }
    rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, CHUNK + SUB / 2, SUB, 0, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes >= SUB, "恢复失败已记账（lost=%llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    /* 关键断言：销毁发生后同分片干净块仍可被淘汰（LRU 头/尾未被污染）。
     * evict_select 走 lru_tail→lru_prev 链；若修复前把脏链表节点的陈旧 lru
     * 链写进 LRU 头/尾，该分片干净块对淘汰不可见 → 插入无法回收 → cur_bytes
     * 无界增长超过预算。构造超预算写入（70×64KB > 4MB 预算）逼出淘汰。 */
    { int i;
      for (i = 3; i < 70; i++) rb_write(s, (rb_u64)i * CHUNK, big, CHUNK, d, &dc, 8); }
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes <= cfg.max_bytes,
          "淘汰仍工作：cur=%llu <= 预算=%llu（LRU 链表完好，超预算写入被回收）",
          (unsigned long long)st.cur_bytes, (unsigned long long)cfg.max_bytes);

    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

int main(void)
{
    g_disk = (unsigned char *)malloc(DISK_SIZE);
    memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);

    test_c7_accounting();
    test_c7_restore();
    test_c7_restore_race();
    test_c7_restore_fail();
    test_c7_restore_fail_lru();
    test_m17_cap();
    test_w17_lru();
    test_w19_guards();

    printf("\n%s: %d failure(s)\n", g_fail ? "FAIL" : "PASS", g_fail);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_bigread.c`

````c
/*
 * P1-1 验证：>128K 大块读（1MB）warm→cached。
 * 首遍下盘预热（readback 填模拟盘），二遍命中内存且字节一致。
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

static int wb_no(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *d, size_t n){(void)u;(void)fid;(void)off;(void)d;(void)n;return 0;}
/* 模拟盘：readback 把盘上数据填入 buf */
static unsigned char g_disk[1024*1024];
static int rb_disk(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    if(off+n > sizeof(g_disk)) return -1;
    memcpy(b, g_disk+off, n);
    return 0;
}

int main(void){
    rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
    c.max_bytes = 256ull*1024*1024;
    c.writeback = wb_no; c.readback = rb_disk; c.block_size = 4096;
    rb_engine *e = rb_engine_create(&c);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 1);

    const size_t SZ = 1024*1024;   /* 1MB > 128K */
    unsigned char *wr = malloc(SZ), *rd = malloc(SZ);
    for(size_t i=0;i<SZ;i++){ wr[i]=(unsigned char)((i*13+7)&0xFF); g_disk[i]=wr[i]; }

    rb_direct_range miss[64]; int mc=0;
    /* 第一遍：全 miss，手动用 readback 回调从模拟盘读入（内核由 FltReadFile 完成） */
    mc=0;
    int r = rb_read(s, 0, rd, SZ, miss, &mc, 64);
    if(r<0){ printf("FAIL: first big read r=%d\n",r); return 1; }
    for(int k=0;k<mc;k++){
        if(rb_disk(NULL, 1, miss[k].offset, rd+miss[k].offset, miss[k].len)!=0){
            printf("FAIL: readback range %d\n",k); return 1;
        }
    }
    if(mc==0){ printf("FAIL: first read should miss\n"); return 1; }
    /* 预热 commit（模拟 PostRead） */
    rb_read_commit(s, 0, rd, SZ);

    /* 校验第一遍读回字节 */
    if(memcmp(rd, wr, SZ)!=0){ printf("FAIL: first readback bytes mismatch\n"); return 1; }

    /* 第二遍：命中内存，盘上数据改为垃圾（验证不读盘） */
    memset(g_disk, 0xEE, SZ);
    mc=0; memset(rd, 0, SZ);
    r = rb_read(s, 0, rd, SZ, miss, &mc, 64);
    if(r<0){ printf("FAIL: second big read r=%d\n",r); return 1; }
    if(mc!=0){ printf("FAIL: second read should hit (mc=%d)\n",mc); return 1; }
    if(memcmp(rd, wr, SZ)!=0){ printf("FAIL: cached big read bytes mismatch\n"); return 1; }
    printf("ok: 1MB big read warm->cached, second pass in-memory, bytes match\n");

    free(wr); free(rd);
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    printf("test_bigread: PASS\n");
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_cache.c`

````c
/*
 * RAMBoostFS 缓存核心单元测试（Linux/gcc 可编译运行）
 *
 * 用一块内存模拟"磁盘"：
 *  - 读：rb_read 命中段直接返回；miss 区间从模拟磁盘读 + rb_read_commit 并入缓存
 *  - 写：rb_write 缓存部分 + direct 区间直写模拟磁盘
 *  - 回写：writeback 回调把脏数据写到模拟磁盘
 * 最终校验：模拟磁盘 == 预期数据（特别是"未加载子块绝不被回写破坏"、
 *          "部分命中读绝不返回磁盘旧数据覆盖缓存新数据"）。
 */

#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>

#define DISK_SIZE (64u * 1024u * 1024u)
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static int g_fail = 0;

static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
    return 0;
}

/* 磁盘读回调（RMW 补读） */
static int rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(buf, g_disk + off, len);
    return 0;
}

/* 可控制失败注入的写回调 */
static int g_wb_fail = 0;
static int wb_fn_ctrl(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (g_wb_fail) return -1;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
    return 0;
}

/* 可控制失败注入的读回调 */
static int g_rb_fail = 0;
static int rb_fn_ctrl(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (g_rb_fail) return -1;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(buf, g_disk + off, len);
    return 0;
}

#define CHECK(cond, msg) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] %s\n", msg); g_fail++; } \
    else { printf("  [ok]   %s\n", msg); } \
} while (0)

static void fill_pattern(unsigned char *p, size_t n, rb_u64 base)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = (unsigned char)((base + i) * 31u + 7u);
}

/* 辅助：执行 miss 直读（模拟驱动：读入临时 buffer -> commit -> 交集拷给用户） */
static void do_miss_read(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 req_off, void *buf, size_t req_len,
                         rb_direct_range *miss, int mc)
{
    int k;
    rb_u64 req_end = req_off + req_len;
    for (k = 0; k < mc; k++) {
        unsigned char *tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(miss[k].len);
        rb_u64 ms_end = miss[k].offset + miss[k].len;
        memcpy(tmp, g_disk + miss[k].offset, miss[k].len);
        rb_read_commit(s, miss[k].offset, tmp, miss[k].len);
        rb_u64 lo = (miss[k].offset > req_off) ? miss[k].offset : req_off;
        rb_u64 hi = (ms_end < req_end) ? ms_end : req_end;
        if (hi > lo)
            memcpy((unsigned char *)buf + (lo - req_off), tmp + (lo - miss[k].offset), (size_t)(hi - lo));
        free(tmp);
    }
}

/* ---------- 用例 ---------- */

static void test_read_hit(void)
{
    printf("== 用例1: 读未命中->commit->命中，数据一致 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 1);
    char diskbuf[4096], buf1[4096], buf2[4096];
    rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    fill_pattern((unsigned char *)diskbuf, sizeof(diskbuf), 0);
    memcpy(g_disk + 1000, diskbuf, sizeof(diskbuf));

    /* 第一次读：未命中（miss 覆盖请求触及的所有子块，整子块对齐） */
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 1000, buf1, sizeof(buf1), miss, &mc, 16) == 0, "首次读取未命中");
    CHECK(mc == 1 && miss[0].offset == 0 && miss[0].len == 8192, "miss 为对齐的整子块");
    do_miss_read(s, 1000, buf1, sizeof(buf1), miss, mc);
    /* 第二次读：命中且数据一致 */
    mc = 0;
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 1000, buf2, sizeof(buf2), miss, &mc, 16) == 1, "二次读取命中缓存");
    CHECK(mc == 0, "无 miss 区间");
    CHECK(memcmp(buf1, buf2, sizeof(buf1)) == 0, "命中数据与磁盘数据一致");

    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.read_req == 2 && st.read_hit == 1, "统计：2次读 1次命中");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_read_partial_hit(void)
{
    printf("== 用例2: 部分命中——脏数据不被磁盘旧数据覆盖 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 2);

    /* 写 [0,4096) 入缓存（dirty，未落盘） */
    char w[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), 0x3333);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "整块写全部入缓存");

    /* 读 [0, 8192)：子块0 命中（缓存新数据），子块1 未命中（磁盘） */
    char out[8192]; rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(out));
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 0, out, sizeof(out), miss, &mc, 16) == 1, "部分命中返回 1（有命中）");
    CHECK(mc == 1 && miss[0].offset == 4096 && miss[0].len == 4096, "miss 区间 = 未加载子块1");
    do_miss_read(s, 0, out, sizeof(out), miss, mc);
    CHECK(memcmp(out, w, sizeof(w)) == 0, "读结果前4KB=缓存新数据（未用磁盘旧数据）");
    CHECK(memcmp(out + 4096, g_disk + 4096, 4096) == 0, "读结果后4KB=磁盘数据");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_write_back_flush(void)
{
    printf("== 用例3: 写缓存->回写，磁盘数据正确 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 3);
    char data[128 * 1024];
    fill_pattern((unsigned char *)data, sizeof(data), 0x100000);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, data, sizeof(data), direct, &dc, 16) == 0, "整块顺序写全部入缓存");
    CHECK(dc == 0, "无直写区间（全部缓存）");
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, data, sizeof(data)) != 0, "回写前磁盘数据未变（延迟写生效）");
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, data, sizeof(data)) == 0, "回写后磁盘数据与写入一致");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_partial_write_direct(void)
{
    printf("== 用例4: 部分覆盖子块走直写，数据正确 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 4);

    /* 磁盘已有旧数据 */
    fill_pattern(g_disk, 16 * 1024, 0x5000);
    /* 先整体读入缓存（加载子块0..3） */
    char old[16 * 1024]; memcpy(old, g_disk, sizeof(old));
    rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    rb_read(s, 0, old, sizeof(old), miss, &mc, 16);
    do_miss_read(s, 0, old, sizeof(old), miss, mc);

    /* 部分覆盖第 1 个 4KB 子块的前 2KB（缓存中有旧数据 -> 读改写入缓存） */
    char p1[2048]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)p1, sizeof(p1), 0x6000);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, p1, sizeof(p1), direct, &dc, 16) == 0, "部分写成功");
    CHECK(dc == 0, "缓存有旧数据 -> 读改写，无直写区间");
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    /* 期望磁盘：前2KB=p1，2KB..4KB=旧数据 */
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, p1, sizeof(p1)) == 0, "磁盘前2KB为新数据");
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + sizeof(p1), old + sizeof(p1), 4096 - sizeof(p1)) == 0,
          "磁盘2KB..4KB保留旧数据");

    /* 再写一个缓存中无旧数据的子块的部分覆盖 -> 必须直写 */
    rb_direct_range d2[16]; int dc2 = 0;
    char p2[2048]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)p2, sizeof(p2), 0x7000);
    rb_write(s, 20 * 1024, p2, sizeof(p2), d2, &dc2, 16);
    CHECK(dc2 == 1 && d2[0].offset == 20 * 1024 && d2[0].len == 2048,
          "无旧数据的部分覆盖 -> 1个直写区间");
    /* 模拟驱动执行直写 */
    memcpy(g_disk + 20 * 1024, p2, sizeof(p2));
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 20 * 1024, p2, sizeof(p2)) == 0, "直写后磁盘数据正确");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_dirty_protected_from_commit(void)
{
    printf("== 用例5: 已脏子块不被 PostRead 覆盖 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 5);

    char w[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), 0x8000);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
    char stale[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)stale, sizeof(stale), 0x9999);
    rb_read_commit(s, 0, stale, sizeof(stale));
    char out[4096]; rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 0, out, sizeof(out), miss, &mc, 16) == 1, "读命中");
    CHECK(memcmp(out, w, sizeof(w)) == 0, "返回脏数据而非旧数据");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_lru_evict(void)
{
    printf("== 用例6: 小缓存 LRU 淘汰，淘汰只发生在干净块 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 3ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 6);

    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < 4 * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096) {
        char b[4096]; rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
        fill_pattern((unsigned char *)b, sizeof(b), i);
        memcpy(g_disk + i, b, sizeof(b));
        rb_read(s, i, b, sizeof(b), miss, &mc, 16);
        do_miss_read(s, i, b, sizeof(b), miss, mc);
    }
    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes <= 3ull * 1024 * 1024, "缓存字节未超上限");
    CHECK(st.evict_bytes > 0, "发生了淘汰");

    char w[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), 0xABCD);
    for (i = 0; i < 8 * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096) {
        rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
        rb_write(s, i, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
    }
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes > 0, "存在脏数据");
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "强制回写后脏数据清零");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_cross_chunk(void)
{
    printf("== 用例7: 跨 64KB 块边界的读写 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 16ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 7);

    /* 从 65520 写 4KB（跨块：65520..65536 属块0，65536..69616 属块1） */
    char data[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)data, sizeof(data), 0x7777);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 65520, data, sizeof(data), direct, &dc, 16) == 0, "跨块写入成功");
    /* 边界子块未加载 -> 直写；驱动执行直写 */
    int k;
    for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
        memcpy(g_disk + direct[k].offset, data + (direct[k].offset - 65520), direct[k].len);
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 65520, data, sizeof(data)) == 0, "跨块回写+直写磁盘数据正确");

    /* 跨块读命中：块0 子块15 与块1 子块0 都须整子块加载 */
    char s15[4096], s0[4096];
    memcpy(s15, g_disk + 61440, 4080);          /* 61440..65520 磁盘值 */
    memcpy(s15 + 4080, data, 16);               /* 65520..65536 */
    memcpy(s0, data + 16, 4080);                /* 65536..69616 */
    memcpy(s0 + 4080, g_disk + 69616, 16);      /* 69616..69632 */
    rb_read_commit(s, 61440, s15, 4096);
    rb_read_commit(s, 65536, s0, 4096);
    char out[4096]; memset(out, 0, sizeof(out));
    rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 65520, out, sizeof(out), miss, &mc, 16) == 1, "跨块读命中");
    CHECK(mc == 0, "跨块读无 miss");
    CHECK(memcmp(out, data, sizeof(data)) == 0, "跨块读数据一致");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_random_consistency(void)
{
    printf("== 用例8: 随机读写 32MB 一致性（影子权威状态验证） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 6ull * 1024 * 1024; /* 小缓存，强制频繁淘汰 */
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 8);

    /* 影子 = 权威最新状态：每次写操作后立即更新（缓存与直写的合并视图） */
    unsigned char *shadow = (unsigned char *)malloc(32u * 1024 * 1024);
    fill_pattern(shadow, 32u * 1024 * 1024, 0x1234);
    fill_pattern(g_disk, DISK_SIZE, 0x1234);

    unsigned int seed = 20261010;
    size_t op;
    for (op = 0; op < 4000; op++) {
        rb_u64 off = (rb_u64)(rand_r(&seed) % (32u * 1024 * 1024));
        size_t len = (size_t)(rand_r(&seed) % 8192) + 1;
        if (off + len > 32u * 1024 * 1024) len = 32u * 1024 * 1024 - off;
        if (len == 0) continue;
        if (rand_r(&seed) & 1) {
            /* 写：影子更新为写入数据 */
            char *data = (char *)malloc(len);
            fill_pattern((unsigned char *)data, len, off);
            rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
            rb_write(s, off, data, len, direct, &dc, 16);
            if (dc > 16) {
                memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
            } else {
                int k;
                for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
                    memcpy(g_disk + direct[k].offset, (char *)data + (direct[k].offset - off), direct[k].len);
            }
            memcpy(shadow + off, data, len);
            free(data);
        } else {
            /* 读：结果必须等于影子（缓存新数据不得被磁盘旧数据覆盖） */
            char *out = (char *)malloc(len);
            rb_direct_range miss[32]; int mc = 0;
            int r = rb_read(s, off, out, len, miss, &mc, 32);
            if (r == -2) {
                memcpy(out, g_disk + off, len);
            } else {
                do_miss_read(s, off, out, len, miss, mc);
            }
            CHECK(memcmp(out, shadow + off, len) == 0, "随机读数据与权威影子一致");
            free(out);
        }
        if (op % 500 == 0)
            rb_engine_flush(eng, 0);
    }
    rb_engine_flush(eng, 1);
    /* 关键验证：全量回写后，磁盘必须等于影子（回写正确性）。
     * [FIX #5.1] 原只随机抽 256x4KB（约 3% 覆盖）——小范围持久错值有约 97%
     * 概率逃逸（如在途回写旧数据覆写）。改为 32MB 全量比对（ms 级），定位
     * 循环保留作诊断输出。 */
    if (memcmp(g_disk, shadow, 32u * 1024 * 1024) != 0) {
        size_t chk;
        for (chk = 0; chk < 256; chk++) {
            rb_u64 off = (rb_u64)(rand_r(&seed) % (32u * 1024 * 1024));
            if (memcmp(g_disk + off, shadow + off, 4096) != 0)
                CHECK(0, "全量回写后磁盘与影子一致（首处差异 @%llu）",
                      (unsigned long long)off);
        }
        CHECK(0, "全量回写后磁盘与影子一致（全量比对失败）");
    } else {
        CHECK(1, "全量回写后磁盘与影子一致（32MB 全量比对）");
    }
    free(shadow);
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_watermark_flush(void)
{
    printf("== 用例9: 脏数据水位触发（need_flush 标志） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.high_water = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.low_water = 1ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 9);

    char w[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), 0x4444);
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < 2 * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096) {
        rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
        rb_write(s, i, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
    }
    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 2ull * 1024 * 1024, "脏数据 2MB");
    CHECK(rb_engine_has_dirty(eng), "存在脏数据");
    size_t n = rb_stream_flush(s, 0);
    CHECK(n >= 1024 * 1024, "非强制回写至少回写 1MB");
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes <= 1024 * 1024, "回写后脏数据降至低位以下");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_rmw_all_memory_write(void)
{
    printf("== 用例10: 读-改-写——无旧数据的部分覆盖也全部进内存 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 10);

    /* 磁盘已有旧数据 */
    fill_pattern(g_disk, 64 * 1024, 0xAA00);
    /* 部分覆盖 20KB 处前 2KB（该子块从未加载 -> 触发 RMW 补读） */
    char p[2048]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)p, sizeof(p), 0xBB00);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 20 * 1024, p, sizeof(p), direct, &dc, 16) == 0, "部分覆盖写入成功");
    CHECK(dc == 0, "全部进内存（RMW 补齐，无直写区间）");
    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.rmw_reads == 1, "发生 1 次磁盘补读（RMW）");

    /* 读回：前2KB=新数据，后2KB=磁盘旧数据补齐 */
    char out[4096]; rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(out));
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 20 * 1024, out, sizeof(out), miss, &mc, 16) == 1, "读命中");
    CHECK(mc == 0, "无 miss");
    CHECK(memcmp(out, p, sizeof(p)) == 0, "前2KB=新数据");
    CHECK(memcmp(out + sizeof(p), g_disk + 20 * 1024 + sizeof(p),
                sizeof(out) - sizeof(p)) == 0, "后2KB=磁盘旧数据补齐");

    /* 回写后磁盘：前2KB=新数据，缺口=旧数据 */
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 20 * 1024, p, sizeof(p)) == 0, "回写后磁盘前2KB=新数据");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_trim_80(void)
{
    printf("== 用例11: 余量检测 80%% 分级整理（丢临时缓存 + 回写脏数据） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 2ull * 1024 * 1024;                 /* 2MB 小缓存 */
    cfg.evict_high = 2ull * 1024 * 1024 * 80 / 100;    /* 1.6MB 触发整理 */
    cfg.evict_low = 2ull * 1024 * 1024 * 60 / 100;     /* 1.2MB 整理目标 */
    cfg.hard_limit = 2ull * 1024 * 1024 * 95 / 100;    /* 1.9MB 硬上限 */
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 11);
    size_t i;
    char b[4096];

    /* 阶段A：连续读入 5MB 干净数据（2MB 缓存必然触发整理，干净块被淘汰释放） */
    for (i = 0; i < 5 * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096) {
        rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
        fill_pattern((unsigned char *)b, sizeof(b), i);
        memcpy(g_disk + i, b, sizeof(b));
        rb_read(s, i, b, sizeof(b), miss, &mc, 16);
        do_miss_read(s, i, b, sizeof(b), miss, mc);
    }
    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.evict_bytes > 0, "读入超 80%% 触发整理（干净块被淘汰释放）");
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes <= cfg.evict_high, "占用回落到整理水位（1.6MB）以下");
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "阶段A 无脏数据");

    /* 阶段B：大量写入 4MB -> 脏数据堆积，80% 整理 + 硬上限保护 */
    rb_u64 evict_before = st.evict_bytes;
    for (i = 0; i < 4 * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096) {
        char w[4096]; rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
        fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), i + 0x77);
        rb_write(s, i, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
        /* 模拟驱动执行直写区间（硬上限兜底时出现） */
        if (dc > 16) {
            memcpy(g_disk + i, w, sizeof(w));
        } else {
            int k;
            for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
                memcpy(g_disk + direct[k].offset, w + (direct[k].offset - i), direct[k].len);
        }
    }
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes <= cfg.hard_limit, "占用被控制在硬上限（1.9MB）内");
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes < 2ull * 1024 * 1024, "脏数据被整理回写（不无限堆积）");
    CHECK(st.evict_bytes > evict_before, "整理过程发生了淘汰（临时缓存丢弃）");

    /* 数据正确性：全量回写后，磁盘必须等于全部写入内容 */
    rb_engine_flush(eng, 1);
    for (i = 0; i < 4 * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096) {
        char w[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), i + 0x77);
        if (memcmp(g_disk + i, w, sizeof(w)) != 0) {
            printf("  [FAIL] 回写后磁盘与写入不一致 @%zu\n", i);
            g_fail++;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (i >= 4 * 1024 * 1024)
        printf("  [ok]   回写后磁盘与全部写入一致\n");
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_hard_limit_direct(void)
{
    printf("== 用例12: 硬上限保护——回写失败时占用超 95%% 新写入直接落盘 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 1ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn_ctrl;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 12);

    /* 模拟磁盘回写失败：trim 无法通过回写降低占用，缓存只能靠硬上限兜底 */
    g_wb_fail = 1;

    /* 写 0.98MB 数据：占用持续增长，80% 整理因回写失败失效 -> 突破到硬上限 */
    char w[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), 0xEE);
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < 1003520; i += 4096) {
        rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
        rb_write(s, i, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
        /* 模拟驱动执行直写区间（硬上限触发时） */
        if (dc > 16) {
            memcpy(g_disk + i, w, sizeof(w));
        } else {
            int k;
            for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
                memcpy(g_disk + direct[k].offset, w + (direct[k].offset - i), direct[k].len);
        }
    }
    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes >= cfg.hard_limit, "回写失败时占用可达到硬上限附近（95%%）");
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes > 0, "存在无法回写的脏数据（磁盘故障，缓存兜底保留）");

    /* 新写入：直接返回直写区间（不缓存，防缓存膨胀把内存写爆） */
    char p[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)p, sizeof(p), 0x55);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 2 * 1024 * 1024, p, sizeof(p), direct, &dc, 16);
    CHECK(dc >= 1, "超硬上限 -> 直写区间返回（不缓存，防膨胀崩溃）");
    /* 模拟驱动直写 */
    if (dc > 16) {
        memcpy(g_disk + 2 * 1024 * 1024, p, sizeof(p));
    } else {
        int k;
        for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
            memcpy(g_disk + direct[k].offset, p + (direct[k].offset - 2 * 1024 * 1024), direct[k].len);
    }
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 2 * 1024 * 1024, p, sizeof(p)) == 0, "直写后磁盘数据正确");
    g_wb_fail = 0;
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_readback_fail_fallback(void)
{
    printf("== 用例13: 磁盘补读失败 -> 直写兜底（数据正确性优先） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn_ctrl;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 13);

    g_rb_fail = 1;
    char p[2048]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)p, sizeof(p), 0xCD);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 100 * 1024, p, sizeof(p), direct, &dc, 16);
    CHECK(dc == 1 && direct[0].offset == 100 * 1024 && direct[0].len == 2048,
          "补读失败 -> 1个直写区间兜底");
    memcpy(g_disk + 100 * 1024, p, sizeof(p));
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 100 * 1024, p, sizeof(p)) == 0, "直写后磁盘数据正确");
    g_rb_fail = 0;
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}


static void test_idle_reclaim(void)
{
    printf("== 用例14: 空闲自动释放（超时干净块丢弃、脏块回写释放） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn; cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    cfg.user_ctx = NULL;
    cfg.idle_reclaim_ms = 60000; /* 60 秒未访问即释放 */
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 14);

    /* 读入 4 个干净块（commit） */
    char buf[256 * 1024];
    rb_read_commit(s, 0, buf, sizeof(buf));
    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes >= 256 * 1024, "读入 4 个块");

    /* 推进 30 秒（未超时）：不释放 */
    rb_engine_tick(eng, 30000);
    CHECK(rb_stream_idle_reclaim(s) == 0, "未超空闲阈值不释放");

    /* 推进到 61 秒：干净块全部释放 */
    rb_engine_tick(eng, 61000);
    rb_u64 freed = rb_stream_idle_reclaim(s);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(freed >= 256 * 1024, "超时干净块全部释放");
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes == 0, "释放后缓存归零");

    /* 脏块：写入后长时间空闲 -> 回写并释放 */
    char w[128 * 1024]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), 0x7A);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 512 * 1024, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
    rb_engine_tick(eng, 200000);
    rb_u64 f2 = rb_stream_idle_reclaim(s);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "空闲脏块已回写");
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes == 0, "回写后块被释放");
    CHECK(f2 >= 128 * 1024, "脏块空闲释放计数正确");
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 512 * 1024, w, sizeof(w)) == 0, "空闲回写磁盘数据正确");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* [FIX #1b] 确定性"牙齿"用例：hard 填满 + hit-miss-hit-miss 布局 + 计时门控
 * 桩，杀死 WS-RACE-2 变异体（wb_drain 空转 = 旧 stage 数据可在新镜像之后落盘）。
 *
 * 布局（max=4 chunk；hard=95%→3 块可驻留；evict_high 置大=写路径不回收）：
 *   chunk0 = A0（旧脏数据，在途回调中——污染目标）；
 *   chunk2 = G（脏，大写时命中——把两个 miss 隔开，防 direct_append 相邻合并）；
 *   chunk5 = E（脏，第 3 块驻留，填满 hard 上限）；
 *   大写 R=[0,256KB)=chunk0..3：hit(A0) / miss(chunk1) / hit(G) / miss(chunk3)
 *   → 两个不相邻 miss → max_direct=1 溢出 → -2。
 * 时序（为什么不能用事件握手）：被测机制正是 rb_write_ex 出口 drain
 * （cache.c"if(dcount>0) wb_drain(s)"）——握手式桩会让修复版死等在途 60s
 * 上界；计时门控（Sleep 50ms）是唯一与修复语义兼容的确定性构造：
 *   1) wb_fn_slow 回调置 g_staged=1 后 Sleep(50ms) 才落盘（在途窗口 50ms）；
 *   2) 写 chunk0=A0、chunk2=G、chunk5=E（吸收为脏；3/3 驻留）；
 *   3) 起 flusher 线程，自旋等 g_staged（A0 已 stage、回调在睡）；
 *   4) 大写 B：chunk0/chunk2 命中吸收；chunk1 miss(dc=1)、chunk3 miss
 *      → dc=2>max_direct → -2 →【出口 drain 等 A0 落盘】；
 *   5) 驱动 P2-1 纪律：整段镜像 B + 整段失效；
 *   6) 停 flusher、join、force flush，断言 R 的 4 chunk 盘面全为 B。
 * 修复版：drain 使 A0 先落（旧数据同区间，无害），B 镜像在后 → 盘面=B（PASS）。
 * 变异体：drain 空转 → -2 即返（t≈1ms）→ B 先镜像 → 失效清脏后 A0 于
 *   t≈50ms 盖回 → 盘面 chunk0=A0（FAIL=杀死）。50ms vs ~1ms，margin 充分。 */
static volatile LONG g_staged = 0;
static int wb_fn_slow(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    InterlockedExchange(&g_staged, 1);       /* 已进入回调（数据在途） */
    Sleep(50);                               /* 在途窗口：旧数据的落盘时刻 */
    memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
    return 0;
}
static volatile LONG g_flush_stop = 0;
static DWORD WINAPI flush_loop(LPVOID p)
{
    rb_stream *s = (rb_stream *)p;
    while (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_flush_stop, 0, 0))
        rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    return 0;
}
static void test_wsrace2_tooth(void)
{
    enum { CH = 64 * 1024, R4 = 4 * CH };
    static unsigned char A0[CH], G2[CH], E5[CH], B[R4];
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    HANDLE th; unsigned i;

    printf("== 用例11: WS-RACE-2 牙齿（hit-miss-hit-miss；修复=PASS 变异=FAIL） ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes   = 4ull * CH;             /* hard=95% → 3 块可驻留 */
    cfg.evict_high  = 16ull * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;  /* 写路径不触发回收（本用例要纯 miss） */
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn_slow;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 1);
    CHECK(eng && s, "用例11：引擎/流创建");
    if (!eng || !s) { if (eng) rb_engine_destroy(eng); return; }

    for (i = 0; i < CH; i++)
    { A0[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 3 + 1); G2[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 17 + 2); E5[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 11 + 5); }
    for (i = 0; i < R4; i++) B[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 5 + 9);

    /* 2) chunk0=A0、chunk2=G、chunk5=E 吸收为脏（3/3 驻留，脏块不可淘汰） */
    { rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
      CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, A0, CH, d, &dc, 8) == 0 && dc == 0, "用例11：chunk0 吸收为脏");
      CHECK(rb_write(s, 2ull * CH, G2, CH, d, &dc, 8) == 0 && dc == 0, "用例11：chunk2 吸收为脏");
      CHECK(rb_write(s, 5ull * CH, E5, CH, d, &dc, 8) == 0 && dc == 0, "用例11：chunk5 填驻留"); }
    InterlockedExchange(&g_staged, 0);
    InterlockedExchange(&g_flush_stop, 0);
    th = CreateThread(NULL, 0, flush_loop, s, 0, NULL);
    CHECK(th != NULL, "用例11：flusher 线程创建");
    /* 3) 自旋等旧数据进入在途回调（回调在睡 50ms） */
    { int spins = 0;
      while (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_staged, 0, 0) && spins < 5000) { Sleep(1); spins++; } }
    CHECK(InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_staged, 0, 0) != 0, "用例11：旧数据已进入在途回调");
    /* 4) 大写 B（max_direct=1 → hit-miss-hit-miss → 双 miss 溢出 → -2 → 出口 drain） */
    { rb_direct_range d[1]; int dc = 0; rb_write_pre pre; int r;
      memset(&pre, 0, sizeof(pre));
      r = rb_write_ex(s, 0, B, R4, d, &dc, 1, &pre);
      if (r != -2 || dc != 2)
          printf("  [note] 用例11：大写形态异常（r=%d dc=%d，期望 -2/2）\n", r, dc);
      CHECK(r == -2 && dc == 2, "用例11：大写触发 -2 溢出（出口 drain 生效点）");
      /* 5) 驱动 P2-1 纪律：整段镜像新数据 + 整段失效 */
      memcpy(g_disk, B, R4);
      rb_stream_invalidate_range(s, 0, R4);
    }
    /* 6) 停 flusher 并收尾 */
    InterlockedExchange(&g_flush_stop, 1);
    WaitForSingleObject(th, INFINITE);
    CloseHandle(th);
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, B, R4) == 0, "用例11：迟到旧数据被拦（4 chunk 盘面=B）");
    { int diff = -1;
      for (i = 0; i < R4; i++) if (g_disk[i] != B[i]) { diff = (int)i; break; }
      if (diff >= 0)
      {
          printf("  [note] 用例11：盘面 @%d got=%u exp=%u（旧数据 A0 落于新镜像之后）\n",
                 diff, g_disk[diff], B[diff]);
          CHECK(0, "用例11：迟到旧数据污染盘面");
      } }
    fill_pattern(g_disk, DISK_SIZE, 0x1111);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

int main(void)
{
    g_disk = (unsigned char *)malloc(DISK_SIZE);
    if (!g_disk) { printf("无法分配模拟磁盘\n"); return 1; }
    memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);
    fill_pattern(g_disk, DISK_SIZE, 0x1111);

    test_read_hit();
    test_read_partial_hit();
    test_write_back_flush();
    test_partial_write_direct();
    test_dirty_protected_from_commit();
    test_lru_evict();
    test_cross_chunk();
    test_random_consistency();
    test_watermark_flush();
    test_rmw_all_memory_write();
    test_wsrace2_tooth();
    test_trim_80();
    test_hard_limit_direct();
    test_readback_fail_fallback();
    test_idle_reclaim();

    printf("\n%s  (失败 %d)\n", g_fail ? "存在失败用例" : "全部用例通过", g_fail);
    free(g_disk);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

````c
/* R2 回归：writer / flusher / flush_partition 交错，断言 dirty 计数
 * 全程无下溢(>FSZ 即判异常)且终态精确归零。Windows 线程版。 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#define FSZ  (16ull*1024*1024)
/* V7.4 merges adjacent dirty blocks into large contiguous segments; a segment
 * near the end can overrun FSZ. Over-allocate disk and bound writes so every
 * truly-writable dirty block can land (fixture fix, not product behavior). */
#define DISKSZ (FSZ + 2ull*1024*1024)
#define OMAX  (FSZ - 512ull*1024)
#define NW   4
#define OPS  800
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static unsigned char *g_shadow;   /* [FIX #5.2] 每写者独占分片影子（NW x SHARD） */
static rb_engine *g_eng;
static rb_stream  *g_st;
static volatile LONG g_stop = 0, g_bad = 0;
static int wb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 f,rb_u64 o,const void*d,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)f; if(o+n>DISKSZ) return -1; memcpy(g_disk+o,d,n); return 0; }
static int rb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 f,rb_u64 o,void*b,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)f; if(o+n>DISKSZ) return -1; memcpy(b,g_disk+o,n); return 0; }
static unsigned nrand(unsigned*s){*s=*s*1103515245u+12345u;return *s>>1;}
/* [FIX #5.2] 每写者独占 1/4 分片（4MB）：原 4 写者在全 16MB 随机覆写但终态
 * 唯一断言是 dirty_bytes==0——无影子、无盘面比对，"有覆写、无校验"。
 * 现按 wid 把 off 限制在片内，每片维护独占影子（写后即时更新，无需锁），
 * 终检逐片全量 memcmp。直写分支补 rb_stream_invalidate_range（对齐
 * test_wsconc.c:186/201 驱动纪律：镜像成功后失效，防陈旧副本后被读命中）。 */
#define SHARD ((OMAX) / NW)
static DWORD WINAPI writer(LPVOID p){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p^0x5a5a; int op;
    int wid=(int)((unsigned long)p-1); rb_u64 base=(rb_u64)wid*SHARD;
    for(op=0;op<OPS&&!g_bad;op++){
        rb_u64 off=base+(rb_u64)(nrand(&seed)%SHARD);
        size_t len=1+(size_t)(nrand(&seed)%(200*1024));
        if(off+len>base+SHARD) len=(size_t)(base+SHARD-off);
        if(len==0) continue;
        { unsigned char*b=(unsigned char*)malloc(len);
          rb_direct_range dr[64]; int dc=0,k;
          for(size_t i=0;i<len;i++) b[i]=(unsigned char)nrand(&seed);
          rb_write(g_st,off,b,len,dr,&dc,64);
          if(dc>64){ memcpy(g_disk+off,b,len); rb_stream_invalidate_range(g_st,off,len); }
          else {
              for(k=0;k<dc;k++) memcpy(g_disk+dr[k].offset,b+(dr[k].offset-off),dr[k].len);
              for(k=0;k<dc;k++) rb_stream_invalidate_range(g_st,dr[k].offset,dr[k].len);
          }
          memcpy(g_shadow+off,b,len);   /* 独占片：无需锁 */
          free(b); }
    } return 0; }
static DWORD WINAPI flusher(LPVOID p){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p^0xa5a5;
    while(!g_stop&&!g_bad){
        rb_stream_flush(g_st,(int)(nrand(&seed)&1));
        { rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
          if(st.dirty_bytes>FSZ){ printf("  [FAIL] dirty underflow: %llu\n",
              (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes); g_bad=1; } }
        Sleep(1);
    } return 0; }
static DWORD WINAPI partflusher(LPVOID p){
    int my=(int)((unsigned long)p)&3;
    while(!g_stop&&!g_bad){ rb_stream_flush_partition(g_st,my,4); Sleep(1); }
    return 0; }
int main(void){
    HANDLE wt[NW],ff[2],pf[4]; int i;
    g_disk=(unsigned char*)calloc(1,DISKSZ);
    g_shadow=(unsigned char*)calloc(1,DISKSZ);   /* 初值 0=盘面初值 */
    { rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof c);
      c.max_bytes=8ull*1024*1024; c.max_merge_len=4ull*1024*1024;
      c.writeback=wb_fn; c.readback=rb_fn; c.block_size=4096;
      g_eng=rb_engine_create(&c); }
    g_st=rb_stream_create(g_eng,1);
    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) wt[i]=CreateThread(NULL,0,writer,(LPARAM)(i+1),0,NULL);
    for(i=0;i<2;i++) ff[i]=CreateThread(NULL,0,flusher,(LPARAM)(i+11),0,NULL);
    for(i=0;i<4;i++) pf[i]=CreateThread(NULL,0,partflusher,(LPARAM)i,0,NULL);
    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) WaitForSingleObject(wt[i],INFINITE);
    g_stop=1;
    for(i=0;i<2;i++) WaitForSingleObject(ff[i],INFINITE);
    for(i=0;i<4;i++) WaitForSingleObject(pf[i],INFINITE);
    rb_stream_flush(g_st,1);
    { rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
      if(st.dirty_bytes!=0){ printf("[FAIL] dirty!=0: %llu\n",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes); g_bad=1; }
      else printf("[ok] dirty=0: concurrent/partition writeback counts consistent\n"); }
    /* [FIX #5.2] 逐片全量比对：覆写并发 + 在途回写后的盘面必须等于影子权威态。
     * 原终态只查 dirty==0（记账），不查数据——旧数据覆写类污染 100% 逃逸。 */
    { int w;
      for(w=0;w<NW;w++){
        rb_u64 base=(rb_u64)w*SHARD;
        if(memcmp(g_disk+base,g_shadow+base,SHARD)!=0){
            size_t j; int shown=0;
            for(j=0;j<SHARD && shown<3;j+=4096){
                if(memcmp(g_disk+base+j,g_shadow+base+j,4096)!=0){
                    printf("  [FAIL] shard %d mismatch @%llu (first of run)\n",
                           w,(unsigned long long)(base+j));
                    shown++; g_bad=1;
                }
            }
            if(!shown){ printf("  [FAIL] shard %d mismatch (unaligned)\n",w); g_bad=1; }
        }
      }
      if(!g_bad) printf("[ok] all %d shards byte-exact vs shadow (overwrite x concurrent writeback)\n",NW); }
    rb_stream_destroy(g_st); rb_engine_destroy(g_eng);
    printf(g_bad?"test_counter: FAIL\n":"test_counter: PASS\n");
    free(g_disk); free(g_shadow);
    return g_bad?1:0;
}
````

````c
/* Seed-parameterized variant of test_counter for fixed-seed regression.
 * argv[1] = seed base; XORed into every thread's random stream. */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#define FSZ  (16ull*1024*1024)
#define DISKSZ (FSZ + 2ull*1024*1024)
#define OMAX  (FSZ - 512ull*1024)
#define NW   4
#define OPS  800
static unsigned g_seed_base = 0;
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static rb_engine *g_eng;
static rb_stream  *g_st;
static volatile LONG g_stop = 0, g_bad = 0;
static int wb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 f,rb_u64 o,const void*d,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)f; if(o+n>DISKSZ) return -1; memcpy(g_disk+o,d,n); return 0; }
static int rb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 f,rb_u64 o,void*b,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)f; if(o+n>DISKSZ) return -1; memcpy(b,g_disk+o,n); return 0; }
static unsigned nrand(unsigned*s){*s=*s*1103515245u+12345u;return *s>>1;}
static DWORD WINAPI writer(LPVOID p){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p^0x5a5a^g_seed_base; int op;
    for(op=0;op<OPS&&!g_bad;op++){
        rb_u64 off=(rb_u64)(nrand(&seed)%OMAX);
        size_t len=1+(size_t)(nrand(&seed)%(200*1024));
        if(off+len>OMAX) len=(size_t)(OMAX-off);
        if(len==0) continue;
        { unsigned char*b=(unsigned char*)malloc(len);
          rb_direct_range dr[64]; int dc=0,k;
          for(size_t i=0;i<len;i++) b[i]=(unsigned char)nrand(&seed);
          rb_write(g_st,off,b,len,dr,&dc,64);
          if(dc>64) memcpy(g_disk+off,b,len);
          else for(k=0;k<dc;k++) memcpy(g_disk+dr[k].offset,b+(dr[k].offset-off),dr[k].len);
          free(b); }
    } return 0; }
static DWORD WINAPI flusher(LPVOID p){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p^0xa5a5^g_seed_base;
    while(!g_stop&&!g_bad){
        rb_stream_flush(g_st,(int)(nrand(&seed)&1));
        { rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
          if(st.dirty_bytes>FSZ){ printf("  [FAIL] dirty underflow: %llu\n",
              (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes); g_bad=1; } }
        Sleep(1);
    } return 0; }
static DWORD WINAPI partflusher(LPVOID p){
    int my=(int)((unsigned long)p)&3;
    while(!g_stop&&!g_bad){ rb_stream_flush_partition(g_st,my,4); Sleep(1); }
    return 0; }
int main(int argc,char**argv){
    HANDLE wt[NW],ff[2],pf[4]; int i;
    if(argc>1) g_seed_base=(unsigned)strtoul(argv[1],NULL,10);
    g_disk=(unsigned char*)calloc(1,DISKSZ);
    { rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof c);
      c.max_bytes=8ull*1024*1024; c.max_merge_len=4ull*1024*1024;
      c.writeback=wb_fn; c.readback=rb_fn; c.block_size=4096;
      g_eng=rb_engine_create(&c); }
    g_st=rb_stream_create(g_eng,1);
    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) wt[i]=CreateThread(NULL,0,writer,(LPARAM)(i+1),0,NULL);
    for(i=0;i<2;i++) ff[i]=CreateThread(NULL,0,flusher,(LPARAM)(i+11),0,NULL);
    for(i=0;i<4;i++) pf[i]=CreateThread(NULL,0,partflusher,(LPARAM)i,0,NULL);
    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) WaitForSingleObject(wt[i],INFINITE);
    g_stop=1;
    for(i=0;i<2;i++) WaitForSingleObject(ff[i],INFINITE);
    for(i=0;i<4;i++) WaitForSingleObject(pf[i],INFINITE);
    rb_stream_flush(g_st,1);
    { rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
      if(st.dirty_bytes!=0){ printf("[FAIL] dirty!=0: %llu\n",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes); g_bad=1; }
      else printf("[ok] dirty=0 seed=%u\n",g_seed_base); }
    rb_stream_destroy(g_st); rb_engine_destroy(g_eng);
    printf(g_bad?"test_counter: FAIL\n":"test_counter: PASS\n");
    free(g_disk);
    return g_bad?1:0;
}
````
