##### `tests/core/test_directwrite_stale.c`

````c
/*
 * test_directwrite_stale.c -- QA 复现用例（用户态 core 域，2026-11-07）
 *
 * 目的：复现/证伪 deliverables/80 §2 BLOCKER 2 —— >4K 几何 + 直写的
 *       silent stale read（陈旧 clean 块读）。
 *
 * 【按主理人 01:4x 精确配方修订 v2；02:0x 增量 v2.1 新增 --mode post-uncond】
 *  · 驱动直写分支 rbio_worker.c RbWriteWorker（[142] 自 rbio.c:925-946 迁出）在 WriteBack=0 下【根本不调用 rb_write_ex /
 *    rb_write】。它是两段式：RbSyncIo(TRUE) 写盘 + rb_read_commit_gen(回填)。
 *    本用例严格手工模拟这两段（直接改模拟盘 + 调 rb_read_commit），
 *    **绝不使用 rb_write_ex / rb_write**，否则测的是回写 RMW 路径、结论无效。
 *  · 用公开 rb_read_commit（cache_read.c:237 rb_stream_view_gen 自动取 view_gen）而非手工传
 *    view_gen，等价原 rbio.c:944-945 的 rb_read_commit_gen(..., rb_stream_view_gen())。
 *  · 逐档输出 ③ 的 mc2 与 rb_engine_get_stats 的 read_hit 增量，并明确
 *    READ_PATH=HIT|MISS：只有缓存命中（mc2=0 / read_hit_delta>0）才暴露陈旧读；
 *    走 miss 下盘读会得到正确数据、不会 FAIL。
 *  · 两个变体：off=4096（写起点非 0）、len=512（扇区尾，4K 档也应 FAIL），
 *    证明缺陷是「任何几何的非整子块写」，16K 只是把覆盖面放大到所有 4K IO。
 *  · --mode pre|post-uncond|post-cond 三套行为断言（post 为 post-uncond 兼容别名），
 *    防止「驱动已修、用例仍断言旧行为 FAIL」在 E3/E4 回归里制造假红。
 *
 * 模式语义（当前有效裁定 = 82 号 §4.7.2：无条件 RbInvalidateAfterFlush）：
 *   pre         修复前（当前代码）：写盘 + 直接 rb_read_commit（等价 :939→:944），
 *               期望 >4K 档 STALE/FAIL（4K+512B 变体也应 FAIL）。
 *   post-uncond 修复后【正向断言模板】，等价方案 A：写盘 + 无条件模拟
 *               RbInvalidateAfterFlush（rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex，superseded=1，
 *               升 view_gen）+ 再 rb_read_commit；期望全档 CLEAN、invalidate=1。
 *               `--mode post` 为兼容别名，行为相同。交工程师作 E3/E4 回归输入。
 *   post-cond   【负面对照】：已撤回的门控版 `bs>4096 && 非整子块写`。实测它在
 *               4K 几何 512B 扇区尾写下仍 STALE ⇒ 门控会漏掉「任何几何的非整子块写」，
 *               正是 82 号 §4.7.2 撤回它、改采无条件方案的实证依据。保留，不删。
 *
 * 代码链路（80 §2.1，逐行复核）：
 *   rbio_worker.c RbWriteWorker 仅当 rb_stream_has_dirty_range 才 flush + RbInvalidateAfterFlush；
 *               直写稳态全 clean ⇒ has_dirty_range=0 ⇒ 不失效。
 *   cache_read.c:206 full_cover=(pos<=sub_start)&&(end>=sub_end)
 *   cache_read.c 回填段 if(!full_cover||excl_hit){ continue; }（[142] 迁后语义不变） ← 非整子块覆盖直接跳过
 *   cache_read.c:102 rb_read_try_cache / rb_read 只要 loaded 命中就返回旧 data
 *
 * 纪律：不改任何产品源码；只 include 公开头 cache.h；不碰真机/配置/注册表/服务。
 * 退出码：**0 只代表用例自身跑通，绝不代表产品无缺陷**。
 *
 * 编译（MSVC cl 19.44 + WinSDK 10.0.26100.0，INCLUDE/LIB/PATH 取自 _build_all.ps1）：
 *   cl /nologo /O2 /W4 /utf-8 /c /I<core> /Fo:<build>\qa_stale_directwrite.obj <core>\test_directwrite_stale.c
 *   cl /nologo /O2 /W4 /utf-8 /c /I<core> /Fo:<build>\qa_stale_cache.obj <core>\cache.c
 *   cl /nologo /O2 /Fe:<build>\qa_stale_directwrite.exe <build>\qa_stale_directwrite.obj <build>\qa_stale_cache.obj
 *
 * 用法：
 *   qa_stale_directwrite.exe                              # 三模式全跑（默认 all）
 *   qa_stale_directwrite.exe --mode pre                   # 修复前
 *   qa_stale_directwrite.exe --mode post-uncond           # 修复后正向断言模板（方案 A）
 *   qa_stale_directwrite.exe --mode post                  # 同上，兼容别名
 *   qa_stale_directwrite.exe --mode post-cond             # 已撤回门控版，负面对照
 *   qa_stale_directwrite.exe --geom 16384                 # 只跑 16K 档
 *   qa_stale_directwrite.exe --case tail512               # 只跑扇区尾变体
 */

#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define MIRROR_SIZE    65536u
#define MAX_MISS       32
#define ENGINE_BYTES   (256ull * 1024u * 1024u)   /* 主理人骨架：cfg.max_bytes=256MB */

enum { MODE_PRE = 0, MODE_POST_UNCOND = 1, MODE_POST_COND = 2, MODE_ALL = 3 };
typedef enum { V_STALE = 0, V_CLEAN = 1, V_ERROR = 2 } verdict_t;

typedef struct { const char *name; rb_u32 off, len; } CaseDef;
static const CaseDef g_cases[] = {
    { "main",     0u,    4096u },   /* 4K 文件系统写，写起点 = 子块起点 */
    { "off4096",  4096u, 4096u },   /* 写起点非 0：16K 档 pos>sub_start */
    { "tail512",  0u,    512u  },   /* 扇区尾：4K 档也应 non-full-cover */
};
static const rb_u32 g_geoms[] = { 4096u, 8192u, 16384u, 32768u };

static unsigned char g_disk[MIRROR_SIZE];   /* 模拟盘 */
static unsigned char g_new[MIRROR_SIZE];    /* 本次直写的新内容（写区间） */
static unsigned char g_tmp[MIRROR_SIZE], g_out[MIRROR_SIZE], g_probe[MIRROR_SIZE];

typedef struct {
    rb_u32 geom; int ci; int mode;
    verdict_t v; int mc2; rb_u64 hit_delta; rb_u64 mismatch;
} Rec;
static Rec g_recs[4 * 3 * 3];
static int g_nrec;

static const char *verdict_name(verdict_t v)
{ return v == V_STALE ? "STALE" : (v == V_CLEAN ? "CLEAN" : "ERROR"); }
static const char *mode_name(int m)
{ return m == MODE_PRE ? "PRE_FIX" :
        (m == MODE_POST_UNCOND ? "POST_FIX_UNCONDITIONAL" :
        (m == MODE_POST_COND ? "POST_FIX_CONDITIONAL" : "ALL")); }

/* 确定性逐偏移 pattern。B 取 A 的按位反码 ⇒ 写区间内【每字节必不同】，
 * 消除两个独立 pattern 偶然相同造成的 MISMATCH_COUNT 噪声；
 * 仍是逐偏移确定性函数（能检测偏移错位），不用 rand()。 */
static uint64_t mix64(uint64_t x)
{
    x ^= x >> 30; x *= (uint64_t)0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ULL;
    x ^= x >> 27; x *= (uint64_t)0x94D049BB133111EBULL;
    x ^= x >> 31; return x;
}
static unsigned char pat_a(rb_u64 off)
{ return (unsigned char)mix64(off ^ (uint64_t)0xA5A5A5A5A5A5A5A5ULL); }
static unsigned char pat_b(rb_u64 off)
{ return (unsigned char)(pat_a(off) ^ 0xFFu); }

/* 模拟盘回调（core 域现成基建范式：edge_v3.c / bench_5g.c direct_write）。
 * writeback 在直写稳态无脏、正常不会被调到；实现为写回 g_disk 便于诊断。 */
static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)fid;
    if (off + (rb_u64)len > (rb_u64)MIRROR_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + (size_t)off, data, len);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)fid;
    if (off + (rb_u64)len > (rb_u64)MIRROR_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(buf, g_disk + (size_t)off, len);
    return 0;
}

/* 复刻 cache_read.c:206 的 full_cover 语义（用于 post-cond 触发条件与输出）。 */
static int is_full_cover(rb_u32 bs, rb_u32 off, rb_u32 len)
{
    rb_u64 sub_start = ((rb_u64)off / (rb_u64)bs) * (rb_u64)bs;
    rb_u64 sub_end   = sub_start + (rb_u64)bs;
    rb_u64 end       = (rb_u64)off + (rb_u64)len;
    return ((rb_u64)off <= sub_start) && (end >= sub_end);
}

static int geom_legal(rb_u32 bs)
{ return bs == 4096u || bs == 8192u || bs == 16384u || bs == 32768u; }

static void record(rb_u32 geom, int ci, int mode, verdict_t v,
                   int mc2, rb_u64 hit_delta, rb_u64 mismatch)
{
    if (g_nrec >= (int)(sizeof(g_recs) / sizeof(g_recs[0]))) return;
    g_recs[g_nrec].geom = geom; g_recs[g_nrec].ci = ci; g_recs[g_nrec].mode = mode;
    g_recs[g_nrec].v = v; g_recs[g_nrec].mc2 = mc2;
    g_recs[g_nrec].hit_delta = hit_delta; g_recs[g_nrec].mismatch = mismatch;
    g_nrec++;
}

static verdict_t run_case(rb_u32 bs, int ci, int mode)
{
    const CaseDef *cd = &g_cases[ci];
    rb_config cfg;
    rb_engine *eng = NULL;
    rb_stream *s = NULL;
    rb_u64 sub_start, view0, view1, mismatch = 0, first_off = 0, hit_delta = 0;
    unsigned char first_exp = 0, first_act = 0;
    rb_direct_range miss[MAX_MISS], miss2[MAX_MISS];
    rb_stats st0, st1;
    int mc = 0, mc2 = 0, rc, i, preload_hit, preload_match;
    int stale_shape = 1, invalidated = 0, full;
    verdict_t v = V_ERROR;

    sub_start = ((rb_u64)cd->off / (rb_u64)bs) * (rb_u64)bs;  /* 写区间所在子块起点 */
    full = is_full_cover(bs, cd->off, cd->len);

    printf("\n----- MODE=%s GEOM=%u CASE=%s OFF=%u LEN=%u "
           "SUB_START=%llu COVER_PCT=%.2f FULL_COVER=%d -----\n",
           mode_name(mode), (unsigned)bs, cd->name, (unsigned)cd->off,
           (unsigned)cd->len, (unsigned long long)sub_start,
           100.0 * (double)cd->len / (double)bs, full);

    /* 模拟盘初始全为 A */
    for (i = 0; i < (int)MIRROR_SIZE; ++i) g_disk[i] = pat_a((rb_u64)i);

    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes  = ENGINE_BYTES;
    cfg.block_size = bs;
    cfg.writeback  = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback   = rb_fn;
    cfg.tinylfu    = 0;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    if (!eng) { printf("[HARNESS-ERROR] rb_engine_create NULL\n"); goto done; }
    /* 硬断言防 cache.c:267 非法几何静默回落 4096 造成 >4K 档假 CLEAN */
    if (rb_engine_block_size(eng) != bs) {
        printf("[HARNESS-ERROR] geometry fell back: want=%u got=%u\n",
               (unsigned)bs, (unsigned)rb_engine_block_size(eng));
        goto done;
    }
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 1);
    if (!s) { printf("[HARNESS-ERROR] rb_stream_create NULL\n"); goto done; }

    /* ---- ① 预热：模拟一次完整子块读，使该子块成为 clean + loaded ---- */
    memset(g_tmp, 0, MIRROR_SIZE);
    rc = rb_read(s, sub_start, g_tmp, (size_t)bs, miss, &mc, MAX_MISS);
    for (i = 0; i < mc; ++i) {
        rb_u64 mo = miss[i].offset; size_t ml = miss[i].len;
        if (mo + (rb_u64)ml > (rb_u64)MIRROR_SIZE ||
            (rb_u64)mo < sub_start || (rb_u64)(mo - sub_start) + ml > (rb_u64)MIRROR_SIZE) {
            printf("[HARNESS-ERROR] preload miss range out of bounds\n"); goto done;
        }
        (void)rb_fn(NULL, 1, mo, g_tmp + (size_t)(mo - sub_start), ml);
        rb_read_commit(s, mo, g_tmp + (size_t)(mo - sub_start), ml);
    }
    memset(g_probe, 0, MIRROR_SIZE);
    preload_hit   = rb_read_try_cache(s, sub_start, g_probe, (size_t)bs);
    preload_match = (memcmp(g_probe, g_disk + (size_t)sub_start, (size_t)bs) == 0);
    printf("STEP1_PRELOAD: rb_read rc=%d mc=%d + rb_read_commit; "
           "try_cache_hit=%d preload_match=%d (clean+loaded prerequisite; "
           "cold cache would fake PASS)\n", rc, mc, preload_hit, preload_match);
    if (preload_hit != 1 || !preload_match) {
        printf("[HARNESS-ERROR] preload did not establish a loaded clean sub-block\n");
        goto done;
    }

    /* ---- ② 模拟驱动直写第一段：RbSyncIo(TRUE) 已把新数据写到盘 ---- */
    memset(g_new, 0, MIRROR_SIZE);
    for (i = 0; i < (int)cd->len; ++i) {
        unsigned char b = pat_b((rb_u64)cd->off + (rb_u64)i);
        g_new[i] = b;
        g_disk[(size_t)cd->off + (size_t)i] = b;
    }
    printf("STEP2_DIRECT_WRITE: disk[%u..%u)=B (RbSyncIo equivalent); "
           "A/B differ at EVERY byte of the write range\n",
           (unsigned)cd->off, (unsigned)(cd->off + cd->len));

    /* ---- ③ 两段式的第二段：rb_read_commit(off, new, len) ---- */
    view0 = rb_stream_view_gen(s);
    if (mode == MODE_POST_UNCOND ||
        (mode == MODE_POST_COND && bs > 4096u && !full)) {
        /* 模拟 RbInvalidateAfterFlush 的无脏分支：
         * rbio_worker.c C7 段 → rb_stream_invalidate_range → _ex(superseded=1)，
         * 入口即升 view_gen（cache.c:1974）、清 loaded（cache.c:2031）。 */
        rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, (rb_u64)cd->off, (rb_u64)cd->len,
                                      1, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);
        invalidated = 1;
    }
    view1 = rb_stream_view_gen(s);
    rb_read_commit(s, (rb_u64)cd->off, g_new, (size_t)cd->len);
    printf("STEP3_COMMIT: rb_read_commit(OFF=%u,LEN=%u) [equiv rbio.c:944] "
           "invalidate=%d view_gen=%llu->%llu full_cover=%d\n",
           (unsigned)cd->off, (unsigned)cd->len, invalidated,
           (unsigned long long)view0, (unsigned long long)view1, full);
    /* 正向断言模板自检：方案 A 是【无条件】失效，任何 case 都必须 invalidate=1。 */
    if (mode == MODE_POST_UNCOND && invalidated != 1) {
        printf("[HARNESS-ERROR] POST_FIX_UNCONDITIONAL must invalidate on EVERY case\n");
        goto done;
    }

    /* ---- ④ 读回比对：输出 mc2 与 read_hit，明确命中 / miss ---- */
    memset(&st0, 0, sizeof(st0)); memset(&st1, 0, sizeof(st1));
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st0);
    memset(g_out, 0, MIRROR_SIZE);
    rc = rb_read(s, (rb_u64)cd->off, g_out, (size_t)cd->len, miss2, &mc2, MAX_MISS);
    for (i = 0; i < mc2; ++i) {
        rb_u64 mo = miss2[i].offset, me = mo + (rb_u64)miss2[i].len;
        rb_u64 lo = mo > (rb_u64)cd->off ? mo : (rb_u64)cd->off;
        rb_u64 hi = me < ((rb_u64)cd->off + cd->len) ? me : ((rb_u64)cd->off + cd->len);
        if (hi > lo && me <= (rb_u64)MIRROR_SIZE)
            memcpy(g_out + (size_t)(lo - cd->off), g_disk + (size_t)lo,
                   (size_t)(hi - lo));   /* 模拟 miss 下盘读 */
    }
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st1);
    hit_delta = st1.read_hit - st0.read_hit;
    printf("STEP4_READ: rb_read rc=%d mc2=%d read_hit_delta=%llu READ_PATH=%s "
           "(mc2=0 => served from CACHE, stale read visible; "
           "mc2>0 => went to lower disk, would read correct B)\n",
           rc, mc2, (unsigned long long)hit_delta, mc2 == 0 ? "HIT" : "MISS");

    for (i = 0; i < (int)cd->len; ++i) {
        if (g_out[i] != g_new[i]) {
            if (mismatch == 0) {
                first_off = (rb_u64)cd->off + (rb_u64)i;
                first_exp = g_new[i];
                first_act = g_out[i];
            }
            mismatch++;
            if (g_new[i] != pat_b((rb_u64)cd->off + (rb_u64)i) ||
                g_out[i] != pat_a((rb_u64)cd->off + (rb_u64)i)) stale_shape = 0;
        }
    }
    printf("MISMATCH_COUNT=%llu\n", (unsigned long long)mismatch);
    if (mismatch == 0) {
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_OFFSET=none\nFIRST_MISMATCH_EXPECTED=none\n"
               "FIRST_MISMATCH_ACTUAL=none\n");
        v = V_CLEAN;
    } else {
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_OFFSET=%llu\n", (unsigned long long)first_off);
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_EXPECTED=0x%02x (B)\n", (unsigned)first_exp);
        printf("FIRST_MISMATCH_ACTUAL=0x%02x (A, stale cache copy)\n", (unsigned)first_act);
        printf("STALE_SHAPE=%d (every diff expected=B actual=A)\n", stale_shape);
        /* STALE 硬判据：所有差异符合陈旧形态 + ③ 确实命中缓存
         * （mc2==0 && read_hit_delta>0）。若 ③ 走 miss 却仍不一致 ⇒ 建模问题。 */
        if (stale_shape && mismatch == (rb_u64)cd->len && mc2 == 0 && hit_delta > 0)
            v = V_STALE;
        else v = V_ERROR;
    }
    if (v == V_ERROR && mismatch != 0)
        printf("[HARNESS-ERROR] unexpected mismatch shape or read did not hit cache\n");

done:
    printf("RESULT: %s\n", verdict_name(v));
    record(bs, ci, mode, v, mc2, hit_delta, mismatch);
    if (s)   rb_stream_destroy(s);
    if (eng) rb_engine_destroy(eng);
    return v;
}

static void print_matrix(void)
{
    size_t g, c;
    int m, errs = 0;
    printf("\n===== MATRIX: PRE_FIX / POST_FIX_UNCONDITIONAL / POST_FIX_CONDITIONAL =====\n");
    printf("%-6s %-9s | %-6s %-9s | %-6s %-9s | %-6s %-9s\n",
           "GEOM", "CASE", "PRE", "mc2/hit", "POSTU", "mc2/hit",
           "POSTC", "mc2/hit");
    printf("(POSTU = POST_FIX_UNCONDITIONAL / plan A; POSTC = withdrawn gated fix, negative control)\n");
    for (g = 0; g < sizeof(g_geoms) / sizeof(g_geoms[0]); ++g) {
        for (c = 0; c < sizeof(g_cases) / sizeof(g_cases[0]); ++c) {
            printf("%-6u %-9s | ", (unsigned)g_geoms[g], g_cases[c].name);
            for (m = 0; m < 3; ++m) {
                int k; const Rec *r = NULL;
                for (k = 0; k < g_nrec; ++k)
                    if (g_recs[k].geom == g_geoms[g] && g_recs[k].ci == (int)c &&
                        g_recs[k].mode == m) { r = &g_recs[k]; break; }
                if (!r) printf("%-6s %-9s |", "-", "-");  /* 本次未运行该模式 */
                else {
                    printf("%-6s %d/%-7llu |", verdict_name(r->v), r->mc2,
                           (unsigned long long)r->hit_delta);
                    if (r->v == V_ERROR) errs++;
                }
            }
            printf("\n");
        }
    }
    printf("HARNESS_ERRORS=%d\n", errs);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    int mode = MODE_ALL;
    rb_u32 only_geom = 0;
    const char *only_case = NULL;
    int i, m, harness_errors = 0;
    size_t g, c;
    static const int modes[3] = { MODE_PRE, MODE_POST_UNCOND, MODE_POST_COND };

    for (i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--mode") && i + 1 < argc) {
            const char *v = argv[++i];
            if (!strcmp(v, "pre")) mode = MODE_PRE;
            else if (!strcmp(v, "post-uncond") || !strcmp(v, "post")) mode = MODE_POST_UNCOND;
            else if (!strcmp(v, "post-cond")) mode = MODE_POST_COND;
            else if (!strcmp(v, "all")) mode = MODE_ALL;
            else { fprintf(stderr, "[HARNESS-ERROR] --mode pre|post-uncond|post|post-cond|all\n"); return 2; }
        } else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--geom") && i + 1 < argc) {
            only_geom = (rb_u32)strtoul(argv[++i], NULL, 10);
            if (!geom_legal(only_geom)) {
                fprintf(stderr, "[HARNESS-ERROR] --geom 4096|8192|16384|32768\n"); return 2;
            }
        } else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--case") && i + 1 < argc) {
            only_case = argv[++i];
            if (strcmp(only_case, "all") && strcmp(only_case, "main") &&
                strcmp(only_case, "off4096") && strcmp(only_case, "tail512")) {
                fprintf(stderr, "[HARNESS-ERROR] --case main|off4096|tail512|all\n"); return 2;
            }
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "usage: qa_stale_directwrite.exe [--mode pre|post-uncond|post|post-cond|all] "
                            "[--geom N] [--case main|off4096|tail512|all]\n");
            return 2;
        }
    }

    printf("test_directwrite_stale 2.1 -- BLOCKER 2 repro (user-mode core, memory mirror)\n");
    printf("TWO-SEGMENT WRITE-THROUGH MODEL: direct disk edit + rb_read_commit; "
           "NO rb_write_ex/rb_write (unreachable under WriteBack=0).\n");
    printf("SCOPE: no product source changes, no driver/service/registry/volume touched.\n");
    printf("EXIT=0 means HARNESS RAN (every case produced a verdict); "
           "it does NOT mean 'product has no defect'.\n");
    printf("VERDICT KEY: STALE=defect reproduced | CLEAN=not reproduced | ERROR=harness/model problem.\n");
    printf("MODE: pre=current code | post-uncond=PLAN A unconditional invalidate "
           "(82 4.7.2, E3/E4 positive template) | post=alias | "
           "post-cond=WITHDRAWN gated fix, negative control.\n");

    for (m = 0; m < (mode == MODE_ALL ? 3 : 1); ++m) {
        int cur = (mode == MODE_ALL) ? modes[m] : mode;
        printf("\n########## MODE=%s ##########\n", mode_name(cur));
        for (g = 0; g < sizeof(g_geoms) / sizeof(g_geoms[0]); ++g) {
            if (only_geom && g_geoms[g] != only_geom) continue;
            for (c = 0; c < sizeof(g_cases) / sizeof(g_cases[0]); ++c) {
                if (only_case && strcmp(only_case, "all") != 0 &&
                    strcmp(only_case, g_cases[c].name) != 0) continue;
                if (run_case(g_geoms[g], (int)c, cur) == V_ERROR) harness_errors++;
            }
        }
    }

    print_matrix();
    printf("\nCOVER_PCT: main/off4096 = 4096/bs (100/50/25/12.5%%); "
           "tail512 = 512/bs (12.5/6.25/3.125/1.5625%%).\n");
    printf("INTERPRETATION: PRE STALE + POST_UNCOND CLEAN => stale read caused by missing "
           "write-before-invalidate; unconditional invalidation fixes ALL cases.\n");
    printf("POST_COND STALE at 4K/tail512 => the withdrawn gated fix misses 4K sector-tail writes; "
           "this is the empirical reason 82 4.7.2 adopted the unconditional fix (negative control).\n");
    printf("NOTE: exit 0 == harness ran successfully, NOT 'no product defect'.\n");
    return harness_errors ? 1 : 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_discard_clean.c`

````c
/*
 * test_discard_clean.c -- [I48c/I48d 2026-11-10] 丢视图但保脏 回归
 *
 * 真机缺陷（137 号）：attach 热开启 / 切每卷直写路径在 force flush 失败后
 * 无条件 rb_stream_discard_all —— 已 ack 脏块被一并销毁并计入
 * lost_dirty_bytes（e5 实测一次 attach 丢 7,872,512 B）。
 *
 * 修复：core 新增 rb_stream_discard_clean()
 *   ① dirty==0 的 chunk 整块销毁（可从盘重建，不记 lost）；
 *   ② 含脏的 chunk 只清干净子块的 loaded 位（loaded &= dirty），
 *      脏子块的数据与 dirty|loaded 位原样留驻，等 flusher 重试；
 *   ③ view_gen 升代，在途回填失格。
 *
 * 本测试判据：
 *   A 干净块被丢弃：clean chunk 走后 cur_bytes/chunk_count 下降，读为 miss；
 *   B 脏块被保留：dirty_bytes 不归零、lost_dirty_bytes==0、脏子块读命中
 *     且内容正确；
 *   C 同 chunk 混合场景：脏子块命中，干净子块 miss（证明 loaded 位被精确
 *     清除，而不是靠"整块保留"蒙对）；
 *   D 失败/成功两态：注入下层写失败 → flush 后脏仍在且 lost==0；解除注入
 *     再 flush → 脏清零、盘面内容正确、lost 全程 0。
 *
 * 编译：cl /nologo /O2 /W4 /utf-8 /I. test_discard_clean.c cache.c
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define DISKSZ   (4u * 1024u * 1024u)
#define BLK      4096u
#define CHUNK    65536u

static unsigned char g_disk[DISKSZ];
static int g_fail_inject;          /* 1 = 下层 writeback 失败 */
static int g_fail;

#define CHECK(c, ...) do { if(!(c)){ printf("  [FAIL] "); printf(__VA_ARGS__); \
                            printf("\n"); g_fail++; } \
                          else { printf("  [ok]   "); printf(__VA_ARGS__); \
                            printf("\n"); } } while(0)

static int wb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *b, size_t n)
{
    (void)u; (void)fid;
    if (off + n > DISKSZ) return -1;
    if (g_fail_inject) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, b, n);
    return 0;
}

static int rb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n)
{
    (void)u; (void)fid;
    if (off + n > DISKSZ) return -1;
    memcpy(b, g_disk + off, n);
    return 0;
}

static void fill(unsigned char *p, size_t n, unsigned char v)
{
    memset(p, v, n);
}

int main(void)
{
    rb_config cfg;
    rb_engine *eng;
    rb_stream *s;
    rb_stats st;
    rb_direct_range miss[16];
    int mc;
    unsigned char buf[BLK];
    unsigned char out[CHUNK];
    int i;

    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes  = 1024u * 1024u;
    cfg.block_size = BLK;
    cfg.writeback  = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback   = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    CHECK(eng != NULL, "engine created");
    if (!eng) return 1;
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0x1234);
    CHECK(s != NULL, "stream created");
    if (!s) { rb_engine_destroy(eng); return 1; }

    /* ---- 预置盘面：chunk0 / chunk1 全 0x11 ---- */
    fill(g_disk, 2u * CHUNK, 0x11);

    /* 读入两个 chunk（干净、全 loaded） */
    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int hit = rb_read(s, (rb_u64)i * CHUNK, out, CHUNK, miss, &mc, 16);
        if (hit == 0) {                     /* 全 miss：按驱动行为回填 */
            memcpy(out + 0, g_disk + (rb_u64)i * CHUNK, CHUNK);
            rb_read_commit(s, (rb_u64)i * CHUNK, out, CHUNK);
        }
    }
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes == 2u * CHUNK && st.dirty_bytes == 0,
          "pre: two clean chunks cached (cur=%llu dirty=%llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.cur_bytes, (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);

    /* chunk0 盘面被外部改写（模拟离场期直写）；chunk1 的 sub1 也被改写 */
    fill(g_disk + 0u * CHUNK, CHUNK, 0x22);
    fill(g_disk + 1u * CHUNK + BLK, BLK, 0x33);

    /* chunk1 的 sub0 写脏（只脏 4K，其余 15 个子块仍是干净已加载） */
    fill(buf, BLK, 0x44);
    {
        rb_direct_range d[16]; int dc = 0;
        int r = rb_write(s, 1u * CHUNK, buf, BLK, d, &dc, 16);
        CHECK(r == 0, "write dirty sub0 of chunk1 (rc=%d)", r);
    }
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == BLK, "pre: dirty=%llu (expect 4096)",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);

    /* ---- 核心动作 ---- */
    rb_stream_discard_clean(s);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0, "A: lost_dirty_bytes == 0 (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == BLK, "B: dirty retained 4096 (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes == CHUNK && st.chunk_count == 1,
          "A: clean chunk destroyed, one chunk kept (cur=%llu chunks=%llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.cur_bytes,
          (unsigned long long)st.chunk_count);

    /* 脏子块：命中且内容 = 0x44 */
    fill(out, BLK, 0xAA);
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 1u * CHUNK, out, BLK, miss, &mc, 16) == 1,
          "B: dirty sub0 read hits cache");
    CHECK(out[0] == 0x44 && out[BLK - 1] == 0x44,
          "B: dirty sub0 content = 0x44 (got 0x%02x)", out[0]);

    /* 同 chunk 干净子块：必须 miss（loaded 已清）——若仍命中说明清理不彻底 */
    fill(out, BLK, 0xAA);
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 1u * CHUNK + BLK, out, BLK, miss, &mc, 16) == 0,
          "C: clean sub1 in dirty chunk is a MISS (stale view dropped)");
    CHECK(out[0] == 0xAA, "C: miss leaves caller buffer untouched (got 0x%02x)",
          out[0]);
    CHECK(g_disk[1u * CHUNK + BLK] == 0x33,
          "C: disk still holds external 0x33 (got 0x%02x)",
          g_disk[1u * CHUNK + BLK]);

    /* 被销毁的 chunk0：读 miss，盘面内容是外部改写的 0x22 */
    fill(out, BLK, 0xAA);
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 0, out, BLK, miss, &mc, 16) == 0,
          "A: dropped clean chunk0 reads MISS");
    CHECK(g_disk[0] == 0x22, "A: chunk0 disk = external 0x22 (got 0x%02x)",
          g_disk[0]);

    /* ---- D: 下层写失败 -> 脏保留；恢复后 flush 收敛 ---- */
    g_fail_inject = 1;
    (void)rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == BLK && st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0,
          "D: failed flush keeps dirty, lost stays 0 (dirty=%llu lost=%llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes,
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
    rb_stream_discard_clean(s);           /* 再次调用也不得丢脏 */
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == BLK && st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0,
          "D: discard_clean after failed flush still data-safe (dirty=%llu lost=%llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes,
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    g_fail_inject = 0;
    (void)rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "D: flush after recovery clears dirty (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0, "D: lost_dirty_bytes still 0 (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(g_disk[1u * CHUNK] == 0x44,
          "D: dirty sub0 landed on disk = 0x44 (got 0x%02x)",
          g_disk[1u * CHUNK]);

    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
    printf("RESULT: %s (%d failures)\n", g_fail ? "FAIL" : "PASS", g_fail);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_evict_wire.c`

````c
/*
 * test_evict_wire.c —— 淘汰接线（RB_WIRED_L2_ON_EVICT=1）数据完整性测试
 *
 * 背景（PRD-01 FR-L2-01 / 设计决策 D1-D3）：core evict_victim 经 5 参钩子
 * RbFeatOnEvict(Ext, LbaBytes, Len, SrcVa, Hits) 向特性层报告"淘汰了什么"，
 * 时序为 stripe 锁内捕获 -> 锁外回调 -> 回调返回后才释放 chunk 数据。
 * 本测试在用户态复刻该链路，验证 core 侧契约：
 *   ① 捕获快照字节 == 事先写入该 LBA 的已知模式（"存什么=淘汰了什么"）；
 *   ② Len == chunk_size（4096x16 = 64KB）；
 *   ③ Ext == (PVOID)(uintptr_t)stream->file_id；
 *   ④ Hits == 对该 chunk 执行的 rb_read 命中次数（D2：fill/commit 不计）；
 *   ⑤ 同一 LBA 一次测试阶段内不重复捕获；
 *   ⑥ 脏块场景：rb_write 制造脏块后施压，flush 前该 LBA 不被捕获；
 *   ⑦ 命中路径正确递增 hits（fill 后读 N 次命中 -> 淘汰捕获 Hits==N）。
 *
 * 编译单元 = test_evict_wire.c + cache.c，cache.c 以 /DRB_EVICT_HOOK_EXTERNAL
 * 编译（抑制其用户态默认空桩），由本文件提供捕获桩。
 */

#include "../../src/core/cache.h"
#include "../../src/common/rb_wiring.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#if !RB_WIRED_L2_ON_EVICT
#error "test_evict_wire requires RB_WIRED_L2_ON_EVICT=1 (wiring flipped in rb_wiring.h)"
#endif

#define DISK_SIZE (32u * 1024u * 1024u)
#define CHUNK     (64u * 1024u)          /* 默认几何 4096 x 16 */
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static int g_fail = 0;

#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); g_fail++; } \
    else { printf("  [ok]   " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); } \
} while (0)

static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(buf, g_disk + off, len);
    return 0;
}
static void fill_pattern(unsigned char *p, size_t n, rb_u64 base)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = (unsigned char)((base + i) * 31u + 7u);
}

/* ---- 淘汰钩子捕获桩（core evict_victim 锁外回调；5 参契约 D1） ---- */
#define EW_MAX_CAP 256
typedef struct {
    int     used;
    PVOID   Ext;
    ULONG64 Lba;
    ULONG   Len;
    ULONG64 Hits;
    unsigned char snap[CHUNK];
} EW_CAP;
static EW_CAP g_cap[EW_MAX_CAP];
static int    g_cap_n = 0;

#if RB_WIRED_L2_ON_EVICT
/* 整行定义以 void 开头（check_repo defn_re 豁免形态）；五参 + Src 前 Len 字节快照 */
void RbFeatOnEvict(PVOID Ext, ULONG64 LbaBytes, ULONG Len, PVOID SrcVa, ULONG64 Hits)
{
    if (g_cap_n < EW_MAX_CAP && SrcVa != NULL && Len <= sizeof(g_cap[0].snap)) {
        EW_CAP *e = &g_cap[g_cap_n++];
        e->used = 1; e->Ext = Ext; e->Lba = LbaBytes; e->Len = Len; e->Hits = Hits;
        memcpy(e->snap, SrcVa, (size_t)Len);
    }
}
#endif

static EW_CAP *ew_find(ULONG64 lba)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < g_cap_n; i++)
        if (g_cap[i].used && g_cap[i].Lba == lba) return &g_cap[i];
    return NULL;
}
static int ew_count_lba(ULONG64 lba)
{
    int i, n = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < g_cap_n; i++)
        if (g_cap[i].used && g_cap[i].Lba == lba) n++;
    return n;
}

/* 辅助：执行 miss 直读（模拟驱动：读入临时 buffer -> commit -> 交集拷给用户） */
static void do_miss_read(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 req_off, void *buf, size_t req_len,
                         rb_direct_range *miss, int mc)
{
    int k;
    rb_u64 req_end = req_off + req_len;
    for (k = 0; k < mc; k++) {
        unsigned char *tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(miss[k].len);
        rb_u64 ms_end = miss[k].offset + miss[k].len;
        memcpy(tmp, g_disk + miss[k].offset, miss[k].len);
        rb_read_commit(s, miss[k].offset, tmp, miss[k].len);
        {
            rb_u64 lo = (miss[k].offset > req_off) ? miss[k].offset : req_off;
            rb_u64 hi = (ms_end < req_end) ? ms_end : req_end;
            if (hi > lo)
                memcpy((unsigned char *)buf + (size_t)(lo - req_off),
                       tmp + (size_t)(lo - miss[k].offset), (size_t)(hi - lo));
        }
        free(tmp);
    }
}

/* 读入一个整 chunk（miss -> commit -> 入缓存）；hit_reads=额外命中读次数 */
static void read_chunk(rb_engine *eng, rb_stream *s, rb_u64 chunk_idx, int hit_reads)
{
    static unsigned char buf[CHUNK];
    rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    rb_u64 off = chunk_idx * CHUNK;
    int i;
    fill_pattern(g_disk + off, CHUNK, off);
    rb_engine_tick(eng, 1000 + chunk_idx);
    rb_read(s, off, buf, CHUNK, miss, &mc, 16);
    do_miss_read(s, off, buf, CHUNK, miss, mc);
    for (i = 0; i < hit_reads; i++) {
        rb_engine_tick(eng, 100000 + chunk_idx * 16 + i);
        rb_read(s, off, buf, CHUNK, miss, &mc, 16);
    }
}

/* ============ 用例1：契约 + 数据完整性 + Hits 语义 + 不重复捕获 ============ */
static void test_evict_contract(void)
{
    printf("== 用例1: 淘汰接线契约（5参/Len/Ext/Hits/快照/不重复） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 2ull * 1024 * 1024;      /* evict_low=1.2MB / evict_high=1.6MB */
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0x5EEDu);   /* file_id 哨兵 */

    g_cap_n = 0;

    /* 阶段A：前 8 个 chunk 入缓存（512KB < 高水位，不触发淘汰）。
     * chunk1/2/3 分别追加 1/2/3 次命中读（fill 不计，D2）。 */
    read_chunk(eng, s, 0, 0);
    read_chunk(eng, s, 1, 1);
    read_chunk(eng, s, 2, 2);
    read_chunk(eng, s, 3, 3);
    read_chunk(eng, s, 4, 0);
    read_chunk(eng, s, 5, 0);
    read_chunk(eng, s, 6, 0);
    read_chunk(eng, s, 7, 0);
    CHECK(g_cap_n == 0, "阶段A（低于高水位）无淘汰捕获");

    /* 阶段B：继续读入 chunk 8..39，跨水位触发多轮回收，淘汰最旧的干净块 */
    {
        rb_u64 k;
        for (k = 8; k < 40; k++) read_chunk(eng, s, k, 0);
    }
    CHECK(g_cap_n > 0, "阶段B发生淘汰捕获（n=%d）", g_cap_n);

    /* ② Len == chunk_size；③ Ext == file_id；⑤ 同一 LBA 不重复捕获 */
    {
        int i, bad_len = 0, bad_ext = 0, dup = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < g_cap_n; i++) {
            if (g_cap[i].Len != CHUNK) bad_len++;
            if (g_cap[i].Ext != (PVOID)(uintptr_t)0x5EEDu) bad_ext++;
            if (ew_count_lba(g_cap[i].Lba) != 1) dup++;
        }
        CHECK(bad_len == 0, "② 全部捕获 Len==chunk_size(64KB)（违例 %d）", bad_len);
        CHECK(bad_ext == 0, "③ 全部捕获 Ext==(PVOID)file_id（违例 %d）", bad_ext);
        CHECK(dup == 0, "⑤ 同一 LBA 无重复捕获（违例 %d）", dup);
    }

    /* ① 快照 == 事先写入该 LBA 的已知模式；④ Hits == 命中读次数 */
    {
        int i, bad_snap = 0;
        static unsigned char expect[CHUNK];
        for (i = 0; i < g_cap_n; i++) {
            ULONG64 lba = g_cap[i].Lba;
            if (lba % CHUNK) { bad_snap++; continue; }
            fill_pattern(expect, CHUNK, lba);
            if (memcmp(expect, g_cap[i].snap, CHUNK) != 0) bad_snap++;
        }
        CHECK(bad_snap == 0, "① 捕获快照与写入模式逐字节一致（违例 %d）", bad_snap);
    }
    {
        EW_CAP *e;
        e = ew_find(0 * CHUNK); if (e) CHECK(e->Hits == 0, "④ chunk0 fill-only -> Hits==0（got %llu）", (unsigned long long)e->Hits); else CHECK(0, "chunk0 应被淘汰捕获");
        e = ew_find(1 * CHUNK); if (e) CHECK(e->Hits == 1, "⑦ chunk1 fill+1命中 -> Hits==1（got %llu）", (unsigned long long)e->Hits); else CHECK(0, "chunk1 应被淘汰捕获");
        e = ew_find(2 * CHUNK); if (e) CHECK(e->Hits == 2, "⑦ chunk2 fill+2命中 -> Hits==2（got %llu）", (unsigned long long)e->Hits); else CHECK(0, "chunk2 应被淘汰捕获");
        e = ew_find(3 * CHUNK); if (e) CHECK(e->Hits == 3, "⑦ chunk3 fill+3命中 -> Hits==3（got %llu）", (unsigned long long)e->Hits); else CHECK(0, "chunk3 应被淘汰捕获");
    }

    /* 收尾前把剩余数据回写，验证缓存语义未被接线破坏 */
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    {
        rb_u64 k; int bad = 0;
        static unsigned char expect[CHUNK];
        for (k = 0; k < 40; k++) {
            fill_pattern(expect, CHUNK, k * CHUNK);
            if (memcmp(g_disk + k * CHUNK, expect, CHUNK) != 0) bad++;
        }
        CHECK(bad == 0, "回写后磁盘 40 个 chunk 数据逐字节一致（违例 %d）", bad);
    }
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 用例2：脏块 flush 前不被捕获，flush 后可捕获 ============ */
static void test_dirty_not_captured(void)
{
    printf("== 用例2: 脏块保护（flush 前不捕获 / flush 后可捕获） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 2ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xAB21u);

    g_cap_n = 0;

    /* chunk0：干净填充（读盘入缓存） */
    read_chunk(eng, s, 0, 0);
    /* chunk1：整块脏写（full cover -> 全部入缓存为脏，无 direct） */
    {
        static unsigned char w[CHUNK];
        rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
        fill_pattern(w, CHUNK, 0xD17);
        rb_write(s, 1 * CHUNK, w, CHUNK, direct, &dc, 16);
        CHECK(dc == 0, "脏写整块入缓存（无 direct）");
    }

    /* 施压：读入 chunk 2..40 触发回收。脏块不在 LRU 上，永不被 evict_victim 选中 */
    {
        rb_u64 k;
        for (k = 2; k < 41; k++) read_chunk(eng, s, k, 0);
    }
    CHECK(g_cap_n > 0, "施压发生淘汰捕获（n=%d）", g_cap_n);
    CHECK(ew_find(1 * CHUNK) == NULL, "⑥ 脏块 LBA 在 flush 前不被捕获");

    /* flush：脏块落盘转干净；继续施压 -> 可被淘汰 -> 捕获存在且快照==写入数据 */
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    {
        rb_u64 k;
        for (k = 41; k < 80; k++) read_chunk(eng, s, k, 0);
    }
    {
        EW_CAP *e = ew_find(1 * CHUNK);
        static unsigned char expect[CHUNK];
        fill_pattern(expect, CHUNK, 0xD17);
        CHECK(e != NULL, "flush 后脏块转干净可被淘汰捕获");
        if (e) {
            CHECK(e->Len == CHUNK, "脏块捕获 Len==chunk_size");
            CHECK(e->Ext == (PVOID)(uintptr_t)0xAB21u, "脏块捕获 Ext==file_id");
            CHECK(e->Hits == 0, "脏块未经读命中 -> Hits==0（got %llu）", (unsigned long long)e->Hits);
            CHECK(memcmp(expect, e->snap, CHUNK) == 0, "脏块捕获快照==脏写数据（存什么=淘汰了什么）");
        }
    }

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

int main(void)
{
    g_disk = (unsigned char *)malloc(DISK_SIZE);
    if (!g_disk) { printf("无法分配模拟磁盘\n"); return 1; }
    memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);

    test_evict_contract();
    test_dirty_not_captured();

    printf("\n%s  (失败 %d)\n", g_fail ? "存在失败用例" : "全部用例通过", g_fail);
    free(g_disk);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

````c
/*
 * test_exclude.c -- [OPT-EXCL 2026-11-01] LBA 排除集（临时文件/软件缓存不占缓存）
 *
 * 契约（cache.h rb_stream_set_exclude 注释）：
 *   1) 命中排除区间的写一律走 direct（不进缓存、不产生脏数据、不占内存）
 *   2) 命中排除区间的读不再回填（否则读一遍就永久占住内存）
 *   3) 设置排除集时：先 force flush 已缓存的脏数据，再失效区间内的块
 *      —— 任何已 ack 的脏数据都不得因"改成不缓存"而丢失
 *   4) 区间排序/合并；清空后恢复原行为
 *
 * 模拟盘：g_disk；direct 区间由调用方（模拟驱动）直写盘面。
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>

#define DISK_SIZE (64u * 1024u * 1024u)
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static int g_fail = 0;

static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(buf, g_disk + off, len);
    return 0;
}

#define CHECK(cond, msg) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] %s\n", msg); g_fail++; } \
    else { printf("  [ok]   %s\n", msg); } \
} while (0)

static void fill_pattern(unsigned char *p, size_t n, rb_u64 base)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = (unsigned char)((base + i) * 31u + 7u);
}

/* 模拟驱动：把 direct 区间镜像落盘 */
static void apply_direct(rb_u64 base_off, const unsigned char *src, size_t len,
                         rb_direct_range *d, int dc)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < dc; i++) {
        rb_u64 o = d[i].offset, e = o + d[i].len;
        if (o < base_off) o = base_off;
        if (e > base_off + len) e = base_off + len;
        if (e > o) memcpy(g_disk + o, src + (o - base_off), (size_t)(e - o));
    }
}

static rb_engine *mk_engine(void)
{
    rb_config cfg;
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback  = rb_fn;
    return rb_engine_create(&cfg);
}

/* ---------- 用例 ---------- */

static void test_write_bypass(void)
{
    printf("== 用例1: 排除区间的写不进缓存（不占内存/不产生脏数据） ==\n");
    rb_engine *eng = mk_engine();
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 1);
    rb_extent ex[1];
    rb_stats st;
    unsigned char *w = (unsigned char *)malloc(128 * 1024);
    rb_direct_range d[64]; int dc = 0;

    fill_pattern(w, 128 * 1024, 0x1000);
    ex[0].start = 0; ex[0].len = 128 * 1024;
    CHECK(rb_stream_set_exclude(s, ex, 1) == 1, "排除集生效（1 条）");

    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, w, 128 * 1024, d, &dc, 64) == 0, "排除区间写返回成功");
    CHECK(dc > 0, "整段以 direct 区间返回（由驱动直写下盘）");
    apply_direct(0, w, 128 * 1024, d, dc);

    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 0, "未创建任何 chunk（零内存占用）");
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes == 0, "缓存占用 0 字节");
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "无脏数据（因此未来也不会有回写）");
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, w, 128 * 1024) == 0, "数据已完整落盘，内容正确");

    { rb_u64 b = 0, o = 0; rb_engine_get_excl_bypass(eng, &b, &o);
      CHECK(b == 128 * 1024 && o > 0, "绕过统计如实记账"); }

    free(w); rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_normal_still_cached(void)
{
    printf("== 用例2: 未命中排除集的区间照常缓存 ==\n");
    rb_engine *eng = mk_engine();
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 2);
    rb_extent ex[1];
    rb_stats st;
    unsigned char w[64 * 1024];
    rb_direct_range d[16]; int dc = 0;

    ex[0].start = 0; ex[0].len = 64 * 1024;
    rb_stream_set_exclude(s, ex, 1);
    fill_pattern(w, sizeof(w), 0x2000);
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 1024 * 1024, w, sizeof(w), d, &dc, 16) == 0, "排除区外写入成功");
    CHECK(dc == 0, "全额被缓存吸收（无 direct）");
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 1 && st.dirty_bytes == 64 * 1024, "块已建、脏量正确");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_set_purges_clean(void)
{
    printf("== 用例3: 设置排除集后，区间内已缓存的干净块被释放 ==\n");
    rb_engine *eng = mk_engine();
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 3);
    rb_extent ex[1];
    rb_stats st;
    unsigned char w[64 * 1024];
    rb_direct_range d[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    unsigned char *out = (unsigned char *)malloc(64 * 1024);

    fill_pattern(w, sizeof(w), 0x3000);
    rb_write(s, 0, w, sizeof(w), d, &dc, 16);
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);                       /* 变干净后再排除 */
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 1 && st.dirty_bytes == 0, "前置：1 个干净块已缓存");

    ex[0].start = 0; ex[0].len = 64 * 1024;
    rb_stream_set_exclude(s, ex, 1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 0, "排除区间内的块被立即释放（内存归还）");
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes == 0, "占用归零");

    /* 读该区间：应当 miss 且不再回填 */
    mc = 0;
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 0, out, 4096, miss, &mc, 16) == 0, "排除区间读 miss（不再缓存）");
    rb_read_commit(s, miss[0].offset, g_disk + miss[0].offset, 4096);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 0, "回填请求被拒（读也不占内存）");
    free(out); rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_set_flushes_dirty(void)
{
    printf("== 用例4: 设置排除集前先把脏数据落盘（已 ack 数据不丢） ==\n");
    rb_engine *eng = mk_engine();
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 4);
    rb_extent ex[1];
    rb_stats st;
    unsigned char w[64 * 1024];
    rb_direct_range d[16]; int dc = 0;

    fill_pattern(w, sizeof(w), 0x4400);
    memset(g_disk, 0, 64 * 1024);
    rb_write(s, 0, w, sizeof(w), d, &dc, 16);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 64 * 1024, "前置：64KiB 脏数据仅在内存");

    ex[0].start = 0; ex[0].len = 64 * 1024;
    rb_stream_set_exclude(s, ex, 1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, w, 64 * 1024) == 0, "排除前已落盘，盘面数据 == 内存新数据");
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "脏量归零");
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0, "未发生任何丢失记账");
    CHECK(st.wb_bytes >= 64 * 1024, "回写统计如实增长");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_merge_and_clear(void)
{
    printf("== 用例5: 区间乱序/重叠自动排序合并；清空恢复 ==\n");
    rb_engine *eng = mk_engine();
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 5);
    rb_extent in[4], out[8];
    int n;

    in[0].start = 128 * 1024; in[0].len = 64 * 1024;   /* 乱序 */
    in[1].start = 0;          in[1].len = 64 * 1024;
    in[2].start = 32 * 1024;  in[2].len = 64 * 1024;   /* 与 [0,64K) 重叠 */
    in[3].start = 4096;       in[3].len = 0;           /* 空区间被丢弃 */
    n = rb_stream_set_exclude(s, in, 4);
    CHECK(n == 2, "4 条输入合并为 2 条");
    n = rb_stream_get_exclude(s, out, 8);
    CHECK(n == 2, "读回 2 条");
    CHECK(out[0].start == 0 && out[0].len == 96 * 1024, "首条合并为 [0,96K)");
    CHECK(out[1].start == 128 * 1024 && out[1].len == 64 * 1024, "次条保持 [128K,192K)");

    CHECK(rb_stream_set_exclude(s, NULL, 0) == 0, "清空排除集");
    CHECK(rb_stream_get_exclude(s, out, 8) == 0, "读回 0 条");

    {   /* 清空后该区间恢复缓存 */
        unsigned char w[64 * 1024];
        rb_direct_range d[16]; int dc = 0;
        rb_stats st;
        fill_pattern(w, sizeof(w), 0x5500);
        rb_write(s, 0, w, sizeof(w), d, &dc, 16);
        rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
        CHECK(dc == 0 && st.chunk_count == 1, "排除集清空后区间恢复缓存");
    }
    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

static void test_partial_overlap(void)
{
    printf("== 用例6: 跨边界写——只有排除部分走直写，其余仍缓存 ==\n");
    rb_engine *eng = mk_engine();
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 6);
    rb_extent ex[1];
    rb_stats st;
    unsigned char w[64 * 1024];
    rb_direct_range d[16]; int dc = 0;

    ex[0].start = 0; ex[0].len = 32 * 1024;      /* 前 8 个子块排除 */
    rb_stream_set_exclude(s, ex, 1);
    fill_pattern(w, sizeof(w), 0x6600);
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, w, sizeof(w), d, &dc, 16) == 0, "跨边界写成功");
    CHECK(dc >= 1 && d[0].offset == 0 && d[0].len == 32 * 1024, "direct 区间 = 排除段");
    apply_direct(0, w, sizeof(w), d, dc);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 32 * 1024, "仅未排除的一半进缓存（脏量 32KiB）");
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 1, "一个块承载未排除部分");
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, w, 32 * 1024) == 0, "排除段已直写落盘");

    /* 缓存里的另一半回写后盘面应完整正确 */
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, w, sizeof(w)) == 0, "回写后整块盘面数据完整正确");
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "回写后脏量归零");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

int main(void)
{
    g_disk = (unsigned char *)calloc(1, DISK_SIZE);
    if (!g_disk) { printf("alloc fail\n"); return 2; }

    test_write_bypass();
    test_normal_still_cached();
    test_set_purges_clean();
    test_set_flushes_dirty();
    test_merge_and_clear();
    test_partial_overlap();

    free(g_disk);
    printf("\n%s (fail=%d)\n", g_fail ? "EXCLUDE TEST FAILED" : "EXCLUDE TEST PASSED", g_fail);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_flush_many.c`

````c
/* R7 回归：600 流各写 1 脏块，force flush 后脏必须归零(不得丢流)。 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define NSTR 600
static unsigned char disk[1<<23];
static int wb(void*u,rb_u64 f,rb_u64 o,const void*d,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)f; if(o+n>sizeof disk) return -1; memcpy(disk+o,d,n); return 0; }
int main(void){
    rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof c);
    c.max_bytes=256ull*1024*1024; c.writeback=wb; c.block_size=4096;
    rb_engine*e=rb_engine_create(&c);
    rb_stream*ss[NSTR]; int i,bad=0;
    for(i=0;i<NSTR;i++){
        unsigned char blk[4096];
        rb_direct_range dr[2]; int dc=0;
        ss[i]=rb_stream_create(e,(rb_u64)(i+1));
        memset(blk,'A'+(i%26),sizeof blk);
        rb_write(ss[i],(rb_u64)i*4096,blk,sizeof blk,dr,&dc,2);
    }
    { rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
      if(st.dirty_bytes<(rb_u64)NSTR*4096){ printf("[FAIL] 预写脏不足\n"); bad=1; } }
    rb_engine_flush(e,1);
    { rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
      if(st.dirty_bytes!=0){ printf("[FAIL] %d 流 force flush 后脏=%llu(丢流)\n",
          NSTR,(unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes); bad=1; }
      else printf("[ok] %d 流 force flush 全覆盖, 脏=0\n",NSTR); }
    for(i=0;i<NSTR;i++) rb_stream_destroy(ss[i]);
    rb_engine_destroy(e);
    printf(bad?"test_flush_many: FAIL\n":"test_flush_many: PASS\n");
    return bad;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_flushpar.c`

````c
/*
 * test_flushpar.c -- [ParallelFlush QA 2026-11-06] 分片并行回写「路数可配」回归
 *
 * 目的（用户口径：「先确认简单速度，然后保证不丢数据、不出问题」）：
 *   把 core 的 zone-parallel 回写入口 rb_stream_flush_zoned(s,zone_sel,nzones,ws)
 *   按 1/2/4/8/16 路参数化，每路一个线程、处理互不重叠的 zone 集合
 *   （core 内部分区：zone_of(c->start) % nzones == zone_sel，见 cache.c
 *   flush_pass），并发写者 + 周期性 zoned flush + 收尾全盘逐字节比对。
 *
 * 用法：test_flushpar [lanes 1|2|4|8|16] [rounds] [seed] [block_size]
 *   · 无 argv[1]  -> 依次跑 1/2/4/8/16 五档（全量回归的免参数门禁姿态）；
 *   · argv[2]     -> 迭代轮数（默认 6，同时参与作业/写次数计算）；
 *   · argv[3]     -> 随机种子（默认 20261106，失败可复现）；
 *   · argv[4]     -> BlockSize 几何（默认 4096；合法值仅 4096/8192/16384/32768，
 *                    与 cache.c:264 的 legal[] 白名单一致）。非法值 fail-closed
 *                    直接报错退出，绝不静默回落 4096 —— 产品 rb_engine_create
 *                    对非法值是「静默回落 4096」（cache.c:267），测试侧必须
 *                    在 create 之前先行拦截，否则「跑 8192」其实跑的是 4096。
 *   每档固定跑 8 个组合：track{concurrent,sentinel} x phase{full,sparse}
 *   x cfg{write-back,write-through}，任一组合 FAIL -> 进程退出码 1。
 *
 * ── 几何参数化（[72] 2026-11-06）────────────────────────────────────────
 *   所有派生量随 block_size 联动，4K 取值与中午 63 号硬编码逐字相同：
 *     SUB        = block_size
 *     CHUNK      = block_size * 16                 (= cache.c eng->chunk_size)
 *     WSPAN_B    = 4 * CHUNK                      (= 64 * SUB，固定每 zone 4 chunk)
 *     TAIL       = block_size - 3                 (= 4093 @4K，卷尾非对齐注入)
 *     WSPAN_A    = WSPAN_B + TAIL
 *     LCM(4096, block_size) = block_size（白名单均为 4096 的整数倍）
 *     WINCAP     = ceil(WSPAN_A / LCM) * LCM      (= 65 * block_size)
 *                 恰好容纳「末子块 RMW 补读」：readback 在 WSPAN_B 处补读
 *                 整整 block_size 字节 -> WSPAN_B + block_size == WINCAP。
 *     WRITE_CAP_A= 3 * CHUNK + 8192               (= 200KB @4K，跨 chunk 上限)
 *   zone_of(off) = off >> 28（256MB/zone）：WINCAP 最大 65*32768 = 2,129,920 B
 *   (~2.03MB) 远小于 256MB，任意写区间 / RMW 补读 / 回写回调都既不越 zone
 *   边界也不越窗口缓冲；truncate 尺寸 VOL_TOP = 4GB 是全部合法 block_size
 *   的整数倍，不触发 cache.c:1219 的尾部清零分支。
 *   双轨 oracle 语义不变：轨道 B 未落盘字节仍残留哨兵、wb_fn 逐字节校验仍
 *   能抓静默写坏 / 陈旧 / 错偏移；不弱化任何断言。
 *
 * ── 双轨口径（为什么是两条轨道）──────────────────────────────────────────
 * 轨道 A「concurrent」：盘面初值 = f(off)（沿用 test_wsconc overlap/wb_fn 的
 *   确定性 oracle：盘面字节 = f(off)，任意写交错收敛同一字节）。写者产生
 *   随机、重叠、非 4KB 对齐、跨 chunk 边界、卷尾非对齐的写；小缓存强制驱逐，
 *   与 zoned 回写交织。落盘前 wb_fn 逐字节校验 b[i]==f(off+i)：任何非 f 值
 *   （零数据 / RB_POISON 毒化残留 / 缓存内陈旧副本）落盘即硬失败并打印现场。
 *   该轨道的价值 = 抓静默写坏、竞态、分片漏刷、记账漂移（与永久回归网同款）。
 *   局限（同 test_wsconc overlap）：初值=f 时「丢写」在盘面上不可见 —— 故补轨道 B。
 *
 * 轨道 B「sentinel」：盘面初值 = sent(off) != f(off)（哨兵）。写者写 f(off)，
 *   写区间按 4KB 子块对齐（避免 RMW 补读把哨兵混进落盘段造成 oracle 误报），
 *   用打乱的确定性作业序列保证每个 active zone 的每个 chunk 都被覆盖；
 *   收尾要求应写区逐字节 = f(off) —— 任何未落盘 / 丢写的字节保持哨兵，
 *   memcmp 立即失败。该轨道的价值 = 真正抓「零丢失」。
 *
 * ── 覆盖项 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *   · chunk 边界   : 轨道 A 非对齐起点 + 随机长；轨道 B 写长 1~3 个 64KB chunk；
 *   · 卷尾非对齐   : 轨道 A 应写区 WSPAN_A 非 block_size 对齐，注入卷尾
 *                    (block_size-3)B 写（4K 时 = 4093B），触发末子块 RMW；
 *   · 重叠写       : 多写者共享作业序列（轨道 B 每 chunk 每轮重写一次）+
 *                    轨道 A 随机区域可重叠；数据确定性 f(off) 保证收敛；
 *   · 失效/truncate: 写者周期性触发 rb_stream_invalidate_range（先镜像后失效，
 *                    驱动「直写成功后失效旧副本」同款纪律，superseded=1）与
 *                    rb_stream_truncate(VOL_TOP)（尺寸 >= 所有 chunk start，
 *                    只 bump 视图世代 + 收敛回写，不丢任何 chunk / 不清零）；
 *   · 两种 cfg     : cfg=0 写回（吸收 -> zoned 回写）；cfg=1 直写
 *                    （rb_stream_set_exclude 覆盖窗口 -> rb_write 返回 direct
 *                    区间 -> 测试侧整段镜像 + 失效，不产生脏、不产生回写）；
 *                    core 无显式 write-through cfg 开关，此为用户态等价建模，
 *                    不代表驱动配置面（报告如实披露）。
 *   · 空 zone      : sparse 阶段 active_zones=min(lanes,3)，lanes>3 时
 *                    多数路 zone 集合为空；断言 dirty/lost=0 + 全盘一致 =
 *                    空路不丢作业。
 *
 * ── 断言（每个组合）──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *   零丢失         : lost_dirty_bytes==0、dirty_bytes==0、has_dirty==0、
 *                    轨道 B 应写区全盘 == f(off)；
 *   零静默写坏     : wb_fn 落盘前 oracle 违反计数 wb_bad==0（违反即拒绝落盘）；
 *   零重复落盘计数错: wb_flush<=wb_calls、wb_bytes<=wb_bytes(回调实测量)、
 *                    wb_bytes%block_size==0；cfg=1 时 wb_flush/wb_calls 必须为 0；
 *   链表净         : rb_stream_destroy 后 chunk_count==0。
 *   失败现场打印首个坏偏移、期望/实际、路数、种子、track/phase/cfg（可复现）。
 *
 * ── 吞吐口径（重要限制）──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *   每路统计 rb_stream_flush_zoned 返回的落盘字节、pass 次数与实际忙时
 *   （QueryPerformanceCounter，不含让出核的 sleep），输出 MB/s；总耗时为
 *   该组合线程启动到收尾净帧的 wall time。
 *   【[72] 本轮环境：Verifier 已关闭（VerifyDrivers 空 / verifier /query
 *     "No drivers are currently verified."），用户自述已切性能模式，但
 *     powercfg /getactivescheme 仍显示「平衡」；两条如实并列记录。
 *     任何 thr 数字仍只是同条件相对粗测：用户态 memcpy 模拟盘、无真实块
 *     设备时延、短窗口下 lane 可能空转 —— 不作峰值宣称。】
 *   程序输出首行在「免第 4 参」默认姿态下保留 63 号的历史 NOTE 逐字不变
 *   （供与中午基线 A/B 等价取证）；显式传几何时改写为本轮真实环境口径。
 *
 * 纯 C，仅使用 cache.h 公开 API + 仓库既有 pthread.h/unistd.h shim；
 * 不新增生产面 API，不修改 cache.c/cache.h。编译单元 = test_flushpar.c + cache.c。
 * 可选增强：/DRB_POISON_NEW_CHUNKS=1（cache.c 新块填 0xA5）可把未初始化字节
 * 落盘变成确定性失败；本轮按最小改动原则未在构建脚本启用，见 QA 报告。
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
/* 不使用 <stdatomic.h>：本机 MSVC 14.44 的实现对 atomic_int 的
 * atomic_load 返回 64 位（/W4 C4244），且不提供 atomic_uint_least64_t。
 * 全部改用 windows.h 的 Interlocked*（pthread.h shim 已引入）。 */

/* ------------------------------ 几何 ------------------------------ */
#define NZ_MAX        16                     /* 支持到 16 路，每路可独占一个 zone */
#define ZSHIFT        28ull                 /* 与 cache.c RB_ZONE_SHIFT 一致：256MB/zone */
#define ZSPAN         (1ull << ZSHIFT)
#define VOL_TOP       ((rb_u64)NZ_MAX << ZSHIFT)   /* 4GB 逻辑卷顶：truncate 安全尺寸 */
#define NCH_PER_ZONE  4ull                  /* 每 zone 的 chunk 数，固定（4K 时 = 4） */
#define NW            4                            /* 并发写者 */
#define MAXD          256                          /* direct 区间容量（>单写子块数） */
#define MAX_LANES     16
#define ROUNDS_DEF    6
#define SEED_DEF      20261106u
#define BS_DEF        4096u                        /* 默认几何：保证向后兼容 */
#define BS_MAX        32768u                       /* 白名单最大几何 */

/* 合法几何白名单（与 cache.c:264 legal[] = {4096,8192,16384,32768,65536} 一致；
 * 65536/131072 已在 F1 批次摘除，测试侧同样不得重新引入）。
 * 关键：cache.c rb_engine_create 对非法值【静默回落 4096】(cache.c:267)，
 * 故测试必须在 create 之前自行 fail-closed 校验，否则「跑 8192」实为跑 4096。 */
static int legal_block_size(unsigned long v)
{
    return v == 4096ul || v == 8192ul || v == 16384ul || v == 32768ul || v == 65536ul;   /* [64K-UNBAN] */
}

/* 运行期几何：main 解析 argv[4] 后一次性冻结，之后只读，无锁安全。
 * 4K 取值全部与 63 号硬编码逐字相同（见文件头「几何参数化」推导）。 */
typedef struct {
    rb_u32   bs;            /* block_size */
    rb_u64   sub;           /* = bs */
    rb_u64   chunk;         /* = bs * 16 = cache.c eng->chunk_size */
    rb_u64   wspan_b;       /* = NCH_PER_ZONE * chunk = 64 * bs */
    rb_u64   tail;          /* = bs - 3 (4093 @4K)，卷尾非对齐注入长度 */
    rb_u64   wspan_a;       /* = wspan_b + tail */
    rb_u64   align;         /* = lcm(4096, bs) = bs（白名单内） */
    rb_u64   wincap;        /* = ceil(wspan_a / align) * align = 65 * bs */
    size_t   write_cap_a;   /* = 3 * chunk + 8192 (200KB @4K) */
} Geom;
static Geom GEOM;
static int  G_geom_verbose = 0;   /* 显式传第 4 参时打印几何 + 引擎几何断言 */

static rb_u64 gcd_u64(rb_u64 a, rb_u64 b)
{
    while (b) { rb_u64 t = a % b; a = b; b = t; }
    return a;
}

static void geom_init(rb_u32 bs)
{
    GEOM.bs     = bs;
    GEOM.sub    = (rb_u64)bs;
    GEOM.chunk  = (rb_u64)bs * 16ull;                 /* = eng->chunk_size */
    GEOM.wspan_b= (rb_u64)NCH_PER_ZONE * GEOM.chunk;  /* = 64 * bs */
    GEOM.tail   = (rb_u64)bs - 3ull;                  /* 4093 @4K */
    GEOM.wspan_a= GEOM.wspan_b + GEOM.tail;
    /* 向上取整到 4096 与 block_size 的公倍数：合法 bs 均为 4096 整数倍，
     * 故 lcm == bs；仍显式求 gcd 表达意图，不依赖隐含前提。 */
    GEOM.align  = 4096ull / gcd_u64(4096ull, (rb_u64)bs) * (rb_u64)bs;
    GEOM.wincap = ((GEOM.wspan_a + GEOM.align - 1ull) / GEOM.align) * GEOM.align;
    GEOM.write_cap_a = (size_t)(3ull * GEOM.chunk + 8192ull);
}

/* oracle：与 test_wsconc wb_fn/pat 同源，盘面字节 = f(off) */
static unsigned char fpat(rb_u64 off) { return (unsigned char)(off * 131u + 7u); }
/* 轨道 B 哨兵：与 f 不同，把「未落盘」变成可观测值；避开 0xA5 毒化值语义 */
static unsigned char sent(rb_u64 off) { return (unsigned char)(fpat(off) ^ 0x3Cu); }

static unsigned nrand(unsigned *s) { *s = *s * 1103515245u + 12345u; return *s >> 1; }
static unsigned zid_of(rb_u64 off) { return (unsigned)(off >> ZSHIFT); }
static rb_u64   zbase_of(rb_u64 off) { return (off >> ZSHIFT) << ZSHIFT; }

/* ------------------------------ 计时 ------------------------------ */
static LARGE_INTEGER g_qpf;
static double now_ms(void)
{
    LARGE_INTEGER t;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t);
    return (double)t.QuadPart * 1000.0 / (double)g_qpf.QuadPart;
}

/* ------------------------------ run 上下文 ------------------------------ */
typedef struct {
    int      lanes, rounds;
    unsigned seed;
    int      track;         /* 0=concurrent(f 初值) 1=sentinel */
    int      phase;         /* 0=full 1=sparse */
    int      cfg;           /* 0=write-back 1=write-through(exclude) */
    int      active_zones;
    rb_u64   wspan;
    unsigned char *win[NZ_MAX];
    pthread_mutex_t zmx[NZ_MAX];
    rb_engine *eng;
    rb_stream *st;
    volatile LONG stop;
    volatile LONG job_idx;    /* track B job cursor */
    volatile LONG wcount;     /* track A write cursor */
    unsigned   *job_order;
    unsigned    job_total;
    unsigned    wtotal;
    unsigned char *meta_tmp;  /* 元数据事件临时缓冲（4*sub）；仅 wid==0 调用，独占 */
    /* 全局回调统计：用 cache.h 的 RB_AADD64/RB_ALOAD64（MSVC <stdatomic.h>
     * 不提供 atomic_uint_least64_t；该宏在 MSCV/gcc 分支均已定义） */
    volatile rb_i64 wb_calls, wb_bytes, mirror_bytes, wb_bad;
    volatile LONG printed;
    /* 每路统计（仅本路线程写，主线程 join 后读） */
    rb_u64  lane_bytes[MAX_LANES];
    rb_u64  lane_pass[MAX_LANES];
    double  lane_busy[MAX_LANES];
} RunCtx;

static RunCtx *G;   /* 当前 run（run 串行执行，回调只读） */

/* 落盘前 oracle 校验 + 落盘（core 的 writeback 回调，锁外调用） */
static int wb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *b, size_t n)
{
    RunCtx *c = G;
    const unsigned char *bb = (const unsigned char *)b;
    unsigned z = zid_of(off);
    rb_u64 w = off - zbase_of(off);
    size_t i;
    (void)u; (void)fid;

    if (z >= NZ_MAX || !c->win[z] || n == 0 || w + n > GEOM.wincap) {
        if (InterlockedExchangeAdd(&c->printed, 1) == 0)
            printf("  [FAIL] wb out-of-window: off=%llu len=%zu zone=%u lanes=%d seed=%u\n",
                   (unsigned long long)off, n, z, c->lanes, c->seed);
        RB_AADD64(&c->wb_bad, 1);
        return -1;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        unsigned char exp = fpat(off + i);
        if (bb[i] != exp) {
            if (InterlockedExchangeAdd(&c->printed, 1) == 0) {
                size_t k, lo = (i > 24) ? i - 24 : 0;
                pthread_mutex_lock(&c->zmx[z]);
                printf("  [FAIL] wb oracle corruption: track=%d phase=%d cfg=%d "
                       "lanes=%d seed=%u rounds=%d zone=%u off=%llu +%zu "
                       "got=%u exp=%u\n",
                       c->track, c->phase, c->cfg, c->lanes, c->seed, c->rounds,
                       z, (unsigned long long)off, i, (unsigned)bb[i], (unsigned)exp);
                printf("    staged:");
                for (k = lo; k < n && k < i + 24; k++) printf(" %02x", (unsigned)bb[k]);
                printf("\n    disk  :");
                for (k = lo; k < n && k < i + 24; k++)
                    printf(" %02x", (unsigned)c->win[z][w + k]);
                printf("\n");
                pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->zmx[z]);
            }
            RB_AADD64(&c->wb_bad, 1);
            return -1;   /* 拒绝落盘：core 不 clean，脏保留 -> 收尾 dirty!=0 双失败 */
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&c->zmx[z]);
    memcpy(c->win[z] + (size_t)w, bb, n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->zmx[z]);
    RB_AADD64(&c->wb_calls, 1);
    RB_AADD64(&c->wb_bytes, (rb_i64)n);
    return 0;
}

/* RMW 补读 / 回源：返回盘面当前值（短持 zone 锁） */
static int rb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n)
{
    RunCtx *c = G;
    unsigned z = zid_of(off);
    rb_u64 w = off - zbase_of(off);
    (void)u; (void)fid;
    if (z >= NZ_MAX || !c->win[z] || n == 0 || w + n > GEOM.wincap) return -1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&c->zmx[z]);
    memcpy(b, c->win[z] + (size_t)w, n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->zmx[z]);
    return 0;
}

static void fill_f(unsigned char *buf, rb_u64 off, size_t len)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < len; i++) buf[i] = fpat(off + i);
}

/* 测试侧直写镜像（内容恒为 f(off)，故 wb oracle 语义不被破坏） */
static void mirror(rb_u64 off, const unsigned char *buf, size_t len)
{
    RunCtx *c = G;
    unsigned z = zid_of(off);
    rb_u64 w = off - zbase_of(off);
    if (z >= NZ_MAX || !c->win[z] || len == 0 || w + len > GEOM.wincap) {
        /* 器具自检：镜像越界单独取证（与「落盘 oracle 违反」区分开，
         * 避免把测试夹具缺陷误报成产品静默写坏） */
        if (InterlockedExchangeAdd(&c->printed, 1) == 0)
            printf("  [FAIL] mirror out-of-window: off=%llu len=%zu zone=%u "
                   "cap=%llu lanes=%d seed=%u track=%d phase=%d cfg=%d\n",
                   (unsigned long long)off, len, z, (unsigned long long)GEOM.wincap,
                   c->lanes, c->seed, c->track, c->phase, c->cfg);
        RB_AADD64(&c->wb_bad, 1);
        return;
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&c->zmx[z]);
    memcpy(c->win[z] + (size_t)w, buf, len);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->zmx[z]);
    RB_AADD64(&c->mirror_bytes, (rb_i64)len);
}

/* direct 区间处理：与 test_wsconc / 驱动 P2-1 同款纪律（先镜像后失效）。
 * wrc!=0 或 dc>MAXD 为 -2 溢出：严禁遍历 direct 数组，整段镜像+整段失效。 */
static void handle_direct(rb_u64 pos, const unsigned char *buf, size_t len,
                          rb_direct_range *dr, int dc, int wrc)
{
    RunCtx *c = G;
    unsigned z = zid_of(pos);
    int k;
    if (c->cfg == 1 || wrc != 0 || dc > MAXD) {
        mirror(pos, buf, len);                       /* 直写 = 整段盘面最终语 */
        rb_stream_invalidate_range(c->st, pos, len);
        return;
    }
    if (dc <= 0) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&c->zmx[z]);
    for (k = 0; k < dc; k++) {
        rb_u64 o = dr[k].offset;
        size_t l = dr[k].len;
        if (o < pos) { if (l < (size_t)(pos - o)) l = 0; else l -= (size_t)(pos - o); o = pos; }
        if (o + l > pos + len) l = (size_t)(pos + len - o);
        if (l) memcpy(c->win[z] + (size_t)(o - zbase_of(o)), buf + (size_t)(o - pos), l);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->zmx[z]);
    for (k = 0; k < dc; k++) {
        rb_u64 o = dr[k].offset;
        size_t l = dr[k].len, m = 0;
        if (o < pos) { if (l < (size_t)(pos - o)) l = 0; else l -= (size_t)(pos - o); o = pos; }
        if (o + l > pos + len) l = (size_t)(pos + len - o);
        m = l;
        if (m) rb_stream_invalidate_range(c->st, o, m);
    }
    RB_AADD64(&c->mirror_bytes, (rb_i64)len);
}

/* 元数据事件：失效（先镜像后失效，superseded=1）/ truncate（安全尺寸） */
static void meta_event(unsigned *s, rb_u64 base)
{
    RunCtx *c = G;
    if ((nrand(s) & 1u) == 0) {
        /* 失效区间必须完整落在窗口缓冲内（+4*sub 不越过 WINCAP），
         * 否则 mirror() 的器具自检会误报 wb_bad。wspan_b/sub 恒为 64，
         * 故 (64-4)*sub + 4*sub = 64*sub = wspan_b < wincap，全几何安全。 */
        rb_u64 o = base + (rb_u64)(nrand(s) % (unsigned)(GEOM.wspan_b / GEOM.sub - 4)) * GEOM.sub;
        size_t l = (size_t)(GEOM.sub * 4);
        fill_f(c->meta_tmp, o, l);
        mirror(o, c->meta_tmp, l);               /* 直写取代：盘面已是最终语 */
        rb_stream_invalidate_range(c->st, o, l);
    } else {
        /* new_size >= 所有 chunk start -> 不销毁任何 chunk、不触发尾部清零，
         * 仅 bump 视图世代并内部 force flush 收敛；不丢数据。 */
        rb_stream_truncate(c->st, VOL_TOP);
    }
}

/* ------------------------------ 线程 ------------------------------ */
typedef struct { int wid; unsigned seed; } WArg;
typedef struct { int lane; } FArg;

/* 轨道 A：随机、重叠、非对齐、跨 chunk、卷尾非对齐的并发写 */
static void *writer_a(void *p)
{
    WArg *a = (WArg *)p;
    unsigned s = a->seed;
    unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc(GEOM.write_cap_a);
    if (!buf) { InterlockedExchange(&G->stop, 1); return NULL; }
    while (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&G->stop, 0, 0)) {
        unsigned idx = (unsigned)InterlockedExchangeAdd(&G->wcount, 1);
        unsigned z;
        rb_u64 base, pos, span;
        size_t len;
        rb_direct_range dr[MAXD];
        int dc = 0, wrc;
        if (idx >= G->wtotal) break;
        /* zone 轮转（保证 full 阶段每个 active zone 都产生脏写 -> 高路数
         * 各路都有活），起点/长度仍随机 -> 非对齐、跨 chunk、重叠保留。 */
        z = idx % (unsigned)G->active_zones;
        base = (rb_u64)z << ZSHIFT;
        span = (rb_u64)(nrand(&s) % (unsigned)(G->wspan - 1));
        len = 1 + (size_t)(nrand(&s) % (unsigned)GEOM.write_cap_a);
        pos = base + span;
        if (pos + len > base + G->wspan) len = (size_t)(base + G->wspan - pos);
        if (len == 0) continue;
        if ((idx % 13) == 0) { pos = base + G->wspan - GEOM.tail; len = (size_t)GEOM.tail; } /* 卷尾非对齐 */
        fill_f(buf, pos, len);
        wrc = rb_write(G->st, pos, buf, len, dr, &dc, MAXD);
        handle_direct(pos, buf, len, dr, dc, wrc);
        if (a->wid == 0 && (idx % 11) == 0) meta_event(&s, base);
    }
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
}

/* 轨道 B：确定性作业序列（Fisher-Yates 打乱），每 (zone,chunk) 每轮恰写一次，
 * 写区间 4KB 子块对齐（无 RMW 洞 -> 哨兵不会混进落盘段），长度 1~3 个 chunk
 * 覆盖 chunk 边界；多写者并发 + 多轮重写构成重叠写。 */
static void *writer_b(void *p)
{
    WArg *a = (WArg *)p;
    unsigned s = a->seed;
    unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)(3ull * GEOM.chunk));
    if (!buf) { InterlockedExchange(&G->stop, 1); return NULL; }
    while (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&G->stop, 0, 0)) {
        unsigned idx = (unsigned)InterlockedExchangeAdd(&G->job_idx, 1);
        unsigned job, z, c, nch;
        rb_u64 base, pos;
        size_t len;
        rb_direct_range dr[MAXD];
        int dc = 0, wrc;
        if (idx >= G->job_total) break;
        job = G->job_order[idx] % (unsigned)(G->active_zones * (unsigned)NCH_PER_ZONE);
        c = job % (unsigned)NCH_PER_ZONE;
        z = job / (unsigned)NCH_PER_ZONE;
        base = (rb_u64)z << ZSHIFT;
        pos = base + (rb_u64)c * GEOM.chunk;
        nch = 1 + (nrand(&s) % 3u);
        if (c + nch > (unsigned)NCH_PER_ZONE) nch = (unsigned)NCH_PER_ZONE - c;
        len = (size_t)(nch * GEOM.chunk);
        fill_f(buf, pos, len);
        wrc = rb_write(G->st, pos, buf, len, dr, &dc, MAXD);
        handle_direct(pos, buf, len, dr, dc, wrc);
        if (a->wid == 0 && (idx % 23) == 0) meta_event(&s, base);
    }
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
}

/* 每路一个 zoned flusher：zone_sel=lane, nzones=lanes，工作集互不重叠 */
static void *flusher(void *p)
{
    int lane = ((FArg *)p)->lane;
    rb_flushws *ws = rb_flushws_create();
    if (!ws) { InterlockedExchange(&G->stop, 1); return NULL; }
    for (;;) {
        int stop = InterlockedCompareExchange(&G->stop, 0, 0);
        double t0 = now_ms();
        size_t w = rb_stream_flush_zoned(G->st, lane, G->lanes, ws);
        double t1 = now_ms();
        G->lane_bytes[lane] += (rb_u64)w;
        G->lane_pass[lane]++;
        G->lane_busy[lane] += (t1 - t0);
        if (stop) break;      /* stop 后仍跑一轮本路分片 flush 再退出：
                               * 保证每路都处理到自己的 zone 集合，不让短测试
                               * 窗口把高路数误判成 empty-zone */
        if (w == 0) usleep(200);   /* 1ms 让出：空 zone / 无活不钉核 */
    }
    rb_flushws_free(ws);
    return NULL;
}

#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); bad++; } \
    else         { printf("  [ok]   " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); } \
} while (0)

/* ------------------------------ 单组合 ------------------------------ */
static int run_one(int lanes, int rounds, unsigned seed, int track, int phase, int cfg)
{
    RunCtx c;
    rb_config cc;
    rb_stats st;
    pthread_t ft[MAX_LANES], wt[NW];
    FArg fa[MAX_LANES];
    WArg wa[NW];
    double wall0, wall1;
    unsigned s, i, z, l, id;
    int bad = 0, k, diskbad = 0;
    rb_u64 first_bad = 0;
    unsigned char got_bad = 0, exp_bad = 0;
    static const char *trk[] = { "concurrent", "sentinel" };
    static const char *phs[] = { "full", "sparse" };
    static const char *cfgname[] = { "write-back", "write-through" };

    memset(&c, 0, sizeof(c));
    c.lanes = lanes; c.rounds = rounds; c.seed = seed;
    c.track = track; c.phase = phase; c.cfg = cfg;
    c.active_zones = (phase == 0) ? NZ_MAX : (lanes < 3 ? lanes : 3);
    c.wspan = (track == 0) ? GEOM.wspan_a : GEOM.wspan_b;
    G = &c;

    printf("== lanes=%d track=%s phase=%s cfg=%s active_zones=%d seed=%u rounds=%d ==\n",
           lanes, trk[track], phs[phase], cfgname[cfg], c.active_zones, seed, rounds);

    /* 盘面窗口：active zone 用 f(轨道A)/sent(轨道B) 初值，其余 zone 填 f（不会被触碰） */
    for (z = 0; z < NZ_MAX; z++) {
        rb_u64 base = (rb_u64)z << ZSHIFT;
        c.win[z] = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)GEOM.wincap);
        if (!c.win[z]) { printf("  [FAIL] OOM win[%u]\n", z); return 1; }
        for (i = 0; i < (unsigned)GEOM.wincap; i++) {
            rb_u64 off = base + i;
            c.win[z][i] = (z < (unsigned)c.active_zones && track == 1) ? sent(off) : fpat(off);
        }
        pthread_mutex_init(&c.zmx[z], NULL);
    }
    InterlockedExchange(&c.stop, 0);
    InterlockedExchange(&c.job_idx, 0);
    InterlockedExchange(&c.wcount, 0);
    RB_ASTORE64(&c.wb_calls, 0);
    RB_ASTORE64(&c.wb_bytes, 0);
    RB_ASTORE64(&c.mirror_bytes, 0);
    RB_ASTORE64(&c.wb_bad, 0);
    InterlockedExchange(&c.printed, 0);

    /* 轨道 A 写次数；轨道 B 作业序列（按 seed 打乱，可复现） */
    c.wtotal = (unsigned)rounds * (unsigned)c.active_zones * 2u;
    c.job_total = (unsigned)c.active_zones * (unsigned)NCH_PER_ZONE * (unsigned)rounds;
    c.job_order = (unsigned *)malloc((size_t)c.job_total * sizeof(unsigned));
    if (!c.job_order) { printf("  [FAIL] OOM job_order\n"); return 1; }
    c.meta_tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)(GEOM.sub * 4));
    if (!c.meta_tmp) { printf("  [FAIL] OOM meta_tmp\n"); return 1; }
    for (i = 0; i < c.job_total; i++) c.job_order[i] = i;
    s = seed ^ (unsigned)lanes * 7919u ^ (unsigned)(track * 131u + phase * 17u + cfg) * 104729u;
    for (i = c.job_total; i > 1; i--) {
        unsigned j = nrand(&s) % i, t;
        t = c.job_order[i - 1]; c.job_order[i - 1] = c.job_order[j]; c.job_order[j] = t;
    }

    /* 引擎：轨道 A 小缓存强制驱逐/回写交织；轨道 B 大缓存专注丢写哨兵 */
    memset(&cc, 0, sizeof(cc));
    cc.max_bytes = (track == 0) ? (4ull * 1024 * 1024) : (512ull * 1024 * 1024);
    cc.writeback = wb_fn; cc.readback = rb_fn; cc.block_size = GEOM.bs;
    c.eng = rb_engine_create(&cc);
    c.st = c.eng ? rb_stream_create(c.eng, 0x464C5553ull) : NULL;   /* "FLUS" */
    if (!c.eng || !c.st) { printf("  [FAIL] engine/stream create\n"); return 1; }
    /* 引擎几何硬断言：防 cache.c:267「非法值静默回落 4096」把一次 32K 回归
     * 悄悄变成 4K 回归。仅在显式传第 4 参时打印，保证 4K 免参姿态与中午
     * 输出逐字等价（4K 本身即回落值，无需该行亦可等价）。 */
    if (G_geom_verbose)
        CHECK(rb_engine_block_size(c.eng) == GEOM.bs,
              "engine geometry honored block_size=%u (got %u)",
              GEOM.bs, rb_engine_block_size(c.eng));

    /* cfg=1 直写：排除集覆盖所有 active zone 窗口 -> 写不进缓存、不产生回写 */
    if (cfg == 1) {
        rb_extent ents[NZ_MAX];
        int r;
        for (z = 0; z < (unsigned)c.active_zones; z++) {
            ents[z].start = (rb_u64)z << ZSHIFT;
            ents[z].len = GEOM.wincap;
        }
        r = rb_stream_set_exclude(c.st, ents, c.active_zones);
        CHECK(r >= 0, "set_exclude(%d extents) ret=%d", c.active_zones, r);
        if (r < 0) bad++;
    }

    wall0 = now_ms();
    for (l = 0; l < (unsigned)lanes; l++) {
        fa[l].lane = (int)l;
        if (pthread_create(&ft[l], NULL, flusher, &fa[l]) != 0) {
            printf("  [FAIL] pthread_create flusher %u\n", l); return 1;
        }
    }
    for (id = 0; id < NW; id++) {
        wa[id].wid = (int)id;
        wa[id].seed = seed ^ (unsigned)lanes * 2654435761u
                      ^ (unsigned)(track * 1000003u + phase * 500009u + cfg * 70001u)
                      ^ (id + 1u) * 2246822519u;
        if (pthread_create(&wt[id], NULL, track == 0 ? writer_a : writer_b, &wa[id]) != 0) {
            printf("  [FAIL] pthread_create writer %u\n", id); return 1;
        }
    }
    for (id = 0; id < NW; id++) pthread_join(wt[id], NULL);
    /* 收尾：先停 zoned 线程（避免与 serial force 互斥），再排空在途回写 */
    InterlockedExchange(&c.stop, 1);
    for (l = 0; l < (unsigned)lanes; l++) pthread_join(ft[l], NULL);
    rb_stream_flush(c.st, 1);
    rb_stream_flush(c.st, 1);     /* 幂等净帧 */
    wall1 = now_ms();

    /* -------- 断言 -------- */
    rb_engine_get_stats(c.eng, &st);
    CHECK(RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_bad) == 0,
          "wb oracle clean, zero silent corruption (bad=%llu)",
          (unsigned long long)RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_bad));
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 0,
          "zero-loss lost_dirty=0 (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0,
          "force flush drained dirty=0 (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(rb_engine_has_dirty(c.eng) == 0,
          "has_dirty=0 (got %d)", rb_engine_has_dirty(c.eng));
    CHECK(st.wb_bytes % GEOM.bs == 0,
          "wb accounting granularity wb_bytes%%%u=0 (got %llu)",
          GEOM.bs, (unsigned long long)st.wb_bytes);
    CHECK((rb_u64)RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_calls) >= st.wb_flush,
          "no double-count wb_flush(%llu)<=wb_calls(%llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.wb_flush,
          (unsigned long long)RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_calls));
    CHECK((rb_u64)RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_bytes) >= st.wb_bytes,
          "no double-count wb_bytes(%llu)<=cb_bytes(%llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.wb_bytes,
          (unsigned long long)RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_bytes));
    if (cfg == 1)
        CHECK(st.wb_bytes == 0 && RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_calls) == 0,
              "write-through cfg yields no writeback (wb_bytes=%llu wb_calls=%llu)",
              (unsigned long long)st.wb_bytes,
              (unsigned long long)RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_calls));

    /* 收尾全盘逐字节比对（仅 active zone 的应写区 [0,wspan)） */
    for (z = 0; z < (unsigned)c.active_zones && !diskbad; z++) {
        rb_u64 base = (rb_u64)z << ZSHIFT;
        for (i = 0; i < (unsigned)c.wspan; i++) {
            if (c.win[z][i] != fpat(base + i)) {
                first_bad = base + i; got_bad = c.win[z][i]; exp_bad = fpat(base + i);
                diskbad = 1; break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (diskbad) {
        printf("  [FAIL] full-disk byte compare: first_bad_off=%llu got=%u exp=%u "
               "lanes=%d seed=%u track=%s phase=%s cfg=%s\n",
               (unsigned long long)first_bad, (unsigned)got_bad, (unsigned)exp_bad,
               lanes, seed, trk[track], phs[phase], cfgname[cfg]);
        bad++;
    } else {
        printf("  [ok]   full-disk byte compare OK (%d zones x %llu B)\n",
               c.active_zones, (unsigned long long)c.wspan);
    }

    /* 每路 flush 吞吐 + 总耗时（安静模式/Verifier 下仅作同条件相对粗测） */
    for (l = 0; l < (unsigned)lanes; l++) {
        double mb = (double)c.lane_bytes[l] / 1e6;
        double thr = c.lane_busy[l] > 0.0 ? mb / (c.lane_busy[l] / 1000.0) : 0.0;
        printf("  lane %2u: bytes=%9.3f MB passes=%6llu busy=%9.3f ms "
               "thr=%10.2f MB/s%s\n",
               l, mb, (unsigned long long)c.lane_pass[l], c.lane_busy[l], thr,
               c.lane_bytes[l] == 0 ? "  [empty-zone]" : "");
    }
    printf("  total_wall=%9.3f ms wb_calls=%llu wb_bytes=%.3f MB "
           "mirror=%.3f MB wb_bad=%llu lost=%llu dirty=%llu wb_flush=%llu\n",
           wall1 - wall0,
           (unsigned long long)RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_calls),
           (double)RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_bytes) / 1e6,
           (double)RB_ALOAD64(&c.mirror_bytes) / 1e6,
           (unsigned long long)RB_ALOAD64(&c.wb_bad),
           (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.wb_flush);

    /* 链表净（销毁后 chunk_count 归零） */
    rb_stream_destroy(c.st); c.st = NULL;
    rb_engine_get_stats(c.eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.chunk_count == 0, "chunk_count=0 after destroy (got %llu)",
          (unsigned long long)st.chunk_count);
    rb_engine_destroy(c.eng); c.eng = NULL;

    printf("  RESULT: %s\n", bad ? "FAIL" : "PASS");
    /* 清理 */
    free(c.job_order);
    free(c.meta_tmp);
    for (z = 0; z < NZ_MAX; z++) {
        free(c.win[z]);
        pthread_mutex_destroy(&c.zmx[z]);
    }
    (void)k;
    return bad;
}

/* ------------------------------ 主入口 ------------------------------ */
static int run_lanes(int lanes, int rounds, unsigned seed)
{
    int track, phase, cfg, bad = 0;
    for (track = 0; track < 2; track++)
        for (phase = 0; phase < 2; phase++)
            for (cfg = 0; cfg < 2; cfg++)
                bad += run_one(lanes, rounds, seed, track, phase, cfg);
    printf("-- lanes=%d summary: %d/8 combos FAILED --\n", lanes, bad);
    return bad;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    static const int all[] = { 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 };
    int lanes = 0, rounds = ROUNDS_DEF, i, bad = 0, nruns = 0;
    unsigned seed = SEED_DEF;
    rb_u32 bs = BS_DEF;
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&g_qpf);
    if (argc > 1) lanes = atoi(argv[1]);
    if (argc > 2) { int r = atoi(argv[2]); if (r > 0 && r <= 64) rounds = r; }
    if (argc > 3) { unsigned long v = strtoul(argv[3], NULL, 0); if (v) seed = (unsigned)v; }
    if (lanes != 0 && lanes != 1 && lanes != 2 && lanes != 4 && lanes != 8 && lanes != 16) {
        printf("usage: test_flushpar [lanes 1|2|4|8|16] [rounds] [seed] [block_size]\n");
        printf("       block_size legal: 4096/8192/16384/32768 (default 4096); illegal = FAIL-CLOSED\n");
        printf("       (no args = sweep all 5 lanes for the no-arg regression gate)\n");
        return 2;
    }
    /* 第 4 参：几何白名单 fail-closed。cache.c:267 对非法值静默回落 4096，
     * 若不在此拦截，「跑 8192/16384/32768」会悄悄退化成 4K 回归。 */
    if (argc > 4) {
        char *end = NULL;
        unsigned long v = strtoul(argv[4], &end, 0);
        if (!end || *end != '\0' || !legal_block_size(v)) {
            printf("test_flushpar: FAIL illegal block_size '%s' "
                   "(legal: 4096/8192/16384/32768)\n", argv[4]);
            printf("  fail-closed: rb_engine_create silently falls back to 4096 "
                   "for illegal values; refuse to run under a false geometry.\n");
            return 2;
        }
        bs = (rb_u32)v;
        G_geom_verbose = 1;
    }
    geom_init(bs);
    /* 静态几何不变式（fail-closed）：窗口不得越过 256MB zone，chunk 不得吞掉
     * 应写区，卷尾非对齐长度必须落在单个子块内 —— 任一不满足立即退出。 */
    if (GEOM.wincap > ZSPAN || GEOM.wspan_a > GEOM.wincap ||
        GEOM.chunk > GEOM.wspan_b || GEOM.tail == 0 || GEOM.tail >= GEOM.sub) {
        printf("test_flushpar: FAIL geometry invariant violated "
               "(bs=%u wincap=%llu zspan=%llu wspan_a=%llu chunk=%llu wspan_b=%llu)\n",
               GEOM.bs, (unsigned long long)GEOM.wincap, (unsigned long long)ZSPAN,
               (unsigned long long)GEOM.wspan_a, (unsigned long long)GEOM.chunk,
               (unsigned long long)GEOM.wspan_b);
        return 2;
    }
    /* 默认（无第 4 参）姿态：首行与 63 号中午基线逐字相同，供 A/B 等价取证。
     * 显式几何运行流：改写为本次 [72] 的真实环境口径，避免误导读者。 */
    if (G_geom_verbose)
        printf("test_flushpar: start seed=%u rounds=%d lanes=%s "
               "[72] Verifier=OFF, user self-reports performance mode (powercfg=Balanced); "
               "throughput is RELATIVE coarse only (userland memcpy RAM disk, no peak claim)\n",
               seed, rounds, lanes ? "single" : "1/2/4/8/16 sweep");
    else
        printf("test_flushpar: start seed=%u rounds=%d lanes=%s "
               "NOTE quiet-mode+Verifier: throughput is RELATIVE coarse only\n",
               seed, rounds, lanes ? "single" : "1/2/4/8/16 sweep");
    if (G_geom_verbose)
        printf("[geom] block_size=%u sub=%llu chunk=%llu wspan_b=%llu wspan_a=%llu "
               "wincap=%llu align=%llu nch=%llu tail=%llu write_cap_a=%zu "
               "zone_span=%llu\n",
               GEOM.bs, (unsigned long long)GEOM.sub, (unsigned long long)GEOM.chunk,
               (unsigned long long)GEOM.wspan_b, (unsigned long long)GEOM.wspan_a,
               (unsigned long long)GEOM.wincap, (unsigned long long)GEOM.align,
               (unsigned long long)NCH_PER_ZONE, (unsigned long long)GEOM.tail,
               GEOM.write_cap_a, (unsigned long long)ZSPAN);
    if (lanes) {
        bad += run_lanes(lanes, rounds, seed);
        nruns = 8;
    } else {
        for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) { bad += run_lanes(all[i], rounds, seed); nruns += 8; }
    }
    printf("test_flushpar: %s (seed=%u rounds=%d runs=%d bad=%d)\n",
           bad ? "FAIL" : "PASS", seed, rounds, nruns, bad);
    return bad ? 1 : 0;
}
````

````c
 *   ④ test_tail(16K/32K/64K)：卷尾非对齐读/写 + truncate 非对齐清尾路径（审计
 *      5.2 #1 / F13 的 core 面；驱动侧 LINK-3 DiskSize 钳位属内核面，由驱动
 *      冒烟覆盖，此处断言 core 等价语义：RMW 合并、清尾零、越界 chunk 销毁）。
 * 统计面：slab 断言经本 TU 内的只读观测（tg_nfree/tg_cap，见 I52 说明）；
 * F10 几何 getter 用公开 rb_engine_block_size()。

 * 的钩子块仍引用 O9-SLAB 已删除的 rb_slab.grows 字段，任何启用该宏的构建都
 * 在 cache.c 编译期 C2039 失败（实测）。core 源不在本任务可改范围（改它会
 * 牵动 .sys 哈希与部署 pin），故改为【测试侧只读观测】：本 TU 直接包含
 * cache_internal.h 读取 rb_engine.slab.nfree 与 slab_free_cap()，不向生产/
 * 内核构建引入任何符号。grows（批分配次数）随批次分配器一并消失，F5 的
````
