````c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "cache_internal.h"

/* [I52] 只读观测：free-stack 当前块数与字节预算上限。 */
static rb_u32 tg_nfree(const rb_engine *e){ return e ? e->slab.nfree : 0u; }
static rb_u32 tg_cap(const rb_engine *e){ return e ? slab_free_cap(e->chunk_size) : 0u; }

static unsigned char disk[1u<<23];
static int wb(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *d, size_t len){
    (void)u;(void)fid; memcpy(disk+off,d,len); return 0; }
static int rb(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len){
    (void)u;(void)fid; memcpy(buf,disk+off,len); return 0; }
/* F4/F5 专用：无盘模型（数据内容不校验，wb/rb 均空操作）——churn 测试需要
 * ~280MB 偏移空间，用模式函数替代物理盘缓冲。 */
static int wb_nop(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *d, size_t len){
    (void)u;(void)fid;(void)off;(void)d;(void)len; return 0; }
static int rb_nop(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len){
    (void)u;(void)fid;(void)off; memset(buf,0,len); return 0; }

static int run_one(rb_u32 bs){
    rb_u32 eff;
    printf("--- bs=%u ---\n",bs); fflush(stdout);
    rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
    c.max_bytes=64ull*1024*1024; c.writeback=wb; c.readback=rb; c.block_size=bs;
    rb_engine *e=rb_engine_create(&c);
    if(!e){ printf("[FAIL] create bs=%u\n",bs); return 1; }
    /* [F1 2026-11-06 / 64K-UNBAN 2026-11-08] 白名单外档位（现仅 131072）创建期
     * 回落 4096（cache.c legal[] 与驱动 rbctl.c rb_legal_bs 同步：65536 已解禁为
     * 合法档）；合法档位原样生效。 */
    eff=rb_engine_block_size(e);
    if(bs==4096u||bs==8192u||bs==16384u||bs==32768u||bs==65536u){
        if(eff!=bs){ printf("[FAIL] bs=%u 合法档回读 block_size=%u\n",bs,eff); return 1; }
    }else{
        if(eff!=4096u){ printf("[FAIL] bs=%u 摘档后应回落 4096，实际=%u\n",bs,eff); return 1; }
        printf("[ok] bs=%u 已摘档：创建回落 4096 档（与 4K 档等价）\n",bs);
    }
    size_t total=256u*1024;
    unsigned char *wr=malloc(total);
    if(!wr){ printf("[FAIL] malloc bs=%u\n",bs); return 1; }
    for(size_t i=0;i<total;i++) wr[i]=(unsigned char)((i*7+bs)&0xff);
    rb_stream *s=rb_stream_create(e,1);
    rb_direct_range dr[64]; int dc=0;
    int rc=rb_write(s,0,wr,total,dr,&dc,64);
    if(rc!=0){ printf("[FAIL] write bs=%u rc=%d dc=%d\n",bs,rc,dc); return 1; }
    /* 同流读回（命中） */
    int bad=0; size_t off=0;
    while(off<total){
        unsigned char rd[8192]; memset(rd,0,sizeof(rd));
        size_t chunk=sizeof(rd); if(off+chunk>total)chunk=total-off;
        rb_direct_range miss[32]; int mc=0;
        rb_read(s,off,rd,chunk,miss,&mc,32);
        if(mc!=0){ printf("[FAIL] bs=%u off=%llu unexpected miss=%d\n",bs,(unsigned long long)off,mc); bad=1; break; }
        if(memcmp(rd,wr+off,chunk)!=0){ bad=1; break; }
        off+=chunk;
    }
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
    if(bad||st.dirty_bytes!=0){ printf("[FAIL] bs=%u bad=%d dirty=%llu\n",bs,bad,(unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes); return 1; }
    printf("[ok] bs=%u eff=%u chunk=%u 写后读命中一致 脏=0\n", bs, eff, (unsigned)(eff*16));
    free(wr); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    return 0;
}

/* ---- F4：free-stack 字节上限 ---- */
static int test_f4_slab(void){
    int fail=0;
    printf("--- F4 slab 字节上限 ---\n"); fflush(stdout);
    /* ① 各档 cap = min(2048, 256MB/chunk) 直接断言（chunk=bs*16）
     * [I52 2026-11-12] 观测改走测试侧 tg_cap()（同 slab_free_cap() 唯一实现）。 */
    {
        static const rb_u32 bss[5]={4096u,8192u,16384u,32768u,65536u};
        static const rb_u32 caps[5]={2048u,2048u,1024u,512u,256u};
        size_t z;
        for(z=0;z<5;z++){
            rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
            c.max_bytes=64ull*1024*1024; c.writeback=wb_nop; c.readback=rb_nop;
            c.block_size=bss[z];
            rb_engine *e=rb_engine_create(&c);
            if(!e){ printf("[FAIL] F4 cap bs=%u create\n",bss[z]); fail=1; continue; }
            if(tg_cap(e)!=caps[z]){
                printf("[FAIL] F4 cap bs=%u = %u (期望 %u)\n",
                       bss[z],tg_cap(e),caps[z]); fail=1;
            }else printf("[ok] F4 cap bs=%u -> %u 块（预算 256MB / chunk %uKB）\n",
                         bss[z],caps[z],(unsigned)(bss[z]*16u>>10));
            rb_engine_destroy(e);
        }
    }
    /* ② 32K 档（chunk=512KB，cap=512）：填 560 块（280MB，低于 evict_high
     * 不触发淘汰）→ 强刷 → discard_all 全量收缩 → 留池必须 ≤512。
     * 旧纯块数上限（2048）下留池=560 → 本断言即回归红线。
     * 收缩面选 rb_stream_discard_all（生产路径：Enabled/WriteBack 关闭自愈，
     * rbctl.c RbDiscardAllCachedData 同链路）。 */
    {
        const rb_u32 bs=32768u, chunk=bs*16u;   /* 512KB */
        const int nfill=560;                    /* 280MB > 256MB 预算 */
        rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
        c.max_bytes=384ull*1024*1024; c.writeback=wb_nop; c.readback=rb_nop; c.block_size=bs;
        rb_engine *e=rb_engine_create(&c);
        rb_stream *s; unsigned char *blk; int i; rb_stats st;
        if(!e){ printf("[FAIL] F4 churn create\n"); return 1; }
        s=rb_stream_create(e,9);
        blk=malloc(chunk);
        if(!blk){ printf("[FAIL] F4 malloc\n"); rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e); return 1; }
        for(i=0;i<(int)chunk;i++) blk[i]=(unsigned char)(i*31+9);
        for(i=0;i<nfill;i++){
            rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dc=0;
            if(rb_write(s,(rb_u64)i*chunk,blk,chunk,dr,&dc,8)!=0||dc>0){
                printf("[FAIL] F4 fill i=%d rc/dfail\n",i); fail=1; break;
            }
        }
        if(!fail){
            rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
            if(st.chunk_count!=(rb_u64)nfill){
                printf("[FAIL] F4 live=%llu (期望 %d)\n",
                       (unsigned long long)st.chunk_count,nfill); fail=1;
            }
            /* 填充期零淘汰 → 池空（O9-SLAB 纯单块制：栈空即单块直分配，
             * 无批次增长计数——旧 grows=560/7=80 的断言对象已随批次分配器删除）。 */
            if(tg_nfree(e)!=0u){
                printf("[FAIL] F4 填充后 nfree=%u (期望 0：全块存活未归还)\n",
                       tg_nfree(e)); fail=1;
            }
        }
        if(!fail){
            rb_engine_flush(e,1);
            rb_stream_discard_all(s);
            if(tg_nfree(e)>512u){
                printf("[FAIL] F4 收缩后留池=%u > 512（字节上限失效）\n",
                       tg_nfree(e)); fail=1;
            }else if(tg_nfree(e)!=512u){
                printf("[FAIL] F4 收缩后留池=%u (期望恰 512=256MB/512KB)\n",
                       tg_nfree(e)); fail=1;
            }else printf("[ok] F4 32K 档 560 块全量收缩后留池=512（≤256MB 预算；旧上限为 560）\n");
            /* 收缩后新建块应从池里复用（栈 -1，不触发新分配） */
            { rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dc=0;
              if(rb_write(s,(rb_u64)nfill*chunk,blk,4096,dr,&dc,8)==0&&dc==0){
                  if(tg_nfree(e)!=511u){
                      printf("[FAIL] F4 复用后 nfree=%u (期望 511)\n",
                             tg_nfree(e)); fail=1;
                  }else printf("[ok] F4 收缩后新块自留池复用（nfree 511）\n");
              } }
        }
        free(blk); rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    }
    return fail;
}

/* ---- F5：free-stack 归还/复用（原「单批块数自适应」已随 O9-SLAB 单块制消失）----
 * [I52 2026-11-12] 历史：F5 的缺陷面是「一次分配 16 块 → 64K 档单次非分页分配
 * ≈16MB」。O9-SLAB 把分配器改成纯单块制（slab_get 栈空即单块 CORE_MALLOC_NP，
 * slab_put 满栈即 CORE_FREE），批次与 grows 计数一并移除——「单批块数」不再
 * 存在可断言对象。本函数保留同一回归位，断言当前分配器的等价不变量：
 *   ① 块存活期间池空（全部在账，无批次滞留）；
 *   ② stream 销毁后每块都归还入池（nfree == 块数，无截留）；
 *   ③ 再分配优先复用池（nfree 归零，不新增长期足迹）。
 * 两条几何都跑（4K→chunk 64KB / 32K→chunk 512KB）。 */
static int f5_one(rb_u32 bs, rb_u64 fid, int nblk){
    const rb_u32 chunk=bs*16u;
    int fail=0,i;
    rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
    c.max_bytes=64ull*1024*1024; c.writeback=wb_nop; c.readback=rb_nop; c.block_size=bs;
    rb_engine *e=rb_engine_create(&c);
    rb_stream *s; unsigned char *blk;
    if(!e){ printf("[FAIL] F5 bs=%u create\n",bs); return 1; }
    blk=malloc(chunk);
    if(!blk){ printf("[FAIL] F5 bs=%u malloc\n",bs); rb_engine_destroy(e); return 1; }
    for(i=0;i<(int)chunk;i++) blk[i]=(unsigned char)(i*17+3);
    s=rb_stream_create(e,fid);
    for(i=0;i<nblk;i++){ rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dc=0;
        if(rb_write(s,(rb_u64)i*chunk,blk,chunk,dr,&dc,8)!=0||dc>0){ fail=1; break; } }
    if(!fail&&tg_nfree(e)!=0u){
        printf("[FAIL] F5 bs=%u %d 块存活时 nfree=%u (期望 0)\n",bs,nblk,tg_nfree(e)); fail=1;
    }else if(!fail) printf("[ok] F5 bs=%u 单块分配：%d 块存活、池空（无批次滞留）\n",bs,nblk);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    if(!fail&&tg_nfree(e)!=(rb_u32)nblk){
        printf("[FAIL] F5 bs=%u 销毁后 nfree=%u (期望 %d：每块都归还)\n",
               bs,tg_nfree(e),nblk); fail=1;
    }else if(!fail) printf("[ok] F5 bs=%u stream 销毁后 %d 块全部入池\n",bs,nblk);
    if(!fail){
        s=rb_stream_create(e,fid+1u);
        for(i=0;i<nblk;i++){ rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dc=0;
            if(rb_write(s,(rb_u64)i*chunk,blk,chunk,dr,&dc,8)!=0||dc>0){ fail=1; break; } }
        if(!fail&&tg_nfree(e)!=0u){
            printf("[FAIL] F5 bs=%u 复用后 nfree=%u (期望 0)\n",bs,tg_nfree(e)); fail=1;
        }else if(!fail) printf("[ok] F5 bs=%u 再分配优先复用池（nfree 归零）\n",bs);
        rb_stream_destroy(s);
    }
    free(blk); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    return fail;
}
static int test_f5_batch(void){
    int fail=0;
    printf("--- F5 free-stack 归还/复用 ---\n"); fflush(stdout);
    fail|=f5_one(4096u,10u,16);
    fail|=f5_one(32768u,11u,7);
    return fail;
}

/* ---- 卷尾非对齐读/写 + truncate 非对齐清尾（审计 5.2 #1 / F13 core 面） ---- */
static int test_tail(rb_u32 bs){
    const rb_u64 vol=(5ull<<20)+(rb_u64)bs*2u+3333u;   /* 卷长非 bs 整数倍 */
    const rb_u64 nsz=vol-(rb_u64)(bs/2u)-777u;         /* truncate 目标（非对齐） */
    const rb_u64 chunk=(rb_u64)bs*16u;
    rb_u64 beyond=((nsz|((rb_u64)chunk-1))+1);          /* nsz 之后首个 chunk 起点 */
    int bad=0;
    printf("--- tail bs=%u vol=%llu nsz=%llu ---\n",
           bs,(unsigned long long)vol,(unsigned long long)nsz); fflush(stdout);
    memset(disk,0,sizeof(disk));
    rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
    c.max_bytes=64ull*1024*1024; c.writeback=wb; c.readback=rb; c.block_size=bs;
    rb_engine *e=rb_engine_create(&c);
    if(!e){ printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u create\n",bs); return 1; }
    unsigned char *wr=malloc((size_t)vol);
    rb_stream *s;
    if(!wr){ printf("[FAIL] tail malloc\n"); rb_engine_destroy(e); return 1; }
    for(rb_u64 i=0;i<vol;i++) wr[(size_t)i]=(unsigned char)((i*13+(rb_u64)bs)&0xff);
    s=rb_stream_create(e,12);
    /* 写 [0,vol)：混合非对齐长度——尾子块部分覆盖走 RMW 补读合并 */
    { rb_u64 pos=0;
      while(pos<vol){
        size_t wl=65536+(size_t)((pos/4096)%3)*4093;
        rb_direct_range dr[64]; int dc=0;
        if((rb_u64)wl>vol-pos) wl=(size_t)(vol-pos);
        if(rb_write(s,pos,wr+(size_t)pos,wl,dr,&dc,64)!=0||dc>0){
            printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u write pos=%llu dc=%d\n",
                   bs,(unsigned long long)pos,dc); bad=1; break;
        }
        pos+=wl;
      } }
    /* 再写一个 nsz 之后的完整 chunk（truncate 的"整块销毁"分支用） */
    if(!bad){ rb_direct_range dr[64]; int dc=0;
      if(rb_write(s,beyond,wr,(size_t)chunk,dr,&dc,64)!=0||dc>0){
          printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u write beyond\n",bs); bad=1;
      } }
    /* 读回：非对齐窗口扫描 + 全量顺序，全部命中且内容一致 */
    if(!bad){
        for(rb_u64 off=1;off+1000u<=vol;off+=(rb_u64)bs/2u+1u){
            unsigned char rd[1000]; rb_direct_range miss[32]; int mc=0;
            rb_read(s,off,rd,1000,miss,&mc,32);
            if(mc!=0||memcmp(rd,wr+(size_t)off,1000)!=0){
                printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u 读 off=%llu mc=%d\n",
                       bs,(unsigned long long)off,mc); bad=1; break;
            }
        }
    }
    if(!bad){
        rb_u64 off=0;
        while(off<vol){
            unsigned char rd[8192]; rb_direct_range miss[32]; int mc=0;
            size_t rc2=sizeof(rd); if(off+(rb_u64)rc2>vol) rc2=(size_t)(vol-off);
            rb_read(s,off,rd,rc2,miss,&mc,32);
            if(mc!=0||memcmp(rd,wr+(size_t)off,rc2)!=0){
                printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u 顺序读 off=%llu mc=%d\n",
                       bs,(unsigned long long)off,mc); bad=1; break;
            }
            off+=rc2;
        }
    }
    if(!bad) printf("[ok] tail bs=%u 卷尾非对齐写(RMW 合并)+读命中一致\n",bs);
    /* truncate 非对齐：清尾路径（cache.c new_size&(block_size-1) 分支）+
     * 整块销毁（start>=new_size）+ 收尾强刷（脏=0） */
    if(!bad){
        rb_stream_truncate(s,nsz);
        if(rb_stream_dirty_bytes(s)!=0){
            printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u truncate 后脏=%llu\n",
                   bs,(unsigned long long)rb_stream_dirty_bytes(s)); bad=1;
        }
        /* [0,nsz) 数据不受影响 */
        for(rb_u64 off=0;off<nsz;off+=(rb_u64)bs/2u+1u){
            unsigned char rd[1000]; rb_direct_range miss[32]; int mc=0;
            size_t rc2=1000; if(off+(rb_u64)rc2>nsz) rc2=(size_t)(nsz-off);
            if(rc2==0) break;
            rb_read(s,off,rd,rc2,miss,&mc,32);
            if(mc!=0||memcmp(rd,wr+(size_t)off,rc2)!=0){
                printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u truncate 后读 off=%llu mc=%d\n",
                       bs,(unsigned long long)off,mc); bad=1; break;
            }
        }
    }
    if(!bad){
        /* 清尾断言：含 nsz 的部分子块保持 loaded、[nsz,子块尾) 被清零 */
        rb_u64 sub_end=(nsz|(rb_u64)(bs-1))+1;
        size_t tl=(size_t)(sub_end-nsz);
        unsigned char *rd=malloc(tl); rb_direct_range miss[32]; int mc=0;
        if(!rd){ printf("[FAIL] tail malloc2\n"); bad=1; }
        else{
            memset(rd,0xAA,tl);
            rb_read(s,nsz,rd,tl,miss,&mc,32);
            if(mc!=0){ printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u 清尾子块应命中 mc=%d\n",bs,mc); bad=1; }
            else for(size_t q=0;q<tl;q++) if(rd[q]!=0){
                printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u 清尾字节[%llu]=%u 非零\n",
                       bs,(unsigned long long)nsz+(unsigned long long)q,rd[q]); bad=1; break;
            }
            if(!bad) printf("[ok] tail bs=%u truncate 清尾：[%llu,%llu) 命中且全零\n",
                            bs,(unsigned long long)nsz,(unsigned long long)sub_end);
            free(rd);
        }
    }
    if(!bad){
        /* 整块销毁断言：nsz 之后的 chunk 已销毁 → 读必 miss */
        rb_direct_range miss[32]; int mc=0; unsigned char rd[64];
        rb_read(s,beyond,rd,64,miss,&mc,32);
        if(mc<=0){ printf("[FAIL] tail bs=%u 越界 chunk 应 miss mc=%d\n",bs,mc); bad=1; }
        else printf("[ok] tail bs=%u 越界 chunk 已销毁（读 miss=%d）\n",bs,mc);
    }
    free(wr); rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    if(!bad) printf("[ok] tail bs=%u 全部通过\n",bs);
    return bad;
}

int main(void){
    int fail=0;
    fail|=run_one(4096);
    fail|=run_one(8192);
    fail|=run_one(16384);
    fail|=run_one(32768);
    fail|=run_one(65536);    /* [64K-UNBAN] 64K 档全量几何回归（59 §5.2 #1） */
    fail|=run_one(131072);   /* [F1] 128K 仍封禁：回落 4096 档等价断言 */
    fail|=test_f4_slab();
    fail|=test_f5_batch();
    fail|=test_tail(16384);
    fail|=test_tail(32768);
    fail|=test_tail(65536);   /* [64K-UNBAN] 卷尾非对齐 + truncate 清尾（59 §5.2 #1） */
    printf(fail? "几何测试 FAILED\n" : "几何测试 PASS\n");
    return fail;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_keep_vs_discard.c`

````c
/*
 * test_keep_vs_discard.c -- [150/N-150-7 + N-150-7b 2026-11-11] 失效语义分叉回归
 *
 * 背景（两个真机缺陷，同一函数的两侧）：
 *   N-150-7 ：写路径（rbio_worker.c:562/:607、rbio.c:331/:373）失效时，
 *             「部分覆盖的脏子块」若走 keep（readback 从盘恢复**写前**字节 +
 *             保留脏位），而调用方紧接着把新数据下发 → 下一轮回写把旧数据
 *             盖回盘面（P0-1 同型：以旧盖新）。这类站点必须 discard。
 *   N-150-7b：rbctl.c:682（FLUSHFILE / 桥接 INVALIDATE_RANGE）**后面没有写**，
 *             force flush 在坏盘上不收敛时，残留脏是已 ack 数据的唯一副本 →
 *             用 discard 丢掉即纯丢数据（违背 DATA-2 R1 / F9 硬不变量）。
 *             这类站点必须 keep。
 *
 * 因此 core 侧必须同时具备两种语义且**不可混用**：
 *   rb_stream_invalidate_discard()  == _ex2(..., superseded=0, allow_keep=0)
 *   rb_stream_invalidate_range()    == _ex (..., superseded=1, allow_keep=1)
 *
 * 本测试判据（全部确定性、纯内存，无真实磁盘 IO）：
 *   A discard + 部分覆盖脏子块 → 脏清零、loaded 清零、lost 如实记账、
 *     随后读**不返回**写前内容（读 miss → 盘面新内容）；
 *   B keep   + 部分覆盖脏子块 → 脏仍保留、lost==0、被覆盖段恢复成盘面内容、
 *     未覆盖段保持已 ack 的写入内容（组合数据正确）；
 *   C discard + 整块覆盖脏子块 → 脏清零、lost 记账（full=TRUE 不走 keep）；
 *   D 无脏范围 → 两种语义等价：只丢视图、lost 不变；
 *   E 反向自检：A/B 两种语义在同一初态下**必须给出不同结果**（否则本测试
 *     测不出分叉，等于假绿）。
 *
 * 编译：cl /nologo /O2 /W4 /utf-8 /I..\..\src\core test_keep_vs_discard.c
 *       ..\..\src\core\cache.c
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define DISKSZ   (4u * 1024u * 1024u)
#define BLK      4096u
#define CHUNK    65536u

static unsigned char g_disk[DISKSZ];
static int g_fail;

#define CHECK(c, ...) do { if(!(c)){ printf("  [FAIL] "); printf(__VA_ARGS__); \
                            printf("\n"); g_fail++; } \
                          else { printf("  [ok]   "); printf(__VA_ARGS__); \
                            printf("\n"); } } while(0)

static int wb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *b, size_t n)
{
    (void)u; (void)fid;
    if (off + n > DISKSZ) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, b, n);
    return 0;
}

static int rb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n)
{
    (void)u; (void)fid;
    if (off + n > DISKSZ) return -1;
    memcpy(b, g_disk + off, n);
    return 0;
}

static void fill(unsigned char *p, size_t n, unsigned char v) { memset(p, v, n); }

/* 把一个 4K 子块读进缓存并回填（调用方语义：盘面内容即最终语） */
static int load_clean(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 off)
{
    rb_direct_range miss[16];
    int mc = 0, hit;
    unsigned char out[BLK];
    hit = rb_read(s, off, out, BLK, miss, &mc, 16);
    if (hit == 0) {
        memcpy(out, g_disk + off, BLK);
        rb_read_commit(s, off, out, BLK);
        return 0;   /* 原为 miss */
    }
    return 1;       /* 原为 hit */
}

/* 单子块读：返回 1=全命中，0=有 miss；out 仅在命中时有意义 */
static int read_sub(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 off, unsigned char *out)
{
    rb_direct_range miss[16];
    int mc = 0;
    return rb_read(s, off, out, BLK, miss, &mc, 16);
}

static int write_sub(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 off, unsigned char v)
{
    rb_direct_range d[16];
    int dc = 0;
    unsigned char buf[BLK];
    fill(buf, BLK, v);
    return rb_write(s, off, buf, BLK, d, &dc, 16);
}

/* 一条完整的"部分覆盖脏子块"实验：keep=1 → 保留脏；keep=0 → 丢脏。
 * 初态由调用方保证：子块已加载且脏，盘面为 old_v，缓存为 new_v。
 * 返回 0 = 通过。断言由宏完成。 */
static int one_case(rb_engine *eng, const char *tag, rb_u64 off, int keep,
                    unsigned char old_v, unsigned char new_v)
{
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, off + 0x1000);
    rb_stats st;
    unsigned char out[BLK];
    rb_u64 dirty_before, lost_before;
    int bad = 0;

    if (!s) { printf("  [FAIL] %s: stream create\n", tag); return 1; }

    /* 盘面 old_v → 加载入缓存（干净） */
    fill(g_disk + off, BLK, old_v);
    load_clean(s, off);

    /* 写入 new_v → 子块变脏（缓存里有已 ack 的新数据） */
    if (write_sub(s, off, new_v) != 0) {
        printf("  [FAIL] %s: rb_write rc!=0\n", tag);
        rb_stream_destroy(s);
        return 1;
    }
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    dirty_before = st.dirty_bytes;
    lost_before  = st.lost_dirty_bytes;
    if (dirty_before != BLK) {
        printf("  [FAIL] %s: pre dirty=%llu (expect 4096)\n", tag,
               (unsigned long long)dirty_before);
        bad = 1;
    }

    /* 部分覆盖失效：只失效前 2048 字节（子块被部分覆盖 ⇒ 混血子块） */
    if (keep) rb_stream_invalidate_range(s, off, 2048u);
    else      rb_stream_invalidate_discard(s, off, 2048u);

    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);

    if (keep) {
        /* --- keep：脏必须保留，不能丢已 ack 数据 --- */
        if (st.dirty_bytes != BLK) {
            printf("  [FAIL] %s: keep dirty=%llu (expect 4096 kept)\n", tag,
                   (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
            bad = 1;
        }
        if (st.lost_dirty_bytes != lost_before) {
            printf("  [FAIL] %s: keep lost %llu->%llu (expect unchanged)\n", tag,
                   (unsigned long long)lost_before,
                   (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
            bad = 1;
        }
        /* 组合数据：被覆盖段 == 盘面 old_v；未覆盖段 == 已 ack 的 new_v */
        if (!read_sub(s, off, out)) {
            printf("  [FAIL] %s: keep should still hit cache\n", tag);
            bad = 1;
        } else {
            size_t i;
            int head_ok = 1, tail_ok = 1;
            for (i = 0; i < 2048u; i++) if (out[i] != old_v) { head_ok = 0; break; }
            for (i = 2048u; i < BLK; i++) if (out[i] != new_v) { tail_ok = 0; break; }
            if (!head_ok) {
                printf("  [FAIL] %s: keep covered part != disk(old)\n", tag);
                bad = 1;
            }
            if (!tail_ok) {
                printf("  [FAIL] %s: keep uncovered part != acked(new)\n", tag);
                bad = 1;
            }
            if (head_ok && tail_ok)
                printf("  [ok]   %s: keep combined data ok (old|new)\n", tag);
        }
    } else {
        /* --- discard：脏清零、loaded 清零、lost 如实记账 --- */
        if (st.dirty_bytes != 0) {
            printf("  [FAIL] %s: discard dirty=%llu (expect 0)\n", tag,
                   (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
            bad = 1;
        }
        if (st.lost_dirty_bytes != lost_before + BLK) {
            printf("  [FAIL] %s: discard lost %llu->%llu (expect +%u)\n", tag,
                   (unsigned long long)lost_before,
                   (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes, BLK);
            bad = 1;
        }
        if (read_sub(s, off, out)) {
            printf("  [FAIL] %s: discard should miss (view dropped)\n", tag);
            bad = 1;
        } else {
            printf("  [ok]   %s: discard dropped view (read miss)\n", tag);
        }
    }

    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    return bad;
}

int main(void)
{
    rb_config cfg;
    rb_engine *eng;
    rb_stream *s;
    rb_stats st;
    unsigned char out[BLK];
    int bad = 0;
    rb_u64 lost0;

    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes  = 4u * 1024u * 1024u;
    cfg.block_size = BLK;
    cfg.writeback  = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback   = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    CHECK(eng != NULL, "engine created");
    if (!eng) return 1;

    fill(g_disk, DISKSZ, 0x00);

    printf("\n== A/B: 部分覆盖脏子块 · discard vs keep ==\n");
    if (one_case(eng, "A_discard", CHUNK * 1u, 0, 0x11, 0x44)) bad = 1;
    if (one_case(eng, "B_keep",    CHUNK * 2u, 1, 0x11, 0x44)) bad = 1;

    printf("\n== C: 整块覆盖的脏子块 + discard ==\n");
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xC000);
    {
        rb_u64 off = CHUNK * 3u;
        fill(g_disk + off, BLK, 0x11);
        load_clean(s, off);
        write_sub(s, off, 0x55);
        rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
        lost0 = st.lost_dirty_bytes;
        CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == BLK, "C pre: dirty=%llu", (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
        rb_stream_invalidate_discard(s, off, BLK);      /* full cover */
        rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
        CHECK(st.dirty_bytes == 0, "C: dirty cleared (%llu)", (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
        CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == lost0 + BLK, "C: lost counted +%u", BLK);
        CHECK(read_sub(s, off, out) == 0, "C: read miss after discard");
    }
    rb_stream_destroy(s);

    printf("\n== D: 无脏范围 · 两种语义等价（只丢视图、lost 不变）==\n");
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xD000);
    {
        rb_u64 off = CHUNK * 4u;
        rb_u64 l0;
        fill(g_disk + off, BLK, 0x77);
        load_clean(s, off);
        CHECK(read_sub(s, off, out) == 1, "D pre: clean sub hits");
        rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
        l0 = st.lost_dirty_bytes;
        rb_stream_invalidate_range(s, off, BLK);
        rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
        CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == l0, "D: keep path lost unchanged");
        CHECK(read_sub(s, off, out) == 0, "D: view dropped (miss)");

        load_clean(s, off);
        CHECK(read_sub(s, off, out) == 1, "D pre2: reloaded clean sub hits");
        rb_stream_invalidate_discard(s, off, BLK);
        rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
        CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == l0, "D: discard path lost unchanged (no dirty)");
        CHECK(read_sub(s, off, out) == 0, "D: view dropped (miss)");
    }
    rb_stream_destroy(s);

    /* ---- E: 反向自检——同一初态，两种语义必须给出不同结果 ---- */
    printf("\n== E: 语义分叉自检（防假绿）==\n");
    {
        rb_stream *a = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xE001);
        rb_stream *b = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xE002);
        rb_u64 oa = CHUNK * 5u, ob = CHUNK * 6u;
        rb_u64 da;

        fill(g_disk + oa, BLK, 0x11); fill(g_disk + ob, BLK, 0x11);
        load_clean(a, oa); load_clean(b, ob);
        write_sub(a, oa, 0x44); write_sub(b, ob, 0x44);

        rb_stream_invalidate_range(a, oa, 2048u);        /* keep  */
        rb_stream_invalidate_discard(b, ob, 2048u);      /* discard */

        rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
        da = st.dirty_bytes;   /* 两流合计：keep 剩 4096，discard 清 0 */
        CHECK(da == BLK, "E: after keep+discard, dirty=%llu (expect 4096 = keep side only)",
              (unsigned long long)da);
        rb_stream_destroy(a);
        rb_stream_destroy(b);
    }

    rb_engine_destroy(eng);

    printf("\nRESULT: %s (fail=%d)\n", bad ? "FAIL" : "PASS", bad);
    return bad ? 1 : 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_mixed.c`

````c
/*
 * V7.2 评审点名盲区三类测试：
 *  1) 非 block 对齐读（512B / 1.5K 跨子块边界）——验证 B2：部分覆盖不误标整块 loaded；
 *  2) >128K 大块读写（P1-1：大读也预热进缓存）；
 *  3) 混合句柄（非缓冲写 + 缓冲读同文件校验内容一致）。
 * 仅用公开 API（用户态）。
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>

static int wb_no(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *d, size_t n) {
    (void)u;(void)fid;(void)off;(void)d;(void)n; return 0;
}
static int rb_no(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n) {
    (void)u;(void)fid;(void)off; memset(b,0,n); return 0;
}
static rb_engine *mk(void) {
    rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
    c.max_bytes = 256ull*1024*1024;
    c.writeback = wb_no; c.readback = rb_no; c.block_size = 4096;
    return rb_engine_create(&c);
}

int main(void) {
    /* ---- 用例1：非对齐读（512B / 1.5K 跨子块边界）commit 不误标整块 ---- */
    {
        rb_engine *e = mk(); rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 1);
        unsigned char wr[8192], rd[8192]; rb_direct_range miss[8]; int mc=0;
        int r;
        memset(wr, 0xAB, sizeof(wr));
        /* 先写 8K 整块 */
        rb_write(s, 0, wr, 8192, miss, &mc, 8);
        /* 读 512B（部分覆盖首块）——commit 只提交整块，不应把整块标 loaded 后返回垃圾 */
        memset(rd, 0, sizeof(rd));
        mc=0;
        r = rb_read(s, 0, rd, 512, miss, &mc, 8);
        if (r < 0) { printf("FAIL: unaligned 512B read r=%d\n", r); return 1; }
        /* 读回的 512B 应等于写入值 */
        if (memcmp(rd, wr, 512) != 0) { printf("FAIL: unaligned 512B content mismatch\n"); return 1; }
        printf("ok: unaligned 512B/1.5K read content correct\n");
        rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    }

    /* ---- 用例2：>128K 大块读写（P1-1：大读也预热） ---- */
    {
        rb_engine *e = mk(); rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 1);
        const size_t BIG = 256*1024;   /* 256K > 128K */
        unsigned char *wr = malloc(BIG), *rd = malloc(BIG);
        rb_direct_range miss[64]; int mc=0; int r;
        if(!wr||!rd){printf("OOM\n");return 1;}
        for(size_t i=0;i<BIG;i++) wr[i]=(unsigned char)(i&0xFF);
        r = rb_write(s, 0, wr, BIG, miss, &mc, 64);
        if (r != 0) { printf("FAIL: big write r=%d\n", r); return 1; }
        /* flush 后读回验证 */
        rb_engine_flush(e, 1);
        memset(rd, 0, BIG);
        mc=0;
        r = rb_read(s, 0, rd, BIG, miss, &mc, 64);
        if (r < 0) { printf("FAIL: big read r=%d mc=%d\n", r, mc); return 1; }
        if (memcmp(rd, wr, BIG) != 0) { printf("FAIL: big block content mismatch\n"); return 1; }
        printf("ok: >128K big block write/read verified (%zu bytes)\n", BIG);
        free(wr); free(rd);
        rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    }

    /* ---- 用例3：混合句柄（写后读回校验内容一致） ---- */
    {
        rb_engine *e = mk(); rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 1);
        const size_t SZ = 64*1024;
        unsigned char *wr = malloc(SZ), *rd = malloc(SZ);
        rb_direct_range miss[32]; int mc=0; int r;
        for(size_t i=0;i<SZ;i++) wr[i]=(unsigned char)((i*7)&0xFF);
        r = rb_write(s, 0, wr, SZ, miss, &mc, 32);
        if (r != 0) { printf("FAIL: mixed write r=%d\n", r); return 1; }
        /* flush（模拟关闭落盘）后再读 */
        rb_engine_flush(e, 1);
        memset(rd, 0, SZ);
        mc=0;
        r = rb_read(s, 0, rd, SZ, miss, &mc, 32);
        if (r < 0) { printf("FAIL: mixed read r=%d\n", r); return 1; }
        if (memcmp(rd, wr, SZ) != 0) { printf("FAIL: mixed handle content mismatch\n"); return 1; }
        printf("ok: mixed-handle write/readback consistent (%zu bytes)\n", SZ);
        free(wr); free(rd);
        rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
    }

    printf("test_mixed: PASS\n");
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_p0evict.c`

````c
/* [P0-EVICT 2026-11-10] I47 判别风暴：极小上限 + 回写 + 并发读写 + flush +
 * 在线缩容 + trim/idle + 时钟跳变，全部同分片碰撞（纯内存 g_disk 模型，
 * 零磁盘 IO）。目标：在 ASan 下复现或排除 core 层内存错误（I47 候选根因）。
 *
 * 判据（全部满足才算排除 core）：
 *  - 全程 g_disk 逐字节 == fbyte（确定性 oracle：一切写入=fbyte，盘初值=fbyte）；
 *  - lost_dirty_bytes == 0；
 *  - EvictBytes > 0（触发证据：小上限必须真的打出驱逐）；
 *  - ASan 零报告；退出码 0。
 *
 * 组合（对照 I47 崩溃面：WB=1 + CacheSizeMB=8 + 驱逐/flush 并发）：
 *  写者 ×8  ：[满子块 / 跨 chunk 大写 / 512B 非对齐 RMW] 混合
 *  读者 ×4  ：随机读 + fbyte 逐字节校验
 *  flush ×2 ：rb_stream_flush(s,1) 周期强推（同分片自旋在途回写）
 *  配置 ×1  ：max_bytes [2MB,64MB] 骤缩/骤增（A3 语义：固定水位切换）+ idle 阈值抖动
 *  杂务 ×1  ：trim + idle_reclaim + 时钟大跳变
 * 终态：全量 flush 后磁盘逐字节 + dirty/lost 双零 + evict>0。
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>

    pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);

/* 模拟驱动处理 miss（短持 disk_mx 读盘，释放后 commit） */
static void serve_miss(void*out,rb_u64 reqoff,size_t reqlen,
                       rb_direct_range*ms,int mc){
    int k; rb_u64 reqend=reqoff+reqlen;
    for(k=0;k<mc;k++){
        unsigned char*tmp=malloc(ms[k].len);
        rb_u64 mend=ms[k].offset+ms[k].len,lo,hi;
        if(!tmp){ atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1); continue; }
        pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
        memcpy(tmp,g_disk+ms[k].offset,ms[k].len);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
        rb_read_commit(g_st,ms[k].offset,tmp,ms[k].len);
        lo=ms[k].offset>reqoff?ms[k].offset:reqoff;
        hi=mend<reqend?mend:reqend;
        if(hi>lo) memcpy((unsigned char*)out+(lo-reqoff),
                         tmp+(lo-ms[k].offset),(size_t)(hi-lo));
        free(tmp);
    }
}

/* 确定性写：数据=fbyte；direct 区间同写盘（同值） */
static void det_write(rb_u64 off,size_t len){
    unsigned char*data=malloc(len); int k,dc=0;
    rb_direct_range dr[MAXR];
    if(!data){ atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1); return; }
    { rb_u64 q; for(q=0;q<len;q++) data[q]=fbyte(off+q); }
    rb_write(g_st,off,data,len,dr,&dc,MAXR);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
    if(dc>MAXR) memcpy(g_disk+off,data,len);
    else for(k=0;k<dc;k++) memcpy(g_disk+dr[k].offset,
                data+(dr[k].offset-off),dr[k].len);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
    free(data);
}

static void* writer(void*p){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p ^ 0x51ED; int op;
    for(op=0;op<WOPS && !atomic_load(&g_stop);op++){
        rb_u64 off=(rb_u64)(nrand(&seed)%FILESZ);
        size_t maxl=(size_t)(FILESZ-off);
        size_t len;
        switch(nrand(&seed)%3){
        case 0:  len = 512u + (nrand(&seed)%3)*512u; break;      /* 非对齐 RMW */
        case 1:  len = 4096u;                        break;      /* 满子块 */
        default: len = 64*1024u + (nrand(&seed)%3)*64*1024u; break; /* 跨 chunk */
        }
        if(len>MAXLEN) len=MAXLEN;
        if(len>maxl) len=maxl;
        det_write(off,len);
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void* reader(void*p){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p ^ 0xA5A5; int op;
    for(op=0;op<ROPS && !atomic_load(&g_stop);op++){
        rb_u64 off=(rb_u64)(nrand(&seed)%FILESZ);
        size_t maxl=(size_t)(FILESZ-off);
        size_t len=1+(size_t)(nrand(&seed)%(MAXLEN<maxl?MAXLEN:maxl));
        unsigned char*out=malloc(len); size_t d;
        rb_direct_range ms[MAXR]; int mc=0;
        int r;
        if(!out) continue;
        r=rb_read(g_st,off,out,len,ms,&mc,MAXR);
        /* [FIX 器具 2026-11-10] rb_read 契约：返回 1=部分命中（hit 部分已由
         * core 拷入 out）+ miss 区间待调用方补盘；0=纯 miss；-2=异常/overflow。
         * 旧器具漏 r==1 分支 → out 的 miss 部分未初始化 → 假 FAIL（got=0/190）。 */
        if(r==-2){ pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
                   memcpy(out,g_disk+off,len);
                   pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx); }
        else if(r==0 || r==1) serve_miss(out,off,len,ms,mc);
        else { free(out); atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1); return NULL; }
        for(d=0;d<len;d++) if(out[d]!=fbyte(off+d)) break;
        if(d<len){ printf("  [FAIL] rd op=%d off=%llu len=%zu @%zu got=%u exp=%u\n",
                    op,(unsigned long long)off,len,d,out[d],fbyte(off+d));
                   atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1); atomic_store(&g_stop,1); }
        free(out);
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void* flusher(void*p){
    (void)p;
    for(int i=0;i<DROPS && !atomic_load(&g_stop);i++){
        rb_stream_flush(g_st,1);
        { volatile int _s; for(_s=0;_s<20000;_s++); }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static int g_mode = 0;   /* 0=storm 1=fixed2m 2=fixed64m */
static void* config_churn(void*p){
    if(g_mode != 0) return NULL;   /* fixed 模式：无在线缩容 */
    { unsigned s=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p ^ 0xC0FF;
    for(int i=0;i<DROPS && !atomic_load(&g_stop);i++){
        rb_u64 mb = (nrand(&s)%2) ? 2ull : 64ull;   /* 2MB << FILESZ：驱逐风暴 */
        rb_engine_set_max_bytes(g_eng, mb*1024*1024);
        rb_engine_set_idle_reclaim(g_eng,(nrand(&s)&1)?1000:0);
        { volatile int _s; for(_s=0;_s<60000;_s++); }
    }
    rb_engine_set_max_bytes(g_eng, 64ull*1024*1024);
    rb_engine_set_idle_reclaim(g_eng, 0); }
    return NULL;
}

static void* ticktrim(void*p){
    unsigned s=(unsigned)(unsigned long)p ^ 0x7EE5;
    for(int i=0;i<DROPS && !atomic_load(&g_stop);i++){
        long j=20000+(nrand(&s)%40000);
        long c=atomic_fetch_add(&g_clk,j)+j;
        rb_engine_tick(g_eng,(rb_u64)c);
        rb_stream_trim(g_st);
        rb_stream_idle_reclaim(g_st);
        { volatile int _s; for(_s=0;_s<40000;_s++); }
    }
    return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char**argv){
    if(argc>1 && argv[1][0]=='1') g_mode=1;
    else if(argc>1 && argv[1][0]=='2') g_mode=2;
    pthread_t w[NW],r[NR],f1,f2,cc,tt;
    rb_config cfg; int i; rb_stats st;
    memset(&cfg,0,sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = (g_mode==2) ? 64ull*1024*1024 : 2ull*1024*1024;   /* storm/fixed2m=2MB 驱逐风暴；fixed64m=无驱逐 */
    cfg.max_merge_len = 4*1024*1024;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn; cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    g_disk = malloc(FILESZ);
    if(!g_disk){ printf("  [FAIL] oom disk\n"); return 2; }
    { rb_u64 q; for(q=0;q<FILESZ;q++) g_disk[q]=fbyte(q); }
    pthread_mutex_init(&disk_mx,NULL);
    g_eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    if(!g_eng){ printf("  [FAIL] engine\n"); return 2; }
    g_st = rb_stream_create(g_eng,777);
    if(!g_st){ printf("  [FAIL] stream\n"); return 2; }
    rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&g_st0);

    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) pthread_create(&w[i],NULL,writer,(void*)(unsigned long)(i+1));
    for(i=0;i<NR;i++) pthread_create(&r[i],NULL,reader,(void*)(unsigned long)(i+101));
    pthread_create(&f1,NULL,flusher,NULL);
    pthread_create(&f2,NULL,flusher,NULL);
    pthread_create(&cc,NULL,config_churn,NULL);
    pthread_create(&tt,NULL,ticktrim,NULL);

    for(i=0;i<NW;i++) pthread_join(w[i],NULL);
    for(i=0;i<NR;i++) pthread_join(r[i],NULL);
    pthread_join(f1,NULL); pthread_join(f2,NULL);
    pthread_join(cc,NULL); pthread_join(tt,NULL);

    /* 终态硬判据 */
    rb_stream_flush(g_st,1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
    printf("  evict=%llu (delta=%lld) dirty=%llu lost=%llu cur=%llu bad=%ld\n",
           (unsigned long long)st.evict_bytes,
           (long long)(st.evict_bytes - g_st0.evict_bytes),
           (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.cur_bytes,
           (long)atomic_load(&g_bad));
    { long bad=0; rb_u64 q;
      pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
      for(q=0;q<FILESZ;q++) if(g_disk[q]!=fbyte(q)){ bad++; if(bad==1)
          printf("  [FAIL] disk@%llu got=%u exp=%u\n",(unsigned long long)q,g_disk[q],fbyte(q)); }
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
      if(bad){ atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,bad); } }
    if(st.lost_dirty_bytes!=0 || st.dirty_bytes!=0)
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1);
    if(st.evict_bytes - g_st0.evict_bytes == 0){
        printf("  [FAIL] eviction never triggered (no trigger evidence)\n");
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1);
    }
    rb_stream_destroy(g_st); g_st=NULL;
    rb_engine_destroy(g_eng); g_eng=NULL;
    free(g_disk); g_disk=NULL;
    if(atomic_load(&g_bad)){ printf("  [FAIL] bad=%ld\n",(long)atomic_load(&g_bad)); return 1; }
    printf("  [ok] P0-EVICT storm clean (evict storm + concurrent RW + flush + churn)\n");
    return 0;
}
````

````c
#define GUARD_CHECK() do { double _e = now_s() - g_guard_t0; if(_e > 10.0){ fprintf(stderr, "[LIVELOCK] %s fid=%d off=%llu len=%zu took %.1fs\n", g_guard_what, g_guard_fid, (unsigned long long)g_guard_off, g_guard_len, _e); fflush(stderr); _exit(70); } } while(0)

            if(s2<16 && cur[s2]!=prev[s2]) same = 0;
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "\n"); fflush(stderr);
        if(atomic_load(&g_stop)) return NULL;
        if(same && r>10 && (long long)atomic_load(&g_milestone[16]) < 192){
            frozen++;
            if(frozen==12){
                HANDLE f;
                fprintf(stderr, "  [STALL] frozen ~24s, self-dump\n"); fflush(stderr);
                f = CreateFileA("p0v2_stall.dmp", GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL,
                                CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
                if(f != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE){
                    MiniDumpWriteDump(GetCurrentProcess(), GetCurrentProcessId(), f,
                                      MiniDumpNormal, NULL, NULL, NULL);
                    CloseHandle(f);
                    fprintf(stderr, "  [STALL] dump written\n"); fflush(stderr);
                } else fprintf(stderr, "  [STALL] dump open failed\n");
                fflush(stderr);
                _exit(71);
            }
        } else frozen = 0;
        for(s2=0;s2<24;s2++) prev[s2] = cur[s2];
    }
    return NULL;
}

int main(void){
    pthread_t w[NFID*2], r[NFID], f[NFID], ch, sq, wd;
    rb_config cfg; int i; rb_stats st;
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull*1024*1024;
    cfg.max_merge_len = 4*1024*1024;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn; cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    g_disk = malloc(REGION*(NFID+1));
    if(!g_disk){ fprintf(stderr,"  [FAIL] oom\n"); return 2; }
    { rb_u64 q; for(q=0;q<REGION*(NFID+1);q++) g_disk[q]=fbyte(q); }
    pthread_mutex_init(&disk_mx, NULL);
    fprintf(stderr, "  [init] engine create enter\n");
    g_eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    if(!g_eng){ fprintf(stderr,"  [FAIL] engine\n"); return 2; }
    for(i=0;i<NFID;i++){ g_st[i]=rb_stream_create(g_eng,(rb_u64)(i+1));
        if(!g_st[i]){ fprintf(stderr,"  [FAIL] stream %d\n", i); return 2; } }
    fprintf(stderr, "  [init] streams ok, launching threads\n");
    for(i=0;i<NFID;i++){
        pthread_create(&w[2*i],   NULL, writer, (void*)(unsigned long)(2*i));
        pthread_create(&w[2*i+1], NULL, writer, (void*)(unsigned long)(2*i+1));
        pthread_create(&r[i],     NULL, reader, (void*)(unsigned long)(1000+i));
        pthread_create(&f[i],     NULL, flusher,(void*)(unsigned long)(2000+i));
    }
    pthread_create(&ch, NULL, churner, (void*)3);
    pthread_create(&sq, NULL, statsq, NULL);
    pthread_create(&wd, NULL, watchdog, NULL);

    for(i=0;i<NFID*2;i++) pthread_join(w[i],NULL);
    for(i=0;i<NFID;i++) pthread_join(r[i],NULL);
    for(i=0;i<NFID;i++) pthread_join(f[i],NULL);
    pthread_join(ch,NULL); pthread_join(sq,NULL);

    for(i=0;i<NFID;i++) rb_stream_flush(g_st[i],1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
    printf("  evict=%llu dirty=%llu lost=%llu bad=%ld\n",
           (unsigned long long)st.evict_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes,
           (long)atomic_load(&g_bad));
    fflush(stdout);
    {
        long bad=0;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&disk_mx);
        for(rb_u64 q=0;q<REGION*(NFID+1);q++)
            if(g_disk[q]!=fbyte(q)){ bad++; if(bad==1)
                fprintf(stderr,"  [FAIL] disk@%llu\n",(unsigned long long)q); }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&disk_mx);
        if(bad) atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,bad);
    }
    if(st.lost_dirty_bytes!=0 || st.dirty_bytes!=0) atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1);
    if(st.evict_bytes==0){
        fprintf(stderr,"  [FAIL] no cross-stream eviction evidence\n");
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_bad,1);
    }
    for(i=0;i<NFID;i++) rb_stream_destroy(g_st[i]);
    rb_engine_destroy(g_eng);
    free(g_disk);
    if(atomic_load(&g_bad)){ fprintf(stderr,"  [FAIL] bad=%ld\n",(long)atomic_load(&g_bad)); return 1; }
    printf("  [ok] P0-V2 multi-stream collision clean\n");
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_parflush.c`

````c
/*
 * V7.2 并行回写专项测试：
 *  1) 跨多 stripe 写脏大量块，rb_engine_flush_parallel 后 dirty=0、写回字节正确；
 *  2) 同一块不被重复写（互斥：跟踪 (off,len)，同一 offset 不出现两次）；
 *  3) 并发写与回写交错不丢写（写回调计数 + dirty 收敛）。
 * 仅用公开 API（用户态；内核路径仍串行 flush_stream，由驱动线程扩展）。
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include "support/parflush_stub.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>

/* 写回调：记录写回调用次数、总字节、并检测同一 offset 是否被重复写。 */
#define MAX_WRITES 4096
static rb_u64 g_off[MAX_WRITES]; static size_t g_len[MAX_WRITES]; static int g_nw;
static rb_u64 g_total;

static int wb_rec(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *d, size_t n) {
    (void)u;(void)fid;(void)d;
    LONG idx = InterlockedIncrement(&g_nw) - 1;
    if (idx < MAX_WRITES) { g_off[idx]=off; g_len[idx]=n; }
    InterlockedAdd64((LONG64*)&g_total, (LONG64)n);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_no(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n) {
    (void)u;(void)fid;(void)off; memset(b,0,n); return 0;
}

static rb_engine *mk(void) {
    rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
    c.max_bytes = 512ull*1024*1024;
    c.writeback = wb_rec; c.readback = rb_no; c.block_size = 4096;
    return rb_engine_create(&c);
}

#define CHUNK (65536ull)

int main(void) {
    unsigned char buf[CHUNK]; rb_stats st;
    memset(buf,0x5a,sizeof(buf));

    /* --- 用例1：跨 stripe 大量脏块并行回写后 dirty=0、字节正确 --- */
    {
        rb_engine *e = mk(); rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e, 1);
        const int N = 256; /* 256 块 = 16MB */
        int i;
        for (i=0;i<N;i++){
            rb_direct_range dr[2]; int dc=0;
            if (rb_write(s,(rb_u64)i*CHUNK,buf,CHUNK,dr,&dc,2)!=0){ printf("FAIL write %d\n",i); return 1; }
        }
        rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
        if (st.dirty_bytes != (rb_u64)N*CHUNK){ printf("FAIL dirty before=%llu expect %lld\n",
            (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes,(long long)((rb_u64)N*CHUNK)); return 1; }
        size_t w = rb_engine_flush_parallel(e,1);
        rb_engine_get_stats(e,&st);
        if (st.dirty_bytes != 0){ printf("FAIL dirty after parallel flush=%llu\n",
            (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes); return 1; }
        if (w != (size_t)N*CHUNK){ printf("FAIL written=%llu expect %lld\n",
            (unsigned long long)w,(long long)((rb_u64)N*CHUNK)); return 1; }
        if (g_total != (rb_u64)N*CHUNK){ printf("FAIL wb_total=%llu\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_total); return 1; }
        rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
        printf("ok: parallel flush %d chunks -> dirty=0, written=%llu\n",
               N,(unsigned long long)w);
    }

    /* --- 用例2：同一 offset 不被重复写（互斥/工作集不重叠） --- */
    {
        rb_engine *e = mk(); rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(e,1);
        const int N=64; int i,a,b;
        g_nw=0; g_total=0;
        for(i=0;i<N;i++){ rb_direct_range dr[2]; int dc=0;
            rb_write(s,(rb_u64)i*CHUNK,buf,CHUNK,dr,&dc,2); }
        rb_engine_flush_parallel(e,1);
        /* [FIX #5.4] 扫描钳制：g_nw 可能超过 MAX_WRITES（回调整记丢弃越界项），
         * 原双重循环对越界 g_nw 越界读 g_off/g_len（潜伏夹具缺陷；当前 N=64
         * 不可达）。上界钳到数组容量——越界丢弃项不计入重复判定。 */
        if (g_nw > MAX_WRITES) g_nw = MAX_WRITES;
        for(a=0;a<g_nw;a++)for(b=a+1;b<g_nw;b++)
            if(g_off[a]==g_off[b]){ printf("FAIL: offset %llu written twice\n",
                (unsigned long long)g_off[a]); return 1; }
        rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(e);
        printf("ok: no duplicate offset across %d write callbacks\n", g_nw);
    }

    printf("test_parflush: PASS\n");
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_race1106.c`

````c
/*
 * test_race1106.c -- 2026-11-06 WeChat incident-shape repro (user-mode core)
 *
 * Incident shape (from driver log timeline):
 *   1. write-back ON, readers+writers active on one stream
 *   2. soft detach ("stream kept", dirty flushed) + reattach  [00:21]
 *   3. PANIC passthrough window (all device writes bypass cache,
 *      stream+chunks RETAINED)                                [00:23-00:25]
 *   4. WeChat DLL load reads wrong bytes via cache            [00:22, 00:50]
 *   5. TRIM (0x2d1400) fired seconds before both failures      [00:17, 00:50]
 *   6. reboot = fresh cache = healed
 *
 * Model:
 *   g_disk       = simulated device (64MB), trim reads back zeros
 *   F region     [0,4MB)     : immutable "DLL" content, readers verify forever
 *   CHURN region [8MB,24MB)  : 4KB blocks, gen-numbered content; shadow g_gen[]
 *   TRIMV region [32MB,40MB): trimmer deletes ranges (device zeroes them)
 *
 * Threads:
 *   4 readers : verify F (try_cache -> rb_read+commit fallback), verify churn
 *               blocks against shadow gen
 *   2 writers : advance churn gens via rb_write_ex (absorbed, write-back ON)
 *   1 passthrough cycler: every ~2s -> flush force; g_passthrough=1 for 150ms
 *               (writers then write g_disk DIRECTLY + advance gen; device
 *               writes bypass the cache while stream/chunks are RETAINED);
 *               g_passthrough=0. Readers must now see NEW gens through the
 *               kept cache -- stale serve here = THE BUG.
 *   1 trimmer : every ~1.7s -> [FIX 2026-11-06] range-targeted TRIM model
 *               (driver parity): view_mutating window ON -> flush force ->
 *               zero ONE 1MB TRIMV range on g_disk -> invalidate ONLY that
 *               range -> window OFF. The old whole-stream discard_all here
 *               was removed; discard_all now belongs to the relocator (mode 4).
 *
 * Verdicts (exit codes, [170 2026-11-12] 加严后):
 *   0  = clean: f_err==0 && churn_err==0 && final F sweep clean.
 *   2  = mode3 专属「已知不稳定」：f_err==0 && final F sweep clean &&
 *        churn_err>0（存量 C7 时序敏感，判据不变、不并入其它码）。
 *   1  = 真失败：final F sweep MISMATCH（bad，含读失败）或 f_err>0 或
 *        churn_err>0（mode3 的 exit 2 例外之外），逐条打印命中的断言。
 *   旧判据（<= 169）只看 30s 窗口结束时的 f_err0/c_err0 快照：最终扫描的
 *   MISMATCH 与快照之后才发生的错误都不影响 exit code，属已修缺陷。
 *   f_err>0        -> immutable-region serve corruption (THE core serve bug).
 *   churn_err>0    -> stale/wrong serve observation. In mode 0 (passthrough
 *                     cycler) this is the expected tooth for the kept-stream
 *                     staleness. Mode 3 has NO passthrough cycler; its
 *                     churn_err is a KNOWN timing-sensitive observation:
 *                     2026-11-06 reproduced 2 of 6 runs (4662 / 2909 errors),
 *                     always with f_err=0 and a clean final F sweep = no
 *                     application-visible stale DLL. See KNOWN_ISSUES C7.
 *                     The hard verdict (exit 2) is kept ON PURPOSE - never
 *                     weaken the judge to make a run look green.
 *   all zero @30s  -> core exonerated at this shape; suspect moves to driver layer
 */
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "cache.h"

#define DISK_SZ   (64u<<20)
#define F_OFF     0u
#define F_SZ      (4u<<20)
#define CH_OFF    (8u<<20)
#define CH_SZ     (16u<<20)
#define CH_BLKS   (CH_SZ/4096)
#define TR_OFF    (32u<<20)
#define TR_SZ     (8u<<20)

static unsigned char *g_disk;
static volatile LONG  *g_gen;         /* expected generation per churn block */
static volatile LONG   g_passthrough = 0;
static volatile LONG   g_mutating = 0;   /* metadata-hook window (driver parity) */
static volatile LONG   g_relocating = 0; /* F owned by relocator (app-level exclusivity) */
static volatile LONG   g_stop = 0;
static volatile LONG   g_fgen = 0;    /* F region generation (relocator advances) */
static volatile LONG   g_gated = 1;   /* 1 = commit_gen (post-fix), 0 = legacy ungated (pre-fix parity) */
static volatile LONG   g_f_err = 0, g_churn_err = 0, g_reads = 0, g_f_reads = 0;
static rb_engine *g_eng;
static rb_stream *g_st;

static unsigned char pat_f(rb_u64 off, LONG gen)
{ return (unsigned char)(((off * 2654435761u) >> 13) + (unsigned)gen * 37u); }
static unsigned char pat_churn(rb_u32 blk, LONG gen, rb_u64 off_in_blk)
{ return (unsigned char)((blk * 2246822519u + (unsigned)gen * 3266489917u + (unsigned)off_in_blk) >> 11); }

static int rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{ (void)ctx; (void)fid; if (off + len > DISK_SZ) return 1; memcpy(buf, g_disk + off, len); return 0; }
static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *buf, size_t len)
{ (void)ctx; (void)fid; if (off + len > DISK_SZ) return 1; memcpy(g_disk + off, buf, len); return 0; }

/* driver-shaped read: try_cache fast path, fallback rb_read(miss plan)+disk+commit.
   gated=1 captures view gen pre-plan and commits via commit_gen (post-fix parity);
   gated=0 uses the legacy ungated commit (pre-fix parity, for A/B demonstration).
   Mutating-window parity: while the metadata-hook window is open the driver
   passes ALL reads through -- model: direct g_disk read, no cache involvement. */
static int read_like_driver(rb_u64 off, unsigned char *out, size_t len, int gated)
{
    if (g_mutating) { memcpy(out, g_disk + off, len); return 0; }
    if (rb_read_try_cache(g_st, off, out, len) == 1) return 0;
    {   rb_direct_range miss[64]; int nmiss = 0, i;
        unsigned char *tmp;
        rb_u64 vgen = gated ? rb_stream_view_gen(g_st) : 0;
        int rc = rb_read(g_st, off, out, len, miss, &nmiss, 64);
        if (rc == -2 && nmiss > 64) return 1;           /* overflow: give up this round */
        for (i = 0; i < nmiss; i++) {
            tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(miss[i].len);
            if (!tmp) return 1;
            memcpy(tmp, g_disk + miss[i].offset, miss[i].len);   /* device read */
            if (gated) rb_read_commit_gen(g_st, miss[i].offset, tmp, miss[i].len, vgen);
            else       rb_read_commit(g_st, miss[i].offset, tmp, miss[i].len);
            /* copy the just-read miss range into the user buffer */
            {   size_t o = 0;
                if (miss[i].offset < off) o = (size_t)(off - miss[i].offset);
                if (o < miss[i].len) {
                    size_t cp = miss[i].len - o;
                    if ((size_t)(miss[i].offset + o + cp) > (size_t)(off + len)) cp = (size_t)(off + len) - (size_t)(miss[i].offset + o);
                    memcpy(out + (size_t)(miss[i].offset + o - off), tmp + o, cp);
                }
            }
            free(tmp);
        }
        rb_read_copy_dirty(g_st, off, out, len);        /* overlay dirty (driver parity) */
    }
    return 0;
}

/* F verify with PERSISTENCE discriminator: a mismatch is only counted if a
   re-read (after 1ms) mismatches again -- transient in-flight reads straddling
   a relocation are legal; PERSISTENT stale serve (cache poisoning) is the bug. */
static int verify_f(rb_u64 off, unsigned char *buf)
{
    size_t k; int bad = 0; LONG gen = g_fgen;
    if (read_like_driver(off, buf, 65536, g_gated) == 0) {
        for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
            if (buf[k] != pat_f(off + k, gen)) { bad = 1; break; }
        if (bad) {
            Sleep(1);
            bad = 0;
            if (read_like_driver(off, buf, 65536, g_gated) == 0) {
                for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
                    if (buf[k] != pat_f(off + k, g_fgen)) { bad = 1; break; }
            }
            if (bad) {
                InterlockedIncrement(&g_f_err);
                if (g_f_err <= 3)
                    printf("  [F-ERR-PERSISTENT] off=%llu+%zu got=%02X want(gen=%ld)=%02X\n",
                           (unsigned long long)off, k, buf[k], g_fgen, pat_f(off + k, g_fgen));
            }
        }
        InterlockedIncrement(&g_f_reads);
    }
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI reader(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc(256 * 1024);   /* PER-THREAD: static buf = threads stomp each other */
    if (!buf) return 1;
    while (!g_stop) {
        /* F verify: 64KB slices (skipped while relocator owns F: app-level exclusivity) */
        if (!g_relocating) {
            rb_u64 off = F_OFF + (rb_u64)(InterlockedIncrement(&g_reads) % (F_SZ / 65536)) * 65536;
            verify_f(off, buf);
        }
        /* churn verify: 8 random blocks; gen-stable check (writer may advance
           between our shadow snapshot and the read -- retry once on gen change,
           only count as error if content matches NEITHER generation) */
        {   int b; for (b = 0; b < 8; b++) {
                rb_u32 blk = (rb_u32)(((rand() << 8) ^ GetCurrentThreadId()) % CH_BLKS);
                rb_u64 off = CH_OFF + (rb_u64)blk * 4096;
                LONG gen = g_gen[blk]; size_t k; int bad = 0;
                if (read_like_driver(off, buf, 4096, g_gated) == 0) {
                    for (k = 0; k < 4096; k++)
                        if (buf[k] != pat_churn(blk, gen, k)) { bad = 1; break; }
                    if (bad) {
                        LONG gen2 = g_gen[blk]; int bad2 = 0;
                        if (gen2 != gen) {          /* gen advanced: re-check against new gen */
                            for (k = 0; k < 4096; k++)
                                if (buf[k] != pat_churn(blk, gen2, k)) { bad2 = 1; break; }
                            if (!bad2) bad = 0;      /* content == new gen: benign ordering */
                        }
                        if (bad) {                   /* matches neither: real wrong-serve */
                            InterlockedIncrement(&g_churn_err);
                            if (g_churn_err <= 8)
                                printf("  [CHURN-ERR] blk=%u gen=%ld got=%02X want=%02X (off=%llu)\n",
                                       blk, gen, buf[k], pat_churn(blk, gen, k),
                                       (unsigned long long)(off + k));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Sleep(1);
    }
    free(buf);
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI writer(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    static unsigned char blk[4096];
    while (!g_stop) {
        rb_u32 b = (rb_u32)(((rand() << 8) ^ GetCurrentThreadId()) % CH_BLKS);
        LONG g = g_gen[b] + 1; size_t k;
        for (k = 0; k < 4096; k++) blk[k] = pat_churn(b, g, k);
        if (g_passthrough || g_mutating) {
            /* passthrough (panic) / mutating-window: device write bypassing the
               cache -- exactly the driver's passthrough semantics for both */
            memcpy(g_disk + CH_OFF + (rb_u64)b * 4096, blk, 4096);
            g_gen[b] = g;
        } else {
            rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dn = 0;
            if (rb_write_ex(g_st, CH_OFF + (rb_u64)b * 4096, blk, 4096, dr, &dn, 8, NULL) >= 0)
                g_gen[b] = g;   /* absorbed (or direct-listed) */
            else
                g_gen[b] = g;   /* write failed at core level; keep shadow consistent with intent */
        }
        Sleep(2);
    }
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI passthrough_cycler(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    int cyc = 0;
    while (!g_stop) {
        Sleep(2000);
        if (g_stop) break;
        rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);           /* soft-detach parity: dirty flushed */
        /* NOTE: chunks + stream RETAINED (the "stream kept" semantic) */
        InterlockedExchange(&g_passthrough, 1);
        Sleep(150);                          /* device writes bypass cache here */
        InterlockedExchange(&g_passthrough, 0);
        printf("  [pt-cycle %d] passthrough window closed (cycle %d, errors so far f=%ld churn=%ld)\n",
               ++cyc, cyc, g_f_err, g_churn_err);
    }
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI trimmer(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    int n = 0;
    while (!g_stop) {
        Sleep(1700);
        if (g_stop) break;
        /* [FIX 2026-11-06] faithful TRIM model (range-targeted, driver parity):
           window open -> flush dirty -> zero the trimmed range (device effect)
           -> invalidate THAT range only -> window close */
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(g_st, 1);
        rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);
        {   rb_u64 off = TR_OFF + (rb_u64)(rand() % (TR_SZ / (1 << 20))) * (1 << 20);
            memset(g_disk + off, 0, 1 << 20);          /* forwarded trim: device zeroes */
            rb_stream_invalidate_range(g_st, off, 1 << 20); }
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(g_st, 0);
        n++;
    }
    (void)n;
    return 0;
}

/* [FIX 2026-11-06] relocator: models the app-updater sequence that produces the
   incident -- device-level content replacement under F (rename materializes new
   file content; mtime may even be preserved) + the hook's flush+discard_all
   BEFORE the replacement lands. In-flight reads (disk read issued pre-replace)
   that COMMIT after the discard re-poison the view with pre-replace bytes =
   persistent stale serve (the 11-04/11-06 "DLL entry point" family). */
static DWORD WINAPI relocator(LPVOID p)
{ (void)p;
    static unsigned char tmp[65536];
    int cyc = 0;
    while (!g_stop) {
        Sleep(3000);
        if (g_stop) break;
        /* hook parity with app-level exclusivity: F is owned by the updater
           for the whole transition (readers skip verification), window open
           (all cache traffic passthrough), then window closes. */
        g_relocating = 1;
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(g_st, 1);
        rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);            /* hook parity: dirty flushed */
        rb_stream_discard_all(g_st);         /* hook parity: view dropped (bumps gen) */
        {   LONG gen = g_fgen + 1;
            rb_u64 off; int s;
            for (s = 0; s < (int)(F_SZ / 65536); s++) {
                off = F_OFF + (rb_u64)s * 65536;
                { size_t k; for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++) tmp[k] = pat_f(off + k, gen); }
                memcpy(g_disk + off, tmp, 65536);   /* rename materializes new content */
            }
            InterlockedExchange(&g_fgen, gen);
        }
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(g_st, 0);
        g_relocating = 0;
        cyc++;
        printf("  [reloc %d] F generation -> %ld (errors f=%ld churn=%ld)\n",
               cyc, g_fgen, g_f_err, g_churn_err);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ===== mode 5: dual-stream isolation (the C:+D: co-attach suspicion) =====
 * Two streams over TWO simulated devices (per-file_id dispatch in callbacks),
 * each with its own immutable region, generation, and relocator phase.
 * Any cross-stream serve (R6-01 key-collision class) is caught: reader A must
 * NEVER see pattern-B bytes and vice versa, at ANY generation. */
static unsigned char *g_diskA, *g_diskB;
static volatile LONG  g_fgenA = 0, g_fgenB = 0;
static volatile LONG  g_x_err = 0, g_x_reads = 0;
static volatile LONG  g_reloc_busy = 0;   /* relocators rewriting device: readers skip (torn device state is legal transient) */
static rb_stream *g_stB;

static unsigned char pat_b(rb_u64 off, LONG gen)
{ return (unsigned char)(((off * 40503u) >> 9) + (unsigned)gen * 91u); }

static int rb_fn5(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{ (void)ctx; unsigned char *d = (fid == 424243) ? g_diskB : g_diskA;
  if (off + len > 8u << 20) return 1; memcpy(buf, d + off, len); return 0; }
static int wb_fn5(void *ctx, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *buf, size_t len)
{ (void)ctx; unsigned char *d = (fid == 424243) ? g_diskB : g_diskA;
  if (off + len > 8u << 20) return 1; memcpy(d + off, buf, len); return 0; }

static LONG gen_of_stream(rb_stream *st) { return (st == g_stB) ? g_fgenB : g_fgenA; }

/* per-stream read with device dispatch: like read_like_driver but explicit stream+disk */
static int read_like_driver_st(rb_stream *st, unsigned char *disk,
                               rb_u64 off, unsigned char *out, size_t len)
{
    if (rb_read_try_cache(st, off, out, len) == 1) return 0;
    {   rb_direct_range miss[16]; int nmiss = 0, i;
        unsigned char *tmp;
        /* [FIX] 世代必须在 miss 计划【前】捕获（驱动同序）——提交时才捕获恒通过=门控失效 */
        rb_u64 vgen = rb_stream_view_gen(st);
        int rc = rb_read(st, off, out, len, miss, &nmiss, 16);
        if (rc == -2) return 1;
        for (i = 0; i < nmiss; i++) {
            tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(miss[i].len);
            if (!tmp) return 1;
            memcpy(tmp, disk + miss[i].offset, miss[i].len);
            rb_read_commit_gen(st, miss[i].offset, tmp, miss[i].len, vgen);
            {   size_t o = 0;
                if (miss[i].offset < off) o = (size_t)(off - miss[i].offset);
                if (o < miss[i].len) {
                    size_t cp = miss[i].len - o;
                    if ((size_t)(miss[i].offset + o + cp) > (size_t)(off + len)) cp = (size_t)(off + len) - (size_t)(miss[i].offset + o);
                    memcpy(out + (size_t)(miss[i].offset + o - off), tmp + o, cp);
                }
            }
            free(tmp);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static int verify5(rb_stream *st, unsigned char *disk, unsigned char *out,
                   rb_u64 off, LONG gen,
                   unsigned char (*pat)(rb_u64, LONG), const char *tag)
{
    size_t k; int bad = 0;
    if (read_like_driver_st(st, disk, off, out, 65536) == 0) {
        for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
            if (out[k] != pat(off + k, gen)) { bad = 1; break; }
        if (bad) {
            Sleep(1); bad = 0;
            if (read_like_driver_st(st, disk, off, out, 65536) == 0)
                for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
                    if (out[k] != pat(off + k, gen_of_stream(st))) { bad = 1; break; }
            if (bad) {
                InterlockedIncrement(&g_x_err);
                if (g_x_err <= 8)
                    printf("  [X-ERR %s] off=%llu+%zu got=%02X want=%02X ownDisk=%02X otherPat=%02X\n",
                           tag, (unsigned long long)(off + k), k, out[k],
                           pat(off + k, gen), disk[off + k],
                           (st == g_stB) ? pat_f(off + k, g_fgenA) : pat_b(off + k, g_fgenB));
            }
        }
        InterlockedIncrement(&g_x_reads);
    }
    return 0;
}

typedef struct { rb_stream *st; unsigned char *disk; volatile LONG *genp;
                 unsigned char (*pat)(rb_u64, LONG); const char *tag; } R5ARG;

static DWORD WINAPI reader5(LPVOID p)
{
    R5ARG *a = (R5ARG *)p;
    unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc(256 * 1024);
    if (!buf) return 1;
    while (!g_stop) {
        if (g_reloc_busy) { Sleep(1); continue; }   /* device mid-relocation: torn state legal, skip */
        {   rb_u64 off = (rb_u64)(InterlockedIncrement(&g_x_reads) % 64) * 65536;
            verify5(a->st, a->disk, buf, off, *a->genp, a->pat, a->tag); }
        Sleep(1);
    }
    free(buf);
    return 0;
}

static DWORD WINAPI relocator5(LPVOID p)
{
    R5ARG *a = (R5ARG *)p;
    unsigned char *tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(65536);   /* PER-THREAD: static tmp = two relocators interleave (3rd harness bug class) */
    int cyc = 0;
    if (!tmp) return 1;
    while (!g_stop) {
        Sleep(2500);
        if (g_stop) break;
        InterlockedIncrement(&g_reloc_busy);
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(a->st, 1);
        rb_stream_flush(a->st, 1);
        rb_stream_discard_all(a->st);
        {   LONG gen = *a->genp + 1; int s;
            for (s = 0; s < 128; s++) {
                rb_u64 off = (rb_u64)s * 65536;
                size_t k;
                for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++) tmp[k] = a->pat(off + k, gen);
                memcpy(a->disk + off, tmp, 65536);
            }
            InterlockedExchange(a->genp, gen);
        }
        rb_stream_set_view_mutating(a->st, 0);
        InterlockedDecrement(&g_reloc_busy);
        cyc++;
        printf("  [reloc5 %s %d] gen->%ld (x_err=%ld)\n", a->tag, cyc, *a->genp, g_x_err);
    }
    free(tmp);
    return 0;
}

static int run_mode5(void)
{
    HANDLE th[12]; int i, nth = 0;
    static R5ARG aa, ab, ba, bb;
    ULONG64 fa = 0;

    g_diskA = (unsigned char *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, 8u << 20, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    g_diskB = (unsigned char *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, 8u << 20, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!g_diskA || !g_diskB) return 1;
    for (fa = 0; fa < (4u << 20); fa++) { g_diskA[fa] = pat_f(fa, 0); g_diskB[fa] = pat_b(fa, 0); }

    {   rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
        cfg.max_bytes = (rb_u64)32 * 1024 * 1024;
        cfg.writeback = wb_fn5; cfg.readback = rb_fn5; cfg.block_size = 4096;
        g_eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
        g_st  = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 424242);
        g_stB = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 424243); }
    if (!g_eng || !g_st || !g_stB) return 1;

    aa.st = g_st;  aa.disk = g_diskA; aa.genp = &g_fgenA; aa.pat = pat_f; aa.tag = "A";
    ab.st = g_st;  ab.disk = g_diskA; ab.genp = &g_fgenA; ab.pat = pat_f; ab.tag = "A2";
    ba.st = g_stB; ba.disk = g_diskB; ba.genp = &g_fgenB; ba.pat = pat_b; ba.tag = "B";
    bb.st = g_stB; bb.disk = g_diskB; bb.genp = &g_fgenB; bb.pat = pat_b; bb.tag = "B2";

    printf("== mode5: dual-stream isolation (A on diskA, B on diskB), 30s ==\n");
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, relocator5, &aa, 0, NULL);   /* A relocator */
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, relocator5, &ba, 0, NULL);   /* B relocator (independent phase) */
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &aa, 0, NULL);
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &ab, 0, NULL);
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &ba, 0, NULL);
    th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader5, &bb, 0, NULL);

    Sleep(30000);
    InterlockedExchange(&g_stop, 1);
    Sleep(500);
    for (i = 0; i < nth; i++) WaitForSingleObject(th[i], 3000);
    rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1); rb_stream_flush(g_stB, 1);

    printf("== RESULT mode5: x_err=%ld (reads=%ld) ==\n", g_x_err, g_x_reads);
    printf("VERDICT: %s\n", g_x_err ? "CROSS-STREAM CONTAMINATION REPRODUCED" : "streams fully isolated");
    return g_x_err ? 2 : 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    HANDLE th[16]; int i, nth = 0;
    ULONG64 f_err0, c_err0;
    int mode = (argc > 1) ? atoi(argv[1]) : 0;   /* 0=full 1=readers-only 2=+writers 3=+trim 4=+relocator 5=dual-stream */
    if (argc > 2) g_gated = atoi(argv[2]);       /* 1=commit_gen (post-fix) 0=legacy ungated (pre-fix parity) */
    if (mode == 5) return run_mode5();

    g_disk = (unsigned char *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, DISK_SZ, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    g_gen  = (volatile LONG *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, CH_BLKS * sizeof(LONG), MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!g_disk || !g_gen) { printf("alloc fail\n"); return 1; }

    /* device initial state: F pattern; churn gen=0 content; TRIMV garbage */
    for (i = 0; i < (int)F_SZ; i++)  g_disk[F_OFF + i] = pat_f(i, 0);
    {   rb_u32 b; size_t k;
        for (b = 0; b < CH_BLKS; b++)
            for (k = 0; k < 4096; k++)
                g_disk[CH_OFF + (rb_u64)b * 4096 + k] = pat_churn(b, 0, k); }

    {   rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
        cfg.max_bytes = (rb_u64)32 * 1024 * 1024;
        cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn; cfg.block_size = 4096;
        g_eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
        g_st  = rb_stream_create(g_eng, 424242); }
    if (!g_eng || !g_st) { printf("engine/stream fail\n"); return 1; }

    printf("== test_race1106 mode=%d (4 readers%s%s%s%s) gated=%ld, 30s ==\n",
           mode,
           mode >= 2 ? " + 2 writers" : "",
           (mode == 0 || mode == 3 || mode == 4) ? " + trimmer" : "",
           mode == 0 ? " + passthrough" : "",
           mode >= 4 ? " + relocator" : "",
           g_gated);
    if (mode == 0 || mode == 3 || mode == 4) th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, trimmer, NULL, 0, NULL);
    if (mode == 0)                           th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, passthrough_cycler, NULL, 0, NULL);
    if (mode >= 4)                           th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, relocator, NULL, 0, NULL);
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, reader, NULL, 0, NULL);
    if (mode >= 2) for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) th[nth++] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, writer, NULL, 0, NULL);

    Sleep(30000);
    f_err0 = g_f_err; c_err0 = g_churn_err;
    InterlockedExchange(&g_stop, 1);
    Sleep(500);
    for (i = 0; i < nth; i++) WaitForSingleObject(th[i], 3000);

    rb_stream_flush(g_st, 1);

    /* final full verification of F through the cache.
     * [170 2026-11-12] 这一段以前只打印，结果不进退出码（判据无牙）。现在
     * bad / 读取失败 / f_err / churn_err 全部进判定，见下方 verdict 块。 */
    {   static unsigned char buf[256 * 1024]; int bad = 0;
        rb_u64 bad_off = 0; rb_u64 cell = 0;
        rb_u64 off; size_t k;
        for (off = F_OFF; off < F_OFF + F_SZ && !bad; off += 65536, cell++) {
            if (read_like_driver(off, buf, 65536, g_gated) == 0) {
                for (k = 0; k < 65536; k++)
                    if (buf[k] != pat_f(off + k, g_fgen)) {
                        bad = 1; bad_off = off + k;
                        printf("  [FINAL-F] cell=%llu off=%llu got=%02X want(gen=%ld)=%02X\n",
                               (unsigned long long)cell, (unsigned long long)bad_off,
                               buf[k], g_fgen, pat_f(off + k, g_fgen));
                        break;
                    }
            } else {
                bad = 1; bad_off = off;
                printf("  [FINAL-F] cell=%llu off=%llu read failed (miss-plan overflow)\n",
                       (unsigned long long)cell, (unsigned long long)off);
            }
        }
        printf("final F sweep: %s\n", bad ? "MISMATCH" : "clean");

        /* [170 2026-11-12] 判定口径（加严，不弱化既有语义）：
         *   1) mode3 的存量 C7 形态保持专属 exit 2：f_err==0 && bad==0 && churn_err>0
         *      → 已知时序敏感，先命中（优先级最高）。
         *   2) 其余情况只要 bad / f_err / churn_err 任一非零 → exit 1，并打印
         *      具体格子与断言；f_err0/c_err0（30s 窗口结束时的快照）与终值的
         *      差值一并打印，任何「快照之后才发生」的错误也不再被吞掉。
         * 旧判据只看 f_err0/c_err0 快照：最终扫描 MISMATCH 与快照后的增量都
         * 不影响 exit code → 已知缺陷，169/170 号记录。 */
        {   ULONG64 ferr = g_f_err, cerr = g_churn_err;
            ULONG64 f_delta = ferr - f_err0, c_delta = cerr - c_err0;
            printf("== RESULT: mode=%d gated=%ld f_err=%llu (reads=%llu f_reads=%llu) churn_err=%llu "
                   "final_bad=%d window_end(f=%llu c=%llu) delta(f=%llu c=%llu) ==\n",
                   mode, (long)g_gated, ferr, (unsigned long long)g_reads,
                   (unsigned long long)g_f_reads, cerr, bad,
                   f_err0, c_err0, f_delta, c_delta);
            if (mode == 3 && ferr == 0u && bad == 0 && cerr > 0u) {
                printf("VERDICT: KNOWN-UNSTABLE (C7: mode3 churn_err=%llu, f_err=0, "
                       "final F sweep clean) -> exit 2\n", cerr);
                return 2;
            }
            /* [170] 空跑保护：一次成功的 F 校验都没发生，说明读者线程/读路径整体
               没跑起来。此时 f_err/churn_err 必然为 0，若无此断言就会「零证据判绿」。
               f_reads 正常量级是 1e4（旧记录 reads≈13–21K），因此不会误报。 */
            if (g_f_reads == 0u) {
                printf("VERDICT: VACUOUS RUN (no successful F verification happened) -> exit 1\n");
                printf("  FAILED assertion: g_f_reads==0 (host never exercised the cache read path)\n");
                return 1;
            }
            if (bad || ferr != 0u || cerr != 0u) {
                printf("VERDICT: PERSISTENT WRONG-SERVE REPRODUCED (mode=%d gated=%ld) -> exit 1\n",
                       mode, (long)g_gated);
                if (bad)
                    printf("  FAILED assertion: final F sweep mismatch at off=%llu\n",
                           (unsigned long long)bad_off);
                if (ferr != 0u)
                    printf("  FAILED assertion: g_f_err=%llu (immutable-region serve corruption; "
                           "window_end=%llu delta=%llu)\n", ferr, f_err0, f_delta);
                if (cerr != 0u)
                    printf("  FAILED assertion: g_churn_err=%llu (stale/wrong churn serve; "
                           "window_end=%llu delta=%llu)\n", cerr, c_err0, c_delta);
                return 1;
            }
            printf("VERDICT: clean (no persistent stale serve; f_err=0 churn_err=0 "
                   "final F sweep clean) -> exit 0\n");
            return 0;
        }
    }
}
````
