##### `tests/core/test_spinfast.c`

````c
/* [OPT-SPIN 2026-11-02] rb_read_try_cache 自旋快路径并发正确性：
 *  - 快读者 vs 写者（撕裂检测：每子块自描述代际模式，块内字代必须一致）
 *  - 快读者 vs 驱逐（小 max_bytes 逼持续 chunk_create/chunk_free → ref 协议
 *    防 UAF，ASan 构建下任何释放竞态即爆）
 *  - 快读者 vs invalidate（回滚窗口读旧代=合法，代 ≤ 当前即通过）
 *  - 快读者 vs flush（回写落盘后读回源，代仍自描述）
 * 写者只做整子块对齐写（保证"子块内单代"不变式，撕裂检测才精确）；
 * 部分覆盖/非对齐路径由 test_write_ex/edge_* 覆盖，不在本测试目标内。
 * 两相位：bs=4096（16MB 区/4096 子块）与 bs=65536（16MB 区/256 子块）。 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "cache.h"
#ifdef _MSC_VER
#include "pthread.h"
#else
#include <pthread.h>
#endif

#define REGION_BYTES  (16ull*1024*1024)   /* 两相位同区 16MB */
#ifdef _MSC_VER
static void ts_yield(void){ Sleep(0); }
#else
static void ts_yield(void){ usleep(200); }
#endif

static unsigned char *g_disk;        /* 盘面影子（回写/回源） */
static pthread_mutex_t g_disk_mx;
static volatile LONG *g_subgen;      /* 每子块当前代（自增） */
static rb_u32 g_sub_bytes;           /* 相位几何：子块=引擎 block_size */
static rb_u32 g_nsubs;               /* 子块总数 */
static rb_engine *g_eng;
static rb_stream *g_str;
static volatile long g_stop;
static volatile long g_hits, g_miss, g_tornfail;

static int wb(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *d, size_t len){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
    memcpy(g_disk+off,d,len);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
    return 0;
}
static int rbk(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
    memcpy(buf,g_disk+off,len);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
    return 0;
}
static void fill_gen(unsigned char *buf, rb_u64 gen){
    rb_u64 *w=(rb_u64 *)buf; rb_u32 i,n=g_sub_bytes/8;
    for(i=0;i<n;i++) w[i]=((rb_u64)gen<<32)|(rb_u64)i;
}
/* 校验 [off,off+len) 每子块内 8 字节字代一致且 ≤ 当前代；返回破坏数 */
static volatile long g_diag_n=0;
static void diag(const char *tag,rb_u64 off,rb_u32 sub,rb_u64 gen0,long cur,
                 const rb_u64 *w,rb_u32 n){
    long i=RB_AADD32((volatile LONG*)&g_diag_n,1);
    if(i>3)return;
    printf("  [DIAG %s] off=%llu sub=%u gen0=%llu cur=%ld w0=%016llx w1=%016llx w2=%016llx\n",
           tag,(unsigned long long)off,sub,(unsigned long long)gen0,cur,
           (unsigned long long)w[0],(unsigned long long)w[1],(unsigned long long)w[2]);
    fflush(stdout);
}
static long validate(const unsigned char *buf, rb_u64 off, size_t len){
    long bad=0;
    size_t p=0;
    while(p<len){
        const rb_u64 *w=(const rb_u64 *)(buf+p);
        rb_u64 gen0=w[0]>>32; rb_u32 k,n=g_sub_bytes/8;
        rb_u32 sub=(rb_u32)(((off+p)/g_sub_bytes)%g_nsubs);
        long cur=(long)RB_ALOAD32((volatile LONG *)&g_subgen[sub]);
        for(k=1;k<n;k++){
            if((w[k]>>32)!=gen0){ diag("TEAR",off+p,sub,gen0,cur,w,n); bad++; break; }
        }
        if(gen0>(rb_u64)(cur<0?0:cur)){ diag("FUTURE",off+p,sub,gen0,cur,w,n); bad++; }
        p+=g_sub_bytes;
    }
    return bad;
}

static void *writer_fn(void *arg){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(size_t)arg; unsigned char *buf=malloc(g_sub_bytes);
    while(!g_stop){
        rb_u32 sub=(rb_u32)((seed=(seed*1103515245u+12345u)>>16)%g_nsubs);
        long g=(long)RB_AADD32((volatile LONG *)&g_subgen[sub],1);
        fill_gen(buf,(rb_u64)g);
        { rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dc=0,q;
          if(rb_write(g_str,(rb_u64)sub*g_sub_bytes,buf,g_sub_bytes,dr,&dc,8)!=0){ diag("WBAD",(rb_u64)sub*g_sub_bytes,sub,0,0,(const rb_u64*)buf,g_sub_bytes/8); g_tornfail++; }
          /* 直写/降级区间落盘影子：保盘面自描述 */
          pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
          for(q=0;q<dc&&q<8;q++)
              if(dr[q].len)
                  memcpy(g_disk+dr[q].offset,buf,dr[q].len<(size_t)g_sub_bytes?dr[q].len:(size_t)g_sub_bytes);
          pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx); }
        ts_yield();
    }
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
}
static void *reader_fn(void *arg){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(size_t)arg*7919u+1u;
    unsigned char *buf=malloc(1024*1024);
    while(!g_stop){
        rb_u32 sub; size_t len;
        /* 80% 读热窗口（前 1/8 区）提高快路径命中覆盖，20% 全区随机 */
        if((seed & 0x07u)!=0) sub=(rb_u32)(((seed=(seed*1103515245u+12345u)>>16))%(g_nsubs/8+1));
        else                  sub=(rb_u32)(((seed=(seed*1103515245u+12345u)>>16))%g_nsubs);
        len=g_sub_bytes*(size_t)(1u+((seed>>8)&0x0Fu));   /* 1-16 子块读 */
        if((rb_u64)sub*g_sub_bytes+len>REGION_BYTES) len=g_sub_bytes;
        if(rb_read_try_cache(g_str,(rb_u64)sub*g_sub_bytes,buf,len)==1){
            RB_AADD32((volatile LONG *)&g_hits,1);
            if(validate(buf,(rb_u64)sub*g_sub_bytes,len)) g_tornfail++;
        }else{
            /* worker 路径：rb_read 只填命中段，miss 区间必须回源（盘面影子）
             * 并 commit——与驱动 worker 流程一致 */
            RB_AADD32((volatile LONG *)&g_miss,1);
            { rb_direct_range miss[64]; int mc=0,q; int bad=0;
              rb_u64 rs=(rb_u64)sub*g_sub_bytes, re=rs+len;
              if(rb_read(g_str,rs,buf,len,miss,&mc,64)<0) bad=1;   /* rb_read 契约：0=纯miss 1=有命中 <0=错误 */
              for(q=0;!bad&&q<mc&&q<64;q++){
                  /* [W1.5] miss 区间按整子块对齐返回，两端可超出请求窗口——
                   * 调用方必须钳位到 [rs,re) 再回填（否则缓冲区越界） */
                  rb_u64 lo=miss[q].offset, hi=miss[q].offset+miss[q].len;
                  if(lo<rs)lo=rs; if(hi>re)hi=re;
                  if(lo<hi){
                      pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
                      memcpy(buf+(size_t)(lo-rs), g_disk+lo, (size_t)(hi-lo));
                      pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
                      rb_read_commit(g_str,lo,buf+(size_t)(lo-rs),(size_t)(hi-lo));
                  }
              }
              if(!bad && mc>64){ diag("MOVF",rs,sub,0,(long)mc,(const rb_u64*)buf,4); bad=1; }
              if(!bad && validate(buf,rs,len)) g_tornfail++;
              if(bad){ diag("RBAD",rs,sub,0,(long)mc,(const rb_u64*)buf,4); g_tornfail++; } }
        }
        ts_yield();
    }
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
}
static void *inval_fn(void *arg){
    unsigned seed=(unsigned)(size_t)arg*31u+7u;
    rb_u32 span=g_nsubs/8; if(!span)span=1;
    while(!g_stop){
        rb_u32 sub=(rb_u32)(((seed=(seed*1103515245u+12345u)>>16))%(g_nsubs-span));
        rb_stream_invalidate_range(g_str,(rb_u64)sub*g_sub_bytes,(rb_u64)span*g_sub_bytes);
        ts_yield();
    }
    return NULL;
}
static void *flush_fn(void *arg){
    (void)arg;
    while(!g_stop){ rb_stream_flush(g_str,0); ts_yield(); }
    return NULL;
}

static int run_phase(rb_u32 bs, int secs){
    pthread_t th[8]; int i, fail=0;
    long hf, mf, tf;
    printf("--- spinfast bs=%u %ds ---\n",bs,secs); fflush(stdout);
    g_sub_bytes=bs; g_nsubs=(rb_u32)(REGION_BYTES/bs);
    g_disk=calloc((size_t)REGION_BYTES,1);
    g_subgen=calloc(g_nsubs,sizeof(LONG));
    g_hits=g_miss=g_tornfail=0; g_stop=0;
    pthread_mutex_init(&g_disk_mx,NULL);
    { rb_config c; memset(&c,0,sizeof(c));
      c.max_bytes=4ull*1024*1024;   /* 驱逐压力：缓存远小于区 */
      c.writeback=wb; c.readback=rbk; c.block_size=bs;
      g_eng=rb_engine_create(&c);
      if(!g_eng){ printf("[FAIL] create\n"); return 1; } }
    g_str=rb_stream_create(g_eng,1);
    /* 初始盘面=代0 全量（供 invalidate 后回源）+ 引擎预热 */
    { unsigned char *z=malloc(g_sub_bytes);
      rb_u32 k;
      for(k=0;k<g_nsubs;k++){
          fill_gen(z,0);
          pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
          memcpy(g_disk+(size_t)k*g_sub_bytes,z,g_sub_bytes);
          pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
          { rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dc=0;
            rb_write(g_str,(rb_u64)k*g_sub_bytes,z,g_sub_bytes,dr,&dc,8); }
      }
      free(z); }
    pthread_create(&th[0],NULL,writer_fn,(void*)1u);
    pthread_create(&th[1],NULL,writer_fn,(void*)2u);
    pthread_create(&th[2],NULL,reader_fn,(void*)1u);
    pthread_create(&th[3],NULL,reader_fn,(void*)2u);
    pthread_create(&th[4],NULL,reader_fn,(void*)3u);
    pthread_create(&th[5],NULL,inval_fn,(void*)1u);
    pthread_create(&th[6],NULL,flush_fn,NULL);
    { int ms=secs*1000; while(ms>0){ Sleep(20); ms-=20; } }
    g_stop=1;
    for(i=0;i<7;i++) pthread_join(th[i],NULL);
    hf=(long)RB_ALOAD32((volatile LONG *)&g_hits);
    mf=(long)RB_ALOAD32((volatile LONG *)&g_miss);
    tf=(long)RB_ALOAD32((volatile LONG *)&g_tornfail);
    printf("  hit=%ld miss=%ld torn/fail=%ld\n",hf,mf,tf); fflush(stdout);
    if(tf){ printf("[FAIL] torn/fail>0\n"); fail=1; }
    if(hf==0){ printf("[FAIL] zero fast-path hits (path dead?)\n"); fail=1; }
    rb_stream_destroy(g_str);
    rb_engine_destroy(g_eng);
    pthread_mutex_destroy(&g_disk_mx);
    free(g_disk); free((void*)g_subgen);
    if(fail) return 1;
    printf("[ok] spinfast bs=%u\n",bs);
    return 0;
}

int main(void){
    int fail=0;
    fail|=run_phase(4096,3);
    fail|=run_phase(65536,3);
    printf(fail? "SPINFAST FAILED\n" : "SPINFAST PASS\n");
    return fail;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_tinylfu.c`

````c
/*
 * test_tinylfu.c -- [F1 2026-11-06] TinyLFU 频率准入回归
 *
 * 场景（OFF / ON 两组，同序列同盘面，模拟驱动读路径）：
 *   ① 热集 A [0,256KB) 反复读 6 遍：首遍 miss -> rb_read_commit 回填并置 loaded，
 *      后续命中；同时 lfu_note 累积访问频率。
 *   ② 施加 MOD 压力（准入开关生效，但不主动淘汰）。
 *   ③ 顺序扫描 B [256KB,2MB)：每 4K 读一次，一次性冷数据频率=1，
 *      读回填路径同样经过 lfu_admit。
 *   ④ 落净脏块、调小上限并施加 HIGH 压力，强制 evict_select 淘汰；
 *      ON 时频率感知淘汰优先丢弃低频扫描块，OFF 时纯 LRU 会丢最旧的热集。
 *   ⑤ 复读热集 A，统计「全命中」次数。
 *
 * 断言：
 *   · OFF 组 tinylfu_rejects == 0（关闭时行为逐字不变）；
 *   · ON  组 tinylfu_rejects >  0；
 *   · ON  组热集命中严格多于 OFF 组且 > 0（防扫描冲掉热集）；
 *   · 落盘前 wb_fn oracle、读出内容 == pat(off)、lost_dirty/dirty/chunk_count 全 0。
 *
 * 拒绝准入只让本次「不缓存」（读下盘），不改变数据正确性。
 * 编译单元 = test_tinylfu.c + cache.c（Release + ASAN）。
 */
#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define DISK_SZ   (4ull << 20)
#define HOT_SZ    (256ull << 10)
#define SCAN_END  (2ull << 20)
#define CACHE_MB  (512ull << 10)
#define SHRINK_MB (256ull << 10)

static unsigned char *g_disk;
static int g_bad;

static unsigned char pat(rb_u64 off)
{
    rb_u64 x = off ^ (off >> 11);
    x *= 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull;
    return (unsigned char)((x >> 17) ^ (x >> 3) ^ 0x5au);
}
static void disk_reset(void)
{
    rb_u64 o;
    for (o = 0; o < DISK_SZ; o++) g_disk[o] = pat(o);
}
static int rb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, void *b, size_t n)
{
    (void)u; (void)fid;
    if (off + n > DISK_SZ) { g_bad++; return 1; }
    memcpy(b, g_disk + (size_t)off, n);
    return 0;
}
static int wb_fn(void *u, rb_u64 fid, rb_u64 off, const void *b, size_t n)
{
    const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)b;
    size_t k;
    (void)u; (void)fid;
    if (off + n > DISK_SZ) { g_bad++; return 1; }
    for (k = 0; k < n; k++)
        if (p[k] != pat(off + k)) { g_bad++; break; }
    memcpy(g_disk + (size_t)off, p, n);
    return 0;
}

/* 驱动同款读：缓存读 -> miss 区间从盘取 -> rb_read_commit 回填 -> 拷回用户缓冲 */
static int do_read(rb_stream *s, rb_u64 off, unsigned char *buf, size_t len, int *full_hit)
{
    rb_direct_range m[8];
    int mc = 0, i, r;
    *full_hit = 0;
    r = rb_read(s, off, buf, len, m, &mc, 8);
    if (r == -2) { g_bad++; return -2; }
    *full_hit = (r == 1 && mc == 0);
    for (i = 0; i < mc && i < 8; i++) {
        size_t n = m[i].len;
        unsigned char *tmp;
        rb_u64 s0, s1;
        if (m[i].offset + n > DISK_SZ) { g_bad++; continue; }
        tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(n);
        if (!tmp) { g_bad++; return -2; }
        memcpy(tmp, g_disk + (size_t)m[i].offset, n);
        rb_read_commit(s, m[i].offset, tmp, n);
        s0 = m[i].offset > off ? m[i].offset : off;
        s1 = (m[i].offset + n) < (off + len) ? (m[i].offset + n) : (off + len);
        if (s1 > s0) memcpy(buf + (size_t)(s0 - off), g_disk + (size_t)s0, (size_t)(s1 - s0));
        free(tmp);
    }
    {
        size_t k;
        for (k = 0; k < len; k++)
            if (buf[k] != pat(off + k)) { g_bad++; break; }
    }
    return r;
}

static int run_case(int on, int *hot_hits, rb_u64 *rejects)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *e; rb_stream *s; rb_stats st;
    unsigned char buf[65536];
    rb_u64 off; int i, hit;

    disk_reset();
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = CACHE_MB;
    cfg.block_size = 4096;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    cfg.tinylfu = on;
    e = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = e ? rb_stream_create(e, 1) : NULL;
    if (!e || !s) { printf("  [FAIL] engine/stream create\n"); return 1; }

    /* ① 热集反复读 6 遍，积累频率 */
    for (i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        for (off = 0; off < HOT_SZ; off += 4096)
            if (do_read(s, off, buf, 4096, &hit) == -2) return 1;

    {   /* 诊断：预热后热集是否真的驻留 */
        int wh=0; rb_u64 o2; rb_stats ws;
        for(o2=0;o2<HOT_SZ;o2+=4096){
            if(do_read(s,o2,buf,4096,&hit)==-2)return 1;
            if(hit)wh++;
        }
        rb_engine_get_stats(e,&ws);
        printf("  diag on=%d warm_hits=%d/64 cur=%llu chunks=%llu\n",
               on, wh, (unsigned long long)ws.cur_bytes, (unsigned long long)ws.chunk_count);
    }

    /* ② MOD 压力：准入生效，不主动淘汰 */
    rb_engine_apply_pressure(e, 1);

    /* ③ 一次性顺序扫描（冷数据） */
    for (off = HOT_SZ; off < SCAN_END; off += 4096)
        if (do_read(s, off, buf, 4096, &hit) == -2) return 1;

    /* ④ 落净、调小上限、强制淘汰 */
    { rb_stats d;
      rb_engine_get_stats(e,&d); printf("  diag on=%d pre cur=%llu chunks=%llu\n",on,(unsigned long long)d.cur_bytes,(unsigned long long)d.chunk_count); }
    rb_engine_flush(e, 1);
    { rb_stats d;
      rb_engine_get_stats(e,&d); printf("  diag on=%d flush cur=%llu chunks=%llu\n",on,(unsigned long long)d.cur_bytes,(unsigned long long)d.chunk_count); }
    rb_engine_set_max_bytes(e, SHRINK_MB);
    rb_engine_apply_pressure(e, 2);
    { rb_stats d;
      rb_engine_get_stats(e,&d); printf("  diag on=%d press cur=%llu chunks=%llu lvl=%u\n",on,(unsigned long long)d.cur_bytes,(unsigned long long)d.chunk_count,d.pressure_level); }

    /* ⑤ 复读热集 */
    *hot_hits = 0;
    for (off = 0; off < HOT_SZ; off += 4096) {
        if (do_read(s, off, buf, 4096, &hit) == -2) return 1;
        if (hit) (*hot_hits)++;
    }
    rb_engine_get_stats(e, &st);
    *rejects = st.tinylfu_rejects;
    if (st.dirty_bytes || st.lost_dirty_bytes) g_bad++;
    printf("  case tinylfu=%d: hot_hits=%d/64 rejects=%llu admits=%llu dirty=%llu lost=%llu cur=%llu chunks=%llu\n",
           on, *hot_hits, (unsigned long long)st.tinylfu_rejects,
           (unsigned long long)st.tinylfu_admits,
           (unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.cur_bytes,
           (unsigned long long)st.chunk_count);

    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_get_stats(e, &st);
    if (st.chunk_count) g_bad++;
    rb_engine_destroy(e);
    return 0;
}

int main(void)
{
    int h_off = 0, h_on = 0, bad = 0;
    rb_u64 r_off = 0, r_on = 0;

    g_disk = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)DISK_SZ);
    if (!g_disk) { printf("oom\n"); return 1; }
    printf("== test_tinylfu: TinyLFU admission OFF/ON comparison ==\n");
    bad += run_case(0, &h_off, &r_off);
    bad += run_case(1, &h_on, &r_on);

    printf("  OFF: hits=%d rejects=%llu | ON: hits=%d rejects=%llu\n",
           h_off, (unsigned long long)r_off, h_on, (unsigned long long)r_on);
    if (r_off != 0) { printf("  [FAIL] OFF must have zero rejections\n"); bad++; }
    if (r_on == 0)  { printf("  [FAIL] ON produced no admission decision\n"); bad++; }
    if (h_on <= h_off) { printf("  [FAIL] ON did not preserve more hot blocks than OFF\n"); bad++; }
    if (h_on == 0) { printf("  [FAIL] ON preserved no hot blocks at all\n"); bad++; }
    if (g_bad) { printf("  [FAIL] oracle/accounting violations=%d\n", g_bad); bad++; }

    free(g_disk);
    if (bad) { printf("test_tinylfu: FAIL (%d)\n", bad); return 1; }
    printf("test_tinylfu: PASS (OFF unchanged, ON admits by frequency, hot set preserved)\n");
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_v5.c`

````c
/*
 * RAMBoostFS V5 新增功能回归测试（Linux/gcc 可编译运行）
 *
 * 覆盖：
 *  T1 在线水位同步：rb_engine_set_watermarks_pct 后高/低水位立即生效
 *  T2 need_flush 标志：脏数据超高水位后 rb_engine_need_flush()==1
 *  T3 跨块合并回写：相邻两块全脏 128KB，回写回调应收到 ≥1 次合并段（128KB），
 *     而非拆成两次 64KB；磁盘数据逐字节正确
 *  T4 合并边界竞争：相邻块第二块前导子块被部分清理时，合并自动退化为单块，数据仍正确
 */

#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define DISK_SIZE (64u * 1024u * 1024u)
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static int g_fail = 0;

/* 记录回写回调观察到的最大段长（验证跨块合并） */
static size_t g_max_seg = 0;
static int    g_wb_calls = 0;

static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
    return 0;
}

static int wb_fn_probe(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (len > g_max_seg) g_max_seg = len;
    g_wb_calls++;
    return wb_fn(ctx, file_id, off, data, len);
}

#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); g_fail++; } \
    else { printf("  [ok]   " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); } \
} while (0)

static void fill_pattern(unsigned char *p, size_t n, rb_u64 base)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = (unsigned char)((base + i) * 31u + 7u);
}

/* T1 + T2 */
static void test_watermarks_and_need_flush(void)
{
    printf("== T1/T2: 在线水位同步 + need_flush 标志 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.high_water = 8ull * 1024 * 1024 * 60 / 100;
    cfg.low_water  = 8ull * 1024 * 1024 * 40 / 100;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 1);

    /* 默认 60/40 -> 高水位 4.8MB */
    CHECK(!rb_engine_need_flush(eng), "初始 need_flush=0");

    /* 写 2MB（低于默认高水位）-> 不应置 need_flush */
    char w[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), 0x11);
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < 2 * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096) {
        rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
        rb_write(s, i, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
        if (dc > 16) memcpy(g_disk + i, w, sizeof(w));
        else { int k; for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
                   memcpy(g_disk + direct[k].offset, w + (direct[k].offset - i), direct[k].len); }
    }
    CHECK(!rb_engine_need_flush(eng), "2MB 脏数据未超 60%% 高水位，need_flush=0");

    /* 把高水位调低到 10% (0.8MB)：2MB 已超 -> need_flush 应置位（由下一次写触发检查） */
    rb_engine_set_watermarks_pct(eng, 10, 5);
    /* 再写一个子块触发 rb_write 尾部水位检查 */
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 2 * 1024 * 1024, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
    if (dc > 16) memcpy(g_disk + 2 * 1024 * 1024, w, sizeof(w));
    else { int k; for (k = 0; k < dc; k++)
               memcpy(g_disk + direct[k].offset, w + (direct[k].offset - 2 * 1024 * 1024), direct[k].len); }
    CHECK(rb_engine_need_flush(eng), "水位下调后 need_flush=1");

    /* 强制回写后 need_flush 应被清（脏=0） */
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(!rb_engine_need_flush(eng), "全量回写后 need_flush=0");

    /* 高水位恢复默认：写 3MB 应低于默认 60% -> 不置位 */
    rb_engine_set_watermarks_pct(eng, 0, 0);
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    for (i = 0; i < 3 * 1024 * 1024; i += 4096) {
        rb_direct_range d2[16]; int dc2 = 0;
        rb_write(s, 8 * 1024 * 1024 + i, w, sizeof(w), d2, &dc2, 16);
        if (dc2 > 16) memcpy(g_disk + 8 * 1024 * 1024 + i, w, sizeof(w));
        else { int k; for (k = 0; k < dc2; k++)
                   memcpy(g_disk + d2[k].offset, w + (d2[k].offset - (8 * 1024 * 1024 + i)), d2[k].len); }
    }
    CHECK(!rb_engine_need_flush(eng), "恢复默认 60%% 后 3MB 不触发 need_flush");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* T3: 跨块合并回写 */
static void test_cross_chunk_merge(void)
{
    printf("== T3: 跨块合并回写（128KB 单次写盘） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn_probe;
    cfg.max_merge_len = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 2);

    g_max_seg = 0; g_wb_calls = 0;
    /* 连续写 128KB（两块全脏，边界连续） */
    char data[128 * 1024];
    fill_pattern((unsigned char *)data, sizeof(data), 0xABCD);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, data, sizeof(data), direct, &dc, 16);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "128KB 全部入缓存（无直写）");
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(g_max_seg >= 128 * 1024, "回写收到 ≥1 次 128KB 合并段（最大段=%zu）", g_max_seg);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, data, sizeof(data)) == 0, "合并回写后磁盘数据逐字节一致");

    /* 再写一块（块2）与块3 全脏但中间有边界 -> 仍应合并 */
    fill_pattern((unsigned char *)data, sizeof(data), 0x5A5A);
    dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 2 * 1024 * 1024, data, sizeof(data), direct, &dc, 16);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "第二组 128KB 全部入缓存");
    g_max_seg = 0;
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(g_max_seg >= 128 * 1024, "第二组同样合并（最大段=%zu）", g_max_seg);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 2 * 1024 * 1024, data, sizeof(data)) == 0, "第二组合并回写磁盘一致");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* T4: 边界竞争退化（第二块前导子块不全脏时不可合并，数据仍正确） */
static void test_merge_boundary_fallback(void)
{
    printf("== T4: 边界不全脏时合并自动退化为单块 ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn_probe;
    cfg.max_merge_len = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 3);

    /* 块0 全部脏；块1 只脏子块 1..15（子块0 不脏 -> 边界不连续，不可合并） */
    char a[64 * 1024], b[64 * 1024];
    fill_pattern((unsigned char *)a, sizeof(a), 0x101);
    fill_pattern((unsigned char *)b, sizeof(b), 0x202);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, a, sizeof(a), direct, &dc, 16);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "块0 写入缓存");
    dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 64 * 1024 + 4096, b + 4096, 60 * 1024, direct, &dc, 16);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "块1 子块1..15 写入缓存");

    g_max_seg = 0;
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(g_max_seg <= 64 * 1024, "边界不连续：最大回写段≤64KB（最大段=%zu）", g_max_seg);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, a, sizeof(a)) == 0, "块0 磁盘一致");
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 64 * 1024 + 4096, b + 4096, 60 * 1024) == 0, "块1 磁盘一致");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

int main(void)
{
    g_disk = (unsigned char *)malloc(DISK_SIZE);
    if (!g_disk) { printf("无法分配模拟磁盘\n"); return 1; }
    memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);
    fill_pattern(g_disk, DISK_SIZE, 0x2222);

    test_watermarks_and_need_flush();
    test_cross_chunk_merge();
    test_merge_boundary_fallback();

    printf("\n%s  (失败 %d)\n", g_fail ? "存在失败用例" : "全部用例通过", g_fail);
    free(g_disk);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

````c
/*
 * RAMBoostFS V6 第二轮验收回归测试（Linux/gcc 可编译运行）
 *
 * 来源：PrimoCache 更新日志映射 + 第二轮隐性 bug 深挖。
 *
 * T1 写放大（PrimoCache v3.0.1 曾修"实际写入 > 请求写入"）：
 *    只写子块 0 与 15，回写总量必须恰好 8KB，不得回写整 64KB。
 * T2 截断一致性（原驱动缺 IRP_MJ_SET_INFORMATION，严重）：
 *    写 256KB 后截断到 64KB / 100KB，回写不得越界、读截断区必须 miss、
 *    非对齐截断尾部零填充。
 * T3 写后释放（移植 PrimoCache"写入后释放相应缓存"）：
 *    回写后缓存块必须释放，再读为 miss。
 * T4 EOF 零语义（RMW 补读在 EOF 之外）：
 *    readback 返回 1（零填充），1KB 写在 100KB 处应整子块缓存，
 *    回写 4KB，用户数据在前、零尾。
 * T5 丢弃全部（删除挂起路径）：discard 后无回写、占用归零。
 */

#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define DISK_SIZE (64u * 1024u * 1024u)
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static int g_fail = 0;

/* 回写探针：总写入字节 + 各调用计数 */
static size_t g_wb_total = 0;
static int    g_wb_calls = 0;

static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
    g_wb_total += len; g_wb_calls++;
    return 0;
}

static int rb_eof_zero(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id; (void)off;
    memset(buf, 0, len);
    return 0;   /* FIX[R1] 契约对齐：0=成功（零填充也是成功）；非 0 一律按“读失败”走直写兜底 */
}

#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); g_fail++; } \
    else { printf("  [ok]   " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); } \
} while (0)

static void fill_pattern(unsigned char *p, size_t n, rb_u64 base)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = (unsigned char)((base + i) * 31u + 7u);
}

/* T1: 无写放大 */
static void test_no_write_amplification(void)
{
    printf("== T1: 写放大（只写子块 0/15，回写必须恰好 8KB） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 1);

    char w[4096]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), 0x31);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, w, 4096, direct, &dc, 16);
    dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 60 * 1024, w, 4096, direct, &dc, 16);
    g_wb_total = 0; g_wb_calls = 0;
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(g_wb_total == 8192, "回写总量 = 8KB（实际 %zu）", g_wb_total);
    CHECK(g_wb_calls == 2, "回写 2 次（实际 %d）", g_wb_calls);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, w, 4096) == 0, "子块0 磁盘一致");
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 60 * 1024, w, 4096) == 0, "子块15 磁盘一致");
    CHECK(g_disk[4096] == 0 && g_disk[59 * 1024] == 0, "中间未写子块保持零");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* T2: 截断一致性 */
static void test_truncate(void)
{
    printf("== T2: 截断一致性（256KB -> 64KB / 100KB） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 16ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 2);

    static char data[256 * 1024];
    fill_pattern((unsigned char *)data, sizeof(data), 0x77);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, data, sizeof(data), direct, &dc, 16);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "256KB 全部入缓存");

    g_wb_total = 0;
    rb_stream_truncate(s, 64 * 1024);
    CHECK(g_wb_total == 64 * 1024, "截断到 64KB：只回写 64KB（实际 %zu）", g_wb_total);

    /* 读截断区：必须 miss */
    char rbuf[4096]; rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    int r = rb_read(s, 128 * 1024, rbuf, 4096, miss, &mc, 16);
    CHECK(r == 0 && mc == 1, "读 128KB（截断区）为 miss");
    /* 读保留区：命中 */
    mc = 0;
    r = rb_read(s, 0, rbuf, 4096, miss, &mc, 16);
    CHECK(r == 1 && mc == 0, "读 0（保留区）命中");
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, data, 64 * 1024) == 0, "磁盘 0..64KB 一致");
    CHECK(g_disk[128 * 1024] == 0, "磁盘 128KB 未被回写（无复活）");

    /* 非对齐截断：256KB -> 100KB */
    dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, data, sizeof(data), direct, &dc, 16);
    g_wb_total = 0;
    rb_stream_truncate(s, 100 * 1024);
    /* 100KB = 25 个 4KB 子块：chunk0 16 个 + chunk1 前 9 个（64..100KB） */
    CHECK(g_wb_total == 100 * 1024, "截断到 100KB：回写 100KB（实际 %zu）", g_wb_total);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, data, 100 * 1024) == 0, "磁盘 0..100KB 数据一致");
    {
        size_t k; int tailZero = 1;
        for (k = 100 * 1024; k < 128 * 1024; k++)
            if (g_disk[k] != 0) { tailZero = 0; break; }
        CHECK(tailZero, "磁盘 100..128KB 尾部零填充");
    }

    /* 真正非对齐：256KB -> 100KB+100B */
    dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, data, sizeof(data), direct, &dc, 16);
    g_wb_total = 0;
    rb_stream_truncate(s, 100 * 1024 + 100);
    /* chunk0 64KB + chunk1 subs0..8 36KB + 边界子块9 4KB = 104KB */
    CHECK(g_wb_total == 104 * 1024, "截断到 100KB+100B：回写 104KB（实际 %zu）", g_wb_total);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk, data, 100 * 1024 + 100) == 0, "磁盘 0..100KB+100 数据一致");
    {
        size_t k; int tailZero = 1;
        for (k = 100 * 1024 + 100; k < 128 * 1024; k++)
            if (g_disk[k] != 0) { tailZero = 0; break; }
        CHECK(tailZero, "磁盘 100KB+100..128KB 零填充（含边界子块尾部）");
    }

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* T3: 写后释放 */
static void test_write_release(void)
{
    printf("== T3: 写后释放（回写后块释放） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    cfg.write_release = 1;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 3);

    char data[128 * 1024];
    fill_pattern((unsigned char *)data, sizeof(data), 0x99);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, data, sizeof(data), direct, &dc, 16);
    rb_stats st;
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes == 128 * 1024, "回写前占用 128KB");
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes == 0, "回写后占用归零（实际 %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.cur_bytes);
    char rbuf[4096]; rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    CHECK(rb_read(s, 0, rbuf, 4096, miss, &mc, 16) == 0 && mc == 1,
          "释放后再读为 miss");

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* T4: EOF 零语义 */
static void test_eof_zero(void)
{
    printf("== T4: EOF 零语义（1KB 写在 100KB，整子块缓存） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    cfg.readback = rb_eof_zero;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 4);

    char w[1024]; fill_pattern((unsigned char *)w, sizeof(w), 0x55);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 100 * 1024, w, sizeof(w), direct, &dc, 16);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "1KB 写经 EOF 零语义整子块入缓存（无直写）");
    g_wb_total = 0;
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    CHECK(g_wb_total == 4096, "回写 4KB（实际 %zu）", g_wb_total);
    CHECK(memcmp(g_disk + 100 * 1024, w, 1024) == 0, "前 1KB 为用户数据");
    {
        int tailZero = 1, k;
        for (k = 1024; k < 4096; k++)
            if (g_disk[100 * 1024 + k] != 0) { tailZero = 0; break; }
        CHECK(tailZero, "后 3KB 零填充");
    }

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* T5: 丢弃全部 */
static void test_discard_all(void)
{
    printf("== T5: 丢弃全部（删除挂起路径） ==\n");
    rb_config cfg; memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn;
    rb_engine *eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    rb_stream *s = rb_stream_create(eng, 5);

    char data[128 * 1024];
    fill_pattern((unsigned char *)data, sizeof(data), 0xCC);
    rb_direct_range direct[16]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write(s, 0, data, sizeof(data), direct, &dc, 16);
    g_wb_total = 0;
    rb_stream_discard_all(s);
    rb_stats st; rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes == 0, "丢弃后占用归零（实际 %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.cur_bytes);
    CHECK(g_wb_total == 0, "丢弃不触发回写（实际 %zu）", g_wb_total);

    rb_stream_destroy(s); rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

int main(void)
{
    g_disk = (unsigned char *)malloc(DISK_SIZE);
    if (!g_disk) { printf("无法分配模拟磁盘\n"); return 1; }
    memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);

    test_no_write_amplification();
    test_truncate();
    test_write_release();
    test_eof_zero();
    test_discard_all();

    printf("\n%s  (失败 %d)\n", g_fail ? "存在失败用例" : "全部用例通过", g_fail);
    free(g_disk);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

##### `tests/core/test_write_ex.c`

````c
/*
 * test_write_ex.c —— [D1] 写路径锁合并（rb_write_ex）用户态验证
 *
 * 覆盖项（与 deliverables/memlevel-perf-design-2026-10-20.md §七 对应）：
 *   ① 快照等价：rb_write_ex 的 pre 采集 vs 旧"先 rb_stream_dirty_mask
 *      再 rb_write"两调用序列——mask/dseq/base/bits 逐位一致
 *      （缺 chunk 子块 dseq=0：双侧缓冲预清零后旧 API 与新 API 同构）；
 *   ② 记账等价：C7 失效语义逐场景（回滚写前未脏/已脏/superseded/无证据/
 *      混合子块恢复/失败写新建块）lost_dirty_bytes 与旧流程相等；
 *   ③ max_bits 不足 → 写成功 + bits=-1 + 调用方防御分支（保守记账）；
 *   ④ rb_write 收壳行为不变（契约守卫/吸收/len==0/统计不双计/C7 记账）。
 *
 * 语义边界（设计 §一-D1 / §九-8）：新流程采集窗口从"两次锁之间"缩为零，
 * 记账"只紧不松"——本测试以旧流程序列为对照组，断言相等；单线程下旧流程
 * 无窗口竞态，故逐场景严格相等（并发窗口优势由 test_wsconc 兜底）。
 *
 * 编译单元 = test_write_ex.c + cache.c（build_all.bat 常规行，Release+ASAN）。
 */

#include "cache.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define DISK_SIZE (32u * 1024u * 1024)
#define SUB       4096u
#define CHUNK     (64u * 1024u)
static unsigned char *g_disk;
static int g_fail = 0;

#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); g_fail++; } \
    else { printf("  [ok]   " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); } \
} while (0)

static int wb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(g_disk + off, data, len);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void *ctx, rb_u64 file_id, rb_u64 off, void *buf, size_t len)
{
    (void)ctx; (void)file_id;
    if (off + len > DISK_SIZE) return -1;
    memcpy(buf, g_disk + off, len);
    return 0;
}
static void fill_pattern(unsigned char *p, size_t n, rb_u64 base)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = (unsigned char)((base + i) * 31u + 7u);
}
static rb_stats eng_stats(rb_engine *eng)
{
    rb_stats st; memset(&st, 0, sizeof(st));
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    return st;
}
/* 快照缓冲（掩码 2048 位 + dseq 2048 项，覆盖 8MB 块契约） */
static uint8_t  g_mask[256];
static uint32_t g_dseq[2048];

/* 干净加载一个 chunk（miss -> commit，模拟驱动读路径；dseq 保持 0） */
static void clean_load(rb_engine *eng, rb_stream *s, rb_u64 chunk_off)
{
    static unsigned char buf[CHUNK];
    rb_direct_range miss[16]; int mc = 0;
    fill_pattern(g_disk + chunk_off, CHUNK, chunk_off);
    rb_engine_tick(eng, 1000);
    rb_read(s, chunk_off, buf, CHUNK, miss, &mc, 16);
    { int k; for (k = 0; k < mc; k++) {
        unsigned char *tmp = (unsigned char *)malloc(miss[k].len);
        memcpy(tmp, g_disk + miss[k].offset, miss[k].len);
        rb_read_commit(s, miss[k].offset, tmp, miss[k].len);
        free(tmp);
    } }
}

/* ============ 组1：快照等价（逐位一致） ============ */
static void test_snapshot_equiv(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char wbuf[CHUNK + SUB];
    rb_write_pre pre;
    rb_direct_range dr[8]; int dc = 0;
    uint8_t mask_old[256]; uint32_t dseq_old[2048];
    rb_u64 base_old = 0; int bits_old;
    int nb, i, badmask = 0, baddseq = 0;

    printf("== 组1: 快照等价（rb_write_ex 零窗口采集 vs 旧两调用序列） ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xE1u);

    /* 混合状态：
     *   chunk A[0,64K)   整块脏（早期 ack 写；每子块 dseq=1）；
     *   chunk B[64K,128K) 干净已加载（read_commit；dseq=0）；
     *   chunk C[128K,192K) 不存在（从未触碰）。 */
    fill_pattern(wbuf, CHUNK, 0x100);
    { rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc2 = 0;
      CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, wbuf, CHUNK, d, &dc2, 8) == 0, "前置：chunk A 整块吸收"); }
    clean_load(eng, s, CHUNK);

    /* 对照快照（旧流程，只读；缓冲预清零——旧 API 缺 chunk 不写 dseq，
     * 预清零后与 rb_write_ex 的"无条件写 0"逐位同构，见设计 §一-D1）。
     * 区间：[2K, 72K) 非对齐起点，跨 A 全余 16 子块 + B 前 2 子块 = 18 位。 */
    memset(mask_old, 0, sizeof(mask_old));
    memset(dseq_old, 0, sizeof(dseq_old));
    bits_old = rb_stream_dirty_mask(s, 2048, CHUNK + SUB, mask_old, 256 * 8,
                                    &base_old, dseq_old);
    CHECK(bits_old == 18, "旧流程快照：18 个子块（got %d）", bits_old);

    /* 新流程：rb_write_ex 单调用，pass1 同一持锁期采集（写前真值） */
    memset(g_mask, 0, sizeof(g_mask));
    memset(g_dseq, 0, sizeof(g_dseq));
    fill_pattern(wbuf, CHUNK + SUB, 0x200);
    pre.mask = g_mask; pre.dseq = g_dseq; pre.max_bits = 256 * 8;
    pre.base = 0; pre.bits = 0;
    CHECK(rb_write_ex(s, 2048, wbuf, CHUNK + SUB, dr, &dc, 8, &pre) == 0,
          "rb_write_ex 吸收成功（rc=0 dcnt=%d）", dc);
    CHECK(pre.bits == 18, "新流程快照：18 个子块（got %d）", pre.bits);
    CHECK(pre.base == base_old, "base 一致（old=%llu new=%llu）",
          (unsigned long long)base_old, (unsigned long long)pre.base);

    nb = (pre.bits + 7) / 8;
    for (i = 0; i < nb; i++) if (mask_old[i] != pre.mask[i]) badmask = 1;
    CHECK(badmask == 0, "mask 逐位一致（缺 chunk 子块 dseq=0 同构）");
    for (i = 0; i < pre.bits; i++) if (dseq_old[i] != pre.dseq[i]) baddseq = 1;
    CHECK(baddseq == 0, "dseq 逐项一致");

    /* 期望值显式断言：A 的 16 位全脏（bit0..15）；B 的 2 位不脏（bit16..17）；
     * dseq：A=1（早期写一次），B=0（干净加载不升代；缺 chunk 记 0）。 */
    { int expectbad = 0;
      for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (!((pre.mask[i>>3] >> (i&7)) & 1)) expectbad = 1;
      for (i = 16; i < 18; i++) if ((pre.mask[i>>3] >> (i&7)) & 1) expectbad = 1;
      CHECK(expectbad == 0, "mask 期望值：A 全脏 / B 不脏");
      expectbad = 0;
      for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (pre.dseq[i] != 1) expectbad = 1;
      for (i = 16; i < 18; i++) if (pre.dseq[i] != 0) expectbad = 1;
      CHECK(expectbad == 0, "dseq 期望值：A=1 / B=0"); }

    /* 快照采集不干扰写语义：写后读回命中且内容正确 */
    { static unsigned char rd[SUB]; rb_direct_range m[8]; int mc = 0;
      int r = rb_read(s, 2048, rd, SUB, m, &mc, 8);
      CHECK(r == 1 && mc == 0 && memcmp(rd, wbuf, SUB) == 0,
            "写后读回命中且逐字节一致（r=%d mc=%d）", r, mc); }

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 组2：记账等价（C7 逐场景 lost_dirty 相等） ============ */
/* 场景：
 *   a 回滚 + 写前未脏（干净已加载）+ dseq 证据      -> lost 增量 0
 *   b 回滚 + 写前已脏                                -> lost 增量 SUB
 *   c superseded=1 全覆盖                            -> lost 增量 0
 *   d 回滚 + 无证据（不传 pre）                       -> lost 增量 SUB
 *   e 混合子块（部分覆盖）readback 恢复               -> lost 增量 0
 *   f 回滚 + 失败写新建 chunk（缺 chunk dseq=0 证据） -> lost 增量 0
 * mode 0 = 旧流程（dirty_mask + rb_write）；mode 1 = 新流程（rb_write_ex）。 */
static rb_u64 run_scenario(int mode, int sc)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char wr[2 * SUB], big[2 * SUB];
    rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
    rb_write_pre pre;
    rb_stats st;
    rb_u64 off, len, before, after;

    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xE2u);

    off = SUB; len = SUB;   /* a/b/c/d/f 默认单子块 */
    if (sc == 'e') { off = SUB / 2; len = SUB; }

    /* ---- 场景准备 ---- */
    if (sc == 'a') {
        clean_load(eng, s, 0);                 /* 写前未脏（干净已加载） */
    } else if (sc == 'b') {
        fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x333);          /* 早期已 ack 脏 */
        rb_write(s, SUB, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8);
    } else if (sc == 'c') {
        fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x555);
        rb_write(s, 2 * SUB, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8);
    } else if (sc == 'e') {
        fill_pattern(g_disk, 2 * SUB, 0x900);  /* 盘面旧内容（恢复源） */
        fill_pattern(big, 2 * SUB, 0x800);     /* 早期 ack：[0,2SUB) 脏 */
        rb_write(s, 0, big, 2 * SUB, d, &dc, 8);
    } else if (sc == 'f') {
        off = 16 * SUB;                        /* 全新区域：无 chunk */
    }

    before = eng_stats(eng).lost_dirty_bytes;

    /* ---- 失败写（吸收）---- */
    fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x700);
    if (sc == 'e') fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x700);

    if (mode == 0) {
        /* 旧流程：先快照（缓冲预清零）再 rb_write */
        memset(g_mask, 0, sizeof(g_mask));
        memset(g_dseq, 0, sizeof(g_dseq));
        { rb_u64 base = 0;
          int bits = rb_stream_dirty_mask(s, off, len, g_mask, 256 * 8, &base, g_dseq);
          (void)bits;
          rb_write(s, off, wr, len, d, &dc, 8);
          if (sc == 'd') {
              rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, off, len, 0, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);
          } else if (sc == 'c') {
              rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, 2 * SUB, SUB, 1, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);
          } else {
              rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, off, len, 0, g_mask, bits, base, g_dseq);
          }
        }
    } else {
        /* 新流程：rb_write_ex 单调用（pre 采集并入同一持锁期） */
        int use_pre = (sc != 'd' && sc != 'c');
        pre.mask = g_mask; pre.dseq = g_dseq; pre.max_bits = 256 * 8;
        pre.base = 0; pre.bits = 0;
        if (sc == 'c') {
            /* superseded 场景：失败写在 2*SUB（独立脏块），吸收后整块失效 */
            rb_write_ex(s, 2 * SUB, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8, NULL);
            rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, 2 * SUB, SUB, 1, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);
        } else {
            CHECK(rb_write_ex(s, off, wr, len, d, &dc, 8, use_pre ? &pre : NULL) == 0,
                  "场景%c：rb_write_ex 吸收成功（dcnt=%d）", sc, dc);
            if (use_pre) {
                rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, off, len, 0,
                                              pre.bits > 0 ? pre.mask : NULL,
                                              pre.bits > 0 ? pre.bits : 0,
                                              pre.base,
                                              pre.bits > 0 ? pre.dseq : NULL);
            } else {
                rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, off, len, 0, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);
            }
        }
    }

    after = eng_stats(eng).lost_dirty_bytes;
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    (void)st;

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
    return after - before;
}

static void test_accounting_equiv(void)
{
    struct { int sc; const char *name; rb_u64 expect; } cases[] = {
        { 'a', "回滚+写前未脏+dseq证据", 0 },
        { 'b', "回滚+写前已脏",          SUB },
        { 'c', "superseded 全覆盖",      0 },
        { 'd', "回滚+无证据（保守）",     SUB },
        { 'e', "混合子块恢复",           0 },
        { 'f', "失败写新建块(dseq=0)",   0 },
    };
    size_t z;
    printf("== 组2: 记账等价（lost_dirty 逐场景 旧流程 == 新流程） ==\n");
    for (z = 0; z < sizeof(cases)/sizeof(cases[0]); z++) {
        rb_u64 lo = run_scenario(0, cases[z].sc);
        rb_u64 ln = run_scenario(1, cases[z].sc);
        CHECK(lo == cases[z].expect,
              "%s：旧流程 lost=%llu（期望 %llu）", cases[z].name,
              (unsigned long long)lo, (unsigned long long)cases[z].expect);
        CHECK(ln == lo,
              "%s：新流程 lost=%llu == 旧流程（只紧不松）", cases[z].name,
              (unsigned long long)ln);
    }
}

/* ============ 组3：max_bits 不足 → 写成功 + bits=-1 + 保守记账 ============ */
static void test_capacity(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char wr[2 * SUB], rd[2 * SUB];
    rb_write_pre pre;
    rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
    rb_stats st;

    printf("== 组3: max_bits 不足 -> 写成功 + bits=-1 + 保守记账 ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xE3u);

    /* 8KB 写（2 子块）但 max_bits=1 → 容量不足 */
    fill_pattern(wr, 2 * SUB, 0x777);
    memset(g_mask, 0, sizeof(g_mask));
    memset(g_dseq, 0, sizeof(g_dseq));
    pre.mask = g_mask; pre.dseq = g_dseq; pre.max_bits = 1;
    pre.base = 0; pre.bits = 0;
    CHECK(rb_write_ex(s, 0, wr, 2 * SUB, d, &dc, 8, &pre) == 0,
          "容量不足：写照常成功（rc=0）");
    CHECK(pre.bits == -1, "容量不足：bits=-1（got %d）", pre.bits);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "容量不足：正常吸收（dcnt=%d）", dc);
    { rb_direct_range m[8]; int mc = 0;
      CHECK(rb_read(s, 0, rd, 2 * SUB, m, &mc, 8) == 1 &&
            memcmp(rd, wr, 2 * SUB) == 0, "容量不足：数据已吸收且读回一致"); }

    /* 调用方防御分支（bits<0 → 传 NULL）：无证据当有早期脏 → 保守记账。
     * 本块 2 子块皆本次失败写产生，无证据 → 全计 lost = 2*SUB。 */
    rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, 0, 2 * SUB, 0, NULL, 0, 0, NULL);
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 2 * SUB,
          "容量不足后续：保守记账 lost==2*SUB（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);

    /* 对照：容量充足时 bits=2 且 dseq 证据生效（同场景 lost=0） */
    { rb_stream *s2 = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xE4u);
      fill_pattern(wr, 2 * SUB, 0x888);
      memset(g_mask, 0, sizeof(g_mask));
      memset(g_dseq, 0, sizeof(g_dseq));
      pre.mask = g_mask; pre.dseq = g_dseq; pre.max_bits = 256 * 8;
      pre.base = 0; pre.bits = 0;
      CHECK(rb_write_ex(s2, 0, wr, 2 * SUB, d, &dc, 8, &pre) == 0, "对照：吸收成功");
      CHECK(pre.bits == 2, "对照：bits=2（got %d）", pre.bits);
      rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s2, 0, 2 * SUB, 0, pre.mask, pre.bits,
                                    pre.base, pre.dseq);
      st = eng_stats(eng);
      CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == 2 * SUB,
            "对照：dseq 证据生效 lost 不增（got %llu）",
            (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
      rb_stream_flush(s2, 1);
      rb_stream_destroy(s2); }

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* ============ 组4：rb_write 收壳行为不变 ============ */
static void test_wrapper(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char wr[SUB], rd[SUB];
    rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
    rb_stats st;
    rb_u64 wrq0;

    printf("== 组4: rb_write 收壳行为不变 ==\n");
    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 4ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0xE5u);
    fill_pattern(wr, SUB, 0x999);

    /* W19 契约守卫（收壳不前移失效） */
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, wr, SUB, NULL, NULL, 8) == -2, "wrapper：NULL direct -> -2");
    { rb_direct_range dd[8];
      CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, wr, SUB, dd, NULL, 8) == -2, "wrapper：NULL count -> -2"); }
    /* len==0 -> 0 且 direct_count 清零 */
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, wr, 0, d, &dc, 8) == 0 && dc == 0, "wrapper：len==0 -> 0");
    /* 正常吸收：rc=0 dcnt=0 */
    wrq0 = eng_stats(eng).write_req;
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, wr, SUB, d, &dc, 8) == 0 && dc == 0, "wrapper：吸收成功");
    { rb_direct_range m[8]; int mc = 0;
      CHECK(rb_read(s, 0, rd, SUB, m, &mc, 8) == 1 && memcmp(rd, wr, SUB) == 0,
            "wrapper：吸收后读回一致"); }
    /* 统计不双计（收壳只转调一次 rb_write_ex） */
    st = eng_stats(eng);
    CHECK(st.write_req == wrq0 + 1, "wrapper：write_req 单次计数（+%llu）",
          (unsigned long long)(st.write_req - wrq0));
    /* C7 记账经 wrapper 与旧流程相等（场景 b 复跑：回滚+写前已脏 -> lost=SUB） */
    { rb_direct_range d2[8]; int dc2 = 0;
      static unsigned char wr2[SUB];
      uint8_t mask[256]; uint32_t dseq[2048]; rb_u64 base = 0; int bits;
      fill_pattern(wr2, SUB, 0xAAA);
      rb_write(s, SUB, wr2, SUB, d2, &dc2, 8);         /* 早期 ack 脏 */
      memset(mask, 0, sizeof(mask)); memset(dseq, 0, sizeof(dseq));
      bits = rb_stream_dirty_mask(s, SUB, SUB, mask, 256 * 8, &base, dseq);
      fill_pattern(wr2, SUB, 0xBBB);
      rb_write(s, SUB, wr2, SUB, d2, &dc2, 8);         /* 失败写（模拟） */
      rb_stream_invalidate_range_ex(s, SUB, SUB, 0, mask, bits, base, dseq);
      st = eng_stats(eng);
      CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes == SUB, "wrapper：C7 记账不变 lost==SUB（got %llu）",
            (unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes); }

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* [FIX R6-02 回归] direct 区间数超过 max_direct：契约=rc==0 且 *direct_count
 * >max_direct，调用方不得遍历 direct 数组（第 max_direct+1 项从未写入——
 * 驱动侧据此放弃缓存吸收整段直写；遍历即越界读）。
 * 构造：dynamic_limit=2 chunk——chunk0 预写吸收、filler 灌满剩余 1 chunk，
 * 随后 3-chunk 写：chunk0 命中吸收，chunk1 落 direct（dc=1），chunk2 时
 * cnt 已满 → 溢出标记 dc=2>max_direct=1。 */
static void test_direct_overflow(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char wr[4 * CHUNK], rd[4 * CHUNK];
    rb_direct_range d[1]; int dc = 0; rb_write_pre pre;
    int i, rc;

    /* [FIX R6-02c] pre 必须零初始化：mask/dseq 为野指针时 core 的快照采集分支
     * 会解引用它们（ASan 实测 stack-buffer-overflow）。零值 → mask=NULL →
     * core 走 bits=-1 保守分支（无快照），本用例不涉及快照断言。 */
    memset(&pre, 0, sizeof(pre));

    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    if (!eng) { CHECK(0, "direct_overflow：引擎创建失败"); return; }
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0);
    CHECK(s != NULL, "direct_overflow：流创建失败");
    if (!s) { rb_engine_destroy(eng); return; }
    /* dynamic_limit=2 chunk：硬上限=2 chunk（缓存饱和点） */
    rb_engine_set_dynamic_limit(eng, 2ull * CHUNK);

    for (i = 0; i < 4 * CHUNK; i++) wr[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 7 + 1);
    /* 驱动同款语义：direct 段由调用方落盘（本测试整段写 g_disk） */
    memcpy(g_disk, wr, sizeof(wr));

    /* chunk0 与 chunk2 预写吸收（2/2 占满）；随后 4-chunk 写：
     * chunk0 命中吸收 → chunk1 miss（dc=1）→ chunk2 命中吸收 →
     * chunk3 miss 时 cnt 已满 → 溢出标记 dc=2>max_direct=1。
     * （关键：两个 miss 之间必须隔着已缓存 chunk，否则相邻区间被合并。） */
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, wr, CHUNK, d, &dc, 1) == 0, "direct_overflow：chunk0 预写失败");
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 2ull * CHUNK, wr + 2 * CHUNK, CHUNK, d, &dc, 1) == 0,
          "direct_overflow：chunk2 预写失败");
    dc = 0;
    rc = rb_write_ex(s, 0, wr, 4 * CHUNK, d, &dc, 1, &pre);
    /* 契约：区间溢出 → -2 + *direct_count=max_direct+1（驱动侧 <0 即整块直写兜底） */
    CHECK(rc == -2, "direct_overflow：溢出返回 -2（rc=%d）", rc);
    CHECK(dc == 2, "direct_overflow：溢出标记=max_direct+1（dc=%d，应=2）", dc);

    /* 驱动同款兜底语义：整段镜像落盘 + 失效（防旧缓存块覆盖镜像） */
    memcpy(g_disk, wr, sizeof(wr));
    rb_stream_invalidate_range(s, 0, 4 * CHUNK);

    /* 数据正确性：读回 + 调用方 Serve miss（rb_read 不填 miss 段）后逐字节一致 */
    memset(rd, 0, sizeof(rd));
    {
        /* [FIX R6-02b] miss 计数溢出（mc>160）时 core 返回 -2 且不保证数组内容，
         * 此时按"全 miss"处理（整段从盘 Serve）；mc 在界才逐段 Serve。 */
        rb_direct_range ms[160]; int mc = 0; int j;
        int r = rb_read(s, 0, rd, 4 * CHUNK, ms, &mc, 160);
        if (r == -2 || mc > 160) {
            memcpy(rd, g_disk, 4 * CHUNK);
        } else {
            for (j = 0; j < mc; j++)
                if (ms[j].len && ms[j].offset + ms[j].len <= 4 * CHUNK)
                    memcpy(rd + ms[j].offset, g_disk + ms[j].offset, ms[j].len);
        }
        CHECK(memcmp(rd, wr, 4 * CHUNK) == 0, "direct_overflow：读回逐字节一致");
    }
    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* [FIX R6-03 回归] 固定尺寸模式（dynamic_limit==0）下 apply_pressure 不得空转：
 * dl==0 时应以固定上限 max_bytes 为回收目标。压低 max_bytes 后施加高压，
 * 断言 cur_bytes 被压回新上限且 freed>0（修复前恒 return 0）。 */
static void test_pressure_fixed_mode(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    static unsigned char wr[2 * 1024 * 1024];
    rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
    rb_stats st; rb_u64 freed;

    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 2ull * 1024 * 1024;      /* 固定 2MB；不设 dynamic_limit（=0） */
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    if (!eng) { CHECK(0, "pressure_fixed：引擎创建失败"); return; }
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0);
    CHECK(s != NULL, "pressure_fixed：流创建失败");
    if (!s) { rb_engine_destroy(eng); return; }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(wr); i++) wr[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 13 + 5);
    CHECK(rb_write(s, 0, wr, sizeof(wr), d, &dc, 8) == 0, "pressure_fixed：2MB 写失败");
    CHECK(rb_engine_get_dynamic_limit_bytes(eng) == 0,
          "pressure_fixed：前置条件 dynamic_limit==0（got %llu）",
          (unsigned long long)rb_engine_get_dynamic_limit_bytes(eng));

    /* 压低固定上限到 512KB，施加高压：修复前整体早退（freed 恒 0、cur 不动） */
    rb_engine_set_max_bytes(eng, 512ull * 1024);
    freed = rb_engine_apply_pressure(eng, RB_PRESSURE_HIGH);
    memset(&st, 0, sizeof(st));
    rb_engine_get_stats(eng, &st);
    CHECK(freed > 0, "pressure_fixed：固定模式高压回收非零（freed=%llu）",
          (unsigned long long)freed);
    CHECK(st.cur_bytes <= 512ull * 1024,
          "pressure_fixed：cur_bytes 压回新上限（cur=%llu）",
          (unsigned long long)st.cur_bytes);

    rb_stream_flush(s, 1);
    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

/* [FIX QA5-3 回归] W19 契约：NULL 流句柄必须安全返回 -2/不崩溃。
 * 2026-10-21 QA 发现 rb_write_ex/rb_read/rb_read_copy_dirty/rb_read_commit
 * 的 `eng=s->eng` 初始化在判空之前执行——契约承诺的 -2 退化为段错误。 */
static void test_direct_overflow(void);
static void test_pressure_fixed_mode(void);
static void test_null_guards(void)
{
    rb_config cfg; rb_engine *eng; rb_stream *s;
    unsigned char buf[SUB]; rb_direct_range d[8]; int dc = 0;
    int rc;

    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes = 8ull * 1024 * 1024;
    cfg.writeback = wb_fn; cfg.readback = rb_fn;
    eng = rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    if (!eng) { CHECK(0, "null_guards：引擎创建失败"); return; }
    s = rb_stream_create(eng, 0);
    CHECK(s != NULL, "null_guards：流创建失败");
    if (!s) { rb_engine_destroy(eng); return; }

    memset(buf, 0x5A, sizeof(buf));
    /* rb_read(NULL) / rb_write_ex(NULL) / rb_write(NULL)：契约 = -2，不触碰输出 */
    rc = rb_read(NULL, 0, buf, SUB, d, &dc, 8);
    CHECK(rc == -2, "null_guards：rb_read(NULL)==-2（got %d）", rc);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "null_guards：rb_read(NULL) 不写 miss_count（got %d）", dc);
    rc = rb_write_ex(NULL, 0, buf, SUB, d, &dc, 8, NULL);
    CHECK(rc == -2, "null_guards：rb_write_ex(NULL)==-2（got %d）", rc);
    CHECK(dc == 0, "null_guards：rb_write_ex(NULL) 不写 direct_count（got %d）", dc);
    rc = rb_write(NULL, 0, buf, SUB, d, &dc, 8);
    CHECK(rc == -2, "null_guards：rb_write(NULL)==-2（got %d）", rc);
    /* void API：NULL 不得崩溃（无返回值可断言，跑到即过） */
    rb_read_copy_dirty(NULL, 0, buf, SUB);
    rb_read_commit(NULL, 0, buf, SUB);
    /* 负向对照：正常句柄仍工作（守卫前移不能破坏正常路径） */
    rc = rb_read(s, 0, buf, SUB, d, &dc, 8);
    CHECK(rc != -2, "null_guards：正常流 rb_read 不返回 -2（got %d）", rc);

    rb_stream_destroy(s);
    rb_engine_destroy(eng);
}

int main(void)
{
    g_disk = (unsigned char *)malloc(DISK_SIZE);
    memset(g_disk, 0, DISK_SIZE);

    test_snapshot_equiv();
    test_accounting_equiv();
    test_capacity();
    test_wrapper();
    test_direct_overflow();
    test_pressure_fixed_mode();
    test_null_guards();

    printf("\n%s: %d failure(s)\n", g_fail ? "FAIL" : "PASS", g_fail);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
````

````c
/*
 * test_wsconc.c —— [D2/D5] 并发写 + 读 + zoned 回写 + 驱逐 完整性测试
 *
 * 场景（与 deliverables/memlevel-perf-design-2026-10-20.md §七 对应）：
 *   8 写者（顺序推进、随机长度、随机数据，各自独占一片稳定前缀）+
 *   8 读者（只读本片已发布稳定前缀，逐字节校验影子）+
 *   4 zoned flusher（rb_stream_flush_zoned 四路并行回写）+
 *   小 max_bytes（2MB）强制驱逐/回收/回写交织。
 *   文件 1GB（跨 4 个 256MB zone → 4 个 flusher 都有活干；每片仅写前 4MB，
 *   盘/影子数组按虚存分配，实驻内存 ~64MB）。
 *
 * 断言（每轮）：
 *   · 磁盘镜像逐字节一致（各片已发布前缀 g_disk == g_shadow）；
 *   · lost_dirty_bytes == 0（驱逐/回写路径零非预期丢弃）；
 *   · dirty_bytes == 0（force flush 净帧）；
 *   · chunk_count 归零（rb_stream_destroy 后）。
 * 10 轮全过 = 分片链表（UAF/漏摘/锁序）+ ents 锁外预扩容 + 淘汰选择分片版
 * 的正确性兜底；ASAN 构建零报告（use-after-free / 堆溢出具象化）。
 *
 * 竞态安全论证（读者为何不会误报、为何不会数据损坏）：
 *   · 写者顺序推进且只向前：发布水位 W_i 之前的字节均只被写过一次 →
 *     [base_i, W_i) 内容稳定；读者只读该区间。
 *   · 发布顺序：rb_write 返回 → direct 区间镜像落盘（disk_mx）+ 失效缓存旧
 *     副本（superseded=1，驱动同款纪律）→ 影子更新 + W_i 发布（shard_mx）。
 *   · miss 填充只回填【请求交集】内的完整子块：miss 区间按子块对齐，末子块
 *     的未发布尾巴在飞——把未发布字节一并 commit 会在直写路径留下陈旧副本
 *     （[WS-RACE] 实证：盘面已新/缓存仍旧/复读仍不符）；裁剪后 full_cover
 *     自然只缓存稳定的内部子块（代价：边缘子块二次读重取，正确性优先）。
 *   · 脏块不被驱逐（evict_victim 仅取 clean；dirty 先由回写/reclaim 落盘
 *     才可变干净）→ 读者 miss 回源盘面时，盘面内容必已等于影子。
 *   · RMW 补读洞必为"未加载"子块（从未脏过 → 回写器不会碰）→ 盘面即写前值。
 *
 * 编译单元 = test_wsconc.c + cache.c（build_all.bat 常规行，Release+ASAN）。
 */

#include "cache.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define NSHARD    8
#define SHARD_SZ  (128ull * 1024 * 1024)          /* 片间距：跨 4 个 zone */
#define WRITE_SZ  (4ull * 1024 * 1024)            /* 每片实写前缀（顺序推进） */
#define DISKSZ    ((rb_u64)NSHARD * SHARD_SZ)     /* 1GB 逻辑盘（虚存） */
#define CACHEMB   2u                              /* 小缓存强制驱逐 */
#define NFLUSH    4
#define ROUNDS    10
/* 诊断/覆盖开关（argv）：
 * noflush=不起回写线程；bigcache=64MB 缓存（不触发驱逐）；
 * bigwrite=写长上限 64KB→1MB（256 子块）；
 * p21=P2-1 确定性覆盖：max_direct=1——任何写出现 ≥2 个 direct 区间即返回 -2，
 *   强制走"整段镜像+整段失效"主路径（驱动 P2-1 逐字同构；1MB 写长下 direct

 * overlap=全员写同一区域（生产同流重叠写；数据=f(off) 确定性——任意交错
 *   收敛同一字节，对竞态损坏价值不可见，QA Round 3 裁定）；
 * slowwb=回写回调 Sleep(1) 模拟慢盘（放大 [stage,writeback] 时长，非 stage
 *   时机窗口；稀缺环节是回写器恰在两笔连续写 absorb 之间 stage 到边界子块）；
 * mirrorall=有 direct 区间时【整段】镜像+失效——应力模式，非驱动行为
 *   （驱动 dc>0 只逐区间镜像、整段仅 -2；本模式放大交错面以暴露竞态，
 *    通过它不证明驱动路径正确性——QA Round 3 裁定口径）。 */
static int opt_noflush = 0, opt_bigcache = 0, opt_mirrorall = 0, opt_bigwrite = 0, opt_p21 = 0;
static int opt_slowwb = 0;   /* 诊断：回写回调 Sleep(1) 模拟慢盘（放大 [stage,writeback] 时长） */
/* [FIX #1] rewrite = 覆盖式重写模式（变异测试牙口）：每写者对同一片跑两趟，
 * 第二趟用另一 seed（同区间不同数据）——Known Issues 披露的"覆盖式重写"构造。
 * 直写/-2 路径对第二趟的逐区间镜像 + 失效，与在途回写的第一趟旧数据形成
 * 持久污染窗口：变异体（stage_revalidate 恒过 / wb_drain 空转）会让旧数据
 * 落在新镜像之后 → 终检 memcmp(disk, shadow) 失败 = 杀死；
 * 修复版（gen 复检弃写 / drain 排空）盘面收敛到第二趟数据 = PASS。
 * 与 overlap 互斥（overlap 数据=f(off) 确定性，两趟相同——显式取随机路径）。 */
static int opt_rewrite = 0;
static int opt_overlap = 0;  /* 诊断：全员写同一区域（生产同流重叠写；数据=f(off) 确定性，损坏价值不可见） */
#define WRITE_CAP (opt_bigwrite ? (1u<<20) : 65536u)   /* 写长上限：默认 64KB；bigwrite=1MB（P2-1 可达） */
#define WRITE_MAXD (opt_p21 ? 1 : 160)                 /* direct 区间上限：p21=1 强制 -2 路径 */

static unsigned char *g_disk;
static unsigned char *g_shadow;
static rb_engine     *g_eng;
static rb_stream     *g_st;
static pthread_mutex_t g_disk_mx;                 /* 盘面回调 + 读者回源 */
static pthread_mutex_t g_shard_mx[NSHARD];        /* 影子区间 + 水位（读者验证） */
static rb_u64         g_wmark[NSHARD];            /* 每片已发布稳定前缀末端 */
static atomic_int     g_stop;                     /* 读者/回写器停止信号 */
static atomic_int     g_rfail;                    /* 读者校验失败计数（轮末汇总） */
static int            g_fail;

#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { \
    if (!(cond)) { printf("  [FAIL] " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); g_fail++; } \
    else { printf("  [ok]   " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); } \
} while (0)

static unsigned nrand(unsigned *s){ *s = *s*1103515245u+12345u; return *s>>1; }
static unsigned char pat(rb_u64 off){ return (unsigned char)(off*131u+7u); }

/* ---- 盘回调：stripe -> disk_mx（唯一方向，无环）---- */
/* [FIX R9-13 回归网] overlap 模式盘面内容确定性 = f(off)（初值即 f、写者只写 f）。
 * wb_fn 是唯一能把缓存内无效数据（典型：被销毁重建块的零数据）带到盘面的路径。
 * 修复前实测复现（2026-10-21 sweep）：chunk 边界起 5 子块全零被回写覆盖正确
 * 盘面——根因 stage 未复核快照脏位（cache.c stage_run [FIX R9-13]）。
 * 本 oracle 在 memcpy 前逐字节校验，违反即打印现场（段/前后文/盘面前值/水位）、
 * 拒绝落盘并 g_fail++（本轮 exit 非 0）——把静默损坏变成带取证的硬失败。 */
static int wb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 fid,rb_u64 off,const void*b,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    if(off+n>DISKSZ) return -1;
    if(opt_slowwb) Sleep(1);   /* 诊断：模拟慢盘，放大 [stage,writeback] 在途窗口（有牙对照） */
    if(opt_overlap){
        const unsigned char*bb=(const unsigned char*)b; size_t i; int bad=-1;
        for(i=0;i<n;i++){
            rb_u64 o=off+i;
            if(o<(rb_u64)WRITE_SZ && bb[i]!=pat(o)){ bad=(int)i; break; }
        }
        if(bad>=0){
            rb_u64 bo=off+(size_t)bad; size_t k; rb_u64 w0=0;
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
            printf("  [FAIL] R9-13 回写污染：seg_off=%llu seg_len=%zu bad@+%d(abs=%llu) got=%u exp=%u\n",
                   (unsigned long long)off,n,bad,(unsigned long long)bo,bb[bad],pat(bo));
            printf("    staged:");
            for(k=(bad>32?(size_t)bad-32:0);k<n&&k<(size_t)bad+32;k++) printf(" %02x",bb[k]);
            printf("\n    disk  :");
            for(k=(bad>32?(size_t)bad-32:0);k<n&&k<(size_t)bad+32;k++) printf(" %02x",g_disk[off+k]);
            printf("\n");
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_shard_mx[0]); w0=g_wmark[0]; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_shard_mx[0]);
            printf("    wmark[0]=%llu（bad_off %s 水位）\n",
                   (unsigned long long)w0, bo<w0?"低于":"高于");
            g_fail++;
            return 0;   /* 拒绝落盘：盘面保持干净，本轮由 g_fail 判负 */
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
    memcpy(g_disk+off,b,n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
    return 0;
}
static int rb_fn(void*u,rb_u64 fid,rb_u64 off,void*b,size_t n){
    (void)u;(void)fid;
    if(off+n>DISKSZ) return -1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
    memcpy(b,g_disk+off,n);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
    return 0;
}

/* 模拟驱动处理 miss：读盘（disk_mx，短持）-> commit -> 交集拷回。
 * [WS-RACE] miss 区间按整子块对齐，两端可越过请求末端进入"写者在飞"区域
 * （请求 ⊆ 已发布前缀，末子块的未发布尾巴在飞）。把未发布字节一并
 * rb_read_commit 会在直写路径留下陈旧副本——直写"镜像→失效"只更盘不更缓存，
 * 读者持旧盘面建块后，其后读取命中陈旧副本（实证：盘面已新/缓存仍旧）。
 * 收敛：只回填【请求交集】内的完整子块（rb_read_commit 的 full_cover 自然
 * 只缓存完整覆盖的内部子块；首尾边缘子块不缓存——代价是二次读重取该子块，
 * 正确性优先）。驱动侧同款收敛见 rbio.c 直写成功后的 invalidate（宽窗口）；
 * 读者盘读+建块之间的残余微窗为存量竞态，见
 * deliverables/wsrace-fix-report-2026-10-21.md §五。 */
static void serve_miss(unsigned char*out,rb_u64 reqoff,size_t reqlen,
                       rb_direct_range*ms,int mc){
    int k; rb_u64 reqend=reqoff+reqlen;
    for(k=0;k<mc;k++){
        unsigned char*tmp=(unsigned char*)malloc(ms[k].len);
        rb_u64 mend=ms[k].offset+ms[k].len,lo,hi,clo,chi;
        if(!tmp){ atomic_store(&g_stop,1); return; }
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
        memcpy(tmp,g_disk+ms[k].offset,ms[k].len);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
        clo=(ms[k].offset>reqoff)?ms[k].offset:reqoff;
        chi=(mend<reqend)?mend:reqend;
        if(chi>clo)
            rb_read_commit(g_st,clo,tmp+(size_t)(clo-ms[k].offset),
                           (size_t)(chi-clo));
        lo=ms[k].offset>reqoff?ms[k].offset:reqoff;
        hi=mend<reqend?mend:reqend;
        if(hi>lo) memcpy(out+(size_t)(lo-reqoff),
                         tmp+(size_t)(lo-ms[k].offset),(size_t)(hi-lo));
        free(tmp);
    }
}

/* ================= 写者：顺序推进 + 随机长/数据 ================= */
typedef struct { int wid; unsigned seed; } WArg;
static void* writer(void*p){
    WArg*a=(WArg*)p; int wid=a->wid; unsigned seed=a->seed;
    /* [D2-race] overlap 模式：全员写同一区域（生产驱动同流 8MB 块/并发 IRP
     * 天然重叠——-2 竞态需要"写者范围内有他人脏子块"，分片写者永不重叠、
     * 竞态不可见）。数据 = f(off) 确定性函数（与影子/读者校验同源，
     * 任意交错收敛同一字节），影子验证仍成立。
     * [FIX #1] rewrite 优先于 overlap：两趟必须不同数据，强制随机路径。 */
    rb_u64 base=(rb_u64)((opt_overlap&&!opt_rewrite)?0:wid)*SHARD_SZ;
    rb_u64 end=base+WRITE_SZ;
    unsigned char*buf=(unsigned char*)malloc((size_t)WRITE_SZ);
    size_t i; int sweep, nsweep=opt_rewrite?2:1;
    if(!buf){ atomic_store(&g_stop,1); return NULL; }
    for(sweep=0;sweep<nsweep && !atomic_load(&g_stop);sweep++){
    rb_u64 pos=base;
    unsigned sw_seed = sweep==0 ? seed : (seed ^ 0xBEEF1234u);
    if(sweep==1){
        /* 覆盖式重写入口：复位本片水位（读者若在会自然等待新区间；
         * rewrite 模式不建读者，见 run_round）。 */
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_shard_mx[wid]);
        g_wmark[wid]=base;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_shard_mx[wid]);
    }
    for(i=0;i<(size_t)WRITE_SZ;i++)
        buf[i]=(opt_overlap&&!opt_rewrite)?(unsigned char)((base+i)*131u+7u):(unsigned char)nrand(&sw_seed);
    while(pos<end && !atomic_load(&g_stop)){
        size_t room=(size_t)(end-pos);
        size_t cap = room<WRITE_CAP?room:WRITE_CAP;
        size_t len=1+(size_t)(nrand(&seed)%cap);
        rb_direct_range dr[160]; int dc=0,k;
        int wrc = rb_write(g_st,pos,buf+(size_t)(pos-base),len,dr,&dc,WRITE_MAXD);
        /* 直写落地策略：
         *  -2（wrc<0，dcnt=max_direct+1）→ 整段镜像 + 整段失效
         *                    （驱动 P2-1 整块直写路径，与 rbio.c:535-548 逐字同构）；
         *  mirrorall 且 dc>0 → 整段镜像 + 整段失效
         *                    【应力模式，非驱动行为】：驱动 dc>0 只逐区间镜像
         *                    （rbio.c:551-586），整段仅 -2 溢出；本条款把逐区间
         *                    升级为整段以放大在途回写交错面（"加压"），用于暴露
         *                    竞态，通过它**不证明**驱动路径正确性；
         *  dc>0（默认）    → 逐区间镜像 + 逐区间失效（驱动逐字同构）；
         *  dc==0（全吸收） → 不碰盘不失效（驱动亦如此，数据走正常回写——
         *                    core 的 wb_drain 只保护 direct 路径）。
         * 【同构口径精确化】"与 P2-1 逐字同构"仅对 wrc!=0 / dc>160 两个
         * 子句成立；mirrorall 且 dc>0 子句为加压模式、非驱动行为（QA
         * Round 3 裁定，finding-3 闭环）。 */
        if(wrc!=0 || dc>160 || (opt_mirrorall && dc>0)){
            /* -2（direct 溢出）：整段按 direct 落盘（缓存退化，数据正确）；
             * mirrorall 且 dc>0：同上落盘形态，但属加压模式（非驱动行为）。 */
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
            memcpy(g_disk+pos,buf+(size_t)(pos-base),len);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
            /* [FIX WS-RACE] 驱动同款纪律：直写成功后失效同区间缓存旧副本
             * （superseded=1）。core 的 direct 区间=未吸收，但洞期间并发读
             * 回填可在缓存留下写前副本；不失效则其后读取命中陈旧副本
             * （test_wsconc 实证：盘面已新/缓存仍旧/复读仍不符）。 */
            rb_stream_invalidate_range(g_st,pos,len);
        }else if(dc>0){
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
            for(k=0;k<dc;k++){
                rb_u64 o=dr[k].offset; size_t l=dr[k].len;
                if(o<pos){ if(l<(size_t)(pos-o)) l=0; else l-=(size_t)(pos-o); o=pos; }
                if(o+l>end) l=(size_t)(end-o);
                if(l) memcpy(g_disk+o,buf+(size_t)(o-base),l);
            }
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
            /* [FIX WS-RACE] 驱动同款：逐区间直写成功后失效（先镜像后失效） */
            for(k=0;k<dc;k++){
                rb_u64 o=dr[k].offset; size_t l=dr[k].len;
                if(o<pos){ if(l<(size_t)(pos-o)) l=0; else l-=(size_t)(pos-o); o=pos; }
                if(o+l>end) l=(size_t)(end-o);
                if(l) rb_stream_invalidate_range(g_st,o,l);
            }
        }
        pos+=len;
        /* 发布：影子先于水位（读者可见时缓存/盘皆具稳定值）。
         * 仅拷本次段（顺序推进不回头，读者只读 < 水位的稳定区）。
         * overlap 模式全员同区：影子用共享锁（g_shard_mx[0]），数据 f(off)
         * 幂等；水位取 max（读者读全区间均可——初值即 f(off)）。 */
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_shard_mx[(opt_overlap&&!opt_rewrite)?0:wid]);
        memcpy(g_shadow+(pos-len),buf+(size_t)(pos-len-base),len);
        if(pos>g_wmark[(opt_overlap&&!opt_rewrite)?0:wid]) g_wmark[(opt_overlap&&!opt_rewrite)?0:wid]=pos;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_shard_mx[(opt_overlap&&!opt_rewrite)?0:wid]);
    }
    }
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
}

/* ================= 读者：只读本片稳定前缀，逐字节校验 ================= */
static void* reader(void*p){
    int wid=(int)(intptr_t)p;
    /* overlap 模式：全员同区，读者固定读 0 号区（初值即 f(off)，任意可读） */
    rb_u64 base=(rb_u64)(opt_overlap?0:wid)*SHARD_SZ;
    unsigned seed=0x9000u+(unsigned)wid*77u;
    unsigned char*out=(unsigned char*)malloc(65536);
    if(!out){ atomic_store(&g_stop,1); return NULL; }
    while(!atomic_load(&g_stop)){
        rb_u64 w,span,off; size_t len; int r;
        rb_direct_range ms[160]; int mc=0;
        int mwid = opt_overlap?0:wid;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_shard_mx[mwid]);
        w=g_wmark[mwid];
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_shard_mx[mwid]);
        if(w<=base+1){ usleep(100); continue; }
        span=(rb_u64)(nrand(&seed)%(unsigned)(w-base-1));
        len=1+(size_t)(nrand(&seed)%65536);
        if(span+len>w-base-1) len=(size_t)(w-base-1-span);
        if(len==0) continue;
        off=base+span;
        r=rb_read(g_st,off,out,len,ms,&mc,160);
        if(r==-2){
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
            memcpy(out,g_disk+off,len);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
        }else{
            serve_miss(out,off,len,ms,mc);
        }
        /* [FIX QA5-8] overlap 模式写者统一持 g_shard_mx[0] 改共享影子区 0，
         * 读者验证必须持同一把锁（mwid）——原持 g_shard_mx[wid] 与数据不匹配，
         * 构成测试器具数据竞争（只误报、不漏报）。 */
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_shard_mx[mwid]);
        if(memcmp(out,g_shadow+off,len)!=0){
            size_t d; for(d=0;d<len&&out[d]==g_shadow[off+d];d++);
            /* 复读探针：同区间再读一次，区分"瞬态竞态"与"持久错值" */
            static unsigned char probe[65536];
            rb_direct_range pm[160]; int pmc=0; int pr; size_t pd;
            unsigned char diskbyte;
            pr=rb_read(g_st,off,probe,len,pm,&pmc,160);
            if(pr!=-2) serve_miss(probe,off,len,pm,pmc);
            else { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
                   memcpy(probe,g_disk+off,len);
                   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx); }
            for(pd=0;pd<len&&probe[pd]==g_shadow[off+pd];pd++);
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_disk_mx);
            diskbyte=g_disk[off+d];
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_disk_mx);
            printf("  [FAIL] 读者%d off=%llu(len=%zu) diff@%zu got=%u exp=%u "
                   "W@read=%llu（距水位 %lld）；复读@%zu（%s）；盘面该字节=%u(%s)\n",
                wid,(unsigned long long)off,len,d,
                d<len?out[d]:0,d<len?g_shadow[off+d]:0,
                (unsigned long long)w,(long long)(w-(off+d)),
                pd, pd>=len?"一致=瞬态":"仍不符=持久",
                diskbyte, diskbyte==(d<len?g_shadow[off+d]:0)?"盘面对":"盘面也旧");
            /* [FIX QA5-8] 与入口同一把锁（mwid）：break 前也要正确释放 */
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_shard_mx[mwid]);
            atomic_fetch_add(&g_rfail,1);
            atomic_store(&g_stop,1);
            break;
        }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_shard_mx[mwid]);
    }
    free(out);
    return NULL;
}

/* ================= zoned flusher ================= */
typedef struct { int zone; } FArg;
static void* flusher(void*p){
    int zone=((FArg*)p)->zone;
    rb_flushws*ws=rb_flushws_create();
    if(!ws){ atomic_store(&g_stop,1); return NULL; }
    while(!atomic_load(&g_stop)){
        size_t w=rb_stream_flush_zoned(g_st,zone,NFLUSH,ws);
        if(w==0) usleep(200);   /* 无活可干：让出核，避免空转钉核 */
    }
    rb_flushws_free(ws);
    return NULL;
}

/* ================= 单轮 ================= */
static int run_round(int round)
{
    rb_config cfg;
    pthread_t wt[NSHARD], rt[NSHARD], ft[NFLUSH];
    WArg wa[NSHARD]; FArg fa[NFLUSH];
    rb_stats st;
    int i, bad = 0;

    printf("== 轮次 %d/%d（8 写者 + 8 读者 + %d zoned flusher + 2MB 缓存）==\n",
           round, ROUNDS, NFLUSH);

    /* 盘/影子：仅实写前缀需具初值（其余虚存零页，缓存永不触碰） */
    for(i=0;i<NSHARD;i++){
        rb_u64 base=(rb_u64)i*SHARD_SZ; size_t k;
        for(k=0;k<(size_t)WRITE_SZ;k++){
            g_disk[base+k]=pat(base+k);
            g_shadow[base+k]=pat(base+k);
        }
        pthread_mutex_init(&g_shard_mx[i],NULL);
        g_wmark[i]=base;
    }
    atomic_store(&g_stop,0);
    atomic_store(&g_rfail,0);

    memset(&cfg,0,sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.max_bytes=(rb_u64)(opt_bigcache?64u:CACHEMB)*1024*1024;
    cfg.writeback=wb_fn; cfg.readback=rb_fn; cfg.block_size=4096;
    g_eng=rb_engine_create(&cfg);
    g_st=rb_stream_create(g_eng,(rb_u64)(1000+round));
    if(!g_eng||!g_st){ printf("  [FAIL] 引擎/流创建失败\n"); return 1; }

    if(!opt_noflush)
        for(i=0;i<NFLUSH;i++){ fa[i].zone=i; pthread_create(&ft[i],NULL,flusher,&fa[i]); }
    for(i=0;i<NSHARD;i++){ wa[i].wid=i; wa[i].seed=0x1234u+(unsigned)round*999u+(unsigned)i*13u;
                           pthread_create(&wt[i],NULL,writer,&wa[i]); }
    /* [FIX #1] rewrite 模式不建读者：两趟之间的水位复位对读者是瞬态
     * （非数据损坏），终端 memcmp 才是该模式的杀手断言。 */
    if(!opt_rewrite)
        for(i=0;i<NSHARD;i++) pthread_create(&rt[i],NULL,reader,(void*)(intptr_t)i);

    for(i=0;i<NSHARD;i++) pthread_join(wt[i],NULL);
    atomic_store(&g_stop,1);            /* 写净：停读者与回写器循环 */
    /* [FIX #1] rewrite 模式未建读者（水位复位瞬态对读者是噪声）——join 同步守卫 */
    if(!opt_rewrite)
        for(i=0;i<NSHARD;i++) pthread_join(rt[i],NULL);
    rb_stream_flush(g_st,1);            /* serial force（与 zoned 互斥，排空在途） */
    if(!opt_noflush)
        for(i=0;i<NFLUSH;i++) pthread_join(ft[i],NULL);
    rb_stream_flush(g_st,1);            /* 幂等净帧（读者已停，无新脏） */

    /* ---- 终校验 ---- */
    rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
    CHECK(st.dirty_bytes==0, "轮%d：force flush 后脏=0（got %llu）",
          round,(unsigned long long)st.dirty_bytes);
    CHECK(st.lost_dirty_bytes==0, "轮%d：lost_dirty=0（got %llu）",
          round,(unsigned long long)st.lost_dirty_bytes);
    { int diskbad=0;
      for(i=0;i<NSHARD;i++){
        rb_u64 base=(rb_u64)i*SHARD_SZ, w;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_shard_mx[i]);
        w=g_wmark[i];
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_shard_mx[i]);
        if(w<=base) continue;   /* 未写片（overlap 模式仅 0 号区）跳过 */
        if(memcmp(g_disk+base,g_shadow+base,(size_t)(w-base))!=0){
          size_t d; for(d=0;d<(size_t)(w-base)&&g_disk[base+d]==g_shadow[base+d];d++);
          printf("  [FAIL] 轮%d：磁盘!=影子 片%d @+%zu got=%u exp=%u\n",
              round,i,d,d<(size_t)(w-base)?g_disk[base+d]:0,
              d<(size_t)(w-base)?g_shadow[base+d]:0);
          diskbad=1;
        }
      }
      CHECK(diskbad==0, "轮%d：磁盘镜像逐字节一致（各片已发布前缀）",round);
      if(diskbad) bad=1; }
    if(st.dirty_bytes||st.lost_dirty_bytes) bad=1;
    if(atomic_load(&g_rfail)){
        printf("  [FAIL] 轮%d：读者校验失败 %d 次\n",round,(int)atomic_load(&g_rfail));
        bad=1;
    }

    /* chunk_count 归零（销毁后） */
    rb_stream_destroy(g_st); g_st=NULL;
    rb_engine_get_stats(g_eng,&st);
    CHECK(st.chunk_count==0, "轮%d：销毁后 chunk_count=0（got %llu）",
          round,(unsigned long long)st.chunk_count);
    if(st.chunk_count) bad=1;
    rb_engine_destroy(g_eng); g_eng=NULL;

    for(i=0;i<NSHARD;i++) pthread_mutex_destroy(&g_shard_mx[i]);
    return bad;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    int round, bad = 0, a;
    for(a=1;a<argc;a++){
        if(!strcmp(argv[a],"noflush")) opt_noflush=1;
        else if(!strcmp(argv[a],"bigcache")) opt_bigcache=1;
        else if(!strcmp(argv[a],"bigwrite")) opt_bigwrite=1;
        else if(!strcmp(argv[a],"p21")) opt_p21=1;
        else if(!strcmp(argv[a],"slowwb")) opt_slowwb=1;
        else if(!strcmp(argv[a],"overlap")) opt_overlap=1;
        else if(!strcmp(argv[a],"mirrorall")) opt_mirrorall=1;
        else if(!strcmp(argv[a],"rewrite")) opt_rewrite=1;
    }
    g_disk=(unsigned char*)malloc((size_t)DISKSZ);
    g_shadow=(unsigned char*)malloc((size_t)DISKSZ);
    if(!g_disk||!g_shadow){ printf("oom\n"); return 1; }
    pthread_mutex_init(&g_disk_mx,NULL);
    atomic_init(&g_stop,0);
    atomic_init(&g_rfail,0);

    for(round=1;round<=ROUNDS;round++) bad += run_round(round);

    pthread_mutex_destroy(&g_disk_mx);
    free(g_disk); free(g_shadow);
    if(bad||g_fail){ printf("\ntest_wsconc: FAIL（轮失败=%d 断言失败=%d）\n",bad,g_fail); return 1; }
    printf("\ntest_wsconc: PASS（%d 轮：并发写+读+zoned 回写+驱逐，镜像/记账/链表全净）\n",ROUNDS);
    return 0;
}
````

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""A2-S · 并发度扫描：把「FLUSH IRP failed」变成可量化的因果证据

A2 主压测已捕获：
  * rbc_e2e_verify 回写态 8 线程 -> writer thread 2: err=1117 (ERROR_IO_DEVICE)
  * 驱动日志 `ERROR [1426] FLUSH IRP failed: dirty writeback incomplete`
  * 源码 rbio.c:1401-1427：IRP_MJ_FLUSH_BUFFERS 强制 rb_stream_flush(s,1)，
    随后 `rb_stream_dirty_bytes(s) > 0` 即判失败、回 STATUS_IO_DEVICE_ERROR。

假设 H：并发写与强制 FLUSH 交错时，刷脏扫描后仍有新写产生的脏块
        -> 失败率随并发度单调上升。
对照：
  * 直写态 16 线程 -> 应 0 失败（排除工具/环境）
  * 回写态 1 线程 -> 应 0 失败（排除单写路径）
  * 每档 3 次重复 -> 区分必现与偶发

同时判定数据安全性：LostDirtyBytes 是否恒 0、关回写后 --verify-only 是否
逐字节 PASS（区分「拒绝写」与「静默损坏」）。
"""
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5199"
ORACLE = r"C:\Users\Public\o9\rbc_e2e_verify.exe"
LOGF = Path(r"C:\ProgramData\RAMBlockCache\logs\driver-20261109.log")
OUT = Path(r"C:\Users\Public\o9\stress")
PREFIX = r"D:\rbc-a2-sweep"


def rpc(m, p=None):
    body = {"method": m}
    if p is not None:
        body["params"] = p
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/rb/rpc",
                                 data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                                 method="POST")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
        d = json.loads(r.read().decode())
    st = d.get("status")
    if st != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("method=%s status=%s message=%s"
                           % (m, st, d.get("message")))
    return d


def cfg():
    return rpc(4)["data"]


def st():
    return rpc(1)["data"]


def log_error_count():
    if not LOGF.exists():
        return 0
    txt = LOGF.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    return txt.count("FLUSH IRP failed: dirty writeback incomplete")


def run(path, threads, seed, verify_only=False):
    cmd = [ORACLE, "--file", path, "--size", "8", "--seed", str(seed),
           "--threads", str(threads), "--pattern", "stripe4k"]
    if verify_only:
        cmd.append("--verify-only")
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    out = p.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    err = p.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    okt = len(re.findall(r"WRITE_THREAD=\d+ OK", out))
    fails = re.findall(r"\[FAIL\][^\r\n]*", err + out)
    errcodes = re.findall(r"err=(\d+)", err)
    return {"exit": p.returncode, "ok_threads": okt, "threads": threads,
            "fail_messages": fails[:3], "err_codes": errcodes[:3],
            "sha_ok": ("SHA256_EXPECTED=" in out and
                       "MISMATCH_COUNT=0" in out and
                       "RESULT: PASS" in out),
            "stdout_tail": out.strip()[-260:]}


def recovery_failed(res, stage, exc):
    """恢复段失败的统一记账：一条响亮日志 + 结果 JSON 字段（退出码由调用点置）。

    不能让「字段缺失」看起来像「恢复成功」，所以显式写 recovery_error。
    """
    msg = repr(exc)[:200]
    res.setdefault("recovery_error", msg)
    res.setdefault("recovery_stage", stage)
    print(json.dumps({"RECOVERY_FAILED": msg, "STAGE": stage,
                      "ACTION": "manually POST method=2 with the baseline config"},
                     ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


def main():
    print("=== A2-S CONCURRENCY SWEEP ===", flush=True)
    c0 = cfg()
    assert c0["WriteBack"] == 0
    res = {"baseline": {"WriteBack": 0,
                        "flush_error_total": log_error_count()}}
    created = []   # (path, seed, threads) —— 保留写入参数供最终 oracle 复传
    rc = 0

    # 直写态 16 线程对照
    wt = PREFIX + "-wt.bin"
    created.append((wt, 900, 16))
    res["control_write_through_16t"] = run(wt, 16, 900)

    cwb = dict(c0)
    cwb["WriteBack"] = 1
    try:
        rpc(2, cwb)
        res["enable"] = {"readback": cfg()["WriteBack"],
                         "WriteBackMode": st()["WriteBackMode"]}

        levels = [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]
        sweep = {}
        for t in levels:
            rows = []
            for i in range(3):
                path = "%s-t%d-r%d.bin" % (PREFIX, t, i)
                seed = 1000 + t * 10 + i
                created.append((path, seed, t))
                e0 = log_error_count()
                s0 = st()
                r = run(path, t, seed)
                time.sleep(0.5)
                e1 = log_error_count()
                s1 = st()
                r.update({"seed": seed,
                          "new_flush_errors": e1 - e0,
                          "d_LostDirtyBytes": s1["LostDirtyBytes"] -
                          s0["LostDirtyBytes"],
                          "d_DirtyBytes": s1["DirtyBytes"] -
                          s0["DirtyBytes"]})
                rows.append(r)
            failed = sum(1 for r in rows if r["exit"] != 0)
            sweep[str(t)] = {"runs": rows, "fail_runs": failed,
                             "fail_rate": round(failed / len(rows), 2),
                             "flush_errors": sum(r["new_flush_errors"]
                                                 for r in rows)}
        res["sweep_writeback"] = sweep

        # 关回写：自动刷脏 + 丢缓存视图
        rpc(2, c0)
        res["disable"] = {"WriteBack": cfg()["WriteBack"],
                          "WriteBackMode": st()["WriteBackMode"],
                          "DirtyBytes": st()["DirtyBytes"],
                          "LostDirtyBytes": st()["LostDirtyBytes"]}

        # 关回写后逐个做盘面 oracle（视图已丢弃，读必来自盘）
        final = []
        for path, seed, _t in created:
            if not os.path.isfile(path):
                continue
            final.append({"file": path, "seed": seed,
                          "verify": run(path, 8, seed, verify_only=True)})
        res["final_disk_oracle"] = final
    finally:
        try:
            rpc(2, c0)
        except Exception as e:
            rc = 2                      # 恢复失败 -> 非 0
            recovery_failed(res, "restore_rpc", e)
        try:
            res["recovery"] = {"WriteBack": cfg()["WriteBack"],
                               "DirtyBytes": st()["DirtyBytes"],
                               "LostDirtyBytes": st()["LostDirtyBytes"]}
        except Exception as e:
            rc = 2
            recovery_failed(res, "recovery_readback", e)

    for f, _seed, _t in created:
        try:
            os.remove(f)
        except OSError:
            pass

    print("=== SWEEP SUMMARY ===", flush=True)
    print("threads | fail_runs/3 | flush_errors | new_FLUSH_errors", flush=True)
    for t in ("1", "2", "4", "8", "16"):
        s = res["sweep_writeback"][t]
        print("  %-5s | %-11d | %-12d | %s" %
              (t, s["fail_runs"], s["flush_errors"],
               [r["new_flush_errors"] for r in s["runs"]]), flush=True)
    print("control_write_through_16t exit=%s" %
          res["control_write_through_16t"]["exit"], flush=True)
    print(json.dumps(res, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    (OUT / "a2_sweep_result.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(res, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return rc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````
