````python
HELPER_NAME = {"probe_aligned_write": "stats",
               "probe_write_readback_integrity": "stats_sample"}


class StatusEnforcement(unittest.TestCase):
    """153 §A 的 21 个 helper：status 必须真的被比较（§A.6 验收第 3 条）。"""

    def _helper(self, name, mod, _kind):
        return getattr(mod, HELPER_NAME.get(name, "rpc"))

    def test_status_ok_returns_data(self):
        for entry in STATUS_TARGETS:
            name, call, kind = entry
            with self.subTest(target=name):
                mod = importlib.import_module(name)
                saved = urllib.request.urlopen
                urllib.request.urlopen = FakeTransport()
                try:
                    res = call(self._helper(name, mod, kind))
                finally:
                    urllib.request.urlopen = saved
                if kind == "T1":
                    self.assertEqual(res.get("status"), 0)
                    self.assertIn("data", res)
                else:
                    self.assertIsInstance(res, dict)
                    self.assertTrue(res)

    def test_status_minus_one_raises(self):
        for entry in STATUS_TARGETS:
            name, call, kind = entry
            with self.subTest(target=name):
                mod = importlib.import_module(name)
                saved = urllib.request.urlopen
                urllib.request.urlopen = _StatusMinusOne()
                try:
                    if kind == "T3":
                        with contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()) as err:
                            res = call(self._helper(name, mod, kind))
                        self.assertIsNone(res)
                        self.assertIn("WARN counters: rpc status=-1", err.getvalue())
                    else:
                        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as ctx:
                            call(self._helper(name, mod, kind))
                        self.assertIn("status=-1", str(ctx.exception))
                        self.assertIn("injected: IOCTL failed", str(ctx.exception))
                finally:
                    urllib.request.urlopen = saved

    def test_status0_without_data_raises_only_for_t1b(self):
        for entry in STATUS_TARGETS:
            name, call, kind = entry
            if kind != "T1b":
                continue
            with self.subTest(target=name):
                mod = importlib.import_module(name)
                saved = urllib.request.urlopen
                urllib.request.urlopen = _NoData()
                try:
                    with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as ctx:
                        call(self._helper(name, mod, kind))
                    self.assertIn("no data field", str(ctx.exception))
                finally:
                    urllib.request.urlopen = saved


class _StatusMinusOne(object):
    def __call__(self, req, timeout=None, **_kw):
        return _Resp({"status": -1, "message": "injected: IOCTL failed"})


class _NoData(object):
    """status:0 但没有 data 字段 —— 服务端契约破损，T1b 必须拒绝。"""

    def __call__(self, req, timeout=None, **_kw):
        return _Resp({"status": 0})

FAKE_SYS = b"RAMBlockCache.sys FAKE IMAGE 2026-11-12"
FAKE_SHA = hashlib.sha256(FAKE_SYS).hexdigest()
DEPLOY_TXT = "SIGNED sha=%s\nRESULT: OK\n" % FAKE_SHA


def fail_nth_method(n, method):
    """第 n 次调用指定 method 时返回 True（用于只打中 finally 的恢复调用）。"""
    state = {"n": 0}

    def pred(m, _p, _t):
        if m != method:
            return False
        state["n"] += 1
        return state["n"] == n

    return pred


class FakeSysFile(object):
    """DEPLOY_LOG / SYS32 的替身（Path 的两个方法 + exists）。"""

    def __init__(self, text="", data=b""):
        self._text = text
        self._data = data

    def exists(self):
        return True

    def read_bytes(self):
        return self._data

    def read_text(self, encoding=None, errors=None):
        return self._text


def fake_oracle_pass(_path, _threads, _seed, verify_only=False):
    return {"exit": 0, "sha_ok": True, "ok_threads": 0, "threads": _threads,
            "seed": _seed, "fail_msgs": [], "verify_only": verify_only}


def fake_read_group(exe, label, settle=0.8):
    """Q 组命中（阳性对照），P/E 组被排除 —— 只用于把 main() 推到结尾。"""
    if label.startswith("Q"):
        return {"label": label, "exe": exe, "exit": 0, "d_ReadReq": 8,
                "d_ReadHit": 8, "d_ReadBytes": 4096, "excluded": False}
    return {"label": label, "exe": exe, "exit": 0, "d_ReadReq": 0,
            "d_ReadHit": 0, "d_ReadBytes": 0, "excluded": True}
````

````c
/* rbc_lba_probe.c —— [O-9 A1 2026-11-08] 文件起始 LBA 探针（FSCTL_GET_RETRIEVAL_POINTERS）
 * usage: rbc_lba_probe <file1> [file2] ...
 * out :  <firstExtentLBA>\t<sizeBytes>\t<path>   （稀疏/失败打 -1）
 */
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t **argv)
{
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        HANDLE h = CreateFileW(argv[i], FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES,
                               FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
                               NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
        long long lba = -1, size = -1;
        if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
            LARGE_INTEGER li; GetFileSizeEx(h, &li); size = li.QuadPart;
            STARTING_VCN_INPUT_BUFFER in; in.StartingVcn.QuadPart = 0;
            UCHAR out[4096]; DWORD ret = 0;
            if (DeviceIoControl(h, FSCTL_GET_RETRIEVAL_POINTERS, &in, sizeof(in),
                                out, sizeof(out), &ret, NULL) && ret >= 24) {
                RETRIEVAL_POINTERS_BUFFER *r = (RETRIEVAL_POINTERS_BUFFER *)out;
                if (r->ExtentCount >= 1) {
                    long long lcn = (long long)r->Extents[0].Lcn.QuadPart;
                    DWORD bpc = 0;
                    /* LCN×簇大小：簇大小从卷上取不到就由调用方换算，这里直接打 LCN 并按 4K 簇打 LBA */
                    lba = lcn;   /* 暂存 LCN，下面用 FSCTL 取簇大小换算 */
                    wchar_t vol[8];
                    vol[0] = L'\\'; vol[1] = L'\\'; vol[2] = L'.'; vol[3] = L'\\';
                    vol[4] = argv[i][0]; vol[5] = L':'; vol[6] = 0;   /* \\.\X: */
                    HANDLE vh = CreateFileW(vol, 0, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
                                            NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
                    if (vh != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
                        NTFS_VOLUME_DATA_BUFFER nv; DWORD br = 0;
                        if (DeviceIoControl(vh, FSCTL_GET_NTFS_VOLUME_DATA, NULL, 0,
                                            &nv, sizeof(nv), &br, NULL))
                            bpc = nv.BytesPerCluster;
                        CloseHandle(vh);
                    }
                    lba = (bpc && lcn >= 0) ? lcn * (long long)bpc : lcn;
                }
            }
            CloseHandle(h);
        }
        wprintf(L"%lld\t%lld\t%s\n", lba, size, argv[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/support/rbc_pooltags.c`

````c
/* rbc_pooltags.c —— [O-9 2026-11-09] 非分页池标签归因（SystemPoolTagInformation=22）
 * usage: rbc_pooltags.exe [topN]   （默认 25；需管理员）
 * out  : 每行 = tag(4) PagedAllocMB NonPagedAllocMB NonPagedFrees
 */
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

typedef LONG NTSTATUS;
typedef struct _SYSTEM_POOLTAG {
    union { UCHAR Tag[4]; ULONG TagUlong; };
    ULONG PagedAllocs; ULONG PagedFrees; SIZE_T PagedUsed;
    ULONG NonPagedAllocs; ULONG NonPagedFrees; SIZE_T NonPagedUsed;
} SYSTEM_POOLTAG;

typedef struct _SYSTEM_POOLTAG_INFORMATION {
    ULONG Count; SYSTEM_POOLTAG TagInfo[1];
} SYSTEM_POOLTAG_INFORMATION;

#define SystemPoolTagInformation 22
typedef NTSTATUS (WINAPI *PFN_NtQuerySystemInformation)(ULONG, PVOID, ULONG, PULONG);

static int cmp(const void *a, const void *b)
{
    const SYSTEM_POOLTAG *x = *(SYSTEM_POOLTAG * const *)a;
    const SYSTEM_POOLTAG *y = *(SYSTEM_POOLTAG * const *)b;
    return (x->NonPagedUsed < y->NonPagedUsed) ? 1 : (x->NonPagedUsed > y->NonPagedUsed) ? -1 : 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    int top = (argc > 1) ? atoi(argv[1]) : 25;
    HMODULE ntdll = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    PFN_NtQuerySystemInformation q = (PFN_NtQuerySystemInformation)GetProcAddress(ntdll, "NtQuerySystemInformation");
    if (!q) { printf("no NtQuerySystemInformation\n"); return 1; }

    ULONG len = 1 << 20, need = 0;
    PVOID buf = malloc(len);
    NTSTATUS st;
    for (;;) {
        st = q(SystemPoolTagInformation, buf, len, &need);
        if (st == 0xC0000004 /*STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH*/) {
            free(buf); len = need + 65536; buf = malloc(len); continue;
        }
        break;
    }
    if (st != 0) { printf("query failed 0x%08lX (需要管理员?)\n", (unsigned long)st); free(buf); return 1; }

    SYSTEM_POOLTAG_INFORMATION *pi = (SYSTEM_POOLTAG_INFORMATION *)buf;
    ULONG n = pi->Count;
    SYSTEM_POOLTAG **idx = malloc(n * sizeof(*idx));
    for (ULONG i = 0; i < n; i++) idx[i] = &pi->TagInfo[i];
    qsort(idx, n, sizeof(*idx), cmp);

    printf("tag  PagedMB   NPagedMB   NPAllocs      NPFrees   NPLeak(PA-FR)\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < top && i < (int)n; i++) {
        SYSTEM_POOLTAG *t = idx[i];
        char tag[5] = { t->Tag[0], t->Tag[1], t->Tag[2], t->Tag[3], 0 };
        printf("%-4s %8.1f %10.1f %12lu %12lu %14.1f\n", tag,
               (double)t->PagedUsed / 1048576.0,
               (double)t->NonPagedUsed / 1048576.0,
               (unsigned long)t->NonPagedAllocs, (unsigned long)t->NonPagedFrees,
               ((double)t->NonPagedAllocs - (double)t->NonPagedFrees) / 1048576.0);
    }
    free(idx); free(buf);
    return 0;
}
````

##### `tests/support/rbc_uncached_read.c`

````c
/* rbc_uncached_read.c —— [O-9 A1 2026-11-08] 无缓存只读压力器（L2 命中测试用）
 *
 * 跨多文件顺序读，总预算 N MiB，全部 IO 走 FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING，64KB 对齐块。
 * 只读：不写任何用户数据。打开失败的文件跳过（可能被独占占用）。
 *
 * usage: rbc_uncached_read.exe <budgetMiB> <file1> [file2] ...
 * exit:  0=ok 2=usage 3=全部文件失败
 */
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define BLK   (64*1024)
#define FLAGS (FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING | FILE_FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH)

static unsigned __int64 s_Rng;
static unsigned __int64 Rnd64(void)   /* xorshift64*，确定性种子 */
{
    s_Rng ^= s_Rng >> 12; s_Rng ^= s_Rng << 25; s_Rng ^= s_Rng >> 27;
    return s_Rng * 2685821657736338717ULL;
}

/* g_Random：1=随机 64K 块（打 chunk 缓存路径），0=顺序 */
static int g_Random;

static int PumpFile(const wchar_t *path, unsigned __int64 *budget, BYTE *buf,
                    unsigned __int64 *doneAll, DWORD *blocks, ULONGLONG t0)
{
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(path, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
                           NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, FLAGS, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        wprintf(L"[skip] %s GLE=%lu\n", path, GetLastError());
        return 0;
    }
    LARGE_INTEGER sz; GetFileSizeEx(h, &sz);
    unsigned __int64 span = (unsigned __int64)sz.QuadPart;
    if (span > *budget) span = *budget;
    span -= span % BLK;
    const unsigned __int64 spanBlocks = span / BLK;

    unsigned __int64 done = 0;
    while (done < span) {
        OVERLAPPED ov; memset(&ov, 0, sizeof(ov));
        unsigned __int64 off = g_Random ? (Rnd64() % spanBlocks) * BLK : done;
        ov.Offset     = (DWORD)(off & 0xffffffffULL);
        ov.OffsetHigh = (DWORD)(off >> 32);
        DWORD got = 0;
        if (!ReadFile(h, buf, BLK, &got, &ov) || got != BLK) {
            wprintf(L"[x] read failed %s @%I64u MB GLE=%lu\n", path, off >> 20, GetLastError());
            CloseHandle(h);
            return 0;
        }
        done += BLK; (*budget) -= BLK; (*doneAll) += BLK; (*blocks)++;
    }
    ULONGLONG ms = GetTickCount64() - t0;
    wprintf(L"[ok] %s +%I64u MiB (total %I64u MiB, %.0f MB/s avg)\n",
            path, span >> 20, (*doneAll) >> 20,
            ms ? (double)(*doneAll) / 1048576.0 / ((double)ms / 1000.0) : 0.0);
    CloseHandle(h);
    return 1;
}

int wmain(int argc, wchar_t **argv)
{
    int argi = 1;
    if (argc > 1 && (!wcscmp(argv[1], L"-r") || !wcscmp(argv[1], L"--random"))) {
        g_Random = 1; argi = 2;
    }
    if (argc < argi + 2) { wprintf(L"usage: rbc_uncached_read [-r] <budgetMiB> <file1> [file2] ...\n"); return 2; }

    unsigned __int64 budget = (unsigned __int64)_wtoi(argv[argi]) * 1024ULL * 1024ULL;
    s_Rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL;            /* 固定种子：同参数跨遍可比 */
    BYTE *buf = (BYTE *)VirtualAlloc(NULL, BLK, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!buf) return 3;

    unsigned __int64 doneAll = 0; DWORD blocks = 0; int okFiles = 0;
    ULONGLONG t0 = GetTickCount64();
    for (int i = argi + 1; i < argc && budget >= BLK; i++)
        okFiles += PumpFile(argv[i], &budget, buf, &doneAll, &blocks, t0);

    ULONGLONG ms = GetTickCount64() - t0;
    wprintf(L"[done] %I64u MiB across %d file(s), %lu blocks, %llu ms (%.0f MB/s)\n",
            doneAll >> 20, okFiles, blocks, ms,
            ms ? (double)doneAll / 1048576.0 / ((double)ms / 1000.0) : 0.0);
    VirtualFree(buf, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
    return okFiles ? 0 : 3;
}
````
